2174bf02-b726-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Yellowknife Observatory is a ground-based facility in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories, Canada, part of the NASA THEMIS project. It houses an IUGONET instrument for magnetometer readings and contributes to the INTERMAGNET network.
2174bf02-b726-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Yellowknife Observatory, Canada

217f0706-b8f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A fluxgate magnetometer located in Husafell, Iceland, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
217f0706-b8f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Conjugate Observation at Iceland

2181c6e6-b845-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The magnetometers at Castellaccio (CAO) were operational from 1933-01-01 to 1969-12-31 as part of IAGA investigations at the iugonet observatory associated with WDC Kyoto and CAO.
2181c6e6-b845-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Castellaccio Observatory

21855ff8-bbc0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **MAGDAS Addis Ababa Station** is a ground-based facility in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, that operates as part of the MAGDAS magnetometer network, focusing on measuring magnetic field variations.
21855ff8-bbc0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Addis Ababa Observatory, Ethiopia

218c465a-b7ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatório Municipal de Campinas Jean Nicolini (Campinas observatory) is an astronomical observatory located in Campinas, São Paulo, Brazil. Established in 1977, it serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
218c465a-b7ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Jean Nicolini Municipal Observatory at Campinas, Brazil

218cb7e6-b713-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Biaxial Fluxgate Magnetometer on GOES 6** is a spinning twin-fluxgate magnetometer designed to measure the orthogonal components of Earth's magnetic field with high sensitivity and resolution. It was part of the GOES-6 satellite and provided data until September 1991, after which only one component remained operational.
218cb7e6-b713-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Biaxial Fluxgate Magnetometer on Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 6

219795dc-b85b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Richardson (RICH) Magnetometer Station, part of the Mid-continent MAgnetoseismic Chain (McMAC), is situated in Richardson, Texas. It functions as a ground-based facility for magnetometric observations at an altitude of 186.799 meters above Earth's surface.
219795dc-b85b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Mid-continent Magnetoseismic Chain Richardson Station

21a3c8b4-b7ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Pluto Energetic Particle Spectrometer Science Investigation (PEPSSI) is a compact instrument on the New Horizons space probe designed to measure ions and electrons over a wide range of energies and angles.
21a3c8b4-b7ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Pluto Energetic Particle Spectrometer Science Investigation on New Horizons

21a7eda6-b66c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Yazhno-Sakhalinsk Ground Observatory was a geomagnetic observatory located in Russia that operated from 1957 to 1988.
21a7eda6-b66c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Yazhno Sakhalinsk Observatory, Russia

21aff388-bbae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Pleasant Groves Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Pleasant Groves, Jackson County, Alabama. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical observations and research.
21aff388-bbae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Pleasant Groves Observatory, United States

21be1434-bab6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: This entity represents a NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) context for a spacecraft, version 10, which is part of the observatory facilities vocabulary and includes an instrument as its component.
21be1434-bab6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: James Webb Space Telescope

21c16012-b99e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Fluxgate magnetometer at Ewa Beach** is a device within the 210 Magnetic Meridian (210MM) magnetometer network, located at Ewa Beach and part of the IUGONET observatory. It measures magnetic field variations using fluxgate technology.
21c16012-b99e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at IUGONET Observatory

21c2b908-bc73-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The ACOS/PICS at MLSO was an H-alpha telescope imager operational from 1997 to 2010, designed for solar observations with a spatial resolution of 2.9" per pixel and a nominal cadence of 3 minutes.
21c2b908-bc73-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: H-alpha Imager on Precision Infrared Coronal Spectrograph at Mauna Loa Solar Observatory

21d0141a-bb9f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Multicomponent Investigations of Fluctuations of Magnetic Fields (MIF-M) instrument on the Interball Tail Probe is a magnetometer that measures magnetic field fluctuations using triaxial fluxgate sensors and a search-coil, contributing to the ASPI consortium's fields and waves experiments.
21d0141a-bb9f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Multicomponent Investigations of Fluctuations of Magnetic Fields on Interball Tail Probe

21d813f0-b842-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer at KUJ** is a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer located in Kuju, Japan. It is part of the MAGDAS observation network within the IUGONET observatory and measures magnetic field variations with high precision.
21d813f0-b842-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of MAGDAS Observation Network

21d9ef56-b6ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MET on the Phoenix Mars Lander is a suite of sensors designed to measure near-surface temperature, pressure, humidity, and wind on Mars. It includes high-precision thermocouples for temperature and a sophisticated pressure sensor system to study Martian weather and climate.
21d9ef56-b6ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Meteorology Suite, Pressure & Temperature part of Phoenix Mars Lander

21e1cb68-b5de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Fort McMurray (FMM), operational since 1973 and part of the IUGONET Observatory network.
21e1cb68-b5de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Fort Mcmurray Observatory

220733ce-b6ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Glenlea Astronomical Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in St. Adolphe, Manitoba, Canada, near Winnipeg. It is identified by the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code 729 and operates as a ground-based facility.
220733ce-b6ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Glenlea Astronomical Observatory at Winnipeg

2208cd1c-b859-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Energetic Electron and Proton Detector** on Helios-B was a magnetic spectrometer designed to study the origin and distribution of low-energy electrons (17 to 835 keV) and protons (21 to 677 keV). It featured six semiconductor detectors with species separation achieved through an inhomogeneous magnetic field.
2208cd1c-b859-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Electron and Proton Detector on Helios-B

2211071e-ba18-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at the Pebek observatory is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of Earth's magnetic field. It has been operational since January 1, 2001, as part of the IUGONET Observatory network associated with WDC Kyoto.
2211071e-ba18-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet Observatory

22354b74-b9af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Luanda Belas geophysical observatory is a ground-based facility located in Talatona Municipality, Luanda Province, Angola, which operated from 1881 to 1971 and was part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) network.
22354b74-b9af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Luanda Geomagnetic Observatory, Angola

224b5be4-bb8f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Brisbane (BRS), part of the IUGONET observatory network, used to measure magnetic fields for geophysical research.
224b5be4-bb8f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IUGONET Observatory

224df450-b7be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Newport Beach Observatory is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Newport Coast, California, United States, at the coordinates 33.60763° N, 242.18366° E.
224df450-b7be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Newport Beach Observatory, United States

225e5a3e-b912-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The O.M.Ni.A. Observatory in Cesena is a ground-based astronomical facility located at 18, Via Sacco e Vanzetti in the Emilia-Romagna region of Italy. It provides resources for observing and studying celestial phenomena.

226f6322-b621-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Generic Infrared High-Speed Photometer is an instrument designed to measure rapid changes in infrared light intensity, useful for applications such as astrophysics, remote sensing, and material analysis.
226f6322-b621-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Generic Infrared High Speed Photometer

2271704c-b787-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
ISIS 1 was a Canadian ionospheric observatory satellite launched in 1969. It carried various instruments to study the ionosphere and was operated until its deactivation in 1990.
2271704c-b787-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: International Satellites for Ionospheric Studies

2283b952-b767-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Faint Object Spectrograph (FOS) was a near-infrared spectrometer aboard the Hubble Space Telescope that operated from 1990 to 1997, capable of low and high-resolution modes covering wavelengths from 115 to 800 nm.
2283b952-b767-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Faint Object Spectrograph on Hubble Space Telescope

228cdf20-ba03-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Medina Dome Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Medina, North America. It is situated at the coordinates 260.73497 longitude and 29.778158 latitude within the United States.
228cdf20-ba03-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Medina Observatory, United States

2292ab54-b138-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The RAPID (Research with Adaptive Particle Imaging Detectors) instrument on the Cluster-3 mission is a dual-sensor spectrometer designed to analyze suprathermal plasma distributions, measuring electrons and ions in specific energy ranges and providing detailed angular distributions over 180 degrees.
2292ab54-b138-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Research with Adaptive Particle Imaging Detectors part of Cluster 3

2293a68c-b9ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Las Cumbres Observatory Global Telescope Network (LCOGTN) 2m Faulkes Telescope South is an optical telescope located at the Siding Spring Observatory in Australia, with a 2.0-meter aperture, part of the global network managed by Las Cumbres Observatory.
2293a68c-b9ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.0m optical Las Cumbres Observatory Global Telescope Network Faulkes Telescope South at Siding Spring Observatory, Australia

22987bb4-b8b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA-identified station CLZ, operational from 1845 to 1918.
22987bb4-b8b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IAGA Observatory

22a19e74-bad5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Mobil Astronomical Robotics Genon Observatory (MARGO)** is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Nauchnyi, Ukraine. It was established in 2014 and operates under the direction of Gennadiy Borisov.
22a19e74-bad5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mobile Astronomical Robotics Genon Observatory

22a4baf8-b5a0-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Königsleiten Observatory (MPC code: C05) is an astronomical observatory located in Wald im Pinzgau, Salzburg, Austria. It is situated at a latitude of 47.247514 and a longitude of 12.1153.
22a4baf8-b5a0-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Königsleiten Observatory, Austria

22b5b36a-b9c1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The specific device referred to here is a magnetometer located at the Hurbanovo ground station in Kyoto, part of the IAGA investigation, operational since January 1, 1900.
22b5b36a-b9c1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hurbanovo Observatory

22c35e88-b8c8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: SuperWASP is an extra-solar planet detection program operating from the Roque de los Muchachos Observatory in Spain (SuperWASP-North) and the South African Astronomical Observatory (SuperWASP-South), using optical wavebands for ground observations.
22c35e88-b8c8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical SuperWASP extra-solar planet detection program at Roque de los Muchachos Observatory and South African Astronomical Observatory

22cc187c-b7bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Energetic Particle Monitor on GOES 5 is an instrument consisting of three detector assemblies designed to monitor protons, alpha particles, and electrons across various energy ranges. It provides data through 25 channels, each sampling at different rates.
22cc187c-b7bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Monitor on Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 5

22cef0be-b89f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The IAGA Magnetometer at the Fresno ground station, operational since 1982, is part of the global network monitoring geomagnetic activity under the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA).
22cef0be-b89f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet Observatory

22d278c2-b982-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Venus Express**: An ESA spacecraft designed to study the atmosphere and plasma environment of Venus from orbit. Launched in 2005, it conducted comprehensive research on Venus' atmospheric dynamics, greenhouse effect, cloud formation, and interactions with solar winds until its mission ended in 2014.
22d278c2-b982-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Venus Monitoring Camera on Venus Express

22e00ab6-b69c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Seismic Experiment for Interior Structure (SEIS)** is a seismometer deployed by the InSight Mars Lander to measure Marsquakes and internal activity, providing insights into Mars' internal structure.
22e00ab6-b69c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Seismic Experiment for Interior Structure part of InSight

22eb6234-b788-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A Magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The Equatorial Magnetometer Network (EMN) utilizes a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer installed at Kuju, Japan, as part of the IUGONET Observatory for monitoring geomagnetic activity.
22eb6234-b788-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of The Equatorial Magnetometer Network

22ece496-b6c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Fréconrupt Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in La Broque, France. It is a ground-based facility situated at 2, Chemin du Champ d'Albet, primarily used for astronomical observations and research.
22ece496-b6c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Freconrupt Observatory, France

22efd576-ba58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Atmosphere Structure Experiment** was a suite of instruments on the Pioneer Venus Small Probe (Day), designed to measure temperature, pressure, and wind velocities in Venus's atmosphere. It utilized an accelerometer and various sensors to profile atmospheric conditions from the surface up to 140 km altitude.
22efd576-ba58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Atmosphere Structure Experiment for Pioneer Venus Small Probe part of Pioneer Venus

22f6358c-b699-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tokai Observatory (MPC ID: 879) is an astronomical observatory located in Toyota, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
22f6358c-b699-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tokai Observatory, Japan

23081cd6-b59d-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Arctic Village Geomagnetic Observatory (AVI) is a ground-based facility located in Unorganized Borough, Alaska, United States, established on January 1, 1979, for geomagnetic research and observation.
23081cd6-b59d-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Arctic Village Geomagnetic Observatory

230b1728-b751-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Kottamia Astronomical Observatory is the largest telescope in the Arab world, located approximately 80 km from Cairo, Egypt. It houses a 1.88-meter diameter main mirror and is operated by the National Research Institute of Astronomy and Geophysics (NRIAG).
230b1728-b751-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.88m Telescope at Kottamia Astronomical Observatory, Egypt

23206506-b698-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Midway Island Magnetic Observatory was a ground-based magnetic observatory located on Midway Island in the United States, operated by the United States Geological Survey from 1964 to 2002.
23206506-b698-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Midway Island Magnetic Observatory, United States

23210908-b755-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
GOES 8 is a geosynchronous operational spacecraft developed by NASA and operated by NOAA. It carries systems for imaging, atmospheric sounding, meteorological data collection, space environment monitoring, search and rescue, and weather information dissemination, aimed at enhancing weather forecasting and environmental monitoring capabilities over the United States.
23210908-b755-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Space Environment Monitor part of Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 8

23460dde-b6b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BOOTES-2 Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Algarrobo, Spain. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
23460dde-b6b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: BOOTES-2 Observatory at Estación Experimental IHSM La Mayora Observatory, Spain

234c7d98-b617-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Catalina 40" Telescope** is an astronomical observatory located on Mount Lemmon in Arizona, U.S., part of the Catalina Sky Survey.
234c7d98-b617-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Catalina 1m Telescope at Mount Lemmon Station, United States

23594398-bb94-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 1-m photometric Cassegrain reflector is a telescope with a 1-meter diameter located at the European Southern Observatory in La Silla, Chile. It has been operational since 1966 and is situated at an altitude of 2347 meters above sea level.
23594398-bb94-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1m Telescope at European Southern Observatory, Chile

23639fd4-b8a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Hot Plasma Composition Analyzer (HPCA) on MMS3 is a Mass Spectrometer instrument that measures the velocity-space distribution of ions with energies from 1 eV to 40 keV, providing composition data with a time resolution of 10 to 15 seconds.
23639fd4-b8a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mass Spectrometer Hot Plasma Composition Analyzer on MMS3

2364b140-b7e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Neutral Atmosphere Composition Experiment (NACE)** on the AE-E satellite was a mass spectrometer designed to measure the spatial distribution and temporal changes of neutral atmospheric species, with an emphasis on hydrogen, helium, oxygen, nitrogen, and argon. It operated within the 1 to 44 atomic mass units range and provided insights into in situ measurement techniques through comparisons with other onboard experiments.
2364b140-b7e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mass Spectrometer part of Neutral Atmosphere Composition Experiment on AE-E

23693118-baae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Addis Ababa Geomagnetic Observatory (AAE) is a ground-based facility located in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, that monitors the Earth's magnetic field. It has been operational since January 1958 and is part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) observatory network.
23693118-baae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Addis Ababa Geomagnetic Observatory

237245ee-bb64-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BAS Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Scandicci, Italy, dedicated to ground-based observations.
237245ee-bb64-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: BAS Observatory, Italy

2375e2ec-b878-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lynn Lake Geomagnetic Observatory (LYN) is a ground-based facility located in West Lynn Heights, Manitoba, Canada. It operates as part of the International Union of Geodesy and Geophysics (IUGG) network and specializes in geomagnetic measurements using instruments such as magnetometers since 1986.
2375e2ec-b878-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Lynn Lake Geomagnetic Observatory, Canada

2379c180-b866-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Qaanaaq (Thule) Magnetic Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Thule, Greenland, that has been operating since 1956 to monitor magnetic activity on Earth.
2379c180-b866-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Qaanaaq Thule Magnetic Observatory, Greenland

238c1e9e-b5ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The SAMBA Magnetometer Array is a ground-based scientific instrument comprising fluxgate magnetometers, specifically the one located at the La Serena geomagnetic observatory.
238c1e9e-b5ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at La Serena Observatory

238ea3a2-b8c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 1.07-m Hall Ritchey-Chretien Reflector #1 is a telescope located at the Lowell Observatory in Arizona, United States, operational since 1970. It is situated at an altitude of 2200 meters and is part of NASA's Planetary Data System (PDS) context for observational facilities.
238ea3a2-b8c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.07m Hall Ritchey-Chretien Reflector #1 at Lowell Observatory, United States

23921106-bb1b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Park Site Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation since 2007.
23921106-bb1b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of THEMIS Mission

239c6508-bbb5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Clinton B. Ford Observatory is an astronomical observatory operated by the Ithaca College Department of Physics and Astronomy, located on the south end of the Ithaca College campus in Ithaca, New York. It houses a 16-inch Cassegrain telescope and is used for astronomy classes and student research projects.
239c6508-bbb5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Clinton B. Ford Observatory, United States

239d053e-b8aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Stardust Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Brașov, Romania. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
239d053e-b8aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stardust Observatory, Romania

23a20a82-b9dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Estels Observatory** is an astronomical facility located in Ager, Catalonia, Spain. It is a ground-based observatory used for various astronomical observations and research purposes.
23a20a82-b9dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Parc Astronòmic Montsec Observatory, Spain

23be083e-b6d3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cap.Thordsen Magnetometer is an instrument located at a station identified by IAGA as CTH, used for measuring magnetic fields starting from January 1, 1883.
23be083e-b6d3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Cap.Thordsen Observatory

23c95be2-b77f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The **Mawson Riometer**, located at the Mawson station in Antarctica, is a ground-based instrument used to measure ionospheric absorption by comparing received cosmic radio noise with a calibration curve. It has been operational since December 1989 and is part of the Iugonet Observatory network.
23c95be2-b77f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer part of Australian Bureau of Meteorology's Space Weather Services, Antarctica

23eee108-b9bb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Lo Fossil Observatory:** An astronomical observatory located in Ager, Catalonia, Spain. It is a ground-based facility known for its contributions to astronomical research and observations.
23eee108-b9bb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lo Fossil Observatory, Spain

23fab1fa-bacd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hel Magnetic Observatory is a ground-based magnetic observatory located in Hel, Poland. It has been operating since 1901 and is managed by the Institute of Geophysics of the Polish Academy of Sciences.
23fab1fa-bacd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Obserwatorium Geofizyczne w Helu, Poland

240e02e8-b7dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Wilcox Solar Observatory (WSO) is a space facility located in the Heliosphere near Earth, designed to monitor and study solar magnetic fields. It includes instruments such as the Babcock magnetograph for detailed observations.
240e02e8-b7dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wilcox Solar Observatory

240febe8-b5b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Dar Es Salaam (DRS) that was operational from January 1896 to December 1903 and used for magnetic field measurements as part of the IAGA investigation.
240febe8-b5b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Dar Es Salaam Observatory

242cde9c-b6df-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Harrow Observatory is an astronomical observatory located at Harrow School in London, England (Minor Planet Center ID: 973).
242cde9c-b6df-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Harrow Observatory

2436e6a2-b979-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **VLF/ELF Nain station** in Labrador, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada, is a ground-based observatory equipped with a VLF/ELF crossed loop antenna, primarily used for research and monitoring of very low frequency (VLF) and extremely low frequency (ELF) signals.
2436e6a2-b979-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: VLF/ELF Crossed Loop Antenna at Nain Station, Canada

2439d3bc-b16d-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The VLF Electromagnetic Waves (NVK-ONCH) instrument is part of the Interball Auroral Probe mission, designed to measure very low frequency electromagnetic waves within the range of 20 Hz to 20 KHz.
2439d3bc-b16d-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: VLF Electromagnetic Waves on Interball Auroral Probe part of Interball 2

243a41e6-b61b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the New Year Island station, operational from 1902 to 1916, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the IAGA investigation.
243a41e6-b61b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy

24415ba0-b73f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) All-Sky Imager at Kevo, Finland is a multi-wavelength instrument designed to study the dynamics of the upper atmosphere by observing nocturnal airglow emissions. It was developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research at Nagoya University and operates as part of the IUGONET Observatory network.
24415ba0-b73f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Imager part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers

2444867a-bb6a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ISEE Magnetometer** is an induction magnetometer located in Kapuskasing, which measures variations in the three-dimensional vector geomagnetic field with a sampling rate of 64 Hz.
2444867a-bb6a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Induction Magnetometer part of International Satellites for Earth Exploration

2454fd7c-b69a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **JPL SynTrack Robotic Telescope 2** is an astronomical observatory located in Auberry, California, operated by Sierra Remote Observatories.
2454fd7c-b69a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: JPL SynTrack Robotic Telescope 2 at Auberry Observatory, United States

24741f3c-bb7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Allan I. Carswell Astronomical Observatory is an astronomical observatory owned and operated by York University, located in the North York district of Toronto, Ontario, Canada. It was established in 1969 and is open to both researchers and amateur astronomers.
24741f3c-bb7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Allan I. Carswell Astronomical Observatory, Canada

247547bc-b94c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the La Ronge Geophysical Observatory, operating since 2007 as part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation.
247547bc-b94c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at La Ronge Observatory

247ce238-b848-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) instrument on the Hayabusa spacecraft used a 1064 nm YAG-Nd laser to measure topography by determining the time of flight of reflected laser pulses.
247ce238-b848-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Light Detection and Ranging Instrument on Hayabusa

249cf420-ba77-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Krasnopresnenskaja Observatory MSU is an astronomical observatory and architectural landmark located in the Presnensky District of Moscow, Russia. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and education.
249cf420-ba77-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Krasnopresnenskaja Observatory

24b75f90-b914-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a ground-based observatory located in Eberstadt, Darmstadt, Hesse, Germany at the coordinates 49.81044 N, 8.65736 E. It is known as the "Darmstadt Observatory."
24b75f90-b914-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Darmstadt Observatory, Germany

24c18590-b77c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Willow Bank Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in West Yorkshire, England. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to observing celestial bodies and phenomena.
24c18590-b77c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Willow Bank Observatory, United Kingdom

24c90acc-b871-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Energetic Particle, Composition and Thermal Plasma Suite (ECT) is an instrument suite designed to measure the spatial, temporal, and pitch angle distributions of electrons and ions in Earth's magnetosphere. It aims to understand particle acceleration mechanisms, plasma wave production, and the control of these processes by the inner magnetospheric plasma environment.
24c90acc-b871-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle, Composition and Thermal Plasma Suite part of Radiation Belt Storm Probes

24d132a2-bb6d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The magnetometer at Husafell (HUS) is an instrument used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field as part of the IAGA observatory network in Kyoto.
24d132a2-bb6d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy Investigation

24d345d4-b8b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Baldwin Geomagnetic Observatory (BAL)** is a ground-based facility located in Baldwin City, Kansas, United States. It operated from 1901 to 1909 and was part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) observatory network, focusing on geomagnetic measurements.
24d345d4-b8b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Baldwin Geomagnetic Observatory, United States

24da2194-b7eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The THEMIS Energetic Particle Instrument (Solid State Telescope) measures the incoming intensity of superthermal electrons and ions, primarily between 30-100 keV for electrons and 30-300 keV for ions, with a maximum capability up to 1000 keV for electrons and 6000 keV for ions. It uses two units equipped with opposing sensors to cover 92% of the sky, and includes features like magnetic contamination reduction and mechanical attenuation to enhance its dynamic range.
24da2194-b7eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solid State Telescope part of THEMIS

24ecce12-b786-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Surface Science Package (SSP)** was an experiment on the Huygens Probe designed to measure various physical properties of Titan's lower atmosphere, surface, and sub-surface using nine separate sensors. It contributed to understanding Titan's near-surface environment and complemented other experiments on the probe during its descent.
24ecce12-b786-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Surface Science Package part of Huygens Probe

24f19e5a-b60b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Kottamiacode (M40) refers to the National Research Institute of Astronomy and Geophysics (NRIAG), known as OSTS-NRIAG. It is a ground observatory located in Al Qattamya, Ain Sokhna Road, Cairo, Egypt, at coordinates 29.936° N, 31.82708° E on the African continent.
24f19e5a-b60b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kottamiacode Observatory, Egypt

24f38062-bcaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The OSIRIS-REx Camera Suite (OCAMS) is a set of three cameras onboard the OSIRIS-REx spacecraft, designed for navigation, surface mapping, and documenting sample collection during its mission to asteroid Bennu.
24f38062-bcaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: OSIRIS-REx Camera Suite on OSIRIS-REx spacecraft

24f7fe16-b5da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Particle Counter is an instrument used in the ISEE atmospheric aerosol observation at Wakayama, designed to measure particle size distributions. It is part of the IUGONET Observatory facilities and specifically operates within the ISEE miscellaneous investigations.
24f7fe16-b5da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Particle Counter part of ISEE Investigation

24ff670a-b990-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tien Shan Astronomical Observatory (TSHAO) is an astronomical observatory situated in the Tien Shan Mountains of Kazakhstan at an altitude of 2,800 meters. It is known for its photometric studies of variable stars and eclipsing systems within the Milky Way galaxy.
24ff670a-b990-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tien Shan Astronomical Observatory, Kazakhstan

25027116-b909-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Goose Bay (GBAY) station** is a ground-based observatory located in Happy Valley-Goose Bay, NL, Canada, part of the UCLA GBO Network and NASA's THEMIS project, primarily used for geophysical measurements.
25027116-b909-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Goose Bay Geophysical Observatory, Canada

2504482e-ba9e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Interball-1 (1995-039A)** is an artificial satellite and part of the Interball Project, a multinational space mission aimed at studying solar wind energy transmission to the magnetosphere and its subsequent dissipation during magnetospheric substorms.
2504482e-ba9e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Camera and Multi-Object Spectrometer on Hubble Space Telescope

25083536-bc53-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ottawa Magnetic Observatory is a ground-based facility in Ottawa, Canada, equipped with a magnetometer to measure and monitor the Earth's magnetic field. It has been operational since January 1968 and is funded by the Geological Survey of Canada.
25083536-bc53-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ottawa Magnetic Observatory, Canada

251b7710-b6a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The European Southern Observatory (ESO) is an intergovernmental research organization for ground-based astronomy located in Chile, established to provide astronomers with advanced research facilities and access to the southern sky.
251b7710-b6a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: European Southern Observatory, Chile

2524543e-b5e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Peach Mountain Observatory (PMO) is an astronomical observatory operated by the University of Michigan, located near Dexter, Michigan. It facilitates research, instruction, and amateur astronomy activities.
2524543e-b5e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 26m Radio Astronomy Telescope at Peach Mountain Observatory, United States

25259f2e-b68e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ager Observatory is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Àger, Noguera, Lleida, Catalonia, Spain (coordinates: 42.01871°N, 0.7439°E). It operates under the label "Ager" and serves as a site for various observational activities.
25259f2e-b68e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.5m Telescope at Ager Observatory, Spain

2531d46a-baf3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **Magnetometer** is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The specific instrument referred to here, the MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer installed at Bengkulu (BKL), Indonesia, operates within the MAGDAS observation network and utilizes a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate design for precise measurements.
2531d46a-baf3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

2538cf8a-bacc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sidmouth Geomagnetic Observatory (SDH), located in Sidmouth, United Kingdom, is a ground-based facility dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity on Earth's surface. It operates under the sponsorship of the U.K. and contributes to global geomagnetic data collection efforts.
2538cf8a-bacc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Sidmouth Geomagnetic Observatory, United Kingdom

253be494-b8ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Lunar Crater Observation and Sensing Satellite (LCROSS) Total Luminance Photometer (TLP)** was an instrument designed to measure the total impact flash luminance and decay of the luminance curve by capturing visible light intensity data at a 1000 Hz sampling rate. It consisted of a Sensor Electronics Module with an uncooled avalanche photodiode and a Digital Electronics Module for signal conversion, mounted on the LCROSS spacecraft.
253be494-b8ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Total Luminescence Photometer on Lunar Crater Observation and Sensing Satellite

254bb664-b774-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Strawberry Field Observatory:** An astronomical observatory located in Southampton, England, known for its ground-based facilities.
254bb664-b774-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Southampton Observatory, United Kingdom

255534e8-b8ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GOES 16 Spacecraft Ephemeris is a dataset providing the position and trajectory information for the GOES-16 satellite, which is part of the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite (GOES) system.
255534e8-b8ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spacecraft Position on GOES 16

25564e60-bba9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Energetic Particles Detector (EPD) is an instrument developed for NASA's Galileo Program by The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory and the Max Planck Institute of Aeronomy. It measures the energy and angular distribution of ions, electrons, ion composition, and various elemental species within specific energy ranges.
25564e60-bba9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particles Detector part of Galileo

25571bac-b72a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Cebu Geomagnetic Observatory (CCP)** was a ground-based facility in Cebu City, Philippines, operating from 1961 to 1963 to monitor geomagnetic activity.
25571bac-b72a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Cebu Geomagnetic Observatory, Philippines

255fd468-b77a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Shigaraki Barometric Sensor is a ground-based facility installed in 2006 by Prof. Toshihiko Iyemori at Kyoto University, located in Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It is used for micro-barometric observations and features a VAISALA PTB210 sensor.
255fd468-b77a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Barometric Sensor at Shigaraki Observatory, Japan

25612b1a-b793-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Donna Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation since November 14, 2007.
25612b1a-b793-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Donna Geophysical Observatory

2566c216-b6b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Murray Hill Observatory:** An astronomical observatory located in Beaverton, Oregon, United States, specifically at 15845 Southwest Breccia Drive. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to stargazing and celestial observations.
2566c216-b6b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Murray Hill Observatory

256939ae-bb6c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Piura Geomagnetic Observatory (PIU), located in La Esmeralda, Colán, Province of Paita, Peru, is a ground-based facility operating since 2000 that monitors geomagnetic activity.
256939ae-bb6c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Piura Geomagnetic Observatory, Peru

256d6aec-b801-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "ISEE atmospheric observation" instrument is a laser-induced fluorescence detector specifically designed to measure nitrogen dioxide (NO2) levels. It operates as part of the IUGONET Observatory's ISEE facility in Fukue, Japan.
256d6aec-b801-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spectrometer part of ISEE Atmospheric Observation

257700d8-b834-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Equatorial Magnetometer Network's (EMN) 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer located in Cuiaba, Brazil is an instrument used to measure magnetic field variations and is part of the IUGONET observatory.
257700d8-b834-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of The Equatorial Magnetometer Network

25770ce6-bbda-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MMS 3 FIELDS Suite, Search Coil Magnetometer (SCM) is an instrument designed to measure the three-axis AC magnetic field up to 6 kHz, aiding in the study of plasma waves and turbulent dissipation in space. It was developed by the Centre d'étude des Environnements Terrestre et Planétaires and has been operational since March 13, 2015.
25770ce6-bbda-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Search Coil Magnetometer on MMS 3 FIELDS Suite

257f1e30-b5c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A CPMN fluxgate magnetometer at DAL is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed at Dalby, Australia, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
257f1e30-b5c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Circum-pan Pacific Magnetometer Network observation network

2588e7c2-bb08-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ESA Optical Ground Station (OGS Telescope) is an observatory operated by the European Space Agency at Teide Observatory in Tenerife, Spain, dedicated to monitoring space debris.
2588e7c2-bb08-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.0m European Space Agency Optical Ground Station at Teide Observatory, Spain

259d2704-b92e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The specific type mentioned here refers to those located at the Kandalakcha observatory in Kyoto, part of the IUGONET network, which are used for geomagnetic research and monitoring.
259d2704-b92e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kandalakcha Observatory

25a038a4-b7d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetometer at Kontagora (KNT) was an instrument used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the IAGA investigation from 1964 to 1965. It was situated at the observatory identified by WDC Kyoto and was a component of the iugonet-observatory network.
25a038a4-b7d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IUGONET Observatory WDC Kyoto WDC KNT

25b37738-b6e6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Riometer Nyrola Station, located in Jyväskylä, Finland, is a ground-based facility developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research (ISEE) at Nagoya University to study upper atmospheric dynamics through nocturnal airglow emissions. It operates as part of a collaborative effort with the Institute of Cosmophysical Research and Aeronomy.
25b37738-b6e6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer at Nyrola Observatory, Finland

25b58d0c-b858-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Science Laboratory (MSL) Curiosity Rover rear Hazard Avoidance Cameras (Hazcams), specifically the left string A camera, are designed to assist with navigation and safety by providing high-resolution images of the terrain behind the rover, helping to detect potential obstacles and ensure safe travel on Mars.
25b58d0c-b858-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rear Hazard Avoidance Camera on Mars Science Laboratory Curiosity Rover

25b78aee-b6c8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Weipa Ionospheric Scintillation Monitor** is a ground-based instrument located near Weipa, Queensland, Australia, designed to monitor ionospheric scintillation levels in real time using GPS signals. It collects and stores scintillation statistics for visible GPS satellites to study ionospheric disturbances.
25b78aee-b6c8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionospheric Scintillation Monitor part of Weipa Observatory, Australia

25be4bb8-bae7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to magnetometers located at the Srednikan observatory, which were operational from January 1, 1936, to December 31, 1966, as part of the IAGA investigation.
25be4bb8-bae7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet Observatory

25c1ede8-b792-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Vitebsk Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Zachodniki, Vitsebsk Region, Belarus, established in 1992. It is situated at an altitude of 180 meters and focuses on ground-based observations.
25c1ede8-b792-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Vitebsk Observatory, Belarus

25cb4174-b600-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DSX/SET1 is an Energetic Particle Instrument designed to characterize space radiation environments, focusing on measuring total ionizing dose, displacement damage, and single event effects using various dosimetry techniques. It aims to validate particle transport codes and inform future mission dosimetry selection to resolve operational anomalies.
25cb4174-b600-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dosimetry Inter-comparison and Miniaturization Experiment Board #1 and Dosimetry Inter-comparison and Miniaturization Experiment Board #2 part of Demonstration and Science Experiments Mission

25ce8154-b81c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kashima Space Research Center 34m Radio Telescope is a large radio telescope located in Asia with an aperture of 34 meters, used for astronomical observations and research.
25ce8154-b81c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 34m Radio Telescope at Kashima Space Research Center

25dc0b04-b74e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) All-sky imager at Rikubetsu, Japan is a multi-wavelength instrument designed to study the dynamics of the upper atmosphere through nocturnal airglow emissions. It was developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research at Nagoya University and is part of the IUGONET observatory network.
25dc0b04-b74e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: multi-wavelength All-Sky Imager part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Investigation

25dded64-b6ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IDP Particle Spectrometer is an instrument designed to measure the fluxes of energetic electrons within the energy range of 60 keV to 600 keV. It is part of the DEMETER mission, operated by CNES and archived at CDPP.
25dded64-b6ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Particle Spectrometer Instrument part of DEMETER Mission

25e15c82-b9bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a ground-based observatory located in Via Don Pietro Zini, Barnasc, Abbiate Guazzone, Tradate, Varese, Lombardy, Italy. It is identified by the code B39 and situated at coordinates 45.71223 latitude and 8.9072 longitude in Europe.
25e15c82-b9bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tradate Observatory, Italy

25f67022-b6de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The **BARREL (Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1S Ephemeris** is a virtual instrument providing trajectory positions in various coordinate systems, part of the BARREL observatory mission designed to study relativistic electron losses.
25f67022-b6de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

26162840-b6e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Culgoora Magnetometer is a ground-based instrument located in Culgoora, NSW, Australia, used to measure variations in the Earth's magnetic field since September 2003. It features a Bartington magnetometer with a high-precision data acquisition system.
26162840-b6e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Culgoora Observatory, Australia

26274cb0-b9a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Iitate Planetary Radio Telescope (IPRT)** is a radio telescope located at the Iitate observatory of Tohoku University in Fukushima Prefecture, Japan, dedicated to observing planetary radio emissions, particularly synchrotron radiation from Jupiter's radiation belt.
26274cb0-b9a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Iitate Planetary Radio Telescope at Iitate Observatory, Japan

2630c040-bb36-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The MINERVA-II1 Rover-1b OWL is a robotic rover deployed by the Hayabusa2 spacecraft onto asteroid Ryugu. It features intelligent wheel locomotion, solar cells, communication antennae, multiple cameras, and various sensors for autonomous hopping and data collection in low gravity environments.
2630c040-bb36-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observation unit with intelligent Wheel Locomotion part of Hayabusa2

263d43f4-b962-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Algiers Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Bouzaréah, Algeria. It was established in the late 19th century and notably contributed to the Astrographic Catalogue project under the direction of François Gonnessiat.
263d43f4-b962-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astrographic Catalogue Telescope at Algiers Observatory, Algeria

263e3106-b7aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IAGA:TFS Magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field, located at the Dusheti station with the IAGA identifier TFS and operational since 1938.
263e3106-b7aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Dusheti Observatory

2643685c-b78b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 2L Optical Photometer** is an instrument designed to detect the flux of visible light at wavelengths near 486.1 nm during relativistic electron precipitation events, aiming to determine the presence of protons accompanying these electrons by identifying emissions characteristic of precipitating protons.
2643685c-b78b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Photometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

264d4b42-b727-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ExTrA (Exoplanets in Transits and their Atmospheres) facility** is a trio of 60-cm optical telescopes located at the La Silla Observatory in South America, funded by the European Research Council and the French Agence National de la Recherche.
264d4b42-b727-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: European Research Council and the French Agence National de la Recherche Exoplanets in Transits and their Atmospheres facility of three 60 cm optical Telescopes at La Silla Observatory

264d5d52-bac5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Equatorial Magnetometer Network (EMN) is a system of instruments that includes a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer installed in Vilhena, Brazil. This instrument is part of the IUGONET observatory and is used to measure magnetic fields for scientific research purposes.
264d5d52-bac5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of The Equatorial Magnetometer Network

2651e91c-bb97-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Europa Ultraviolet Spectrograph is an ultraviolet spectrograph imager on the Europa Clipper spacecraft designed to analyze Europa's atmospheric gases and surface materials, as well as search for signs of plume activity.
2651e91c-bb97-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet Europa Ultraviolet Spectrograph on Europa Clipper

2654a536-b966-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 2B Engineering Data Interface** is part of the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) project, responsible for converting analog signals such as temperatures, voltages, and currents into digital data with high precision. It features multiple inputs for voltage, current, and temperature monitoring, all scaled to a 5V range and converted with 16-bit accuracy.
2654a536-b966-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

2656bef0-b968-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The LANL1994 Energetic Sensor for Particles (ESP) is an instrument that measures higher-energy particles, specifically electrons and protons within specified energy ranges. It consists of a bismuth germanate crystal coupled to a thick plastic scintillator and a photomultiplier tube.
2656bef0-b968-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energy Spectrometer for Particles part of LANL 1994 Observatory

265bfdd0-bbec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 15 Cold Cathode Gage Experiment (CCGE) was a component of the Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments package (ALSEP), designed to measure neutral particle density and determine gas presence on the lunar surface.
265bfdd0-bbec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cold Cathode Ionization Gauge part of Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package

265f2b62-b63e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: MAVEN is a NASA space probe orbiting Mars to study the loss of atmospheric gases over time, providing insights into the planet's climate history and water. It was launched on an Atlas V rocket in 2013 and entered Mars orbit in 2014.
265f2b62-b63e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mars Atmosphere and Volatile Evolution on MAVEN

266165b2-bbc5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA Nuclear Spectroscopic Telescope Array (NuSTAR) is a space mission designed to explore the universe in high-energy X-rays, providing unprecedented insights into phenomena such as black holes and supernovae.
266165b2-bbc5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray NASA Nuclear Spectroscopic Telescope Array

2663e80c-b91b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The VHS-VISTA Observatory is an astronomical facility located at Cerro Paranal in Chile, dedicated to ground-based observations of the sky.
2663e80c-b91b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: VHS-VISTA Observatory, Chile

26712bee-b749-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** TOPEX/Poseidon was a joint satellite mission between NASA and CNES launched in 1992 to map ocean surface topography, revolutionizing oceanographic research.
26712bee-b749-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ocean Surface Topography Mission part of TOPEX/Poseidon

2682c336-b7ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The Patrony/Irkutsk Magnetometer specifically refers to one located at a station identified by IAGA code IRT, operational since 1887.
2682c336-b7ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Irkutsk Observatory

268673d6-ba29-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a magnetometer instrument located at the Agincourt station, identified by IAGA as AGN. This instrument was operational from January 1, 1881, to December 31, 1969.
268673d6-ba29-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Agincourt Observatory

268b5cfa-b9ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Galileo Dust Detection System (GDDS) is an instrument on the Galileo spacecraft designed to study micro-dust particles in Jupiter's environment using a specialized sensor and advanced detection systems, focusing on particle characteristics like mass, velocity, charge, and trajectory.
268b5cfa-b9ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dust Detector on Galileo

268eab40-ba57-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Electron Drift Instrument (EDI) on the Cluster 2/FM6 spacecraft measures the drift of test electrons to determine electric and magnetic field characteristics in space. It uses modulated electron beams and correlators to track flight times and detect beam electrons, providing valuable data for understanding space plasma environments.
268eab40-ba57-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electron Drift Instrument part of Cluster 2/FM6 mission

26911f24-ba7f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solar Wind Ion Composition Spectrometer (GLG/SWICS) on Ulysses is an instrument designed to measure the elemental and ionic composition, temperatures, and mean speeds of major solar wind ions, ranging from Hydrogen to Iron. It operates within a wind speed range of 145 to 1350 km/s and an energy/charge range of 110 eV/Q to 66.7 keV/Q.
26911f24-ba7f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar Wind Ion Composition Spectrometer on Ulysses

269469b0-b7a3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ion and Electron Sensor (IES) is a plasma instrument on the Rosetta spacecraft consisting of two electrostatic analyzers that measure electrons and ions across specified azimuth and polar angles to collect comprehensive plasma data.
269469b0-b7a3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ion and Electron Sensor part of Rosetta

269b2356-b724-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 3E was a specific mission event within the broader BARREL campaign, designed to study electrons escaping from Earth's radiation belts using high-altitude balloons equipped with scientific instruments. This particular balloon was operational from August 21 to August 22, 2015, in the stratosphere near Earth's surface.
269b2356-b724-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses on part of Living with a Star Geospace Mission of Opportunity

26a1695c-badd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Uzhhorod Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Uzhhorod, Ukraine. It was established in 1957 and operates as a ground-based facility for celestial observations.
26a1695c-badd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Uzhhorod Observatory, Ukraine

26a3ed2c-ba00-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Live Oak Observatory in Lake Jackson, Texas, is a ground-based astronomical observatory located at 201 Live Oak Lane, known for its research and observation facilities.
26a3ed2c-ba00-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Live Oak Observatory, Lake Jackson, United States

26b21e10-b96f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Genesis Positions" refers to the ephemeris data of the Genesis spacecraft, detailing its positional information over time. This dataset is part of the observational facilities related to the Genesis mission and provides essential coordinates for scientific analysis.
26b21e10-b96f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Genesis Spacecraft part of Genesis

26b68ff4-bc80-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Rainbow Observatory (MPC ID: 430) is an astronomical observatory located near Coonabarabran in New South Wales, Australia. It functions as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
26b68ff4-bc80-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rainbow Observatory, Australia

26c0e298-b9be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lower Thermosphere Profiler Radar (LTPR) at Shigaraki in Japan is an instrument used to measure ionospheric irregularities, operating with a center frequency of 31.57 MHz and peak power of 24 kW, contributing to studies on the morphology and variations of these irregularities.
26c0e298-b9be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar at Shigaraki Observatory, Japan

26c24984-b81b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Special Astrophysical Observatory of the Russian Academy of Sciences (SAO RAS) is an astronomical observatory located in the Bolshoi Zelenchuk Valley near Nizhny Arkhyz, Russia. It houses two notable telescopes: BTA-6, one of the world's largest optical telescopes, and RATAN-600, a large radio telescope, which are approximately 20 kilometers apart.
26c24984-b81b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Special Astrophysical Observatory of the Russian Academy of Sciences

26c5c752-bc27-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ionospheric Station at Zhigansk, located in the Sakha Republic of Russia, is an advanced ground facility equipped with a Digisonde to study ionospheric conditions by evaluating various characteristics of reflected skywave signals.
26c5c752-bc27-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digisonde at Zhigansk Observatory, Russia

26d1aff8-b5f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences (NAOC) 13.7m Delingha Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Purple Mountain Observatory's Qinhai Observation Station in Asia. It has an aperture of 13.7 meters and is used for astronomical research.
26d1aff8-b5f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 13.7m optical National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences Delingha Telescope at Purple Mountain Observatory; Qinhai Observation Station

26d23334-b673-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The ATLAS–MLO observatory is an astronomical facility located on Mauna Loa in Hawaii, United States, dedicated to detecting and tracking asteroids that could potentially impact Earth.
26d23334-b673-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Asteroid Terrestrial Impact Last Alert System - Mauna Loa Observatory part of Asteroid Terrestrial Impact Last Alert System, United States

26db152c-b9c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Astrophoton Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Audorf, Austria. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to the observation and study of celestial objects.
26db152c-b9c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astrophoton Observatory, Austria

26ed8eec-b694-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: "Ephemeris: Jupiter Moons is an investigative platform that calculates the positions and movements of Jupiter's moons, developed using a tool by Joseph Groene from the University of Iowa."
26ed8eec-b694-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Jupiter Moons Ephemeris part of Galileo Mission

26f2093c-b634-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Viking 1 Lander was a spacecraft deployed by the Viking 1 mission to Mars in 1976. It successfully landed on the Martian surface and conducted scientific experiments to study the planet's biology, chemical composition, meteorology, seismology, magnetic properties, and physical characteristics of its atmosphere and soil.
26f2093c-b634-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Camera and Multi-Object Spectrometer on Viking 1 Lander

27136c72-b64c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Laquila Station is a ground-based observatory in L'Aquila, Italy, part of the CPMN magnetometer network, dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity.
27136c72-b64c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at L'Aquila Observatory, Italy

271c0528-b104-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: Table Mountain Observatory is a ground-based astronomical facility located at Table Mountain, California. It is known for its telescopes and other astrophysics equipment used for various celestial observations.
271c0528-b104-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Table Mountain Observatory

27225250-bb15-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Taloyoak (TALO) station is a ground-based observatory located in Taloyoak, Nunavut, Canada, part of the UCLA GBO Network and NASA's THEMIS project. It includes instruments such as magnetometers for monitoring geomagnetic activity.
27225250-bb15-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Taloyoak Observatory, Canada

272ab404-bae8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Port Aux Français station with the IAGA identifier PAF. It measures magnetic field strength and has been operational since January 1, 1957.
272ab404-bae8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Port aux Français Observatory, Antarctica

272df956-b760-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
OGO 6 was an American geophysical research satellite designed to study high-altitude atmospheric parameters during a period of increased solar activity. Launched in 1969, it carried 26 experiments and featured advanced attitude control systems and rotating solar panels for maximum sunlight exposure.
272df956-b760-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Orbiting Geophysical Observatory 6 part of Orbiting Geophysical Observatory Program

272e0db6-b877-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hong Kong Geomagnetic Observatory (HKC), located in Chung Hom Kok, Hong Kong Island, is a ground-based facility that operates under the sponsorship of the U.K., focusing on geomagnetic measurements since 1971.
272e0db6-b877-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hong Kong Geomagnetic Observatory, China

273126aa-b6d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The POLRAD instrument on the Interball Auroral Probe is a step-frequency analyzer designed to measure the intensity and polarization parameters of Auroral Kilometric Radiation (AKR) within a frequency range from 4 kHz to 2 MHz, utilizing three orthogonal antennae for wave electric field detection.
273126aa-b6d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Auroral Kilometric Radiation on Interball Auroral Probe

2738715c-b741-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ranch Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Lakewood, Eddy County, New Mexico, United States. It operates as a ground-based facility with the MPC code V36.
2738715c-b741-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lakewood Observatory, United States

273aa0aa-bb5e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The KT17: Mercury Magnetic Field Model is a dynamic representation of Mercury's magnetospheric magnetic field, which is parameterized by heliocentric distance and magnetic activity. It is part of the observatory CDPP-AMDA under CNES, based on data from the Mariner 10 mission.
273aa0aa-bb5e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mercury Magnetic Field Model part of Mariner 10

27473698-b637-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Jassy Observatory is a ground-based facility in Iași, Romania, that operated from 1931 to 1971 and was part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) network. It was equipped with magnetometers for geophysical observations.
27473698-b637-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Jassy Observatory, Romania

274bcd8a-bb9a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ground-based millimeter-wave spectroscopic radiometer at the Rikubetsu observatory in Japan is an instrument equipped with a superconducting receiver designed to monitor variations in the vertical ozone distribution within the stratosphere and mesosphere.
274bcd8a-bb9a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Millimeter Wave Spectroscopic Radiometer at Rikubetsu Observatory

275ad802-b70d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EMN Medea station is a ground-based facility located in Tizi Mahdi, Ouzera District, Médéa, Algeria, functioning as part of the EMN magnetometer network to monitor and record magnetic field data.
275ad802-b70d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Médéa Observatory, Algeria

275d1d68-bc37-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Nagatoro Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Nagatoro, Chichibu County, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It operates as a ground-based facility and has the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code 398.
275d1d68-bc37-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Nagatoro Observatory, Japan

276a3bea-b937-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity describes a fluxgate magnetometer located in Adelaide, part of the 210 Magnetic Meridian (210MM) magnetometer network. It is associated with the IUGONET observatory and is used for magnetic field measurements.
276a3bea-b937-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IUGONET Observatory

27705622-b736-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Iznik Magnetic Observatory is a ground-based facility in İznik, Bursa, Turkey, established in 2007 to monitor and study magnetic fields.
27705622-b736-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iznik Magnetic Observatory, Turkey

2778ccd8-b8cd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Cluster-Salsa Ephemeris** is a dataset that provides the positions of the Cluster-2 spacecraft in various coordinate systems. It is part of the CDPP archive and facilitates investigations related to spacecraft positioning within the Cluster mission framework.
2778ccd8-b8cd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Value Set on CLUSTER II

27793332-b5dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA observatory in Refuge Harbour, active since 1924 and used for measuring magnetic fields as part of geomagnetic investigations.
27793332-b5dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Refuge Harbour Observatory

277a593a-ba72-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Alert Magnetic Observatory is a ground-based magnetic observatory located in Nunavut, Canada, operated by the Geological Survey of Canada since 1961.
277a593a-ba72-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Alert Magnetic Observatory, Canada

277c8fb8-b818-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The specific magnetometer referenced here was installed in 1960 as part of an investigation by IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) at Misallat Observatory, contributing to global geomagnetic studies coordinated by the WDC for Kyoto.
277c8fb8-b818-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at Misallat Observatory

27801504-b9b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Flarestar Observatory (obs. code: 171) is an astronomical observatory located in San Ġwann, Malta, owned and operated by astronomer Stephen M. Brincat. It has been active since January 1999.
27801504-b9b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Flarestar Observatory, Malta

2783808a-b664-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 210MM Guam Station is a ground-based magnetic observatory located in Dededo Municipality, Guam, part of the ISEE Magnetometer Network, operated to monitor Earth's geomagnetic activity.
2783808a-b664-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at 210 Magnetic Meridian Observatory, United States

278466ca-b1b5-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AKR-2 instrument on the Interball Tail Probe measures electromagnetic emissions in the frequency range of 100 kHz to 1.5 MHz using a shielded loop antenna, with high sensitivity in higher frequency channels and continuous operation.
278466ca-b1b5-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Kilometric Radioemission 100 KHz - 1.5 MHz on Interball Tail Probe part of Interball Observatory

278d2eb0-b6ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solaris Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Luczanowice, Poland. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical research and observations.
278d2eb0-b6ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Luczanowice Observatory, Poland

27921a0e-bb06-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Trapped Radiation Detector (TRD) on Pioneer 10 is a scientific instrument designed to measure and analyze the intensity and characteristics of trapped radiation particles in space. It features an array of detectors sensitive to electrons and protons within specific energy thresholds, providing valuable data on radiation environments during the mission.
27921a0e-bb06-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Instrument Trapped Radiation Detector on Pioneer 10

279890d0-b5c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: An astronomical observatory located in Monte Patria, Río Hurtado, Chile.
279890d0-b5c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: SADR Observatory, Chile

279a1a74-bb38-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Saku Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Sakuho, Minamisaku County, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. It is a ground-based facility used for celestial observations and research.
279a1a74-bb38-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Saku Observatory, Japan

27aee4b4-b9c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **ElectrostaticAnalyser (SPAN-A)**: The ElectrostaticAnalyser, specifically the SPAN-A module aboard the Parker Solar Probe, is an instrument designed to measure ion and electron velocity distributions from the ram direction and nadir. It features two electrostatic analyzers (ESAs) with a broad field of view, enabling detailed observations of solar wind particles and their characteristics during the probe's close approach to the Sun.
27aee4b4-b9c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar Probe Analyzer-A on Parker Solar Probe

27ba706c-b5fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Ultraviolet Photometer for P10**: A space instrument designed to measure ultraviolet (UV) radiation, aiding in the analysis of atmospheric composition, stellar emissions, and planetary atmospheres.
27ba706c-b5fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet Photometer on Spacecraft P10

27c49cfe-b624-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The PENGUIn-3 (PG3) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility located on Earth's surface at an altitude of 3107 meters, established in January 2013 to conduct geophysical observations. It is part of the broader observatory network and includes a magnetometer as one of its key instruments.
27c49cfe-b624-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at PENGUIn-3 Geophysical Observatory

27c8240c-b663-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Rorvik (RVK) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Gravset, Nærøysund, Trøndelag, Norway, primarily involved in geophysical measurements including magnetometer readings. It is part of the IUGONET observatory network and has been operational since December 30, 2006.
27c8240c-b663-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Rorvik Geophysical Observatory, Norway

27cc186a-b752-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Paamiut (FHB) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Greenland that specializes in geomagnetic measurements and is part of the global IUGONET observatory network.
27cc186a-b752-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Paamiut Geophysical Observatory

27d6afd0-b9a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The Equatorial Magnetometer Network (EMN) operates a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer installed at Guadalcanal, Solomon Islands, as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
27d6afd0-b9a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Equatorial Magnetometer Network

27de3fb6-bc9f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Mt. Clemens Geomagnetic Observatory is a ground facility in Harrison Township, Michigan, USA, that monitors geomagnetic activity and contributes data to the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA).
27de3fb6-bc9f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Mt. Clemens Geomagnetic Observatory

27e1b79c-b8a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a magnetometer instrument located at the Tatuoca station (identified as TTB by IAGA), which has been operational since January 1, 1933. This magnetometer is part of the IUGONET observatory network associated with WDC Kyoto and is used for magnetic field measurements.
27e1b79c-b8a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at Tatuoca

27e99d3c-b5d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Harvest Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Madison County, Alabama, specifically at 101 Silver Poplar Place in Poplar Ridge. It operates as a ground-based observatory for stargazing and scientific research.
27e99d3c-b5d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatory at Harvest, United States

27edf334-b9b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Energetic Particle Anisotropy Spectrometer (EPAS) was an instrument aboard the International Cometary Explorer (ICE) that measured the directional distribution and energy of energetic protons and heavy nucleons using three charged-particle telescopes.
27edf334-b9b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Anisotropy Spectrometer on International Cometary Explorer

27f6c372-b918-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **CHILESCOPE Observatory** (W76) is an astronomical observatory located in El Sauce, Río Hurtado, Chile. It operates as a ground-based facility for celestial observations.
27f6c372-b918-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: CHILESCOPE Observatory

2808c0be-bb0b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Ukiah Geophysical Observatory** is a ground-based facility located in Umatilla County, Oregon, part of the THEMIS Ground UCLA-EPO observatory network. It specializes in geophysical measurements and includes instruments like magnetometers for monitoring Earth's magnetic field.
2808c0be-bb0b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ukiah Observatory, United States

2809b218-babf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGIC (Major Atmospheric Gamma Imaging Cherenkov Telescopes) collaboration operates a set of gamma-ray telescopes located at the Roque de los Muchachos Observatory in La Palma, Canary Islands. These telescopes are used for high-energy astrophysics research by detecting gamma rays through atmospheric Cherenkov imaging techniques.
2809b218-babf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gamma-ray MAGIC collaboration Major Atmospheric Gamma Imaging Cherenkov Telescopes at Roque de los Muchachos Observatory

2809f03c-b8f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Črni Vrh Observatory (IAU code: 106) is an astronomical observatory situated in western Slovenia, near the settlement of Črni Vrh and the town of Idrija. It has been operational since January 1975 and is located at an altitude of 730 meters.
2809f03c-b8f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Črni Vrh Observatory, Slovenia

28166290-b77e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Otomari observatory (identified by IAGA as OTM), operational from January 1, 1920, to December 31, 1943.
28166290-b77e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Otomari Observatory

2816fc84-b835-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Guaraciaba Observatory** is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Linha Sede Flores, Santa Catarina, Brazil. It serves as an important facility for conducting astronomical research and observations in the South American region.
2816fc84-b835-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Guaraciaba Observatory, Brazil

281a3b58-b9c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Phobos 2 was a Soviet space probe launched in 1988 to explore Mars and its moon Phobos. Its mission included studying the interplanetary environment, observing the Sun, characterizing the Martian plasma environment, and examining the surface of Phobos, but contact was lost before completing all objectives.
281a3b58-b9c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Phobos 2

281b8e6e-b71f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The BARREL Balloon 2T X-ray Instrument (XRI) is a scintillation detector designed to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons. It operates with an energy response from 10 keV to 10 MeV and is part of the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) mission.
281b8e6e-b71f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Scintillation Detector part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

28200020-b7d3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ISEE Magnetometer** is an induction magnetometer located in Athabasca, part of the IUGONET observatory. It measures 3-D vector geomagnetic field variations with a sampling rate of 64 Hz controlled by a PC clock signal.
28200020-b7d3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Induction Magnetometer part of International Study of Earth-Atmosphere Coupling
