29e66398-b8fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Yamagawa ionospheric radar facility is a ground-based observatory located in Ibusuki, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan, operated by the National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT) for studying the Earth's ionosphere.
29e66398-b8fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionospheric Radar Facility at Yamagawa Observatory, Japan

29f3adb2-b7ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Durham University Observatory is a historical weather observatory in Durham, England, established in 1839 as both an astronomical and meteorological facility, but has focused solely on meteorology since 1937.
29f3adb2-b7ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Durham Observatory, United Kingdom

29f46118-b803-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer, specifically the Special Sensor Magnetometer (SSM) onboard the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program's DMSP-5D3 satellite, measures geomagnetic fluctuations related to geophysical phenomena.
29f46118-b803-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Special Sensor Magnetometer on Defense Meteorological Satellite Program

2a0146a6-b670-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Upernavik Magnetometer is an instrument located at the Upernavik (UPN) Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG since 2007, used to measure magnetic fields.
2a0146a6-b670-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Upernavik Observatory

2a0d631a-b804-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The STEREO-B SECCHI is an instrument suite on the STEREO B spacecraft designed to observe coronal mass ejections (CMEs) from the Sun, tracking their evolution and impacts on Earth's magnetic environment. It includes coronagraphs, EUV imagers, and heliospheric imagers to provide a comprehensive view of solar activity and its effects on interplanetary space.
2a0d631a-b804-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sun Earth Connection Coronal and Heliospheric Investigation part of STEREO B

2a0f9332-b9db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IGPP-LANL Crete Magnetometer Station is a ground-based facility located in Charkia, Municipality of Rethymnon, Greece, dedicated to magnetic field measurements.
2a0f9332-b9db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Crete Observatory, Greece

2a1c58d6-b735-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Macquarie Island Ionosonde is a ground-based instrument located on Macquarie Island, Tasmania, Australia, used for radar investigation of the ionosphere since 1950. It has undergone several upgrades, transitioning from analog systems using film to digital ionosondes over the years.
2a1c58d6-b735-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar on Macquarie Island Ionosonde at Macquarie Observatory, Antarctica

2a2b171c-b6c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Astronomical Observatory of Chile (OAN) is an astronomical observatory owned and operated by the University of Chile, located on Cerro Calán in Las Condes, Santiago. Founded in 1852, it became part of the university in 1927, with its current facility completed in 1962.
2a2b171c-b6c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: National Astronomical Observatory of Chile, Chile

2a2d3eb4-b7f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Rouet Observatory (MPC ID: C09) is an astronomical observatory located in Le Crès, France. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical observations and research.
2a2d3eb4-b7f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rouet Observatory, France

2a3bd8a6-b60d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a 70 cm AZT-8 reflecting telescope located at the Chuguev Observatory in Kharkiv Oblast, Ukraine. This telescope is identified by the code "urn:nasa:pds:context:telescope:chuguev.azt8_0m70" and has an aperture of 0.7 meters.
2a3bd8a6-b60d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.7m Telescope at Chuguev Observatory, Ukraine

2a3d9eba-b677-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA42 Camera is an imaging device mounted on the Lowell Observatory's Hall 1.07m Ritchey-Chretien telescope, featuring a 4kx4k CCD with a plate scale of 0.74 arcsec/pixel in 2x2 binned mode and a field of view (FOV) ranging from 22 to 25.3 arcminutes.
2a3d9eba-b677-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: CCD Imager on Lowell Observatory Hall Ritchey-Chretien Telescope

2a40575a-bb12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Chelmsford Observatory (MPC ID: 970) is an astronomical observatory located in Chelmsford, Essex, England. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
2a40575a-bb12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Chelmsford Observatory, United Kingdom

2a4981e8-b853-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gerard P. Kuiper Airborne Observatory (KAO) was a NASA-operated airborne infrared observatory using a modified Lockheed C-141A Starlifter aircraft for high-altitude astronomical research.
2a4981e8-b853-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Gerard P. Kuiper Airborne Observatory on C-141A Starlifter, United States

2a4bd5e4-ba04-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IGPP-LANL Southeast Louisiana University Fluxgate Magnetometer is an instrument used to measure variations in the Earth's magnetic field at the Southeast Louisiana University station, as part of the IGPP-LANL Magnetometer Array.
2a4bd5e4-ba04-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of IGPP-LANL Magnetometer Array

2a5973c2-b95d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN magnetometer network at Ewa Beach, Hawaii is a ground-based observatory facility that monitors magnetic field variations on Earth's surface, operated as part of the INTERMAGNET global network.
2a5973c2-b95d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at CPMN Ewa Beach Station, United States

2a66a7ae-b9bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The THEMIS Flux Gate Magnetometer (FGM) is an instrument on the THEMIS spacecraft launched in 2007 that measures background magnetic fields and low-frequency fluctuations with high precision using advanced digital technology developed by the Technical University of Braunschweig, Germany.
2a66a7ae-b9bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on THEMIS

2a690992-baaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Papeete station with the IAGA identifier PPT, operational since 1968.
2a690992-baaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Pamatai Observatory

2a6fc60a-b191-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA THEMIS EPO Hot Springs Station, also known as the Hot Springs Geophysical Observatory, is a ground-based facility located in Sanders County, Montana, United States. It operates a magnetometer and has been part of the THEMIS ground network since September 9, 2004.
2a6fc60a-b191-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at NASA Time History of Events and Macroscale Interactions during Substorms Ground UCLA EPO, United States

2a75e9d8-b9d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Southwest Institute for Space Research (also known as the SW Institute for Space Research or simply "Cloudcroft") is an astronomical observatory located in Otero County, New Mexico. It operates as a ground-based facility for observing celestial phenomena and conducting space research from its location at 53 East Spur Road, Cloudcroft.
2a75e9d8-b9d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cloudcroft Observatory

2a76e2e8-b7b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **CAST (Civic Astronomical Station of Talmassons) Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Talmassons, Udine, Italy. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical research and observation.
2a76e2e8-b7b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Talmassons Observatory, Italy

2a8008e0-b5be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The one located at Parc St Maur geophysical observatory (Station Code: PSM) has been operational since January 1, 1883.
2a8008e0-b5be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Parc St. Maur Observatory

2a8170ba-b846-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 2M X-Ray Instrument (XRI) is a scintillation detector designed to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons. It operates within an energy range from 10 keV to 10 MeV with a spectral resolution of 5 keV, providing data crucial for studying electron loss processes in the Earth's radiation belts.
2a8170ba-b846-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Scintillation Detector part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

2a888616-ba71-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sormano Astronomical Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in the mountain village of Sormano, Italy, near the Swiss border. It was privately funded and built in 1986 by the Gruppo Astrofili Brianza.
2a888616-ba71-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sormano Astronomical Observatory, Italy

2a8c8cae-b7fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 2MASS 1.3m Telescope at Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory, now known as the Peters Automated Infrared Imaging Telescope (PAIRITEL), is a 1.3-meter optical telescope located in North America, primarily used for automated infrared imaging.
2a8c8cae-b7fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 1.3m Two Micron All Sky Survey and Peters Automated Infrared Imaging Telescope at Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory

2a92ad9a-bb60-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Desert Beaver Observatory (IAU code 919) is a private astronomical observatory located near Eloy, Arizona, notable for its discovery of the asteroid 25893 Sugihara.
2a92ad9a-bb60-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Desert Beaver Observatory, United States

2a93ac16-b7f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Carson City (CCNV) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Nevada, United States, primarily known for its magnetometer instrument as part of the NASA THEMIS EPO network.
2a93ac16-b7f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Carson City Geophysical Observatory, United States

2a956458-bb39-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Vulcan North is an astronomical observatory located at the Lick Observatory on Mount Hamilton in California, United States.
2a956458-bb39-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Vulcan North at Lick Observatory

2a9ae4a0-bb61-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Shapotou Wind Tunnel** is a large experimental facility located at the Shapotou Desert Experimental Research Station in China, designed for conducting aerodynamic research with variable wind speeds and sectional configurations.
2a9ae4a0-bb61-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wind Tunnel at Shapotou Desert Experimental Research Station

2aa3845c-b904-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The KYSUCE observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Kysucké Nové Mesto, Slovakia. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
2aa3845c-b904-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kysucké Nové Mesto Observatory, Slovakia

2aafa4d2-b8b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Celico Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Celico, Cosenza, Calabria, Italy. It is a ground-based facility used for celestial observations and research.
2aafa4d2-b8b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Celico Observatory, Italy

2aba980c-bb8b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ISON-Byurakan Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Byurakan, Armenia. It is a ground-based facility used for conducting astronomical observations and research.
2aba980c-bb8b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ISON-Byurakan Observatory, Armenia

2abb7004-b827-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A fluxgate magnetometer located at Syowa Station in Antarctica used for monitoring the upper atmosphere's physical properties. It is part of the IUGONET Observatory under WDC Kyoto.
2abb7004-b827-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Upper Atmosphere Physics Monitoring Observation, Antarctica

2ac26f78-b99c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Harlan J. Smith 2.7m Telescope is a 2.72-meter optical telescope located at the McDonald Observatory in West Texas, administered by the University of Texas at Austin. It features multiple focal points and is used for astronomical research.
2ac26f78-b99c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.72m Harlan J. Smith Telescope at McDonald Observatory, United States

2ac595a6-b7ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 2B X-Ray Instrument (XRI) is a scintillation detector used in the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses mission to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons. It features a NaI crystal, photomultiplier tube, and pulse height analyzer to detect and analyze X-ray energies ranging from 10 keV to 10 MeV.
2ac595a6-b7ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-Ray Scintillation Detector part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

2ad3eaf2-bb11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Energetic Particle and Plasma Spectrometer Energetic Particle Spectrometer (EPS)** is an instrument on the MESSENGER spacecraft, designed to measure high-energy electrons and ions within Mercury's magnetosphere using a time-of-flight telescope and solid state detectors.
2ad3eaf2-bb11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Spectrometer on Mercury Surface Space Environment Geochemistry Ranging (MESSENGER)

2adab2fa-ba40-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Shahe Station is an astronomical observatory located in Changping District, Beijing, China. It operates as part of the Beijing Astronomical Observatory and is situated at coordinates 116.3277 longitude and 40.101011 latitude.
2adab2fa-ba40-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 324m Telescope at Beijing Astronomical Observatory, China

2adfe8da-b688-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Cooktown station is a ground-based facility located in Cooktown, Australia, part of the MAGDAS magnetometer network used for geomagnetic observations.
2adfe8da-b688-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Cooktown Observatory, Australia

2ae0e97c-b9f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Wewak Station is a ground-based magnetometer network located in Wewak, Papua New Guinea, specifically at Wewak Market on Valley Lane.
2ae0e97c-b9f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at CPMN Wewak Station, Papua New Guinea

2ae701b8-b798-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cocos Islands Ionosonde is a ground-based instrument located in the Cocos Islands, WA, Australia, used for radar investigation of the ionosphere. It has been operational since November 1961 with various upgrades, currently employing an IPS 5D vertical digital sounding ionosonde that sweeps frequencies from about 1.0 to 21.5 MHz.
2ae701b8-b798-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar at Cocos Islands Observatory, Australia

2aed25b4-b7c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Granat** was an international astrophysical observatory and satellite mission focused on gamma-ray astronomy, designed to study high-energy phenomena in the universe.
2aed25b4-b7c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gamma-ray International Astrophysical Observatory Granat X-ray Satellite Mission

2aed2acc-b971-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ōizumi Observatory is a private astronomical observatory located in Ōizumi, Gunma Prefecture, Japan, known for the discovery of numerous minor planets by Takao Kobayashi.
2aed2acc-b971-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ōizumi Observatory, Japan

2aef58f8-b13b-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tolar Astronomical Observatory is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Tolar Grande, Salta, Argentina. It is situated at the coordinates -24.589539 latitude and 292.60125 longitude in South America.
2aef58f8-b13b-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Tolar Observatory, Argentina

2aeff1d6-b925-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lukiapang-2 Magnetometer was an instrument located at the Lukiapang station (identifier LUK), operational from 1908 to 1933, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the IAGA investigation.
2aeff1d6-b925-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Lukiapang Observatory

2afbc040-b765-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer operated from 1965 to 2002 at the Molodezhnaya ground station, part of the IAGA investigation and associated with the Kyoto World Data Center.
2afbc040-b765-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IAGA

2b0007f4-bb6b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Fort Pius Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Barcelona, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for celestial observations and research within the European continent.
2b0007f4-bb6b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fort Pius Observatory, Spain

2b1a5b3c-b5ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Astronomical Observatory of Japan Nobeyama Radio Polarimeters are instruments located at the Nobeyama Radio Observatory in Asia, used for observing solar activity in the millimeter waveband.
2b1a5b3c-b5ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Millimeter National Astronomical Observatory of Japan Nobeyama Radio Polarimeters at Nobeyama Radio Observatory

2b1cb376-bab3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The California Association for Research in Astronomy's 10-meter W.M. Keck Interferometer is located at the Mauna Kea Observatory in North America and operates primarily within the infrared waveband.
2b1cb376-bab3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared California Association for Research in Astronomy 10m W.M. Keck Interferometer at Mauna Kea Observatory

2b1e13ec-b775-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Color Imager (MARCI) is a wide-angle, low-resolution camera aboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter designed to monitor Martian weather and climate by observing variations in dust, ozone, carbon dioxide, and polar caps.
2b1e13ec-b775-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mars Color Imager on Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter

2b212564-b815-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "GOES 11 Position" refers to the ephemeris data of the GOES-11 spacecraft, detailing its position over time as part of the GOES observatory system.
2b212564-b815-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GOES 11 Position on Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 11

2b37ef14-b730-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** GO-ABOVE, or the Geospace Observatory - Array for Broadband Observations of VLF/ELF Emissions, is a network of ground-based radio receivers in Canada that monitor very low frequency (VLF) and extremely low frequency (ELF) electromagnetic waves, operated by the Canadian Space Agency.
2b37ef14-b730-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Array for Broadband Observations of VLF/ELF Emissions part of Canadian Space Agency's Geospace Observatory

2b3ba1be-b928-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Venus Wind Tunnel (VWT) was a specialized wind tunnel at NASA Ames Research Center used to simulate the atmospheric conditions on Venus, particularly for studying aeolian processes such as particle movement and ripple dynamics. It operated with carbon dioxide at high pressures to mimic Venus's environment and has since been refitted as the Titan Wind Tunnel.
2b3ba1be-b928-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wind Tunnel at Planetary Aeolian Laboratory

2b3f6b38-b5ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Jakokoski Observatory, also known as A83, is an astronomical observatory located in Palovaara, Kontiolahti, Finland. It operates as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical research and observations.
2b3f6b38-b5ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Jakokoski Observatory, Finland

2b42f9de-b769-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Helium Vector Magnetometer on Pioneer 10 is a triaxial instrument designed to measure magnetic fields with high precision and multiple dynamic ranges.
2b42f9de-b769-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Helium Vector Magnetometer on Pioneer 10

2b465448-b747-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Aureol 3 (also known as Oreol 3 or Aureole 3) was a Soviet Earth observation satellite launched on September 21, 1981. It was part of the Intercosmos Series and carried out experiments to study magnetosphere-ionosphere coupling at high latitudes.
2b465448-b747-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Intercosmos Series Aurora Observatory part of Automatic Universal Orbital Station Terrestrial Studies

2b4be038-b630-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "South Pole Magnetometer" was an instrument used from 1959 to 1979 for measuring magnetic fields at the South Pole as part of the IAGA investigation.
2b4be038-b630-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at South Pole Observatory

2b5260a8-bb07-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mykolaiv Astronomical Observatory, located in Mykolaiv, Ukraine, is a ground-based astronomical research institute that has been operational since 1852.
2b5260a8-bb07-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mykolaiv Astronomical Observatory, Ukraine

2b57fc0a-b636-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Alnitak Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in El Puerto de Santa María, Spain. It operates as a ground-based facility for conducting observations of celestial bodies and phenomena.
2b57fc0a-b636-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: El Puerto de Santa Maria Observatory

2b581d4c-b795-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The Equatorial Magnetometer Network (EMN) operates a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer located in Okinawa, Japan, which is part of the IUGONET observatory network.
2b581d4c-b795-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of The Equatorial Magnetometer Network

2b596c08-b80b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Chibougamau (CHBG) Station**: A ground-based observatory located in Chibougamau, Quebec, Canada, part of the UCLA GBO Network, focused on magnetic field measurements.
2b596c08-b80b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Chibougamau Observatory, Canada

2b68e782-baa9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
GOES 15 (Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 15), launched in March 2010, is a U.S. weather satellite that provides continuous monitoring of Earth's atmosphere and space environment from geostationary orbit, equipped with instruments for imaging, sounding, solar X-ray detection, and space weather observation.
2b68e782-baa9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 15 part of GOES mission

2b767448-b616-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Heaven on Earth Observatory (MPC ID: V30) is an astronomical observatory located in Mayhill, New Mexico, United States. It operates as a ground-based observatory for astronomical research and observations.
2b767448-b616-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mayhill Observatory

2b7982b0-b638-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Radiation Assessment Detector (RAD)** is an instrument on the Mars Science Laboratory's Curiosity rover designed to detect and analyze energetic particle radiation on the Martian surface, essential for assessing the planet's habitability and planning future crewed missions.
2b7982b0-b638-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radiation Assessment Detector on Curiosity rover part of Mars Science Laboratory

2b79c36a-b935-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Cambridge Bay, identified by the IAGA code CBB, used for measuring magnetic field variations since 1972.
2b79c36a-b935-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Cambridge Bay Observatory

2b7ab56e-b74f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Borken Observatory (MPC code: B59) is an astronomical observatory located in Borken, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical observations and research.
2b7ab56e-b74f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Borken Observatory, Germany

2b7bfc84-bb42-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Observatory of Nurol** is an astronomical observatory located in Aurec-sur-Loire, France. It was established in 1983 and serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research.
2b7bfc84-bb42-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatoire de Nurol at Aurec-sur-Loire, France

2b7f1150-b65e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Dust Particle Counter and Mass Analyzer (DUCMA) for Vega 2 was an instrument designed to detect and measure the mass of dust particles in space. It used a polyvinylidene fluoride film and electronics to register pulse heights, accumulate counts based on threshold levels, and included an anticoincidence detector to ensure measurement accuracy.
2b7f1150-b65e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: The Dust Particle Counter and Mass Analyzer on Vega 2

2b8485fe-bb13-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The VLF/ELF crossed loop antenna is an instrument used for measuring magnetic field variations in the very low frequency (VLF) and extremely low frequency (ELF) ranges. It is located in Zhigansk, Russia, and operates with a 10-turn design at a height of 5 meters, sampling data at 100kHz with peak sensitivity at 8kHz.
2b8485fe-bb13-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Very Low Frequency/Extremely Low Frequency Crossed Loop Antenna at Zhigansk Observatory, Russia

2b8684f2-b655-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
LISA Pathfinder is a space mission designed to test the technology for future gravitational wave detectors in space. It primarily focused on validating key components and concepts for the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) project.
2b8684f2-b655-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: LISA-Pathfinder

2b8a1e6c-b896-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mauren Valley Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Holzgerlingen, Germany. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
2b8a1e6c-b896-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mauren Valley Observatory at Holzgerlingen, Germany

2b8e051e-b86d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA station in Cape Parry (CPY), part of the IUGONET-Observatory and WDC Kyoto network, used for measuring magnetic fields.
2b8e051e-b86d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet Observatory

2b9856c0-b7c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Kalamazoo Observatory is an astronomical observatory located at King-Westwood Elementary School in Kalamazoo Township, Michigan. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
2b9856c0-b7c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kalamazoo Observatory, United States

2b9f0f58-bb47-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Berlin-Babelsberg Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Potsdam, Germany. Established as a ground-based facility, it is known for its contributions to astronomy and is situated at coordinates 52.406679° N, 13.1062° E.
2b9f0f58-bb47-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Berlin-Babelsberg Observatory, Germany

2b9f8f06-bb3c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CTIO 1.0m 2D-Frutti Spectrograph is an instrument used at the Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO), featuring a Boller & Chivens fast UV-transmitting image tube spectrograph and a two-dimensional photon counting detector known as the 2D-Frutti, which is highly sensitive in the UV to red spectral range.
2b9f8f06-bb3c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Boller & Chivens fast uv-transmitting image tube spectrograph on 1.0m Telescope at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory

2bac96f4-b6d9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Townsville station, located in Townsville, Queensland, Australia, is a ground-based observatory that has been operational since June 1946 and includes an ionosonde instrument for atmospheric studies.
2bac96f4-b6d9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionosonde at Townsville Observatory, Australia

2bae85da-b0f9-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lanzhou Magnetic Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Lanzhou, China, focused on magnetic observations and funded by the China Earthquake Administration.
2bae85da-b0f9-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Lanzhou Magnetic Observatory, China

2bb670c0-ba80-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Cylindrical Electrostatic Probe (CEP)** on AE-E was a retarding-potential Langmuir probe instrument designed to measure electron temperatures, electron and ion concentrations, ion mass, and spacecraft potential. It consisted of two identical probes oriented differently to maximize observation coverage during the spacecraft's spin period.
2bb670c0-ba80-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Langmuir Probe part of AE-E Mission

2bb81d4e-b6c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Volkssternwarte Bonn** is a public observatory located in Bonn, Germany. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and education.
2bb81d4e-b6c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Volkssternwarte Bonn Observatory, Germany

2bb88218-b8ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NSF NOIRLab 4m Victor M. Blanco Telescope is a 4-meter optical telescope located at the Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO) in South America, known for its contributions to astronomical research.
2bb88218-b8ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 4.0m Victor Blanco Telescope at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory

2bbb87c4-b7b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A 60 MHz riometer located near Norilsk, Russia, equipped with an 8x8-element dipole antenna array to monitor the dynamics of the upper atmosphere by measuring nocturnal airglow emissions over a large area.
2bbb87c4-b7b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 60MHz Riometer part of Imaging Riometer Observation at Istok, Russia

2bc6949a-badb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Amderma Geophysical Observatory (AMD) is a ground-based facility located in the Zapolyarny District of Russia, primarily dedicated to geomagnetic observations. It was operational from 1979 until its closure at the end of that year and later reopened on July 25, 2011.
2bc6949a-badb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Amderma Geophysical Observatory, Russia

2bc92262-b777-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA Small Astronomy Satellite 2 (SAS-2), also known as Explorer 48, was a space mission focused on gamma-ray astronomy. It operated in the 1970s and contributed significantly to our understanding of high-energy astrophysical phenomena.
2bc92262-b777-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gamma-ray NASA Small Astronomy Satellite 2 Mission

2bdeb7be-b8c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of Texas, Austin 9.3m Hobby-Eberly Telescope is a large optical telescope located at the McDonald Observatory in North America, known for its 9.3-meter aperture and contributions to astronomical research.
2bdeb7be-b8c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hobby-Eberly Telescope at McDonald Observatory

2be522a8-b828-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Global Ultraviolet Imager (GUVI) on TIMED is a far-ultraviolet imaging spectrograph that scans the Earth's horizon to monitor the composition and temperature of the mesosphere and lower thermosphere/ionosphere (MLTI) region, providing detailed observations of auroral activity and atmospheric changes.
2be522a8-b828-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Far-ultraviolet Global Ultraviolet Imager part of TIMED

2be909ae-b855-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Konkoly Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Budapest, Hungary. It is the largest astronomical research institute in the country and hosts its most significant telescopes.
2be909ae-b855-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Konkoly Observatory, Hungary

2bec0b1c-bb4e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA Einstein (High Energy Astronomy Observatory 2, HEAO-2) was a space mission designed to study X-ray sources in the universe. Launched by NASA, it played a significant role in high energy astronomy research.
2bec0b1c-bb4e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: x-ray NASA Einstein Satellite

2becaa64-b684-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Astronomical Observatory of Lviv University is an astronomical observatory in Lviv, Ukraine, founded in 1771 and currently part of the Ivan Franko National University of Lviv. It focuses on research in cosmology, relativistic astrophysics, and stellar astrophysics.
2becaa64-b684-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Observatory of Lviv University, Ukraine

2bee5636-ba79-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The OSIRIS-REx Thermal Emission Spectrometer (OTES) is an infrared point spectrometer on the OSIRIS-REx spacecraft that operates in the 4-50 micron range, capable of generating high-resolution maps from distances as close as 0.5 km to as far as 7 km from a surface by collecting interferograms every 2 seconds, which are then converted to infrared spectra on Earth.
2bee5636-ba79-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared OSIRIS-REx Thermal Emission Spectrometer on OSIRIS-REx spacecraft

2bf4c6f2-ba5a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Detmold Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Detmold, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observation.
2bf4c6f2-ba5a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Observatory at Detmold, Germany

2bf7cd5a-b8bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: "DEEP SPACE 1," also known as DS-1, was a NASA spacecraft designed for testing advanced technologies like ion propulsion and autonomous navigation in deep space.
2bf7cd5a-b8bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Deep Space 1

2bf97b32-b9c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO) is a ground-based astronomical observatory in Chile, part of the U.S. National Optical Astronomy Observatory, serving as a key facility for Southern hemisphere astronomy. It is located at an altitude of 2200 meters and approximately 500 km north of Santiago.
2bf97b32-b9c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory, Chile

2bff2330-ba6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA High Energy Transient Explorer 2 (HETE-2) was a space mission designed to detect and study gamma-ray bursts in the universe. It operated in the gamma-ray waveband, providing valuable data on these high-energy cosmic events.
2bff2330-ba6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gamma-ray NASA High Energy Transient Explorer 2 (HETE-2) part of NASA High Energy Transient Explorer 2 Satellite Mission

2c0aaefc-b66a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ionospheric Station at Narsarsuaq, Greenland (URSI-code: NQJ61), operated from 2000 to 2008 and featured a Digisonde for advanced ionospheric measurements.
2c0aaefc-b66a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digisonde Ionosonde at International Space Weather Initiative Observatory in Narsarsuaq, Greenland

2c0f7cb2-bbb4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EMN magnetometer network in Koror, Palau is a ground-based facility located on a floating platform off Ngermid Road. It is part of the IUGONET instrument network and measures magnetic field data in Oceania.
2c0f7cb2-bbb4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Melekeok Station and Koror Station

2c163130-bb85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Sögel Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Sögel, Lower Saxony, Germany. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
2c163130-bb85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sögel Observatory, Germany

2c202c6a-b8b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in La Paz that operated from January 1, 1974, to December 31, 1976, as part of the IAGA investigation and the IUGONET observatory network.
2c202c6a-b8b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at La Paz Observatory

2c2ac8ae-b908-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DMSP/F15 SSM/T-2 is a five-channel microwave radiometer launched in 1999 as part of the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program to monitor global atmospheric water vapor concentration, even under cloudy conditions.
2c2ac8ae-b908-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Special Sensor Microwave Water Vapor Profiler on Defense Meteorological Satellite Program part of DMSP 5D-3 F15

2c32d118-b686-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Sonoran Skies Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Cochise County, Arizona, United States, specifically in the town of St. David. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to stargazing and astronomical research.
2c32d118-b686-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sonoran Skies Observatory, United States

2c3678b6-b863-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Tweenhills Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Hartpury, Gloucestershire, England. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
2c3678b6-b863-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tweenhills Observatory, United Kingdom

2c40c314-b7fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Deep Synoptic Array-110 (DSA-110) is a radio telescope array located at the Owens Valley Radio Observatory in North America, designed to conduct deep and synoptic surveys of the sky.
2c40c314-b7fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: radio Deep Synoptic Array-110 at Owens Valley Radio Observatory

2c42f0ee-b7a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DMSP 5D-2/F14, also known as USA 131, is a meteorological satellite developed and operated by the U.S. Air Force under the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program (DMSP). Launched in 1997, it provides global visual and infrared cloud cover data to support Department of Defense weather analysis and forecasting requirements.
2c42f0ee-b7a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Defense Meteorological Satellite Program 5D-2/F14 part of Defense Meteorological Satellite Program

2c4e74a6-b69d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Dearborn Observatory is an astronomical observatory located at Northwestern University in Evanston, Illinois, originally constructed in 1888 and moved to its current site in 1939.
2c4e74a6-b69d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dearborn Observatory

2c51914c-bb41-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA-identified station SJL in San José de las Lajas, operational from January 1964 to December 1976.
2c51914c-bb41-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at San Jose Las Lajas Observatory

2c598f32-b867-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Viking Lander 2 Spacecraft (VL2) seismometer was a device aboard the NASA's Viking mission to Mars designed to measure seismic activity and detect potential Marsquakes but ended up being used primarily as a weather station due to wind noise contamination.
2c598f32-b867-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Seismometer on Viking Lander 2 Spacecraft part of Viking mission

2c5b0060-baf6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Colleverde di Guidonia Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Guidonia Montecelio, Italy. Established in 1981, it operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
2c5b0060-baf6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Guidonia Montecelio Observatory, Italy

2c5ffc1a-b9d3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "GOES 7 Position" is an instrument that provides ephemeris data for the GOES 7 spacecraft, detailing its precise location and movement in orbit as part of the GOES-7 observatory.
2c5ffc1a-b9d3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 7 Position on Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 7

2c645e26-b14b-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The TLC Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Castel San Pietro Terme, near Bologna, Italy. It is identified by the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code 600 and focuses on ground-based observations.
2c645e26-b14b-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: TLC Observatory, Italy

2c69a826-b5ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU Radio Beacon Receiver (GRBR) station at Uji is an observatory located in Kyoto Prefecture, Japan, designed to measure ionospheric disturbances related to middle-upper atmospheric coupling processes.
2c69a826-b5ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU Radio Beacon Receiver Station at Uji, Japan

2c6aeb34-b64a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The **Bar J Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in New Smyrna Beach, Florida. It is a ground-based facility used for stargazing and scientific research.
2c6aeb34-b64a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bar J Observatory, United States

2c8e1882-ba70-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Stardome Observatory & Planetarium is a public astronomical observatory and planetarium located in Auckland, New Zealand. It was previously known as the Auckland Observatory and is situated within the Maungakiekie/One Tree Hill Domain.
2c8e1882-ba70-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stardome Observatory

2c9320b8-b7c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Mercury Electron Analyzer 2 (MEA2) is an instrument onboard the Mio spacecraft of the BepiColombo mission, designed to measure the three-dimensional distribution function of electrons in both the solar wind and Mercury's magnetosphere. It uses a top-hat type toroidal electrostatic analyzer to select electron energies ranging from 3 eV/q up to 26 keV/q, depending on operational modes, and provides various data products to understand plasma dynamics and interactions at Mercury.
2c9320b8-b7c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mercury Electron Analyzer part of Mercury Plasma Particle Experiment

2c93a7b6-b728-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Muensterschwarzach Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Schwarzach am Main, Germany. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
2c93a7b6-b728-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Münsterschwarzach Observatory, Germany

2c96c7a8-bbcd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The TIMED Doppler Interferometer (TIDI) on the TIMED satellite is an instrument designed to measure horizontal vector winds and temperature profiles in Earth's mesosphere and lower thermosphere/ionosphere (MLTI) region. It uses four telescopes and a Fabry-Perot interferometer to observe specific airglow emissions, providing data with high vertical resolution and accuracy under optimal conditions.
2c96c7a8-bbcd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Interferometer on TIMED

2cada4fc-b8ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A CPMN fluxgate magnetometer at KOT is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed in Kotzebue, United States, designed to measure magnetic fields. It is part of the IUGONET Observatory's CPMN network and operates under the code spase://IUGONET/Instrument/ICSWSE/CPMN/KOT/fluxgate.
2cada4fc-b8ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Circum-pan Pacific Magnetometer Network investigation on IUGONET Observatory

2cb36c18-b7cd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Auckland Observatory was a ground-based facility located in Clevedon, Auckland, New Zealand, operational from December 1967 to March 1998, primarily used for ionospheric research.
2cb36c18-b7cd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Auckland Observatory, New Zealand

2cc2808c-b7f4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Gonzales Videla station with the IAGA identifier GVD, operational since January 1961.
2cc2808c-b7f4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Gonzales Videla Observatory

2cc8e882-b68c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA station LNN in Leningrad, operational since 1869, used for measuring magnetic field variations.
2cc8e882-b68c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at Leningrad Observatory

2cd3ea8e-b8c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Near Infrared Camera Spectrometer (NICS) is an infrared multimode instrument used at the TNG telescope for imaging, spectroscopy, polarimetry, and adaptive optics-enhanced observations within the 0.9 to 2.5 micron range.
2cd3ea8e-b8c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Near Infrared Camera Spectrometer on Galileo National Telescope

2ce994a6-b669-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Near Infrared Camera (NIR) is an instrument from the Clementine mission designed for lunar mineral mapping using a cryogenically cooled 256x256 indium antimonide focal plane array, operating in the wavelength range of 1.0 to 5.5 microns with various integration times and gains to optimize observations across different lunar latitudes.
2ce994a6-b669-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Camera part of Clementine mission

2cee1aba-b850-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tsingtao Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Qingdao, Shandong, China. It focuses on resolving spectra shift in urban air quality monitoring systems using the Differential Optical Absorption Spectroscopy (DOAS) method.
2cee1aba-b850-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Qingdao Observatory

2cf0894a-b92b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 2Y Optical Photometer is an instrument designed to detect visible light at wavelengths near 486.1 nm during relativistic electron precipitation events, aiming to determine the presence of protons accompanying these electrons and support the theory of scattering by electromagnetic ion cyclotron waves as a precipitation mechanism.
2cf0894a-b92b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Photometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

2cf89fa4-ba6b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "LANL 1997 Positions" refers to a dataset that provides the spatial coordinates of the Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL) spacecraft in various coordinate systems, facilitating the tracking and analysis of its position during its 1997 mission.
2cf89fa4-ba6b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spacecraft Position on LANL 1997 Observatory

2cfc0cd0-b709-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Giuseppe S. Vaiana Astronomical Observatory is an astronomical research facility located in the Palazzo dei Normanni, Palermo, Sicily, Italy, focusing on studies in astronomy and astrophysics such as solar and stellar coronas, stellar evolution, and supernova remnants.
2cfc0cd0-b709-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Giuseppe S. Vaiana Astronomical Observatory, Italy

2cfff02a-b916-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Starhoo Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Lakeville, Massachusetts, USA. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
2cfff02a-b916-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Starhoo Observatory

2d026cdc-bb10-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Akebono Positions" refers to the recorded spatial coordinates of the Akebono spacecraft in different reference frames, providing data on its location during its mission.
2d026cdc-bb10-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris on Akebono Spacecraft

2d06ee28-b75b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer at DAW is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed in Darwin, Australia, part of the MAGDAS observation network under IUGONET.
2d06ee28-b75b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

2d11fd9e-b649-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The THEMIS Flux Gate Magnetometer (FGM) is an instrument designed to measure the background magnetic field and low frequency fluctuations up to 64 Hz with high precision. Developed by Technical University of Braunschweig in Germany, it utilizes digital fluxgate technology for improved robustness and lower mass, providing data at various resolutions for scientific analysis.
2d11fd9e-b649-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tri-axial Fluxgate Magnetometer part of THEMIS

2d166d10-ba37-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Observatory Raleigh**, also known as the Rayleigh Observatory, is an astronomical observatory located in South Woodham Ferrers, Chelmsford, Essex, England. It has been operational since 1978 and is situated at an altitude of 75 meters above sea level.
2d166d10-ba37-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Raleigh Observatory

2d185264-b740-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences (NAOC) 40m Kunming Radio Telescope is located at the Yunnan Astronomical Observatory in Lijiang, China. It operates in the radio waveband and has an aperture of 40 meters.
2d185264-b740-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 40.0m radio National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences Kunming Radio Telescope at Yunnan Astronomical Observatory; Lijiang Observatory

2d1de78e-b6ef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **NEAT QUEST camera** is an astronomical instrument installed at Palomar Observatory's 1.2m Samuel Oschin Schmidt Telescope, featuring 112 CCD chips arranged in four rows, designed to cover a wide field of view for surveying the sky.
2d1de78e-b6ef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: QUEST Camera on Oschin Schmidt 1.2m Telescope at Palomar Observatory

2d322cee-b68b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A CPMN fluxgate magnetometer is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument used to measure magnetic fields, installed at the observatory in Davao, Philippines. It is part of the IUGONET Observatory network and operates under the ICSWSE project.

2f1e20ee-b9e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Bei-Jing Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Beijing, China, primarily focused on geomagnetic measurements. It operates a magnetometer and has been active since January 1957.
2f1e20ee-b9e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Beijing Observatory

2f3c02ca-b8df-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ionospheric Station at Moscow (MO155) is an advanced ground-based observatory located in Troitsk, Moscow, Russia. It utilizes a Digisonde to evaluate various parameters of skywave signals reflected from the ionosphere, such as angle of arrival, polarization, and Doppler frequency shift, in addition to their travel time.
2f3c02ca-b8df-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digisonde at Ionospheric Station, Russia

2f3d5f2a-b809-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a set of analytical models used for investigating the magnetosphere as part of the Cluster 2 mission, archived under the CDPP at CNES. These models are designed to provide detailed analyses and insights into various phenomena within Earth's magnetic environment.
2f3d5f2a-b809-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetospheric Analytical Models part of Cluster II

2f3fce84-baf4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **OACL Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Mosciano Sant'Angelo, Teramo, Italy. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
2f3fce84-baf4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: OACL Observatory at Mosciano Sant'Angelo, Italy

2f415c9c-bc32-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA Wallops Flight Facility, located on Wallops Island in Accomack County, Virginia, is a ground-based observatory that specializes in x-ray observations of the Sun.
2f415c9c-bc32-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray Observatory at NASA Wallops Flight Facility, United States

2f4465c0-b7c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Stuttgart-Hoffeld Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Feuerbach, Stuttgart, Germany. It is a ground-based observatory used for various astronomical observations and research.
2f4465c0-b7c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stuttgart-Hoffeld Observatory, Germany

2f4c398c-b732-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Antananarivo Ground Magnetic Field Instrument** is a magnetometer located at the Antananarivo ground station in Madagascar. It has been operational since January 1, 1890 and is part of the IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) investigation network.
2f4c398c-b732-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Antananarivo Observatory

2f5ab396-ba4c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **210MM Yamakawa station** is a magnetic observatory located in Ibusuki, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. It operates as part of the 210 Magnetic Meridian (210MM) magnetometer network and features a fluxgate instrument for monitoring geomagnetic activity.
2f5ab396-ba4c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Yamakawa Observatory, Japan

2f5b3fdc-bb50-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Energetic Particle, Composition and Thermal Plasma Suite (ECT) is an instrument onboard the RBSP-B observatory designed to measure the spatial, temporal, and pitch angle distributions of electrons and ions over a wide range of energies. It aims to understand particle acceleration mechanisms and the role of the inner magnetospheric plasma environment in these processes through comprehensive data analysis and modeling techniques.
2f5b3fdc-bb50-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle, Composition and Thermal Plasma Suite on Van Allen Probes

2f5c74ec-b5f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatoire de Bédoin is an astronomical observatory located in Bédoin, France.
2f5c74ec-b5f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatoire de Bédoin

2f627948-b95f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Big Delta Ground Magnetic Field Instrument was a magnetometer operated at the Big Delta ground station from January 1957 to December 1958 as part of the IAGA investigation.
2f627948-b95f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Big Delta Observatory

2f63d2f0-ba7e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The North Pole 10 Geomagnetic Observatory (NPJ) was a ground-based facility in Russia, operating from 1961 to 1962, dedicated to geomagnetic measurements at coordinates 76.62°N and 166.38°E.
2f63d2f0-ba7e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at North Pole 10 Geomagnetic Observatory

2f6d8084-b61e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Radar Mapper (ORAD)** on the Pioneer Venus Orbiter was an instrument used to gather data on Venus's altitude, surface temperature, and radar scattering properties. It operated with a low-power S-band pulse system to map the planet's topography and geological characteristics, achieving an accuracy of 150 meters in measuring surface heights.
2f6d8084-b61e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar Mapper on Pioneer Venus Orbiter

2f80067e-b75d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Lagos Station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Festac Town, Amuwo Odofin, Lagos State, Nigeria. It is part of the global MAGDAS (Magnetic Data Acquisition System) network and provides magnetic field measurements from its location on Earth's surface.
2f80067e-b75d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Lagos Observatory, Nigeria

2f892d22-bb5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Alouette 2 Sweep-Frequency Sounder** was an instrument on the Alouette 2 satellite that measured ionospheric electron density between 300 and 3000 km altitude using radio-frequency pulses, extending observations to higher altitudes and different solar cycle periods compared to its predecessor.
2f892d22-bb5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sweep-Frequency Sounder on Alouette 2

2f9db526-b62b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NSMR (Nippon/Norwegian Meteor Radar) station is a ground-based observatory located at Adventdalen on Spitzbergen Island in the Svalbard archipelago, Norway. It is co-located with the SOUSY Svalbard Mesosphere–Stratosphere–Troposphere (MST) radar operated by the University of Tromsø.
2f9db526-b62b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Meteor Radar at Norwegian Svalbard MST Radar Observatory, Norway

2fa40ddc-ba62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Brigham Young University (BYU) 0.4m David Derrick Telescope (DDT) is an optical telescope located at the Orson Pratt Observatory in North America, with a primary mirror diameter of 16 inches. It is used for astronomical observations and research by BYU faculty and students.
2fa40ddc-ba62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 0.4m David Derrick Telescope at Orson Pratt Observatory

2faff74c-bb6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Leiden Observatory was an astronomical facility located in Pieterswijk, Leiden, Netherlands, operational before 1860. It is one of the oldest ground-based observatories in Europe.
2faff74c-bb6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Leiden Observatory, Netherlands

2fb2a562-bc39-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetic Data Acquisition System (MAGDAS) fluxgate magnetometer at Hobart (HOB) is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument used for measuring magnetic field variations, part of the IUGONET observatory network.
2fb2a562-bc39-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

2fb37fa4-ba3c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MMS 2 FIELDS Suite's Fluxgate Magnetometer is an instrument aboard the Magnetospheric Multiscale (MMS) mission that combines Analog and Digital Fluxgate magnetometers to measure magnetic fields. It operates in various modes, providing intercalibrated data with high accuracy and reliability.
2fb37fa4-ba3c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of MMS

2fb5651a-b6a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magdalena Ridge Observatory Andor 2k x 2k CCD Camera is a specialized astronomical instrument featuring an Andor 2kx2k CCD operating at -85 degrees Celsius, designed for highly accurate astrometry with minimal residual errors, and synchronized via GPS for precision timing.
2fb5651a-b6a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2kx2k CCD Camera at Magdalena Ridge Observatory

2fc3dd88-b73d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Double Star 2 EPOS Model Data" is a dataset from the CDPP Archive, containing catalogues of predicted scientific events, as well as geometric and magnetic positions related to the Double Star mission. It is part of the CNES Observatory's CDPP Archive for the Double Star 2 investigation.
2fc3dd88-b73d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: EPOS Model Data part of Double Star 2

2fdbe186-b1ce-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ageo Observatory (MPC Code: 349) is an astronomical observatory located in Ageo, Saitama Prefecture, Japan, dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
2fdbe186-b1ce-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Ageo Observatory, Japan

2fde5ba4-b111-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The term "http://purl.org/dc/terms/description" refers to a Dublin Core metadata element used to describe resources, providing a summary or abstract of the content associated with it. In this context, it describes the Agile imager, a high-speed time-series photometer on the ARC 3.5-m telescope at Apache Point Observatory.
2fde5ba4-b111-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: High-speed time-series photometer on 3.5m Apache Point Observatory Telescope

2fe6bdc8-bb8c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Garden Observatory of Siegfried Gebhard is an astronomical observatory located in Dresden, Germany. It was established in 1990 and is situated at 27d Duckwitzstraße.
2fe6bdc8-bb8c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Garden Observatory of Siegfried Gebhard at Dresden, Germany

2fe7a884-b950-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lhasa Geomagnetic Observatory (LSA) is a ground-based facility located in Lhasa, Tibet, China, that has been monitoring geomagnetic activity since 1957. It is part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) observatory network.
2fe7a884-b950-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Lhasa Geomagnetic Observatory, China

2ff4402e-b9ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a magnetometer located at the Beloit observatory station (identified as BLT by IAGA) that was operational from January 1, 1957, to December 31, 1959. This instrument was used for measuring magnetic fields and was part of the World Data Center in Kyoto under the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA).
2ff4402e-b9ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Beloit Observatory

2ff8efb2-ba87-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Trapped Radiation Detector (TRD)** on Pioneer 11 was an instrument comprising five particle detectors designed to measure electron and proton energies, primarily for studies during planetary encounters but also capable of gathering data in interplanetary space.
2ff8efb2-ba87-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Trapped Radiation Detector on Pioneer 11

2ffef002-b603-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Spain's National Geographic Institute (IGN) Yebes Observatory 40 m radio telescope is a large astronomical instrument located in Yebes, Europe, used for conducting radio astronomy observations. It has an aperture of 40 meters and operates within the radio waveband.
2ffef002-b603-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 40.0m Radio Telescope at Spain’s National Geographic Institute Yebes Observatory

30005d7e-b992-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Open-Source Neutral Mass Spectrometer** on AE-C is a double-focusing Mattauch-Herzog magnetic deflection mass spectrometer designed to study the chemical and dynamic processes in the thermosphere by measuring neutral atmospheric constituents with masses from 1 to 48 atomic mass units.
30005d7e-b992-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Open-Source Neutral Mass Spectrometer on AE-C

300610d0-b978-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: DSS 55 is a radio telescope located at the Madrid Deep Space Communications Complex with an aperture of 34 meters.
300610d0-b978-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 34m Radio Telescope at Madrid Deep Space Communications Complex

301e1738-b6fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Proton-Electron Telescope (PET)** on the SAMPEX mission was an energetic particle instrument designed to measure electrons in the 1--30 MeV range and nuclei from H to heavier elements up to several hundred MeV/nucleon using eight lithium-drifted solid state detectors.
301e1738-b6fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Proton-Electron Telescope on SAMPEX

3025fd1a-b648-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** PeLe's Observatory in Ager is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Àger, Catalonia, Spain. It is situated at approximately 42.01926 latitude and 0.74381 longitude.
3025fd1a-b648-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: PeLe's Observatory, Spain

3026da5e-b851-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ISEE atmospheric observation instrument is an aerosol extinction spectrometer, specifically a cavity ring-down type, originally designed for measuring the extinction of light due to aerosols in the atmosphere.
3026da5e-b851-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Aerosol Extinction Spectrometer part of ISEE Observatory

30284f22-b862-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The BAS A80 Search Coil Instrument is a geomagnetic research tool situated at the Augsburg observatory (BAS.A80), designed to record micropulsations in the Earth's magnetic field at frequencies below 10 Hz, particularly at a geographic latitude of approximately 80.8° North and an east longitude of 339.6°.
30284f22-b862-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Search Coil on BAS A80 Geomagnetic Observatory

302b2c5c-b997-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The CLPS Task Order 2-AB Neutron Spectrometer System (NSS) is an instrument aboard the Peregrine Lunar Lander, designed to measure low-energy neutron flux from lunar soil to determine hydrogen abundance and stratigraphy, indicative of water-equivalent hydrogen content.
302b2c5c-b997-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutron Spectrometer System on Peregrine Lunar Lander

303b8616-b9ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Minnetonka Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Minnetonka, Minnesota, United States. It serves as a ground-based observatory for various astronomical research and observations.
303b8616-b9ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Minnetonka Observatory, United States

303f1316-bb72-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The LIPS (Low Energy Imaging Particle Spectrometer) is a scintillator-based instrument on the DSX spacecraft designed to monitor low-energy charged particles, specifically protons and electrons, within the energy range of 20 KeV through 1 MeV. It differentiates between particle types using their cross-section characteristics and scintillator properties, providing both energy and angular information.
303f1316-bb72-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Low Energy Imaging Particle Spectrometer on DSX

303fec60-ba2c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gravitational-wave Optical Transient Observer (GOTO) is a network of robotic optical telescopes designed to detect the visible light counterparts to gravitational wave events and other multi-messenger signals, with each system comprising eight 0.4m telescopes on a single mounting.
303fec60-ba2c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Gravitational-wave Optical Transient Observer at Roque de los Muchachos Observatory

305062dc-b73b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nice Observatory in France was a ground-based facility dedicated to magnetometry, operating from 1885 to 1901. It was located at an altitude of 175 meters on the Earth's surface and was part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) network.
305062dc-b73b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Nice Observatory

30506e44-b67d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 2C Data Processing Unit (DPU) is an instrument controller for the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) mission, responsible for acquiring data from various sensors and managing communication and control systems. It utilizes a Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) to ensure flexibility in its operations.
30506e44-b67d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Data Processing Unit part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

3053a0de-b897-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Telford Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Little Dawley, England. It serves as a ground-based facility for observing celestial objects and phenomena.
3053a0de-b897-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dawley Hamlets Observatory, United Kingdom

30595f5e-bbeb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The "Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) Balloon 1G Trajectory Positions" refers to the trajectory data of a specific balloon in the BARREL array, providing ephemeris information in various coordinate systems. This virtual instrument is part of the broader BARREL observatory mission, which studies relativistic electron losses from Earth's radiation belts.
30595f5e-bbeb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses part of BARREL Observatory

305a3b06-b676-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Chinle Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located at Many Farms Public School in Apache County, Arizona. It is a ground-based facility situated on the North American continent.
305a3b06-b676-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Many Farms Public School Observatory at Chinle Observatory, United States

30610d10-badf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **fluxgate magnetometer** is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields, particularly in space missions like DSCOVR, with high sensitivity and temporal resolution.
30610d10-badf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer on Deep Space Climate Observatory

306497f8-b97e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Big Water Observatory (code: V03, MPC ID: V03) is an astronomical observatory located in Big Water, Kane County, Utah, United States. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
306497f8-b97e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Big Water Observatory, United States

30693676-b976-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gekko Observatory, located in Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan, is an astronomical observatory known for its significant contributions to the discovery of minor planets.
30693676-b976-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gekko Tenmondai Observatory, Japan

306de03c-b899-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The entity refers specifically to the magnetometers operated in Barentsburg from 1957 to 1959 as part of the IAGA investigation, under the World Data Center (WDC) Kyoto.
306de03c-b899-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at Barentsburg

306e5f9c-b625-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Cloud Photopolarimeter (OCPP)** on the Pioneer Venus Orbiter was an instrument designed to provide low-resolution, four-color maps of Venusian cloud cover and determine properties such as particle distribution, size, refractive index, and cloud-top height.
306e5f9c-b625-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cloud Photopolarimeter on Pioneer Venus Orbiter

306fed6e-b939-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) 1U Ephemeris** is a virtual instrument providing trajectory positions in various coordinate systems for the BARREL Balloon, part of an observatory studying relativistic electron losses.
306fed6e-b939-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

3072aaea-b7a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Markree Observatory** was an astronomical observatory located in County Sligo, Ireland, notable for the discovery of the asteroid 9 Metis in 1848 and for housing the largest refractor telescope of its time during the early 1830s.
3072aaea-b7a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 340mm Refractor Telescope at Markree Observatory, Ireland

3072b978-b753-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Boundary Layer Radar-3 (BLR-3) at Kototabang Observatory is a high-frequency radar instrument operated in Indonesia to measure wind velocity within the atmospheric boundary layer, featuring a phased-array antenna system for multi-directional observations.
3072b978-b753-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar part of Coupling Processes in the Equatorial Atmosphere

30751e04-b7e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Automatic Space Plasma Experiment with Rotating Analyzer (ASPERA) on Phobos2 is a mass spectrometer instrument designed for space plasma analysis, featuring an electron spectrometer and an ion mass spectrometer with a 360-degree field-of-view.
30751e04-b7e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mass Spectrometer part of Automatic Space Plasma Experiment with Rotating Analyzer on Phobos 2

307718f8-b620-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Lunping Magnetic Observatory** is a ground-based magnetic observatory located in Zhongli District, Taoyuan City, Taiwan. It operates magnetometers to monitor the Earth's magnetic field and has been functional since January 1965.
307718f8-b620-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Lunping Magnetic Observatory, Taiwan

30811ae4-b5b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1Q Tilt Compensated Magnetometer (TCM2)** is a three-axis magnetometer used on the BARREL (Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses) payload to measure magnetic field components with high resolution, useful for identifying substorm activity and ULF oscillations.
30811ae4-b5b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

30895276-ba0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Odin is a space mission with a 1.1-meter telescope designed for astronomical and atmospheric research in the millimeter waveband.
30895276-ba0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Millimeter 1.1m Telescope part of Odin Astronomical and Atmospheric Satellite Mission

308e6d5a-b779-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Equatorial Magnetometer Network (EMN) includes a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer installed at Sao Luis, Brazil, which is part of the IUGONET observatory.
308e6d5a-b779-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of The Equatorial Magnetometer Network

30902d28-ba2d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Park Site (PKS) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Biggar No. 347, Saskatchewan, Canada, established in August 1986 for conducting geophysical measurements, including magnetometer readings on Earth's surface.
30902d28-ba2d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Park Site Geophysical Observatory, Canada

30959550-b961-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CARISMA Magnetometer at Rabbit Lake is a ground-based instrument located in Canada, designed to measure magnetic field variations and support scientific investigations as part of the CARISMA network.
30959550-b961-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Canadian Array for Realtime Investigations of Magnetic Activity

30a03036-ba61-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Koror, operational from January 1957 to December 31, 1966, part of the IAGA investigation and affiliated with the WDC Kyoto observatory.
30a03036-ba61-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IUGONET Observatory WDC Kyoto

30b760e2-b658-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Snohomish Hilltop Observatory, located in North America, Washington State is an astronomical observatory known for ground-based observations.
30b760e2-b658-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Snohomish Hilltop Observatory, United States

30cf410c-b5b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The New Mexico State University (NMSU) 1m Telescope is an optical telescope with a 1-meter aperture located at the Apache Point Observatory in North America.
30cf410c-b5b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 1.0m Telescope at Apache Point Observatory

30d291a6-b80a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Los Altos de Arguineguin Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Mogán, Las Palmas, Canary Islands, Spain. It is a ground-based facility situated at the coordinates 27.768871° N and -15.6856° W on Earth.
30d291a6-b80a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Los Altos de Arguineguin Observatory, Spain

30d3e6c4-b1d3-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Central University (NCU) 1m Telescope is an optical telescope with a 1-meter aperture located at the Lulin Observatory in Asia.
30d3e6c4-b1d3-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.0m National Central University Telescope at Lulin Observatory

30d64280-bb23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The RadioJOVE Terminated Folded Dipole (TFD) and FSX series spectrograph system is a ground-based instrument used for high-frequency band radio astronomy, designed to observe emissions from Jupiter, the Sun, and other phenomena in the 15 to 30+ MHz range. The TFD array features dual polarization phased antennas with variants of 4 or 8 elements, while the FSX spectrographs come in single or dual polarization models.
30d64280-bb23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Terminated Folded Dipole and FSX model Spectrometer at RadioJOVE Observatory

30e32148-b147-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a magnetometer located at the Gjoahavn observatory (identified as GJO by IAGA), which was operational from January 1, 1903, to December 31, 1905. This instrument is part of the iugonet-observatory network and is documented in various databases for scientific research purposes.
30e32148-b147-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IUGONET Observatory

30eb5b8e-b5f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The Magnetometer at Magadan, operational since October 1966, is part of the IUGONET-Observatory network and contributes to the World Data Center for Geomagnetism in Kyoto.
30eb5b8e-b5f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Magadan Observatory

30f43ac0-b84d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 2MASS camera at the Cerro Tololo International Observatory in Chile is an astronomical instrument featuring three NICMOS3 arrays within a liquid nitrogen cryostat, designed to observe the sky in J, H, and Ks bands using a complex optical system with dichroics and specialized lenses.
30f43ac0-b84d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared 2MASS Camera on 1.3m Telescope at Cerro Tololo International Observatory

30f48222-bc59-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tucson-Winterhaven Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Winterhaven, Tucson, Arizona, dedicated to ground-based observations of the night sky. It operates from a facility situated at coordinates 32.269723 latitude and -110.9303 longitude within North America.
30f48222-bc59-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tucson-Winterhaven Observatory, United States

30f5f27c-b756-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "BARREL Balloon 1O" is a component of the Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) project, a NASA mission using multiple high-altitude balloons to study electron loss from Earth's radiation belts by measuring X-rays and magnetic fields in the stratosphere.
30f5f27c-b756-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared BARREL Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses part of Living with a Star Mission of Opportunity

30f8f73a-b704-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Jim Carrigan Magnetic Observatory** is a ground-based geophysical observatory located in North Slope Borough, Alaska, United States, primarily focused on magnetic observations. It was established in 2005 and is part of the INTERMAGNET network.
30f8f73a-b704-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Jim Carrigan Observatory, United States

30fbc84e-bbfe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cascade Mountain Observatory is an astronomical facility located at 70 Santa Fe Trail in Faulkner County, Arkansas, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial phenomena.
30fbc84e-bbfe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cascade Mountain Observatory, United States

30fbf532-b87d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Dehra Dun Observatory was a ground-based facility in Dehradun, India, operational from 1903 to 1943, primarily known for its magnetometer instruments as part of the IAGA observatory network.
30fbf532-b87d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Dehra Dun Observatory, India

30fcb7b2-b59c-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Astronomsko društvo Nanos is a ground-based observatory located in Otlica, Slovenia, known by the IAU-MPC code M37.
30fcb7b2-b59c-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomsko Drustvo Nanos Observatory at Ajdovščina, Slovenia

310bb448-ba0a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer used for absolute calibration of the vector magnetometer onboard the Ørsted spacecraft.
310bb448-ba0a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Overhauser Effect Scalar Magnetometer on Oersted spacecraft

310f7ae4-b5b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "K-derived planetary indices and Dst index" are geomagnetic indicators provided by the International Service of Geomagnetic Indices (ISGI), used to monitor and assess global geomagnetic activity.
310f7ae4-b5b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: K-derived Planetary Indices and Dst Index part of International Service of Geomagnetic Indices

311085a6-bb9d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ELTE Gothard Observatory** in Szombathely is a ground-based astronomical observatory located at 110, Szent Imre herceg útja, Herény, Hungary. It is part of Eötvös Loránd University and is situated in the Western Transdanubia region.
311085a6-bb9d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gothard Astrophysical Observatory, Hungary

31132b8e-b9a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The 0.7m GROWTH India Telescope (GIT) is an optical telescope located in Asia, with a 0.7-meter aperture, designed for astronomical observations as part of the Global Relay of Observatories Watching Transients Happen (GROWTH) project.
31132b8e-b9a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.7m optical The Growth India Telescope

3116bc4a-b671-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Solar Wind Ion Composition Experiment** is an instrument aboard the ISEE-3 spacecraft that uses a mass spectrometer to analyze the charge state and isotopic composition of solar wind ions, with specific energy and velocity ranges.
