3116bc4a-b671-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar Wind Ion Composition Mass Spectrometer part of International Sun-Earth Explorer 3

311b519c-bb3f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Mawson Magnetic Observatory**: A ground-based magnetic observatory located in Mawson Station, Antarctica, operated by Geoscience Australia since 1964.
311b519c-bb3f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Mawson Magnetic Observatory, Antarctica

311d173e-ba4f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **P.M.P.H.R. Deep Sky Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Colle, Atina, Italy. It is dedicated to deep sky observations and has the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code K81.
311d173e-ba4f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: P.M.P.H.R. Deep Sky Observatory at Atina, Italy

311d4382-b5e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Instituto de Astrofisica de Andalucia - IAA/CSIC 1.5m Telescope at Observatorio de Sierra Nevada" is a ground-based observatory located in Spain, featuring a 1.5-meter telescope used for astronomical research and observations.
311d4382-b5e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.6m Telescope at Observatorio de Sierra Nevada

311ebf42-b826-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity is a "Scanning Mobility Particle Sizer" instrument used in the ISEE atmospheric observation study. It measures the size distribution of particles and is part of the IUGONET Observatory ISEE Hongo facility.
311ebf42-b826-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Scanning Mobility Particle Sizer part of International Satellites for Ionospheric Studies

31277806-b864-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Space Interferometry Mission (SIM)**, also known as SIM Lite or the SIM PlanetQuest, was a planned NASA space telescope designed to detect Earth-sized planets in habitable zones and map the Milky Way using optical interferometry; it was ultimately cancelled in 2010.
31277806-b864-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Space Interferometry Mission

3129b8d2-ba08-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The CONTOUR Interstellar Dust Analyzer (CIDA) was a time-of-flight mass spectrometer designed to study interstellar dust, mounted on the front of the spacecraft and considered an improved version of similar instruments used in previous comet missions.
3129b8d2-ba08-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Interstellar Dust Analyzer on Contour Spacecraft

312d0d4e-b692-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Corbera Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Sitges, Barcelona, Spain. It's a ground-based observatory used for stargazing and astronomical research.
312d0d4e-b692-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Observatory of Corbera

313d1932-b656-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Calvin College Observatory (H62) is an astronomical observatory located in Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States, known for its ground-based facilities.
313d1932-b656-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Calvin College Observatory, United States

314010c0-b998-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Cassini** is a NASA space probe that explored Saturn and its system from 2004 to 2017, delivering significant data on the planet's rings, atmosphere, and moons, including deploying the Huygens probe to Titan.
314010c0-b998-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cassini−Huygens part of NASA, European Space Agency and Italian Space Agency mission

314ab19a-b611-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Montevideo Astronomical Observatory is a ground-based observatory located in Montevideo, Uruguay. It is situated within the Museo de Historia Natural Dr. Carlos Torres de la Llosa and operates under the Minor Planet Center (MPC) ID X50.
314ab19a-b611-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Montevideo Astronomical Observatory, Uruguay

314c7fa0-bbb3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer operated at the IAGA North Pole station from January 01, 1963 to December 31, 1964 as part of an investigation into geomagnetic activity.
314c7fa0-bbb3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IAGA Observatory

3151802a-bca0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The magnetometer located at Eskdalemuir Observatory in Scotland has been operational since 1908, contributing to global geomagnetic research as part of the IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) network.
3151802a-bca0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Eskdalemuir Observatory

31593bde-b7ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Michelson Doppler Imager (MDI) on the SOHO spacecraft is an instrument designed to study the solar interior using helioseismology and to map the photosphere and corona through high-resolution imaging in narrow wavelength bands.
31593bde-b7ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Michelson Doppler Imager part of Solar and Heliospheric Observatory

315c419e-b873-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Murchison Widefield Array (MWA) is a radio telescope located at the Murchison Radio-astronomy Observatory in Australia, designed for low-frequency radio astronomy observations. It operates within the radio waveband and is situated on the continent of Oceania.
315c419e-b873-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Murchison Widefield Array at Murchison Radio-astronomy Observatory, Australia

316382b6-ba52-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Korea Microlensing Telescope Network (KMTNet) at Siding Spring Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Coonabarabran, New South Wales, Australia.
316382b6-ba52-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Korea Microlensing Telescope Network-SSO Observatory, Australia

31656874-b917-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Institute of Astrophysics is a ground-based observatory located in Dushanbe, Tajikistan, affiliated with the Tadzhik Academy of Sciences.
31656874-b917-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Institute of Astrophysics at Dushanbe Observatory, India

31724b68-b67c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Kachina Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Kachina Village near Flagstaff, Arizona. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
31724b68-b67c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Flagstaff Observatory

3174d950-bb54-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Karachi, identified by the IAGA code KRC, used for measuring and monitoring magnetic field variations as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
3174d950-bb54-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IUGONET Observatory

3175f2b6-b8e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity is a magnetometer located in Norilsk (identified as NOK), operational from January 1969 to December 31, 1975. It was part of the IAGA investigation and situated at the observatory affiliated with WDC Kyoto.
3175f2b6-b8e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at IUGONET Observatory

31770436-ba3d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Blackrock Castle Observatory, located in Cork, Ireland, is an astronomical observatory dedicated to ground-based observations and public outreach.
31770436-ba3d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Blackrock Castle Observatory, Ireland

3187e72c-b62a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of Virginia 26-inch Telescope is an optical telescope with a 0.66m aperture located at the Leander McCormick Observatory in North America, operated by the University of Virginia.
3187e72c-b62a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.66m Optical Telescope at Leander McCormick Observatory

31890ae2-b7e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Transmitting (TX) High Gain Antenna (HGA) for LICIACube is a compact 4x8 patch array antenna designed to provide high directivity and gain, primarily used for downlink transmission in the deep space frequency band. It operates at 8437 MHz with a turnaround ratio of 880/749 for the transponder.
31890ae2-b7e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Transmitting High Gain Antenna on LICIACube

31915514-bbd4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Golmud station with the IAGA identifier GLM.
31915514-bbd4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Golmud Observatory

31915776-b81e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 2B magnetometer is a three-axis instrument used to measure magnetic field components with high resolution. It is part of the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) project and helps identify substorm activity and ultra-low frequency oscillations, crucial for studying electron precipitation modulations.
31915776-b81e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

319385d0-ba50-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Kourovka Astronomical Observatory, also known as the K.A. Barkhatova Kourovka Astronomical Observatory, is an astronomical research facility located in Kourovka, Sverdlovsk Oblast, Russia, operated by Ural Federal University and named after Soviet astronomer K.A. Barkhatova.
319385d0-ba50-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: K.A. Barkhatova Kourovka Astronomical Observatory, Russia

31a2fbcc-b7a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Einstein Probe is a space mission led by the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) in collaboration with the European Space Agency (ESA), designed to observe X-ray emissions from transient phenomena in space.
31a2fbcc-b7a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray Einstein Probe

31a69f42-b75a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "CPEA (Coupling Processes in the Equatorial Atmosphere) Radiosonde Sounding System at Kototabang" is a scientific instrument located in West Sumatra, Indonesia. It measures vertical profiles of pressure, temperature, humidity, and horizontal wind in the lower atmosphere using Vaisala radiosondes and TOTEX balloons to gather data up to approximately 30 km altitude.
31a69f42-b75a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radiosonde Sounding System part of Coupling Processes in the Equatorial Atmosphere

31bc1bd0-b776-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "1.6m Telescope at Observatoire du Mont-Mégantic (OMM)" is a ground-based observatory located in Canada and operated by the Université de Montréal, Université Laval, and McGill University.
31bc1bd0-b776-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.6m Telescope at Observatoire du Mont Mégantic

31bc5ede-babd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) Airglow Temperature Photometer at Rikubetsu, Japan is an instrument that measures airglow intensities and rotational temperatures of OH and O2, as well as specific spectral lines, to investigate the dynamics of the upper atmosphere through nocturnal airglow emissions.
31bc5ede-babd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Airglow Temperature Photometer part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers

31cd2f96-b902-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Helios corefit data product: auxiliary orbital data" is an auxiliary dataset from the Helios mission that provides orbital information necessary for interpreting and analyzing other core scientific measurements collected by the spacecraft.
31cd2f96-b902-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform part of CNES Observatory CDPP AMDA HELIOS1

31d7bce6-b8d9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The FPO 0.32m is a 0.32-meter telescope situated at the Fremont Peak Observatory in Monterey County, California, United States, primarily used for astronomical observations.
31d7bce6-b8d9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.32m Telescope at Fremont Peak Observatory, United States

31d821a6-bc6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Isaac Newton Telescope (INT) is a 2.54 m optical telescope located at the Roque de los Muchachos Observatory on La Palma in the Canary Islands, known for its Cassegrain design and precise tracking capabilities.
31d821a6-bc6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.54m Isaac Newton Telescope at Roque de los Muchachos Observatory, Spain

31e5ff0e-ba19-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Allegheny Observatory is an astronomical research institution and historic landmark affiliated with the University of Pittsburgh. It is located in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and is notable for its contributions to astronomy and historical significance.
31e5ff0e-ba19-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Allegheny Observatory, United States

31e6973c-b683-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The specific magnetometer referenced operated at the Plateau observatory from January 1966 to December 31, 1968, and was part of the IAGA investigation associated with the Kyoto World Data Center for Geomagnetism (WDC-Kyoto).
31e6973c-b683-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet Observatory

31e7e01e-b819-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The ICESTAR Ground Observatory Group is a network of ground-based observatories located on Earth's surface, comprising stations such as AGO P1-P6, Gakona, Iqaluit, McMurdo, and South Pole, dedicated to scientific research.
31e7e01e-b819-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ICESTAR Ground Observatory Group

31fec9b2-b8f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Phoenix Lander Thermal and Evolved Gas Analyzer (TEGA) was an instrument on the Phoenix Mars Lander designed to analyze soil samples by heating them and studying the released gases using scanning calorimetry and mass spectrometry. It aimed to detect volatile compounds, including water and carbon dioxide, and potentially identify organic molecules in Martian ice and soil.
31fec9b2-b8f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Thermal and Evolved Gas Analyzer on Phoenix Mars Lander

320345e4-ba25-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 1-micron Camera (IR1) is an instrument designed to image Venus's dayside and nightside at specific wavelengths, measuring scattered solar radiation, thermal emission, and surface water abundance while also searching for active volcanism.
320345e4-ba25-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared 1-micron Camera on Akatsuki

3213ddea-bb57-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Iowa Robotic Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Santa Cruz County, Arizona. It specializes in ground-based observations and is situated at coordinates 31.665465736227926° N, -110.60198041846508° W.
3213ddea-bb57-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sonoita Observatory, United States

3218bbb2-b8a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Science Laboratory (MSL), known as Curiosity, is a NASA rover mission designed to explore Mars' habitability and geology. Launched in 2011, it aims to assess the potential for past or present life on Mars over at least one Martian year.
3218bbb2-b8a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Curiosity part of Mars Science Laboratory

3223a84c-b1a7-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Bossekop Geomagnetic Observatory (BOP) is a ground-based facility in Alta, Norway, that conducted geomagnetic measurements from 1839 to 1933.
3223a84c-b1a7-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Bossekop Geomagnetic Observatory, Norway

3227ffa0-b99a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Meteorological Operational satellite programme (MetOp) is a European initiative led by ESA and Eumetsat to provide weather data services for climate monitoring and forecast improvement, with MetOp-B being the second satellite in the series.
3227ffa0-b99a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Meteorological Operational satellite programme on Earth Near Surface

323a0d04-ba4d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Wide Band Data (WBD) on Cluster 2/FM8 (Tango) is an instrument designed to provide high-resolution frequency/time spectra of plasma waves in the Earth's magnetosphere by measuring electric and magnetic fields in selected frequency bands from 25 Hz to 577 KHz. It processes signals from electric field sensors and search coil magnetometers, enabling very-long-baseline-interferometer measurements with microsecond time resolution.
323a0d04-ba4d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waveform Receiver Wide Band Data part of Cluster 2

323e8944-b87f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Trebur Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Trebur, Hesse, Germany. It operates as a ground-based observatory for conducting astronomical research and observations.
323e8944-b87f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Michael Adrian Observatory, Germany

324940f6-b680-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Waltonfields Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Walton, Kentucky. It is a ground-based facility used for observing celestial objects and phenomena.
324940f6-b680-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waltonfields Observatory, United States

3250eeea-b6bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Uiterstegracht Station is an astronomical observatory located in Leiden, South Holland, Netherlands. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
3250eeea-b6bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Leiden Observatory, Netherlands

3262bdee-b700-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tananarive (TAN) Magnetic Observatory, also known as the Antananarivo Magnetic Observatory, is a ground-based facility located in Madagascar that has been operating since 1902 to monitor and study magnetic fields.
3262bdee-b700-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Antananarivo Magnetic Observatory, Madagascar

326d73c0-b993-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Kiruna Geomagnetic Observatory (KIR), located in Kiruna, Sweden, is a ground-based facility that has been operating since 1962 to monitor and study geomagnetic activity. It is part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) observatory network.
326d73c0-b993-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kiruna Geomagnetic Observatory, Sweden

326f7620-b768-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lenkerbeck Observatory (MPC ID: 612) is an astronomical observatory located in Burgaltendorf, Essen, Germany. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
326f7620-b768-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lenkerbeck Observatory, Germany

3276da0a-b8bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Cosmic Ray Particles Experiment on Helios-A** was an instrument designed to study high-energy charged particles, including protons, alpha particles, and electrons, originating from solar, planetary, and galactic sources in interplanetary space. It operated with a particle telescope equipped with multiple detectors, capable of measuring particles within specific energy ranges over the distance from 0.3 to 1.0 AU.
3276da0a-b8bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: EnergeticParticleInstrument on Helios-A part of Cosmic Ray Particles Experiment

32784358-b74b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Winnipeg that operated from January 1, 1969, to December 31, 1975, as part of the IAGA investigation and the IUGONET Observatory network.
32784358-b74b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Winnipeg Observatory

32794cf0-ba14-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The Qaanaaq Ground Magnetic Field Instrument, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG and located at Thule ground station, has been operational since January 1, 2007.
32794cf0-ba14-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of THEMIS Mission

327a4b12-b97b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Armenian Academy of Sciences 2.6m Telescope is a part of the Byurakan Astrophysical Observatory (BAO), a ground-based observatory located in Armenia.
327a4b12-b97b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.6m Telescope at Byurakan Astrophysical Observatory

327dd764-b999-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Fluxgate magnetometer at Darwin** is part of the 210 Magnetic Meridian (210MM) magnetometer network and is situated at the IUGONET observatory, specifically at the International Sun-Earth Explorer (ISEE).
327dd764-b999-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of IUGONET Observatory

32848256-b5ef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Culgoora station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Narrabri, Australia (coordinates: -30.32 latitude, 149.57 longitude), part of the global MAGDAS network for studying geomagnetic field variations.
32848256-b5ef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at MAGDAS Culgoora station, Australia

328a4142-b6ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Thomas G. Cupillari Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Fleetville, Pennsylvania, United States. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observation.
328a4142-b6ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Thomas G. Cupillari Observatory, United States

3292f0da-ba44-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The United Kingdom Infra-Red Telescope (UKIRT) is a 3.8-meter infrared reflecting telescope located on Mauna Kea, Hawai'i, formerly operated by the Joint Astronomy Centre and currently funded by NASA under scientific cooperation with Lockheed Martin Advanced Technology Center, the University of Hawaii, and the U.S. Naval Observatory.
3292f0da-ba44-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: infrared 3.8m United Kingdom Infrared Telescope at Mauna Kea Observatory, United States

32a02194-bad3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Bodo that operated from January 1, 1932, to December 31, 1934, used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field as part of the IAGA investigation.
32a02194-bad3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at WDC Kyoto Observatory

32a2d280-bc6e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ISEE1 spacecraft ephemeris** is a dataset that provides the position and velocity of the ISEE1 spacecraft in Geocentric Solar Ecliptic (GSE) coordinates, facilitating orbital analysis for scientific investigations.
32a2d280-bc6e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ISEE1 Spacecraft Ephemeris part of International Sun-Earth Explorer 1

32a3df1e-b6b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Jornada Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Las Cruces, New Mexico, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial objects.
32a3df1e-b6b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Jornada Observatory, United States

32c25d80-baf2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Teoloyucan Magnetic Observatory** is a ground-based magnetic observatory located in Teoloyucan, State of Mexico. It was operated by the National Autonomous University of Mexico from 1965 to 2008 and contributed to geomagnetic data collection as part of global networks like IUGONET and WDC Kyoto.
32c25d80-baf2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Teoloyucan Magnetic Observatory, Mexico

32dc87c8-b674-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Baguio that operated from 1967 to 1983 as part of the IAGA investigation.
32dc87c8-b674-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Baguio Observatory

32dfa202-b924-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Niue station, located on Niue Island in Oceania, is a ground-based observatory that has been operational since October 2004, focusing on ionosonde observations.
32dfa202-b924-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionosonde at Niue Observatory, Niue

32e2485e-b96a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **New Bullpen Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Alpharetta, Georgia, United States. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
32e2485e-b96a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Alpharetta Observatory, United States

32eb15f6-ba5f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ATCA at the Paul Wild Observatory is an array of six 22-meter diameter antennas located in Narrabri, Australia, used for radio astronomy observations in wavelengths ranging from 3 mm to 27 cm.
32eb15f6-ba5f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 54m radio Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation Astronomy and Space Science Australia Telescope Compact Array at the Paul Wild Observatory, Australia

32ece93a-b9c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of Tasmania's 30-meter telescope at the Ceduna Radio Observatory is a ground-based observational facility designed for radio astronomy. It forms part of the larger Ceduna Radio Observatory complex.
32ece93a-b9c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 30m Telescope at Ceduna Radio Observatory

32efa78e-b711-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Siding Spring-LCO Clamshell #1 is an astronomical observatory located at the Siding Spring Observatory in Coonabarabran, New South Wales, Australia.
32efa78e-b711-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Siding Spring Observatory, Australia

32f30bba-b89a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Plasma and Radio Waves (WAVES) instrument on the Wind spacecraft is designed to study radio and plasma wave phenomena in the Earth's geospace. It utilizes a combination of electric and magnetic sensors along with advanced analysis electronics to measure various types of plasma waves and their interactions, providing crucial insights into the Earth's response to solar wind conditions.
32f30bba-b89a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Plasma and Radio Waves on Wind

32f42314-ba2b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Extreme Solar Ultraviolet Monitor (ESUM) is a spectrometer instrument designed to make absolute broadband spectro-radiometric measurements of the solar EUV flux from 200 Å to Lyman-alpha at 1216 Å, focusing on precise temporal variability.
32f42314-ba2b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Extreme Solar Ultraviolet Monitor part of AE-E

330150c8-babe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Lowell Observatory, Anderson Mesa** is a ground-based observatory located at Anderson Mesa in Arizona. It houses the NASA 0.6m LONEOS (Lowell Observatory Near Earth Object Search) telescope, which is used for researching near-Earth objects.
330150c8-babe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.6m LONEOS Telescope at Lowell Observatory, Anderson Mesa

3304e71e-b682-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kanzelhöhe Solar Observatory (KSO) is a ground-based astronomical facility located on the Earth's surface, dedicated to solar observations. It is part of the larger observational network and is equipped with specialized instruments for studying solar phenomena.
3304e71e-b682-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kanzelhoehe Solar Observatory

330769ea-b9a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 2L Tilt Compensated Magnetometer (TCM2)** is a three-axis magnetometer aboard the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) payload. It measures magnetic field components with high resolution to identify substorm activity and ULF oscillations, crucial for studying electron precipitation modulations.
330769ea-b9a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

330938d6-b944-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Aryabhatta Research Institute of Observational Sciences (ARIES) 1m Sampurnanand Telescope is an optical telescope with a 1.0-meter aperture, located in Asia and operated by the ARIES institute for astronomical research.
330938d6-b944-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical 1.0m Aryabhatta Research Institute of Observational Sciences Sampurnanand Telescope at Aryabhatta Research Institute of Observational Sciences

330a0434-b825-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Ventilla Observatory**, located in Madrid, Spain, is an astronomical observatory primarily dedicated to ground-based observations.
330a0434-b825-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Madrid Observatory, Spain

33220d38-bb20-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The DSS 25 is a radio telescope located at the Goldstone Deep Space Communications Complex in Fort Irwin, California. It has an aperture of 34 meters and is part of NASA's Deep Space Network.
33220d38-bb20-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 34.0m Radio Telescope at Goldstone Deep Space Communications Complex, United States

3322e656-b9f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Shimotsuma Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Yagiwara, Shimotsuma, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
3322e656-b9f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Shimotsuma Observatory, Japan

33236aae-ba38-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: MAGDAS Hermanus station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Hermanus, South Africa, part of the global MAGDAS network. It operates with a fluxgate instrument to monitor geomagnetic activity at coordinates -34.34 latitude and 19.24 longitude in Western Cape.
33236aae-ba38-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hermanus Observatory, South Africa

3326b426-b9bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kremsmunster Magnetometer was an instrument used for measuring magnetic fields at the IAGA-designated station in Kremsmunster from 1891 to 1904. It was part of the observatory's efforts within the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA).
3326b426-b9bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kremsmunster Observatory

333164ba-bbc3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Guimar-Tenerife Magnetic Observatory is a ground-based facility in Güímar, Spain, that has been continuously monitoring Earth's magnetic field since 1993. It operates under the sponsorship of Spain and is managed by the Instituto Geográfico Nacional.
333164ba-bbc3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Guimar Geomagnetic Observatory, Spain

3331fa62-ba27-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields, particularly Earth's magnetic field. The Muono Magnetometer, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation, has been operational at the Muono Geophysical Observatory since January 1, 2017.
3331fa62-ba27-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Muono Geophysical Observatory

333783b0-b973-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MGS Proxies are a set of proxy data derived from the Magnetometer instrument onboard the Mars Global Surveyor (MGS), managed by CNES's CDPP-AMDA observatory, providing useful information for studying Mars.
333783b0-b973-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Mars Global Surveyor

333d24da-b623-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "NOAA 8 Positions" entity describes the spatial coordinates of the NOAA 8 spacecraft across different reference frames. It is part of the broader NOAA 8 observatory platform.
333d24da-b623-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform part of NOAA 8

3350aed0-bb67-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EMN fluxgate magnetometer at CNX is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed in Chiangmai, Thailand, designed to measure magnetic field variations as part of the Equatorial Magnetometer Network.
3350aed0-bb67-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Equatorial Magnetometer Network

3354bd3c-b927-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Van Allen Probe A (RBSP-A)** is a space probe designed to study Earth's Van Allen radiation belts as part of NASA's Living With a Star Geospace program, aimed at understanding the sun's influence on near-Earth space and improving astronaut safety.
3354bd3c-b927-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radiation Belt Storm Probes A part of Van Allen Probes

3368af0a-b719-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: This entity describes a ground-based facility located at Nagoya University in Japan that collects CO2 isotope data using an infrared laser absorption spectrometer.
3368af0a-b719-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Laser Absorption Spectrometer at Nagoya Observatory, Japan

336f696c-b78c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Kuujjuarapik Geophysical Observatory, operational since October 17, 2014, and part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation.
336f696c-b78c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kuujjuarapik Geophysical Observatory, Canada

3370d420-b85c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kiev Magnetic Observatory is a ground-based facility in Dymer Settlement Hromada, Ukraine, that conducts magnetic observations on Earth's surface. It has been operational since July 1958 and is part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) network.
3370d420-b85c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kiev Geomagnetic Observatory, Ukraine

337378de-b63a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Toledo Geophysical Observatory was a ground-based facility in Spain that operated from 1957 to 1981, primarily focusing on geomagnetic measurements.
337378de-b63a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Toledo Geophysical Observatory, Spain

33753ec2-bb2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: An Electrostatic Analyser named CIS-HIA, part of the Cluster mission, is a symmetric quadrispherical analyzer that measures 2D and 3D distributions of ions in the energy range of ~5 eV/charge to 32 KeV/charge, using microchannel-plate electron multipliers and position encoding by discrete anodes.
33753ec2-bb2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cluster Ion Composition Investigation - Hot Ion Analyser on Cluster 1

33792d22-b99d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) All-Sky Imager at Magadan, Russia is a multi-wavelength instrument developed by Nagoya University to study the dynamics of the upper atmosphere through nocturnal airglow emissions.
33792d22-b99d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Multi-wavelength All-Sky Imager part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers at Magadan Observatory

338d93a4-b662-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Electrostatic Analyser (ERPA) on the Rocket Experiment for Neutral Upwelling 2 (RENU2) mission was an instrument designed to measure thermal electrons in the energy range from 0 eV to 3 eV in 0.06 eV increments, launched by NASA on December 13, 2015.
338d93a4-b662-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electron Retarding Potential Analyzer part of Rocket Experiment for Neutral Upwelling 2

33917156-b9b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The TIM (Total Irradiation Monitor) on SORCE is an instrument designed to measure total solar irradiance with high accuracy, covering all visual and infrared wavelengths.
33917156-b9b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Total Irradiation Monitor on Solar Radiation and Climate Experiment

3396277e-b8e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **FIELDS instrument** is part of the Parker Solar Probe Mission and combines magnetic and electric field measurements using various sensors mounted on a deployable boom and at the base of the spacecraft's heat shield. It includes the V1 voltage probe, which measures electric fields and reaches extremely high temperatures during close solar approaches.
3396277e-b8e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: FIELDS Suite part of Parker Solar Probe Mission

339d6828-b8b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Earth Polychromatic Imaging Camera (EPIC)** is a 10-channel spectroradiometer onboard NOAA's DSCOVR spacecraft that captures spectral images of the entire sunlit face of Earth and provides data for climate research.
339d6828-b8b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Earth Polychromatic Imaging Camera on Deep Space Climate Observatory

33a44844-b6a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mutual Impedance Probe (RPC-MIP) is an instrument on the Rosetta orbiter designed to measure plasma parameters like electron density using an electric antenna and HF analyzer. It operates in both active and passive modes to study plasma characteristics around comets.
33a44844-b6a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mutual Impedance Probe part of Rosetta Plasma Consortium

33ae9996-b757-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer at EUS" is a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer installed in Eusebio, Brazil, part of the MAGDAS observation network within the IUGONET observatory.
33ae9996-b757-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

33b3cab2-b868-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Linares (LRES) Fluxgate Magnetometer is a magnetometer located at the McMAC Linares station, part of the Mid-continent Magnetoseismic Chain (McMAC), used for magnetic field measurements.
33b3cab2-b868-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Mid-continent Magnetoseismic Chain

33b4001a-b721-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Lunar Gravity Ranging System (LGRS) B** is an instrument onboard the GRAIL-B spacecraft designed to generate and measure radio signals at Ka-band, X-band, and S-band for precise determination of the distance between twin GRAIL spacecraft orbiting the Moon. It works in conjunction with its identical counterpart on GRAIL-A to study lunar gravity and interior structure.
33b4001a-b721-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lunar Gravity Ranging System on Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory B Spacecraft part of Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory

33c93e86-b72f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, and the one at Wilhelmshaven was operational from 1884 to 1932 as part of the IAGA investigation.
33c93e86-b72f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Wilhelmshaven Observatory

33ca8eb6-bae1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA station in Tomsk (TMK), operational from January 1958 to December 1969.
33ca8eb6-bae1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at WDC-Tmk Observatory

33d7ebd0-b86e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Mars Express Orbiter Analyzer of Space Plasma and Energetic Atoms (3rd Version) (ASPERA-3) is an instrument on the Mars Express Orbiter designed to study solar wind-atmosphere interactions and characterize plasma and neutral gas environments around Mars using four sensors: two ENA sensors, an electron spectrometer, and an ion mass analyzer.
33d7ebd0-b86e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Analyzer of Space Plasma and Energetic Atoms on Mars Express

33e0e836-ba15-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Space Environment Monitor (SEM) on GOES 8 is an instrument suite designed to measure the real-time effects of solar activity on the near-Earth electromagnetic environment, providing crucial data for space weather reports that impact communication systems, navigation, electric power transmission, and satellites.
33e0e836-ba15-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ion Chamber part of Space Environment Monitor on GOES 8

33e3aea0-bb95-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Crimean Astrophysical Observatory-Simeis is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Nauchny, Crimea, Ukraine. It includes the Simeis telescope and conducts various astrophysical research activities.
33e3aea0-bb95-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1m Grubb Telescope at Simeiz Observatory, Ukraine

33e62300-b759-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 's-Gravenwezel Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Schilde, Antwerp, Belgium. It is situated at coordinates 4.5597 longitude and 51.24003 latitude on the continent of Europe.
33e62300-b759-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 's-Gravenwezel Observatory, Belgium

33ec9cea-b6cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The HATNet is an automated telescope network based at the Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics in North America, dedicated to surveying exoplanets using optical waveband observations.
33ec9cea-b6cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics Hungarian-made Automated Telescope Network Exoplanet Survey Network

33ef6236-b7b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lincoln Near-Earth Asteroid Research (LINEAR) project is an astronomical observatory located in Socorro, New Mexico, dedicated to detecting and tracking near-Earth objects through a collaboration between the U.S. Air Force, NASA, and MIT's Lincoln Laboratory.
33ef6236-b7b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lincoln Near-Earth Asteroid Research at Lincoln Laboratory's Experimental Test Site on White Sands Missile Range, United States

34004eaa-bb51-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **IMAGE (Imager for Magnetopause-to-Aurora Global Exploration)** was a NASA satellite mission launched in 2000 to study the Earth's magnetosphere and its response to solar wind changes, using neutral atom, ultraviolet, and radio imaging techniques. It unexpectedly ceased operations in 2005 but has contributed significantly to scientific research in space physics.
34004eaa-bb51-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Imager for Magnetopause-to-Aurora Global Exploration part of Medium Explorer Program

340214f6-b967-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Moca Ground Magnetic Field Instrument is a magnetometer located at the IAGA station MFP in Moca. It was operational from January 1, 1958, to December 31, 1971, and was part of the WDC Kyoto observatory network.
340214f6-b967-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kyoto Observatory

3402a5fa-b96d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Observatoire de Saint Domineuc" is a ground-based observatory located in Les Grands Champs, Saint-Domineuc, Brittany, France. It serves as an astronomical facility for Earth observations and research.
3402a5fa-b96d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatoire de Saint-Domineuc, France

3402e6c8-bb0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Venera 16 Energetic Particles experiment was a Soviet suite of particle detectors designed to monitor the flux of charged particles in interplanetary space and Venus orbit, measuring protons and alpha particles from both sunward and anti-sunward directions.
3402e6c8-bb0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particles experiment on Venera 16

340546ae-b7c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: An Electrostatic Analyzer, specifically the CIS-HIA (Cluster Ion Spectrometry - Hot Ion Analyser), is an instrument onboard the Cluster 3 spacecraft that measures the 2D and 3D distribution of ions in the energy range from ~5 eV/charge to 32 KeV/charge, using a symmetric quadrispherical analyzer with microchannel-plate electron multipliers.
340546ae-b7c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electrostatic Analyser on Cluster 3, part of Cluster Ion Spectrometry Experiment

340adfba-b821-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Retarding Potential Analyzer (RPA) on Dynamics Explorer 2 was an instrument designed to measure the bulk ion velocity, ion concentrations, and ion temperature along the satellite's path. It used a multigridded planar retarding potential analyzer to derive these parameters from the ion number flux vs energy curve obtained by varying the voltage applied to its internal retarding grids.
340adfba-b821-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Retarding Potential Analyser on Dynamics Explorer 2

3411cfae-b80e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 4.1m Southern Astrophysical Research (SOAR) Telescope is an optical telescope located at Cerro Pachón in South America, designed for astrophysical research.
3411cfae-b80e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 4.1m optical Southern Astrophysical Research Telescope at Cerro Pachon

34181456-b929-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The McGraw-Hill Observatory is a ground-based observatory facility that includes the Tinsley 1.3m telescope, part of NASA's Planetary Data System (PDS).
34181456-b929-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: McGraw-Hill Observatory

341c092a-ba24-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Driesen Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Chyże, Lubusz Voivodeship, Poland. It operates as a ground-based facility with the MPC (Minor Planet Center) ID 284.
341c092a-ba24-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Driesen Observatory, Poland

341fdb82-b5af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Macquarie Island Ionospheric Scintillation Monitor** is a specialized GPS receiver system located near Macquarie Island, Tasmania, Australia, designed to monitor and collect data on ionospheric scintillation levels in real time for scientific research.
341fdb82-b5af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionospheric Scintillation Monitor at Macquarie Island Observatory, Australia

342602d6-b772-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Terra (EOS AM-1) is a NASA Earth observation satellite launched in 1999 to study changes in Earth's atmosphere, land, and water through simultaneous measurements.
342602d6-b772-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Terra part of Earth Observing System

342904d2-ba4b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Paratunka Magnetic Observatory is a ground-based magnetic observatory located in Paratunka, Russia, which is part of the MAGDAS magnetometer network.
342904d2-ba4b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Paratunka Magnetic Observatory, Russia

3429aa8c-b68a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Beimian Tianwentai Observatory (also known as the Corona Borealis Observatory) is an astronomical observatory located in Ali, Ngari Prefecture, Tibet, China. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
3429aa8c-b68a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Corona Borealis Observatory, China

342aa9e0-b839-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
NOAA-14 (1994-089A) is a third-generation Polar Orbiting Environmental Satellite (POES) operated by NOAA, launched in 1994 to provide data for meteorological prediction, oceanographic services, and space environment monitoring.
342aa9e0-b839-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Polar Orbiting Environmental Satellite NOAA-J part of National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration

342daa30-b737-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN fluxgate magnetometer at CPA is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument located in Cachoeira Paulista, Brazil. It is part of the IUGONET Observatory and measures magnetic field variations as part of its observational network.
342daa30-b737-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of Circum-Pan Pacific Magnetometer Network

342f2df2-b646-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The San Antonio (SATX) Fluxgate Magnetometer is a magnetometer located at the San Antonio station of the Mid-continent Magnetoseismic Chain (McMAC), used for measuring magnetic field variations.
342f2df2-b646-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Mid-continent Magnetoseismic Chain

3438286e-bad6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Parker Solar Probe is a NASA spacecraft launched in 2018 to study the Sun's outer corona and solar wind by making numerous close approaches to trace energy flow and explore magnetic fields.
3438286e-bad6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.3m Parker Solar Probe

34397cc0-b840-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "ISEE atmospheric observation" instrument known as the **aerosol extinction spectrometer** is a cavity ring-down spectrometer used to measure the extinction of aerosols in the atmosphere. It was originally developed for detailed atmospheric studies and is part of the IUGONET Observatory at Shigaraki.
34397cc0-b840-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Aerosol Extinction Spectrometer at Shigaraki Observatory

343b0f92-b794-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Rolvenden Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Rolvenden, Kent, England. It is a ground-based facility situated at Hastings Road, Cherrygarden Farm, with coordinates approximately 51.0542° N, 0.6333° E.
343b0f92-b794-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rolvenden Observatory, United Kingdom

344891d8-b8e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the Astronomical Objects Ephemerides, which are calculated using SPICE (NAIF) kernels and managed by CNES CDPP-AMDA. This data set provides orbital information for planets and moons within the Heliosphere starting from January 1, 1970.
344891d8-b8e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemerides on CDPP-AMDA

3451bc16-b964-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Fremont Peak Observatory (FPOA) is an astronomical observatory located in Fremont Peak State Park near San Juan Bautista, California, operated by the Fremont Peak Observatory Association since its establishment in 1986.
3451bc16-b964-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 32 inch Challenger Telescope at Fremont Peak Observatory, United States

3452d58a-ba2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Astronomical Observatory of Saratov State University is a ground-based observatory located in Saratov, Russia. It serves as a facility for astronomical research and education within the university's campus.
3452d58a-ba2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Observatory of Saratov State University

345d3532-ba63-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 4G was a high-altitude balloon mission launched on August 29, 2016, and concluded on August 30, 2016, as part of the BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) project to study particles escaping from Earth's radiation belts.
345d3532-ba63-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses part of Living with a Star Mission of Opportunity

34702dd2-b959-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cape Parry Geomagnetic Observatory (CPY) is a ground-based facility located in the Inuvialuit Settlement Region of Northwest Territories, Canada, dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity.
34702dd2-b959-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Cape Parry Geomagnetic Observatory, Canada

3477be9c-b915-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The PEACE (Plasma Electron and Current Experiment) instrument, part of the Cluster-1 mission starting from December 2000, is designed to measure the three-dimensional electron velocity distribution function with high time, energy, and angular resolution. It consists of two sensors per spacecraft, each providing complete 4π solid angle coverage in one spin, optimized for accurate low-energy measurements and relative accuracy between sensors on multiple spacecraft.
3477be9c-b915-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Plasma Electron and Current Experiment on Cluster-1

347c77b6-b744-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Mariner 7 was a NASA spacecraft launched in 1969 as part of the dual mission with Mariner 6 to explore Mars. Its primary objectives were to study the Martian surface and atmosphere during close flybys, contributing to future investigations and technological developments for Mars missions.
347c77b6-b744-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Spectrometer on Mariner 7

348ae93a-bba0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MMS 3 Energetic Particle Detector (EPD) Suite, Fly's Eye Energetic Particle Sensor (FEEPS) is an instrument on the Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission that measures three-dimensional energetic ion and electron flux distributions over specified energy ranges with a time resolution of 10 seconds. It was launched in March 2015 and is part of the CNES observatory CDPP archive.
348ae93a-bba0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fly's Eye Energetic Particle Sensor part of MMS 3 EPD Suite

34943ddc-b60f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Psyche Gamma Ray Spectrometer (GRS) is an instrument aboard the Psyche spacecraft designed to detect, measure, and map the elemental composition of asteroid (16) Psyche. It is mounted on a boom to minimize background radiation interference and ensure clear observations.
34943ddc-b60f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gamma Ray Spectrometer on Psyche spacecraft

34a8cf66-ba53-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Almeria (ALM), operational from 1955 to 1991, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the IAGA investigation.
34a8cf66-ba53-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Almería Observatory

34ae41a8-b97c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Curdridge Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Curdridge, near Winchester, Hampshire, England. It operates as a ground-based facility for stargazing and celestial observations.
34ae41a8-b97c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Curdridge Observatory, United Kingdom

34b6f0b8-b7f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Marienburg Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Hildesheim, Germany, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial bodies.
34b6f0b8-b7f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hildesheim Observatory, Germany

34d2c904-baeb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DSS-13 34-m Radio Telescope, located in San Bernardino County, California, is a fully steerable research and development radio/radar antenna that is part of NASA's Deep Space Network. It has been used for radar interferometry and facilitates high-frequency development work.
34d2c904-baeb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 34m Deep Space Station 13 Radio Telescope at Goldstone Observatory, United States

34d5b314-b7ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Université de Montréal/Université Laval/McGill University 1.6m telescope is located at the Observatoire du Mont-Mégantic in North America and operates within the optical waveband, featuring an aperture of 1.6 meters.
34d5b314-b7ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.6m Telescope at Observatoire du Mont-Mégantic

35123df4-bb5a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Angra Do Heroismo Magnetometer is an instrument used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field at a station identified by IAGA as ANH, operational from January 1, 1957, to December 31, 1970.
35123df4-bb5a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Angra Do Heroismo Observatory

351ebc68-ba07-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Geyserland Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Pukehangi, Rotorua, New Zealand. It serves as a ground-based facility for observing celestial bodies and phenomena from Earth.
351ebc68-ba07-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geyserland Observatory

3522f96a-b6a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Skyledge Observatory (MPC code: W77) is an astronomical observatory located in Killingworth, Connecticut, United States. It functions as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
3522f96a-b6a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Skyledge Observatory, United States

35292dea-bba3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Coimbra Observatory, also known as the Coimbra Geomagnetic Observatory (COI), is a ground-based facility located in Coimbra, Portugal, that has been operational since 1866 and includes instruments such as the WDC Kyoto Magnetometer for geomagnetic measurements.
35292dea-bba3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Coimbra Observatory, Portugal

3530d582-b67f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hornepayne Magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field at the Hornepayne Geophysical Observatory. It has been operational since February 3, 2007, and is part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation.
3530d582-b67f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hornepayne Observatory

3534045a-baf8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Dumont d'Urville Magnetic Observatory is a ground-based facility located at Dumont d'Urville Station in Antarctica, established in 1957 to conduct magnetic observations.
3534045a-baf8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Dumont d'Urville Magnetic Observatory, Antarctica

354230a2-b9e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A Magnetometer from the MAGDAS observation network located in Durban, South Africa, which is a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate instrument used to measure magnetic fields.
354230a2-b9e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System Observation Network

355361a4-b72b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) is a radio telescope array located in Australia, designed to conduct astronomical observations in the radio waveband.
355361a4-b72b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder at Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder, Australia

355ac730-b5e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The VLF/ELF valley antenna at Moshiri, Japan, is a crossed loop antenna system designed to detect very low frequency (VLF) and extremely low frequency (ELF) signals, operational from 1980 until August 28, 2009.
355ac730-b5e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Very Low Frequency and Extremely Low Frequency crossed loop antenna with a valley antenna part of Iugonet Observatory

3565667a-bbcb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Sternwarte Limburg** is an astronomical observatory located in Limburg an der Lahn, Hesse, Germany. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
3565667a-bbcb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Limburg Observatory, Germany

35684e7e-bb78-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Yerres-Canotiers Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Yerres, France. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical observations and research.
35684e7e-bb78-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Yerres-Canotiers Observatory, France

357d025a-b822-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Wide-range 3D Ion Spectrometer (CORAL)** on the Interball Tail Probe is an electrostatic analyzer designed to measure quasi-3D ion distribution in the energy range of 50 eV to 25 keV without separating species, covering approximately 10.9 steradians every 2 minutes.
357d025a-b822-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electrostatic Analyser Wide-range 3D Ion Spectrometer on Interball Tail Probe

357e19e2-bbab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 9.3m Southern African Large Telescope (SALT) is a major optical telescope located in South Africa, operating under the South African Astronomical Observatory and used for astronomical research.
357e19e2-bbab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 9.3m Southern African Large Telescope at South African Astronomical Observatory, Africa

3583ee5a-b6d6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **El Gato Gris Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Tanti, Argentina. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
3583ee5a-b6d6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: El Gato Gris Observatory, Argentina

35865322-ba85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Digisonde ionospheric station at Boa Vista, Brazil (URSI-code: BVJ03) was an advanced facility that measured angle of arrival, polarization, Doppler frequency shift, and travel time of skywave signals reflected from the ionosphere. It operated from October 2002 to December 2002 and was located at Rua Apocalipse, Cinturão Verde, Boa Vista, Brazil.
35865322-ba85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digisonde at GIRO Observatory, Brazil

35894a6c-b703-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Eileen M. Collins Observatory is a small astronomical observatory located at Corning Community College in Corning, New York. It is used for teaching astronomy classes and offers monthly public viewing sessions.
35894a6c-b703-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Eileen M. Collins Observatory, United States

358a7e48-ba12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Mars 2020**: A NASA mission featuring the Perseverance rover and the Ingenuity helicopter, designed to explore Mars' Jezero Crater for signs of past life and collect samples for future return to Earth.
358a7e48-ba12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Perseverance Rover part of Mars Exploration Program

3591bba0-bbd3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA Chandra X-ray Observatory (CXO) is a satellite mission designed to observe and study X-ray emissions from celestial objects, providing crucial data for astrophysical research.
3591bba0-bbd3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Chandra X-ray Telescope part of NASA Chandra X-ray Observatory

359922a4-bae4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Advanced Camera for Surveys (ACS)** is an imaging instrument on the Hubble Space Telescope designed to capture high-resolution images across a range of wavelengths from near-infrared to ultraviolet. It features three observing modes: a wide-field channel (WFC), a high-resolution channel (HRC), and a solar blind channel (SBC).
359922a4-bae4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Advanced Camera for Surveys on Hubble Space Telescope

359c3970-bac7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the ground observatory located at 6, Via Filippo Addis, Luna e Sole, Sassari, Sardinia, Italy (latitude 40.72749, longitude 8.5785), known as the Sassari Observatory.
359c3970-bac7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sassari Observatory, Italy

35ace796-b808-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The IAGA magnetometer station located in South Uist is a scientific instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field and contributes data to the INTERMAGNET network under the identifier SOU.
35ace796-b808-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet-Observatory Wdc Kyoto

35af6538-b5b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Plasma Spectrometer (PLS) on Voyager 1** is an instrument featuring two Faraday-cup detectors used to measure the properties of space plasmas, including density, temperature, and velocity of solar wind and interstellar plasma. It employs sequential energy scans to analyze both ions and electrons in various energy ranges.
35af6538-b5b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Faraday Cup part of Plasma Science Experiment for Voyager 1

35b0d13e-b9da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Quainton Observatory:** An astronomical observatory located in Quainton, Buckinghamshire, England, known for its ground-based observations.
35b0d13e-b9da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Quainton Observatory, United Kingdom

35b31f9a-b654-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Zeno Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical observations and research.
35b31f9a-b654-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Zeno Observatory, United States

35c068fc-b763-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Odessa station, operational from 1896 to 1925, as part of the IAGA investigation and affiliated with the WDC Kyoto observatory.
35c068fc-b763-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IUGONET Observatory

35c30888-b708-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Calar Alto-Schmidt Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Portocarrero, Spain. It operates as a ground-based observatory for studying celestial objects and phenomena from Earth.
35c30888-b708-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Calar Alto Schmidt Observatory, Spain

35c8dfc6-b6c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mariner 6 Spacecraft Ultraviolet Spectrometer (UVS) was an instrument on NASA's Mariner 6 spacecraft that flew by Mars in 1969 to analyze the Martian atmosphere by measuring ultraviolet light absorption.
35c8dfc6-b6c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet Spectrometer on Mariner 6 Spacecraft

35c98896-b91c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Quadrispherical Analyser within the Triaxial Fluxgate Magnetometer is a plasma instrument on the AMPTE IRM spacecraft. It uses two symmetrical electrostatic analyzers to measure 3-D velocity distribution functions of electrons and ions, covering specific energy ranges and providing real-time computation of distribution moments.
35c98896-b91c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Quadrispherical Analyser part of Triaxial Fluxgate Magnetometer

35cfe5dc-bb43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Villa Remedios Magnetometer is an instrument used for measuring magnetic fields, located at the IAGA station in Villa Remedios since January 2002.
35cfe5dc-bb43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Villa Remedios Observatory

35d09ae6-bbce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 0.7 m Telescope at Chuguevskaya Station is a 70 cm telescope located in Volokhiv Yar, Ukraine, used for astronomical observations.
35d09ae6-bbce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.7m Telescope at Chuguevskaya Observatory, Ukraine

35d16a12-b9fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CCD imager, known as the "CFIM + T2KA," is a Tektronik 2kx2k chip device with specific imaging and performance characteristics, mounted on a 2.1m telescope at Kitt Peak National Observatory.
35d16a12-b9fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.1m Telescope at Kitt Peak National Observatory

35d67284-bba8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Entity:** DMSP 5D-2 F8 (USA 26)

**Definition:** DMSP 5D-2 F8 is a meteorological satellite launched in 1987 under the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program, designed to provide global visual and infrared cloud cover data for Department of Defense weather analysis and forecasting.
35d67284-bba8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Defense Meteorological Satellite Program 5D-2 F8 part of Defense Meteorological Satellite Program

35dd8ed2-b7f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Midway-2**: A ground-based observatory facility located in the United States, specifically at Halsey Drive on North America's surface, which operated until December 31, 2002, and included a magnetometer instrument.
35dd8ed2-b7f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Midway Observatory, United States

35de1e3a-b8d8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) 16-inch Telescope is an optical telescope with a 0.41m aperture located at the George R. Wallace, Jr. Astrophysical Observatory in North America.
35de1e3a-b8d8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.41m optical Telescope at George R. Wallace, Jr. Astrophysical Observatory

35f7a2ec-bc89-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Solid-State Detectors on IMP-J" is an energetic particle instrument designed to measure the composition and energy spectra of low-energy particles during solar flares and recurrent events, utilizing electrostatic analyzers and solid-state detectors to identify particles with energies from 0.1 to 10 MeV per charge.
35f7a2ec-bc89-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Instrument on IMP-8

3600ca4e-bbca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Christchurch Observatory**: A ground-based observatory located in Christchurch, New Zealand, known for its historical ionosonde operations and geomagnetic measurements, contributing to atmospheric and space weather research.
3600ca4e-bbca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Christchurch Geomagnetic Observatory, New Zealand

3608efcc-b872-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Tenerife Observatory-LCO B:** An astronomical observatory located in Teide National Park on the island of Tenerife, Spain, known for its ground-based observation facilities.
3608efcc-b872-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tenerife Observatory, Spain

360c8a3e-bbb9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Entity Definition:**
Mariner 6 was an uncrewed NASA spacecraft that, along with Mariner 7, completed the first dual mission to Mars in 1969. Its primary objectives were to study the Martian surface and atmosphere during a close flyby to establish a foundation for future investigations, particularly those relevant to the search for extraterrestrial life.
360c8a3e-bbb9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mariner 6 part of Mariner Mars 69

36101b86-b6e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition**:
Thule-2/Camp Tuto was a ground-based observatory located in North America, specifically in Greenland, that operated from 1932 to 1952 and included magnetometer instruments.
36101b86-b6e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Thule Observatory

36191b6a-b659-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Baxter Garden Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Salisbury, Wiltshire, England. It is identified by the Minor Planet Center with the code I74 and serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
36191b6a-b659-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Baxter Garden Observatory, United Kingdom

361a2fae-b696-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Mariner 6 Spacecraft Infrared Spectrometer was an instrument onboard the Mariner 6 spacecraft designed to measure thermal infrared emissions from Mars' surface and atmosphere, aiming to determine atmospheric composition, surface temperature, and other characteristics during its 1969 flyby.
361a2fae-b696-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Spectrometer on Mariner 6 Spacecraft

361d107e-b61f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: JBL Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Bathurst, New South Wales, Australia. It is a ground-based facility used for stargazing and scientific research.
361d107e-b61f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: JBL Observatory, Australia

361e0e18-bb31-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Pistoia Mountains Astronomical Observatory, located in San Marcello Piteglio, Tuscany, Italy, is a ground-based astronomical observatory known for its contributions to astronomy and astrophysics. It operates under the MPC code 104 and has been active since August 8, 2015.
361e0e18-bb31-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Pistoia Mountains Astronomical Observatory, Italy

361eb00e-bad0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Dust Particle Counter and Mass Analyzer (DUCMA) was an instrument on the Vega 1 spacecraft designed to measure the mass and count of dust particles, utilizing a polyvinylidene flouride film and electronic pulse measurement.
361eb00e-bad0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dust Particle Counter and Mass Analyzer on Vega 1

362fed48-b6ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA 0.38m Ultraviolet Imaging Telescope (UIT) is a space telescope with an aperture of 0.38 meters, designed to operate in the ultraviolet waveband, and was deployed on both the ASTRO-1 and ASTRO-2 missions.
362fed48-b6ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet NASA 0.38m Ultraviolet Imaging Telescope on ASTRO-1 and ASTRO-2

3633ae90-ba86-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Charged Particle Measurements Experiment (CPME)** on the IMP-J satellite is an instrument designed to measure energetic particles, including electrons, protons, alpha particles, and heavy ions, as well as X-rays. It features solid-state detectors and Geiger-Mueller tubes to observe particles primarily of solar origin, with capabilities extending to cosmic rays and magnetotail particles due to its dynamic range and resolution.
3633ae90-ba86-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Charged Particle Measurements Experiment part of IMP-J

363614d6-b951-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The LICIACube is a small satellite mission by the Italian Space Agency designed to accompany NASA's DART spacecraft to observe and record the impact and aftermath of DART's collision with the asteroid Dimorphos.
363614d6-b951-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Light Italian CubeSat for Imaging of Asteroids Spacecraft part of Light Italian CubeSat for Imaging of Asteroids

363707d6-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **1.3-m Tinsley Cassegrain/Coude reflector** is a telescope located in Pima County, Arizona, United States, operational since May 1975 and managed by the University of Michigan Radio Astronomy Observatory.
363707d6-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.3m Tinsley Reflector at McGraw Hill Observatory, United States

3637eaa8-b69b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "IAGA endorsed geomagnetic indices" are standardized measures that describe various aspects of geomagnetic activity, capturing the complex interactions between the solar wind and Earth's magnetosphere. These indices help in understanding phenomena occurring in different parts of the Earth’s system by considering factors such as measurement location, timing, and calculation methods.
3637eaa8-b69b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy Endorsed Geomagnetic Indices

3638f576-b7ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Solid State Detector** is a component of the High Energy Telescope (HET) within the Energetic Particle Detector (EPD) suite onboard Solar Orbiter. It measures electrons, protons, and heavy ions by detecting energy deposition characteristics, covering an energy range from a few keV to 450 MeV/n.
3638f576-b7ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Detector and High Energy Telescope part of Solar Orbiter

363c2b38-b65d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **Geocentric Occultation Observational** refers to a space mission or activity involving the observation of occultations—events where one celestial body passes in front of another, as seen from Earth's center—using a spacecraft. This type of observation is valuable for studying the properties and dynamics of celestial objects.
363c2b38-b65d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geocentric Occultation Observation

363c98fc-b6fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Alcarràs Observatory (OAIA) is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Alcarràs, Catalonia, Spain. It is situated at the Institut d'Alcarràs and focuses on various astronomical observations and research activities.
363c98fc-b6fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Alcarràs Observatory, Spain

3646db3e-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Two-Meter Twin Telescope (TTT3), also known as the Teide telescope, is a ground-based observatory located in Güímar, Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain. It operates under the IAU-MPC list notation Y68 and is situated at coordinates 28.29893 latitude and -17.50924 longitude (Earth).
3646db3e-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.0m Telescope at Teide Observatory, Spain

36496a42-b6f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The European Space Agency (ESA) Hipparcos Space Astrometry Mission Satellite was a spacecraft dedicated to high-precision astrometry in the optical waveband, launched by ESA to measure the positions and distances of stars with unprecedented accuracy.
36496a42-b6f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical European Space Agency Hipparcos Space Astrometry Mission Satellite

364d5fb4-bab5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Poker Flat search coil magnetometer** is an instrument used for geomagnetic observations, specifically designed to measure magnetic field variations. It operates as part of the IUGONET Observatory at Tohoku University's Poker Flat site.
364d5fb4-bab5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Poker Flat Observatory

3655ee6e-b965-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The **AZM Martinsberg Observatory**, also known as the **Sternwarte Orion**, is an astronomical observatory located in Oed, Lower Austria. It is designated with the MPC code G00 and primarily functions as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
3655ee6e-b965-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Martinsberg Observatory, Austria

3658acc0-bafb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The InSight Mars Lander Context Camera (ICC) is a fixed-mounted, wide-angle lens camera on the InSight Lander spacecraft, designed to capture images of the lander's arm workspace and surrounding terrain. It shares similar optics with Mars Science Laboratory's Hazcam instrument but does not support stereo imaging due to its fixed nature.
3658acc0-bafb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Insight Context Camera on InSight Lander

365f4564-ba13-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Les Pedritxes Observatory** is an astronomical facility located in Matadepera, Spain. It serves as a ground-based observatory for conducting various astronomical observations and research.
365f4564-ba13-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Les Pedritxes Observatory, Spain

3667294e-b948-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ISEE ozone monitor is a spectrometer used for atmospheric observations, specifically measuring ozone levels through the UV absorption method (Thermo-Electron, model 49-C), and is part of the IUGONET observatory.
3667294e-b948-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ozone Monitor at Iugonet Observatory

366f34a2-b92c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: Birkdale Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Birkdale, Greater Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
366f34a2-b92c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Birkdale Observatory, Australia

366f8e02-bbac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lucy Propulsion Subsystem is a component of the Lucy spacecraft that provides data used to calculate forces exerted by thrusters on the spacecraft.
366f8e02-bbac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Propulsion Subsystem on Lucy

366f9344-b65b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Magnetometer Network in Ancon, Peru is a magnetic observatory operated by the Geophysics Institute of Peru. It is located in the Ancón District and focuses on monitoring geomagnetic activity using instruments such as fluxgate magnetometers.
366f9344-b65b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ancon Observatory, Peru

367668ac-b92d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatoire de l'Ardèche is an astronomical observatory located in Saint-Vincent-de-Barrès, Ardèche, France.
367668ac-b92d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatoire de l'Ardèche, France

367e5f04-bb93-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The specific magnetometer described operated from January 1, 1957, to December 31, 1958, as part of the IAGA investigation at the Oasis (OAS) observatory in Kyoto.
367e5f04-bb93-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy

367f102e-b838-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Electric Field and Waves (EFW)** instrument on Cluster 2/FM5 (Rumba) is a scientific device that measures electric fields and waves in space using four spherical sensors deployed on long cables, designed to capture detailed data for studying plasma phenomena and wave activities in the Earth's magnetosphere. It was launched as part of the Cluster mission starting from December 1, 2000.
367f102e-b838-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electric Field and Waves part of Cluster 2

367fe2ea-b678-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer situated at the Adelaide observatory (identified by IAGA as ADE), operational since January 1973, used for measuring magnetic field variations.
367fe2ea-b678-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Adelaide Observatory

368a8c56-b6f8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Petersburg Magnetometer is a ground-based instrument located at the Petersburg Geophysical Observatory, used to measure magnetic fields as part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation since September 2004.
368a8c56-b6f8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of THEMIS Mission

368cf074-b665-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Bakersfield Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Kern County, California, used for ground-based observations of celestial objects.
368cf074-b665-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bakersfield Observatory, United States

3690169e-ba0e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Bloemfontein is a city in South Africa's Free State province, known for its ground observatory at the Boyden Observatory Science Education Centre.
3690169e-ba0e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Burst Optical Observer and Transient Exploring System on 1.5m Telescope at Boyden Observatory, South Africa

3691dafc-b922-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Macnairston Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in South Ayrshire, Scotland, known for its ground-based facilities dedicated to celestial observations.
3691dafc-b922-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Macnairston Observatory, United Kingdom

36a5c90c-b762-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The UWO Meteor Radar Complex, located in Tavistock, Ontario, Canada, is a ground-based observatory operated by the University of Western Ontario, designed for meteor radar observations.
36a5c90c-b762-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Meteor Radar at Tavistock Observatory, Canada

36a62c26-bb04-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetic Field Monitor (MFM) on GOES-2 is a magnetometer instrument designed to measure and record magnetic field components in space.
