It provides data in both 3-second and 5-minute averages, recorded on binary magnetic tape, facilitating the study of geomagnetic activity and space weather.
36a62c26-bb04-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetic Field Monitor on Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 2

36b6a0d8-b93d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nice Observatory is an astronomical observatory situated in Nice, France on the summit of Mount Gros, founded in 1879 by Raphaël Bischoffsheim and designed by Charles Garnier and Gustave Eiffel.
36b6a0d8-b93d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Nice Observatory part of Côte d'Azur Observatory, France

36bd1402-b7b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1V Optical Photometer** is an instrument designed to detect the flux of visible light at wavelengths near 486.1 nm during relativistic electron precipitation events, thereby determining the presence of accompanying protons and supporting studies on scattering mechanisms involving electromagnetic ion cyclotron (EMIC) waves.
36bd1402-b7b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Photometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

36c3d5ee-bb2e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Visible Airglow Photometer (VAE) on the AE-C mission was a filter photometer designed to measure airglow and auroral features in the spectral range between 3000 and 7500 Å, specifically targeting key emissions that play crucial roles in atmospheric energy balance.
36c3d5ee-bb2e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Visible Airglow Photometer part of AE-C

36c6ce16-b63d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Stockholm Observatory is an astronomical observatory and institution founded in the 18th century in Stockholm, Sweden. It was initially located in central Stockholm and later moved to Saltsjöbaden, operating there until 2001, and is now part of Stockholm University.
36c6ce16-b63d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stockholm Observatory

36c7c14e-babc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Harvard Observatory in Arequipa is an astronomical observatory located in Peru. It was operated by Harvard University and played a significant role in early 20th-century astronomy before its closure in the mid-20th century.
36c7c14e-babc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Harvard Observatory, Peru

36d09806-bbba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Phoenix Lander Microscopy, Electrochemistry, and Conductivity Analyzer (MECA) Optical Microscope (OM) was a high-resolution imaging system on the Phoenix Mars Lander designed to capture detailed images of Martian soil and dust particles. It utilized a 512 x 256 pixel CCD detector with a spatial resolution of 4 microns per pixel, contributing to the MECA instrument suite's scientific analyses.
36d09806-bbba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Microscope part of Phoenix Lander Microscopy, Electrochemistry, and Conductivity Analyzer

36d3c970-b9aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at the Eyrewell observatory starting from 1978, used for measuring magnetic fields and contributing to IAGA investigations.
36d3c970-b9aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Eyrewell Observatory

36d575f8-b71c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Berri Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in South Australia, known for its ground-based observations. It is situated at Jury Road, Monash, within The Berri Barmera Council area.
36d575f8-b71c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Berri Observatory, Australia

36d7d450-b8e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Siple Station Experiment** was a ground-based facility operating from 1973 to 1988, designed to study magnetospheric wave-particle interactions using a transmitting station in Antarctica and a receiving station in Quebec, Canada. It is renowned for its contributions to understanding whistler mode waves and validating computer simulations of these interactions.
36d7d450-b8e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: VLF Siple Experiment

36d8e0ee-b7ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Radebeul Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Radebeul, Saxony, Germany. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
36d8e0ee-b7ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radebeul Observatory, Germany

36dd0606-b95b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Miryang Arirang Astronomical Observatory is a ground-based observatory located at the Miryang Municipal Museum in Miryang, South Korea. It is situated at coordinates 35.50278° N latitude and 128.76108° E longitude on the continent of Asia.
36dd0606-b95b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Miryang Arirang Astronomical Observatory, South Korea

36e5c850-b766-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover Mastcam-Zoom Camera Instrument Suite, or Mastcam-Z, is a mast-mounted camera system with zoom capabilities, designed to capture detailed images and videos of distant objects on Mars.
36e5c850-b766-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover Mastcam-Zoom Camera Instrument Suite part of Mars 2020

36f242fc-bb5c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at Ekaterinburg (SVD) is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. It is part of the observatory facilities managed by IUGONET in Kyoto, specifically within the WDC SVD division.
36f242fc-bb5c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at World Data Center Kyoto

36fa9fda-b9de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Research Institute of Astronomy and Geophysics (NRIAG) 1.88m Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Kottamia Astronomical Observatory in Africa, used for astronomical research.
36fa9fda-b9de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.88m optical National Research Institute of Astronomy and Geophysics Telescope at Kottamia Astronomical Observatory, Egypt

37086786-bba6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Entity Definition:**
GOES 11 (Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite) is a weather monitoring satellite launched in 2000 as part of the GOES-NEXT series, a joint effort by NASA and NOAA to provide continuous weather data and environmental monitoring primarily over the United States.
37086786-bba6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite at GOES Observatory

371974b8-b5b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Tromsø, Norway, operational since 1930 and part of the IUGONET observatory network.
371974b8-b5b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tromsø Observatory

371d9a6c-b934-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kilodegree Extremely Little Telescope (KELT) is a pair of small, wide-field optical telescopes designed for detecting transiting exoplanets, with one located at Winer Observatory in Arizona, USA (KELT-North), and the other at the South African Astronomical Observatory (SAAO; KELT-South).
371d9a6c-b934-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical Kilodegree Extremely Little Telescope at Winer Observatory and at South African Astronomical Observatory

3721f3da-b602-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Florence and George Wise Observatory (IAU code 097), also known as the Wise Observatory, is an astronomical observatory operated by Tel Aviv University. It is located near Mitzpe Ramon in Israel's Negev desert and serves as the country's only professional astronomical observatory.
3721f3da-b602-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1m Telescope at Wise Observatory, Israel

37249b1e-ba01-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences (NAOC) 0.6m Telescope at Yunnan Astronomical Observatory (YAO) is an optical telescope with a 0.6-meter aperture located in Asia, specifically at the Yunnan Astronomical Observatory in China.
37249b1e-ba01-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical 0.6m National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences Telescope at Yunnan Astronomical Observatory

37287978-b8f8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Baja Astronomical Observatory is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Baja, Hungary, operated by the University of Szeged.
37287978-b8f8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Szegedi Tudományegyetem Baja Astronomical Observatory, Hungary

37297d5a-b9cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mawson Cosmic Ray instrument, a proportional counter situated at the IUGONET Observatory in Antarctica (WDC Kyoto), measures cosmic rays indirectly by detecting secondary neutrons produced when cosmic ray particles interact with Earth's atmosphere. This neutron monitor provides real-time data for studying ground level events and Forbush decreases, contributing valuable insights into solar activity and space weather.
37297d5a-b9cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutron Monitor at Mawson Observatory, Antarctica

3731eb06-bb3d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 12 Lunar Module "Intrepid" was the second crewed vehicle to land on the Moon as part of NASA's Apollo program. It carried astronauts Charles P. Conrad and Alan L. Bean, who conducted various scientific experiments and collected lunar samples during their mission in November 1969.
3731eb06-bb3d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ALSEP at Oceanus Procellarum

37339344-b93e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatorio NovaCanet is a ground-based observatory located in Canet d'en Berenguer, Valencia, Spain. It serves as an astronomical facility for scientific observations and research.
37339344-b93e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatorio NovaCanet at Canet de Berenguer, Spain

373c451e-bc47-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Chittagong Geomagnetic Observatory (CHT) is a ground-based facility located in Bangladesh that monitors geomagnetic activity and is sponsored by Nigeria.
373c451e-bc47-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Chittagong Geomagnetic Observatory, Bangladesh

373edc3e-ba7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IAGA:BUP Magnetometer was a ground-based instrument located in Budapest, operational from 1875 to 1889, used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field as part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) investigations.
373edc3e-ba7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Budapest Observatory

37469dfc-b91d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**

The Lunar Prospector was a NASA spacecraft that orbited the Moon from 1998 to 1999 to map its surface composition, measure magnetic and gravity fields, and study lunar outgassing events. The mission ended with a deliberate impact into a lunar crater to search for water ice.
37469dfc-b91d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Camera and Multi-Object Spectrometer on Lunar Prospector

374b6888-b723-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Beta Orionis Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Rosario, Argentina. It is a ground-based facility situated at 1575 Coronel Biedma, Barrio Moreno, and focuses on astronomical research and observations.
374b6888-b723-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Beta Orionis Observatory at Rosario

374edba4-b84e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Beijing Observatory is a ground-based facility located in the Haidian District of Beijing, China, established in 1957 and equipped with a magnetometer.
374edba4-b84e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Beijing Observatory, China

3761a20a-b78d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Pioneer 9 was a NASA space probe launched on November 8, 1968, to study interplanetary space, focusing on magnetic fields, plasma, and cosmic rays. It operated until May 1983, providing data from widely separated points in the solar system.
3761a20a-b78d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.94m Pioneer 9

37621e66-b601-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The UCLA GBO THEMIS ground station network is part of the THEMIS satellite mission, consisting of over 20 sites in Northern US and Canada equipped with All-Sky Imagers (ASIs) and Fluxgate magnetometers to record white-light and magnetic signatures of substorms affecting the auroral region.
37621e66-b601-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: All-Sky Imager and Fluxgate Magnetometer part of NASA's Time History of Events and Macroscale Interactions during Substorms Ground Observatories

37631042-b85d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Wind Magnetic Field Investigation (MFI)** is an instrument on the Wind Spacecraft featuring a dual triaxial fluxgate magnetometer designed to measure and study the interplanetary magnetic field with high precision and sensitivity. It provides data at various rates for different analysis needs, ensuring broad dissemination and detailed scientific research.
37631042-b85d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Wind Spacecraft part of Magnetic Field Investigation

376b433a-bbbd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Multispectral Visible Imaging Camera (L'MVIC) is part of the L'Ralph instrument onboard NASA’s Lucy mission, designed to capture both panchromatic and color imaging with a spectral range of 0.38 - 0.92 microns across five spectral bands and one panchromatic band.
376b433a-bbbd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Multispectral Visible Imaging Camera on Ralph Imager/Spectrometer for Lucy

377e9a1c-b644-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Arctic Ice Flo Geomagnetic Observatory (AIF), located on Earth's surface at coordinates 83.52°N and 193.05°E, was a ground facility operated by the United States from January 1, 1957, to December 31, 1958, for geomagnetic research.
377e9a1c-b644-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Arctic Ice Flo Geomagnetic Observatory

378029f6-b921-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The REPTile (Relativistic Electron and Proton Telescope integrated little experiment) Instrument is a compact telescope designed to measure energetic electrons and protons for the Colorado Student Space Weather Experiment (CSSWE), utilizing a stack of solid-state doped silicon detectors to determine particle energy ranges.
378029f6-b921-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Relativistic Electron and Proton Telescope integrated little experiment on Colorado Student Space Weather Experiment CubeSat

378068e8-b9e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Pueyrredon Observatory (X38) is an astronomical facility located in Club de Campo Pueyrredón, Villa Rosa, Partido del Pilar, Buenos Aires, Argentina. It serves as a ground-based observatory and is known by alternative names such as "Observatorio Pueyrredon" and "La Lonja."
378068e8-b9e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Pueyrredon Observatory, Argentina

37843c42-bc16-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The JCPM Sakura Station is an astronomical observatory located in Higashioka, Tsukuba, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. It is known for its ground-based observations and has the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code 393.
37843c42-bc16-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sakura Observatory, Japan

37855bf8-b852-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Dawn**: A retired NASA space probe launched in 2007 to study the asteroids Vesta and Ceres, aimed at understanding early solar system conditions by examining these protoplanets.
37855bf8-b852-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Spectrometer on Dawn space probe part of Discovery Program

378f9544-b6e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Doppler Wind Experiment (DWE) on the Huygens Probe was designed to measure winds in Titan's atmosphere using the Doppler Effect, with ultra-stable oscillators on both the probe and the Cassini orbiter providing precise radial velocity information.
378f9544-b6e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Doppler Wind Experiment on Huygens Probe part of Cassini

379291c4-b6d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Balbriggan Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Newhaven Bay, Balbriggan, County Dublin, Ireland. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
379291c4-b6d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balbriggan Observatory, Ireland

37956ab0-bb96-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The PROBA-2 Dual Segmented Langmuir Probe (DSLP) is an instrument onboard the PROBA-2 satellite, developed by a Czech consortium, that measures plasma properties such as ion and electron densities and temperatures in the upper terrestrial ionosphere.
37956ab0-bb96-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dual Segmented Langmuir Probe Experiment part of PROBA-2 Observatory

37969498-b8c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Chiro Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Yerecoin, Western Australia. It is a ground-based facility used for studying celestial objects and phenomena.
37969498-b8c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Chiro Observatory, Australia

37a6b120-b7b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Poznań Observatory is an astronomical observatory operated by the physics department of Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań, Poland. Founded in 1919, it is dedicated to astronomical research and education.
37a6b120-b7b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Poznań Observatory

37af268c-ba5e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Apache Point Observatory, located in Otero County, New Mexico, is a ground-based astronomical facility known for its role in the Sloan Digital Sky Survey.
37af268c-ba5e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Apache Point Observatory, United States

37b00ecc-baad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Low Energy Magnetospheric Ion Composition Sensor (LOMICS) was an instrument on the CRRES satellite that measured fluxes and composition of ions up to mass 56 amu in the energy/Q range of 40 eV/Q to 40 keV/Q. It used a combination of an electrostatic energy analyzer and a time-of-flight analyzer to determine the mass and energy/charge of each ion.
37b00ecc-baad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Low Energy Magnetospheric Ion Composition Sensor on Chemical Release and Radiation Effects Satellite

37b1231a-b707-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CS3-Trojan Station is an astronomical observatory located in Landerstype, California. It is situated at Gibralter Road in San Bernardino County and focuses on ground-based observations (MPC ID: U81).
37b1231a-b707-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: CS3-Trojan Station Observatory at Lander, United States

37b7c06e-b831-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars (CRISM) is a hyperspectral imager aboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO), designed to study Martian mineralogy and geology by capturing spectral data ranging from ultraviolet to mid-wave infrared.
37b7c06e-b831-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars on Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter

37bc4328-b83b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The THEMIS Electric Fields Instrument (EFI) is a device on the THEMIS spacecraft that measures the ambient vector electric field using multiple wire and rigid booms. It provides comprehensive data including waveform measurements, spectral analyses, and estimates of the spacecraft floating potential for studying plasma dynamics in space.
37bc4328-b83b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electric Field Instrument on Time History of Events and Macroscale Interactions during Substorms

37c407ca-b6f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Toulouse Magnetometer, operational from 1882 to 1905, was an instrument used at the IAGA observatory in Toulouse for measuring magnetic fields as part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) investigations.
37c407ca-b6f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Toulouse Observatory

37e96bf8-bbd5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: North Pole 13 is a ground observatory located at the coordinates 81.0° N, 165.0° E on Earth's surface, equipped with a magnetometer for geomagnetic measurements. It is part of the IAGA Observatory network.
37e96bf8-bbd5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at North Pole 13

37fdc352-bba1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A CPMN fluxgate magnetometer at CEB is a 3-axis ring-core type magnetic sensor installed in Cebu, Philippines, used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
37fdc352-bba1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of International Real-time Magnetic Observatory Network

380958d4-b8ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **ShadowCam**: A NASA-funded instrument on the Korea Pathfinder Lunar Orbiter designed to capture high-resolution images of Permanently Shadowed Regions (PSRs) on the Moon, aiding in understanding terrain and water ice distribution.
380958d4-b8ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.27m ShadowCam on Korea Pathfinder Lunar Orbiter

380f3e2e-b8e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Bradbury Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Stockton-on-Tees, England. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting observations of celestial bodies and phenomena.
380f3e2e-b8e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stockton-on-Tees Observatory, United Kingdom

381a8f64-ba02-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Okinawa Geomagnetic Observatory (OKN) is a ground-based facility in Japan that has been operating since 1977 to monitor and study geomagnetic activity. It is part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) observatory network and includes instruments like magnetometers for data collection.
381a8f64-ba02-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Okinawa Geomagnetic Observatory

3821b592-bb82-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Chambon-La-Foret (CLF) is a ground-based observatory in France that has been operating since 1936, known for its magnetometer instrument and contributions to geomagnetic research.
3821b592-bb82-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Chambon La Foret Observatory, France

38225364-b932-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The Magnetometers at Kashi (KSH) are part of the IUGONET observatory network and have been operational since January 1987, providing essential data for geomagnetic studies.
38225364-b932-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at WDC Kyoto Observatory

3836b67c-ba56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Earl Hill Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Trinity Beach, Queensland, Australia. It is situated at 3 Tari Place and operates as a ground-based facility.
3836b67c-ba56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Earl Hill Observatory, Australia

3838bfda-bace-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Kingston Cosmic Ray** instrument was a proportional counter located in Kingston, near Hobart, Tasmania, Australia. It operated from June 2004 to November 2016 and was used to indirectly observe cosmic rays by detecting secondary neutrons produced when cosmic ray particles interact with the Earth's atmosphere.
3838bfda-bace-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cosmic Ray Proportional Counter part of Kingston Observatory, Australia

3844efac-ba43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Valencia Observatory** (also known as the *Observatorio Astronómico de Valencia*) is an astronomical observatory located in Valencia, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
3844efac-ba43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Observatory at Valencia Observatory, Spain

384d3fb8-b77d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) Fabry-Perot Interferometer at Tromsø, Norway is an instrument used to measure thermospheric and mesospheric neutral winds and temperatures through airglow/aurora emissions. It operates at wavelengths of 630.0 nm for the thermosphere and 557.7 nm for the mesosphere, developed by Nagoya University to study upper atmospheric dynamics.
384d3fb8-b77d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fabry-Perot Interferometer part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers at Tromsoe, Norway

385be84c-b5c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cape Schmidt Geomagnetic Observatory (CPS) is a ground-based facility located in Ryrkaypiy, Chukotka Autonomous Okrug, Russia. It operates as part of the World Data Center for Geomagnetism at Kyoto and focuses on geomagnetic observations.
385be84c-b5c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Cape Schmidt Geomagnetic Observatory

385c0750-b6c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Bengkulu Station is a ground facility located in Bumi Ayu, Bengkulu, Indonesia that operates as part of the MAGDAS magnetometer network. It's situated at approximately -3.86 latitude and 102.31 longitude on the continent of Asia.
385c0750-b6c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Bengkulu Observatory, Indonesia

38643a26-bbb8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute (KASI) 0.61m Telescope is located at the Sobaeksan Optical Astronomy Observatory (SOAO) in Asia, specifically designed for optical astronomy with an aperture of 0.61 meters.
38643a26-bbb8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.61m optical Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute Telescope at Sobaeksan Optical Astronomy Observatory

3874aa84-b701-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)** is an instrument type used for navigation and geospatial positioning, part of the SWARM-B mission under the CNES observatory CDPP AMDA, operational since December 2, 2013.
3874aa84-b701-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Global Navigation Satellite System on SWARM B

3879e81e-b666-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: DSS-27 is a decommissioned high-speed beam waveguide (HSB) antenna, originally built for the U.S. Army and later transferred to NASA, known for its unique design that enhances tracking capabilities and environmental protection of electronic equipment.
3879e81e-b666-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 34m High-Speed Beam Waveguide Antenna at Goldstone Deep Space Communications Complex, United States

387b2100-ba6e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Majuro, operational from 1964 to 1966, used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field as part of the IAGA investigation.
387b2100-ba6e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IUGONET Observatory

387b9c1c-b64e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The one located at the Sao Miguel geophysical observatory has been operational since October 1, 1965, and is part of the IUGONET-Observatory network managed by WDC Kyoto.
387b9c1c-b64e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at São Miguel Observatory

38954fe2-b61a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to magnetometers located at the Umba observatory, which are part of the IUGONET-Observatory WDC Kyoto network and are used for magnetic field measurements as per IAGA standards.
38954fe2-b61a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at IUGONET Observatory WDC Kyoto and WDC Uma

389631e4-b83d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Osservatorio Sideris Oculus** is an astronomical observatory located at Via Foscolo, San Pietro in Gu, Province of Padua, Veneto, Italy. It is situated at coordinates 45.6078° N, 11.67408° E and serves as a ground-based facility for celestial observation.
389631e4-b83d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: San Pietro in Gu Observatory, Italy

38a78278-b734-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Murchison Bay (MUB) was a ground-based observatory in Svalbard, Norway, sponsored by Sweden and operational from 1957 to 1959. It primarily conducted magnetic observations using magnetometers provided by WDC Kyoto.
38a78278-b734-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Murchison Bay Observatory, Norway

38aae754-b830-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) Akari Satellite Mission, also known as ASTRO-F, was an infrared space mission designed to conduct astronomical observations.
38aae754-b830-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: infrared Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency Akari Satellite Mission

38b15032-b5cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Alaska Geophysical Institute Magnetometer Array (GIMA) is a network of ground-based observatories in Alaska and Western Canada, operated by the University of Alaska Fairbanks as part of NASA's THEMIS mission. It includes magnetometers and other instruments to study geomagnetic phenomena and supports the GI rocket program at Poker Flat Rocket Range.
38b15032-b5cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Alaska Geophysical Institute Magnetometer Array

38b2d8ba-b5fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Orbiter Mission 2 (MOM-2) is an Indian spacecraft designed for studying Mars from orbit.
38b2d8ba-b5fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mars Orbiter Mission 2

38b6fe88-b5db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ISEE Magnetometer station at Zhigansk, Russia is a ground-based facility located in the Sakha Republic, designed to measure and monitor magnetic fields on Earth's surface. It is situated at latitude 66.78 and longitude 123.37 within the Far Eastern Federal District of Russia.
38b6fe88-b5db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Zhigansk Observatory, Russia

38c23c10-b7ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mamalluca Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Vicuña, Coquimbo Region, Chile, offering ground-based observations of the night sky.
38c23c10-b7ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mamalluca Observatory, Chile

38c2bd34-b5bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The bRing experiment is a twin two-camera project based at the Siding Spring Observatory in Australia, designed for optical waveband observations.
38c2bd34-b5bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical The bRing experiment twin two-camera project at Siding Spring Observatory, Australia

38c6f8b8-b5ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The RISH MWR at Shigaraki is a meteor wind radar that operated from 1977 to 1986 in Shiga Prefecture, Japan, measuring radial wind velocity using reflected VHF radio waves from ionized meteor trails.
38c6f8b8-b5ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar at Shigaraki MU Observatory, Japan

38cee1ec-b70c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Cala d'Hort Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Ses Paisses de Cala d'Hort (Necropolis), Sant Josep de sa Talaia, on the island of Ibiza, Spain. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
38cee1ec-b70c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cala d'Hort Observatory, Spain

38d74a1e-bb24-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer operated at the Jarvis Island ground station from January 1, 1957, to December 31, 1958, as part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) investigation.
38d74a1e-bb24-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Jarvis Island Observatory

38dd8c3a-b75f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The LANL1990 Magnetospheric Plasma Analyzer (MPA) is an instrument designed to measure three-dimensional energy/charge distributions of ions and electrons in the magnetosphere, utilizing a single electrostatic analyzer coupled with channel electron multipliers. It operates at synchronous orbit and provides high sensitivity measurements with moderate energy and angular resolutions.
38dd8c3a-b75f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electrostatic Analyser on Los Alamos National Laboratory 1990 Observatory

38e6306a-b66f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Wide Band Data (WBD)** instrument on the Cluster 2 spacecraft is designed to provide high-resolution frequency/time spectra of plasma waves in Earth's magnetosphere by measuring electric and magnetic fields within selected frequency bands from 25 Hz to 577 KHz. It processes signals from various sensors, including spherical electric antennas and search coil magnetometers, enabling very-long-baseline-interferometer measurements with microsecond time resolution.
38e6306a-b66f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wide Band Data on Cluster 2 part of Cluster

38ee76dc-bb4f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Active Spacecraft Potential Control (ASPOC)** on Cluster-3 is an instrument designed to regulate the electric potential of a spacecraft relative to its surrounding plasma by emitting variable currents of positive ions, ensuring minimal interference with scientific measurements by maintaining a low and stable spacecraft potential.
38ee76dc-bb4f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Active Spacecraft Potential Control part of Cluster-3

38f33f48-b9cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Innsbruck Observatory (Universitäts-Sternwarte Innsbruck) is an astronomical observatory operated by the University of Innsbruck, located in Innsbruck, Austria.
38f33f48-b9cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Innsbruck Observatory, Austria

38f6ac30-ba7d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Interball-1 Ephemeris is an instrument onboard the Interball-1 spacecraft that models orbital and attitude data for studying the Earth's magnetotail region.
38f6ac30-ba7d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris on Interball 1

38f88218-bb9e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Bosque Alegre Ground Station is a ground observatory located in the Punilla Department of Córdoba, Argentina. It operates as part of the Argentine National Observatory and is funded by Telecom Argentina.
38f88218-bb9e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bosque Alegre Observatory at Argentine National Observatory, Argentina

38f9c284-bb0f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The BSA Observatory is an astronomical observatory located at the Cuneo International Airport in Savigliano, Italy. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to studying celestial objects and phenomena.
38f9c284-bb0f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: BSA Observatory

39036a9a-b84f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Keck I telescope is a 10-meter optical and infrared telescope located at the W.M. Keck Observatory on Mauna Kea, Hawaii, operated by the California Association for Research in Astronomy. It features a segmented primary mirror and began science operations in May 1993.
39036a9a-b84f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 10m W. M. Keck I Telescope at W. M. Keck Observatory

39090b8c-b64f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Don Astronomical Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Rostov-on-Don, Russia. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical research and observations.
39090b8c-b64f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Don Astronomical Observatory, Russia

390aee98-b6e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer** is a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate instrument installed at Macquarie Island, Australia, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the MAGDAS observation network.
390aee98-b6e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of MAGDAS observation network

39130038-b807-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Viking Orbiter 2 Spacecraft (VO2) Radio Science Subsystem (RSS)** was an instrument suite on the Viking Orbiter 2 spacecraft that collected various radio science data to study Mars' gravitational field, atmospheric properties, and surface characteristics. It utilized both orbiter and lander data through different radio links and signal measurements.
39130038-b807-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Science Subsystem on Viking Orbiter 2 Spacecraft

3913d676-bbc6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Induction Magnetometer at Isafjordur, Iceland" is a scientific instrument used to measure magnetic field variations as part of the Conjugate Observation at Iceland project. It operates within the NIPR observatory network in Iceland and utilizes induction coil technology for its measurements.
3913d676-bbc6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Conjugate Observation at Iceland

391ae4e4-b5ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The Magnetometers at Arctowski (ARC) were operational from January 1, 1978, to December 31, 1995, as part of the IAGA investigation at the WDC Kyoto observatory.
391ae4e4-b5ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Arctowski Observatory

391d8b76-bb99-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Badalozhnyj Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Zhukovsky Selsoviet, Krasnoyarsk Krai, Russia. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
391d8b76-bb99-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Badalozhnyj Observatory

391e3246-b640-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover Planetary Instrument for X-ray Lithochemistry (PIXL) is an instrument on the Mars 2020 rover that uses microfocus X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy to analyze the elemental composition and distribution within rock and soil samples, aided by a Micro-Context Camera for visual registration.
391e3246-b640-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Planetary Instrument for X-ray Lithochemistry part of Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover

39210a88-b7bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: An astronomical observatory located in Cochise County, Arizona, USA known as the Moka Observatory.
39210a88-b7bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Benson Observatory, United States

392a0674-ba92-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the GOES 15 spacecraft's position data, known as its ephemeris, which tracks the spacecraft's location over time. It is part of the GOES-15 observatory and provides essential information for understanding the spacecraft's orbit and trajectory.
392a0674-ba92-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris on Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 15 Spacecraft

393370bc-b5fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The KNUE Astronomical Observatory is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Deunggok 1-gil, Bugang-myeon, Sejong, South Korea. It has an MPC (Minor Planet Center) ID of 346 and is used for various astronomical observations and research purposes.
393370bc-b5fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Korea National University of Education Astronomical Observatory, South Korea

3933f068-b78f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Phoenix Atmospheric Structure Experiment (ASE) was an instrument on the Phoenix Mars Lander consisting of Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) that measured Martian atmospheric properties like pressure, density, and temperature during entry, descent, and landing.
3933f068-b78f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Atmospheric Structure Experiment on Phoenix Mars Lander

3938cc86-b943-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Badalona Boreal Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Badalona, Catalonia, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
3938cc86-b943-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Badalona Boreal Observatory, Spain

3942d130-babb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Rankin Inlet station with the IAGA identifier RIT, operational from January 1974 to December 31, 1976.
3942d130-babb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of THEMIS Ground-Based Observatories, Canada

394d454c-b742-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Yunnan Astronomical Observatory (YAO), also known as the Lijiang Observatory, is a ground-based observatory located in Lijiang, China. It operates under the National Astronomical Observatories of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and features a 2.4m optical telescope.
394d454c-b742-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.4m Optical Telescope at Yunnan Astronomical Observatory Lijiang Observatory
