4f719788-bbc5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Psyche Radio Science Subsystem (RSS)** is an instrument on the Psyche spacecraft that uses X-band telecommunications to measure Doppler shifts, determining changes in the spacecraft's velocity caused by the gravitational influence of asteroid 16 Psyche.
4f719788-bbc5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Science Subsystem on Psyche

4f71df26-b842-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **CPMN magnetometer network in Trinidad and Tobago** is a ground-based facility located at Bamboo Main Road, Bamboo Settlement No. 2, Tunapuna-Piarco (10.62° N, -61.42° W), dedicated to monitoring magnetic fields on Earth's surface.
4f71df26-b842-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at CPMN Observatory, Trinidad and Tobago

4f8325fa-b681-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL (Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2N Data Processing Unit (DPU) is an instrument controller board that collects data from various sensors, formats it for transmission via an Iridium modem, and controls the command-cutdown system. It features a flexible design with an FPGA for backplane signal interfacing and has been successfully used in multiple sounding rocket experiments and balloon flights.
4f8325fa-b681-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Data Processing Unit part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

4f8430b0-ba48-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Ion Gauge (IG2)** was an instrument onboard the Rocket Experiment for Neutral Upwelling 2 (RENU2) mission, launched by NASA in 2015. It consisted of six Anelva Ion Gauges designed to measure neutral particle data, primarily atomic oxygen number density, during its flight through the dayside cusp region.
4f8430b0-ba48-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ion Gauge on Rocket Experiment for Neutral Upwelling 2

4f85ffee-bbd8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Loose Goose Observatory (MPC ID: W70) is an astronomical observatory located in Saint-Jérôme, Quebec, Canada. It functions as a ground-based facility for stargazing and scientific research.
4f85ffee-bbd8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Loose Goose Observatory, Canada

4f882c3c-ba58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Price Geomagnetic Observatory (PCU) was a ground-based facility located in Price, Utah, United States, operational from 1957 to 1958, which included a magnetometer as part of its instrumentation.
4f882c3c-ba58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Price Geomagnetic Observatory at International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy Observatory, United States

4fa6cc48-bae7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Cylindrical Electrostatic Probes on Alouette 2** were a pair of Langmuir probes designed to measure local electron temperature and density, primarily aimed at assessing the feasibility of direct measurements on spacecraft equipped with long antennas for topside sounding.
4fa6cc48-bae7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Langmuir Probe part of Alouette 2

4fb8df86-bb74-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Althuraya Astronomy Center is an astronomical observatory located in Mushrif National Park, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
4fb8df86-bb74-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Althuraya Astronomy Center, United Arab Emirates

4fc780b6-b847-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of Louisville 0.6m (24-inch) Telescope at Moore Observatory is an optical telescope located in North America, specifically part of the Moore Observatory, used for astronomical observations and research.
4fc780b6-b847-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.6m Telescope at Moore Observatory

4fc7ce38-b6bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Goodricke-Pigott Observatory, located in Tucson, Arizona, United States, is a ground-based observatory known for its telescopes, including the Orion AstroView.
4fc7ce38-b6bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Orion AstroView at Goodricke-Pigott Observatory, United States

4fd5f54e-b949-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Kjell Henriksen Observatory is an optical observatory located near the EISCAT Svalbard Radar facility in Longyearbyen, Svalbard. It is operated by UNIS (The University Centre in Svalbard) and focuses on researching the middle- and upper atmosphere using over 25 optical instruments since its establishment in 2008.
4fd5f54e-b949-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kjell Henriksen Observatory

4fda4406-b795-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Alice Springs Ionosonde**: A former ground-based instrument located near Alice Springs, Australia, that used analog technology and 16 mm film to study the ionosphere from May to October 1985.
4fda4406-b795-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar at Alice Springs Observatory, Australia

4fdcbfde-b159-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Scoresby Sund 2 geophysical observatory is a ground facility located in Ittoqqortoormiit, Greenland. Established in 1932, it includes instruments like the Scoresby Sund 2 magnetometer and is part of the DTU Space Geomagnetic Observatories network.
4fdcbfde-b159-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Scoresby Sund 2 Observatory, Greenland

4fe79af4-b856-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Ulysses was a joint ESA/NASA space probe launched in 1990 to study the Sun's environment at all latitudes, providing comprehensive measurements of heliospheric particles and fields.
4fe79af4-b856-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: James Webb Telescope

4ff03654-b76c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Murviel-lès-Montpellier Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Murviel-lès-Montpellier, France. It is a ground-based observatory used for conducting astronomical research and observations.
4ff03654-b76c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Murviel-lès-Montpellier Observatory, France

4ff173f6-ba2e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mezmay Comet Search Center is a ground-based observatory located in Mezmay, Apsheronsky District, Krasnodar Krai, Russia. It focuses on the search and study of comets.
4ff173f6-ba2e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mezmay Comet Search Center, Russia

4ff1e768-bb42-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Campomaggiore Observatory**, also known as the Osservatorio Astronomico Campomaggiore, is an astronomical observatory located in Campomaggiore, Canneto Sabino, Fara in Sabina, Rieti, Lazio, Italy.
4ff1e768-bb42-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Osservatorio Astronomico Campomaggiore, Italy

4ff20762-b12d-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Express ASPERA-3 Neutral Particle Imager (NPI) is a scientific instrument designed to measure the integral flux of Energetic Neutral Atoms (ENAs) with high angular resolution, utilizing a graphite surface and Microchannel Plate (MCP) stack for detection.
4ff20762-b12d-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutral Particle Imager part of Mars Express

4ff2d22c-b8cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at Wu-Han (WHN) is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, specifically located at the WDC Kyoto observatory in Wuhan as part of the IUGONET network.
4ff2d22c-b8cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Wu-Han Observatory

4ff54fac-ba52-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Piero Angela Observatory is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Broncigliano, Scandicci, near Florence, Italy. It serves as an important site for astronomical research and observations in Europe.
4ff54fac-ba52-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Piero Angela Observatory, Italy

4ff6cd08-bab3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Slutsk observatory under the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA), operational from 1878 to 1944.
4ff6cd08-bab3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Slutsk Observatory

4ffb05b8-bb66-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Transient Survey Telescope (TST) at Teide is a ground-based observatory located in Güímar, Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain. It focuses on monitoring transient astronomical events and is situated at coordinates 28.29893 latitude and -16.51039 longitude (343.48961 in positive longitude format).
4ffb05b8-bb66-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Transient Survey Telescope at Teide Observatory, Spain

4ffba30c-b836-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the magnetometers located at the Sidmouth observatory, part of the IUGONET network. These instruments are used for measuring variations in the Earth's magnetic field as part of the IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) investigations.
4ffba30c-b836-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Sidmouth Observatory

500657b8-baaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Padova Observatory 0.92m Schmidt Telescope is located at the Asiago Observatory in Europe and operates in the optical waveband with an aperture of 0.92 meters.
500657b8-baaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical 0.92m Schmidt Telescope at Asiago Observatory

502b9f98-bbc0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Las Cumbres Global Telescope Network - 2m Telescopes are a set of identical Altitude-Azimuth mounted Ritchey-Chretian Cassegrain telescopes with a 2-meter aperture, part of the global observatory network operated by Las Cumbres.
502b9f98-bbc0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2m Telescope at Las Cumbres Observatory

51f3a234-bac2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 34m Deep Space Station 55 Antenna at Madrid Deep Space Communications Complex, Spain

51f859a6-b6fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A Riometer is an instrument used to measure radio wave absorption in the ionosphere. The broad-beam riometer at Tjornes, Iceland, part of the IUGONET observatory, specifically monitors these conditions as part of the Conjugate Observation at Iceland investigation.
51f859a6-b6fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer at Iugonet Observatory

52088722-b7ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Kinver Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in South Staffordshire, England, dedicated to ground-based astronomy. It is situated at Dunsley Road, Kinver, and operates under the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code J66.
52088722-b7ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kinver Observatory, United Kingdom

520c4fae-b861-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) Airglow Temperature Photometer at Kototabang, Indonesia, is an instrument designed to measure airglow intensities and rotational temperatures of OH and O2 in the upper atmosphere, as well as specific emission lines for atmospheric studies.
520c4fae-b861-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Airglow Temperature Photometer part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers

520f84aa-ba76-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Dettenhausen Observatory is an astronomical facility located at 31 Sofienstraße in Dettenhausen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. It functions as a ground-based observatory for astronomical research and observations.
520f84aa-ba76-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dettenhausen Observatory, Germany

521766f0-bb04-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatoire LAURIER is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in La Cañada, El Marqués, Querétaro, Mexico.
521766f0-bb04-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatoire LAURIER at El Marqués Observatory, Mexico

5225c4ac-b785-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1L Tilt Compensated Magnetometer (TCM2)** is a scientific instrument used in the BARREL project to measure magnetic field components with high resolution. It employs three orthogonal magneto-inductive sensors and includes a tilt sensor to distinguish between horizontal and vertical magnetic field components, essential for studying ULF timescale modulations of precipitation and identifying substorm activity.
5225c4ac-b785-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

52319f3c-b750-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **CPMN fluxgate magnetometer at KUJ** is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed at Kuju, Japan, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
52319f3c-b750-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of Circum Pan Pacific Magnetometer Network observation network

523dad64-b7a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer at BCL is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed in Bac Lieu, Vietnam, designed to measure magnetic field variations as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
523dad64-b7a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of MAGDAS observation network

5240a6ec-b7bb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Southeast Louisiana University (SLU) Magnetometer Station is a ground facility located in Livingston, Louisiana, USA, dedicated to measuring magnetic fields and operated by the IGPP-LANL.
5240a6ec-b7bb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Livingston Observatory, United States

5244daca-bb7e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Alma Ata Geophysical Observatory, also known as the Alma Ata Geomagnetic Observatory (AAA), is a ground-based facility located in Qarasay District, Almaty Region, Kazakhstan. It has been operational since 1963 and specializes in geomagnetic measurements using instruments like magnetometers.
5244daca-bb7e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Alma Ata Geomagnetic Observatory, Kazakhstan

52552a0a-b9d6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Energy-Mass Analyzer (AMEI-2)** is a low energy plasma composition spectrometer on the Interball Tail Probe that measures and separates fluxes of major ion species in the magnetotail, analyzing their energy and angular distributions.
52552a0a-b9d6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energy-Mass Analyzer part of Interball Tail Probe

525679c2-bc43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The AeroCube-6B (AC6) CubeSat is a nanosatellite developed by the Aerospace Corporation for technical research, featuring advanced structural design and micro dosimeters to measure space radiation.
525679c2-bc43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: AeroCube-6B CubeSat

525cf9a0-b93c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU radio beacon receiver (GRBR) station at Hue is an observatory located in Huế, Vietnam, designed to monitor ionospheric disturbances related to middle-upper atmospheric coupling processes. It operates as part of the GRBR network and is situated at 16.4572° N latitude and 107.5781° E longitude on Earth's surface with an altitude of approximately 8 meters above sea level.
525cf9a0-b93c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU Radio Beacon Receiver station at Hue, Vietnam

5265da6c-b69d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Ptolemy instrument was a gas chromatograph isotope ratio mass spectrometer onboard the Philae Lander of the Rosetta mission, designed to analyze the composition and isotopic ratios of cometary materials.
5265da6c-b69d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gas Chromatograph Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometer on Philae Lander part of Rosetta

5268b29a-badb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Scoresbysund Geomagnetic Observatory (SCO) is a ground facility located in Ittoqqortoormiit, Greenland. Operating under the sponsorship of Denmark, it primarily conducts geomagnetic measurements using instruments like magnetometers.
5268b29a-badb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Scoresbysund Geomagnetic Observatory, Greenland

527f1816-b7ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **THEMIS-A Probe Status** is an instrument that tracks and provides the positional status of the ARTEMIS-P1 probe as part of a spacecraft platform investigation within the CNES Observatory CDPP AMDA Artemis project.
527f1816-b7ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ARTemis-P1 probe status part of ARTEMIS Mission

528295a4-b9da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Odesa Astronomical Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Odesa, Ukraine.
528295a4-b9da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Odesa Astronomical Observatory, Ukraine

52867b5a-b8a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Owls and Ravens Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Holzgerlingen, Germany. It operates as a ground-based observatory for stargazing and research purposes.
52867b5a-b8a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Owls and Ravens Observatory, Germany

5289d080-b782-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A Riometer is an instrument used for monitoring the upper atmosphere's physics by observing cosmic noise absorption, and the one at Syowa Station in Antarctica is a broad-beam type.
5289d080-b782-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer part of Upper Atmosphere Physics Monitoring Observation at Syowa Station, Antarctica

528c228a-bb2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: El Vendrell Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Coma-ruga, Catalonia, Spain. It is a ground-based observatory used for various astronomical observations and research.
528c228a-bb2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: El Vendrell Observatory, Spain

5297815a-b9ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Mars Exploration Rover Opportunity Descent Camera (DESCAM) is an imaging instrument mounted on the lander of the MER-1 (Opportunity) rover, designed to capture images during descent onto Mars. It shares optical design with Navcams and Hazcams and produces 1024 x 1024 pixel images using a broadband visible filter.
5297815a-b9ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Descent Camera on Mars Exploration Rover Opportunity

52980694-b8c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Plasma Electron and Current Experiment (PEACE)** on Double Star 2 is an electrostatic analyzer designed to count low to medium energy electrons by measuring their impacts at various energy levels and directions.
52980694-b8c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electrostatic Analyser part of Double Star 2

52985e74-b7ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatory of Strasbourg is an astronomical observatory located in Strasbourg, France, established in 1881 and situated at Rue Goethe.
52985e74-b7ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatory of Strasbourg, France

529904d2-b77e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The "SAMPEX Positions" refers to the dataset containing the spacecraft positions of the Solar Anomalous and Magnetospheric Particle Explorer (SAMPEX) in various coordinate systems, providing essential information for analyzing its orbital trajectory and scientific observations.
529904d2-b77e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: SAMPEX Position part of Solar Anomalous and Magnetospheric Particle Explorer

529d97a2-b63b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
SMART-1 (Small Missions for Advanced Research in Technology 1) is a lunar orbiter developed by the European Space Agency to test advanced spacecraft technologies, particularly a solar-powered ion drive. It entered initial lunar orbit on November 13, 2004, and conducted scientific studies of the Moon until its controlled impact on September 3, 2006.
529d97a2-b63b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Small Missions for Advanced Research in Technology 1

52a4f518-b674-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Compustar Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Rouen, France. It is identified by the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code L59 and operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
52a4f518-b674-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Compustar Observatory, France

52a9c1f8-b94c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Radio Science Subsystem (RSS) for Mars Orbiter (MO) is a scientific instrument used to study the atmosphere and surface of Mars by analyzing radio signals transmitted between the orbiter and Earth. It helps gather data on atmospheric conditions, topography, and subsurface composition, contributing significantly to understanding the Martian environment.
52a9c1f8-b94c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Science Subsystem on Mars Orbiter

52ad7218-b6a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) Fabry-Perot Interferometer at Kototabang, Indonesia, is an instrument designed to measure thermospheric neutral wind by analyzing airglow emissions at 630.0 nm wavelengths, contributing to the study of upper atmospheric dynamics.
52ad7218-b6a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fabry-Perot Interferometer part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers at Kototabang, Indonesia

52aed5e6-b765-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Lucky Lake Geomagnetic Observatory (LUC)** is a ground-based facility located in Canaan No. 225, Saskatchewan, Canada, which monitors geomagnetic activity and includes instruments such as magnetometers.
52aed5e6-b765-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Lucky Lake Geomagnetic Observatory, Canada

52b2a894-bb2d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Fluxgate DC Magnetometer FM-3I on the Interball Tail Probe is an instrument consisting of two flux-gate magnetometers, M1 and M2, designed to measure magnetic fields in different ranges (-200 to +200 nT and -1000 to +1000 nT) for scientific research and spacecraft attitude control.
52b2a894-bb2d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate DC Magnetometer on Interball Tail Probe

52b6366e-b694-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU Radio Beacon Receiver (GRBR) Station at Tirunelveli is an observatory in India that measures ionospheric disturbances related to middle-upper atmospheric coupling processes. It is part of the GRBR network and located near the equator, with a GNU radio beacon receiver installed for its operations.
52b6366e-b694-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU Radio Beacon Receiver on GRBR Station at Tirunelveli, India

52bb3f48-bca6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields, particularly Earth's magnetic field. The Magnetometers at Qianling (QIX) are specifically part of the observatory network managed by IUGONET/WDC Kyoto, contributing data for geomagnetic research.
52bb3f48-bca6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Qianling Observatory

52bcb4da-b9cd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Astronaut Memorial Planetarium and Observatory (AMPO), also known as the Eastern Florida State College Planetarium and Observatory, is an astronomical observatory and planetarium located at Eastern Florida State College in Cocoa, Florida. The facility includes a planetarium, public observatory, large-screen movie theater, exhibit halls, multimedia classroom, and art gallery.
52bcb4da-b9cd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronaut Memorial Planetarium and Observatory, United States

52be0692-b9fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Viking Meteorology Instrument System (VMIS)** for Viking Lander 2 is a scientific instrument designed to measure atmospheric conditions on Mars, including temperature, pressure, wind speed, and direction. It consists of three main components: the Meteorology Sensor Array (MSA), the Meteorology Boom Assembly (MBA), and the Meteorology Electronic Assembly (MEA).
52be0692-b9fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Viking Meteorology Instrument System on Viking Lander 2

52c51be4-b74c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The STA-1600, 10.5x10.5k CCD is a high-resolution charge-coupled device (CCD) with 10560x10560 pixels, each measuring 9 µm, developed by the Imaging Technology Laboratories of the University of Arizona for use in astronomical imaging.
52c51be4-b74c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: CCD at STA Observatory

52c70de8-bc2c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Pioneer Venus Small Probe (Night) Differential Long Base Line Interferometer was an experiment that used interferometry techniques on radio signals from entry probes and a bus to measure wind speeds in Venus' lower atmosphere, contributing to the modeling of its circulation patterns.
52c70de8-bc2c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Differential Long Baseline Interferometer on Pioneer Venus Probe Bus

52c74862-b614-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DSS-65 34-m Radio Telescope, relocated in 2005, is a fully steerable dual-shaped reflector antenna that was part of NASA's Deep Space Network and operated from Madrid, Spain.
52c74862-b614-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 34m Radio Telescope at Madrid Deep Space Communications Complex, Spain

52dcefd0-b698-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Proton Switch is an energetic particle instrument onboard the CRRES satellite, designed to detect omnidirectional fluxes of protons within the 20-80 MeV energy range using lithium-drifted silicon detectors. It primarily served to alert the spacecraft's Data Processing Unit to the presence of protons, enabling telemetry reallocation for specific experiments under the SPACERAD project.
52dcefd0-b698-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Proton Switch on Chemical Release and Radiation Effects Satellite

52f524e2-b774-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tjornes Geomagnetic Observatory (TJO) in Iceland is a ground-based facility that collaborates with Syowa Station in Antarctica for geomagnetic conjugate observations, initiated in 1984 by the University of Iceland and NIPR.
52f524e2-b774-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geomagnetic Instrument at Tjornes Geomagnetic Observatory, Iceland

530242c2-baac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ambarnaya Geomagnetic Observatory (AMN) is a ground-based facility located in Амбарнское сельское поселение, Russia. It focuses on geomagnetic measurements and contributes to the global network of observatories monitoring Earth's magnetic field.
530242c2-baac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ambarnaya Geomagnetic Observatory

530b94da-bb2e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Thule (Quaanaaq) Geomagnetic Observatory is a space facility located near Earth in the Heliosphere, dedicated to geomagnetic observations and research. It is often referred to as THULE.
530b94da-bb2e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Thule Geomagnetic Observatory

531514bc-b735-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: An electron microprobe is a specialized analytical tool used to determine the chemical composition of small solid samples by bombarding them with an electron beam and analyzing the resulting X-rays. The "ASU Electron Microprobe" specifically refers to such an instrument located at Arizona State University (ASU).
531514bc-b735-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electron Microprobe part of Arizona State University

531a78ba-bafc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Venera 11 Energetic Particles experiment was a Soviet mission suite of particle detectors designed to measure the flux of charged particles in interplanetary space during its cruise and Venus flyby. It specifically monitored protons with energies greater than 30 MeV and between 3-5 MeV from both sunward and anti-sunward directions.
531a78ba-bafc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particles on Venera 11

531b9ae8-b89e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solar and Heliospheric Observatory (SOHO) is a collaborative space mission between ESA and NASA designed to study the Sun's internal structure, its atmosphere, and the solar wind. Launched in 1995, SOHO continues to operate from an orbit around the first Lagrangian point (L1), providing valuable data for helioseismology and improving space weather forecasting.
531b9ae8-b89e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar and Heliospheric Observatory ultraviolet part of International Solar Terrestrial Physics Program

531d1256-ba24-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at the Eagle (EAGL) Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission, used to measure magnetic fields since 2007.
531d1256-ba24-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Eagle Observatory

533329b0-b605-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Plasma Flow Detector VDP-S is an instrument onboard the Magion-4 spacecraft consisting of four Faraday cup detectors designed to register ions and electrons with energies above 170 eV. The detectors are oriented at +/- 45 degrees from the main axis of the spacecraft, with an angular aperture of 100 degrees, and operate at maximum frequencies of 1, 2, 4, and 8 Hz depending on telemetry mode.
533329b0-b605-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Faraday Cup part of Interball Mission

5333b436-b621-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sable Island Magnetometer is a scientific instrument located at the IAGA-identified station SBL on Sable Island, part of an observatory ground facility. It measures magnetic field variations and has been operational since January 1999 as part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) investigation.
5333b436-b621-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Sable Island Observatory

533e8f5c-ba2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Guidestar Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Weinheim, Germany. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
533e8f5c-ba2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Guidestar Observatory

53424c1a-b600-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Esashi Geomagnetic Observatory (ESA)** is a ground-based facility located on Earth's surface at an altitude of 396 meters, established in January 1993. It specializes in geomagnetic observations and is part of the IAGA network.
53424c1a-b600-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Esashi Geomagnetic Observatory

53482fe2-b85b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ELFIN mission's Energetic Particle Detector for Electrons is a solid-state detector designed to measure the energy and pitch angle of electrons in the range of 50 keV to 4.5 MeV, specifically from within the loss cone of Earth's radiation belts.
53482fe2-b85b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Detector for Electrons part of The Electron Losses and Fields Investigation mission

535071da-ba5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ondřejov–BlueEye600 Telescope Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Ondřejov, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic. It houses the BlueEye600 telescope and is part of the Astronomický ústav AV ČR (Astronomical Institute of the Czech Academy of Sciences).
535071da-ba5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: BlueEye600 Telescope at Ondřejov Observatory, Czechia

5353f866-ba79-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Whitin Observatory is an astronomical observatory owned and operated by Wellesley College in Wellesley, Massachusetts. It was built in 1900 and has undergone several additions over the years.
5353f866-ba79-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.7m Planewave Telescope at Whitin Observatory, United States

535e462e-b8e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the Solar Irradiance data collection initiative, starting from January 22, 2002, and operated by CDPP-AMDA in Sun. It compiles solar irradiance measurements from various missions such as TIMED/SEE for EUV/Xray and Fermi/LAT for Gamma rays.
535e462e-b8e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar Irradiance part of CDPP-AMDA Observatory on Sun

5364a740-b5b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gorgonzola Observatory (K23) is an astronomical observatory located in Gorgonzola, Milan, Italy. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical research and observations.
5364a740-b5b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gorgonzola Observatory, Italy

53680408-b63e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Podkamenaya Tunguska is a ground-based observatory located in the Turukhansky District, Krasnoyarsk Krai, Russia. It has been operational since 1969 and features a magnetometer for geomagnetic measurements.
53680408-b63e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Podkamenaya Tunguska Observatory, Russia

536835e0-b927-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Grainger Observatory is an astronomical observatory operated by Phillips Exeter Academy in Exeter, New Hampshire. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and educational purposes.
536835e0-b927-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Grainger Observatory, United States

536e2a88-b669-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mercury Transfer Module (MTM) is a component of the BepiColombo mission designed to transport two orbiters to Mercury. It provides solar electric propulsion for the journey from Earth to Mercury and will be jettisoned upon arrival at its destination.
536e2a88-b669-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mercury Transfer Module part of BepiColombo

5387d568-b99e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU Radio Beacon Receiver (GRBR) is a digital instrument installed in Chiang Mai, Thailand, designed to measure ionospheric total electron content (TEC) using signals from Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites. It utilizes GNU Radio software and Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP) hardware for signal processing and acquisition.
5387d568-b99e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waveform Receiver GRBR (GNU Radio Beacon Receiver) part of IUGONET Observatory

538afe1a-b5f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Polar is a spacecraft designed for conducting polar orbital investigations. It gathers ephemeris data and is part of the CNES observatory CDPP-AMDA Polar.
538afe1a-b5f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Part of Polar Spacecraft

538fa38e-bbb9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Weihai Observatory** is an astronomical facility equipped with a 1-meter telescope operated by Shandong University at the Weihai site, located in China.
538fa38e-bbb9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1m Telescope at Weihai Observatory

53954a1e-b68c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Buehler Planetarium and Observatory** is a domed theater and observatory located at Broward College in Davie, Florida, serving as the only public planetarium in Broward County.
53954a1e-b68c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Buehler Observatory at Broward College, United States

539b245e-bac7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Lenomiya Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Casa Grande, Arizona, United States. It operates as a ground-based facility with the MPC code H13.
539b245e-bac7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lenomiya Observatory at Casa Grande, United States

539cd3c8-bb38-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solid-State Imaging (SSI) system is a specialized camera setup with an 800x800 CCD sensor designed to capture high-resolution images of the Jovian satellites and atmosphere using a 1500 mm Cassegrain telescope.
539cd3c8-bb38-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solid State Imaging System on Galileo Orbiter

53a6d9b0-b7f8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Ametlla de Mar Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in L'Ametlla de Mar, Catalonia, Spain. Operated by Jaume Nomen, it holds the IAU code 946 and contributes to projects like the "Unicorn Project" and Minor Planet Astrometry group (Grup d'Estudis Astronòmics, GEA).
53a6d9b0-b7f8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ametlla de Mar Observatory, Spain

53ab5abc-bb86-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Imaging Riometer Observation at Zhigansk** is a 60MHz riometer located in Zhigansk, Russia, equipped with an 8x8-element dipole antenna array that produces independent beams covering an area of about 180km x 180km at the D region altitude. It was developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research at Nagoya University to study upper atmospheric dynamics through nocturnal airglow emissions.

53b684c8-bbb3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Dombas Geomagnetic Observatory (DOB), located in Dovre, Norway, is a ground-based facility specializing in geomagnetic measurements, operating since December 30, 2006.

53bf905a-ba90-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Irmtraut Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Sessenbach, Ransbach-Baumbach, Germany. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
53bf905a-ba90-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Irmtraut Observatory, Germany

53c5e394-b692-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tula Rooftop Observatory is a ground-based astronomical facility located at 13, улица Галкина in Tula, Russia. It provides opportunities for celestial observation and research within the Central Federal District of Europe.
53c5e394-b692-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tula Rooftop Observatory, Russia

53ca3e4c-bb9e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Alouette2 Positions" is a dataset that provides the spatial coordinates of the Alouette 2 spacecraft in different reference frames.
53ca3e4c-bb9e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris part of Alouette 2

53ca62f8-b62d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Oukaimedencode Y63 is a ground observatory located in Oukaïmeden, Morocco. It is part of the SNX-NET and situated at coordinates 31.2066° N, 7.86632° W (352.13368° longitude) within Al Haouz Province, Marrakech-Safi region.

53cb68b8-b7d8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Entity Definition**: THEMIS-E (code: 2007-004E) is a geomagnetic satellite in the Time History of Events and Macroscale Interactions during Substorms (THEMIS) mission, designed to study magnetospheric substorms. It was launched on February 17, 2007, aboard a Delta II rocket from Cape Canaveral.

53cbb720-ba6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Langenberg and Bochum Magnetometer** was an instrument used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field, operational from January 1, 1893, to December 31, 1934, at a station identified by IAGA as BOC.

53e097e2-b9a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Instituut voor Sterrenkunde and Katholieke Universiteit Leuven 1.2m Mercator Telescope** is located at the Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos in La Palma, Canary Islands, and is part of a ground-based observatory facility used for astronomical research.

53e14f70-bc74-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Institute of Space and Astronautical Science (ISAS) 8m Hakucho X-ray Satellite** is an astronomical observatory with an 8.0-meter telescope aperture primarily operating in the gamma-ray waveband, designed for space exploration and astronomy research.

53f98956-b7be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Collmberg Geomagnetic Observatory (CLL) is a ground-based facility in Germany that has been operating since 1935 to monitor geomagnetic activity on Earth's surface. It is part of the IUGONET network and includes instruments such as magnetometers for its observations.
53f98956-b7be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Collmberg Geomagnetic Observatory, Germany

5406773c-b756-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Costa Teguise Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Costa Teguise, Teguise, on the Canary Island of Lanzarote, Spain. It operates as a ground-based observatory for stargazing and astronomical research.
5406773c-b756-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Costa Teguise Observatory, Spain

540d43fa-b6c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Pevek (PBK) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based research facility located in Chukotka Autonomous Okrug, Russia, known for its magnetometer instrument and contributions to geophysical studies. It has been operational since 2011.
540d43fa-b6c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Pevek Geophysical Observatory, Russia

540dec4e-ba33-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Middlesex School Observatory (I29) is an astronomical observatory located in Concord, Massachusetts. It serves as a ground-based facility for observing celestial phenomena and has the Minor Planet Center ID I29.
540dec4e-ba33-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Concord Observatory, United States

540feac2-b70d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Varian Excalibur Series FTS 3000 is a laboratory spectrometer capable of collecting Fourier transform spectra in the range of 0.9 to 22 micrometers with a minimum spectral resolution of 0.5 1/cm, using MCT and DTGS detectors along with KBr and quartz beamsplitters.

54117fe4-b8b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Rover Camera Right (RCRT) for MPFR is a high-resolution imaging system mounted on the right side of the rover. It captures detailed images of the surrounding environment to support scientific analysis and navigation tasks during exploration missions.
54117fe4-b8b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rover Camera Right on Mars Perseverance Rover

54161106-b6b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mineyama Microbarometric Database (2010.07 - Latest) comprises microbarometric observations made using a VAISALA PTB210 barometric sensor, part of the IUGONET observatory managed by WDC Kyoto, designed to monitor low-frequency sound waves in the atmosphere.
54161106-b6b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrasound Investigation at WDC Kyoto Observatory

541611a0-b946-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Canberra Observatory

5428641e-bbd4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: Barnaul was a ground-based observatory in Russia, operational from 1842 to 1873, equipped with magnetometers for geomagnetic measurements.
5428641e-bbd4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Barnaul Observatory, Russia

5428defc-b71b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the position data of the NOAA 17 spacecraft, provided in different coordinate systems.

542f1e88-b83e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) Balloon 2T Trajectory Positions** is a virtual instrument that provides the trajectory positions of balloons in various coordinate systems, supporting investigations into relativistic electron losses within the Earth's radiation belts.
542f1e88-b83e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses part of BARREL

5430eb2e-b711-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The specific magnetometer located in Colorado Springs, part of the IAGA investigation, has been operational since January 1973 and provides valuable data on Earth's magnetic field variations.
5430eb2e-b711-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Colorado Springs Observatory

5436ec50-b846-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mont Mégantic Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Quebec, Canada, jointly operated by the Université de Montréal and the Université Laval. It houses one of the largest telescopes in Eastern Canada and is situated at the summit of Mont Mégantic.
5436ec50-b846-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mont Mégantic Observatory, Canada

5437c8fc-b5ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1K X-ray Instrument (XRI)** is a scintillation detector designed to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons. It utilizes a NaI crystal, photomultiplier tube, and pulse height analyzer to convert incident X-ray energies into charge pulses for spectral analysis.
5437c8fc-b5ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray Scintillation Detector part of Balloon Array for Radiation Belt Relativistic Electron Losses

543a5c5a-b9e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Galaxy Blues Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Gatineau, Quebec, Canada. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to celestial observation and research.
543a5c5a-b9e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Galaxy Blues Observatory, Canada

543ab4ac-b684-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Low Energy Plasma Analyzer (LEPA) on CRRES is an instrument consisting of two spherical electrostatic analyzers designed to measure electrons and ions in the energy range of 10 eV - 30 keV, with advanced capabilities for detailed plasma analysis and wave-particle interaction detection.
543ab4ac-b684-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Low Energy Plasma Analyzer on CRRES

543d8124-b737-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Volkssternwarte Buchloe** is a public observatory located in Buchloe, Bavaria, Germany. Established in 1987, it serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and education.
543d8124-b737-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Public Observatory Buchloe, Germany

54438896-b6f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Explorer 22**, also known as **Beacon Explorer-B (BE-B)**, was a small NASA ionospheric research satellite launched in 1964. It aimed to study the total electron content between the spacecraft and Earth, contributing to both geodetic measurements and atmospheric research.
54438896-b6f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.47m Beacon Explorer-B part of Explorer Program

5446d1e8-ba25-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Torredembarra Observatory (A03) is an astronomical observatory located in Torredembarra, Tarragona, Catalonia, Spain. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
5446d1e8-ba25-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Torredembarra Observatory, Spain

544c28ec-b678-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Radisson Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG, operational since October 21, 2014.
544c28ec-b678-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Radisson Observatory

544c799e-b6de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** ORFEES (Observation Radio Fréquences pour l'Etudes des Eruptions Solaires) is a ground-based observatory in Nançay, France, featuring a 5 m diameter antenna used for space weather prediction by monitoring solar eruptions through daily radio frequency observations between 130 MHz and 1 GHz.
544c799e-b6de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observation Radio Fréquences pour l'Etudes des Eruptions Solaires at Nançay Observatory, France

545e7f04-b819-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Herrenberg Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Herrenberg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. It has the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code 240 and operates as a ground-based facility.
545e7f04-b819-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Herrenberg Observatory, Germany

545f29e8-b9b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Magnetic Field Observations (MAG-B) instrument on Dynamics Explorer 2 was a triaxial fluxgate magnetometer designed to study magnetic field interactions between the magnetosphere, ionosphere, and atmosphere, particularly focusing on measuring field-aligned currents in auroral regions.
545f29e8-b9b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Triaxial Fluxgate Magnetometer part of Dynamics Explorer 2

5460cf10-bb3f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer onboard Phobos 2 was an instrument designed to investigate the magnetic environment around Mars, particularly at low altitudes (down to 850 km above the surface) and in the tail region.
5460cf10-bb3f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Phobos2

5461c2ac-ba0f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **University of Canterbury 1.8m MOA Project Telescope** is an optical telescope with a 1.8-meter aperture located at the Mount John University Observatory in Australia, part of Oceania.
5461c2ac-ba0f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.8m Microlensing Observations in Astrophysics Telescope at Mount John University Observatory, Australia

546e3426-ba17-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Giotto Extended Mission**: The Giotto Extended Mission was a continuation of the original Giotto mission, which successfully encountered Comet Halley in 1986. Starting in 1990 and concluding in 1992, this phase saw the spacecraft reactivated from hibernation for an additional flyby of comet Grigg-Skjellerup, collecting valuable scientific data despite the challenges posed by its extended time in space and limited resources.
546e3426-ba17-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Giotto Extended Mission

546f1c18-b186-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Bareket Observatory (IAU code B35) is an astronomical educational observatory located east of Maccabim, near Modiin in Israel. It is owned and operated by the Bareket family.
546f1c18-b186-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Bareket Observatory, Israel

5472eb76-b9d9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AMPTE/IRM Magnetometer is a three-axis fluxgate magnetometer launched in 1984 as part of the Active Magnetospheric Particle Tracer Explorers (AMPTE) mission. It was designed to measure magnetic fields with high precision and multiple sampling rates, contributing to studies in geoscience and remote sensing.
5472eb76-b9d9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Triaxial Fluxgate Magnetometer part of Active Magnetospheric Particle Tracer Explorers

547644ce-b777-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Fort Nelson Geophysical Observatory (FTN) is a ground-based facility located in Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, British Columbia, Canada. It includes instruments such as magnetometers and operates from July 22, 1991, at an altitude of 18 meters above sea level.
547644ce-b777-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Fort Nelson Geophysical Observatory, Canada

548f59d8-bb8b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. 548f59d8-bb8b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Cape Chelyuskin Observatory

5493da86-b937-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The Dixon Ground Magnetic Field Instrument, located at the WDC Kyoto observatory, has been operational since 1957 and provides data for the IAGA investigation.
5493da86-b937-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ground Magnetic Field Instrument at Dixon Observatory

5494fce4-ba50-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Altay Astronomical Observatory** is a ground-based observatory located in Karamgay Town, Fuhai County, Altay Prefecture, Xinjiang, China. It serves as an important facility for astronomical research and observations within Asia.
5494fce4-ba50-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Altay Astronomical Observatory, China

549a3b02-b873-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Clyde River Magnetometer is an instrument located at the Clyde River (CRVR) Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG, used to measure magnetic fields starting from January 1, 2008.
549a3b02-b873-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of THEMIS Mission GMAG

549b29d8-ba15-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Siena Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Àger, Lleida, Catalonia, Spain. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
549b29d8-ba15-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Siena Observatory, Spain

54a22790-b62a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Houstrup Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Nørre Nebel, Varde Municipality, Denmark. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
54a22790-b62a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Houstrup Observatory, Denmark

54a4980e-bb9d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ile-Ife Magnetometer is a ground-based instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field at the IAGA station identified as IIF, operational since January 1992.
54a4980e-bb9d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ile Ife Observatory

54a8d998-b871-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Calar Alto Observatory's 1.23-meter telescope is an astronomical facility located in the Valle del Almanzora, Almeria, Andalusia, Spain, situated at an altitude of 2100 meters above sea level.
54a8d998-b871-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.23m Telescope at Centro Astronómico Hispano en Andalucía, Spain

54b0625e-b8ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Volkssternwarte Hagen** is a public observatory located in Hagen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It operates as a ground-based facility at an altitude of 300 meters and is situated at Eugen-Richter-Turm, Kuhlerkamp.
54b0625e-b8ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hagen Observatory, Germany

54b36000-b693-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Schmelz Observatory:** An astronomical observatory located in Schmelz, Saarland, Germany, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial phenomena.
54b36000-b693-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Schmelz Observatory, Germany

54c26ddc-bacd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Yaoan Station (O49) is a ground-based observatory operated by the Purple Mountain Observatory, located in Xiao, Yao'an County, Chuxiong, Yunnan, China. It is situated at approximately 25.52861° latitude and 101.18111° longitude on the Asian continent.
54c26ddc-bacd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Yaoan Station of Purple Mountain Observatory, China

54ccf43e-ba85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** A magnetometer located at the Capri station with the IAGA identifier CPI, part of the IUGONET observatory network since 1957.
54ccf43e-ba85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Capri Observatory

54d04c2c-b9a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Partizánske Observatory (also known as Partizanske observatory) is an astronomical observatory located in Malé Bielice, Slovakia. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
54d04c2c-b9a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Partizánske Observatory, Slovakia

54d2c306-b719-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA station in Hong Kong (identifier HKC), operational from January 1, 1884, to December 31, 1978.

54e2a5d0-b978-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sutherland-LCO is an astronomical observatory located in Sutherland, South Africa. It operates as part of the larger Sutherland Observatory complex and is situated in the Northern Cape province.
54e2a5d0-b978-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sutherland Observatory, South Africa

54e44c0c-b971-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of Wyoming 2.3m Telescope at Wyoming Infrared Observatory (WIRO), located in North America, is a telescope with a 2.3-meter aperture designed for infrared observations.
54e44c0c-b971-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared 2.3m Telescope at Wyoming Infrared Observatory

54e4c69c-bbaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hamburg Magnetometer was an instrument used for measuring magnetic fields at the IAGA station in Hamburg from 1885 to 1896.
54e4c69c-bbaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hamburg Observatory

54e71f06-ba64-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Ivywood Observatory**: A ground-based astronomical observatory located in Edmond, Oklahoma, United States.
54e71f06-ba64-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ivy Wood Observatory

54fadc46-ba62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN magnetometer network at Kuju, Japan is a ground-based facility located in Kokonoe, Oita Prefecture, designed to monitor and measure magnetic fields. It includes instruments like the fluxgate magnetometer as part of its operations.
54fadc46-ba62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kuju Observatory, Japan

5506b89c-b632-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Pathfinder Rover, also known as Sojourner or the Microrover Flight Experiment (MFEX), was a NASA mission launched in 1997 to test autonomous mobile vehicle technologies on Mars. It carried out experiments such as wheel-soil interactions and autonomous navigation while collecting elemental composition data using an Alpha Proton X-ray Spectrometer (APXS).
5506b89c-b632-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Microrover Flight Experiment part of Mars Pathfinder Mission

550713ee-bb11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The KaVA is a collaborative ground-based observatory in Asia that combines the Korean VLBI Network (KVN) and the Japanese VLBI Exploration of Radio Astrometry (VERA), specializing in millimeter waveband observations.
550713ee-bb11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Millimeter The combined VLBI array consisting of the Korean VLBI Network and VLBI Exploration of Radio Astrometry

5509ed06-b91f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the Ionospheric Station at El Arenosillo, Spain (URSI-code: EA036), which operates a Digisonde—an advanced ionosonde that measures angle of arrival, polarization, and Doppler frequency shift of skywave signals reflected from the ionosphere.
5509ed06-b91f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digisonde at Ionospheric Station of El Arenosillo, Spain

551cd438-ba47-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the PENGUIn-0 (PG0) Geophysical Observatory in Antarctica, operational since December 28, 2014, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of a broader scientific investigation.
551cd438-ba47-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at PENGUIn-0 Geophysical Observatory, Antarctica

551cfdea-b79b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The AWESOME (Atmospheric Weather Electromagnetic System for Observation, Modeling, and Education) receiver is a ground-based instrument that monitors very low frequency (VLF) radio transmissions and extremely low frequency (ELF) natural signals, such as those from lightning and wave-particle interactions in the Earth's magnetosphere. It was developed at Stanford University and deployed globally to track these phenomena with high temporal resolution.
551cfdea-b79b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Very Low Frequency Atmospheric Weather Electromagnetic System for Observation, Modeling, and Education

552a61d2-b864-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer, specifically the Derby (DRBY) Geophysical Observatory Magnetometer, is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields and was deployed as part of the THEMIS Mission starting on October 25, 2005.
552a61d2-b864-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Derby Geophysical Observatory

5531be5e-bb4e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Volkssternwarte Michelbach** is an astronomical observatory located in Lower Austria, specifically in the village of Michelbach near St. Pölten. Established in 1984, it serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
5531be5e-bb4e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: NÖ Volkssternwarte at Volkssternwarte Michelbach, Austria

56bf2a88-b773-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The **BARREL Balloon 3B** was part of NASA's BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) mission, launched on August 13, 2015. 56e8eb4e-bb41-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity describes an infrasound sensor located at Aichi University of Education in Kariya, Japan. 56f3f544-b6e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Grantham Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Grantham, England, dedicated to the study and observation of celestial bodies from Earth.

57773c96-bb28-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the Forthimage Observatory in Edinburgh, a ground-based astronomical facility located at 1 Clifton Road, West Clifton, City of Edinburgh, Scotland.

57a0e886-b7ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Maisach-2 Magnetometer was an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, operational from January 1, 1927, to December 31, 1932, at the IAGA observatory in Maisach.

57fec3b2-ba80-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wide-field Mufara Telescope at Isnello Observatory, Italy

5806e30c-bb03-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Explorer 34 (IMP-4)** was a NASA satellite launched on May 24, 1967, as part of the Explorer program. It was designed to study interplanetary magnetic fields, energetic particles, and plasma from its high-inclination, highly eccentric Earth orbit until its reentry in May 1969.
5806e30c-bb03-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Explorer 34 part of Interplanetary Monitoring Platform

580c81c0-b92f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 2O X-ray Instrument (XRI) is a scintillation detector designed to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons. 580c81c0-b92f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-Ray Scintillation Detector part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

580e8df6-ba1c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Public Observatory Mainz** is a ground-based observatory located in Mainz, Germany. It serves as a public facility for astronomical observations and educational activities.
580e8df6-ba1c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Public Observatory Mainz, Germany

580e9338-b741-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The THEMIS Solid State Telescope (SST) is an energetic particle instrument on the THEMIS spacecraft designed to measure the intensity of superthermal electrons and ions, primarily in the energy ranges of 30-100 keV for electrons and 30-300 keV for ions.

581d7554-bab8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Analyzer of Wideband Electromagnetic Waves (MEMO) on the Interball Auroral Probe is an instrument designed to measure and provide waveforms associated with electromagnetic waves in three frequency bands: ELF (5-1000 Hz), VLF (1-20 kHz), and LF (20-250 kHz). It operates primarily in a snapshot mode due to memory constraints.
581d7554-bab8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waveform Receiver part of Interball Auroral Probe

58210532-b808-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Antarctic Muon and Neutrino Detector Array (AMANDA)** is a scientific instrument located in Antarctica, designed to observe neutrinos, particles, and gravitational waves.

5830fcf2-b8e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: - **Definition**: A magnetometer located in Colaba (CLA) used for geomagnetic observations from 1846 to 1906 as part of the IAGA investigation.

5847ebd6-ba63-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Emerald Lane Observatory, United States

584c9c14-b778-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Mekrijarvi Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG since 2017.

5856b894-b759-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at the Hankasalmi Observatory in Kyoto, operational since January 1995, is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields as part of the IAGA investigation.
5856b894-b759-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hankasalmi Observatory

58594870-b8bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, and the one installed in 1933 at the College Observatory (CMO) as part of IAGA's investigation helps monitor geomagnetic activity.

5869e0ee-b809-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Putre Geomagnetic Observatory is a ground-based facility in Putre, Chile, dedicated to observing geomagnetic activities on Earth's surface since May 1, 2003. 589584bc-b924-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Alibag, India, part of the Equatorial Magnetometer Network (EMN), designed to measure magnetic field variations using a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate.

58968430-ba4f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The WAA Remote Observatory, located at the Hakos Astrofarm on Gamsberg Pass in Khomas, Namibia, is a ground-based observatory situated at latitude -23.2366 and longitude 16.36131.

58a74eb2-b998-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Eskimo Point (ESKI) is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Arviat, Nunavut, Canada. It operates as part of the CARISMA magnetometer array to monitor and study geomagnetic activity on Earth's surface.

58a7f190-b688-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Rose-Hulman Observatory**, also known as the Oakley Observatory, is an astronomical observatory located at the Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology in Terre Haute, Indiana. 58dc4310-b763-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Chapel Hill Observatory (H34) is an astronomical observatory located in New Chapel Hill, Smith County, Texas. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to the study of celestial objects and phenomena.
58dc4310-b763-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Chapel Hill Observatory, United States

58e4b97c-bc64-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Jean-Marc Salomon Telescope at Buthiers Observatory, France

58e8d548-b868-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Table Mountain Observatory (TMO) is an astronomical observational facility operated by NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, located in Big Pines, California.
58e8d548-b868-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Table Mountain Observatory

58f34fa8-b7ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Beckman DK2A Ratio Recording Spectroreflectometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the relative reflectance of samples across visible and infrared wavelengths, utilizing an integrating sphere and interchangeable detectors. 58f5e11a-b616-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nain Neutron Monitor is an Energetic Particle Instrument designed to measure neutrons in the context of space weather research. 58f5e11a-b616-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutron Monitor part of Bartol Observatory

59021a3c-ba2d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the "CNOFS Positions," which provides data on the spatial coordinates of the Communication/Navigation Outage Forecasting System (CNOFS) spacecraft in different reference frames, as part of the CNOFS observatory mission.
59021a3c-ba2d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris on Communication Navigation Outage Forecasting System

5904f8f8-b5f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **GOES 2**: A NASA-developed, NOAA-operated geosynchronous weather satellite launched in 1977 to monitor Earth's atmosphere and space environment.
5904f8f8-b5f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Visible Infrared Spin Scan Radiometer on GOES 2

590b0c98-b922-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The All-Sky Automated Survey for Supernovae (ASAS-SN) is an optical survey based on Earth that monitors the entire sky to detect and study supernovae.
590b0c98-b922-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical All-Sky Automated Survey for Supernovae

590b8994-b7b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Hidaka Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Hidaka, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. It is designated as a ground-based facility with the Minor Planet Center ID 868.
590b8994-b7b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hidaka Observatory, Japan

590bf64e-b625-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Sitka Magnetic Observatory:** A ground-based magnetic observatory located in Sitka, Alaska, operated by the United States Geological Survey since 2007.
590bf64e-b625-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Sitka Magnetic Observatory, United States

59188cb2-bb0f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Moonglow Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Warrensburg on Northwest 450 Road, Johnson County, Missouri, United States. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
59188cb2-bb0f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Moonglow Observatory, United States

591c73fc-bad0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NEA Scout (NEAS) mission is a 6U CubeSat equipped with a controllable solar sail designed to encounter and characterize the near-Earth asteroid 2020 GE using optical navigation and a monochromatic camera.
591c73fc-bad0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Earth Asteroid Scout

5923e9c6-b6c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The US Air Force Space Test Program Advanced Research and Global Observation (ARGOS) Satellite Mission is a space mission focused on conducting research and global observations using X-ray wavebands.
5923e9c6-b6c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: x-ray US Air Force Space Test Program Advanced Research and Global Observation Satellite Mission

59250902-b7bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1B X-ray Instrument (XRI)** is a scintillation detector used in the BARREL project to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons. It employs a NaI crystal, photomultiplier tube, and peak detect board to convert X-ray energies into charge pulses for analysis.
59250902-b7bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-Ray Scintillation Detector part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

5934f65a-b96f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "MMS1234 Ephemeris" is a virtual instrument providing positional data for the Magnetospheric Multiscale (MMS) spacecraft, part of the CNES-CDPP-AMDA observatory.
5934f65a-b96f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: MMS1234 Ephemeris part of CNES-CDPP-AMDA Observatory

5935b55e-b140-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Entity Definition:**

The entity describes the "BARREL Balloon 2F," part of the BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) mission, which is a NASA project using high-altitude balloons to study particle loss from Earth's radiation belts.
5935b55e-b140-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses 1m at BARREL Observatory

593bbcb8-b976-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Buenaventura Suarez Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located at the Universidad de La Punta in San Luis, Argentina. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical research and education.
593bbcb8-b976-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Buenaventura Suarez Observatory, Argentina

593ce606-b804-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **GNU radio beacon receiver (GRBR) station at Tohoku Sendai** is an observatory located in Miyagi Prefecture, Japan, dedicated to measuring ionospheric disturbances related to middle-upper atmospheric coupling processes. It is part of the GRBR network and situated at Tohoku University Aobayama North Campus.
593ce606-b804-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU radio beacon receiver on GRBR station at Tohoku Sendai, Japan

59426fa4-b908-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **TRAC (Fluxgate Magnetometer)** on Aureol 3 was a triaxial fluxgate magnetometer used for spacecraft attitude determination and control, capable of producing high-precision magnetic field measurements to study fields associated with field aligned currents.
59426fa4-b908-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Aureol 3

5943b6da-bac9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Huancayo Neutron Monitor is an energetic particle instrument located at the Huancayo Observatory in Peru, designed to detect and measure cosmic rays and solar particles.
5943b6da-bac9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutron Monitor at Huancayo Observatory, Peru

5946f7de-bb5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Large Binocular Telescope (LBT) is an optical telescope located on Mount Graham in southeastern Arizona, United States, known for its large aperture and advanced astronomical capabilities as part of the Mount Graham International Observatory.
5946f7de-bb5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 8.4m Large Binocular Telescope at Mount Graham International Observatory, United States

59481598-bb70-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 1B was a high-altitude balloon mission launched on January 2, 2013, and concluded on January 9, 2013, designed to study the loss of relativistic electrons from Earth's radiation belts by measuring Bremsstrahlung X-rays in the stratosphere.
59481598-bb70-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses Balloon Array part of Living with a Star Mission of Opportunity

5962f3d6-bb20-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CONSERT experiment was designed to obtain tomography of a comet nucleus using instruments on both the Philae lander and the orbiter, functioning as a time domain transponder between them.
5962f3d6-bb20-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: The Comet Nucleus Sounding Experiment by Radiowave Transmission on Rosetta Philae Lander

59656d94-b749-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 1T Data Processing Unit (DPU) is an instrument controller board used in the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) project. It acquires data from various sensors, formats and transmits this data via an Iridium modem, and controls the command-cutdown system, utilizing an FPGA for flexible interface logic.
59656d94-b749-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Data Processing Unit part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

5965ad88-b75b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hartebeesthoek Radio Astronomy Observatory (HARTRAO) 26m radio telescope is a 26-meter aperture instrument located in Africa, designed for radio astronomy observations.
5965ad88-b75b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 26.0m Radio Telescope at Hartebeesthoek Radio Astronomy Observatory

596b2460-bbcb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Explorer Spacecraft Series** is a collection of spacecraft missions designed to study various aspects of the solar wind, lunar environment, Earth's magnetosphere, ionosphere, and aeronomy. These satellites are part of broader scientific efforts to understand space weather and near-Earth phenomena.
596b2460-bbcb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Explorer Spacecraft Series

597f8662-b95f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Ostrorog Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Mutowo, Szamotuły County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland. It is identified by the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code A54 and operates as a ground-based facility.
597f8662-b95f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ostrorog Observatory, Poland

598a452a-b770-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Iturrieta Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Róitegui/Erroitegi, Arraia-Maeztu, Álava, Spain. It is situated at coordinates 42.793367 latitude and -2.34480000000002 longitude within the Autonomous Community of the Basque Country.
598a452a-b770-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Iturrieta Observatory, Spain

598b9676-b939-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GOES 9 Position refers to the ephemeris data of the GOES 9 spacecraft, which provides information on its positional coordinates and trajectory as part of the GOES-9 observatory.
598b9676-b939-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GOES 9 Position part of Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite

598eab40-b99d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute's Korean Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) Network (KVN) is a ground-based observatory in Asia that operates in the millimeter waveband, used for high-resolution astronomical observations.
598eab40-b99d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Millimeter Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute Korean Very Long Baseline Interferometry Network

599013ce-b649-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Search Coil Magnetometer on Helios-A (E4) was an instrument designed to study the magnetic component of electromagnetic waves in the solar wind, measuring rapid variations in the magnetic field and providing power spectral density data from 0.3 to 1.0 AU.
599013ce-b649-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Search Coil Magnetometer on Helios-A

599068b8-bc54-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer used in the MEASURE Magnetometer Array, specifically a fluxgate type instrument located at the geomagnetic observatory operated by Clarkson University.
599068b8-bc54-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at Clarkson University Observatory

599bcd16-b86c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Neutraubling Observatory:** An astronomical observatory located in Neutraubling, Bavaria, Germany, dedicated to ground-based observations.
599bcd16-b86c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutraubling Observatory, Germany

599bd248-b8d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Proton-Alpha Sensor (PAS)** is a particle detector on the Solar Orbiter mission, designed to measure the three-dimensional distribution functions of solar wind ions, primarily protons and alpha particles, within an energy range of 200 eV to 20 keV. It provides high-resolution data used to calculate density, speed, pressure, and temperature tensors of the solar wind's main components.
599bd248-b8d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Proton-Alpha Sensor part of Solar Orbiter

599dcb70-b8f8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the Mikolow Observatory in Poland, which was a ground-based facility for magnetic measurements active from 1925 to 1932.
599dcb70-b8f8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Mikolow Observatory

59a0e5c6-b740-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Modra Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Modra, Slovakia, operated by the Comenius University in Bratislava. It focuses on research led by the Department of Astronomy, Physics of the Earth, and Meteorology within the Faculty of Mathematics, Physics, and Informatics.
59a0e5c6-b740-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical and Geophysical Observatory

59a29b2e-b686-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Meteorological Operational satellite programme (MetOp) is a European initiative, co-established by ESA and Eumetsat, to provide weather data services for climate monitoring and forecast improvement. It operates in conjunction with NOAA's satellite system as part of a global cooperative venture.
59a29b2e-b686-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: MetOp part of Meteorological Operational Satellite Programme

59ad29e2-b7c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Wide Field Camera (WFC)** is an optical mosaic camera used at the prime focus of the 2.5m Isaac Newton Telescope (INT), featuring four thinned EEV CCDs with high quantum efficiency and low noise, capable of capturing wide-field astronomical images efficiently.
59ad29e2-b7c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.5m Wide Field Camera on Isaac Newton Telescope

59b2263c-b7d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The GRBR (GNU Radio Beacon Receiver) is a digital receiver located in Uji, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan, designed for measuring ionospheric total electron content (TEC) using LEO satellite beacon signals, utilizing GNU Radio software and Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP) hardware.
59b2263c-b7d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waveform Receiver part of Research Institute for Sustainable Humanosphere and Ionosphere Observatory, Japan

59b95060-bad4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Yohkoh (Japanese for "sunbeam") is a solar observatory satellite designed to study high-energy radiations from solar flares and quiet structures on the Sun. Launched in 1991, it carries four instruments: two imagers and two spectrometers, and operates in collaboration with Japan, the US, and the UK.
59b95060-bad4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Soft X-ray Telescope on Yohkoh spacecraft

59c53958-bb50-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Taya Beixo Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Barquisimeto, Venezuela. It is situated at coordinates 290.6769 longitude and 10.075583 latitude, functioning as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
59c53958-bb50-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Taya Beixo Observatory, Venezuela

59c84130-bbef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the La Maddalena Observatory in Kyoto, Japan, used for monitoring and studying variations in the Earth's magnetic field as part of the IAGA program.
59c84130-bbef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at IUGONET Observatory WDC Kyoto LMD

59ce653a-b92c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Carla Jane Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Charlotte, North Carolina. It is a ground-based facility used for stargazing and scientific research.
59ce653a-b92c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Carla Jane Observatory at Charlotte, United States

59dd2bec-b6f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Oakridge Observatory**, also known as the Miami-Dade County's Hammocks Observatory (H76), is an astronomical observatory located in The Hammocks, Miami-Dade County, Florida. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to stargazing and astronomy research.
59dd2bec-b6f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Miami Observatory

59e12546-ba3d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** GOES 14, also known as GOES-O, is a geostationary weather satellite operated by the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), launched in 2009 to monitor weather patterns and space environment conditions.
59e12546-ba3d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 14
