643b0c44-b152-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a spacecraft named "MUSES-B," which is informed by the NAIF list and has an alternative label of "ValueSet({Value@MUSES-B})."
643b0c44-b152-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: MUSES-B

644b4470-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Zuy Observatory (IAGA:ZUY) is a ground-based facility located in Zuy, Irkutsk Oblast, Russia. It operated from January 1, 1915, to December 31, 1958, primarily for magnetometer measurements at an altitude of 430 meters above Earth's surface.
644b4470-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Zuy Observatory, Russia

6450a58c-b5ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The VLF/ELF Nyrola station in Finland is a ground-based observatory equipped with a Very Low Frequency / Extremely Low Frequency crossed loop antenna, established by Prof. Shiokawa of ISEE and collaborating with the Sodankyla Geophysical Observatory and Finnish Meteorological Institute.
6450a58c-b5ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Very Low Frequency and Extremely Low Frequency Antenna at Nyrola Station, Finland

64525782-b747-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Drum Hill Station**: An astronomical observatory located in Chelmsford, Massachusetts, known for its ground-based observation facilities.
64525782-b747-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Drum Hill Station at Chelmsford Observatory, United States

645b87ea-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **CLPS Task Order 2 AB Peregrine Lunar Lander** is a small-class lander designed by NASA to deliver payloads to lunar orbit and the lunar surface, featuring advanced systems for thermal regulation, propulsion, guidance, navigation, control, and communication.
645b87ea-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Peregrine Lunar Lander part of CLPS Task Order 2 AB

645fe784-b833-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Chengdu Geomagnetic Observatory (CDP), located in Xujia, Dujiangyan City, Chengdu, Sichuan, China, is a ground-based facility dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity and has been operational since January 1995.
645fe784-b833-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Chengdu Geomagnetic Observatory, China

64604816-b615-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Biak Observatory is a ground-based facility located near the equator in Biak, Indonesia, primarily equipped with a meteor wind radar to measure wind velocity in the equatorial mesosphere and lower thermosphere.
64604816-b615-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Biak Observatory, Indonesia

64779512-b6af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **SESAME VELOX (VLF-ELF Logger Experiment)** is a multi-channel radio receiver designed to study magnetospheric plasma structures and wave interactions within the 0.5-30 kHz frequency range, typically recording data for one minute every fifteen minutes.
64779512-b6af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waveform Receiver part of SESAME VELOX, Antarctica

64856914-b734-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Glyndon station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Wilkin County, Minnesota, United States. It is part of the MAGDAS magnetometer network and operates at coordinates 46.5°N, -96.3°W.
64856914-b734-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: MAGDAS Magnetometer at Glyndon Station, United States

64881eaa-b970-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Cerro del Viento Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Badajoz, Spain. It operates as a ground-based facility and is used for various astronomical observations and research purposes.
64881eaa-b970-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Badajoz Observatory, Spain

648a1a92-bb15-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DSX-SWx's High Energy Imaging Particle Spectrometer (HIPS) is an advanced charged-particle spectrometer designed to measure the flux and angular distribution of high-energy protons (30-300 MeV) and electrons (1-30 MeV) in multiple energy bins, essential for understanding space radiation effects and advancing technologies for Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) spaceflight.
648a1a92-bb15-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: High Energy Imaging Particle Spectrometer part of Demonstration and Science Experiments

6499e150-b1b2-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Explorer 32 (Atmospheric Explorer B)**: A former NASA research satellite launched in 1966 to study the Earth's upper atmosphere, focusing on measuring temperatures, composition, densities, and pressures.
6499e150-b1b2-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Atmosphere Explorer B

649dfe46-bb1e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Romito Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Romito Magra, Arcola, Italy. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
649dfe46-bb1e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Romito Observatory, Italy

64a1d000-b792-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The DSS-43 70-m Radio Telescope is a fully steerable parabolic reflector antenna located in Canberra, Australia, operating as part of NASA's Deep Space Network for radio astronomy observations and spacecraft communication.
64a1d000-b792-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: radio The Deep Space Network, radio astronomy observations with 70 m on DSS-43 70-m Radio Telescope part of NASA Deep Space Network, Australia

64a7ef72-ba02-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The BARREL Balloon 1B Optical Photometer is an instrument designed to detect visible light at wavelengths near 486.1 nm, specifically during relativistic electron precipitation events, to determine the presence of protons and support the study of scattering by electromagnetic ion cyclotron waves.
64a7ef72-ba02-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Photometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

64b00ab0-ba8c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Special Sensor Microwave Imager/Sounder (SSMIS)** on the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program's 5D-3/S20 platform is a multi-channel microwave radiometer that provides imagery and atmospheric sounding data, enhancing precipitation measurements through its temperature and humidity channels operating in the 54 and 183 GHz bands.
64b00ab0-ba8c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Special Sensor Microwave Imager and Sounder part of Defense Meteorological Satellite Program

64b482fe-bbac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The LWP (Long-Wavelength Prime) Camera was the primary imaging device for the International Ultraviolet Explorer's Long-Wavelength Spectrograph, used to capture ultraviolet spectra in the range of 1850 to 330 angstroms.
64b482fe-bbac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet Long-Wavelength Spectrograph on International Ultraviolet Explorer

64ca1680-b19f-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "WDC_GDMC" investigation involves a magnetometer at the Phuthuy ground station in South Africa, which measures magnetic field data and has been operational since January 1996.
64ca1680-b19f-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Phuthuy Observatory

64dac462-bc1c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The South Pole Riometer Instrument is a device located at the South Pole ground station, designed to measure cosmic radio noise absorption in the Earth's ionosphere. It is part of the ICESTAR investigation and operates under the Bartol Neutron Monitor Observatory.
64dac462-bc1c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer part of ICESTAR, Antarctica

64dda1be-baaa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at the Tristan Da Cunha Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation since 2009.
64dda1be-baaa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tristan Da Cunha Observatory

64df10bc-b6db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Ras Algethi, Ronda is a ground-based observatory located in Rosalejo, Ronda, Andalusia, Spain, known for its astronomical observations and research.
64df10bc-b6db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ras Algethi Observatory, Spain

64f68582-bbbb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Port.Jeanne.D'Arc Magnetometer** is an instrument located at the Port.Jeanne.D'Arc station (IAGA identifier PJA), used for measuring magnetic fields from 1930 to 1962 as part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) investigations.
64f68582-bbbb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Port Jeanne d'Arc Observatory

64feff4a-b7a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Digisonde ionospheric station at Cachoeira Paulista, Brazil (URSI-code: CAJ2M) is an advanced ground facility that measures various characteristics of skywave signals reflected from the ionosphere to study its properties. It is part of the GIRO observatory network and located in São José dos Campos, São Paulo, Brazil.
64feff4a-b7a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digisonde Ionospheric Station at Cachoeira Paulista Observatory, Brazil

65043316-bc7f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Magnetometers at Weston (WES)** were ground-based instruments used to measure the Earth's magnetic field as part of the IAGA investigation from January 1965 to December 31, 1968.
65043316-bc7f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet Observatory

6507d2cc-b811-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **THEMIS E Spacecraft Modes** refer to the operational states of the THEMIS E satellite, including slow survey, fast survey, particle burst, and wave burst modes. These modes are part of the THEMIS mission and facilitate various types of scientific measurements in space.
6507d2cc-b811-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Part of THEMIS E Spacecraft Modes

650ad498-bca5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: Hong Kong 1 is a ground-based observatory in Sha Tin, Hong Kong, that operated from January 1, 1884, to December 31, 1978, primarily for magnetic field measurements using a magnetometer.
650ad498-bca5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hong Kong Observatory, China

650b77cc-b89f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The East Anglia Geomagnetic Observatory (EAA), located in Norwich, England, is a ground-based facility that has been operating since 1973 to monitor geomagnetic activity. It is part of the IUGONET observatory network and includes instruments such as magnetometers provided by the WDC Kyoto.
650b77cc-b89f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at East Anglia Geomagnetic Observatory, United Kingdom

650f2888-b726-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Centennial Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Twin Falls, Idaho, United States, known for ground-based observations and research.
650f2888-b726-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Centennial Observatory, United States

651cf2ce-b8ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Brigham Young University (BYU) 0.91m Telescope at West Mountain Observatory is an optical telescope located in North America, operated by Brigham Young University as part of the West Mountain Observatory.
651cf2ce-b8ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.91m Telescope at West Mountain Observatory

652497f4-bb13-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Atmospheric Structure Experiment for the Pioneer Venus Large Probe (LAS) was an instrument package that included accelerometers, pressure sensors, and temperature sensors. It was designed to profile atmospheric properties along the probe's trajectory from Venus’s surface to approximately 140 km altitude, measuring wind velocities and turbulence to help determine circulation models of the planet's atmosphere.
652497f4-bb13-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Large Probe Atmospheric Structure Experiment part of Pioneer Venus

652b0b9c-b7c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1G Data Processing Unit (DPU)** is a versatile instrument controller board used in the BARREL project to gather data from various sensors, format it for transmission via an Iridium modem, and manage command-cutdown systems. It employs an FPGA for interface logic flexibility and has been successfully deployed on multiple sounding rocket experiments and balloon flights.
652b0b9c-b7c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Data Processing Unit part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

652b3760-b895-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Observatoire de la Nine** is a ground-based observatory located in Saint-Pé d'en Bas, Canens, France. It serves as an astronomical facility for observations and research.
652b3760-b895-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatoire de la Nine, Canens

6549d944-b7bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer at ASW is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed in Aswan, Egypt, used for measuring magnetic field variations as part of the MAGDAS observation network.
6549d944-b7bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

654d256e-bbab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The USNO 1.55m telescope is a 1.55-meter optical telescope located at the United States Naval Observatory Flagstaff Station in Arizona, primarily used for astrometry and imaging purposes.
654d256e-bbab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.55m Kaj A. Strand Astrometric Reflector at Naval Observatory Flagstaff Station

6557a76c-bb99-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 210 Magnetic Meridian (210MM) Moshiri Station is a ground-based magnetic observatory located in Moshiri, Hokkaido Prefecture, Japan. It is part of the ISEE magnetometer network and includes instruments such as fluxgate magnetometers to monitor geomagnetic activity.
6557a76c-bb99-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Moshiri Observatory, Japan

6559acae-ba83-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatory of Atmospheric Environment in the Atacama highland, Chile, is a ground-based facility located at San Pedro de Atacama dedicated to studying atmospheric conditions using instruments such as millimeter wave spectroscopic radiometers.
6559acae-ba83-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Millimeter Wave Spectroscopic Radiometer at Observatory of Atmospheric Environment in Atacama, Chile

656d5f6a-ba1a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The VLF/ELF Gakona station in Alaska is a ground-based observatory operated by ISEE for studying very low frequency and extremely low frequency electromagnetic waves. The facility collaborates with the Geophysical Institute at the University of Alaska Fairbanks and the University of Florida, focusing on geophysical research in this remote location.
656d5f6a-ba1a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Crossed Loop Antenna at Gakona Observatory, United States

6574bd2c-bb4c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Killer Rocks Observatory:** An astronomical observatory located in Catron County, New Mexico, known as the "Killer Rocks Observatory" or "Pie Town".
6574bd2c-bb4c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Killer Rocks Observatory at Pie Town, United States

6581f5b0-b59c-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Coronal Diagnostic Spectrometer (CDS) is an instrument on the Solar and Heliospheric Observatory (SOHO) designed to study the solar atmosphere by analyzing spectral emission lines in the extreme ultraviolet wavelength range, providing detailed information about temperature, density, flow, and abundance of plasmas.
6581f5b0-b59c-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Extreme ultraviolet Coronal Diagnostic Spectrometer on Solar and Heliospheric Observatory

658f7aae-b831-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The SENSU SuperDARN Syowa East HF Radar is a high-frequency coherent radar located at Syowa Station in Antarctica, functioning as part of the Super Dual Auroral Radar Network (SuperDARN) operated by Japan's National Institute of Polar Research.
658f7aae-b831-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: HF radar on Super Dual Auroral Radar Network part of National Institute of Polar Research, Antarctica

6594a2a6-b64a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 210MM Canberra Station is a ground facility located in Canberra, Australian Capital Territory, Australia, that operates as part of the 210 Magnetic Meridian (210MM) magnetometer network. It includes a fluxgate instrument to measure magnetic fields and is situated at coordinates -35.3 latitude and 149.0 longitude in Oceania.
6594a2a6-b64a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Canberra Observatory, Australia

65952d72-b65c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "GOES 1 Position" refers to the ephemeris data of the GOES 1 (Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite) spacecraft, providing information on its orbital position and trajectory over time.
65952d72-b65c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris on GOES 1

659e26ae-b95c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The IceCube South Pole Neutrino Observatory is a ground-based observatory located in Antarctica, designed to detect neutrinos, particles, and gravitational waves.
659e26ae-b95c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: IceCube South Pole Neutrino Observatory, Antarctica

65a110da-b943-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Fan Mountain Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Virginia, known for its ground-based telescopes and facilities.
65a110da-b943-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.6m Rapid Response Robotic Telescope at Fan Mountain Observatory, United States

65a3e40c-b85a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Bremen Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Bremen, Germany, dedicated to ground-based astronomical research and observations.
65a3e40c-b85a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bremen Observatory, Germany

65a839ca-b9aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Learmonth Ionosonde, located at the Learmonth Solar Observatory in Western Australia, is an instrument used for radar investigations of the ionosphere. It has been operational since 1994, initially with a Lowell ionosonde and currently with an IPS 5D that sweeps frequencies from 1.0 to 21.5 MHz.
65a839ca-b9aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionosonde at Learmonth Solar Observatory, Australia

65b1e9bc-b6ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CREDANCE instrument is part of the DSX/SET1 mission, designed to measure space radiation and charging environments. It specifically assesses proton flux, ion LET spectra, total ionizing dose, and energetic electron flux at various shielding depths to characterize space weather effects on operational spacecraft.
65b1e9bc-b6ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cosmic Ray Environment Dosimetry and Charging Experiment part of Demonstration and Science Experiments Mission

65b295e0-bae6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Micro Palomar Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Reilhanette, France. It is situated at coordinates 5.4214 longitude and 44.17014 latitude and operates as a ground-based observatory.
65b295e0-bae6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Micro Palomar Observatory, France

65ba64c0-b9f4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The magnetometers at Oulujarvi (OUJ) are scientific instruments used to measure the strength and direction of Earth's magnetic field, operating since January 1, 1993.
65ba64c0-b9f4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Oulujarvi Observatory

65c15386-b6ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Hot Ion Analyzer (HIA) on Double Star 1 is an electrostatic analyzer designed to measure the distribution function of ions in both the magnetosphere and solar wind, providing data every four seconds during each spin period.
65c15386-b6ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electrostatic Analyser on Double Star 1

65dcfa54-b921-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gravina in Puglia Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Via Maurizio Lettieri, Gravina in Puglia, Bari, Apulia, Italy. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
65dcfa54-b921-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gravina in Puglia Observatory, Italy

65e1641e-bad3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity represents the positional data of the DMSP_5D3-F17 spacecraft, providing its coordinates in various reference systems for use in scientific investigations and observatory operations.
65e1641e-bad3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: part of Defense Meteorological Satellite Program 5D-3 Mission

65e53c08-b75c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Leirvogur Geomagnetic Observatory (LRV), located in Mosfellsbær, Iceland, is a ground facility established in 1957 for geophysical observations, primarily focusing on magnetometer data.
65e53c08-b75c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Leirvogur Geophysical Observatory, Iceland

65e70e78-b7d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **EMN Teresina Station** is a ground-based magnetometer network located in Teresina, Brazil, operated by the IUGONET observatory. It is situated at Avenida Poty Velho, Santa Rosa, and provides magnetic field measurements using instruments like fluxgate magnetometers.
65e70e78-b7d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at Teresina Observatory, Brazil

65f2971e-bb3e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU Radio Beacon Receiver (GRBR) station at Chofu is an observatory located in Tokyo, Japan, designed to study ionospheric disturbances and atmospheric coupling processes.
65f2971e-bb3e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU Radio Beacon Receiver Station at Chofu, Japan

66108a0c-b7cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) is a robotic space probe developed by the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA), scheduled to launch in 2026 to collect and return samples from Mars' largest moon, Phobos.
66108a0c-b7cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Martian Moons Exploration part of Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency

661f2f16-b695-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Energetic Particle Detector (EPD) on Solar Orbiter is a suite of sensors designed to measure the spectra, composition, and distribution of energetic particles in space, with the primary goal of studying how solar eruptions produce particle radiation that fills the heliosphere.
661f2f16-b695-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Detector on Solar Orbiter

661fb636-b9cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF) is a wide-field sky astronomical survey conducted using a new camera attached to the Samuel Oschin Telescope at Palomar Observatory in San Diego County, California. It was commissioned in 2018 and supersedes the earlier Palomar Transient Factory.
661fb636-b9cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Samuel Oschin Telescope at Palomar Observatory, United States

66213f4a-bac8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 17 Command and Service Module (CSM) was the sixth and final crewed vehicle to orbit the Moon during NASA's Apollo program. It carried astronaut Ronald E. Evans and provided critical support for the lunar landing mission in December 1972.
66213f4a-bac8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Apollo 17 Command and Service Module

66237e3a-b6b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The High Gain Antenna (HGA) for the Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) was a Spiral Radial Line Slot Array used as the primary antenna on the spacecraft, operating at X-band frequencies to collect and transmit radio science data during the final phase of the mission.
66237e3a-b6b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: High Gain Antenna on Double Asteroid Redirection Test

6627d022-b9be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EMN magnetometer network at the Eusébio station, located in Ceará, Northeast Region of Brazil, is a ground-based facility that measures magnetic field variations for scientific research.
6627d022-b9be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer Network at Eusébio, Brazil

662d21c6-bbc6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Vega 1 Energetic Particles** experiment was a Soviet suite of particle detectors designed to monitor the flux of charged particles in interplanetary space during the Vega 1 mission's cruise and Venus flyby. It specifically measured protons with energies greater than 30 MeV, focusing on the direction 45 degrees sunward.
662d21c6-bbc6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particles on Vega 1

66307ede-b806-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Garden Point site, located at Pirlangimpi on Melville Island (11.4S, 130.5E) in Australia, served as a launch site for radiosondes during the Darwin Area Wave Experiment (DAWEX) from October to December 2001.
66307ede-b806-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radiosonde at Garden Point site, Australia

6634fc66-b81a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hobart Geomagnetic Observatory (HBT), located in Lauderdale, Tasmania, Australia, was an Australian ground facility operational from 1840 to 1854 that specialized in geomagnetic measurements.
6634fc66-b81a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hobert Geomagnetic Observatory, Australia

664a22c8-b9d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "AMPTE/CCE Positions" is a dataset containing the ephemerides (positions) of the AMPTE/CCE spacecraft in various coordinate systems. It provides historical location data for this specific spacecraft, which was part of NASA's Active Magnetospheric Particle Tracer Explorers (AMPTE) mission.
664a22c8-b9d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris part of Active Magnetospheric Particle Tracer Explorers Charge Composition Explorer

664af784-bbce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Medium Energy Particle Analyzer (MEPA)** is a particle telescope on the AMPTE-CCE spacecraft, featuring an ION head for measuring ion energy and a TOF head capable of identifying species and energy.
664af784-bbce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Medium Energy Particle Analyzer on AMPTE-CCE

66583200-b958-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Popov Island Station is a ground-based magnetometer network facility located on Popov Island, Russia, part of the CPMN network that monitors geomagnetic activity.
66583200-b958-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at CPMN Popov Island Station, Russia

665e66f4-b7d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity describes an aerosol observation facility located at Nagoya University in Japan, which uses a photoacoustic spectrometer to measure aerosol optical properties.
665e66f4-b7d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Photoacoustic Spectrometer at Nagoya Observatory, Japan

666f5074-b85f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **SESAME Fabry-Perot Interferometer** is an instrument designed to measure Doppler shifts in oxygen emissions with high resolution, aiding the study of airglow and auroral processes in the thermosphere. It consists of key optical components such as a scanning mirror, etalon, Cassegrain telescope, filter wheel, and imaging photon detector.
666f5074-b85f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fabry-Perot Interferometer part of Satellite Experiments Simultaneous with Antarctic Measurements

666fd746-b996-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The High Energy Electron Detector (HEED) is an instrument aboard the Double Star 2 spacecraft designed to measure the flux of energetic electrons in Earth's magnetosphere. It is part of the CNES Observatory CDPP Archive and provides valuable data for studying high-energy particles within this region.
666fd746-b996-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: High Energy Electron Detector on Double Star 2

66751a64-b822-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Equatorial Magnetometer Network (EMN) includes a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer installed in Koror, Palau, which is part of the IUGONET observatory network. This instrument measures magnetic field variations and contributes to geomagnetic research.
66751a64-b822-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of The Equatorial Magnetometer Network

667f857c-ba74-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **IAGA:KEL Magnetometer** is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, operating from January 1936 to December 1963 at the IAGA observatory in Keles.
667f857c-ba74-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Keles Observatory

668f066a-b6b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Three Buttes Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Saddlebrooke, near Tucson, Arizona. It is a ground-based facility situated at the coordinates 32.642288 latitude and -111.0342 longitude.
668f066a-b6b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Three Buttes Observatory

66935b56-b7e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Mars Pathfinder was a NASA mission that landed on Mars in 1997, consisting of a stationary lander (Carl Sagan Memorial Station) and a small rover (Sojourner). It demonstrated low-cost landings and explored the Martian surface, conducting various scientific experiments.
66935b56-b7e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mars Pathfinder and Sojourner Rover part of Mars Pathfinder Mission

669e77e6-bae9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **THEMIS-D Ephemeris** is an instrument onboard the THEMIS spacecraft that provides data on the status and position of the THEMIS-D probe. It is part of the CDPP/AMDA observatory under CNES.
669e77e6-bae9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ValueSet on THEMIS part of CNES Observatory CDPP AMDA

66a75942-b652-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetospheric Multiscale (MMS) mission, specifically MMS-3, is a NASA project using four spacecraft to study magnetic reconnection in Earth's magnetosphere. It is part of the CNES/Observatory CDPP Archive and focuses on understanding solar-terrestrial interactions within the Heliophysics Division.
66a75942-b652-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetospheric Multiscale part of NASA's Heliophysics Division

66ae09f8-b95a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ehrensberg Observatory Traunstein is an astronomical observatory located in Traunstein, Germany. It was established in 1913 and serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
66ae09f8-b95a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.6m Telescope at Ehrensberg Observatory Traunstein, Germany

66be2e0e-ba69-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The OPERA Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Les Mouriers, Saint-Palais, France. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
66be2e0e-ba69-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: OPERA Observatory at Saint-Palais, France

66be738e-ba3a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity describes a fluxgate magnetometer located in Katanning, part of the 210 Magnetic Meridian (210MM) magnetometer network. It is associated with the IUGONET observatory and specifically monitors magnetic field variations using fluxgate technology.
66be738e-ba3a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of 210 Magnetic Meridian magnetometer network

66beb19c-b7aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Vega Mission Plasma Energy Analyzer, also known as the Retarding Potential Analyser (PLASMAG), was an instrument designed to study the solar wind's interaction with comets. It consisted of five detectors that measured various aspects of plasma and ions during the Vega mission, aiming to understand changes in solar wind parameters near comets and the chemical composition of ions produced by photoionization of cometary neutral particles.
66beb19c-b7aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Retarding Potential Analyser part of Vega Mission

66bf00a4-b93d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Phuthuy geophysical observatory is a ground-based facility located in Hanoi, Vietnam, primarily used for magnetic measurements as part of the INTERMAGNET network. It was established on January 1, 1996.
66bf00a4-b93d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Phuthuy Observatory, Vietnam

66cc2284-b8b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Wisconsin Ultraviolet PhotoPolarimeter Experiment (WUPPE) was an instrument designed to measure ultraviolet light polarization, flown aboard the Space Shuttle missions ASTRO-1 in 1990 and ASTRO-2 in 1995.
66cc2284-b8b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet Wisconsin Ultraviolet PhotoPolarimeter Experiment on Astro-1 and Astro-2

66cd758e-ba56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The New Horizons KBO Search is an astronomical instrument consisting of a telescope located at the Las Campanas Observatory in Vallenar, Chile. It was part of the ground-based observational campaign to support the New Horizons mission, specifically searching for Kuiper Belt Objects using the Magellan/Baade Telescope.
66cd758e-ba56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 6.5m Magellan/Baade Telescope at Las Campanas Observatory, Chile

66cf1ad4-b79e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AGO P4 Ground Observatory is a ground-based facility located on Earth's surface at an altitude of 3597 meters, specifically situated at coordinates -82.01 latitude and 96.76 longitude, part of the ICESTAR observatory network.
66cf1ad4-b79e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: AGO P4 Photometer at ICESTAR Observatory, Antarctica

66cfc336-b5b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Climenhaga Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located at the University of Victoria in Oak Bay, British Columbia, Canada. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
66cfc336-b5b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Climenhaga Observatory at University of Victoria

66d5ccb8-b144-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 12 Lunar Surface Experiments Package (ALSEP) was a suite of scientific instruments deployed on the lunar surface during the Apollo 12 mission to conduct various experiments and collect data, powered by a radioisotope thermoelectric generator.
66d5ccb8-b144-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Apollo 12 Lunar Surface Experiments Package part of Apollo Mission

66e47bc4-b6d4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The M’Bour Magnetic Observatory (MBO), located in Warang, Senegal, is a ground-based magnetic observatory sponsored by France and operated since 1957.
66e47bc4-b6d4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Mbour Magnetic Observatory, Senegal

66ee3b46-b783-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Astronomsko Geofizikalni Observatorij Golovec is a ground-based observatory located in Ljubljana, Slovenia. It is situated at coordinates 46.04378° N, 14.52774° E on the European continent.
66ee3b46-b783-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomsko Geofizikalni Observatorij Golovec, Slovenia

66fb25be-b764-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Wadena station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Lakeview No. 337, Saskatchewan, Canada, part of the MAGDAS magnetometer network, which monitors geomagnetic activity on Earth's surface.
66fb25be-b764-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Wadena Observatory, Canada

66fda302-b6ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Gross Raum is a ground-based observatory facility located in Ryabinovka, Kaliningrad, Russia, specializing in magnetometer measurements as part of the IAGA network since 1935.
66fda302-b6ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Gross Raum Observatory, Russia

66fe14ca-b9b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Kawachi Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Ohtawara, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan.
66fe14ca-b9b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kawachi Observatory, Japan

6703604a-b646-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Color Digital SLR Camera with a fish-eye lens at Longyearbyen, Svalbard, Norway" is an imaging instrument used for the Auroral and Airglow Observation in Svalbard, part of the IUGONET observatory network.
6703604a-b646-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Color Digital SLR Camera part of Auroral and Airglow Observation in Svalbard

6706df32-b9f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "CRRES Spacecraft Position" is an instrument aboard the Combined Release and Radiation Effects Satellite (CRRES) that provides positional data of the spacecraft, aiding in various scientific investigations.
6706df32-b9f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spacecraft Position part of Combined Release and Radiation Effects Satellite

670fe4c0-b900-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Osservatorio Il Coreggiolo is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Via delle Polle, Biassa, La Spezia, Liguria, Italy. It operates at coordinates 44.0949° N latitude and 9.77319° E longitude on the European continent.
670fe4c0-b900-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Osservatorio Il Coreggiolo, Italy

6727d6d6-b8f4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The specific magnetometer referenced here is located at the World Data Center in Kyoto's Tulsa observatory, operational since 1961 as part of the IAGA investigation.
6727d6d6-b8f4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tulsa Observatory

672fcedc-ba51-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EISCAT Kiruna station is a ground-based facility in Sweden that houses the EISCAT UHF receiver antenna and EISCAT_3D demonstrator-array, used for receiving signals transmitted by the Tromsoe radar.
672fcedc-ba51-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: UHF receiver antenna and EISCAT_3D demonstrator-array at EISCAT Kiruna Station, Sweden

6733f238-b96a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ultraviolet Spectrometer (UVS) on board the Voyager 1 spacecraft is a compact spectrometer designed to measure atmospheric properties and radiation of outer planets and their satellites by recording spectral data within its wavelength range.
6733f238-b96a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet Spectrometer on Voyager 1

6738ae20-bb79-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Fanning Geomagnetic Observatory** (FAN) was a ground-based facility located on Fanning Island in Kiribati, operational from 1957 to 1958, sponsored by the United Kingdom and equipped with magnetometers for geomagnetic measurements.
6738ae20-bb79-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Fanning Geomagnetic Observatory, Kiribati

6739f740-b78b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kempshott Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Kempshott, Basingstoke and Deane, Hampshire, England. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
6739f740-b78b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kempshott Observatory, United Kingdom

673e4642-bace-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The PENGUIn-2 (PG2) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility located on Earth's surface at an altitude of 3445 meters, focusing on geophysical observations. It is situated at the coordinates -84.4 latitude and 58.0 longitude.
673e4642-bace-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at PENGUIn-2 Geophysical Observatory, Antarctica

674093cc-bad6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: PISCES is a wide-field near-infrared camera designed for use with several telescopes, including the MMT 6.5-meter, offering high-resolution imaging capabilities and versatile field of view options depending on the telescope it's paired with.
674093cc-bad6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Wide-Field Camera on Multiple Mirror Telescope

67428d92-b821-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Neutral Atmosphere Temperature Experiment (NATE)** on the AE-C satellite measured the kinetic temperature and density of molecular nitrogen in the neutral atmosphere using a spherical chamber with an orifice, providing insights into atmospheric composition and wind movements.
67428d92-b821-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutral Atmosphere Temperature part of AE-C

6743c872-b990-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Falkensee Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Falkensee, Germany. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
6743c872-b990-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Falkensee Observatory, Germany

674c0cf2-b7e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Transit Dreams Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Gramling, Campobello, South Carolina. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to studying celestial phenomena and transit events.
674c0cf2-b7e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Transit Dreams Observatory at Campobello, United States

674ec0b8-b17c-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU Radio Beacon Receiver (GRBR) is a digital receiver installed in Miyagi Prefecture, Japan, designed to measure ionospheric total electron content by capturing LEO satellite signals using open-source software and hardware.
674ec0b8-b17c-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU Radio Beacon Receiver at Tohoku Sendai Observatory, Japan

6753a13c-b9a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The VLT Imager and Spectrometer for mid-Infrared (VISIR) is an instrument developed by CEA/DAPNIA/SAP and NFRA/ASTRON, located at the Cassegrain focus of UT3 (Melipal). It provides high sensitivity, diffraction-limited imaging in three mid-infrared atmospheric windows: M-band (5µm), N-band (8-13µm), and Q band (17-20µm), along with a long-slit spectrometer offering spectral resolutions from 150 to 30,000.
6753a13c-b9a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mid-infrared VLT Imager and Spectrometer on 8.2m UT3 Melipal Telescope at Paranal Observatory

675629ba-b6a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DSS-35 is a ground-based observatory facility known for its telescopic observations and scientific research.
675629ba-b6a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: DSS-35 Observatory

67594062-b7ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Space Environment Monitor (SEM)** on GOES 10 is an instrument subsystem that measures the impact of solar activity on Earth's electromagnetic environment in real-time. It consists of four instruments: the Energetic Particle Sensor, High Energy Proton and Alpha Detector, Solar X-Ray Sensor, and Magnetic Field Sensor, providing critical data for space weather reports.
67594062-b7ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Space Environment Monitor on GOES 10

675c848a-b999-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ISEE 2 Fast Plasma Experiment** was an investigation on the International Sun-Earth Explorer (ISEE) mission designed to measure plasma velocity distributions and their variations in various regions of space using electrostatic analyzers. It studied positive ions and electrons with high energy resolution, complementing similar instrumentation on the ISEE mother spacecraft.
675c848a-b999-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fast Plasma Experiment and Solar Wind Experiment on International Sun-Earth Explorer 2

677920d2-b83f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The one mentioned here has been operational since 1932 and is located at the Tamanrasset observatory, part of the IAGA network.
677920d2-b83f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at WDC Kyoto Observatory

6782b866-b751-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Paus Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Sabadell, Spain. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical research and observations.
6782b866-b751-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Observatory at Paus Observatory, Spain

67bfbf3e-b654-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Phobos2 Spacecraft Ephemeris** is a virtual instrument that provides position data for the Phobos 2 spacecraft. It is part of the CDPP-AMDA observatory under CNES and offers ephemeris information essential for tracking and studying the spacecraft's trajectory.
67bfbf3e-b654-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Phobos2 Positions part of Phobos2 Spacecraft

67c3fcf8-bad1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: El Sauce Observatory is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Río Hurtado, Provincia de Limarí, Coquimbo Region, Chile. It serves as the ShAO Chile station and is situated at approximately -30.47011 latitude and 289.235 longitude.
67c3fcf8-bad1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ShAO Chile Station at El Sauce Observatory, Chile

67d22a70-b8a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Iznik and part of the IAGA investigation, operational since January 1, 2005, used for measuring magnetic fields.
67d22a70-b8a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iznik Observatory

67d7ecca-b966-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The RISH Radiosonde and Rawinsonde system at Serpong, Indonesia, is a balloon-based atmospheric sounding instrument that measures vertical profiles of pressure, temperature, humidity, and wind in the lower atmosphere using Vaisala radiosondes and TOTEX balloons.
67d7ecca-b966-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Vaisala Radiosonde RS80 and Vaisala Radiosonde RS92 on RISH Radiosonde and Rawinsonde part of Serpong Observatory

67d82274-b611-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Omaha Observatory (V72)**: A ground-based astronomical observatory located in Omaha, Nebraska, United States. It is identified by the Minor Planet Center with the code V72 and is situated at coordinates 41.274124 (latitude), -96.10989 (-263.89011 longitude).
67d82274-b611-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Omaha Observatory, United States

67e1d946-b5c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Electrostatic Analyser on the ISEE 2 spacecraft was designed to measure electron and proton fluxes in the outer magnetosphere, using identical instrumentation on mother/daughter spacecraft to study particle phenomena's spatial extent, propagation velocity, and temporal behavior.
67e1d946-b5c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electrostatic Analyser part of International Sun Earth Explorer

67ee08d0-bb27-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: NOAA-I (NOAA-13) is a polar orbiting meteorological satellite in the Advanced TIROS-N series operated by NOAA's National Environmental Satellite Service, launched to enhance weather prediction and environmental monitoring but lost communications shortly after launch.
67ee08d0-bb27-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Space Environment Monitor on Advanced TIROS-N

67ee7b6c-b6b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nerchinsk Magnetometer was an instrument used for measuring magnetic fields at the IAGA-identified station in Nerchinsk from 1841 to 1864.
67ee7b6c-b6b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Nerchinsk Observatory

67f89ec6-ba6e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences (NAOC) 1.26m Telescope is an infrared telescope located at the Xinglong Station of the Beijing Astronomical Observatory in Asia.
67f89ec6-ba6e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.26m infrared National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences Telescope at Beijing Astronomical Observatory

67faf8ac-b766-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) All-sky imager at Sata, Japan is a multi-wavelength instrument designed to study the dynamics of the upper atmosphere by observing nocturnal airglow emissions. It was developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research at Nagoya University and is part of the IUGONET Observatory network.
67faf8ac-b766-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Multi-wavelength All-sky Imager part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers

67fb8340-bc15-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Giotto Radio Science Experiment (GRE) was an investigation on the Giotto spacecraft that utilized its telecommunications system and ground-based antennas to study comet 1P/Halley. It primarily involved transmitting and receiving radio signals in S-band and C-band frequencies.
67fb8340-bc15-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Science Experiment on Giotto spacecraft

680926aa-b768-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Washburn Observatory** (obs. code: 753) is an astronomical observatory located on the University of Wisconsin–Madison campus in Madison, Wisconsin, known for its historical significance and ongoing educational use. Completed in 1881, it houses a 15.6-inch Clark refractor telescope and remains active for student courses and public viewings.
680926aa-b768-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Washburn Observatory, United States

680b7d48-b62c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: L32 is an astronomical observatory known as the Korea Microlensing Telescope Network-SAAO (KMTNet-SAAO), located at Sutherland Observatory in South Africa.
680b7d48-b62c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.6m Korea Microlensing Telescope Network at Sutherland Observatory, South Africa

680b9136-b7b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Daocheng's Xingyuan Observatory is a ground-based observatory located in Zilong, Daocheng County, Kardze, Sichuan, China. It is situated at coordinates 29.01306° N and 100.22861° E on the Asian continent.
680b9136-b7b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Daocheng Observatory, China

680f45d4-b8c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Netherlands Institute for Radio Astronomy (ASTRON) Low-Frequency Array (LOFAR) is a radio telescope located in Europe, specifically in the Netherlands. It operates primarily in the low-frequency radio waveband and is used for advanced astronomical research.
680f45d4-b8c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Low-Frequency Array radio Netherlands Institute for Radio Astronomy

680f71ae-b8c1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer at PTN is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed in Pontianak, Indonesia, designed to measure magnetic field variations as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
680f71ae-b8c1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

6819bd64-b6c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Midcourse Space Experiment (MSX)** was a satellite mission launched in 1996 by the Ballistic Missile Defense Organization to gather data over a wide-wavelength interval for identifying and tracking ballistic missiles during their midcourse flight phase, also contributing to civilian aeronomic and auroral studies.
6819bd64-b6c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: infrared Spirit III on Midcourse Space Experiment

681b3086-b973-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Choakanan Observatory** in Lampang is a ground-based astronomical facility located at Bo Haeo, Mueang Lampang District, Thailand. It is situated at latitude 18.33697 and longitude 99.46556 on the Asian continent.
681b3086-b973-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: National Astronomical Research Institute of Thailand, Choakanan Observatory, Lampang, Thailand

681e8d9a-b84b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Muntinlupa Geomagnetic Observatory (MUT) was a ground-based facility in the Philippines dedicated to geophysical observations, primarily using magnetometers, from 1957 to 1972.
681e8d9a-b84b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Muntinlupa Geomagnetic Observatory, Philippines

68200fca-b720-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **CARISMA Magnetometer at Dawson** is an instrument located at the Dawson Canadian ground station, designed to measure and monitor magnetic field variations as part of the CARISMA (Canadian Array for Realtime Investigations of Magnetic Activity) network.
68200fca-b720-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Dawson Observatory

682ac052-b845-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Toronto Magnetometer is an instrument used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field, operational at the IAGA observatory in Toronto from January 1, 1840 to December 31, 1898.
682ac052-b845-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Toronto Observatory

682dd1b4-b6cb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to magnetometers located at the station identified by IAGA code TST, part of the WDC Kyoto observatory network. These instruments are used for magnetic field measurements and were previously known as the IAGA:TST Magnetometer or Magnetometers at Tungsten.
682dd1b4-b6cb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at Tungsten

683a3558-b86a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: La Sagrada is a ground-based observatory located in Puebla de Don Fadrique, Granada, Spain, known as the OAM Observatory.
683a3558-b86a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: OAM Observatory, La Sagra, Spain

683afe02-b9a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ISEE-1 Plasma Wave Experiment** was an instrument on the International Sun-Earth Explorer (ISEE) 1 satellite designed to measure and analyze wave phenomena within the magnetosphere and solar wind using electric dipole antennas and a triaxial search-coil antenna.
683afe02-b9a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Plasma Wave Experiment on International Sun-Earth Explorer 1

68404708-b7b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Hayabusa2**: Hayabusa2 is a Japanese Space Agency (JAXA) mission designed to rendezvous with asteroid 162173 Ryugu, collect samples from its surface, and return them to Earth for analysis. The mission launched on December 3, 2014, and successfully returned samples on December 5, 2020.
68404708-b7b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Spectrometer on Hayabusa2

68482888-b7cb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer instrument located at the Kharasavey Observatory in Kyoto, operational from January 1974 to December 31, 1980, used for measuring magnetic field variations as part of the IAGA investigation.
68482888-b7cb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at Kharasavey Observatory

684d653a-b930-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CLPS Task Order 19D Regolith Adherence Characterization (RAC) Wheel B Top side is an instrument designed to photograph sample materials exposed to the Lunar environment, specifically covering the top side of Wheel B in the RAC experiment.
684d653a-b930-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Regolith Adherence Characterization on CLPS Task Order 19D

68590c90-b7e7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tsumeb Magnetic Observatory was a ground-based facility in Namibia that operated from 1964 to 2016, focusing on magnetic observations as part of the global geophysical research network.
68590c90-b7e7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tsumeb Magnetic Observatory, Namibia

685c7506-b6cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 1T Engineering Data Interface is an instrument that performs analog to digital conversion of temperatures, voltages, and currents for the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) mission. It includes various inputs for voltage, current, and temperature monitoring with 16-bit precision.
685c7506-b6cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

685e4520-b8af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Next-Generation Transit Survey (NGTS) at the ESO Paranal Observatory is an optical survey located in South America designed to detect transiting exoplanets around bright stars.
685e4520-b8af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Next-Generation Transit Survey optical at European Southern Observatory Paranal Observatory

68601218-b762-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solar Ultraviolet Measurement of Emitted Radiation (SUMER) is a high-resolution far UV spectrometer on the SOHO spacecraft, designed to measure solar radiation in the 50--160 nm range with precise angular and spectral resolution to study plasma parameters and solar dynamics.
68601218-b762-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Far UV Solar Ultraviolet Measurement of Emitted Radiation part of SOHO

686a6de8-b691-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** INTERMAGNET is a global network of digital magnetic observatories established to standardize and modernize geomagnetic data measurement and recording, facilitating real-time data exchange and product generation.
686a6de8-b691-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at INTERMAGNET

68725b02-b93e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition**:
The "DMSP_5D2-F12 Positions" entity refers to the recorded locations of the DMSP_5D2-F12 spacecraft in different coordinate systems, essential for understanding its orbital trajectory and mission data.
68725b02-b93e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris on DMSP 5D-2 F12 Spacecraft

687dcafa-b713-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Slutsk Observatory was a ground-based facility in Russia that operated from 1878 to 1944, primarily focused on magnetometer observations.
687dcafa-b713-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Slutsk Observatory, Russia

687e9000-b6e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Cassini RPWS-HFR (Radio and Plasma Wave Science - High Frequency Receiver) is a dual-channel radio receiver designed to cover the 3.5 kHz to 16.125 MHz frequency band, capable of providing goniopolarimetric measurements to determine the direction, polarization, and flux of observed radio waves.

687f838a-b7fa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Radio Science Instrument (RSI) for MAVEN:** A device onboard the MAVEN spacecraft designed to investigate Mars' ionosphere by analyzing radio signal interactions, providing data on electron densities and atmospheric dynamics to understand Mars’ atmosphere and climate history.

688000c0-bb98-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Tour de la Babotte** is an astronomical observatory located in Montpellier, France, known for its historical significance and contributions to ground-based astronomy.
688000c0-bb98-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tour de la Babotte Observatory at Montpellier, France

6880a93a-b729-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** NSFCAM is an infrared array camera designed to capture images in the wavelength range of 1.0-5.5 microns, utilizing a Santa Barbara Research Center 256x256 InSb array.
6880a93a-b729-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3m2 NASA Infrared Telescope Facility at Maunakea Observatory

688987e8-bbd0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **UHF Radio Telescope at Toyokawa, Japan** is a specialized instrument used for Interplanetary Scintillation (IPS) measurements, part of the ISEE-IPS observatory network located in Toyokawa.
688987e8-bbd0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: UHF Radio Telescope for Interplanetary Scintillation (IPS) measurements at Toyokawa Observatory, Japan

688e2b58-b86b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Cyclops Observatory**: An astronomical ground observatory located in Oostkapelle, Netherlands, dedicated to studying the night sky.
688e2b58-b86b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Oostkapelle Observatory, Netherlands

68aa8b10-b6e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Srednikan Geomagnetic Observatory** is a ground-based facility located in Ust-Srednekan, Russia, primarily focused on geomagnetic measurements.

68c695d8-b65e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: EFOSC2 (ESO Faint Object Spectrograph and Camera 2) is a versatile astronomical instrument installed on the New Technology Telescope at La Silla Observatory, designed for imaging and spectroscopy in the wavelength range of 305nm to 1100nm with a field of view of 4.1'x4.1'.

68e3ae70-b848-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Arcadia Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Sydney, Australia. It is situated at Geelans Road, Arcadia, and has the MPC ID E23.
68e3ae70-b848-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Arcadia Observatory, Australia

68e6ddd4-b807-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **PENGUIn-1 (PG1) Geophysical Observatory** is a ground-based facility located at an altitude of 3,342 meters on Earth's surface, established on January 9, 2008. 68fdea3e-b7ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Punta Arenas (PUC) Geomagnetic Observatory** is a ground-based facility located in Departamento Collón Curá, Neuquén Province, Argentina, dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity on Earth's surface.
68fdea3e-b7ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geomagnetic Observatory at Punta Arenas, Argentina

690a8042-bc51-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tasiusak Magnetometer is a ground-based instrument used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field at the IAGA station identified as TSK in Greenland. It has been operational since January 1st, 1899 and contributes to global geomagnetic research under the IAGA investigation.
690a8042-bc51-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IAGA Tasiusak Observatory

690dece0-bc84-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Astrophysical Observatory of the College of Staten Island (MPC ID 294) is an astronomical observatory located at the College of Staten Island in New York. It functions as a ground-based facility for observing celestial phenomena.
690dece0-bc84-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astrophysical Observatory at College of Staten Island, United States

69169712-b8c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Charge and Mass Magnetospheric Ion Composition Experiment (CAMMICE)** on Polar is an instrument that measures ion charge state, mass, and incident energy between ~1keV/e to 420keV/e. It uses an ogive-shaped electrostatic analyzer and other components to determine the composition and energy of magnetospheric ions with high spatial and temporal resolution.
69169712-b8c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Charge and Mass Magnetospheric Ion Composition Experiment part of Polar

691908fc-bb92-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields. 691908fc-bb92-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Nantes Observatory

692f3a2a-b7e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2m Himalayan Chandra Telescope at Indian Astronomical Observatory, India

69368a9c-b7de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lulin Widefield Telescope at Mount Lulin Observatory

6977d6f6-bb43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 4m Nicholas U. Mayall Telescope at Kitt Peak National Observatory, United States

69ab8f18-ba54-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: iTelescope SRO Observatory at Auberry
