69b729da-b8cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IAGA Observatory in Bouzareah was a ground-based facility located in Algiers, Algeria, operating from January 1, 1888, to December 31, 1950, primarily for geomagnetic measurements.
69b729da-b8cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Bouzareah Observatory

69be86a2-b84e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EMCCD Kevo Station in Utsjoki, Finland, is a ground-based facility developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research (ISEE), Nagoya University, to study upper atmospheric dynamics via nocturnal airglow emissions. It collaborates with the Finnish Meteorological Institute and features an EMCCD instrument specifically designed for this research purpose.
69be86a2-b84e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: [waveband unknown] Electron Multiplying Charge Coupled Device Station at Kevo, Finland

69bece06-b631-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Exploration Rover 1 (MER-1), also known as Opportunity, was one of two identical rovers sent by NASA to explore the surface of Mars. Launched in 2003, it landed in Meridiani Planum and conducted extensive scientific investigations using its suite of instruments designed for geological and environmental studies.
69bece06-b631-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Athena Science Payload part of Mars Exploration Rover

69cc30a6-bb08-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 210MM Magadan station is a ground-based magnetic observatory located in the Khasynsky Urban District, Magadan Oblast, Russia, which is part of the ISEE magnetometer network and equipped with a fluxgate instrument for monitoring geomagnetic activity.
69cc30a6-bb08-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Magadan Observatory, Russia

69d51f5e-b739-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The UJA Observatory is an astronomical observatory located at the Universidad de Jaén in Andalusia, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical research and observations.
69d51f5e-b739-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: UJA Observatory, Spain

69d9a6e8-bbb0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The **Tros Alt Observatory** is a ground-based astronomical facility located at Carretera Torrent a Montserrat, Torrent, l'Horta Sud, Valencia, Spain. It is situated at coordinates 39.40089° N and -0.53383° E (359.46617° W).
69d9a6e8-bbb0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tros Alt Observatory, Spain

69dac9e2-b985-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A Magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The MAGDAS observation network uses 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometers, including one installed at Crib Point, Australia (MLB), to monitor geomagnetic activity.
69dac9e2-b985-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of MAGDAS observation network

69f13c3a-b995-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Johnson Point Geomagnetic Observatory (JOP)** is a ground-based facility located in the Inuvialuit Settlement Region of Northwest Territories, Canada. It is sponsored by the U.S.A. and operates as part of the global network of geomagnetic observatories, specifically under the World Data Centre for Geomagnetism at Kyoto.
69f13c3a-b995-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Johnson Point Geomagnetic Observatory

69fd9f86-b623-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Relativistic Proton Spectrometer (RPS)** is an instrument on the Radiation Belt Storm Probe mission designed to measure inner Van Allen belt protons with energies from 50 MeV to 2 GeV, aiming to improve understanding and modeling of space radiation hazards for astronauts and spacecraft.
69fd9f86-b623-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: EnergeticParticleInstrument part of Radiation Belt Storm Probe

6a04bd22-ba77-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL) Magnetometer Station, situated in Fenton Hill, New Mexico, USA, is a ground facility dedicated to measuring and monitoring the Earth's magnetic field.
6a04bd22-ba77-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Los Alamos National Laboratory, United States

6a0d107a-b870-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA-identified station Dome Concordia, used for measuring and recording variations in Earth's magnetic field since 2004.
6a0d107a-b870-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Dome Concordia Observatory, Antarctica

6a0deba0-b760-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Fort Rae 2 geophysical observatory was a ground-based facility located in the North Slave Region of the Northwest Territories, Canada, which operated from January 1, 1964, to December 31, 1996.
6a0deba0-b760-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Fort Rae 2 Observatory, Canada

6a1301aa-ba42-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The California Institute of Technology Cosmic Infrared Background Experiment (CIBER) is a sounding rocket designed to study the cosmic infrared background radiation. It operates primarily within the infrared waveband.
6a1301aa-ba42-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: infrared California Institute of Technology Cosmic Infrared Background Experiment on Sounding Rocket

6a14ae3c-b61f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Astronomical Observatory University of Siena, located in Polo San Niccolò - Sezione di Fisica, Via di Porta Giustizia, Contrada di Valdimontone, Valli, Siena, Tuscany, Italy, is a ground-based observatory dedicated to astronomical research and education.
6a14ae3c-b61f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Observatory of the University of Siena, Italy

6a14be6c-b8f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Calar Alto-CASADO Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Gérgal, Almeria, Spain. It operates as a ground-based observatory and is part of the Centro Astronómico Hispano en Andalucía.
6a14be6c-b8f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Calar Alto-CASADO Observatory, Spain

6a22bf06-bab9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity describes the **Ionospheric Station at Port Stanley**, located in the Falkland Islands (Malvinas), South America. This ground-based facility, known by its URSI code PSJ5J, uses a Digisonde to study ionospheric reflections through advanced measurements including angle of arrival, polarization, and Doppler frequency shift.
6a22bf06-bab9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digisonde at Ionospheric Station at Port Stanley, Falkland Islands (Malvinas)

6a2eb5e8-bc46-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MMS 4 Hot Plasma Composition Analyzer (HPCA) is a particle detector onboard the Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission (MMS) designed to measure ion fluxes in space, featuring advanced technologies for high dynamic range and mass resolution.
6a2eb5e8-bc46-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hot Plasma Composition Analyzer part of Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission

6a3e4556-b96e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The "ROCSAT-1 Positions" dataset provides the spatial coordinates of the ROCSAT-1 spacecraft, detailing its position in different reference frames for various scientific and operational purposes.
6a3e4556-b96e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris on ROCSAT-1 Spacecraft

6a41afd6-bb88-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The California Institute of Technology 10.4m Caltech Submillimeter Observatory (CSO) is a telescope located at the Mauna Kea Observatory in North America, designed for millimeter waveband observations with an aperture of 10.4 meters.
6a41afd6-bb88-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Millimeter California Institute of Technology 10.4m Caltech Submillimeter Telescope at Mauna Kea Observatory

6a431b9c-ba06-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The UCLA MHD and iPic3D model is a hybrid simulation technique that combines particle-in-cell (PiC) simulations with global magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) simulations to study space plasma phenomena.
6a431b9c-ba06-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetohydrodynamics Simulation Technique and Particle-in-Cell Simulation part of Space Plasma Simulation Group

6a514aee-b634-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Extreme Ultraviolet Imager (EUI) is a suite of three instruments onboard the Solar Orbiter spacecraft designed to observe the Sun's photosphere, chromosphere, and corona in high-resolution at extreme ultraviolet wavelengths. Its primary goal is to study the link between the solar surface and outer corona, including the origins of solar wind streams and the evolution of coronal mass ejections.
6a514aee-b634-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Extreme Ultraviolet Imager on Solar Orbiter

6a571ea8-b7ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Max-Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics (MPE) eROSITA is an X-ray telescope aboard the Russian-German "Spectrum-Roentgen-Gamma" (SRG) space mission, designed to conduct extensive surveys of the universe in the X-ray waveband.
6a571ea8-b7ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: x-ray Max-Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics eROSITA X-ray Telescope on Spectrum-Roentgen-Gamma Mission

6a583fa0-b663-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Los Campitos Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Cañuelas, Buenos Aires, Argentina.
6a583fa0-b663-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Los Campitos Observatory, Argentina

6a5cb474-b7a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Campbell Island Geomagnetic Observatory (CAI) is a ground-based facility located on Campbell Island, New Zealand, dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
6a5cb474-b7a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Campbell Island Geomagnetic Observatory, New Zealand

6a5ce02c-bb64-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Stowupland Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Mid Suffolk, England. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to the observation and study of celestial phenomena.
6a5ce02c-bb64-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stowupland Observatory, United Kingdom

6a796c76-bb7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Helios 1**: A solar probe launched in 1974 as part of a cooperative program between NASA and the Federal Republic of Germany (FRG) to study the interplanetary medium from Earth's orbit to 0.3 AU.
6a796c76-bb7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer and Electric and Magnetic Wave Experiment on Helios 1

6a87fb92-b8e7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Osservatorio Astronomico di Remanzacco is an astronomical observatory located in Remanzacco, Italy. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
6a87fb92-b8e7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Osservatorio astronomico di Remanzacco Observatory, Italy

6a9098fc-b9ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The **Xingming Observatory-KATS**, also known as **Nanshan Observatory**, is an astronomical observatory located in Ürümqi County, Xinjiang, China. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
6a9098fc-b9ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Xingming Observatory, China

6a972788-ba32-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Langmuir Probe Instrument on CRRES is a scientific tool designed to measure electron temperature and density, as well as electric fields in the magnetosphere, using spherical sensors and cylindrical antennas for studying wave-particle interactions.
6a972788-ba32-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Langmuir Probe Instrument on CRRES

6aa329ec-bad8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **Spacecraft** is a vehicle designed for travel and operation in the vacuum of space, often used for scientific research, communications, or transportation beyond Earth's atmosphere. This includes various types of craft such as satellites, probes, and manned vehicles.
6aa329ec-bad8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: James Webb Space Telescope

6aa3a2ee-b8c8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The VLT Kueyen (UT2) is one of the four 8.2-meter telescopes that make up the Very Large Telescope array at the European Southern Observatory's Paranal Observatory in Chile. It operates in the optical waveband and uses an alt-azimuth mount for sky coverage.
6aa3a2ee-b8c8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 8.2m Unit Telescope 2 Kueyen part of Very Large Telescope at Paranal Observatory, Chile

6aa4373c-ba7f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Pevek Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG starting from 2011.
6aa4373c-ba7f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Pevek Observatory

6abf4e90-b6a7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Beryl Junction is a ground-based observatory located in Iron County, Utah, United States. Also known as the Skygems Dreamscope Utah, it operates under the address of 3045 North 2400 West and is situated at coordinates approximately 37.76281 latitude and -113.71239 longitude.
6abf4e90-b6a7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Skygems Dreamscope Utah Observatory at Beryl Junction, United States

6ac22802-b677-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
DCAM3-A is an analog imaging system onboard the DCAM3 spacecraft, designed for continuous monitoring of impact events.
6ac22802-b677-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: DCAM3 Analog on DCAM3

6ac63386-bb34-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cassini Orbiter Radio Science Subsystem (RSS) is an instrument that conducted radio science experiments on the Cassini spacecraft, operating in both one-way and two-way measurement modes to study various aspects of Saturn's environment and gravity.
6ac63386-bb34-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Science Subsystem on Cassini Orbiter

6acd2ac0-bac0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences 1m Swedish Solar Telescope (SST) is an optical telescope located at the Roque de los Muchachos Observatory in Africa, primarily used for observing solar phenomena.
6acd2ac0-bac0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.0m optical Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences Swedish Solar Telescope at Roque de los Muchachos Observatory

6ace5e10-b6c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Krasnodar Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in the Republic of Adygea, Russia. It operates as a ground-based facility and is situated at 17 Tsentralnaya Street in Энемское городское поселение.
6ace5e10-b6c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Krasnodar Observatory

6ad25ec8-b6ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Argentine National Observatory, also known as the Astronomical Observatory of Córdoba, is an astronomical observatory located in Córdoba, Argentina, founded in 1871 by President Domingo F. Sarmiento and astronomer Benjamin Apthorp Gould.
6ad25ec8-b6ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Observatory of Córdoba

6ad4e760-b6d8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Linares Geophysical Observatory, located in Nuevo León, Mexico, is a ground-based facility primarily known for its magnetometer instrument used to monitor geophysical phenomena. It has been operational since January 1, 2007 and is part of the McMac observatory network.
6ad4e760-b6d8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Linares Geophysical Observatory, Mexico

6ad66470-b60e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The European Space Agency (ESA) Gaia Satellite Mission is an astronomical observatory spacecraft designed to create the largest and most precise 3D map of our Milky Way galaxy, operating primarily in the optical waveband.
6ad66470-b60e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Gaia part of European Space Agency Gaia Satellite Mission

6ad8b12c-ba1d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Instituto de Astrofisica de Andalucia (IAA-CSIC) 1.5m Telescope is located at the Observatorio de Sierra Nevada in Europe and operates within the optical waveband for astronomical observations.
6ad8b12c-ba1d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.5m Telescope at Observatorio de Sierra Nevada

6ad9a758-b6e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The St. Helier Magnetometer was a ground-based instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field at the IAGA observatory in St. Helier from 1898 to 1907.
6ad9a758-b6e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at St. Helier Observatory

6adc9120-b6ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Long Wavelength Array (LWA) is a radio telescope located in North America on the plains of San Agustin. It operates primarily in the low-frequency radio waveband and is designed to observe astronomical phenomena at long wavelengths.
6adc9120-b6ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Long Wavelength Array Telescope

6ade522e-b786-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: An astronomical observatory located in Essen, Germany. It is situated at Wallneyer Straße and operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
6ade522e-b786-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Essen Observatory, Germany

6adebee0-badc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The BARREL Balloon 1S Optical Photometer is an instrument designed to detect visible light at wavelengths near 486.1 nm, specifically during relativistic electron precipitation events, to determine the presence of accompanying protons and study their correlation with electromagnetic ion cyclotron waves.
6adebee0-badc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Photometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

6ae86efc-bacf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Easter Island observatory, operational from 1959 to 1968, used for magnetic field measurements as part of the IAGA investigation.
6ae86efc-bacf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Easter Island Observatory

6afd1aee-baea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Oakwood Observatory (MPC ID: 749) is an astronomical observatory located in Alandale, Hall County, Georgia, United States. It operates as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
6afd1aee-baea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Oakwood Observatory

6b05d718-bb5a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 2A Data Processing Unit (DPU) is an instrument controller board designed for the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) mission. It collects data from various sensors, formats it for transmission via an Iridium modem, and controls critical systems using a flexible Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA).
6b05d718-bb5a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Data Processing Unit part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

6b0a40a4-b796-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Rover Environmental Monitoring Station (REMS) is the primary meteorological instrument on the Mars Science Laboratory Curiosity rover, designed to record atmospheric parameters such as wind speed, pressure, humidity, temperature, and ultraviolet radiation.
6b0a40a4-b796-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rover Environmental Monitoring Station on Mars Science Laboratory Curiosity Rover

6b0e424e-b8a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ondřejov Observatory is an astronomical facility in the Czech Republic, notable for housing a 0.65m telescope operated by the Astronomical Institute of the Academy of Sciences of the Czech Republic.
6b0e424e-b8a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.65m Telescope at Ondrejov Observatory

6b1e3a24-b957-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Rattle Snake Observatory (code: V86) is an astronomical observatory located in Sedalia, Missouri, United States, known for its ground-based observations.
6b1e3a24-b957-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sedalia Observatory, United States

6b1fbfb4-b5e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Stixendorf Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Katastralgemeinde Stixendorf, Lower Austria, dedicated to ground-based observations.
6b1fbfb4-b5e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stixendorf Observatory, Austria

6b2c0ff8-ba03-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Tree Gate Farm Observatory** is a ground-based astronomical observatory located on Robinson Road in Oktibbeha County, Mississippi. It serves as a facility for sky observations and research in the state of Mississippi.
6b2c0ff8-ba03-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tree Gate Farm Observatory at Starkville

6b2f65fa-b18d-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ISEE Magnetometer station at Moshiri, Japan is a ground-based facility located on the Earth's surface, dedicated to measuring magnetic fields and induction phenomena. It operates under the IUGONET network and is situated in Hokkaido Prefecture, Japan.
6b2f65fa-b18d-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Moshiri Observatory, Japan

6b36214e-b7da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Arcturus Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Manchester Township, New Jersey, United States (Q115536720). It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
6b36214e-b7da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Arcturus Observatory, United States

6b38c134-b7b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Sparky's Stars in Masseris is a ground-based astronomical observatory located at Strada Turistica di Montemaggiore in Savogna, Udine, Italy. It serves as a facility for stargazing and astronomical research in the region of Friuli – Venezia Giulia.
6b38c134-b7b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sparky's Stars Observatory, Italy

6b3b4896-b5fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lunar Prospector Spacecraft Magnetometer (MAG) was an instrument designed to measure magnetic fields on the Moon. It featured a high-sensitivity, triaxial fluxgate magnetometer and shared electronics with the Electron Reflectometer, contributing to studies of lunar crustal magnetic fields and the potential metallic core.
6b3b4896-b5fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Lunar Prospector

6b434906-bb0d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Pozuelo Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to studying celestial bodies and phenomena.
6b434906-bb0d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Pozuelo Observatory, Spain

6b5b5dac-b70c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL (Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2P Ephemeris** is a virtual instrument that provides trajectory positions of the BARREL balloons in various coordinate systems, supporting studies on relativistic electron losses as part of NASA's Radiation Belt Storm Probes (RBSP) mission.
6b5b5dac-b70c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

6b602cb4-b7f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Parc St Maur geophysical observatory is a ground-based facility located in Saint-Maur-des-Fossés, France. It includes a magnetometer and has been operational since 1883.
6b602cb4-b7f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Parc Saint Maur Observatory, France

6b68ccae-b9a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Rancho Hidalgo is an astronomical observatory located in Earth. It is situated at 36, County Road C079, Hidalgo County, New Mexico, United States, with coordinates of approximately -108.89852 longitude and 31.94692 latitude. The observatory is also known as Harlingten Research Observatory.
6b68ccae-b9a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Harlingten Research Observatory, United States

6b73fb88-b90e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The International Sun-Earth Explorer-2 (ISEE-2) was a spacecraft designed to study magnetic fields near Earth and investigate solar-terrestrial relationships as part of the ISEE mission.
6b73fb88-b90e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: International Sun-Earth Explorer-2 part of International Sun-Earth Explorers Mission

6b963830-b628-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Nira Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Tías on the island of Lanzarote, Canary Islands, Spain. It is a ground-based facility used for stargazing and astronomical research.
6b963830-b628-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Nira Observatory, Spain

6b982cd2-b6fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nippon-Tromsoe Meteor Radar (NTMR) is an instrument located in Tromsø, Norway, designed to measure the height profile of horizontal winds in the mesosphere and lower thermosphere. It operates as part of the IUGONET observatory network, focusing on atmospheric dynamics using radar technology.
6b982cd2-b6fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Meteor radar part of Nippon-Tromsoe Meteor Radar observation in Tromsoe, Norway

6ba21290-b66e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ISEE Magnetometer Kevo Station** is a ground-based observatory located in Kevo, Finland, dedicated to monitoring and studying magnetic field variations. It operates under the IUGONET network, focusing on geomagnetic research and data collection.
6ba21290-b66e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Induction Magnetometer at Kevo Observatory, Finland

6ba3ead6-b987-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Vega del Thader Observatory is an astronomical facility located in El Palmar, Murcia, Spain, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial bodies and phenomena.

6ba7d968-b7a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mirasteilas Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Falera, Switzerland. It features a 90-centimeter telescope and is the largest publicly accessible observatory in the country.
