6badafc2-b8d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Airali Observatory, Italy

6bb1f518-bb58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Genova Geomagnetic Observatory (GEN), located in Mignanego, Italy, was a ground-based facility operating from 1958 to 1962, focused on geomagnetic measurements.
6bb1f518-bb58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Genova Monte Capellino Observatory, Italy

6bba16ea-bba7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Montarrenti Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Sovicille, near Siena, Italy. It is a ground-based facility used for studying celestial objects and phenomena.
6bba16ea-bba7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Montarrenti Observatory, Italy

6bba1a3a-baff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Smith River Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Danbury, New Hampshire. It operates as a ground-based facility for studying celestial phenomena from Earth.
6bba1a3a-baff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Smith River Observatory

6bbbdf96-bc67-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **Magnetometer** is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The **CPMN fluxgate magnetometer at KAT** specifically refers to a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer installed at Katanning, Australia, as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
6bbbdf96-bc67-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of International Geomagnetic Reference Field, Australian Observation Network

6bbc679e-b60f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Roque de los Muchachos Observatory (SuperWASP-North) in the Canary Islands, Spain, and the South African Astronomical Observatory (SAAO; SuperWASP-South) in Sutherland, South Africa, are ground-based observatories equipped with Super Wide Angle Search for Planets (SuperWASP) cameras, dedicated to detecting exoplanets using transit photometry.
6bbc679e-b60f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Roque de los Muchachos Observatory and South African Astronomical Observatory

6bbd7bec-b63d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ionospheric station at King Salmon, Alaska (URSI-code: KS759) is a ground facility equipped with an advanced digisonde that measures the angle of arrival, polarization, and Doppler frequency shift of signals reflected from the ionosphere. It has been operational since December 31, 1999.
6bbd7bec-b63d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digisonde Ionospheric Station at King Salmon Observatory, United States

6bc088e6-b67e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Lynn Lake, identified by IAGA as LYN and part of the IUGONET observatory network since 1986.
6bc088e6-b67e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IAGA Observatory

6bc3d2ec-b94b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Potsdam Geomagnetic Observatory** was a ground-based facility in Potsdam, Germany, that operated from 1890 to 1931 and focused on measuring geomagnetic data.
6bc3d2ec-b94b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Potsdam Geomagnetic Observatory, Germany

6bcaeebe-ba82-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sinistro Camera attached to the Las Cumbres 1m Telescopes is a wide-field imaging system designed for high-resolution astronomical photography, equipped with a large CCD detector optimized for capturing detailed images of faint celestial objects over expansive sky areas.
6bcaeebe-ba82-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sinistro Camera on 1m0 Telescope at Las Cumbres Observatory

6bd3d81c-ba46-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Bulgarian Academy of Sciences (BAS) Institute of Astronomy (IA) 2m Telescope at Rozhen Observatory is an optical telescope with a 2.0-meter aperture located in Europe, specifically part of the Rozhen Observatory in Bulgaria.
6bd3d81c-ba46-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.0m optical Bulgarian Academy of Sciences Institute of Astronomy Telescope at Rozhen Observatory

6bd858a2-b7e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gemini Multi-Object Spectrograph - North (GMOS-N) is an imaging spectrograph mounted on the Gemini North telescope at Mauna Kea, designed for long-slit and multi-slit observations with a wavelength range of 0.36-1.03 micrometers.
6bd858a2-b7e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gemini Multi-Object Spectrograph - North on Gemini North Telescope

6bdbf328-bae4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Raheny Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Dublin, Ireland, known for its ground-based facilities used for stargazing and research.
6bdbf328-bae4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Raheny Observatory, Ireland

6be81cce-b5a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Frosty Cold Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Mash Harbor, Addison, Washington County, Maine, United States. It operates as a ground-based observatory for studying celestial phenomena and is situated at the coordinates 44.52076° N, -67.73351° W.
6be81cce-b5a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Frosty Cold Observatory at Mash Harbor, United States

6bf728fe-b955-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Honjo Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Honjo, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
6bf728fe-b955-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Honjo Observatory, Japan

6c0b35ca-bacb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Helios Mission consisted of a pair of deep space probes developed by the Federal Republic of Germany (FRG) in collaboration with NASA. Launched on December 10, 1974, and ending on December 23, 1979, the mission aimed to study solar phenomena within the inner Heliosphere.
6c0b35ca-bacb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Helios Mission

6c0d2b84-b7ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN magnetometer network at College, Alaska is a ground-based facility located in Fairbanks North Star Borough, United States. It operates as part of the IUGONET observatory system and includes instruments like the fluxgate magnetometer for geomagnetic field measurements.
6c0d2b84-b7ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at College Observatory, United States

6c164736-ba11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The NASA Solar Anomalous and Magnetospheric Particle Explorer (SAMPEX) was a space mission designed to study the composition and behavior of energetic particles, including neutrinos, in near-Earth space. It focused on understanding the solar and magnetospheric interactions that generate these particles and gravitational waves.
6c164736-ba11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: NASA Solar Anomalous and Magnetospheric Particle Explorer part of NASA Solar Anomalous and Magnetospheric Particle Explorer Mission

6c1efc7c-bb1b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The InfraRed Spectrograph (IRS) was an instrument on the Spitzer Space Telescope capable of obtaining low and high-resolution spectra in specific wavelength ranges, consisting of four modules each with a 128x128 pixel array.
6c1efc7c-bb1b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: InfraRed Spectrograph on Spitzer Space Telescope

6c2195f6-bb91-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 2Q Data Processing Unit (DPU)** is a versatile instrument controller board used in the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) project. It collects data from various sensors, formats it, and transmits it via an Iridium modem while also controlling critical systems like command-cutdown.
6c2195f6-bb91-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Data Processing Unit part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

6c23b8ec-b77f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MIMI Charge/Energy Mass Spectrometer (CHEMS) is an instrument aboard the Cassini Orbiter that measures the charge, energy, and mass of particles in Saturn's magnetosphere to study their composition and interactions.
6c23b8ec-b77f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Charge/Energy Mass Spectrometer on Cassini Orbiter

6c2b8df6-b5f4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Murcia Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Guadalupe de Maciascoque, Region of Murcia, Spain. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
6c2b8df6-b5f4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Murcia Observatory, Spain

6c2cfd0e-bbc5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Metsähovi Optical Telescope Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Kirkkonummi, Finland, primarily used for ground-based astronomical observations.
6c2cfd0e-bbc5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Metsahovi Observatory, Finland

6c3ec88c-b6b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A CPMN fluxgate magnetometer is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed at Macquarie Island, Australia, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
6c3ec88c-b6b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Circum-pan Pacific Magnetometer Network on Macquarie Island

6c4173b2-bb19-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Wailuku is a ground observatory located in Happy Valley, Maui County, Hawaii, United States. It operates under the label SNX-NET and is situated at coordinates 20.90063° N latitude and 156.78492° W longitude (converted from the provided longitude).
6c4173b2-bb19-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wailuku Observatory

6c4840d0-ba00-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Pula Geomagnetic Observatory (POL)** is a ground-based facility located in Pula, Croatia, dedicated to monitoring and studying geomagnetic activity. It is part of the World Data Center for Geomagnetism in Kyoto and features a magnetometer as its primary instrument.
6c4840d0-ba00-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Pula Geomagnetic Observatory, Croatia

6c4b2a22-bb7f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **OV1-19**: A spin-stabilized research satellite launched in 1969 to study trapped radiation in the Van Allen belts and assess hazards of incoming and trapped radiation to humans.
6c4b2a22-bb7f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: OV1-19

6c515596-b657-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Axial Double Probe (ADP)** is an instrument on the MMS 4 spacecraft, consisting of two 10-meter antennas that measure three-dimensional electric fields with high accuracy. It is part of the FIELDS suite and was developed by a consortium including the Swedish Institute of Space Physics and several U.S. universities.
6c515596-b657-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Axial Double Probe Instrument on Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission

6c53855e-bb62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **SMT MPIfR 19-channel Bolometer** is a decommissioned submillimeter telescope instrument developed by the Max Planck Institute for Radio Astronomy (MPIfR) and used at the Heinrich Hertz Submillimeter Telescope until mid-2004, known for its sensitivity in the range of 310 to 380 GHz.
6c53855e-bb62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 19-channel Bolometer on Heinrich Hertz Submillimeter Telescope

6c5593ee-b941-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A fluxgate magnetometer located in the Sor Rondane Mountains, Antarctica, part of the Automated Magnetometer Network (AMN) developed by NIPR for low power consumption and real-time data transmission.
6c5593ee-b941-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: NIPR Low Power Magnetometer at NIPR-AMN Observatory, Antarctica

6c5b7f84-bb71-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Jaipur, India, operational from 1976 to 1987, used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field as part of the IAGA investigation.
6c5b7f84-bb71-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IAGA investigation

6c6259bc-b5ef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: An Imaging Spectrometer named STIX (Spectrometer/Telescope for Imaging X-rays), launched in 2020, is part of the ESA's Solar Orbiter mission and is designed to study the timing, location, intensity, and spectra of energetic X-rays produced by solar flares and microflares.
6c6259bc-b5ef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spectrometer/Telescope for Imaging X-rays part of Solar Orbiter

6c65982e-bb9a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Akin Observatory, Rayong:** An astronomical ground observatory located in Ban Khai District, Rayong Province, Thailand (Latitude 12.7347° N, Longitude 101.27869° E).
6c65982e-bb9a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Akin Observatory, Thailand

6c6f8e0c-bb71-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lunar Dust Experiment (LDEX) is an instrument aboard the LADEE mission designed to map and characterize dust particles in the lunar environment by measuring their size, spatial distribution, and interaction with Earth's magnetosphere using impact ionization detection.
6c6f8e0c-bb71-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lunar Dust Experiment on Lunar Atmosphere and Dust Environment Explorer

6c73675a-b150-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity represents a magnetometer located at the Chimbote station with the IAGA identifier CMB, operational from January 1957 to December 31, 1960. It is part of the iugonet-observatory-wdc_kyoto-wdc network and includes detailed metadata accessible via the provided URLs and identifiers.
6c73675a-b150-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IUGONET Observatory

6c74f43e-b62e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a magnetometer located in Melbourne (identified as MEL), operational from 1865-01-01 to 1921-12-31, and associated with the IAGA investigation and the WDC Kyoto Observatory.
6c74f43e-b62e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IUGONET Observatory

6c785cae-b6bb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Vysokaya Dubrava ground station, operational from 1929 to 1980, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the IAGA investigation.
6c785cae-b6bb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Vysokaya Dubrava Observatory

6c7b41a8-bb8e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1C X-ray Instrument (XRI)** is a scintillation detector designed to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons. It features a NaI crystal scintillator, photomultiplier tube, and pulse height analyzer, with an energy response from 10 keV to 10 MeV and a spectral resolution of 5 keV.
6c7b41a8-bb8e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-Ray Instrument part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

6c8fed32-ba18-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ASPERA-3 Electron Spectrometer (ELS) on Mars Express is an instrument designed to measure electrons within the energy range of 0.01-20 keV, featuring a compact top-hat electrostatic analyzer with a field of view covering 10 degrees by 360 degrees divided into 16 sectors.
6c8fed32-ba18-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electron Spectrometer part of Mars Express

6c931f10-ba7d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solar Irradiance at Wavelengths from 2 to 35 nm instrument (also known as the SNOE Solar X-ray Photometer) measures solar irradiance in specific wavelength ranges using five photometer channels with silicon photodiodes and metallic film filters. It captures integrated solar measurements once per orbit with a 63-second integration time, centered on the zenith.
6c931f10-ba7d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-Ray Photometer part of Student Nitric Oxide Experiment

6c984942-b81e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Laser Rangefinder (LIDAR) instrument used on the Clementine mission was designed to measure lunar topography using a 1064 nm NdYag laser signal and an avalanche photodiode detector, enabling high-resolution mapping of the Moon's surface from altitudes below 640 km.
6c984942-b81e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Laser Rangefinder part of Clementine Mission

6c9d8372-b7e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Mordor" Ultra-high Vacuum System is a complex instrument suite designed for high-precision analysis under ultra-high vacuum conditions, featuring multiple analytical tools including spectrometers, microbalances, and gas dosers. It is named after the Mordor Macula terrain on Charon and includes advanced components like cryopumped chambers and cryostats.
6c9d8372-b7e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mordor Ultra-high Vacuum System

6cab7f76-b89b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EISCAT Sodankylä Radar is a VHF incoherent scatter radar system located in Sodankylä, Finland, operated by the EISCAT Scientific Association to study electron and ion density, temperature, and velocity in the Earth's ionosphere.
6cab7f76-b89b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Incoherent Scatter Radar part of EISCAT Scientific Association

6cabeee4-b7af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Gal Hassin Robotic Telescope Observatory is an astronomical facility located in the Gal Hassin Astronomical Park near Isnello, Sicily, Italy. It operates ground-based telescopes for astronomical research and observation.
6cabeee4-b7af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Galhassin Robotic Telescope Observatory at Parco Astronomico GAL Hassin, Italy

6caeac5c-b641-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Peawanuck Neutron Monitor is an energetic particle instrument used for monitoring neutrons, part of the Bartol Neutron Monitor observatory.
6caeac5c-b641-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: EnergeticParticleInstrument at Bartol Observatory

6cb49716-ba0b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sierra Nevada Observatory is an astronomical observatory located at Loma de Dilar in the Sierra Nevada mountain range of Granada, Spain. Established in 1981 and operated by the Instituto de Astrofísica de Andalucía, it features two Nasmyth telescopes with apertures of 1.5 and 0.9 meters.
6cb49716-ba0b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 30m Telescope on IRAM at Sierra Nevada Observatory, Spain

6cb7aa5a-bb46-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Sanikiluaq Geomagnetic Observatory (SNKQ), located in Sanikiluaq, Nunavut, Canada, is a ground-based facility part of the THEMIS CANMAG network and NRCan Network, focused on geomagnetic measurements.
6cb7aa5a-bb46-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Sanikiluaq Geomagnetic Observatory, Canada

6cbad954-b994-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Novolazarevskaya Ground Observatory is a ground-based research facility located on Earth's surface at an altitude of 460 meters. Established in 1961, it includes a magnetometer instrument and operates as part of the IAGA global network of observatories.
6cbad954-b994-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Novolazarevskaya Ground Observatory, Antarctica

6cc59e0e-bb4a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The **SupraThermal Electrons and Protons (STEP)** unit of the Energetic Particle Detector (EPD) is designed to measure protons and electrons at supra-thermal energies (2-80 keV) using two co-aligned sensor heads with solid state detectors for angular resolution.
6cc59e0e-bb4a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: SupraThermal Electrons and Protons part of Energetic Particle Detector on Solar Orbiter

6cc6f512-b83c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Darwin Station is a ground-based observatory in the MAGDAS magnetometer network, located at McMillans Road, Berrimah, Darwin, Australia. It operates as part of IUGONET and includes instruments like fluxgate magnetometers to monitor geomagnetic activity.
6cc6f512-b83c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer Network at Darwin Observatory, Australia

6cc77e24-b6a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Frankfurt Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Frankfurt, Germany. It is situated at the Senckenberg-Turm and serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
6cc77e24-b6a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Senckenberg-Turm Observatory, Germany

6cceea0c-b66f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The AC Electric Field Measurement on S-Cubed A is an instrument consisting of an electric dipole antenna and associated electronics designed to measure electric fields in space. It uses a step-frequency analyzer and a wideband receiver to capture and process data, providing high-resolution frequency-time spectrograms.
6cceea0c-b66f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waveform Receiver part of S-Cubed A AC Electric Field Measurement

6cd83f46-b5f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Galileo Near Infrared Mapping Spectrometer (NIMS) is an advanced imaging spectrometer designed to analyze the composition of Jupiter's atmosphere and its moons, operating in the 0.7 to 5.2 micron spectral range with high resolution.
6cd83f46-b5f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Mapping Spectrometer on Galileo Orbiter

6ce4f0c4-b965-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The THEMIS Flux Gate Magnetometer (FGM) is a scientific instrument launched in 2007 to measure background magnetic fields and low frequency fluctuations with high precision. Developed by the Technical University of Braunschweig, it utilizes advanced digital technology for improved robustness and reduced mass.
6ce4f0c4-b965-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tri-axial Fluxgate Magnetometer part of THEMIS

6cea61a6-baca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The THEMIS-C Digital Fields Board Filter Bank is a component of the THEMIS mission that provides band-pass filtering for electric field (EFI) and search coil magnetometer (SCM) spectra, as well as peak and average values for high-frequency signals. It operates with lower computational and power requirements compared to Fast Fourier Transform methods, using a cascading low-pass filter system to process and compress data efficiently.
6cea61a6-baca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digital Fields Board and Filter Bank part of THEMIS

6cf1ae20-b70f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Observatory Bad Wurzach** is a ground-based observatory located at 12 Kreuzbergweg, Bad Wurzach, Germany. It is situated in the Landkreis Ravensburg region of Baden-Württemberg and operates as an astronomical facility.
6cf1ae20-b70f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatory Bad Wurzach, Germany

6cf2d9b4-b6bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Gehrden Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Kirchdorf, Barsinghausen, Lower Saxony, Germany. It is a ground-based observatory used for stargazing and celestial observations.
6cf2d9b4-b6bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gehrden Observatory, Germany

6cf7bf36-bb51-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **CADRE (Coupling and Dynamics in Regions Equatorial) radiosonde sounding system** is a meteorological instrument located in Bandung, Indonesia. It measures vertical profiles of pressure, temperature, humidity, and horizontal wind in the lower atmosphere using Vaisala Radiosonde RS80 and TA1000 or TX1000 balloons to study atmospheric conditions up to approximately 30 km.
6cf7bf36-bb51-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Vaisala Radiosonde RS80 on CADRE part of Bandung Observatory

6cfac928-ba26-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Munich Observatory (1819-1938), located in Bogenhausen, Munich, Germany, was an astronomical observatory that operated from 1819 to 1938.
6cfac928-ba26-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Munich Observatory, Germany

6cfb480e-b94e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Romo Geophysical Observatory, operational since September 2008, as part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation.
6cfb480e-b94e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Romo Geophysical Observatory

6d00358e-b698-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **P2 Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Mayhill, New Mexico, USA. It operates as a ground-based facility for celestial observations.
6d00358e-b698-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mayhill Observatory, United States

6d04bf90-bb85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IAGA:JSS Magnetometer was a scientific instrument used for measuring magnetic fields at the Jassy Observatory from 1931 to 1971.
6d04bf90-bb85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Jassy Observatory

6d0ea814-ba7e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Orbiter Neutral Mass Spectrometer (ONMS) is an instrument aboard the Pioneer Venus Orbiter designed to measure the concentration and distribution of neutral atoms and molecules in Venus's upper atmosphere. It utilizes a quadrupole mass spectrometer with multiple operating modes to analyze gases based on their mass, contributing to the understanding of Venus's atmospheric composition and dynamics.
6d0ea814-ba7e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutral Mass Spectrometer on Pioneer Venus Orbiter

6d12b1ae-b653-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Penamayor Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Nava, Asturias, Spain. It operates as a ground-based facility and is situated at coordinates 354.48883 longitude and 43.359111 latitude.
6d12b1ae-b653-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Nava Observatory, Spain

6d14149a-ba59-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mbour Observatory (MBour) is a ground-based facility located in Senegal, primarily known for its magnetometer instrument. It is part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA).
6d14149a-ba59-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Mbour Observatory, Senegal

6d163554-b8a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **S3-3 (1976-065B)** is a small observatory spacecraft launched in 1976 into a near-polar orbit to observe various magnetospheric parameters using eight different sensors. It provided real-time data on energetic protons and Alpha particles for the U.S. Air Force Air Weather Service until its decommissioning in 1979.
6d163554-b8a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetospheric Exploration Satellite on S3-3

6d1cb9d4-baf8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Bennett Ion-Mass Spectrometer (BIMS) on AE-C was an instrument designed to measure the concentrations of thermal ion species in the mass range of 1 to 72 atomic mass units throughout its orbit, capable of operating in various ambient density ranges and selectable mass scanning modes.
6d1cb9d4-baf8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bennett Ion-Mass Spectrometer on Atmosphere Explorer C

6d1dbe64-b626-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Baldones Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Riekstukalna ceļš, Mežkalni, Baldones Parish, Latvia, operated by the University of Latvia since 1959.
6d1dbe64-b626-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Baldone Observatory, Latvia

6d296e4c-badd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Komakallio Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Kirkkonummi, Finland. It serves as a ground-based facility for stargazing and astronomical research.
6d296e4c-badd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kirkkonummi Observatory, Finland

6d36ba42-b9c1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The WIYN Consortium 0.9m Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Kitt Peak National Observatory in North America, with a 0.9-meter aperture.
6d36ba42-b9c1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical WIYN Consortium 0.9m Telescope at Kitt Peak National Observatory

6d4b7852-b5fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Southern Hemisphere SECS Observatory is a virtual observatory that aggregates data from various ground magnetometer arrays in the southern hemisphere, including those from AAL-PIP Chain, BAS, GFZ, and AGO. It operates to create comprehensive datasets for Spherical Elementary Current Systems (SECS).
6d4b7852-b5fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spherical Elementary Current Systems part of Ground Based Observatory

6d5113a6-ba0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Radio Frequency Spectrometer - High Frequency Receiver (RFS/HFR)** is an instrument aboard the Parker Solar Probe mission, designed to remotely sense radio waves and measure electrostatic fluctuations in space. It operates within a frequency range of approximately 10 kHz to 19.2 MHz and focuses on remote sensing activities.
6d5113a6-ba0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: High Frequency Receiver part of Parker Solar Probe Mission

6d565792-b61c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer installed in 1965 at the WDC Kyoto's Tehran ground station, designed to measure and monitor variations in the Earth's magnetic field.
6d565792-b61c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tehran Observatory

6d587ce0-ba2a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetospheric Ion Composition Sensor (MICS) on CRRES was an instrument designed to measure the mass and energy spectra of magnetospheric ions, particularly in the range of 30 to 400 keV/Q, to understand mechanisms that energize and transport charged particles within the magnetosphere.
6d587ce0-ba2a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: part of CRRES

6d5b8ee8-b855-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Le Creusot Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Saint-Sernin-du-Bois, France. It is designated by the Minor Planet Center (MPC) with ID 504 and operates as a ground-based observatory for studying celestial objects.
6d5b8ee8-b855-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Le Creusot Observatory, France

6d6b874c-b9bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Panoramic Survey Telescope and Rapid Response System (Pan-STARRS2; obs. code: F52) is an automated survey telescope located at the Haleakala Observatory in Hawaii, US, designed to continuously monitor the sky for moving or variable objects while providing precise astrometry and photometry data.
6d6b874c-b9bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.8m Panoramic Survey Telescope and Rapid Response System at Haleakala Observatory, United States

6d72003a-b98e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Vaucluse Observatoire Céleste** is an astronomical observatory located in Blauvac, France, used for ground-based observations.
6d72003a-b98e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Vaucluse Observatoire Celeste at Blauvac Observatory, France

6d773e3a-b8fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A Magnetometer installed in Kupang, Indonesia as part of the MAGDAS observation network. It is a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate instrument used for measuring magnetic field variations.
6d773e3a-b8fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

6d782938-bbd2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Maliya Karmakul Geomagnetic Observatory (MKL) is a ground-based facility located in Novaya Zemlya, Arkhangelsk Oblast, Russia, dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity. It is sponsored by Russia and includes instruments such as magnetometers for detailed measurements.
6d782938-bbd2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Maliya Karmakul Geomagnetic Observatory, Russia

6d8568da-b6ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetometer at Seoul (SEO) is an instrument used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field, located at a station with the IAGA identifier SEO. It is part of the observatory network managed by WDC Kyoto and Seo under the International Union of Geodesy and Geophysics.
6d8568da-b6ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Seoul Observatory

6d8797bc-baef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Goldstone DSS-28 is a 34-meter radio telescope located in San Bernardino County, California, originally built for the U.S. Army and later repurposed by NASA for scientific experiments under the GAVRT project.
6d8797bc-baef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 34m High-Speed Beam Waveguide Antenna at Goldstone Deep Space Communications Complex, United States

6d8938e6-b5eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Sintini Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Alfonsine, Italy. It operates as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
6d8938e6-b5eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Alfonsine Observatory, Italy

6d90e842-b94d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer at CKT** is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed in Cooktown, Australia, used to measure magnetic field variations as part of the MAGDAS observation network within the IUGONET observatory.
6d90e842-b94d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

6d984088-b9e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1S Engineering Data Interface** is an instrument aboard the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) that converts analog signals of temperatures, voltages, and currents into digital data. It features multiple inputs with configurable functionality and a high-precision ADC for data conversion.
6d984088-b9e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses part of BARREL

6d9f5548-b728-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: H57 is an automated magnetometer station located near Syowa Station in Antarctica, part of the Japanese Antarctic Research Expedition (JARE) network. It operates as a ground facility designed to monitor magnetic field variations at latitude -69.16 and longitude 40.98.
6d9f5548-b728-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Syowa Station, Antarctica

6d9fd68c-b901-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Guelph Wind Tunnel is a research facility at the University of Guelph's Wind Erosion Laboratory, designed to investigate wind erosion, sediment transport, and atmospheric boundary layer processes.
6d9fd68c-b901-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Guelph Wind Tunnel at Wind Erosion Laboratory

6da863d8-bbd6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EISCAT (European Incoherent Scatter) facility is a research organization that uses radar systems to study the interactions between the Sun and Earth's magnetosphere and ionosphere. It employs the Incoherent Scatter Technique to measure various parameters within the ionosphere, including electron density, temperature, and velocity, contributing significantly to understanding phenomena such as the aurora borealis (Northern Lights).
6da863d8-bbd6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: European Incoherent Scatter Radar at Svalbard

6db34592-b9dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Noto Radio Observatory is a ground-based astronomical observatory located near Noto, Sicily, Italy, known for its 32-meter radio telescope used in Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI).
6db34592-b9dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 32m Very Long Baseline Interferometry Station on 32m Radio Telescope at Noto Radio Observatory, Italy

6dbe5834-b797-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Joint Observatory for Cometary Research** is an astronomical observatory located in Socorro County, New Mexico, dedicated to the study of comets and other celestial bodies.
6dbe5834-b797-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Joint Observatory for Cometary Research

6dbe9234-b83e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A Magnetometer (Fluxgate) located in Abuja, Nigeria as part of the MAGDAS observation network.
6dbe9234-b83e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

6dc7ab4e-b6e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Castle Fields Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Quemerford, Calne, Wiltshire, England.
6dc7ab4e-b6e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Castle Fields Observatory, United Kingdom

6dcbf162-b9c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Southwater Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Southwater, West Sussex, England. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
6dcbf162-b9c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Southwater Observatory

6dccfe18-b71d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Large Area Telescope (LAT)** is an imaging high-energy gamma-ray telescope onboard the Fermi Gamma-Ray Space Telescope, operational since June 2008. It covers an energy range from about 20 MeV to over 300 GeV and continuously scans the entire sky every three hours.
6dccfe18-b71d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gamma-ray Large Area Telescope on Fermi Spacecraft

6dd7e556-b86e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Automatic Weather Station (AWS) at the Pontianak observatory is part of the HARIMAU project and measures various meteorological parameters such as precipitation, temperature, humidity, pressure, and wind direction and speed. It has been operated by the Research Institute for Sustainable Humanosphere (RISH), Kyoto University since March 2008.
6dd7e556-b86e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Automatic Weather Station part of Hydrometeorological Array for Isv-Monsoon Automonitoring

6ddb33f2-ba88-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Stardust was a NASA space probe launched in 1999 with the primary mission to collect dust samples from comet Wild 2 and cosmic dust, returning them to Earth for analysis. It also studied asteroid 5535 Annefrank during its journey and later visited Comet Tempel 1 as part of an extended mission called Stardust-NExT.
6ddb33f2-ba88-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stardust

6dea1bec-b5a1-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: This entity refers to the Paris Observatory, a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Paris, France, specifically at 61 Avenue de l'Observatoire.
6dea1bec-b5a1-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Paris Observatory, France

6deab282-baba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CRISP imager was a telescopic instrument aboard the CONTOUR spacecraft designed to capture images of comet nuclei using 10 filters across the 450-770 nm wavelength range, with a field of view of 1.2 x 1.2 degrees and typical exposure times of 9-150 ms.
6deab282-baba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Remote Imaging Spectrograph - Imager on CONTOUR

6df04f46-b65d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Deep Space Station 61 (DSS-61) is a decommissioned 34-meter radio telescope located at the Madrid Deep Space Communications Complex in Spain, formerly part of NASA's Deep Space Network.
6df04f46-b65d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 34m Deep Space Station 61 (DSS-61) at Madrid Deep Space Communications Complex, Spain

6dfdf8b2-b905-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Povegliano Veronese Observatory (code: A48) is an astronomical observatory located in Povegliano Veronese, Italy. It operates as a ground-based facility and is identified by the Minor Planet Center with the code A48.
6dfdf8b2-b905-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Povegliano Veronese Observatory, Italy

6e040fe2-b8d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity is the **Minor Planet Center**, a ground-based observatory located at 60 Garden Street, Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States. It operates under Earthcode 310 and focuses on tracking and cataloging minor planets within our solar system.
6e040fe2-b8d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Minor Planet Center at Harvard College Observatory, United States

6e07139c-b95b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ruhr University Bochum and Catholic University of the North (UCN) 0.81m Infra Red Imaging Survey Telescope is an infrared telescope located at the Cerro Armazones Observatory in South America, designed for surveying celestial objects with a 0.81-meter aperture.
6e07139c-b95b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared 0.81m Infra Red Imaging Survey Telescope at Cerro Armazones Observatory

6e09d9e6-b8d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Phoenix Lander Robotic Arm (RA) was a 2.4-meter long arm mounted on the Phoenix Mars lander, designed to collect soil samples, dig trenches, modify terrain, and insert scientific instruments into the Martian soil. It featured multiple joints for precise movement and included attachments like a scoop and various probes.
6e09d9e6-b8d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Robotic Arm on Phoenix Lander

6e0fb022-baed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CLPS Task Order 19D Stereo Cameras for Lunar Plume-Surface Studies (SCALPSS) is an imaging system designed to capture video during the descent and landing on the lunar surface, with the aim of reconstructing the effects of plume-surface interaction using stereo photogrammetry.
6e0fb022-baed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stereo CAmeras for Lunar Plume-Surface Studies on CLPS Task Order 19D

6e285b40-baf2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Proton Auroral Imager (PAI) at Syowa Station, Antarctica, is an all-sky imaging instrument designed to observe and study the proton aurora by comparing Doppler-broadened Hβ emission lines with background levels.
6e285b40-baf2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Imager part of Auroral Observation at Syowa Station

6e386824-bae7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: "**Dekelia**: A ground-based observatory in Acharnes, Greece that operated from 1935 to 1939, known for its magnetometer instrument."
6e386824-bae7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Dekelia Observatory, Greece

6e39e996-ba52-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Fountain Hills Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Fountain Hills, Arizona, United States. It was established in 1998 and operates as a ground-based facility.
6e39e996-ba52-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fountain Hills Observatory

6e3bacb0-b91a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: DSS 34 is a radio telescope with a 34.0m aperture located at the Canberra Deep Space Communications Complex in the Australian Capital Territory, Australia. It is part of NASA's Deep Space Network and is used for tracking and communication with spacecraft.
6e3bacb0-b91a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 34m Radio Telescope at Canberra Deep Space Communications Complex, Australia

6e3f125c-b685-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: LIDAR onboard the Hayabusa2 spacecraft is a laser altimeter used for navigation and scientific purposes. It measures distances to the surface of asteroid Ryugu, providing position information, topography, albedo data, and supporting dust count and laser link experiments.
6e3f125c-b685-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: LIght Detection And Ranging on Hayabusa2

6e4512bc-bb0b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cherokeeridge Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Fort Madison, Iowa, United States. It is a ground-based facility situated at 24th Street, Fort Madison, Lee County, and operates under the Minor Planet Center (MPC) ID V94.
6e4512bc-bb0b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cherokeeridge Observatory, United States

6e4d8826-b817-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Athabasca (ATHA) Station is a ground-based observatory located at the Athabasca University Geophysical Observatory in Alberta, Canada. It serves as part of the THEMIS network and was established as its prototype Ground-Based Observatory (GBO).
6e4d8826-b817-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Athabasca University Geophysical Observatory, Canada

6e530efc-babc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The THEMIS On Board Moments (MOM) system is an instrument used for onboard calculations of electron and ion moments from a combination of ESA and SST data. It provides outputs such as number density, energy flux, momentum flux tensor, velocity, plasma temperature, and pressure in various coordinate systems for both ions and electrons.
6e530efc-babc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: On Board Moments part of THEMIS

6e675f82-bb21-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Yunnan Astronomical Observatory (YAO) is a research institution of the Chinese Academy of Sciences located in Kunming, Yunnan, China, dedicated to astronomy research and public science education. It operates multiple telescopes and is the only observatory of its kind in southwest China.
6e675f82-bb21-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.2m Altazimuth Telescope at Yunnan Astronomical Observatory, China

6e7e6a5a-b9dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Edwards Raven Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Kern County, California, United States. It is a ground-based facility situated at coordinates 34.984639° N, 117.8669° W.
6e7e6a5a-b9dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Raven Observatory, United States

6e7f64fe-b754-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The B Star Tracker Camera for CLEM1 was one of two cameras on the Clementine 1 spacecraft designed primarily to determine spacecraft attitude by imaging star fields and comparing them with an onboard catalog. It also conducted scientific observations, particularly of dim objects like the lunar surface, but was not used on the sunlit side of the Moon due to its sensitivity.
6e7f64fe-b754-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: B Star Tracker Camera on Clementine 1

6e7fdf64-b953-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hot Plasma Composition Analyzer (HPCA) on MMS2 is an instrument that measures the composition-resolved velocity-space distribution of ions ranging from 1 eV to 40 keV with a time resolution of 10 - 15 seconds.
6e7fdf64-b953-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hot Plasma Composition Analyzer on MMS2

6e9991d2-bb8f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Hope Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Belcamp, Maryland, United States. It operates as a ground-based facility with the Minor Planet Center (MPC) ID H88.
6e9991d2-bb8f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hope Observatory, United States

6e9aca12-bb07-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ST5-094 Fluxgate Magnetometer** is a low power science-grade instrument designed to measure magnetic fields in space, featuring two commandable ranges (64,000 and 1000 nT) and high tolerance to temperature extremes. It was developed at UCLA for the ST5 mission using heritage from earlier missions such as Polar and FAST.
6e9aca12-bb07-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of Space Technology 5

6ea1aa1c-b864-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cesena Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Cesena, Italy (Europe). It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
6ea1aa1c-b864-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cesena Observatory, Italy

6eab6e94-b8be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The SAE Observatory is a virtual observatory comprising various ground magnetometers from different networks and stations, used to create the southern auroral electrojet index dataset. It operates by integrating data from these magnetometers to produce indices when all necessary data are available.
6eab6e94-b8be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Southern Auroral Electrojet Index

6eaee7ac-b997-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Energetic and Relativistic Nuclei and Electrons (ERNE)** is an instrument aboard the SOHO spacecraft designed to investigate the solar atmosphere by detecting particles produced in various energy release processes. It measures particle fluxes during quiet times and events, as well as energy spectra of elements and abundance ratios of isotopes using two separate particle telescopes: LED (Low Energy Detector) and HED (High Energy Detector).
6eaee7ac-b997-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic and Relativistic Nuclei and Electrons on Solar and Heliospheric Observatory

6eb1b12e-bb9c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS magnetometer network at Kuju, Japan is a ground-based observatory located in Taketa, Oita Prefecture. It operates as part of the International Geomagnetic Reference Field (IGRF) to monitor and study geomagnetic activities on Earth's surface.
6eb1b12e-bb9c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kuju Observatory, Japan

6eb35776-b94f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Østervold Observatory, also known as the Copenhagen University Observatory, was a former astronomical observatory in Copenhagen, Denmark, owned and operated by the University of Copenhagen from its opening in 1861.
6eb35776-b94f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Østervold Observatory, Denmark

6eb586cc-b765-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Millau Observatory (G07) is an astronomical observatory located in Millau, Aveyron, France. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
6eb586cc-b765-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Millau Observatory, France

6eb93f76-b722-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Advanced Coronal Observation System (ACOS) at Mauna Loa Solar Observatory is a suite of instruments designed to observe the solar atmosphere, including key components like the CHIP and PICS imagers and the Mk4 K-coronameter.
6eb93f76-b722-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Advanced Coronal Observation System at Mauna Loa Solar Observatory

6ecb923c-b733-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ECCCO Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Potrero de Garay, Córdoba, Argentina. It is situated at coordinates -64.55619 longitude and -31.795292 latitude within the Bosque Alegre area.
6ecb923c-b733-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ECCCO Observatory, Argentina

6edb5496-bbbc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The SSIES Special Sensor Topside Thermal Plasma Monitor on DMSP_5D-2 is an instrument designed to measure ambient electron density and temperatures, as well as ion density, temperature, and molecular weight at the orbital altitude of the DMSP satellite. It is an improved version of the Special Sensor for Ions and Electrons (SSI/E).
6edb5496-bbbc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Langmuir Probe part of Defense Meteorological Satellite Program

6ede592c-b8c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "US Air Force 1.5m Starfire Optical Range (SOR) Telescope" is a ground-based observatory located at Kirkland Air Force Base, used for astronomical and atmospheric research.
6ede592c-b8c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.5m Starfire Optical Range Telescope at Kirkland Air Force Base

6ee6a642-b8c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solar X-ray Monitor on GOES 8 is an instrument designed to measure solar X-ray emissions in two specific wavelength bands, utilizing ion chambers and a lead-lined aluminum collimator to focus its field of view.
6ee6a642-b8c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray Solar X-ray Monitor on Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 8

6ef30bbe-b9bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Chichijima Geomagnetic Observatory (CBI) is a ground-based facility in Japan that has been operating since 1973 to monitor magnetic fields on Earth's surface.
6ef30bbe-b9bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetic Field Sensor at Chichijima Geomagnetic Observatory, Japan

6f075874-baa5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity "DSS-43" refers to a ground-based observatory, also known as the Deep Space Station 43, part of NASA's Deep Space Network.
6f075874-baa5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: DSS-43

6f08df5c-b8b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **BepiColombo**: A joint space mission by the European Space Agency (ESA) and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) to explore Mercury, focusing on X-ray observations of neutrinos, particles, and gravitational waves.
6f08df5c-b8b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray part of The European Space Agency and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency BepiColombo Mercury mission

6f1add30-b9d4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cylindrical Electrostatic Probes on ISIS 2 were Langmuir probe instruments designed to study global variations in electron temperature and concentration at spacecraft altitudes, featuring enhanced sensitivity and high resolution for detailed plasma structure analysis.
6f1add30-b9d4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cylindrical Electrostatic Probes on ISIS 2

6f228856-b76c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nain Magnetometer is an instrument part of the THEMIS Mission, located at the Nain Geophysical Observatory. It measures magnetic field variations and has been operational since June 8, 2007.
6f228856-b76c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of THEMIS Mission

6f230106-b5e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Madrid Observatory**: A ground-based observatory located in Madrid, Spain, dedicated to astronomical research and observations. It is identified by the code 399003 within a specific ontological framework for astronomical facilities.
6f230106-b5e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Madrid Observatory

6f258f40-b606-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mt. Bigelow Station 27" Telescope is an astronomical observatory located on Mount Bigelow in Arizona, U.S., part of the Catalina Sky Survey.
6f258f40-b606-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mount Bigelow Station 0.68-meter Telescope at Catalina Sky Survey, United States

6f307f40-b69c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Max Planck Institute for Astronomy and Institute of Astrophysics of Andalusia (CSIC) 1.5m Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Calar Alto Observatory in Europe, used for astronomical research.
6f307f40-b69c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 1.5m Telescope at Calar Alto Observatory

6f4b861e-bbd3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The one at Charters Towers ground station has been operational since 1984 and is part of the IAGA investigation.
6f4b861e-bbd3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Charters Towers Observatory

6f4d447a-b99b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The UTP Astronomical Observatory is a ground-based facility located at the Universidad Tecnológica de Pereira in Colombia, dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
6f4d447a-b99b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Observatory at Universidad Tecnológica de Pereira

6f4ed11a-b5da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Iridium satellite constellation is a network of satellites in low Earth orbit, primarily designed for communication services. It includes the Iridium magnetometer instrument for scientific observations and measurements.
6f4ed11a-b5da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on IRIDIUM

6f5f89fe-ba19-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The UKS spacecraft position refers to the location data of the UKS spacecraft within various coordinate systems. It is part of the AMPTE-UKS mission managed by CNES and available through the CDPP-AMDA observatory.
6f5f89fe-ba19-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spacecraft Position on AMPTE United Kingdom Satellite

6f73ac52-b755-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gillam (GILL) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility in Gillam, Canada, part of the NASA THEMIS Ground-Based Observatories network, which operated from 2006 to 1976 and focused on geomagnetic measurements.
6f73ac52-b755-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Gillam Geophysical Observatory, Canada

6f743522-b8aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Hanau Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Hanau, Hesse, Germany. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
6f743522-b8aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hanau Observatory

6f7be226-ba86-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Energetic Neutrals Analyzer (ENA) is a sensor within the Mercury Plasma Particle Experiment (MPPE) suite onboard Mio, designed to measure mass-identified energetic neutral atoms from 10 eV to 3.3 keV, studying the abundance of neutrals from Mercury's surface and the coupling between its magnetosphere and exosphere.
6f7be226-ba86-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Neutrals Analyzer part of Mercury Plasma Particle Experiment

6f7c2378-ba43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **riometer** (Relative Ionospheric Opacity Meter) is an instrument used to measure the absorption of cosmic radio noise by the Earth's ionosphere. The **Imaging Riometer Observation at Nain** specifically operates at 60MHz and features an 8x8-element dipole antenna array, covering an area of approximately 180km x 180km at D region altitude to study the upper atmosphere's dynamics through nocturnal airglow emissions.
6f7c2378-ba43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer at Nain Observatory, Canada

6f8329e4-b6eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Hackney Wick 2**: A historical ground-based observatory in London, operational from 1817 to 1822, equipped with magnetometers for geomagnetic measurements.
6f8329e4-b6eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hackney Wick Observatory, United Kingdom

6f83576e-bba2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The JCPM Tone Station is an astronomical observatory located in Shimizu, Sunto County, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. It serves as a ground-based facility for celestial observations.
6f83576e-bba2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tone Astronomical Observatory, Japan

6f83ce14-bb35-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: "**Electrostatic Analyser (E1 Plasma Experiment):** A set of instruments aboard the Helios 1 spacecraft designed to measure positive ions and electrons in the solar wind. It consists of four components: I1a, I1b, I2, and I3, each with distinct measurement capabilities for ion and electron energy distribution and current."
6f83ce14-bb35-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Plasma Experiment part of Helios Mission

6f94e8c2-b5b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL (Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses) Scintillation Detector is an instrument used to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons, featuring a NaI crystal scintillator and photomultiplier tube with varying time and energy resolutions.
6f94e8c2-b5b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-Ray Scintillation Detector part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

6f9c028c-b79c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Fujieda Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Fujieda, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to the observation of celestial phenomena and has an assigned Minor Planet Center (MPC) ID of 898.
6f9c028c-b79c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fujieda Observatory, Japan

6f9fecf0-b15a-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Bac Lieu station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Bạc Liêu Province, Vietnam, part of the MAGDAS network that monitors geomagnetic activity.
6f9fecf0-b15a-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Bac Lieu Observatory, Vietnam

6fa29ce0-ba27-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Keles Observatory is a ground-based facility in Uzbekistan that operated from 1936 to 1962, equipped with magnetometers for geomagnetic measurements.
6fa29ce0-ba27-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Keles Observatory, Uzbekistan

6fa428b2-b635-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **FaradayCup (SPC):** A Faraday Cup is a scientific instrument used to measure the flux of charged particles in space. The Solar Probe Cup (SPC), part of the Parker Solar Probe's SWEAP Investigation, is specifically designed to withstand extreme temperatures and measure ion and electron energy distributions from the Sun-facing side of the spacecraft.
6fa428b2-b635-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: FaradayCup part of Parker Solar Probe SWEAP Investigation

6faa76a2-b727-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lumezzane Observatory (also known as the Serafino Zani Astronomical Observatory) is an astronomical facility located in Lumezzane, Italy, dedicated to ground-based observations and research.
6faa76a2-b727-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatoire Astronomique Serafino Zani at Lumezzane Observatory, Italy

6fab7fe2-ba70-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **6ROADS Observatory 2** is an astronomical observatory located in Nerpio, Albacete, Castile-La Mancha, Spain. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
6fab7fe2-ba70-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 6ROADS Observatory, Spain

6fae2d28-bb33-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Dumont d'Urville Geomagnetic Observatory (DRV) is a ground-based facility located at Dumont d'Urville Station in Antarctica, established in 1957 to monitor geomagnetic activity.
6fae2d28-bb33-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Dumont d'Urville Geomagnetic Observatory, Antarctica

6fb3c050-b8ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a set of analytical models used in the investigation of magnetospheric phenomena as part of the Cluster 4 mission, housed within the CDPP-AMDA archive at CNES Observatory.
6fb3c050-b8ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Different Magnetospheric Analytical Models part of Cluster 4

6fb462ae-b62b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA), located in Chile's Andes Mountains, is an international astronomical observatory composed of 66 high-precision antennae operating as a single telescope to observe the universe at millimeter and submillimeter wavelengths.
6fb462ae-b62b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 12m Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array at Chajnantor Observatory, Chile

6fb577b8-baf7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: OSIRIS-REx is a NASA mission launched in 2016 to return a sample from the near-Earth carbonaceous asteroid Bennu, aiming to study Solar System formation and organic compounds.
6fb577b8-baf7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Origins Spectral Interpretation Resource Identification Security - Regolith Explorer part of New Frontiers Program

6fb97874-b749-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a ground-based observatory located in Temecula, California, United States, with the Earthcode G81.
6fb97874-b749-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Temecula Observatory, United States

6fbecc2c-b7fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Cedar Knolls Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Hanover Township, New Jersey, United States. It is a ground-based facility used for studying celestial objects and phenomena.
6fbecc2c-b7fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cedar Knolls Observatory, United States

6fc906dc-ba40-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The High Energy Proton Detector (HEPD) on Double Star 1 is an instrument designed to detect energetic protons in the magnetosphere and solar wind. It is part of the CNES observatory CDPP AMDA Double Star 1 mission.
6fc906dc-ba40-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: High Energy Proton Detector on Double Star 1

6fe17862-bb25-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Chokurdakh station is a ground-based facility in Chokurdakh, Russia, part of the CPMN magnetometer network, dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity. It is located at coordinates 70.62 latitude and 147.89 longitude within the Sakha Republic, Far Eastern Federal District.
6fe17862-bb25-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Chokurdakh Station, Russia

6fe230ec-b6c8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **iota Scorpii Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in La Spezia, Italy. It specializes in ground-based observations and provides facilities for studying celestial phenomena from Earth.
6fe230ec-b6c8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: iota Scorpii Observatory, Italy

70085656-b5ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sveagruva Magnetometer, established in 1933 and located at the IAGA-identified SVG station, is an instrument designed to measure the Earth's magnetic field as part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) investigations.
70085656-b5ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Sveagruva Observatory

7012b18e-b9b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Vanimo Ionosonde was an instrument located near Vanimo, Papua New Guinea, used to study the ionosphere. It operated various models of ionosondes from 1964 until at least 2009, conducting vertical soundings primarily in the frequency range of 1.0 to 21.5 MHz.
7012b18e-b9b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar Ionosonde part of Vanimo Observatory

7017b312-bba9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The BARREL Balloon 1M Trajectory Positions instrument is a virtual tool within the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) project that provides ephemeral data, including trajectory positions in various coordinate systems.
7017b312-bba9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

701c5816-b9bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Berthelot Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Fărcădin, General Berthelot, Hunedoara, Romania. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
701c5816-b9bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Berthelot Observatory, Romania

702ab2a8-b8db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Magnetometers at Bangkok (BKK)" is a magnetometer located at the station with the IAGA identifier BKK, part of the observatory network affiliated with WDC Kyoto.
702ab2a8-b8db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Bangkok Observatory

7031ac86-b8e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Key West Observatory was a ground-based facility in Florida, operational from 1860 to 1866, equipped with magnetometers for geomagnetic measurements.
7031ac86-b8e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Key West Observatory, United States

7038e948-b67b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Black Springs 0.8m is a 0.8-meter Newtonian Reflector telescope situated at the Star Castle Observatory in South Australia, specifically located at coordinates -33.899000 latitude and 138.888000 longitude.
7038e948-b67b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.8m Newtonian Reflector Telescope at Star Castle Observatory, Australia

70464e7a-b852-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The BARREL (Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2L Ephemeris is a virtual instrument that provides trajectory positions of the balloon array in various coordinate systems, supporting the investigation of relativistic electron losses as part of the Radiation Belt Storm Probes (RBSP) mission.
70464e7a-b852-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

705953dc-b8f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Aarhus Wind Tunnel Simulator II (AWTSI 2004) is a low-pressure recirculating wind tunnel used for multi-disciplinary scientific studies, including aerosol formation and transport on Mars and Earth, magnetic properties, erosion, and bacterial survival. It is accessible to international collaborators and space agencies for various experiments and instrument testing.
705953dc-b8f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Low-pressure Recirculating Wind Tunnel at Aarhus

70596d68-b64d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer used to measure magnetic field fluctuations up to 4 Hz with two measurement ranges and equipped with a flipper mechanism.
70596d68-b64d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Helios 1

706294d2-b798-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Cloudcroft Observatory (obs. code: V29) is an astronomical observatory situated in the Lincoln National Forest near Cloudcroft, New Mexico, owned by the Tzec Maun Foundation.
706294d2-b798-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cloudcroft Observatory, United States

7067aab6-bac3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Climax Neutron Monitor is an Energetic Particle Instrument located in Climax, Colorado, established in 1950 at an elevation of 11,400 feet. It consists of two sections with six tubes each and is part of the neutron monitor observatory network.
7067aab6-bac3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Instrument part of Neutron Monitor Investigation

70730230-b5aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: GOES-17 (Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 17) is a weather satellite launched in 2018 as part of the GOES-R series, designed to improve weather forecasting and environmental monitoring by providing high-resolution images and real-time data, covering the Western Hemisphere from its position over the Pacific Ocean.
70730230-b5aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 17 part of GOES-R Series

70735278-b60c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the **Deep Space Station 54 (DSS-54)**, a ground-based observatory, specifically designated for deep space communication and observation.
70735278-b60c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 399054 Observatory

70751288-baa9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Purple Mountain Observatory, Dayao** is an astronomical observatory located in Zuomen, China, at the coordinates 25.6975° N, 101.04528° E. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
70751288-baa9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Purple Mountain Observatory at Dayao

70761ae4-bb66-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The International Space Station (ISS) is a modular space station in low Earth orbit, serving as a collaborative research laboratory and habitation facility for astronauts from various nations.
70761ae4-bb66-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: International Space Station

7076eeb8-b866-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Sachs Harbour Geomagnetic Observatory** is a ground-based facility located in Sachs Harbour, Northwest Territories, Canada, dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity as part of the IAGA observatory network.
7076eeb8-b866-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Sachs Harbor Geomagnetic Observatory

707806f8-b790-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Holsteinsborg Magnetometer was an instrument used at the IAGA-identified HST station from 1853 to 1965 to measure magnetic fields.
707806f8-b790-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Holsteinsborg Observatory

70860456-b75e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 210MM fluxgate magnetometer is an instrument located in Guam, part of the IUGONET observatory network, designed to measure magnetic field variations as part of the 210 Magnetic Meridian (210MM) magnetometer network.
70860456-b75e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at IUGONET Observatory

7089c80e-bb44-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Coupled Ion-Neutral Dynamics Investigation (CINDI) is a NASA mission payload aboard the C/NOFS satellite that studies ion and neutral dynamics in space, consisting of an Ion Velocity Meter and a Neutral Wind Meter.
7089c80e-bb44-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ion Drift Meter and Retarding Potential Analyzer on Coupled Ion-Neutral Dynamics Investigation part of C/NOFS

7090eb20-bac7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Marine Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Hamburg, Germany, specifically at 7 Neumayerstraße. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
7090eb20-bac7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Marine Observatory, Germany

70a69ab8-ba10-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Chuguev Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Ukraine and operated by the Institute of Astronomy of Kharkiv National University, featuring a 0.7-meter telescope.
70a69ab8-ba10-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.7m AZT-8 Telescope at Chuguev Observatory, Ukraine

70ad67ae-bbc7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The specific instance mentioned, the "Memambetsu Ground Magnetic Field Instrument," has been operational since January 1950 and is part of the IUGONET Observatory network managed by WDC Kyoto in Memambetsu (MMB).
70ad67ae-bbc7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet Observatory

70b3f7dc-b982-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Extreme Ultraviolet Imaging Telescope (EIT) is an instrument on the Solar and Heliospheric Observatory (SOHO) spacecraft designed to capture high-resolution images of the solar corona in specific ultraviolet wavelengths, primarily to study the evolution and dynamics of coronal structures.
70b3f7dc-b982-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Extreme-ultraviolet Imaging Telescope on Solar and Heliospheric Observatory

70b544b0-b61d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: NASA's Parker Solar Probe (PSP) is a spacecraft designed to study the Sun and its corona by observing neutrinos, particles, and gravitational waves within the optical waveband.
70b544b0-b61d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Parker Solar Probe part of Parker Solar Probe

70c14c70-b7f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Desert Wanderer Observatory is an astronomical facility located in El Centro, California, dedicated to ground-based observations of the night sky.
70c14c70-b7f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: El Centro Observatory, United States

70c8aef6-b672-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Charcot Geomagnetic Observatory (CTX), located on Earth's surface at coordinates 139.02 longitude and -69.38 latitude with an altitude of 2400 meters, operated from January 1, 1957, to December 31, 1958, as part of a ground facility for geomagnetic studies under the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA).
70c8aef6-b672-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Charcot Geomagnetic Observatory on Charcot Station, Antarctica

70cd2a8e-bb78-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lunar Prospector Spacecraft Gamma Ray Spectrometer (GRS) was an instrument on the Lunar Prospector spacecraft designed to measure the global surface abundances of key elements on the Moon and investigate the lunar crust's composition and structure. It featured a bismuth germanate crystal within a borated-plastic anticoincidence shield, providing enhanced sensitivity for detecting gamma rays and neutrons.

7301da76-b771-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Schefferville Observatory

73021136-b180-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Triaxial Fluxgate Magnetometer (MAG) on Voyager 1 is an instrument designed to measure magnetic fields in space, particularly focusing on the magnetic environments of Jupiter and Saturn, as well as the interplanetary magnetic field. It uses two high-field and two low-field triaxial fluxgate magnetometers to achieve accurate measurements with a range from 0.01 nT to 2 mT.
73021136-b180-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Triaxial Fluxgate Magnetometer on Voyager 1

7302e000-b614-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The **Dingle Observatory**, located in Churchstoke, Powys, Wales, is a ground-based astronomical observatory with the MPC code J18.
7302e000-b614-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dingle Observatory, United Kingdom

73142d7c-ba08-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The "Galileo position and velocity" instrument within the GEOS-2 investigation provides data on the positions of the GEOS-2 spacecraft in various coordinate systems, contributing to ephemeris studies.
73142d7c-ba08-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris on GEOS-2

7323e26a-b7a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Kwajalein Geomagnetic Observatory (KWJ) is a ground-based facility located in Kwajalein, Marshall Islands, dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity since 1973. It is part of the IAGA observatory network and operates a magnetometer instrument associated with WDC Kyoto.
7323e26a-b7a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kwajalein Geomagnetic Observatory, Marshall Islands

7324a5b4-ba2e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Galileo Galilei Observatory (MPC code X31) is an astronomical observatory located in Oro Verde, Entre Ríos Province, Argentina. It is a ground-based facility used for various astronomical observations and research.
7324a5b4-ba2e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Galileo Galilei Observatory, Argentina

733b4bdc-ba58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AGO P6 Magnetometer is an instrument located at the AGO P6 ground station, designed to measure variations in the Earth's magnetic field as part of the ICESTAR observatory.
733b4bdc-ba58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of International Conjugate Point Electrical and Magnetic Field Observatory, Antarctica

733d88aa-b744-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of Central Arkansas Observatory is an astronomical observatory located at the University of Central Arkansas in Conway, Arkansas. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and education.
733d88aa-b744-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Conway Observatory, United States

734d6a28-bb26-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Kilpisjärvi All Sky Camera** is an imaging instrument operated by the Finnish Meteorological Institute since 1996, designed to capture all-sky color images of auroras using fisheye optics and digital detectors.
734d6a28-bb26-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: All Sky Camera at Kilpisjärv Observatory

73523f12-bb67-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer used in the Giotto mission to investigate the interaction between Comet Halley and the solar wind, specifically focusing on measuring the interplanetary magnetic field.
73523f12-bb67-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Giotto

737506a6-b93b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The BAS A81 Search Coil Instrument is a scientific device used to measure geomagnetic micropulsations at frequencies below 10 Hz, located at the AUGSBURG Magnetometer Array's BAS.A81 observatory in Augsburg.
737506a6-b93b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Search Coil Magnetometer at Augsburg Observatory

737529fc-b787-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The California Institute of Technology 1.5m (60-inch) Telescope (P60) is an optical telescope located at Palomar Observatory in North America, managed by the California Institute of Technology.
737529fc-b787-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.5m Telescope at Palomar Observatory

738d9338-ba7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Automatic Weather Station (AWS) at Shigaraki MU Observatory in Shiga Prefecture, Japan, is a comprehensive weather monitoring system that measures various meteorological parameters such as surface pressure, temperature, relative humidity, wind direction and speed, and precipitation using advanced instruments. It has been operated by the Research Institute for Sustainable Humanosphere (RISH) at Kyoto University since April 30, 1994.
738d9338-ba7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Automatic Weather Station at Shigaraki Observatory

7396ad94-b6d2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AGO P3 Riometer Instrument is a device located at the AGO P3 ground station, part of the ICESTAR observatory, used to measure radio wave absorption in the ionosphere. It operates under the ICESTAR investigation and contributes to studies on space weather and atmospheric conditions.
7396ad94-b6d2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer part of ICESTAR, Antarctica

739b2cf4-b1cb-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: This entity describes the 70-meter radio telescope located near Madrid, Spain, which is part of NASA's Deep Space Network and used for radio astronomy observations.
739b2cf4-b1cb-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio DSS-63 70-m Radio Telescope part of The Deep Space Network

739bd438-b8f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solar Wind Plasma Experiment (SWOOPS) on the Ulysses spacecraft is an instrument designed to analyze solar wind plasma parameters as it traverses from Earth towards Jupiter and beyond. It utilizes electrostatic analyzers and Channel Electron Multipliers (CEMs) to measure electrons and ions across various energies, aiming to characterize the bulk flow and internal conditions of interplanetary plasma.
739bd438-b8f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electrostatic Analyser on Solar Wind Plasma part of Ulysses

739d89f2-b718-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The CBA Concord Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Concord, California. It is part of the Center for Backyard (Basement) Astrophysics and operates as a ground-based facility.
739d89f2-b718-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Concord Observatory

73b975c8-b942-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Pousada dos Anões Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Alto Paraíso de Goiás, Brazil, situated at coordinates -47.5019 longitude and -14.317305 latitude on Earth.
73b975c8-b942-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Pousada dos Anoes Observatory, Brazil

73c3cd24-b8fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Principia Astronomical Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located at Principia College in Elsah, Illinois, featuring a 16-inch Ritchey-Chretien telescope.
73c3cd24-b8fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.4m Telescope at Principia Astronomical Observatory, United States
