73c53218-bb32-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nephelometer for Pioneer Venus Small Probe (Day) was an instrument on the Pioneer Venus mission designed to measure backscattered energy from cloud particles using a gallium arsenide laser LED and photodiodes, providing insights into Venus's cloud structure and variability.
73c53218-bb32-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Nephelometer for Pioneer Venus Small Probe on Pioneer Venus

73cef28e-b601-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) Balloon 2W Data Processing Unit** is an instrument controller board designed to collect data from various sensors on high-altitude balloons, including X-ray spectrometers and magnetometers. It processes this information and sends it via Iridium modem for downlink while managing flight operations like command-cutdown systems.
73cef28e-b601-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Data Processing Unit part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

73d8b75a-b724-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2X is a component of the BARREL mission, designed to study particles escaping from Earth's radiation belts by measuring X-rays produced by precipitating relativistic electrons in the stratosphere. This specific balloon was operational from January 4, 2014, to January 13, 2014, and included a NaI scintillator and a DC magnetometer among its payload instruments.
73d8b75a-b724-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses part of Living with a Star Geospace Mission of Opportunity

73dfd33e-b6be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EMN magnetometer network in São Luís, Brazil is a ground-based observatory located at Rua Nossa Senhora da Conceição, São Luís. It is part of the IUGONET facilities and operates to measure magnetic field variations on Earth's surface.
73dfd33e-b6be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer Network at São Luís Observatory, Brazil

73e15018-b693-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A spacecraft, denoted by the identifier "urn:nasa:pds:context:instrument_host:spacecraft.v5," is a vehicle designed for space travel and exploration, which includes various instruments and equipment for scientific research and mission objectives.
73e15018-b693-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: James Webb Space Telescope

73e7d494-b7a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Biaxial Fluxgate Magnetometer on GOES 1 is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields at synchronous altitude, featuring two sensors aligned parallel and perpendicular to the spacecraft's spin axis, with selectable measurement ranges and calibration capabilities.
73e7d494-b7a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on GOES 1

73f6fb04-b67d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Piera Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Piera, Catalonia, Spain. It is recognized by the International Astronomical Union with the code 165 and specializes in ground-based observations.
73f6fb04-b67d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Piera Observatory

74047104-b857-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 2A Optical Photometer** is an instrument designed to detect visible light emissions near 486.1 nm during relativistic electron precipitation events, specifically aimed at identifying the presence of protons accompanying these electrons and understanding their interaction mechanisms.
74047104-b857-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Visible Light Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses Photometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses mission

7407a044-b998-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Windsor Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Windsor Downs, New South Wales, Australia, known for its ground-based observations.
7407a044-b998-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Windsor Observatory, Australia

7407a150-b71f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) station at Chiang Mai, Thailand is a ground-based facility developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research (ISEE), Nagoya University, to study upper atmospheric dynamics through nocturnal airglow emissions.
7407a150-b71f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers at ISEE OMTI Chiang Mai Station, Thailand

7409cf90-b96b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Kamenskoe Plateau Observatory is an astronomical observatory founded in 1947 and located in Almaty, Kazakhstan, within the grounds of the Fesenkov Astrophysical Institute.
7409cf90-b96b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kamenskoe Plateau Observatory, Kazakhstan

7418b920-b8e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Hottviller Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Hottviller, France. It is a ground-based observatory used for astronomical research and observations.
7418b920-b8e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hottviller Observatory, France

741d392e-b6df-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Giotto Magnetometer (MAG) Experiment was an instrument onboard the Giotto spacecraft designed to measure magnetic fields using triaxial and biaxial fluxgate sensors, addressing magnetic contamination challenges due to the lack of a magnetometer boom during its mission to comet 1P/Halley.
741d392e-b6df-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Giotto Spacecraft

7420722e-b964-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The San Marco-D/L (or San Marco 5) was a spacecraft designed to study the relationship between solar activity and thermosphere-ionosphere phenomena. Launched in 1988, it carried various scientific instruments and had a planned operational lifetime of one year.
7420722e-b964-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Drag Balance Instrument part of San Marco-D/L

742221aa-b8d8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The SFA Observatory is an astronomical observatory situated near Nacogdoches, Texas, operated by Stephen F. Austin State University for both undergraduate teaching and graduate research since its opening in 1976.
742221aa-b8d8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stephen F. Austin Observatory

7427ff9a-b7ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Hartley Wintney Observatory (MPC code: I67) is an astronomical observatory located in Hartley Wintney, Hampshire, England. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
7427ff9a-b7ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hartley Wintney Observatory, United Kingdom

742c33a0-b920-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 15 lunar module "Falcon" was the fourth crewed vehicle to land on the Moon, carrying astronauts David R. Scott and James B. Irwin along with scientific experiments and equipment including a Lunar Roving Vehicle (LRV) and an Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package (ALSEP).
742c33a0-b920-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lunar Roving Vehicle and Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package part of Falcon

742d3464-ba4a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Viking Lander 2 Spacecraft Gas Chromatograph Mass Spectrometer (GCMS) was an instrument on the Viking Lander 2 designed to analyze chemical compounds in Mars' surface layer and measure atmospheric composition through gas chromatography and mass spectrometry.
742d3464-ba4a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gas Chromatograph Mass Spectrometer on Viking Lander 2 Spacecraft

742f13e6-b9c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Osservatorio La Dehesilla** is an astronomical observatory located in Alhaurín de la Torre, Málaga, Spain. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
742f13e6-b9c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatorio La Dehesilla at Alhaurín de la Torre Observatory, Spain

74389f8c-bbc8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The PROMICS-3 instrument is a plasma experiment on the Interball Auroral Probe that performs three-dimensional measurements of ions and electrons within specific energy ranges, using toroidal electrostatic analyzers for mass separation.
74389f8c-bbc8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electrostatic Analyzer part of Ion Composition and Energy on Interball Auroral Probe

74393b1e-bb1d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The High-Energy Electron Fluxmeter (HEEF) on CRRES was an instrument designed to measure the differential energy spectrum of electrons in the range of 1 to 10 MeV, featuring a three-element telescope with advanced shielding and detection capabilities for radiation belt modeling.
74393b1e-bb1d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: High-Energy Electron Fluxmeter on CRRES

7439fb3c-b69d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MDM Observatory is an astronomical facility that includes the 2.4m Hiltner Telescope, used for ground-based observations and research in astronomy.
7439fb3c-b69d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.4m Hiltner Telescope at MDM Observatory

7447a922-b1bf-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Instituto de Astrofisica de Canarias Gregory Coude Telescope (GCT) is a solar telescope located at the Observatorio del Teide on Tenerife, dedicated to observing the Sun and conducting astrophysical research.
7447a922-b1bf-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Instituto de Astrofisica de Canarias Gregory Coude Telescope at Observatorio del Teide

744bccfc-b74e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Keck II telescope is a 10-meter Ritchey-Chretien altazimuth reflector located at the W.M. Keck Observatory on Mauna Kea, Hawaii, operational since April 1996 and known for its optical observations.
744bccfc-b74e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 10m W. M. Keck II Telescope at W. M. Keck Observatory

7451923c-b621-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hemet Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Riverside County, California, United States, designated with the MPC code G54.
7451923c-b621-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hemet Observatory, United States

7457e2c0-bc18-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ISEE Magnetometer** is an induction magnetometer located at Moshiri, Japan, that measures variations in the 3-D vector geomagnetic field with a sampling rate of 64 Hz. It is part of the International Geomagnetic Reference Field (IGRF) and contributes to global geomagnetic data collection.
7457e2c0-bc18-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Induction Magnetometer part of International Sun-Earth Explorer Magnetometer Data

745b9c8c-b8ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetic Field Experiment (MFE) is a scientific instrument on the AMPTE-CCE mission featuring a fluxgate magnetometer sensor that measures magnetic field vectors with high sensitivity and dynamic range, providing data from 1984 to 1989.
745b9c8c-b8ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetic Field Experiment on AMPTE-CCE

74641aae-ba33-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Spaceguard Centre is an astronomical observatory located in Knighton, Powys, Wales. It specializes in tracking and studying near-Earth objects (NEOs) to understand potential hazards they pose to Earth.
74641aae-ba33-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spaceguard Centre Observatory, United Kingdom

74675672-b13e-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DSS-61 is a 26-meter (later upgraded to 34-meter) radio telescope located at the Madrid Deep Space Communications Complex in Spain, operated by NASA and part of the Deep Space Network.
74675672-b13e-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Deep Space Station 61 on Madrid Deep Space Communications Complex, Spain

7480a78c-b0fb-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the "FAST spacecraft position" in the GSE coordinate system, which is part of the FAST observatory and provides ephemeris data for the platform.
7480a78c-b0fb-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform part of Fast Auroral Snapshot Explorer

7483111a-b76e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Imaging Photopolarimeter (IPP) for Pioneer 10** was an instrument on the Pioneer 10 spacecraft designed to measure light intensity and polarization, providing valuable data about Jupiter's cloud particles, gas abundance, and producing digitally processed images of the planet.
7483111a-b76e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Imaging Photopolarimeter on Pioneer 10

748ac8ee-b933-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MF (Medium Frequency) radar at the Pontianak observatory in Indonesia is a scientific instrument used to measure wind velocity in the mesosphere and lower thermosphere, operating at 1.98 MHz with a peak power of 25 kW since 1995.
748ac8ee-b933-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Medium Frequency Radar part of Equatorial Atmosphere Dynamics Experiment

748f0620-bb6d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Isaac Newton Group (ING) 4.2m William Herschel Telescope (WHT) is an optical telescope located at the Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos in Africa, featuring a 4.2-meter aperture and used for astronomical observations.
748f0620-bb6d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 4.2m optical William Herschel Telescope at Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos

7496d00c-bb73-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Robotic Optical Transient Search Experiment (ROTSE)** is an astronomical observatory project consisting of multiple telescopes designed to detect and study the optical afterglows of gamma-ray bursts. The telescopes are strategically placed in various locations around the world, including Australia, Namibia, Turkey, and at the McDonald Observatory near Fort Davis, Texas.
7496d00c-bb73-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Robotic Optical Transient Search Experiment

7499a252-b81f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The LANL1991 Energetic Sensor for Particles (ESP) is an instrument designed to measure higher-energy particles since 1989. It utilizes a bismuth germanate crystal coupled with a thick plastic scintillator and a photomultiplier tube to detect the spectrum of electrons from 0.7 to 26 MeV and protons from 11 to >20 MeV.
7499a252-b81f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energy Spectrometer for Particles on LANL 1991 Observatory

749c3928-b936-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Visible Airglow Photometer (VAE)** on the AE-E satellite was an instrument designed to measure the excitation rates of atomic and molecular constituents in the thermosphere, utilizing two optical channels with different fields of view and multiple interference filters.
749c3928-b936-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Visible Airglow Photometer on Atmosphere Explorer-E

749f453e-b740-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Fiamene Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Verona, Italy, specifically at Via Papa Luciani, Saline, Fane, Negrar di Valpolicella.
749f453e-b740-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fiamene Observatory

749fbc5e-b73f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "CPMN fluxgate magnetometer at YAP" is a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer situated in Yap, Federated States of Micronesia (FSM), part of the IUGONET observatory network.
749fbc5e-b73f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Circum-Pan Pacific Magnetometer Network

74ab8cce-b711-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Masquefa Observatory, located in Catalonia, Spain, is an astronomical observatory with the Minor Planet Center (MPC) ID 232.
74ab8cce-b711-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Masquefa Observatory, Spain

74ae8b98-ba6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Venera 6 Energetic Particles experiment** was a suite of particle detectors on the Soviet Venera 6 spacecraft designed to measure medium-energy charged particles in interplanetary space during its journey and approach to Venus.
74ae8b98-ba6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particles on Venera 6

74af52ec-b94a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EISCAT Svalbard Radar (Fixed Antenna) is a research instrument operated by the EISCAT Scientific Association that uses incoherent scatter radar techniques to measure electron density and temperature, ion density, temperature, and velocity in the Earth's ionosphere. It is located in Longyearbyen, Svalbard, and contributes to studies of Sun-Earth interactions, including phenomena like auroras.
74af52ec-b94a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar part of European Incoherent Scatter Scientific Association at Svalbard Observatory

74b6c2aa-bbb3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Worthington (WRTH) Fluxgate Magnetometer is an instrument within the Mid-continent Magnetoseismic Chain (McMAC) observatory network, designed to measure magnetic field variations.
74b6c2aa-bbb3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Mid-continent Magnetoseismic Chain

74b7b8d6-bb7c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Advanced Space-based Solar Observatory (ASO-S) is a Chinese satellite mission launched in 2022 to study solar activity, particularly flares and coronal mass ejections (CMEs), with the goal of understanding their formation mechanisms and improving space weather forecasting.
74b7b8d6-bb7c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: x-ray Advanced Space-based Solar Observatory part of Kuafu

74bda5e2-b826-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Wayside Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Minnetonka, Minnesota, United States, identified by the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code 855.
74bda5e2-b826-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wayside Observatory, United States

74bdba0a-bbaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Wallops Island (WLPS) Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS GBO Network, used to measure magnetic field variations since 2012.
74bdba0a-bbaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Wallops Island Observatory

74be2e8c-b6c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Homburg-Erbach Observatory (Q113716385) is an astronomical observatory located in Erbach, Saarland, Germany. It is identified by the Minor Planet Center with the code 196 and operates as a ground-based facility.
74be2e8c-b6c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Homburg-Erbach Observatory, Germany

74bff788-b5e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Electric and Magnetic Field Instrument Suite and Integrated Science (EMFISIS) is an instrument suite on the Radiation Belt Storm Probe (RBSP) mission designed to measure electric and magnetic fields, providing crucial data for understanding plasma wave dynamics and particle acceleration processes within Earth's radiation belts.
74bff788-b5e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electric and Magnetic Field Instrument Suite and Integrated Science part of Radiation Belt Storm Probe

74cbd98e-bb3a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **WestRock Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located at the Coca-Cola Space Science Center in Columbus, Georgia. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to stargazing and celestial observations.
74cbd98e-bb3a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: WestRock Observatory at Coca-Cola Space Science Center, United States

74d42c52-b71a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Galactic and Solar Cosmic Ray Experiment on Helios-B** (E7) was an instrument on the Helios-2 spacecraft designed to measure cosmic rays, including electrons, protons, and alpha particles within specific energy ranges. It consisted of three dE/dx vs E telescopes and a proportional counter for monitoring solar X-rays between 2-8 keV.
74d42c52-b71a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Galactic and Solar Cosmic Ray Experiment part of Helios B

74daed72-b71e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Dome Fuji is a ground-based observatory facility located in Antarctica, specifically at Dome Fuji Station. It operated from 1995 to 2003 and was equipped with magnetometers for scientific research.
74daed72-b71e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Dome Fuji Observatory, Antarctica

74e49322-b926-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Ilorin station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Ilorin, Nigeria, which operates as part of the MAGDAS magnetometer network under ICSWSE.
74e49322-b926-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ilorin Observatory, Nigeria

74e7dca2-b7a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences (NAOC) 1m Ritchey Chretien Cassegrain Telescope (RCCT) is a 1-meter optical telescope located at the Yunnan Astronomical Observatory in Asia.
74e7dca2-b7a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences 1m Ritchey Chretien Cassegrain Telescope at Yunnan Astronomical Observatory

74ebbc52-b907-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Matera Laser Ranging Observatory (MLRO) is an astronomical facility located in Matera, Italy. It specializes in laser ranging techniques to measure distances to satellites and other space objects for geodetic research.
74ebbc52-b907-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Matera Laser Ranging Observatory, Italy

74f563e4-b6a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Lamalou-les-Bains Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Lamalou-les-Bains, France. It is a ground-based facility used for studying celestial bodies and phenomena from Earth.
74f563e4-b6a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lamalou-les-Bains Observatory, France

75051d46-b6a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer deployed as part of the JMA electrometer investigation, this geo-electric field sensor consists of perpendicularly aligned N-S and E-W lines with copper plates, designed to measure variations in the Earth's electric field at the Kakioka observatory.
75051d46-b6a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IUGONET Observatory

75072da2-bc45-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Calvin–Rehoboth Robotic Observatory is an astronomical observatory collaboratively operated by Calvin University in Michigan and Rehoboth Christian School in New Mexico, featuring identical telescopes at each location for student use.
75072da2-bc45-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Calvin–Rehoboth Robotic Observatory, United States

751dd78e-b9c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Radio Science Subsystem for VEX** (Venus Express) was a comprehensive system used to conduct radiometric and radio propagation measurements to study Venus's gravity field, atmospheric conditions, and surface properties through various antenna configurations and frequency bands.
751dd78e-b9c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Science Subsystem part of Venus Express Mission

75202406-b709-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Bastia Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Bastia, Ravenna, Emilia-Romagna, Italy. It is a ground-based facility with the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code 197.
75202406-b709-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bastia Observatory, Italy

752940f2-b8fa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Wakkanai ionospheric radar facility is a ground-based observatory located in Wakkanai, Hokkaido, Japan, operated by the National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT), used for studying the Earth's ionosphere.
752940f2-b8fa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionospheric Radar Facility at Wakkanai Observatory, Japan

75350352-b700-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Kenai Geophysical Observatory, operational since 2016 and part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG, used for measuring magnetic field variations.
75350352-b700-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kenai Geophysical Observatory

754b370c-b6f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ALPHA Observatory** in South Laurel is a ground-based observatory located at Capitol Technology University in Maryland. It serves as an astronomical facility for educational and research purposes.
754b370c-b6f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ALPHA Observatory

754fee8e-b7bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
NEO Surveyor is a spacecraft designed for the study and surveillance of Near-Earth Objects (NEOs).
754fee8e-b7bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: NEO Surveyor

755029aa-b9e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **Magnetometer** is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The **CPMN fluxgate magnetometer at MSR**, specifically, is a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer installed in Moshiri, Japan, part of the IUGONET observatory network.
755029aa-b9e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Circum-pan Pacific Magnetometer Network observation network

755e3894-bbd8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Bibai Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Bibai, Sorachi Subprefecture, Hokkaido Prefecture, Japan. It operates as a ground-based facility with the MPC code 406 and focuses on astronomical observations.
755e3894-bbd8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bibai Observatory, Japan

755e8c86-b5f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Talara Geomagnetic Observatory** is a ground-based facility located in Talara, Peru, that operated from July 1958 to December 31, 1960.
755e8c86-b5f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Talara Geomagnetic Observatory, Peru

755f0574-bb94-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer at TGG is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed in Tuguegarao, Philippines, used to measure the Earth's magnetic field as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
755f0574-bb94-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

756269b0-b74f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** BARREL Balloon 2C was a high-altitude balloon mission, part of the BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) project, designed to study electrons escaping from Earth's radiation belts. It operated in the stratosphere from January 20, 2014, to January 25, 2014, carrying instruments like a NaI scintillator and a DC magnetometer for scientific measurements.
756269b0-b74f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Instrument on Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses

757063cc-b735-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The UCL Observatory, formerly known as the University of London Observatory, is an astronomical teaching observatory located at Mill Hill in London, and it operates under the Department of Physics and Astronomy at University College London.
757063cc-b735-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: University College London Observatory at Mill Hill, United Kingdom

7574fc58-b72f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **THEMIS_D**: A satellite in the THEMIS constellation, designed to study magnetospheric substorms and their impact on Earth's geomagnetic field as part of NASA's Explorer program.
7574fc58-b72f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.84m Time History of Events and Macroscale Interactions during Substorms on THEMIS

7575bdf8-bab0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Fluxgate Magnetometer (FGM)** on Double Star 2 is an instrument designed to measure magnetic fields, positioned at the end of a 3.5-meter boom and capable of sampling the field at a rate of 67 samples per second. The principal investigator for this instrument is T. Zhang from IWF, Austria.
7575bdf8-bab0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer on Double Star 2

757a0af0-bbd9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mauna Kea Observatory is a ground-based astronomical observatory located on the summit of Mauna Kea in Hawaii, featuring multiple telescopes including the 2.24-meter University of Hawaii telescope and NASA's 3-meter Infrared Telescope Facility (IRTF).
757a0af0-bbd9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.4m Telescope at Mauna Kea Observatory and 3m Infrared Telescope Facility on NASA IRTF

757b0f0e-b6de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Hobbs Observatory is an astronomical observatory in Wisconsin owned by the University of Wisconsin–Eau Claire and serves as a hub for both academic research and community engagement through astronomy.
757b0f0e-b6de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hobbs Observatory, United States

758995f8-b8f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) station in Ithaca, USA, was a ground-based facility developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research to study upper atmospheric dynamics through nocturnal airglow emissions.
758995f8-b8f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers at Ithaca Observatory, United States

7589e056-ba17-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Terre Adelie Magnetometer, operational since January 1957, is a ground-based instrument used for measuring magnetic fields at the IAGA station in Terre Adelie.
7589e056-ba17-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Terre Adelie Observatory, Antarctica

759bee28-b714-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gumma Astronomical Observatory is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Takayama Onsen Fureai Plaza, Gunma Prefecture, Japan. It is situated at coordinates 36.596424 latitude and 138.9728 longitude on the continent of Asia.
759bee28-b714-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.65m Telescope at Gunma Astronomical Observatory, Japan

75acadde-b9b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Australia Telescope National Facility (ATNF)/Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO) 22m Mopra Radio Telescope is a radio telescope located in Australia with an aperture of 22 meters, designed for observing radio wavebands.
75acadde-b9b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: radio Australia Telescope National Facility Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation 22m Mopra Radio Telescope, Australia

75b0a828-bb96-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **MMS 1 Energetic Particle Detector (EPD) Suite, Energetic Ion Spectrometer (EIS)** is an instrument onboard the Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission (MMS) that uses a time-of-flight/pulse-height sensor to measure ion composition and angular distributions in the energy range of ~45 keV to 500 keV, with a temporal resolution of 30 seconds.
75b0a828-bb96-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Detector Suite, Energetic Ion Spectrometer part of Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission

75b4634a-ba7a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The European Southern Observatory (ESO)/Max Planck Gesellschaft (MPG) 2.2m Telescope is a 2.2-meter optical telescope located at the La Silla Observatory in South America, operated jointly by ESO and MPG for astronomical research.
75b4634a-ba7a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.2m Telescope at La Silla Observatory

75b985b0-b5b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Mars Express (MEX) Crustal Magnetic Field Analytical Models" are scientific tools used to analyze and interpret the magnetic fields of Mars' crust. These models are part of the CDPP-AMDA observatory within the CNES Mars Express mission, aiding in understanding the planet's geological history through its magnetic properties.
75b985b0-b5b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mars Crustal Magnetic Field Analytical Models part of Mars Express

75bb4a8a-bbb9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lindenberg Observatory is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Lindenberg, Tauche, Brandenburg, Germany. It operates at the coordinates 52.20891° N latitude and 14.1222° E longitude within Europe.
75bb4a8a-bbb9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lindenberg Observatory, Germany

75be1e16-b5ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Happy Valley Observatory (MPC ID: 484) is an astronomical observatory located in Wellington, New Zealand. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
75be1e16-b5ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Happy Valley Observatory

75cce556-b5e7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Novi Ligure Observatory is an astronomical facility located in the city of Novi Ligure, Italy, on Earth. It operates as a ground-based observatory for studying celestial phenomena.
75cce556-b5e7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Novi Ligure Observatory, Italy

75cee846-bb5b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The **El Leoncito Astronomical Complex (CASLEO)** is an observatory located in San Juan, Argentina, known for housing the 2.15m Jorge Sahade telescope and conducting ground-based astronomical observations.
75cee846-bb5b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.15m Jorge Sahade Telescope at El Leoncito Astronomical Complex, Argentina

75d27e34-b5a2-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Inter-regional Geomagnetic Data Center of the Russian-Ukrainian INTERMAGNET segment**, operated by the Geophysical Center of the Russian Academy of Sciences (GC RAS), collects and transmits geomagnetic data from observatories in Russia and Ukraine, featuring an automated system for real-time recognition of artificial disturbances.
75d27e34-b5a2-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Geomagnetic Data Center Russia Ukraine

75d7848c-b7b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The EPI-Hi/HET instrument aboard the Parker Solar Probe is a high energy telescope designed to measure energetic protons, Helium nuclei, and electrons within specific energy ranges. It is part of the Integrated Science Investigation of the Sun (ISOIS) suite and aims to study solar energetic particle sources, acceleration, and transport near the Sun.
75d7848c-b7b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Instrument-Hi on Parker Solar Probe

75db82ec-b8de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Royal Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Greenwich Park, London. It played a significant role in the history of astronomy and navigation and is known for being the location through which the Prime Meridian passes, establishing Greenwich Mean Time.
75db82ec-b8de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Royal Observatory Greenwich, United Kingdom

75df6e92-b74a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 30MHz Imaging Riometer (IRIO) at Syowa Station, Antarctica, is an instrument used for atmospheric research. It features an 8x8-element dipole antenna array that produces 8x8 independent beams covering an area of about 180km x 180km at the D region altitude.
75df6e92-b74a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Imaging Riometer on IUGONET Observatory, Antarctica

75e47cd8-b96c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of Tasmania 14m Vela Antenna is a radio telescope located at the Mount Pleasant Radio Observatory in Australia. It has an aperture of 14 meters and operates within the radio waveband.
75e47cd8-b96c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 14.0m Vela Antenna at Mount Pleasant Radio Observatory, Australia

75e5e0d6-b8dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Allen Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in McKinney, Texas, dedicated to ground-based observations.
75e5e0d6-b8dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Allen Observatory, United States

75efc460-b5c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Wakayama Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Wakayama, Japan, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial bodies.
75efc460-b5c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wakayama Observatory, Japan

75f2db2a-bb38-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Karlovy Vary Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in the Czech Republic. It is a ground-based facility situated in Karlovy Vary, primarily used for astronomical observations and research.
75f2db2a-bb38-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Karlovy Vary Observatory, Czechia

75f7b470-ba29-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Frignano Observatory (code: 146, MPC ID: 146) is an astronomical ground-based observatory located in Via Borrasilano, Casa Amorotti, Piane di Mocogno, Lama Mocogno, Modena, Emilia-Romagna, Italy. It operates on Earth and is part of the Frignano region in Europe.
75f7b470-ba29-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Frignano Observatory, Italy

7609bf64-b8a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Irydeo Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Camarma de Esteruelas, Spain. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical observations and research.
7609bf64-b8a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Irydeo Observatory, Spain

7620142c-b14d-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Chibougamau Magnetometer, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAGs, is a ground-based instrument located at the Chibougamau Geophysical Observatory in Canada, designed to measure magnetic field variations and contribute to space weather research.
7620142c-b14d-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Chibougamau Geophysical Observatory

762152e4-b777-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Philadelphia Observatory was a ground-based facility located in Fairmount, Pennsylvania, operational from 1840 to 1845, primarily involved in magnetometer observations as part of the IAGA network.
762152e4-b777-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Philadelphia Observatory, United States

762c3d2a-bc55-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1D Magnetometer** is a three-axis magnetometer with 50 nT resolution used in the BARREL project to measure magnetic field variations and identify substorm activity and ULF oscillations. It is equipped with tilt compensation to differentiate horizontal and vertical components of the magnetic field.
762c3d2a-bc55-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

762cd572-bb61-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Yatsugatake South Base Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Hokuto, Yamanashi, Japan. It is known for its ground-based observations and has the observatory code 896.
762cd572-bb61-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Yatsugatake South Base Observatory, Japan

762fc94a-ba98-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA station identified as AMN in Ambarnaya, part of the observatory network managed by WDC Kyoto.
762fc94a-ba98-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of International Monitor for Auroral Geomagnetic Effects

76351e3e-b72a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Piszkéstető Station is an astronomical observatory located in the Mátra mountains of Hungary, known for its ground-based observations and research activities since 1958.
76351e3e-b72a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Piszkés tető Observatory, Hungary

7640fdd2-b74b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at Cape Denison from 1912 to 1931, part of the IAGA investigation and the IUGONET Observatory network.
7640fdd2-b74b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Cape Denison Observatory, Antarctica

764a7092-ba3e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Red Mountain Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Mesa, Arizona, United States, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial phenomena.
764a7092-ba3e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Red Mountain Observatory, United States

764dfc5e-b9a7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Landéhen Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Brittany, France, designed for ground-based observations of celestial phenomena.
764dfc5e-b9a7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Landéhen Observatory, France

764fecca-bc19-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Venera 5 Energetic Particles experiment was a Soviet instrument suite designed to measure the flux of charged particles in interplanetary space during the cruise and Venus approach phases of the mission. It specifically monitored protons and electrons within defined energy ranges from various directions relative to the Sun.
764fecca-bc19-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particles Experiment on Venera 5

76537834-bafe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **IAGA: UCC Magnetometer** was an instrument used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field at a ground-based station in Uccle from January 1896 to December 31, 1919. It was part of an observatory linked with IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy).
76537834-bafe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Uccle Observatory

7655d32c-b6f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Preobrazhenia is a ground-based observatory located in the Sakha Republic, Far Eastern Federal District, Russia, primarily known for its magnetometer instrument used for geomagnetic research. It operates as part of the IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) network.
7655d32c-b6f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Preobrazhenia Observatory, Russia

76564354-b674-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hennef Observatory is an astronomical facility located in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It operates as a ground-based observatory and contributes to astronomical research with the MPC ID B43.
76564354-b674-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hennef Observatory, Germany

7663ac3a-b5fa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at Niemegk (NGK) is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields, particularly for geomagnetic observations. It has been operational since January 1, 1930, as part of the IUGONET Observatory network managed by the WDC Kyoto.
7663ac3a-b5fa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Niemegk Observatory

766a9e16-ba76-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Bettles Magnetometer is an instrument located at the Bettles Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG, designed to measure magnetic field variations starting from January 1, 2007.
766a9e16-ba76-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Bettles Geophysical Observatory

766b2de8-bb54-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** SkyMapper is a fully automated 1.35-meter wide-angle optical telescope located at the Siding Spring Observatory in Australia, known for its large field of view and multi-wavelength imaging capabilities.
766b2de8-bb54-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.69m SkyMapper at Siding Spring Observatory, Australia

766cb7fa-b7f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Steward Observatory 1.54m (61-inch) Kuiper Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Catalina Station in North America, part of NASA's astronomical facilities.
766cb7fa-b7f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical Steward Observatory 1.54m Kuiper Telescope at Catalina Station

76741636-b8fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The SOLIS telescope is an optical facility located at Kitt Peak National Observatory in North America, dedicated to long-term observations of the Sun.
76741636-b8fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical National Solar Observatory Synoptic Optical Long Term Investigations of the Sun at Kitt Peak National Observatory

7675e526-b8d9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The BARREL Balloon 2B was a component of the BARREL mission, which involved launching multiple balloons into the stratosphere to study electron loss from Earth's radiation belts. It operated from January 17, 2014, to February 8, 2014, and carried instruments like a NaI scintillator and a DC magnetometer for scientific measurements.
7675e526-b8d9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Investigation part of Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses

767beffa-b6d3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AVON (Asia VLF Observation Network) Tainan station, located in Shalun Village, Annan District, Tainan, Taiwan, is a ground-based facility designed for observing Very Low Frequency (VLF) radio waves. It is part of the broader Asia VLF Observation Network and contributes to scientific research by monitoring electromagnetic phenomena in the Earth's atmosphere.
767beffa-b6d3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Asia VLF Observation Network Tainan station at AVON Tainan Observatory, Taiwan

7684d47e-b86f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Lunar Imager/SpectroMeter (LISM) is an instrument onboard the Kaguya spacecraft designed to obtain topographic and mineralogical data of the Moon's surface for detailed geological mapping.
7684d47e-b86f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lunar Imager and SpectroMeter on Kaguya

7686bcc2-b63e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Requena Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Requena, Valencia, Spain. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
7686bcc2-b63e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Requena Observatory, Spain

76897d4a-bac6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Meteor Radar (MR) at Bear Island, located between Tromsø and Longyearbyen, is an instrument used for observing wind velocities in the mesosphere and lower thermosphere since 2007. It is part of the IUGONET observatory network and operates similarly to radars in Tromsø and Longyearbyen.
76897d4a-bac6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar at ISEE Observatory, Bearild

768be196-bb0e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Autonomous Adaptive Low-Power Instrument Platform (AAL-PIP) chain is a network of six autonomous stations equipped with Fluxgate magnetometers, established along the 40° geomagnetic meridian on the East Antarctic Plateau to monitor magnetic field variations.
768be196-bb0e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of Autonomous Adaptive Low-Power Instrument Platform Chain

768f5c0e-b884-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Global Surveyor (MGS) was a NASA spacecraft launched in 1996 to conduct global mapping of Mars. It collected data on the planet's surface morphology, topography, composition, gravity, atmospheric dynamics, and magnetic field from 1997 until communication was lost in 2006.
768f5c0e-b884-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Accelerometer on Mars Global Surveyor

769284f2-b658-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Priddis Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation since October 2005.
769284f2-b658-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Priddis Observatory

76938f08-b7f4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Drebach-South Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Windhoek, Khomas Region, Namibia. It operates as a ground-based facility and can be found at the coordinates 18.0169 longitude and -23.460102 latitude.
76938f08-b7f4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Drebach-South Observatory

7697a9cc-b5b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The OSIRIS-REx Radio Science Subsystem (RSS) is a component of the OSIRIS-REx spacecraft that includes X-band transponders, amplifiers, and multiple antennas to facilitate radio science experiments and communication.
7697a9cc-b5b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Science and Telecom Subsystem on OSIRIS-REx

76a7ebac-b7bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Ager Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Àger, Catalonia, Spain. It operates as a ground-based observatory and is part of the Parc Astronòmic Montsec.
76a7ebac-b7bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ager Observatory, Spain

76bc482e-b7c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Burlington Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Burlington Township, New Jersey, dedicated to ground-based observations.
76bc482e-b7c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Burlington Observatory, United States

76beadd2-b70e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: BARREL Balloon 2D was a component of the BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) mission, designed to study the escape of particles from Earth's radiation belts by measuring Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating relativistic electrons.
76beadd2-b70e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses, part of Living with a Star

76c2c2d6-b59d-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AMPTE/IRM Plasma Instrument is a scientific device launched in 1984, designed to measure the complete 3-D velocity distribution function of plasma particles using quadrispherical electrostatic analyzers and microcomputers for real-time data processing.
76c2c2d6-b59d-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Plasma Instrument on AMPTE IRM

76c4787e-b683-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Solar Observatory (NSO) Hilltop Dome Facility at Sacramento Peak is an optical ground-observatory located in North America, specifically designed for observing the Sun.
76c4787e-b683-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: National Solar Observatory Hilltop Dome Facility at Sacramento Peak

76c5b6b8-b952-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Ojima Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Tokyo, Japan, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial phenomena. It is situated at FamilyMart on Shin Ohashi Dori Avenue in the Oshima district.
76c5b6b8-b952-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ojima Observatory, Japan

76c83084-b8bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lunar Crater Observation and Sensing Satellite (LCROSS) Near Infrared Spectrometer 2 (NSP2) was an instrument on the LCROSS mission designed to measure near-infrared emission reflectance spectrometry of the vapor plume and ejecta cloud resulting from the Centaur impact, focusing on grain properties and water features.
76c83084-b8bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Spectrometer 2 on Lunar Crater Observation and Sensing Satellite

76c8be0a-b89c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Ahmedabad observatory station identified by IAGA as AHM, operational since January 1973. This instrument is part of the IUGONET Observatory at WDC Kyoto and is used for geomagnetic measurements.
76c8be0a-b89c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ahmedabad Observatory

76cc5e2a-baae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Atacama Desert Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in San Pedro de Atacama, Chile. It operates as a ground-based facility situated in the Antofagasta Region of South America.
76cc5e2a-baae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Atacama Desert Observatory at San Pedro de Atacama, Chile

76ccf842-b97a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1T Optical Photometer** is an instrument designed to detect the flux of visible light at wavelengths near 486.1 nm, specifically during relativistic electron precipitation events, to determine the presence of protons accompanying these electrons and support the study of scattering by electromagnetic ion cyclotron waves as a precipitation mechanism.
76ccf842-b97a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Photometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

76d3c184-b6b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of Michigan Curtis Schmidt telescope is an optical telescope located at the NSF's Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory in South America.
76d3c184-b6b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Curtis Schmidt Telescope at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory

76db6900-b73a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The BARREL Balloon 2O was a scientific payload launched in 2014 as part of the BARREL mission, designed to study relativistic electron losses from Earth's radiation belts by measuring X-rays and magnetic fields in the stratosphere.
76db6900-b73a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses on BARREL

76e18f7a-bae5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTIs) station at Husafell, Iceland, is a ground-based observatory developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research to study upper atmospheric dynamics through nighttime airglow emissions. It operates in collaboration with the National Institute of Polar Research and the University of Iceland.
76e18f7a-bae5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers Husafell Station at Iceland Observatory

76ec0ed4-b688-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The SPAG Monfrague Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Palazuelo-Empalme, Spain. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to the observation of celestial bodies and phenomena from Earth.
76ec0ed4-b688-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Monfragüe Observatory, Spain

76fe5e58-b9a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mauritius Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Mauritius, known for housing the Mauritius Radio Telescope. It is dedicated to observing and studying celestial phenomena through radio astronomy.
76fe5e58-b9a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mauritius Radio Telescope at Mauritius Observatory

77072140-b7ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Highworth Observatory (MPC ID: 951) is an astronomical observatory located in Highworth, Swindon, England. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting various astronomical observations and studies.
77072140-b7ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Highworth Observatory, United Kingdom

770ae0b6-b6bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Hatizyo Geophysical Observatory, located in Hachijō, Tokyo, Japan, was a ground-based facility dedicated to geomagnetic measurements, operational from 1967 to 2009.
770ae0b6-b6bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hatizyo Geomagnetic Observatory, Japan

770d9c34-bc3c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AGO P3 Magnetometer Instrument is a device used for measuring magnetic fields, located at the AGO P3 ground station as part of the ICESTAR observatory.
770d9c34-bc3c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of International Conjugate Point Stations and Polar Cap

7711f244-b85d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Super Dual Auroral Radar Network (SuperDARN) is a global network of radars designed to study plasma convection in the Earth's upper atmosphere, consisting of 14 radars in the northern hemisphere and 7 in the southern hemisphere.
7711f244-b85d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Super Dual Auroral Radar Network

7712742c-ba87-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Fregenal de la Sierra Observatory (Z10) is an astronomical facility located in Fregenal de la Sierra, Spain, known as the PGC observatory. It operates as a ground-based observatory with coordinates at 353.37235 longitude and 38.215823 latitude.
7712742c-ba87-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fregenal de la Sierra Observatory, Spain

77173b68-b7f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kuchino Magnetometer was an instrument used for measuring magnetic fields, operational from 1926 to 1938 at the Kuchino station identified by IAGA as KTC.
77173b68-b7f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kuchino Observatory

7726bd7a-b9b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Mould Bay Magnetic Observatory was a ground-based facility in Nunavut, Canada, operated by the Geological Survey of Canada from 1962 to 1997 for monitoring magnetic field variations.
7726bd7a-b9b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Mould Bay Magnetic Observatory, Canada

772ad968-b5dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** GRAIL-A was one of two spacecraft in NASA's Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory (GRAIL) mission, designed to map the Moon's gravitational field to understand its internal structure and thermal evolution.
772ad968-b5dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lunar Gravity Ranging System on GRAIL-A part of Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory

772bc046-b837-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AMPTE CCE Hot Plasma Composition Experiment (HPCE) is an instrument on the Active Magnetospheric Particle Tracer Explorers-Charge Composition Explorer (AMPTE-CCE) spacecraft, designed to measure the composition and energy of ions and electrons in Earth's magnetosphere. It consists of an energetic ion mass spectrometer and an electron background-environment monitor.
772bc046-b837-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hot Plasma Composition Experiment on AMPTE CCE

773359d0-b974-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity describes the Digisonde ionospheric station located in Bermuda (BJJ32), which is an advanced facility that evaluates various characteristics of skywave signals reflected from the ionosphere.
773359d0-b974-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digisonde at Ionospheric Observatory in Bermuda

7733bd0e-ba5e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition**:
Explorer 52, also known as Hawkeye-1, was a NASA geomagnetic satellite launched in 1974 to study the Earth's polar magnetosphere and solar wind.
7733bd0e-ba5e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Hawkeye

7737822e-bbc9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The South Pole Neutron Monitor is an Energetic Particle Instrument located at the South Pole, designed to measure neutron fluxes for studying cosmic rays and solar particle events.
7737822e-bbc9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutron Monitor at Bartol Observatory, Antarctica

773b6310-ba7c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Butterfield Wind Tunnel is an open circulation, suction-style wind tunnel located at the Whitehead Aeronautical Laboratory, Queen Mary University of London. It has a length of 3 meters and a cross-sectional area of 0.16 by 0.16 meters.
773b6310-ba7c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Butterfield Wind Tunnel at Whitehead Aeronautical Laboratory

77423faa-bb76-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity represents the Deep Space Station 15 (DSS-15), a ground-based observatory. It is identified by the code 399015 and categorized under facilities for ground observation, as defined by the VoParis namespace.
77423faa-bb76-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: DSS-15

774da192-bb17-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Fluxgate Magnetometer** on ISEE 1 was a tri-axial instrument designed to study magnetic signatures of magnetospheric phenomena and waves. It featured three orthogonal ring-core sensors with two operating ranges (+/- 8192 nT and +/- 256 nT) and provided high-resolution data crucial for various spacecraft experiments until its re-entry in 1987.
774da192-bb17-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer and Tri-axial on ISEE 1 part of International Sun/Earth Explorer Mission

77580e6c-b8ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ARIES 1m Sampurnanand Telescope is a ground-based observatory facility located at the Aryabhatta Research Institute of Observational Sciences (ARIES), equipped for optical astronomical observations. It's part of a larger network of facilities dedicated to scientific research and observation.
77580e6c-b8ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.0m Sampurnanand Telescope at Aryabhatta Research Institute of Observational Sciences

7773f956-ba1c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Wallops Island Geophysical Observatory (WLPS), located in Virginia, USA, is a ground-based facility that includes instruments such as magnetometers and is part of the McMac observatory network.
7773f956-ba1c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Wallops Island Geophysical Observatory, United States

777724b4-bb84-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Advanced Camera for Surveys (ACS) is an imaging instrument on the Hubble Space Telescope designed to capture high-resolution images across near-infrared to ultraviolet wavelengths, featuring three observing modes: a wide-field channel (WFC), a high-resolution channel (HRC), and a solar blind channel (SBC).
777724b4-bb84-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near-infrared to ultraviolet Advanced Camera for Surveys on Hubble Space Telescope

7777a8ac-b793-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Magnetometers at Poker Flat (POK)" is a magnetometer instrument located at the observatory identified by IAGA as POK in Tohoku University's Optical Observatory, used for magnetic field measurements and part of the international IUGONET network.
7777a8ac-b793-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tohoku University Optical and Infrared Astronomy Observatory Poker Flat Station

777b1062-b89e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Alder Springs Observatory**: A ground-based astronomical observatory located in Auberry, California, operated by Sierra Remote Observatories.
777b1062-b89e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Alder Springs Observatory, United States

777b522e-b818-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 2P magnetometer is a three-axis instrument used to measure magnetic field components with high resolution and identify substorm activity and ULF oscillations for studying electron precipitation modulations.
777b522e-b818-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

777e6906-b6d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of California, Berkeley Hat Creek Observatory is a ground-based observatory located in Hat Creek, California. It includes the Berkeley-Illinois-Maryland Array (BIMA) and is dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
777e6906-b6d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Berkeley Illinois Maryland Array at Hat Creek Observatory

777ec87e-b781-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU Radio Beacon Receiver (GRBR) is a digital receiver located in Hue, Vietnam, designed to measure ionospheric total electron content using LEO satellite signals, employing open-source software and hardware for signal processing.
777ec87e-b781-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU Radio Beacon Receiver at Hue Observatory, Viet Nam

77828b72-b6a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Magnetometers at Durham" is an instrument located at the Durham station with the IAGA identifier DUR, designed to measure magnetic fields as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
77828b72-b6a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IUGONET Observatory

7787428e-bacd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Cesaraugusto Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Villamayor de Gállego, Zaragoza, Aragon, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
7787428e-bacd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cesaraugusto Observatory, Spain

778c2ce4-b858-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **DTU Space's Magnetic Ground Stations**: A network of ground facilities operated by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) that monitors Earth’s magnetic field, comprising 17 coastal stations in Greenland and additional sites in Denmark and the South Atlantic, providing high-resolution geomagnetic data.
778c2ce4-b858-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetic Ground Stations at Technical University of Denmark

77973062-bbe6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory (GRAIL) was an American lunar science mission in NASA's Discovery Program that used precise gravitational field mapping to study the Moon's interior structure. The mission consisted of two small spacecraft, GRAIL A (Ebb) and GRAIL B (Flow), launched on September 10, 2011, which orbited the Moon to gather detailed data about its mass distribution and internal composition.
77973062-bbe6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory part of Discovery Program

779b9ac4-b6f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity is the **Ionospheric Station at Chilton, United Kingdom (URSI-code: RL052)**, an advanced ionosonde facility that measures the angle of arrival, polarization, and Doppler frequency shift of skywave signals reflected from the ionosphere. It began operations on December 16, 1996, at 14:23:15 UTC and is located in Eton, England.
779b9ac4-b6f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionospheric Station at Chilton Observatory, United Kingdom

77a1749a-b935-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The IAGA:ZIN Magnetometer was an instrument used to measure magnetic fields at the Zinzen observatory from January 1921 to December 1941.
77a1749a-b935-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Zinzen Observatory

77a2915a-ba60-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The InSight Mars Lander Heat Flow and Physical Properties Package (HP3) was designed to measure heat flow on Mars using a "mole" to penetrate the subsurface and collect temperature data. The mole included heating foils for determining thermal conductivity but faced operational challenges, limiting its depth of penetration.
77a2915a-ba60-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Heat Flow and Physical Properties Package on InSight Mars Lander

77a29758-b642-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU Radio Beacon Receiver (GRBR) Station at Sarobetsu is an observatory located in Hokkaido Prefecture, Japan, dedicated to measuring ionospheric disturbances related to middle-upper atmospheric coupling processes.
77a29758-b642-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU radio beacon receiver station at Sarobetsu, Japan

77a65030-bb30-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tokyo Geomagnetic Observatory (TOK), located in Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan, was a ground-based facility dedicated to geophysical observations, specifically focusing on magnetometry. It operated from January 1, 1897, to December 31, 1912.
77a65030-bb30-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tokyo Geomagnetic Observatory, Japan

77c2b3f8-bbba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer used at the Masi (MAS) Geophysical Observatory as part of the THEMIS Mission Ground-Based Observatories network, operational since January 1, 2017.
77c2b3f8-bbba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of THEMIS Mission

77c2bc5e-b8a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Electric Field Instrument: Thermal Ion Imager (TII) is a scientific instrument launched in December 2013 aboard the SWARM-C satellite. It measures ion density, drift velocity, and electric fields using Langmuir Probes and thermal ion imaging techniques.
77c2bc5e-b8a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electric Field Instrument: Thermal Ion Imager part of Swarm-C

77ca2b5e-bab3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The X-Ray Spectrometer (XRS) was an instrument aboard the NEAR Shoemaker spacecraft designed to measure characteristic X-ray emissions from the surface of asteroid (433) Eros induced by solar flux.
77ca2b5e-bab3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-Ray Spectrometer on NEAR Shoemaker spacecraft

77cb9af4-b75a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **29PREMOTE Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Dauban, Banon, France. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
77cb9af4-b75a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatoire des Makes at Observatoire des Makes, France

77cc22ac-b5b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The VLF/ELF crossed loop antenna at Istok (near Norilsk), Russia, is an instrument designed to measure magnetic field variations in the very low frequency (VLF) and extremely low frequency (ELF) ranges. It features two perpendicular loops for North-South and East-West measurements, with a sensitivity peak at 8kHz and a sampling rate of 100kHz.
77cc22ac-b5b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Very Low Frequency and Extremely Low Frequency crossed loop antenna at Istok Observatory, Russia

77ce6c84-b8b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 12 Lunar Module, named "Intrepid," was the second crewed vehicle to land on the Moon. It carried astronauts Charles P. Conrad and Alan L. Bean, who conducted experiments and collected lunar samples during their mission in November 1969.
77ce6c84-b8b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lunar Module Intrepid part of Apollo 12

77db2cbe-b9b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Toronto Magnetic and Meteorological Observatory is a historical astronomical observatory located at the University of Toronto in Ontario, Canada. It was established in 1840 to study magnetic declination and later served as a primary meteorological station until its closure in 1898.
77db2cbe-b9b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Toronto Magnetic and Meteorological Observatory, Canada

77deb820-b7c1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Global Surveyor Spacecraft (MGS) Thermal Emission Spectrometer (TES) is an instrument onboard the MGS that measured thermal infrared radiation from the Martian surface to identify minerals and study the planet's temperature, atmosphere, and surface features. It contributed significantly to understanding Mars' composition and potential for past water activity by mapping key minerals like basalt and clay.
77deb820-b7c1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Thermal Emission Spectrometer on Mars Global Surveyor Spacecraft

77e1feba-b607-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Tuguegarao Station is a ground-based facility located in Tuguegarao, Philippines, that operates as part of the MAGDAS magnetometer network to monitor magnetic field variations.
77e1feba-b607-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at MAGDAS Tuguegarao Station, Philippines

77e723fe-b8d2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Las Cumbres 1m Telescopes equipped with Finger Lakes Instrumentation (FLI) Imager are part of the Las Cumbres Observatory Global Telescope Network, used for astronomical research and education through a worldwide network of telescopes.
77e723fe-b8d2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1m Las Cumbres Telescopes at Las Cumbres Observatory

77e76bc6-bb1a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAVEN (Mars Atmosphere and Volatile Evolution) spacecraft ephemeris is an instrument that provides detailed positional data for the MAVEN mission, launched in 2013 to study Mars' atmosphere under NASA’s Mars Scout Program.
77e76bc6-bb1a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spacecraft Ephemeris part of Mars Atmosphere and Volatile Evolution

77eda158-b962-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer installed in Trivandrum, India, as part of The Equatorial Magnetometer Network (EMN), used to measure magnetic field variations.
77eda158-b962-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of The Equatorial Magnetometer Network

77f2b5aa-b7ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **MMS 2 Active Spacecraft Potential Control (ASPOC) Instrument** is a spacecraft system that generates indium ion beams to regulate positive spacecraft potentials within +4V, enhancing the performance of other instruments onboard the MMS mission.
77f2b5aa-b7ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Active Spacecraft Potential Control part of Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission

7801893c-b71b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer operated in Spitsbergen from 1978 to 1979, part of the IAGA investigation and located at the observatory identified as SPB.
7801893c-b71b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Spitsbergen Observatory

7804c902-b627-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Berkeley Illinois Maryland Array (BIMA) was a millimeter-wave radio telescope array operated by the University of California, Berkeley at the Hat Creek Observatory in North America.
7804c902-b627-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Millimeter Berkeley Illinois Maryland Array at Hat Creek Observatory

78146bee-b859-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Launceston Station**: A ground-based observatory located in Launceston, Tasmania, that has been operational since June 2013 and includes a magnetometer instrument.
78146bee-b859-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Launceston Observatory, Australia

7816e1a0-b8bb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ultraviolet Spectrometer (OUVS) on the Pioneer Venus Orbiter was an instrument designed to study the upper atmosphere of Venus by measuring ultraviolet emissions, including airglow and scattered sunlight, to determine its composition, temperature, and photochemistry. It operated in the wavelength range of 1100-3400 Å.
7816e1a0-b8bb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet Spectrometer part of Pioneer Venus Orbiter

781d82fe-b603-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at Castle Rock (CRC), operational from 1970 to 1974, was used for magnetic field measurements as part of the IAGA investigation.
781d82fe-b603-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IAGA

78226c4a-bb28-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a magnetometer located at the ground-based observatory in Pleshenitsy, Russia, identified by the IAGA code MNK and operational since January 1, 1961.
78226c4a-bb28-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Pleshenitz Observatory

7837a218-b867-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Sverdlovsk/Yekaterinburg observatory is a ground-based facility in Yekaterinburg, Russia, that operated from 1841 to 1929 and was part of the IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) network.
7837a218-b867-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Sverdlovsk Observatory

783c7c1e-b706-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer operational from 1932 to 1957 located at the Elizabethville station, identified by IAGA as ELI.
783c7c1e-b706-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at IUGONET Observatory

783e8f4e-b671-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **University of Oklahoma Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located on the campus of the University of Oklahoma in Norman, Oklahoma.
783e8f4e-b671-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Norman Observatory, United States

7842da4e-b8b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Medium Energy Ion Mass Spectrometer (IMS-HI) on CRRES is an instrument designed to measure ring current ions within specific energy ranges for various atomic masses, utilizing a magnetic field chamber and solid state detectors to determine ion momentum and energy.
7842da4e-b8b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Medium Energy Ion Mass Spectrometer on CRRES

785b5f7a-bc8e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The International VLBI Service (IVS) for Geodesy and Astrometry is a global network of radio telescopes dedicated to precise measurements in geodynamics and astrometry using Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI). It operates on Earth, providing crucial data for studying the planet's rotation, tectonic plate movements, and other geophysical phenomena.
785b5f7a-bc8e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: International VLBI Service for Geodesy and Astrometry

78669b8a-b778-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Tiki Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Puna'auia, French Polynesia. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
78669b8a-b778-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tiki Observatory at Puna'auia Observatory

78692890-b7dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatorio Astrofísico Guillermo Haro (OAGH) is a ground-based observatory featuring the Instituto Nacional de Astrofísica, Óptica y Electrónica's (INAOE) 2.12m telescope, located in Mexico and dedicated to astrophysical research.
78692890-b7dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.12m Telescope at Observatorio Astrofisico Guillermo Haro

786a8814-b839-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Astronomical Station Vidojevica is an observatory located in Central Serbia, Europe, primarily used for ground-based astronomical observations.
786a8814-b839-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Station Vidojevica, Serbia

786adb82-b98f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Space Environmental Monitor-2 (SEM-2) on MetOp-A is an energetic particle spectrometer provided by NOAA that measures the intensity of Earth's radiation belts and charged particle flux to monitor solar terrestrial phenomena and provide warnings of potential impacts on communication, satellite operations, and spacecraft systems.
786adb82-b98f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Space Environmental Monitor 2 on MetOp-A

788b7e08-ba72-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Metsala Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Espoo, Finland. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
788b7e08-ba72-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Metsala Observatory, Finland

788cd366-b612-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Fort Yates (FYTS) station in North Dakota, USA, is an Educational Public Outreach magnetometer site operated by UCLA, part of the NASA THEMIS project, and it provides magnetic field data with considerations for environmental noise.
788cd366-b612-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Fort Yates Geophysical Observatory

788d8a1c-b64f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ICE Electric Field Instrument on DEMETER is designed to continuously monitor DC and AC electric fields across a broad frequency range in the ionosphere, with a focus on detecting electrostatic and electromagnetic waves potentially linked to seismic activity. It utilizes four spherical sensors mounted on booms to measure the potential difference between pairs of sensors, providing detailed data on the electric field components.
788d8a1c-b64f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Double Sphere Electric Field Instrument on DEMETER part of CNES Observatory

788e8436-bb2b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MMS 4 FIELDS Suite Fluxgate Magnetometer is an instrument aboard the Magnetospheric Multiscale mission, consisting of Analog and Digital Fluxgate magnetometers that work together to measure magnetic fields, providing high-resolution data for studying Earth's magnetosphere.
788e8436-bb2b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission

7894d68a-b791-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Brera Astronomical Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in the Brera district of Milan, Italy. It was established in 1764 by Jesuit astronomer Roger Boscovich and is situated within the historic Palazzo Brera.
7894d68a-b791-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Brera Astronomical Observatory at Milan, Italy

7897541e-b967-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: New Norcia is a ground-based observatory located in Western Australia, known for its radio telescopes and contributions to astronomical research.
7897541e-b967-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: New Norcia Observatory

78989d46-b756-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Astronomical Observatory-Ensenada is a ground-based observatory located at the National University of Mexico in Ensenada, Baja California, Mexico. It includes facilities such as the 2m12 telescope and contributes to astronomical research in North America.
78989d46-b756-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.1m Telescope at Ensenada Observatory, Mexico

789f0580-b947-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Rio de Janeiro Geomagnetic Observatory (RDJ) was a ground-based facility in Brazil that operated from 1837 to 1910, dedicated to measuring and studying geomagnetic data.
789f0580-b947-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geomagnetic Observatory at Rio de Janeiro Observatory, Brazil

78a13482-b6da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The European Space Agency's PROBA2 Satellite Mission is a spacecraft designed to demonstrate advanced technologies and conduct solar observations in the x-ray waveband.
78a13482-b6da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray European Space Agency Project for On-Board Autonomy 2 Satellite Mission

78a37a3c-b7ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Saint Johns Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Newfoundland, Canada, primarily used for geophysical observations and equipped with instruments such as the magnetometer.
78a37a3c-b7ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Saint John Geophysical Observatory, Canada

78a70614-b79d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Old Ten Inch" is a decommissioned 25 cm telescope situated at the Palmer Divide Observatory in El Paso County, Colorado, USA. It was located at geographic coordinates 39.100000° N, 255.250000° W and had an altitude of 2306 meters above sea level.
78a70614-b79d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.25m Telescope at Palmer Divide Observatory, United States

78c13adc-b6aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **2MASS Camera - North** was an instrument used for the Two Micron All Sky Survey (2MASS) located at the Whipple Observatory in Arizona, featuring three NICMOS3 arrays to capture images in J, H, and Ks bands with a shared optical path and specific bandpass filters.
78c13adc-b6aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2MASS Camera - North on 1m3 Telescope at Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory

78c9e8f8-b9fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Varuna Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Cuorgnè, Italy, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial bodies.
78c9e8f8-b9fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Varuna Observatory, Italy
