78d027e8-b6fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Black Mountain Observatory (U57) is an astronomical observatory located in Los Altos Hills, California. It operates as a ground-based facility with the MPC ID U57 and is situated at 237.84128 longitude and 37.366692 latitude.
78d027e8-b6fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Los Altos Observatory

78d3b5ee-ba25-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mount Wilson Observatory (MWO) is an astronomical observatory located on Mount Wilson in Los Angeles County, California, known for its historical significance and ongoing research.
78d3b5ee-ba25-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mount Wilson Observatory

78d6c17a-b68e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: ASPERA-3 (Analysis of Space Plasmas and Energetic Atoms, version 3) is a suite of instruments on the Mars Express mission designed to study the interaction between the solar wind and Martian atmosphere, consisting of a Neutral Particle Imager, Neutral Particle Detector, Electron Spectrometer, and Ion Mass Analyzer.
78d6c17a-b68e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutral Atom Imager on Mars Express

78edbee4-b9da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Leopold-Figl-Observatorium is a ground observatory located in Lower Austria, specifically at Mitterschöpflstraße in the Klausen-Leopoldsdorf area near Baden. It is known for its astronomical research and observations, contributing to scientific studies from its strategic location in Europe.
78edbee4-b9da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Leopold Figl Observatory, Austria

78f01f98-b74d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The SMARTS Yale 1.0m Telescope is a 1.0-meter optical telescope located at the Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory in South America, operated as part of The Small and Medium Research Telescope System by Yale University.
78f01f98-b74d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.0m The Small and Medium Research Telescope System Yale Telescope at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory

78f240e8-ba3b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hagerstown Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Robinwood, Washington County, Maryland. It serves as a ground-based observatory for conducting astronomical research and observations.
78f240e8-ba3b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hagerstown Observatory, United States

78f7c308-bb6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Val-d'Or Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG.
78f7c308-bb6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Val-d'Or Observatory

78fa9bde-b67c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Fort Churchill Magnetic Observatory**: A ground-based magnetic observatory located in Fort Churchill, Manitoba, Canada, operated by the Geological Survey of Canada since 1957.
78fa9bde-b67c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Fort Churchill Magnetic Observatory, Canada

790bae9e-b922-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A laser-induced fluorescence detector for NO₂, originally part of the ISEE atmospheric observation project at the IUGONET Observatory.
790bae9e-b922-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: part of ISEE atmospheric observation

79158236-b62d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hinotori Plasma Probes were instruments aboard the Japanese Hinotori spacecraft designed to measure ionospheric electron temperatures and densities using a "rectification probe" and a "gyro plasma probe."
79158236-b62d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Plasma Probes on Hinotori

792c8002-b84f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Boulder Knolls Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Hidden Meadows, San Diego County, California. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to studying the night sky and celestial bodies.
792c8002-b84f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Boulder Knolls Observatory, United States

794a5908-b6d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Machida Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Machida, Tokyo, Japan. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
794a5908-b6d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Machida Observatory, Japan

794acb8a-bb55-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Casey Ionosonde** is an instrument located in Casey, Antarctica, used for radar investigation of the ionosphere. It has been operational since July 1957 with various upgrades over time, currently utilizing an IPS 5D vertical sounding ionosonde that sweeps frequencies from about 1.0 to 21.5 MHz.
794acb8a-bb55-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar Casey Ionosonde part of IUGONET Observatory, Antarctica

794fb89c-bc14-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Fort Yates Magnetometer is an instrument used in the THEMIS Mission to measure magnetic fields at the Fort Yates Geophysical Observatory. It has been operational since September 2, 2005.
794fb89c-bc14-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Fort Yates Geophysical Observatory

795de894-b8c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Angell Hall Observatory is an astronomical observatory operated by the University of Michigan, located on top of Angell Hall in Ann Arbor. It features a 0.4-m Cassegrain telescope and a small radio telescope for various astronomical studies.
795de894-b8c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Angell Hall Observatory

796c538e-b8e6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer (JUICE)** is a European Space Agency mission launched in 2023 to study Jupiter and its three large ocean-bearing moons: Ganymede, Callisto, and Europa. The spacecraft aims to characterize these moons as potential habitats for life and explore the broader Jovian system using an array of scientific instruments.
796c538e-b8e6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer

7975522e-b7db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hong Kong Observatory is a government agency responsible for monitoring and forecasting weather conditions in Hong Kong. It was established in 1883 and is located in Ting Kok Village, Tai Po District.
7975522e-b7db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hong Kong Observatory

79848e70-b7d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The USDA-ARS Wind Tunnel is an open circulation, suction-type wind tunnel located in Lubbock, Texas, with a working section measuring 10.0 m length, 0.5 m width, and 1.0 m height.
79848e70-b7d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Open circulation suction-type wind tunnel at United States Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service, Wind Erosion and Water Conservation Research Unit, Lubbock, TX

798551a8-bae0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **NEAT Palomar Tri-Camera** is an astronomical instrument consisting of three 4096 x 4096 pixel CCDs installed on the Palomar 1.2m Oschin Schmidt telescope in San Diego, CA. It was used by the NEAT program from April 2001 to June 2003 for wide-field imaging with a central wavelength of 702 nm.
798551a8-bae0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 702nm Tri-Camera on 1.2m Oschin Schmidt Telescope at Palomar Observatory

798a0764-b5d8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Deep Sky Observatory Collaborative (code: V35) is an astronomical observatory located at Pier 5 in Fort Davis, Texas, United States. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
798a0764-b5d8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Deep Sky Observatory Collaborative at Fort Davis

7999df3e-b70b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Eremo di Tizzano Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Casalecchio di Reno, Italy. It operates as a ground-based observatory for conducting astronomical research and observations.
7999df3e-b70b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Eremo di Tizzano Observatory, Italy

79a2b638-b77c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The VLF/ELF crossed loop antenna is an instrument designed to measure magnetic field variations in the Very Low Frequency (VLF) and Extremely Low Frequency (ELF) ranges. It operates with a sensitivity peak at 8kHz and features specific channels for different directional measurements, located in Kapuskasing, Canada.
79a2b638-b77c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: VLF/ELF Crossed Loop Antenna at IUGONET Observatory

79a47f78-b7c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Minsk Geomagnetic Observatory (MNK) is a ground-based facility located in Valozhyn, Belarus, dedicated to geomagnetic research and operated since 1961.
79a47f78-b7c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Minsk Geomagnetic Observatory, Belarus

79bc3cfa-b95e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A portable meteorology station designed by Ralph Lorenz for studying dust devils in the field. It features a high-precision pressure sensor and logger, operates on battery power for extended periods, and can be augmented with additional sensors.
79bc3cfa-b95e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Portable Meteorological Station

79cc889c-b6ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Chibougaou Magnetometer is an instrument located at the Chibougaou geophysical observatory, designed to measure magnetic fields and contribute to understanding Mercury's intrinsic magnetic field and its interaction with the solar wind.
79cc889c-b6ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Chibougamau Observatory

79cee456-bb7d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at the Canberra observatory used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the IAGA investigation since 1979.
79cee456-bb7d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at World Data Centre for Geomagnetism

79d1bb0c-bafd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MEASURE Magnetometer Array at the Grafton Test Facility is a fluxgate magnetometer instrument used to measure geomagnetic fields. It is part of an observatory system designed for precise and continuous monitoring of magnetic fluctuations in the Earth's environment.
79d1bb0c-bafd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at Grafton Test Facility Observatory

79d5530a-ba55-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Bendestorf Observatory** is an astronomical facility located in Bendestorf, Germany. It operates as a ground-based observatory used for celestial observations and research.
79d5530a-ba55-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bendestorf Observatory, Germany

79da9046-bb53-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Special Sensor Microwave Temperature Sounder (SSM/T) on the DMSP-F15 satellite is a seven-channel passive microwave instrument that measures Earth's surface and atmospheric emissions in the 50 to 60 GHz oxygen band, providing temperature profiles with varying spatial resolutions.
79da9046-bb53-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Special Sensor Microwave Temperature Sounder part of Defense Meteorological Satellite Program

79e2de88-b6fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The one in Quanzhou, operational since 1982, is part of the IAGA investigation and monitors Earth's magnetic field as part of the IUGONET Observatory network.
79e2de88-b6fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Quanzhou Observatory

79eecb80-bb42-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Midway-1 Magnetometer was an instrument used for geomagnetic measurements at the Midway Observatory, operational from January 1964 to December 31, 1965. It was part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) investigation network.
79eecb80-bb42-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Midway Observatory

79f8c488-b6e6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Qsaybeh (QSB) that is part of the IUGONET-Observatory network, used to measure magnetic fields and contribute data to the World Data Center for Geomagnetism in Kyoto.
79f8c488-b6e6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at WDC Kyoto Observatory

7a023d32-b949-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The San Costantino Observatory is an astronomical facility located in San Costantino, Briatico, Vibo Valentia, Calabria, Italy. It serves as a ground-based observatory for conducting astronomical research and observations.
7a023d32-b949-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: San Costantino Observatory, Italy

7a081624-b8dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Tbilisi Geomagnetic Observatory (TFS)** is a ground-based facility located in Dusheti, Georgia, operating since 1844 to monitor and study geomagnetic activity. It is sponsored by the country of Georgia and includes instruments like magnetometers for precise measurements.
7a081624-b8dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tbilisi Geomagnetic Observatory

7a08bf96-b9c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: An All-Sky Imager (ASI) located at the Poker Flat Research Range in Alaska, used to observe and study two-dimensional intensity distributions of airglows and auroras in the upper atmosphere. This instrument is part of a joint project between the National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT) and the Geophysical Institute of the University of Alaska Fairbanks.
7a08bf96-b9c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Imager part of Alaska Project

7a12f684-b76b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Wallis Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Ventura County, California, with MPC ID 665, dedicated to ground-based observations.
7a12f684-b76b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wallis Observatory, United States

7a1e9d4c-b750-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Ascension Island Magnetic Observatory** is a magnetic observatory located on Ascension Island in the South Atlantic Ocean. It is operated by the British Geological Survey and has been active since 1993, providing continuous measurements of Earth's magnetic field.
7a1e9d4c-b750-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ascension Island Magnetic Observatory

7a203268-b7fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Neutral Atmosphere Composition Spectrometer (NACS) on Dynamics Explorer 2 is a mass spectrometer designed to measure the neutral atmospheric composition and study its variations in response to energy from the magnetosphere.
7a203268-b7fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutral Atmosphere Composition Spectrometer on Dynamics Explorer 2

7a23365e-ba2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mariner 7 Spacecraft Narrow Angle Camera (NAC) was a high-resolution imaging instrument aboard the Mariner 7 spacecraft, which flew by Mars in 1969 to capture detailed photographs of specific regions on the planet's surface.
7a23365e-ba2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Narrow Angle Camera on Mariner 7 Spacecraft

7a2498b4-bb29-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Entity Definition:**

ARTEMIS_P2 (previously THEMIS-C) is a repurposed satellite from the THEMIS mission, currently in lunar orbit to study particle acceleration, magnetic reconnection, and turbulence in the Earth's magnetotail and solar wind. It was launched in 2007 as part of NASA's THEMIS constellation and later repurposed for the ARTEMIS mission in 2010.
7a2498b4-bb29-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Camera and Multi-Object Spectrometer on Hubble Space Telescope

7a2856a8-ba1f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Toungoo Magnetometer was an instrument used for measuring magnetic fields, operational from 1905 to 1932 at the IAGA-identified station TGO.
7a2856a8-ba1f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Toungoo Observatory

7a2926de-b761-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The New Horizons KBO Search at the Canada-France-Hawaii Telescope (CFHT) is an astronomical observatory located on Mauna Kea, Hawaii. It was used in support of NASA's New Horizons mission to search for Kuiper Belt Objects (KBOs).
7a2926de-b761-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Canada-France-Hawaii Telescope at Mauna Kea Observatories, United States

7a2ed8c6-baf0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The magnetometer at the Belsk station (identified as BEL by IAGA) is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields and has been operational since January 1960. It is part of the IUGONET observatory network associated with WDC Kyoto and is primarily utilized for geomagnetic research and monitoring.
7a2ed8c6-baf0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Belsk Observatory

7a37b1da-b992-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Aso Observatory, also known as the Aso Geomagnetic Observatory (ASO), is a ground-based facility located in Minamiaso, Aso County, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan. It operated from July 1957 to December 31, 1965 and was primarily used for geomagnetic measurements.
7a37b1da-b992-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Aso Geomagnetic Observatory, Japan

7a573af4-b65a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **iTelescope Deep Sky Chile, Rio Hurtado** is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Camino del Observatorio, Río Hurtado, Provincia de Limarí, Coquimbo Region, Chile. It specializes in deep sky observations and is part of the iTelescope network.
7a573af4-b65a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Deep Sky Chile Observatory at Rio Hurtado, Chile

7a5887d4-bb8b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Miyasaka Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Hokuto, Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. It is designated as a ground-based facility with the Minor Planet Center (MPC) ID 366.

7a6025d8-b5ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Polino Astronomical Observatory is a ground-based observatory located in Polino, Terni, Umbria, Italy. It is used for astronomical research and observations and holds the Minor Planet Center (MPC) ID 609.

7a722e60-b7a7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Edmund Kline Observatory (H05) is an astronomical observatory located in Deer Trail, Colorado, United States. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
7a722e60-b7a7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Edmund Kline Observatory

7a743490-b9c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Ionospheric Station at Hermanus, South Africa (URSI-code: HE13N) is a ground-based facility that operates as part of the GIRO observatory network. 7a756a18-b99a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Maidenhead Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Cleveland Close, Fishery, Maidenhead, England. It functions as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and studies.
7a756a18-b99a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Maidenhead Observatory, United Kingdom

The **THEMIS B spacecraft modes** refer to the operational configurations of the THEMIS B satellite, including slow survey, fast survey, particle burst, and wave burst modes, each designed for specific types of scientific data collection during its mission.
7a768c1e-b9c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: THEMIS B Spacecraft Modes part of ARTEMIS

7a86dfd2-bb4d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Comeglians Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Comeglians, Udine, Italy. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical observations and research.
7a86dfd2-bb4d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Comeglians Observatory, Italy

7a8d6e48-b868-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Snap Lake Magnetometer is an instrument located at the Snap Lake Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation. It measures magnetic field variations and has been operational since October 22, 2008.
7a8d6e48-b868-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Snap Lake Observatory

7a9d2186-b808-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Geminiano Montanari Observatory, located in Cavezzo, Italy, is an astronomical observatory established in 1972. It is known for its ground-based facilities and contributions to astronomical research.
7a9d2186-b808-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geminiano Montanari Observatory, Italy

7aa20664-b93f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Rybachy Observatory in Russia, part of the IUGONET network, used for measuring and recording variations in the Earth's magnetic field. 7aa95dac-b86c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Kangwon National University Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located at Kangwon National University in Chuncheon-si, Gangwon State, South Korea. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
7aa95dac-b86c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kangwon National University Observatory, South Korea

7aad0aa4-b8a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The St. Petersburg Magnetometer is an instrument used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field, located at the IAGA observatory in St. Petersburg and operational from 1869 to 1877.
7aad0aa4-b8a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IAGA Saint Petersburg Observatory

7aadbdbe-bad5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AGO P1 Photometer Instrument is a photometric device located at the AGO P1 ground station, part of the ICESTAR observatory network, used for measuring light intensity and related properties.
7aadbdbe-bad5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Photometer part of ICESTAR investigation

7ab200a6-b673-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: "Suisei" (Japanese for "Comet"), also known as Planet-A, was an uncrewed space probe launched by Japan in 1985 to study Comet Halley. 7ac0db2e-bb6b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Barrackpore was a ground-based observatory in West Bengal, India, operational from 1904 to 1914, equipped with magnetometers for geomagnetic measurements.
7ac0db2e-bb6b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Barrackpore Observatory, India

7ac45eec-b93c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Riometer Nain Station is a ground-based facility located in Nain, Labrador, Canada, developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research (ISEE) at Nagoya University to study upper atmospheric dynamics through nocturnal airglow emissions.
7ac45eec-b93c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer at Nain Station, Canada

7ac520da-b8eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Rio Hurtado Observatory**, officially known as the OMA – Observatorio Mancomunado de Astrofísica, El Sauce Observatory, is a ground-based observatory located in Río Hurtado, Coquimbo Region, Chile. 7ac520da-b8eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: SNX-NET at El Sauce Observatory, Chile

7ad11b6c-b81c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The TMRT is a 65-meter radio telescope located in Sheshan, Asia, operated by the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the City of Shanghai. It is used for astronomical observations in the radio waveband.
7ad11b6c-b81c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: radio Chinese Academy of Sciences and the City of Shanghai Tianma 65m Telescope at Sheshan

7add2e68-b95f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Castlemaine Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Castlemaine, Victoria, Australia, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial bodies.
7add2e68-b95f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Castlemaine Observatory

7ade7e76-badb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kamioka Gravitational Wave Detector, also known as the Large-scale Cryogenic Gravitational Wave Telescope (KAGRA), is a facility in Asia designed to observe neutrinos, particles, and gravitational waves.
7ade7e76-badb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Large-scale Cryogenic Gravitational Wave Telescope at Kamioka Observatory

7ae73c38-b832-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Heaven's Mirror Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Yass, New South Wales, Australia. It serves as a ground-based facility for observing celestial objects and phenomena.
7ae73c38-b832-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Heaven's Mirror Observatory, Australia

7aea296e-b785-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **CALLISTO Spectrometer** is a programmable heterodyne receiver designed for observing solar radio bursts and monitoring Radio Frequency Interference (RFI), with applications in astronomy, education, outreach, and citizen science.

7aee389e-bab7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kiana Geophysical Observatory (KIAN) is a ground-based facility located in Northwest Arctic Borough, Alaska, United States. It operates as part of the NASA THEMIS Ground-Based Observatories and includes instruments such as magnetometers for geophysical research.
7aee389e-bab7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kiana Geophysical Observatory part of Themis Ground Based Observatories UCLA GBO, United States

7af7c2c4-b7d3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields. This specific instrument is a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer located at the CPMN observatory in Bac Lieu, Vietnam, and it is part of the IUGONET observation network.
7af7c2c4-b7d3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Canadian Magnetic Observatory System network

7afc32d6-b8ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity "IAGA:UCC" refers to the Uccle Geomagnetic Observatory located in Brussels-Capital, Belgium, which operated from 1896 to 1919 and was part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) network.
7afc32d6-b8ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Uccle Observatory, Belgium

7b041fee-b7ef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Penteli Geomagnetic Observatory (PEG) is a ground-based facility located in Nea Makri, Greece, that monitors geomagnetic activity on the Earth's surface. 7b041fee-b7ef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Penteli Geomagnetic Observatory, Greece

7b145c96-b8d6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MMS 1 FIELDS Suite, Spin-plane Double Probe (SDP) Instrument is a scientific tool on the Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission (MMS), consisting of four wire booms with spherical sensors that measure three-dimensional electric fields from DC to 100 kHz.

7b1bbec6-ba45-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Low Energy Telescope (LET) is an instrument on the Ulysses spacecraft's COSPIN suite, designed to measure the flux, energy spectra, and elemental composition of solar energetic particles and low-energy cosmic ray nuclei in the range of approximately 1 to 75 MeV/n.

7b1f5d18-b619-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 1.5-m Ritchey-Chretien Cassegrain reflector is a telescope located at the Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory in Chile, operational since November 1967.

7b22e412-b860-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Zvenigorod Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Moscow Oblast, Russia, established in 1958. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
7b22e412-b860-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Zvenigorod Observatory

7b23ee0c-b7c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Fort Smith Neutron Monitor is an instrument used to measure energetic particles, specifically neutrons. It is part of the Bartol Neutron Monitor observatory located in Fort Smith.

7b2a4f90-b928-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the "Galileo Ephemeris," a platform instrument used for determining the position of the Galileo spacecraft, with data calculated using SPICE kernels and special tools from IRAP and the University of Iowa.
7b2a4f90-b928-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: part of Galileo Mission

7b2a4fec-b692-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Eden Astronomical Observatory is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Jhugian Alfa, Lahore Cantonment Tehsil, Pakistan. It serves as a center for astronomical observations and research within the Punjab region of Asia.
7b2a4fec-b692-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Eden Astronomical Observatory, Pakistan

7b309636-b92b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gevelsberg Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Breckerfeld, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It operates as a ground-based facility with the MPC code K58.
7b309636-b92b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gevelsberg Observatory, Germany

7b34e562-bafa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Rosetta:** A space probe built by the European Space Agency that launched on March 2, 2004. Along with its lander module Philae, Rosetta performed a detailed study of comet 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko (67P).
7b34e562-bafa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ultraviolet imager and spectrometer on Hubble Space Telescope

7b49df48-bbfa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Five College Radio Astronomy Observatory (FCRAO) Telescope was a millimeter-wave radio telescope located in North America. It was operated by the Five College Radio Astronomy Observatory, a consortium of institutions in Massachusetts, USA.
7b49df48-bbfa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Millimeter Five College Radio Astronomy Observatory Telescope

7b4a4dc4-bae3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS FMCW observation network is a frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar installed at Paratunka, Russia. It is part of the IUGONET observatory and is used for atmospheric and ionospheric investigations.
7b4a4dc4-bae3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave Radar part of Magdas Observation Network

7b4f7e6a-baad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tiksi Geophysical Observatory, Russia

7b54b578-ba22-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 38.2MHz Imaging Riometer (IRIO) at Syowa Station, Antarctica is an instrument with an 8x8-element dipole antenna array designed to produce independent beams covering an area of approximately 180km x 180km at the D region altitude.
7b54b578-ba22-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 38.2 MHz Imaging Riometer part of IUGONET Observatory, Antarctica

7b58ef64-ba48-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Swan Reach Imaging in Glenalta is a ground-based observatory located in Fisher, Swan Reach, Mid Murray Council, South Australia. It is situated at the coordinates -34.54408 latitude and 139.57008 longitude within Oceania.
7b58ef64-ba48-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Swan Reach Imaging Telescope at Glenalta Observatory, Australia

7b6552e4-b62f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Canadian Meteor Orbit Radar is a large telescope with an 8.06 km aperture, located in Oxford County, Ontario, Canada, and operated by the University of Western Ontario (UWO) since late 2001 for meteor orbit research.

7b6f2724-b7ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Ile-Ife is a ground-based observatory located in Oyo State, Nigeria, that operates as part of the International Association for Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) network. It includes a magnetometer and has been operational since 1992.
7b6f2724-b7ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ile-Ife Observatory, Nigeria

7b7bd3c2-b8a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **McMurdo Magnetometer** is a scientific instrument located at the McMurdo ground station in Antarctica, used for measuring and recording variations in Earth's magnetic field. It is part of the ICESTAR investigation.
7b7bd3c2-b8a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at McMurdo Observatory, Antarctica

7b7cff5a-b9b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Helium Vector Magnetometer (HVM) on Pioneer 11 was a triaxial instrument designed to measure magnetic fields with high precision and linearity, featuring seven dynamic ranges from ±2.5 nT to ±1.0E-3 T.

7b7d526e-b9ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Jubilee Telescope is a 0.5-meter Newtonian-Cassegrain reflecting telescope situated at the Stockport Observatory in South Australia, located at coordinates -34.322000, 138.729000.
7b7d526e-b9ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.5m Jubilee Telescope at Stockport Observatory, Australia

7b7efff6-ba1b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the **Skygems Chile, Rio Hurtado**, a ground-based observatory located at Camino del Observatorio in Río Hurtado, Coquimbo Region, Chile. 7b7efff6-ba1b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Skygems Chile Observatory, Rio Hurtado

7b90b1f2-b853-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MMS 4 FIELDS Suite, Digital Signal Processor (DSP) is a critical component of the Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission (MMS), responsible for processing signals from various instruments on the spacecraft. 7b999eb0-b6f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The DSS-36 is a ground observatory primarily used for astronomical observations and research, known for its 34-meter antenna as part of NASA's Deep Space Network.

7b9bf9d2-b72b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at the St. John Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation, used to measure magnetic field variations since 1968.
7b9bf9d2-b72b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at St. John Observatory

7b9f9a6c-b954-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Rothney Astrophysical Observatory (RAO) is an astronomical observatory near Priddis, Alberta, Canada, operated by the University of Calgary for research, education, and public outreach. It is known for its variable star search program and minor planet discoveries.
7b9f9a6c-b954-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rothney Astrophysical Observatory, Canada

7ba9a69a-bbd1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Resolute Bay, Canada, part of the IAGA network, operational since 1952 for monitoring Earth's magnetic field.
7ba9a69a-bbd1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Resolute Bay Observatory

7bc6260c-bb50-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **City Observatory**, also known as the Calton Hill Observatory, is an astronomical observatory and Category A listed building located on Calton Hill in Edinburgh, Scotland.
7bc6260c-bb50-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Calton Hill Observatory, Scotland

7bcc5e68-bae8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ISL Langmuir Probe is an instrument designed for in situ measurements of the bulk parameters, such as electron density and temperature, of ionospheric thermal plasma with a time resolution of 1 second. It features two sensors: a cylindrical sensor and a segmented spherical sensor.
7bcc5e68-bae8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Langmuir Probe part of DEMETER Mission

7be171e4-bb2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ankara Geomagnetic Observatory (ANK), located in Ankara, Turkey, is a ground-based facility that operated from 1986 to 1993, dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity.
7be171e4-bb2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ankara Geomagnetic Observatory, Turkey

7befdc6c-b6f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Planetary Geosciences Laboratory Analytical Spectral Devices (ASD) FieldSpec 3 is a portable instrument used for field-based spectral measurements across the visible, near-infrared, and shortwave infrared regions. It is employed in remote sensing, environmental monitoring, and geological surveying to analyze materials and surfaces in outdoor environments.
7befdc6c-b6f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Analytical Spectral Devices FieldSpec 3 at Planetary Geosciences Laboratory

7bf3cb66-bbd7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The O'Higgins (OHI) Geomagnetic Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Antarctica, established on January 1, 2004, to monitor geomagnetic activity. It is part of the SAMBA observatory network and includes a magnetometer instrument.
7bf3cb66-bbd7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: O'Higgins Geomagnetic Observatory, Antarctica

7bfc730a-b6a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Koganei facility, located in Tokyo, Japan, was operated by the National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT) for conducting near-surface mesospheric observations as part of the SALMON project.
7bfc730a-b6a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: SALMON instrument at Koganei Observatory, Japan

7c03da6a-baf1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **DSS-45 34-m Radio Telescope** was a fully steerable, dual-shaped reflector radio antenna located in Canberra, Australia. It operated from 1986 to 2016 as part of NASA's Deep Space Network and could receive frequencies ranging from 2.0 to 8.6 GHz with an aperture of 34 meters.
7c03da6a-baf1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 34m Radio Telescope at Canberra Deep Space Communications Complex, Australia

7c05add2-b9a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Fabra Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. Established in 1904, it stands at an altitude of 415 meters above sea level and is known for its contributions to astronomy.
7c05add2-b9a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fabra Observatory, Spain

7c05d242-b5c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gemini:South telescope is an 8.1-meter optical telescope located at the Cerro Pachon observatory in South America, operated by the Association of Universities for Research in Astronomy (AURA). It features a primary mirror with a surface accuracy of 15.6 nm (rms) and advanced tip-tilt correction capabilities.
7c05d242-b5c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 8.1m Gemini South Telescope at Cerro Pachon

7c1042e4-b66b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Instituut voor Sterrenkunde and Katholieke Universiteit Leuven 1.2m MERCATOR Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos in Africa, operated by the Institute of Astronomy and Catholic University of Leuven.
7c1042e4-b66b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 1.2m MERCATOR Telescope at Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos

7c218012-bab8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Younchun Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Yeoncheon County, Gyeonggi Province, South Korea. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
7c218012-bab8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Yeoncheon Observatory, South Korea

7c36d288-b639-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias' 1.52m Carlos Sanchez Infrared Telescope (TCS) is located at the Observatorio del Teide in Africa and specializes in observing the infrared waveband with an aperture of 1.52 meters.
7c36d288-b639-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: infrared 1.52m Carlos Sanchez Telescope at Observatorio del Teide

7c4800a8-b738-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Cosmic Ray Nuclear Composition (CRNC)** instrument on IMP-8 is a scientific tool designed to measure the composition and energy spectra of solar and galactic particles above 0.5 MeV/nucleon using two telescopes with specialized detectors and shielding for detailed particle analysis.
7c4800a8-b738-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Instrument part of Interplanetary Monitoring Platform 8

7c4d9a54-b67f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "LANL 1989 Positions" dataset provides the spatial coordinates of the LANL spacecraft in various reference systems for the year 1989.
7c4d9a54-b67f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: LANL 1989 Ephemeris part of SMWG Observatory

7c522ee0-b939-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetic Electron Spectrometers (MES) were an instrument onboard the OV3-3 satellite, designed to study energetic particles in Earth's magnetosphere.
7c522ee0-b939-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetic Electron Spectrometers on OV3-3

7c58ebac-ba53-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A fluxgate magnetometer located in Birdsville, part of the 210 Magnetic Meridian (210MM) network, used for measuring magnetic fields and associated with the IUGONET observatory.
7c58ebac-ba53-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IUGONET Observatory

7c5bb2dc-b88d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gemini Multi-Object Spectrograph - South (GMOS-S) is an imaging spectrograph mounted on the Gemini South telescope, capable of long-slit and multi-slit observations with a wavelength range of 0.36-0.94 micrometers and a field of view of 5.5 square arcminutes.
7c5bb2dc-b88d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gemini Multi-Object Spectrograph on Gemini South Telescope

7c67a3d0-bb12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ATLAS–HKO observatory is an astronomical facility located at Haleakalā on the island of Maui in Hawaii, United States. It is part of the Asteroid Terrestrial-Impact Last Alert System (ATLAS) and operates as a ground-based observatory.
7c67a3d0-bb12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ATLAS–HKO Observatory at Haleakalā Observatory, United States

7c6d5d88-b6e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kiyosato Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Hokuto, Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. It is a ground-based facility situated at coordinates 35.952876° N, 138.402305° E.
7c6d5d88-b6e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kiyosato Observatory, Japan

7c71f19a-b767-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AGO P4 Magnetometer Instrument is a device located at the AGO P4 ground station, used to measure magnetic fields as part of the ICESTAR investigation.
7c71f19a-b767-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of ICESTAR investigation

7c772ba0-b99d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at Livingston Island (LIV) is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of the Earth's magnetic field, located specifically at Livingston Island as part of the WDC Kyoto observatory network.
7c772ba0-b99d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Livingston Island Observatory, Antarctica

7c86f40a-b69a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The KPNO Single Channel Polarimeter is an astronomical instrument operational since 1969 at the Kitt Peak National Observatory, designed to measure polarization using a rapidly rotating polarizer and a star-chopping technique for sky brightness management.
7c86f40a-b69a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Single-channel Polarimeter on 0.9m Telescope at Kitt Peak National Observatory

7c8d930c-bb9d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Lomnický Štít Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Tatranská Lomnica, Slovakia. It was established in 1962 and operates as a ground-based facility at an altitude of approximately 2,632 meters.
7c8d930c-bb9d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lomnický Štít Observatory, Slovakia

7c9d647c-ba61-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The McDonald P45a Two-Channel Photometer is a sensitive astronomical instrument used to measure light intensity in two wavelength bands, particularly for studying variable stars and other celestial phenomena.
7c9d647c-ba61-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Two-Channel Photometer on 2.7m Harlan J. Smith Telescope at McDonald Observatory

7cb711b0-bb47-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Learmonth Station is a ground-based observatory located in Western Australia, part of the CPMN magnetometer network, used for geomagnetic measurements. It is situated at coordinates -22.22 latitude and 114.1 longitude on Minilya-Exmouth Road, Shire Of Exmouth, Australia.
7cb711b0-bb47-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at CPMN Learmonth station, Australia

7cb829f8-b8f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MRO 2.4m is a 2.4-meter telescope situated at the Magdalena Ridge Observatory in Socorro County, New Mexico, USA. It is used for astronomical observations and research.
7cb829f8-b8f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.4m Telescope at Magdalena Ridge Observatory, United States

7cb87380-bb14-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tangra Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Saint Clair, New South Wales, Australia, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial phenomena.
7cb87380-bb14-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tangra Observatory

7cc0f070-b676-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: La Cañada Observatory is a privately-owned astronomical observatory located in Ávila, Spain, primarily dedicated to monitoring near-Earth objects, asteroids, and comets.
7cc0f070-b676-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: La Cañada Observatory, Spain

7cc2fba8-ba3c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **BARREL Balloon 4H:** A specific balloon payload from the BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) mission, which was operational from August 30 to August 31, 2016, in the Earth's stratosphere to study the loss of relativistic electrons from the radiation belts.
7cc2fba8-ba3c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses part of Living with a Star, Geospace Mission of Opportunity

7cc37996-b86d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Las Cumbres Global Telescope Network - 1m Telescopes are a set of identical, Equatorial C-ring mounted Ritchey-Chretian Cassegrain telescopes with an aperture of 2 meters, part of the Las Cumbres Observatory.
7cc37996-b86d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2m Las Cumbres Telescope at Las Cumbres Observatory

7cc55dca-bb3c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DMSP/F16 SSUSI is a photometer launched in 2003 as part of the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program, designed to observe Extreme and Far UV radiation from Earth's limb, providing vertical profiles of electron density and ion and neutral densities.
7cc55dca-bb3c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Special Sensor Ultraviolet Limb Imager part of Defense Meteorological Satellite Program

7cc57ee4-b66a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1M X-ray Instrument (XRI)** is a scintillation detector used in the BARREL mission to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons. It employs a NaI crystal, photomultiplier tube, and pulse height analyzer to convert X-ray energy into detectable charge pulses, providing insights into electron energies with varying time and energy resolutions.
7cc57ee4-b66a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray Scintillation Detector part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

7cca3f8e-b871-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Canakkale Onsekiz Mart University 1.22m T-122 Telescope is an optical telescope with a 1.22-meter aperture located at the COMU Ulupinar Observatory in Asia.
7cca3f8e-b871-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.22m Optical Telescope at Ulupinar Observatory

7cced564-bba3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **NASA Deep Space Network (DSN) Radio Science** instrumentation is used for studying gravity fields, relativistic effects, and properties of celestial bodies through radio tracking and measurements. It also supports communication with spacecraft and various astronomical observations.
7cced564-bba3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Science Instrumentation on NASA Deep Space Network

7cd1390a-bafc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Del Rio Magnetic Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Val Verde County, Texas, dedicated to monitoring and studying geomagnetic activity on Earth's surface. It operates under the United States Geological Survey and has been functional since 1982.
7cd1390a-bafc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Del Rio Magnetic Observatory, United States

7cd160ba-b6c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kitami Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in the Kitami-Abashiri Region Cultural Centre in eastern Hokkaidō, Japan.
7cd160ba-b6c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kitami Observatory, Japan

7cd3d44c-ba09-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Electric Field Detector (OEFD) on the Pioneer Venus Orbiter is an instrument designed to measure electric field components in specific frequency bands to study plasma interactions between the solar wind and Venus's ionospheric or exospheric plasma, as well as investigate plasma instabilities.
7cd3d44c-ba09-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electric Field Detector part of Pioneer Venus Orbiter

7cdb542a-b774-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer at AMA is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed at Amami-Oh-shima, Japan, used for measuring magnetic field variations. It is part of the IUGONET observatory and contributes to the MAGDAS observation network.
7cdb542a-b774-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of MAGDAS Observation Network

7cdf5042-bba8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Dust Impact Plasma Detector (SP-1) for Vega 1 is an instrument designed to detect electric charges in the plasma cloud generated by solid particle impacts on a gold target, with capabilities for calibration and density measurement.
7cdf5042-bba8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dust Impact Plasma Detector on Vega 1

7ce0d8e6-b819-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences (NAOC) 0.6m Telescope at Beijing Astronomical Observatory (BAO) is an optical telescope located in Xinglong Station, Asia, used for astronomical observations and research.
7ce0d8e6-b819-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical 0.6m Telescope at Xinglong Station

7ce7cab8-baab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Dehra.Dun Magnetometer** was a ground-based instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field at the Dehra Dun observatory from 1903 to 1943 as part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) investigations.
7ce7cab8-baab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Dehra Dun Observatory

7cf95e4e-b68d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Geminis Austral Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Rosario, Argentina, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial phenomena.
7cf95e4e-b68d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geminis Austral Observatory

7cfa870c-baa6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity describes the TWINS (Two Wide-angle Imaging Neutral-atom Spectrometers) mission, a NASA project involving two instruments on separate spacecraft that provide stereoscopic imaging of Earth's magnetosphere to study its processes and connectivities.
7cfa870c-baa6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Two Wide-angle Imaging Neutral-atom Spectrometers part of Mission of Opportunity under Small Explorer program

7d0105cc-bb24-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Parker Solar Probe ISOIS (Integrated Science Investigation of the Sun) is an instrument suite onboard the Parker Solar Probe spacecraft designed to study energetic particles in the inner heliosphere. It consists of two main instruments, EPI-Lo and EPI-Hi, which measure the composition, energy, and distribution of electrons, protons, and heavy ions to understand their origins and dynamics in the solar atmosphere and wind.
7d0105cc-bb24-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mass Spectrometer on Parker Solar Probe

7d0d983c-b836-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Solar Proton Monitoring Experiment** on IMP-F was an instrument designed to measure the fluxes of protons and alpha particles with specific energy levels, using four detectors equipped with solid-state sensors. It provided hourly averaged flux data published in Solar-Geophysical Data from its launch until mid-1969.
7d0d983c-b836-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar Proton Monitoring Experiment part of Interplanetary Monitoring Platform F

7d12d76c-b8b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Kochi Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Oharacho, Kōchi, Japan. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical research and observations.
7d12d76c-b8b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kochi Observatory, Japan

7d162514-b5e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) is a non-governmental body within the International Union of Geodesy and Geophysics (IUGG), coordinating global geomagnetic observatories and maintaining historical records since its inception in 1991.
7d162514-b5e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: IAGA

7d2329e4-b869-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Merate Astronomical Observatory is an old ground-based observatory located in Merate (Lecco), Italy, known for housing a 1-meter Zeiss telescope since 1926.
7d2329e4-b869-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1m Zeiss Telescope at Merate Astronomical Observatory, Italy

7d259f92-bbae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Xinglong Station is an astronomical observatory located in the Yanshan Mountains, Hebei province, China, known for its multiple telescopes including LAMOST and popular as a tourist site.
7d259f92-bbae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.6m Infrared Telescope at Xinglong Observatory, China

7d29d21c-b80a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solar Anomalous and Magnetospheric Particle Explorer (SAMPEX) was a NASA solar observatory launched in 1992 to study cosmic rays, solar energetic particles, and magnetospheric electrons. It operated until July 2004 and carried four science instruments: LICA, HILT, MAST, and PET.
7d29d21c-b80a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar Anomalous and Magnetospheric Particle Explorer part of Small Explorer program

7d2ad500-b908-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Vize Island Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation since February 2017.
7d2ad500-b908-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Vize Island Observatory, Antarctica

7d3651d6-b61b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **WSO Babcock Magnetograph** is an instrument at the Wilcox Solar Observatory that measures magnetic fields on the full solar disk with a resolution of 3 arc minutes, typically performing daily observations in FeI 5250 around 20:00 UT.
7d3651d6-b61b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Babcock Magnetograph at Wilcox Solar Observatory

7d38c0b0-b850-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Sayre Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in South Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, United States. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
7d38c0b0-b850-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sayre Observatory, United States

7d3e0bc2-b730-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Stettin-Zabelsdorf Magnetometer was an instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field at the IAGA observatory in Stettin.Zabelsdorf from January 1, 1892, to December 31, 1901.
7d3e0bc2-b730-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Stettin-Zabelsdorf Observatory

7d42421a-bb5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "BepiColombo Ephemeris" is an instrument within the BepiColombo spacecraft mission, calculated by IRAP using SPICE kernels from the ESA SPICE Service to determine the precise trajectory and positioning of the spacecraft.
7d42421a-bb5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: part of BepiColombo

7d4d0e48-bbb7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ESO VLT Focal Reducer and Spectrograph #1 (FORS1) is an all-dioptric instrument designed for imaging and spectroscopy in the visual and near-UV wavelength range, mounted on Unit Telescope 2 (Kueyen) of the Very Large Telescope (VLT) at the European Southern Observatory.
7d4d0e48-bbb7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Visual and near-UV Focal Reducer and low-dispersion Spectrograph on Very Large Telescope Unit 2 Kueyen at European Southern Observatory

7d50e7e2-b1b3-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Pontianak station is a ground-based facility located in Ngoro, East Java, Indonesia, which operates as part of the MAGDAS magnetometer network to monitor geomagnetic activity.
7d50e7e2-b1b3-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at MAGDAS Pontianak Station, Indonesia

7d695592-babf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DSS-74 is a 35-meter radio telescope located near New Norcia, Australia, operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) and known for its deep space communications capabilities. It is part of ESA's Deep Space Antenna network and can transmit at 2 and 7 GHz frequencies, with plans to upgrade for operation in the 30 GHz range.
7d695592-babf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 35m Radio Telescope at New Norcia Observatory, Australia

7d70b4c4-b937-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Osservatorio Galileo, Padova** is an astronomical observatory located in Mestrino, Province of Padua, Italy. It is situated at the coordinates 45.46541° N and 11.73622° E.
7d70b4c4-b937-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatory in Padova

7d795d36-b630-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the Holbrook Observatory located at Little London Road in Heathfield and Waldron, East Sussex, England (TN21 0BF). It is a ground-based observatory situated approximately at latitude 50.9669 and longitude 0.23964 in the United Kingdom.
7d795d36-b630-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Heathfield Observatory, United Kingdom

7d7ba800-b763-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Bologna Astronomical Observatory's 1.52m Gian Domenico Cassini Telescope is an optical telescope located in Loiano, Europe, and is part of the Loiano Observatory.
7d7ba800-b763-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gian Domenico Cassini Telescope at Loiano Observatory

7d85be14-b6d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EMN magnetometer network at Ancon, Peru is a ground-based observatory located in the Lima Metropolitan Area, dedicated to measuring and monitoring magnetic fields on Earth's surface.
7d85be14-b6d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ancon Observatory, Peru

7da486ae-b938-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Helmut Ullrich Astronomical Observatory is an astronomical facility located on Col Drusciè in Cortina d'Ampezzo, Italy, at an elevation of 1,780 meters above sea level. It features two domes housing a 20" Newtonian telescope and an 11" Schmidt–Cassegrain telescope for astronomical observations.
7da486ae-b938-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 20" Newtonian Telescope at Helmut Ullrich Astronomical Observatory, Italy

7da73f02-b70d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ionospheric Station at Irkutsk, Russia (code: IR352) is a ground-based observatory equipped with an advanced Digisonde ionosonde that measures various parameters of skywave signals reflected from the ionosphere to study its properties.
7da73f02-b70d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digisonde at Irkutsk Observatory, Russia

7da7cf06-b705-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1S Data Processing Unit (DPU)** is a versatile instrument controller board designed for the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) mission, capable of acquiring data from multiple sources such as an X-ray spectrometer and magnetometer, formatting it, and transmitting it via an Iridium modem. It features a flexible design with an FPGA for adaptable interface logic and has been successfully used in various sounding rocket experiments and balloon flights.
7da7cf06-b705-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Data Processing Unit part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

7da99564-b59f-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: This entity represents a geo-electric field sensor, specifically the JMA electrometer, which is part of the IUGONET observatory at Kyoto WDC-MMB and consists of perpendicularly aligned N-S and E-W lines with copper plates.
7da99564-b59f-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Geo-electric Field Sensor at World Data Center for Geomagnetism

7dad0c9a-b78d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Mooray Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Christchurch, New Zealand. It specializes in ground-based observations and has the MPC ID R66.
7dad0c9a-b78d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mooray Observatory, New Zealand

7db0c908-b638-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Groruddalen Optical Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Oslo Municipality, Norway. It is situated at 4 Høgtunveien, Nedre Høybråten, Stovner, and specializes in ground-based observations.
7db0c908-b638-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Groruddalen Optical Observatory, Norway

7db16440-b9b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Sternwarte Tentlingen** is an astronomical observatory located in Tentlingen, Fribourg, Switzerland. It is a ground-based facility situated at 21 Uf em Bärg and operates under the MPC code A16.
7db16440-b9b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sternwarte Tentlingen Observatory, Switzerland

7dc49e50-bbca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Peking.1 is a historical ground-based observatory located in Beijing, China, which operated from 1868 to 1883 and was part of the IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) network.
7dc49e50-bbca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Beijing Observatory, China

7dccfe3e-bb4c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: IMAP is a spacecraft designed for astronomical observations, categorized under the VOParis namespace for observational facilities.
7dccfe3e-bb4c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Interstellar Mapping and Acceleration Probe

7dcea4dc-bb56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Comet Hunter Observatory 2:** An astronomical observatory located in New Ringgold, Pennsylvania, United States, identified by the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code W62.
7dcea4dc-bb56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Comet Hunter Observatory at New Ringgold, United States

7dd6cf62-ba71-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Quetta Ground Magnetic Field Instrument is a magnetometer located in Quetta that has been operational since January 1953. It is part of the IUGONET Observatory and contributes to the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) investigations.
7dd6cf62-ba71-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Quetta Observatory

7de63dd6-b679-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The White-light All-sky Watec Imager (AWI) at Sodankylä, Finland is an automatic optical instrument used for capturing wide-angle images of the sky, featuring a CCD camera and fisheye lens. It is part of the Multiple Imager Network Observations in Northern Europe under the IUGONET observatory.
7de63dd6-b679-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: White-light All-sky Watec Imager on IUGONET Observatory NIPR EISCAT SOD

7deb120c-bb1f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Juno**: A NASA space probe orbiting Jupiter to study its atmosphere, magnetic field, and internal structure. Launched in 2011, it aims to understand the planet's origin and evolution by measuring water abundance, mapping gravity fields, and exploring magnetospheric activity.
7deb120c-bb1f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Juno spacecraft

7df00896-b84c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover Entry, Descent, and Landing (EDL) Camera Suite is a collection of seven infrared cameras designed to capture visual data during the EDL phase of the Mars 2020 mission, including parachute deployment, skycrane maneuvers, and surface approach. It also includes an omnidirectional microphone for recording sound during these critical stages.
7df00896-b84c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Entry, Descent, and Landing Camera Suite part of Mars 2020 Mission

7df06098-b9a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The RAS Observatory in Moorook is an astronomical observatory located on Battams Road, Moorook, in the District Council of Loxton Waikerie, South Australia.
7df06098-b9a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: RAS Observatory, Australia

7e014d90-b5e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Apollo 15 Solar Wind Spectrometer** was an instrument left on the Moon as part of the ALSEP package during the Apollo 15 mission. It was designed to measure protons and electrons in the solar wind using seven modulated Faraday cups, aimed at understanding the interaction of the solar wind with the lunar surface and local magnetic field.
7e014d90-b5e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar Wind Spectrometer part of Apollo 15 Lunar Surface Experiments Package

7e09963c-ba4d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The CEAM Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Caimari, Balearic Islands, Spain. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
7e09963c-ba4d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: CEAM Observatory, Spain

7e0c6980-b7c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Skallen (SKL) is an automated magnetometer station located near Syowa Station in Antarctica, part of a network used for geomagnetic observations.
7e0c6980-b7c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Skallen, Antarctica

7e122800-b5d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Learmonth Magnetic Observatory, located in Western Australia, was a ground-based facility operated by Geoscience Australia to monitor and study magnetic phenomena from 1979 until its closure at the end of 2016.
7e122800-b5d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Learmonth Geomagnetic Observatory

7e15700e-b6b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 2F Optical Photometer** is an instrument designed to detect visible light at wavelengths near 486.1 nm during relativistic electron precipitation events, aiming to determine the presence of protons accompanying these electrons by measuring emissions characteristic of precipitating protons.
7e15700e-b6b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Photometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

7e1e02b2-bafb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Retamar Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Almeria, Andalusia, Spain, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial bodies.
7e1e02b2-bafb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Retamar Observatory, Spain

7e1e8a2a-b6f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Parker Solar Probe SWEAP Investigation's Electrostatic Analyser (ElectrostaticAnalyser)** is a scientific instrument onboard the Parker Solar Probe designed to measure the energy and direction of ions and electrons in space, featuring multiple modules for comprehensive coverage. It utilizes electrostatic deflectors and microchannel plate detectors to provide high-resolution data on solar wind particles.
7e1e8a2a-b6f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electrostatic Analyser part of Parker Solar Probe SWEAP Investigation

7e21c7f2-b8e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The **Two Wide-angle Imaging Neutral-atom Spectrometers (TWINS)** mission is a NASA Small Explorer (SMEX) program designed to study the Earth's magnetosphere through stereoscopic neutral atom imaging from two high-altitude, high-inclination spacecraft in Molniya orbits. The mission aims to understand global connectivities and causal relationships between different regions of the magnetosphere by collecting image data with a time resolution of 60 seconds during the apogee portion of each orbit.
7e21c7f2-b8e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Two Wide-angle Imaging Neutral-atom Spectrometers part of Small Explorer

7e21e222-b814-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Moore Observatory:** An astronomical observatory owned and operated by the University of Louisville, located in Oldham County, Kentucky, approximately 20 kilometers northeast of Louisville.
7e21e222-b814-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.6m Telescope at Moore Observatory, United States

7e24244a-b75d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU Radio Beacon Receiver (GRBR) is a digital receiver located in Tirunelveli, India, designed to measure ionospheric total electron content using Low Earth Orbit satellite signals with open-source software and hardware components.
7e24244a-b75d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waveform Receiver part of Research Institute for Sustainable Humanosphere, Kyoto University

7e397afe-b1b6-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kiepenheuer-Institut für Sonnenphysik (KIS) 0.70m Vacuum Tower Telescope (VTT) is a solar observatory located at the Observatorio del Teide in Africa, designed for optical observations of the Sun with an aperture of 0.7 meters.
7e397afe-b1b6-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.70m Vacuum Tower Telescope at Observatorio del Teide

7e4d6ef4-b820-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Celado Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Castello Tesino, Italy. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
7e4d6ef4-b820-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Celado Observatory at Castello Tesino, Italy

7e53c12a-ba62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Accelerometer on the Mars Global Surveyor (MGS) is an instrument designed to measure acceleration forces acting on the spacecraft. It uses a proof mass and electromagnetic field adjustments to determine acceleration, with data sampled every 0.1 seconds and recorded in quantized velocity increments.
7e53c12a-ba62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Accelerometer on Mars Global Surveyor

7e53e25a-baac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IGPP-LANL Los Alamos National Laboratory Fluxgate Magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field at the Los Alamos National Laboratory station. It is part of a larger array managed by the Institute of Geophysics and Planetary Physics (IGPP) and the Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL).
7e53e25a-baac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at Los Alamos Observatory

7e545b80-b715-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The one located at Byrd Station 2 has been operational since August 1957 as part of a geophysical observatory.
7e545b80-b715-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Byrd Station Observatory

7e5a378c-bb2d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Proxima Centauri Observatory, Valdín**: A ground-based observatory located in Valdín, Galicia, Spain, primarily used for astronomical observations. It is situated at the coordinates 42.22244 latitude and -6.98811 longitude (353.01189 expressed in a different format).
7e5a378c-bb2d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Proxima Centauri Observatory at Valdín, Spain

7e805a16-ba47-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Fluxgate Magnetometer (MISCHA) on Vega 2 was an instrument designed to measure magnetic fields with high precision and determine their role in the interaction between the solar wind and comets. It featured a dual-sensor system mounted on a boom to minimize interference from the spacecraft itself.
7e805a16-ba47-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer on Vega 2

7e86ca5a-b712-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Sodium (Na) Temperature Lidar at Syowa Station, Antarctica is an atmospheric research instrument developed by the National Institute of Polar Research and Shinshu University, designed to measure sodium density and temperature at altitudes between 80-105 km using a two-frequency laser technique.
7e86ca5a-b712-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sodium Temperature Lidar part of Sodium Lidar Observation at Syowa Station, Antarctica

7e988e2c-ba85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Infrasound Sensor IGAYA-E is a ground-based facility located at Aichi University of Education in Japan, installed in 1984 for the purpose of conducting micro-barometric observations.
7e988e2c-ba85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrasound Sensor Line Microphone IGAYA-E at Aichi University of Education Observatory, Japan

7e9e48d0-ba3f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The MUPUS is an instrument suite on the Rosetta Philae Lander, featuring a penetrator with thermal sensors, an infrared radiometer, and other sensors to study the surface and subsurface of a comet.
7e9e48d0-ba3f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: The Multi Purpose Suite for Surface and Subsurface Science part of Rosetta Philae Lander

7ea21430-b92f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Neufahrwasser Magnetometer** was a magnetic measurement instrument operational from 1891 to 1903, located at the IAGA Neufahrwasser observatory.
7ea21430-b92f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Neufahrwasser Observatory

7ea80aa8-b979-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Neutral Mass Spectrometer (NMS) aboard the LADEE mission is a high-sensitivity quadrupole mass spectrometer designed to measure the abundance of various atomic and molecular species at altitudes of 50 km and below.
7ea80aa8-b979-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutral Mass Spectrometer on LADEE

7eaf0e02-ba23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Neutral and Ion Mass Spectrometer (NIM) is a highly sensitive time-of-flight mass spectrometer designed to study the chemical composition of Jupiter's icy moons' atmospheres and ionospheres by measuring neutral gases and ions. It is part of the Particle Environment Package (PEP) on the JUICE mission, focusing on interactions within Jupiter’s magnetosphere.
7eaf0e02-ba23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutral and Ion Mass Spectrometer on PEP

7eafd8de-ba35-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Auckland Island Magnetometer was an instrument used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field at a ground station on Auckland Island from 1874 to 1875.
7eafd8de-ba35-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Auckland Island Observatory

7eb0d556-b5dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IAGA:TEH Magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, located at the observatory identified by IAGA as TEH in Tehran. It has been operational since January 1, 1960.
7eb0d556-b5dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tehran Observatory

7eb13562-b59e-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Atmospheric Density Accelerometer (MESA) is an instrument that measured neutral atmospheric density at altitudes between 120 to 400 km using accelerometers and was part of the AE-D satellite mission.
7eb13562-b59e-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Miniature Electrostatic Analyzer part of Atmospheric Density Accelerometer on AE-D

7eb149fe-b746-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Huenfelden Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Kirberg, Hünfelden, Germany. It is a ground-based facility used for observing celestial objects and phenomena.
7eb149fe-b746-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Huenfelden Observatory

7eba873a-b6e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Varennes Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Varennes, Toulouse, France. It operates as a ground-based facility for observing celestial phenomena.
7eba873a-b6e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Varennes Observatory, France

7ebe0318-ba13-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The magnetometer located at the IAGA station TPA in Tampa is an instrument used for measuring magnetic fields and is part of the WDC Kyoto observatory network.
7ebe0318-ba13-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at World Data Center Kyoto Observatory

7ec0e238-b6c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **PVO Ephemeris** is the ephemeris data for the Pioneer Venus Orbiter (PVO) spacecraft, detailing its positions from December 5, 1978, to October 8, 1992.
7ec0e238-b6c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris part of Pioneer Venus Orbiter

7ed667a2-ba5c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Southwest Research Institute (SwRI) Ultraviolet Reflectance Chamber (SwURC) is an ultra-high vacuum chamber designed for absolute bi-directional reflectance measurements of lunar soils and simulants using far-ultraviolet illumination. It features a retractable sample tray, a FUV monochromator with a deuterium lamp, and a channel electron multiplier detector to ensure an extended dynamic range.
7ed667a2-ba5c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Far Ultraviolet Southwest Research Institute Ultraviolet Reflectance Chamber

7edbf508-ba81-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MMS 4 Energetic Particle Detector (EPD) Suite, Fly's Eye Energetic Particle Sensor (FEEPS) is an instrument designed to measure three-dimensional energetic ion and electron flux distributions over specific energy ranges with a time resolution of 10 seconds.
7edbf508-ba81-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fly’s Eye Energetic Particle Sensor part of Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission

7edc9f24-b835-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity describes a magnetometer located in Roburent with the IAGA identifier ROB, operational from January 1, 1964, to December 31, 1973. It was part of the IUGONET Observatory and used for magnetic field measurements as part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) investigation.
7edc9f24-b835-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at WDC Kyoto Observatory

7eea42aa-b5c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Kinmen Educational Remote Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located at Jincheng Junior High School in Kinmen, Taiwan. It serves as a ground-based facility for educational and astronomical observations.
7eea42aa-b5c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kinmen Educational Remote Observatory at Jincheng Junior High School, Taiwan

7ef3e662-b8ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Tuorla Observatory is the Department of Astronomy at the University of Turku in southwest Finland and serves as the largest astronomical research institute in the country.
7ef3e662-b8ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tuorla Observatory, Finland

7efd87e2-bb65-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Livorno Observatory (A66) is an astronomical observatory located in Livorno, Italy. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to the observation and study of celestial objects.
7efd87e2-bb65-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Observatory at Livorno, Italy

7f04280a-b600-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hackney.Wick.2 Magnetometer was an instrument used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field at a specific observatory station identified by IAGA as BYH from 1817 to 1822.
7f04280a-b600-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hackney Observatory

7f16737c-b7a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA station in Bucharest (identifier BUC) used for measuring magnetic fields since 1898.
7f16737c-b7a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Bucharest Observatory

7f2255a8-b5ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kenting Observatory in Checheng is an astronomical facility located at the National Museum of Natural Science's Kending Astronomical Observatory in Pingtung County, Taiwan. It is situated on Gui Mountain Trail and serves as a ground-based observatory for celestial studies.
7f2255a8-b5ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kenting Observatory, Taiwan

7f23474c-b77e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **SESAME (Satellite Experiments Simultaneous with Antarctic MEasurements)** is a ground-based research program in Antarctica, part of the NASA/ISAS Global Geospace mission, designed to study various geospace phenomena and their ionospheric effects using a suite of instruments centered at Halley.
7f23474c-b77e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Satellite Experiments Simultaneous with Antarctic Measurements at Halley

7f285d42-bb23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 17 Lunar Surface Experiments Package Lunar Ejecta and Meteorites (LEAM) experiment was designed to measure the frequency of cosmic dust particle impacts on the moon and evaluate the effects of lunar ejecta from meteorite impact sites.
7f285d42-bb23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lunar Ejecta And Meteorites Experiment part of Apollo 17 Lunar Surface Experiments Package

7f2d2332-bb86-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Bennington Magnetometer Station, part of the Mid-continent MAgnetoseismic Chain (McMAC), is located in Bennington, Nebraska, USA. It functions as a ground facility for monitoring geomagnetic activity at an altitude of 330.104 meters above Earth's surface.
7f2d2332-bb86-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Mid-continent Magnetoseismic Chain Bennington Station, United States

7f42334a-b879-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Torreaguila Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Puebla de la Calzada, Badajoz, Spain. It is a ground-based facility situated at the Villa romana de Torre Águila site.
7f42334a-b879-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Torreaguila Observatory, Spain

7f432fe4-b5a3-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **PSP FIELDS Instrument** is part of the Parker Solar Probe mission, designed to measure magnetic and electric fields, plasma wave spectra, and other properties in the inner heliosphere to study coronal heating mechanisms.
7f432fe4-b5a3-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Fields Antenna part of Parker Solar Probe

7f43a0c2-b8d3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAVEN Magnetometer (MAG) is an instrument onboard the MAVEN spacecraft designed to measure the magnitude and direction of magnetic fields around Mars, including interplanetary, induced, ionospheric, and crustal fields.
