8cd70ae6-bb92-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Kapuskasing (KAPU) station** is a ground-based observatory located in Kapuskasing, ON, Canada, and part of the UCLA Ground Based Observatories Network.
8cd70ae6-bb92-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kapuskasing Geophysical Observatory, Canada

8ce47a48-ba1e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatory of Atmospheric Environment in Shigaraki is a ground-based facility located in Kouka, Shiga, Japan, operated by the Research Institute for Sustainable Humanosphere (RISH) at Kyoto University. It focuses on monitoring and studying atmospheric conditions, including aerosol extinction spectrometry.
8ce47a48-ba1e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatory of Atmospheric Environment in the Shigaraki MU Observatory, Japan

8cec197e-bb4a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Volkssterrenwacht Simon Stevin is an astronomical observatory located in Hoeven, North Brabant, Netherlands. It serves as a ground-based facility for stargazing and astronomical research.
8cec197e-bb4a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Volkssterrenwacht Simon Stevin Observatory, Netherlands

8cee6682-ba43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lohrmann Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Dresden, Germany. It was established in 1913 and serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research.
8cee6682-ba43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lohrmann Observatory, Germany

8cefd6ae-b122-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The California Institute of Technology Caltech 40m Telescope at Owens Valley Radio Observatory (OVRO) is a radio telescope with a 40-meter aperture located in North America, specifically at the Owens Valley Radio Observatory.
8cefd6ae-b122-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: 40.0m radio telescope at Owens Valley Radio Observatory, North America

8cf7e0d0-bbcf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL (Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1U Engineering Data Interface is an instrument designed to convert analog signals, such as temperatures, voltages, and currents, into digital data with high precision. It includes various inputs for voltage, current, and temperature measurements, all scaled to a 5V full-scale range.
8cf7e0d0-bbcf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

8cfaf6b8-b782-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The OSIRIS-REx Visible and Near Infrared Spectrometer (OVIRS) is an instrument aboard the OSIRIS-REx spacecraft designed to map surface characteristics of asteroids in visible and near-infrared wavelengths, featuring a 4 mrad field of view and spectral coverage from 0.4 to 4.3 microns.
8cfaf6b8-b782-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Visible and Near Infrared The OSIRIS-REx Visible and Near InfraRed Spectrometer on OSIRIS-REx Spacecraft

8d00221a-b6b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The RCT Consortium's Robotically Controlled 1.3m Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Kitt Peak National Observatory in North America, designed for automated astronomical observations.
8d00221a-b6b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Robotically Controlled 1.3m Optical Telescope at Kitt Peak National Observatory

8d10a682-b7ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Muntinlupa Station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Poblacion, Muntinlupa District 1, Metro Manila, Philippines, operating as part of the IUGONET Observatory network to monitor magnetic field variations on Earth's surface.
8d10a682-b7ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at CPMN Muntinlupa Station, Philippines

8d170fe8-b637-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Okinawa Station is a ground-based magnetometer network located in Kunigami, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan, operating as part of the IUGONET Observatory to monitor magnetic field variations.
8d170fe8-b637-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Okinawa Observatory, Japan

8d17f3fa-b10e-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ionospheric Station at Wallops Island, Virginia, USA (URSI-code: WP937) is an advanced ionosonde facility that evaluates various parameters of skywave signals reflected from the ionosphere to determine reflection points and other characteristics.
8d17f3fa-b10e-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionospheric Station at GIRO Observatory on Wallops Island, United States

8d1a688e-b667-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Very Large Telescope (VLT) Melipal (UT3) is an 8.2-meter Ritchey-Chretien Cassegrain telescope located at the European Southern Observatory's Paranal Observatory in Chile, featuring advanced optics and an alt-azimuth mount for comprehensive sky coverage.
8d1a688e-b667-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 8.2m Very Large Telescope Unit Telescope 3 Melipal optical at Paranal Observatory, Chile

8d245d50-b7aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Astronomical Observatory of the Jagiellonian University (MPC ID: 055) is a ground-based observatory located in Krakow, Poland, operated by Jagiellonian University since 1792.
8d245d50-b7aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Observatory at Krakow

8d26134c-bbb6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 2M is a component of the BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) mission, which uses multiple high-altitude balloons equipped with scientific instruments to study the precipitation of relativistic electrons from Earth's radiation belts.
8d26134c-bbb6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray on BARREL Balloon 2M part of NASA Living with a Star Geospace Mission of Opportunity

8d328356-b80b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ionospheric Station at Yakutsk (URSI-code: YA462) is a ground facility located in Yakutsk, Russia, equipped with an advanced ionosonde that evaluates angle of arrival, polarization, and Doppler frequency shift of skywave signals reflected from the ionosphere.
8d328356-b80b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionospheric Station at Yakutsk Observatory, Russia

8d35c9b4-b845-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **British Antarctic Survey (BAS)** is a leading environmental research center based in the United Kingdom that conducts national scientific activities in Antarctica and collaborates with various international institutes to provide ground magnetometer data from multiple stations.
8d35c9b4-b845-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at British Antarctic Survey, Antarctica

8d3c3e5a-b969-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Kyoto, Japan, specifically the WDC observatory station with the IAGA identifier QGZ. It measures the Earth's magnetic field and is part of a global network for geomagnetic observation since 1982.
8d3c3e5a-b969-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Qiongzhong Observatory

8d4399ea-b95d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity "Colorado Springs" refers to a ground-based observatory facility located in Pueblo County, Colorado, United States, specializing in magnetometer observations as part of the IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) network.
8d4399ea-b95d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Colorado Springs Observatory, United States

8d4daaf8-b64b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 1H is a component of the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) mission, designed to measure and provide trajectory positions in various coordinate systems as part of its ephemeris data.
8d4daaf8-b64b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

8d543fb2-ba79-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the Deep Space Station 53 (DSS-53), a ground-based observatory used for space communications and tracking.
8d543fb2-ba79-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Deep Space Station Antenna 53

8d604c76-ba1a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Digital CCD Imagers on the Flare Monitoring Telescope (FMT) at Ica University in Peru are instruments used for capturing detailed images of solar flares and other chromospheric activities on the Sun.
8d604c76-ba1a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digital CCD Imagers on Flare Monitoring Telescope at Kwasan Hida Observatory

8d6e8ba6-b8da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Zouy Geomagnetic Observatory (ZUY), located in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, is a ground facility dedicated to monitoring and studying Earth's geomagnetic field. It includes a magnetometer as part of its instrumentation.
8d6e8ba6-b8da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Zouy Geomagnetic Observatory, Russia

8d791a90-bae6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Altdorf Observatory**: A ground-based astronomical observatory located in Holzgerlingen, Germany. It is identified by the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code K40 and is situated at coordinates 48.625483° N, 9.0135° E.
8d791a90-bae6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Altdorf Observatory, Germany

8da8f520-ba56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Stuttgart Observatory is an astronomical observatory in Stuttgart, Germany, operated by the volunteer association Schwäbische Sternwarte e.V., located on Uhlandshöhe hill since 1922.
8da8f520-ba56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stuttgart Observatory, Germany

8dab082c-b904-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ettaiyapuram Geomagnetic Observatory (ETT), located in Ettayapuram, Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, India, was a ground-based facility that operated from 1980 to 2002 for monitoring geomagnetic activity. It included instruments such as magnetometers and contributed data under the sponsorship of India.
8dab082c-b904-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ettaiyapuram Geomagnetic Observatory, India

8dab334a-bb27-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Spectrograph on the Domeless Solar Telescope (DST) at Hida Observatory is an instrument used to analyze the solar spectrum and study the Sun's activity.
8dab334a-bb27-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spectrograph on Domeless Solar Telescope at Kwasan and Hida Observatory

8db5de12-b82f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, and the specified entity refers to magnetometers located at the Hong Kong observatory (HKC) under the World Data Center for Geomagnetism in Kyoto.
8db5de12-b82f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hong Kong Observatory

8dbaae80-b9c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DMSP/F16 SSULI is an Imaging Spectrometer launched in 2003 as part of the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program (DMSP), designed to observe Extreme and Far UV radiation from Earth's limb, particularly focusing on the spectral range of 80-170 nm.
8dbaae80-b9c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Special Sensor Ultraviolet Spectrographic Imager part of Defense Meteorological Satellite Program

8dc8760e-b923-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatory of Atmospheric Environment in Syowa Station is a ground-based research facility located at Showa Station, Antarctica, dedicated to studying the atmospheric conditions and environment of the region. It is situated at coordinates -69.0 latitude and 39.6 longitude on Earth's surface.
8dc8760e-b923-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatory of Atmospheric Environment in Syowa Station, Antarctica

8dd1067c-b6d8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Besançon Astronomical Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Besançon, France, owned and operated by the Centre national de la recherche scientifique (CNRS).
8dd1067c-b6d8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Besançon Astronomical Observatory, France

8dd309d2-b9b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Diviner Lunar Radiometer Experiment (DLRE) is a multi-channel radiometer on the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter that measures emitted thermal and reflected solar radiation from the moon's surface using 21 detectors in nine spectral bands.
8dd309d2-b9b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Diviner Lunar Radiometer Experiment on Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter

8de2b67c-b739-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The FUV (Far Ultraviolet Imaging Spectrograph) is an instrument aboard the ICON satellite that captures 2D images of the Earth's horizon in far ultraviolet light, designed to study atmospheric phenomena and magnetic field interactions.
8de2b67c-b739-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Far Ultraviolet Imager on ICON

8de63362-b6a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: OV3-3 was a spacecraft launched in 1966 to measure trapped and precipitating particles and correlated electromagnetic wave fields in Earth's magnetosphere. It operated successfully for about 14 months before its tape recorder failed, but continued low-latitude tracking until it was deactivated in 1969.
8de63362-b6a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: OV3-3 Spacecraft

8de834c8-b872-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Vera C. Rubin Observatory**, formerly known as the Large Synoptic Survey Telescope (LSST), is an astronomical observatory under construction in Chile, designed to conduct a broad and comprehensive survey of space and time.
8de834c8-b872-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 8.42m Simonyi Survey Telescope at Vera C. Rubin Observatory, Chile

8debd52e-b651-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Spatial Heterodyne Imager for Mesospheric Radicals (SHIMMER) was an interferometer on the STPSat-1 satellite, designed to measure ultraviolet emissions in the mesosphere to observe water vapor (OH) and polar mesospheric clouds (PMCs).
8debd52e-b651-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spatial Heterodyne Imager for Mesospheric Radicals part of STPSat-1

8df287ae-baaa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Sonmiani is a ground-based observatory facility in Pakistan, part of the IAGA network, equipped with a magnetometer and located at an altitude of 55 meters on Earth's surface. It has been operational since January 1, 2008.
8df287ae-baaa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Sonmiani Observatory, Pakistan

8df7213a-bada-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The LWR was the redundant camera of the International Ultraviolet Explorer (IUE) satellite's Long-Wavelength Spectrograph instrument, used to capture ultraviolet spectra from 1850 to 330 angstroms.
8df7213a-bada-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet Long-Wavelength Spectrograph Redundant Camera on International Ultraviolet Explorer

8dfa4b08-b620-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ISEE Magnetometer Nyrola station** is a ground-based facility located at 440 Vertaalantie, Vertaala, Tikkakoski-Nyrölä, Jyväskylä, Finland. It operates as part of the IUGONET Observatory and specializes in magnetometer measurements.
8dfa4b08-b620-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Nyrola Station, Finland

8dfaa316-b8d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA-identified station PRE in Preobrazhenia, used for measuring magnetic fields.
8dfaa316-b8d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Preobrazhenia Observatory

8e07cfa4-b764-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The IAGA Shillong Magnetometer, operational since January 1976, is specifically located at the Shillong station and is part of the IUGONET observatory network, contributing to global geomagnetic research.
8e07cfa4-b764-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Shillong Observatory

8e13a0c8-b8e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The "Vega 2 Trajectory" instrument is a platform designed to investigate the position of the spacecraft during its mission. It provides ephemeris data, which includes the calculated positions of celestial objects and the spacecraft over time, as part of the Vega 2 observatory.
8e13a0c8-b8e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris part of Vega 2

8e1c295e-ba0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lowell Observatory 0.8m (31-inch) Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Lowell Observatory's Anderson Mesa site in North America.
8e1c295e-ba0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 0.8m Telescope at Lowell Observatory, Anderson Mesa

8e202fda-ba8a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetometer Array for Cusp and Cleft Studies (MACCS) is a collaborative project between Augsburg College and Boston University aimed at studying natural interactions in the Earth's space environment using magnetometers installed in various Arctic locations.
8e202fda-ba8a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer Array for Cusp and Cleft Studies

8e252b8a-bb01-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Double Star 1 EPOS Model Data" refers to a dataset within the EPOS (Earth Polar Orbiting System) catalogues, providing predicted scientific events and geometric/magnetic positions related to the Double Star mission conducted by CNES.
8e252b8a-bb01-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Unspecified investigation part of Double Star

8e2b2b1a-b5df-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields, particularly the Earth's magnetic field. The Teplitz Bay Magnetometer, located at the IAGA station TPB since 1904, has contributed to geomagnetic research as part of the observatory network.
8e2b2b1a-b5df-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Teplitz Bay Observatory

8e351d6e-b864-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Hartwell Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Hartwell, Northamptonshire, England. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
8e351d6e-b864-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hartwell Observatory, United Kingdom

8e3ade5a-b848-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tatuoca Geomagnetic Observatory (TTB) is a ground-based facility in Brazil that operated from 1933 to 1999, primarily focused on geomagnetic measurements.
8e3ade5a-b848-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tatuoca Geomagnetic Observatory, Brazil

8e4b4482-b787-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Jekman Island**: A ground-based observatory facility located in Russia, equipped with a magnetometer for geomagnetic measurements.
8e4b4482-b787-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Jekman Island Observatory, Russia

8e4cb43c-baef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetometer at Hatizyo is a magnetic field instrument located at the ground station in Hatizyo and has been operational since January 1967. It is part of the IUGONET Observatory managed by WDC Kyoto.
8e4cb43c-baef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hatizyo Observatory

8e5a0f1e-b613-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1J X-ray Instrument (XRI)** is a Scintillation Detector designed to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons. It utilizes a NaI crystal scintillator, photomultiplier tube, and pulse height analyzer to detect and analyze X-ray energies from 10 keV to 10 MeV with varying time resolutions for different scientific objectives.
8e5a0f1e-b613-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Scintillation Detector part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

8e5d514c-bb9f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Weipa station, located in Weipa, Queensland, Australia, is a ground-based observatory that has been operational since January 2010. It focuses on monitoring ionospheric scintillation and is situated at the coordinates -12.63 latitude and 141.88 longitude.
8e5d514c-bb9f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionospheric Scintillation Monitor at Weipa Observatory, Australia

8e614568-b834-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Entity Definition:**
The PUNCH-WFI 3 is a space telescope within NASA's PUNCH mission, designed to image and track sunlight scattered off free electrons in the boundary zone between the outer solar corona and the young solar wind, contributing to understanding solar wind formation and large space weather events.
8e614568-b834-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wide Field Imager on Punch Satellite part of Polarimeter to Unify the Corona and Heliosphere Mission

8e6681e0-b92e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ascot Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Ascot, England. It is situated at Buckhurst Road in the Royal Borough of Windsor and Maidenhead and operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical research.
8e6681e0-b92e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ascot Observatory, United Kingdom

8e874954-b86e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Rushay Farm Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Chapel Road, Bagber, Sturminster Newton, Dorset, England. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and studies.
8e874954-b86e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rushay Farm Observatory

8e8cc6d6-b75b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Fluxgate Magnetometer for P11 was an instrument designed to measure the magnetic fields of Jupiter and Saturn, featuring a triaxial fluxgate magnetometer sensor capable of detecting fields from 0.01 to 10 gauss along each axis. It operated until October 1979, providing vector measurements every 36 seconds without onboard processing.

8e918408-b9f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NIPR-type Low Power Magnetometer (NIPR-LPM) is a fluxgate magnetometer located at Skallen, Antarctica, known for its low power consumption and near-real-time data transmission via the Iridium satellite system.
8e918408-b9f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: NIPR-type Low Power Magnetometer at IUGONET Observatory, Antarctica

8e9459b2-b6cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GRBR (GNU Radio Beacon Receiver) is a digital receiver installed in Kototabang, Indonesia, designed to measure ionospheric total electron content (TEC) using Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite signals. It employs GNU Radio software and Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP) hardware for signal processing and acquisition at 150 and 400 MHz frequencies.
8e9459b2-b6cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waveform Receiver GNU Radio Beacon Receiver at Kototabang Observatory

8e975dd4-b6d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatório Astronômico do Sertão de Itaparica (OASI) is an astronomical observatory situated in the municipality of Itacuruba, Pernambuco, Brazil. Established in 2011, it operates as a ground-based facility with an altitude of 390 meters.
8e975dd4-b6d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatório Astronômico do Sertão de Itaparica at Nova Itacuruba Observatory, Brazil

8e98ab48-b96f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) station at Syowa Base, Antarctica, was a ground facility developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research to study upper atmospheric dynamics through nighttime airglow emissions. It is located at Fukushima's Rock Cairn, Showa Station, and has since been closed.
8e98ab48-b96f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers at Syowa Observatory, Antarctica

8ea5f89e-b82e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of Tasmania 26m Mount Pleasant antenna is a radio telescope located at the Mount Pleasant Radio Observatory in Australia. It has an aperture of 26 meters and operates within the radio waveband.
8ea5f89e-b82e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 26.0m radio University of Tasmania 26m Mount Pleasant antenna at Mount Pleasant Radio Observatory, Australia

8eab0714-b66f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Kuriwa Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Hawkesbury Heights, Australia. It operates as a ground-based facility and has been assigned the MPC code E28.
8eab0714-b66f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kuriwa Observatory, Australia

8eb3383e-bbac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of Southern California 18m (60-foot) Solar Tower at Mount Wilson Observatory is a telescope located in North America that observes the Sun in the optical waveband. It features an aperture of 18 meters and is part of the Mount Wilson Observatory.
8eb3383e-bbac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical University of Southern California 18m Solar Tower at Mount Wilson Observatory

8eb49390-bb21-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Alston Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Preston, Lancashire, England. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to the study of celestial objects and phenomena.
8eb49390-bb21-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Alston Observatory, United Kingdom

8ec553a6-b96e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Great Whale River station, operational from 1965 to 1984, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the IAGA investigation.
8ec553a6-b96e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Great Whale River Observatory

8ec73524-b831-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cambridge (CAM) Magnetometer Station, operated by the Institute of Geophysics and Planetary Physics at Los Alamos National Laboratory (IGPP-LANL), is located in Cambridge, Minnesota, USA. It functions as a ground facility for measuring magnetic field variations and is part of the broader IGPP-LANL observatory network.
8ec73524-b831-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Cambridge Observatory, United States

8ecf7642-b95a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The THEMIS-Associated Ground Magnetometer Stations are a network of ground facilities equipped with magnetometers, part of the THEMIS spaceflight mission, aimed at studying geomagnetic fields and space weather phenomena.
8ecf7642-b95a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Time History of Events and Macroscale Interactions during Substorms

8ed1848e-bb8d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Karmakuli is a ground-based observatory located in Novaya Zemlya Urban Okrug, Arkhangelsk Oblast, Russia, which operated from January 1977 to December 31, 1980. It was equipped with magnetometers and part of the IAGA network for magnetic observations.
8ed1848e-bb8d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Karmakuli Observatory, Russia

8ed1acfc-b999-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU radio beacon receiver (GRBR) station at Hirosaki is an observatory in Aomori Prefecture, Japan, dedicated to measuring ionospheric disturbances related to middle-upper atmospheric coupling processes.
8ed1acfc-b999-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU radio beacon receiver on GRBR station at Hirosaki Observatory, Japan

8edccb7c-ba3a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AstroCamp Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Nerpio, Albacete, Castile-La Mancha, Spain, dedicated to ground-based observations. It is situated at the coordinates 38.165641 latitude and -2.326700 longitude.
8edccb7c-ba3a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: AstroCamp Observatory, Spain

8ee67a4a-b644-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Midway-1 is a ground-based observatory located in the United States, specifically on Halsey Drive, North America. It was operational from January 1, 1964, to December 31, 1965, and included a magnetometer as part of its instrumentation.
8ee67a4a-b644-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Midway Observatory, United States

8ef22e0a-b958-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Sierra Contraviesa Observatory (MPC code Z85) is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Torvizcón, Granada, Spain.
8ef22e0a-b958-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sierra Contraviesa Observatory, Spain

8efb29ea-b7b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The PENGUIn-0 (PG0) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based research facility located on Earth's surface at an altitude of 2549 meters and coordinates -83.7 latitude, 88.7 longitude, operational since December 28, 2014. It includes a magnetometer as part of its instrumentation.
8efb29ea-b7b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at PENGUIn-0 Geophysical Observatory, Antarctica

8f01377a-b691-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Scheuren Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Wermelskirchen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It has been operational since 1994 and is situated at an altitude of 200 meters.
8f01377a-b691-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Scheuren Observatory, Germany

8f01dff0-baff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **Fluxgate Magnetometer** is an instrument used at the Bullcreek Observatory to measure variations in the Earth's magnetic field. It is part of The MEASURE Magnetometer Array and aids in geomagnetic studies by providing precise measurements of magnetic flux density.
8f01dff0-baff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Bullcreek Observatory

8f0bd8d4-b97e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Spacewatch Project is an astronomical survey based at the University of Arizona's telescopes on Kitt Peak near Tucson, Arizona, specializing in the study of minor planets, including asteroids and comets.
8f0bd8d4-b97e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spacewatch Project at Kitt Peak Observatory, United States

8f0ef6ae-b965-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ghezz Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Acquarossa, Switzerland. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
8f0ef6ae-b965-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ghezz Observatory, Switzerland

8f0f96ce-b9ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lovo Geomagnetic Observatory (LOV) was a ground-based facility in Sweden dedicated to geomagnetic measurements, operational from 1929 to 2004.
8f0f96ce-b9ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Lovo Geomagnetic Observatory, Sweden

8f0fa702-b6c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "MESSENGER Spacecraft Ephemeris Virtual Instrument" is a platform used for investigation, specifically designed to track and report the positional data of the MESSENGER spacecraft. It is part of the CNES Observatory CDPP-AMDA infrastructure.
8f0fa702-b6c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris part of MESSENGER Mission

8f159f8c-b91e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, and the one at the Dourbes ground station, part of the IAGA investigation since 1955, specifically monitors the Earth's magnetic field.
8f159f8c-b91e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet Observatory

8f1cb222-b5d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Zeist Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Beusichem, Buren, Gelderland, Netherlands. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
8f1cb222-b5d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Zeist Observatory, Netherlands

8f24e10e-b833-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ccd21 camera is an astronomical instrument featuring a Lick3 CCD with 2048x2048 pixels, used on the Kuiper 1.54m telescope to achieve an effective plate scale of 0.435 arcseconds per pixel with 3x3 binning.
8f24e10e-b833-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.54m Telescope

8f2553a4-b866-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Skybor Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Borja, Zaragoza, Aragon, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for celestial observations and research.
8f2553a4-b866-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Skybor Observatory, Spain

8f2f5950-b9b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Yuzhny Shar station (identified by IAGA as YSH), operational since January 1980.
8f2f5950-b9b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IUGONET Observatory

8f3b20ee-b852-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The **Stull Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located at Alfred University in New York, known for its seven telescopes and public outreach programs.
8f3b20ee-b852-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stull Observatory

8f3f8bbe-b917-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Guangzhou Geomagnetic Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Guangzhou City, China, that operates a magnetometer to monitor geomagnetic activity as part of the IAGA observatory network.
8f3f8bbe-b917-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Guangzhou Geomagnetic Observatory, China

8f4ce70e-b729-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Purple Mountain Observatory, Xuyi Station is an astronomical observatory located in Xuyi County, Jiangsu Province, China. It operates as part of the Purple Mountain Observatory and serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research.
8f4ce70e-b729-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Purple Mountain Observatory, Xuyi Station, China

8f53a080-b6e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Arizona Radio Observatory (ARO) 12m Sub-millimeter Telescope is a large radio telescope with a 12-meter aperture located at the Mount Graham International Observatory in North America, designed for observing millimeter wavebands.
8f53a080-b6e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Millimeter Arizona Radio Observatory Sub-millimeter Telescope at Mount Graham International Observatory

8f5774dc-b821-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The specific magnetometer referenced here was operational from January 1, 1957, to December 31, 1959, at Climax as part of the IAGA investigation.
8f5774dc-b821-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy

8f5a486e-b8ef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Instituto de Astrofisica de Andalucia (IAA-CSIC) 0.9m Telescope at Observatorio de Sierra Nevada is a telescope with an aperture of 0.9 meters, located in Europe and specialized in optical waveband observations. It is part of the Observatorio de Sierra Nevada facility in Spain.
8f5a486e-b8ef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.9m optical Telescope at Observatorio de Sierra Nevada

8f6c2bea-b7ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Radio Plasma Imager (RPI) on the IMAGE spacecraft was a low-frequency radio sounder designed to characterize plasma in Earth's magnetosphere by transmitting and receiving coded electromagnetic waves.
8f6c2bea-b7ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Plasma Imager on IMAGE

8f71c882-b132-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Magnetometers at Beijing Ming Tombs (BMT)" is a magnetic field instrument located at the Beijing Ming Tombs ground station, used to measure and monitor magnetic fields since January 1991.
8f71c882-b132-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Beijing Observatory

8f76820e-ba11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Ewa Beach Station is a ground-based magnetometer observatory located in East Honolulu, United States, part of the global MAGDAS network for geomagnetic monitoring.
8f76820e-ba11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ewa Beach Observatory, United States

8f8335d4-b8af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NSF NOIRLab Coude Feed Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Kitt Peak National Observatory in North America, funded by the National Science Foundation.
8f8335d4-b8af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Coude Feed Telescope at Kitt Peak National Observatory

8fa456ec-b701-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to an astronomical instrument known as the Palmer Divide 0.5m CCD, specifically a Finger Lakes Instrumentation (FLI) IMG with a Kodak 1001E sensor featuring a resolution of 1024x1024 pixels and a pixel size of 24 micrometers.
8fa456ec-b701-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.25m FLI IMG w/Kodak 1001E at Palmer Divide Observatory

8fab8586-bae2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Langmuir Probe and Waves (LPW) instrument is part of the MAVEN mission to Mars, designed to measure electron density, temperature, and electric field wave power in the Martian ionosphere. It helps determine ionospheric properties, wave heating, and solar EUV input to understand atmospheric loss processes.
8fab8586-bae2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Langmuir Probe and Waves Instrument part of MAVEN Langmuir Probe and Waves Investigation

8fac371c-b5ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Andrushivka Astronomical Observatory** is a private astronomical observatory located in Andrushivka, Zhytomyr Oblast, Ukraine, established in 2001 and directed by Yuri Ivashchenko.
8fac371c-b5ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Andrushivka Astronomical Observatory, Ukraine

8fadb6c4-b6a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Martin de Vivies geophysical observatory is a ground-based facility located in the French Southern and Antarctic Lands that was operational from 1981 to 2013, primarily focusing on magnetic field measurements.
8fadb6c4-b6a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Martin de Vivies Observatory

8fb39f8c-b704-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The multi-color meridian scanning photometer (SPM) at Syowa Station, Antarctica is an instrument used to continuously monitor and record the intensity variations of auroral emission lines as a function of elevation angles in the meridian plane. It consists of multiple photometer units that scan the sky along the magnetic meridian, measuring specific wavelengths associated with auroral emissions.
8fb39f8c-b704-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Multi-color Meridian Scanning Photometer part of Auroral Observation at Syowa Station, Antarctica

8fb8b036-b9c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Magnetic Survey, Rubidium Vapor Magnetometer" on the OGO-4 spacecraft was an instrument used to conduct a comprehensive survey of Earth's magnetic field from 1967 to 1969. It provided scalar magnetic field measurements with high accuracy and time resolution, crucial for studying variations in the field magnitude.
8fb8b036-b9c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rubidium Vapor Magnetometer on OGO-4 spacecraft

8fb93266-bc0f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Al-Fulaij Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Barka Province, Al Batinah South Governorate, Oman. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
8fb93266-bc0f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Al-Fulaij Observatory, Oman

8fc24b24-b914-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The DSS-14 70-m Radio Telescope, also known as "Mars Station," is a fully steerable parabolic antenna located in Goldstone, California. It is part of NASA's Deep Space Network (DSN) and is used for radio astronomy observations and deep space communications.
8fc24b24-b914-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 70m DSS-14 Radio Telescope part of The Deep Space Network at Goldstone, United States

8fc57c26-b71c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Center for Planetary Exploration at Stony Brook University Nicolet iN10MX FTIR Microscope is an advanced infrared imaging instrument used for acquiring hyperspectral image cubes and point spectra, featuring a liquid nitrogen-cooled MCT 16 pixel linear array and DTGS detector.
8fc57c26-b71c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: infrared Nicolet iN10MX FTIR Microscope at Center for Planetary Exploration

8fc7128a-bb7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Viking Lander 2 Atmospheric Structure** experiment was a set of instruments on the Viking Lander 2 spacecraft that collected data to analyze the Martian atmosphere's pressure, temperature, and density below an altitude of 132 km.
8fc7128a-bb7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Atmospheric Structure part of Viking Lander 2

8fc8ef3c-b62c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Observatorio Kappa Crucis** is a ground-based observatory located in Córdoba, Argentina. It is situated at 494 Balcarce Street in Nueva Córdoba and is used for astronomical observations.
8fc8ef3c-b62c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kappa Crucis Telescope at Observatorio Kappa Crucis, Argentina

8fd04d28-b9be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ultra-Violet Auroral Imager (UVAI) is a Canadian instrument on the Interball Auroral Probe designed to capture ultraviolet images of auroras. Despite challenges with spacecraft motion, it successfully obtained high-resolution image data during its operational period.
8fd04d28-b9be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultra-Violet Auroral Imager on Interball Auroral Probe

8fd14912-b810-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cosmos Research Center is an astronomical observatory located in Encinitas, California. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
8fd14912-b810-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Encinitas Observatory, United States

8ff6800e-bb91-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Andenes Geophysical Observatory, located in Andøy, Nordland, Norway, is a ground-based facility equipped with instruments such as magnetometers for geophysical research. It has been operational since December 30, 2006.
8ff6800e-bb91-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Andenes Geophysical Observatory, Norway

8ffd31fc-b794-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 3.8-m UK Grubb-Parsons IR Cass. eq. reflector (UKIRT) is a 3.8-meter infrared telescope located at the Mauna Kea Observatories in Hawaii, operated by the Joint Astronomy Centre since 1978.
8ffd31fc-b794-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.8m United Kingdom Infrared Telescope at Mauna Kea Observatory, United States

8fffab68-b973-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Yorii Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It was established in 1988 and is situated at an altitude of 140 meters above sea level.
8fffab68-b973-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Yorii Observatory, Japan

900b68f6-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ISEE Magnetometer station at Kapuskasing, Canada is a ground-based facility located in Northeastern Ontario that monitors magnetic field variations on Earth's surface. It is situated at approximately 49.39 degrees latitude and -82.19 degrees longitude (277.81 degrees E).
900b68f6-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kapuskasing Observatory, Canada

900c071e-bbc6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed at the ICSWSE observatory in Oiso, Japan, used for measuring magnetic field variations as part of the global Magnetic Data Acquisition System (MAGDAS) network.
900c071e-bbc6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of MAGDAS Observation Network

90122998-ba70-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Puna'auia Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Punaauia, French Polynesia. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
90122998-ba70-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Puna'auia Observatory, France

9020af3c-bbc3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Brandon Geomagnetic Observatory (BRD)** is a ground-based facility in Canada that operates geomagnetic instruments to monitor Earth's magnetic field. It has been active since 2007 and is located at an altitude of 380 meters in the Unorganized North Cochrane region of North America.
9020af3c-bbc3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Brandon Geomagnetic Observatory, Canada

902463a8-b898-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
ELFIN B is a 3U+ CubeSat developed by UCLA for the ELFIN Mission, designed to study electron losses and fields in Earth's radiation belts using energetic particle detectors and a fluxgate magnetometer.
902463a8-b898-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electron Losses and Fields Investigation B

902bbc54-b5fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Spitsbergen Geomagnetic Observatory (SPB) was a ground-based facility located in Svalbard, Norway, that operated from January 1978 to December 1979, focusing on geomagnetic measurements.
902bbc54-b5fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Spitsbergen Geomagnetic Observatory

9036ae58-b633-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Goethe Link Observatory (code 760) is an astronomical observatory located near Brooklyn, Indiana, United States. It is operated by the Indiana Astronomical Society and owned by Indiana University, dedicated to amateur astronomy efforts.
9036ae58-b633-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Goethe Link Observatory

9036fc44-b9b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **The Studios Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Grantham, England, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial objects.
9036fc44-b9b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Grantham Observatory, United Kingdom

904a57f4-bae9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The BARREL Balloon 1Q Engineering Data Interface is a component of the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) mission, responsible for converting analog signals—such as temperatures, voltages, and currents—into digital data with high precision.
904a57f4-bae9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

904a621c-ba80-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Manastash Ridge Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Kittitas County, Washington, built by the University of Washington in 1972. It features a 0.75-meter Ritchey-Chrétien telescope and is primarily used for undergraduate instruction and research.
904a621c-ba80-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.75m Ritchey-Chrétien Telescope at Manastash Ridge Observatory, United States

90590ece-b92d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "National Solar Observatory NSO Hilltop Dome Facility at Sacramento Peak" is a ground observatory located on Sacramento Peak, dedicated to the study of solar phenomena. It features specialized telescopes and instruments for detailed observations of the Sun.
90590ece-b92d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: National Solar Observatory Hilltop Dome Facility at Sacramento Peak

905b18e2-b5b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Space Environment Monitor-2 (SEM-2) on NOAA 19 is an instrument designed to measure the Earth's radiation belts and charged particle precipitation in the upper atmosphere, consisting of two sensors: the Total Energy Detector (TED) and the Medium Energy Proton/Electron Detector (MEPED).
905b18e2-b5b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Space Environment Monitor-2 on NOAA 19

905bc76c-b708-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Pioneer Venus Orbiter Ultraviolet Spectrometer (OUVS) was an instrument on the Pioneer Venus spacecraft designed to map and analyze ultraviolet light in the Venusian atmosphere, aiding in understanding its composition, temperature, and photochemistry.
905bc76c-b708-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet Pioneer Venus Orbiter Ultraviolet Spectrometer on Pioneer Venus

9060decc-b817-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Tucci Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Martos, Jaén, Andalusia, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
9060decc-b817-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tucci Observatory, Spain

90799a86-ba4f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Bennett Ion-Mass Spectrometer (BIMS) on AE-E was an instrument designed to measure the concentrations of thermal ion species in the mass range 1 to 72 atomic mass units and ambient density range from 5 to 5.E6 ions/cc throughout its orbit, with adjustable scan times and voltage settings for optimizing sensitivity and resolution.
90799a86-ba4f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bennett Ion-Mass Spectrometer on Atmosphere Explorer E

907cbabe-b6ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Terra Nova Bay Geomagnetic Observatory (TNB), located in Antarctica and sponsored by Italy, has been operating since 1987 to conduct geomagnetic measurements. It is situated at Jang Bogo Station and includes a magnetometer as part of its instrumentation.
907cbabe-b6ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Terra Nova Bay Geomagnetic Observatory, Antarctica

909f244a-b83d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Compact Spherical Coil (CSC) Fluxgate Vector Magnetometer is a high-precision instrument used to measure magnetic fields with a range of ±65536 nT and a resolution of 20 bits at 100 vector samples per second, deployed on the SAC-C project from January 23, 2001, until December 4, 2004.
909f244a-b83d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Compact Spherical Coil Fluxgate Vector Magnetometer on SAC-C

90a074f8-b7f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Wimborne Minster Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Hinton Parva, Dorset, England. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
90a074f8-b7f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wimborne Minster Observatory, United Kingdom

90a8c826-bb9c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IAGA:BAH Magnetometer was an instrument used to measure magnetic fields at the IAGA Barth observatory from January 1898 to December 1903.
90a8c826-bb9c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Barth Observatory

90af8424-b915-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Spectral Instruments 10K CCD is an astronomical instrument located at Mount Lemmon, Arizona, equipped with a STA1600LN_10K detector for white light imaging and featuring a scroll shutter.
90af8424-b915-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spectral Instruments 10K CCD on Mount Lemmon Observatory

90b2c164-bb10-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The GNU Radio Beacon Receiver (GRBR) is a digital receiver installed in Nha Trang, Vietnam, designed to measure ionospheric total electron content (TEC) using signals from Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites. It utilizes open-source software (GNU Radio) and hardware (USRP) for signal processing and acquisition at frequencies of 150 and 400 MHz.
90b2c164-bb10-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waveform Receiver part of IUGONET Observatory, Viet Nam

90c757c8-b9c1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The High-Energy Proton Detector (HEPD) on Double Star 2 is an energetic particle instrument designed to measure high-energy protons in space, with J. Liang and J. B. Cao from CSSAR, China serving as its Principal Investigators.
90c757c8-b9c1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: High-Energy Proton Detector on Double Star 2

90cd0d1c-baf7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** La Sagra Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Granada, Spain, known for its robotic telescopes and contributions to tracking near-Earth objects and space debris.
90cd0d1c-baf7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: La Sagra Observatory, Spain

90d5855e-b5a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nippon-Svalbard Meteor Radar (NSMR) is an instrument in Svalbard, Norway that measures height profiles of horizontal winds in the mesosphere and lower thermosphere.
90d5855e-b5a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Meteor radar part of Nippon-Svalbard Meteor Radar investigation

90db3c4a-b78f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Murmansk Observatory, also known as Loparskaya/Murmansk, was a ground-based facility located in Olenegorsk Urban Okrug, Russia, that operated from 1957 to 1988. It primarily functioned as part of the IAGA observatory network and included magnetometers for geophysical research.
90db3c4a-b78f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Loparskaya Observatory, Russia

90e2e21e-bbd2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tellnitz Magnetometer was an instrument used to measure magnetic fields at the Tellnitz observatory from 1933-01-01 to 1934-12-31 as part of IAGA investigations.
90e2e21e-bbd2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tellnitz Observatory

90eeaed8-bb9a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Wustrow was a ground-based observatory in Germany, operational from 1891 to 1903, known for its magnetometer facilities and located at 13 Schmiedestraße, Wustrow.

9157ba4e-b9ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Chandrayaan-1 orbiter was India's first mission to the Moon, launched on October 22, 2008. 9161e1d4-b828-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Spektr-R**: A Russian radio astronomy satellite launched in 2011 as part of the RadioAstron project, designed to study supermassive black holes, collapsed stars, and dark energy using a 10-meter antenna.

916f1740-b9af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Aryabhatta Research Institute of Observational Sciences (ARIES) 3.6-meter Devasthal Optical Telescope is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Devasthal, India, designed for conducting observational research in astronomy and astrophysics.

9181228c-b86f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Command Module Observatory (V02) is an astronomical observatory located in Tempe, Arizona. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.

919e5c5c-b86b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Environmental Satellite, Data, and Information Service (NESDIS) Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite (GOES) system is a spacecraft operated by NESDIS that primarily observes the Sun in the x-ray waveband.

91f2a8c4-bba5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.3m Telescope at Skinakas Observatory

9288a9de-bb85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Norfolk Island Ionosonde station in Norfolk Island, NSW, Australia, operates radar instruments to investigate the ionosphere, with continuous operations since February 1964 using various models of ionosondes.
