a90244bc-bb6d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to an all-sky Electron Multiplying Charge Coupled Device (EMCCD) imager equipped with an RG665 filter, located in Gakona, Alaska (US). Specifically, it uses the ImagEM X2 EMCCD camera (C9100-23B) produced by Hamamatsu Photonics.
a90244bc-bb6d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: All-sky EMCCD Imager with a RG665 Filter at ISEE Observatory, United States

a9181ed8-b6c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: Farpoint Observatory is an astronomical observatory in Kansas, owned and operated by the Northeast Kansas Amateur Astronomers' League (NEKAAL), located near Auburn, approximately 30 miles southwest of Topeka.
a9181ed8-b6c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Farpoint Observatory

a91adf20-b642-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hornepayne (HRP) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Northeastern Ontario, Canada. It operates as part of the University of Alberta Polar Magneto-Atmospheric Laboratories and includes instruments such as magnetometers for geophysical research.
a91adf20-b642-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hornepayne Geophysical Observatory, Canada

a921d61a-b843-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Blauvac Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Blauvac, France. It operates as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical research and observations.
a921d61a-b843-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Blauvac Observatory, France

a931d156-b8fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: SORCE (SOlar Radiation and Climate Experiment) is a NASA satellite mission that measured incoming solar radiation in various wavelengths to study the Sun's impact on Earth's climate and atmosphere.
a931d156-b8fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar Radiation and Climate Experiment

a94e7452-bb01-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Anysllum observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Àger, Catalonia, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
a94e7452-bb01-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Anysllum Observatory, Spain

a94f1d3c-b852-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Alphard Observatory (K82) is an astronomical observatory located in Ostuni, Italy, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial phenomena.
a94f1d3c-b852-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ostuni Observatory, Italy

a94fb3a8-b8e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Liverpool Observatory, established before 1867 and located in Liverpool, England, is an astronomical facility dedicated to the study of celestial bodies. It was historically significant for its contributions to astronomy from its ground-based location on Earth.
a94fb3a8-b8e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Liverpool Observatory, United Kingdom

a950b5be-b688-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The THEMIS B spacecraft position data provides the location of the THEMIS B (or ARTEMIS P2) satellite in Geocentric Solar Ecliptic (GSE) coordinates with a resolution of 1 minute. This information is part of the broader ARTEMIS mission, which focuses on studying Earth's magnetosphere and its interactions with the solar wind.
a950b5be-b688-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform on THEMIS B spacecraft part of ARTEMIS

a9540c4a-b148-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Defense Meteorological Satellite Program (DMSP) F15 Operational Linescan System (OLS) is an imaging instrument on the DMSP satellite that measures visible and infrared wavelengths to provide global cloud cover imagery at resolutions of 0.56 km and 2.7 km.
a9540c4a-b148-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Operational Linescan System on Defense Meteorological Satellite Program

a955f71c-b8fa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Davao Geomagnetic Observatory (DAV) in the Philippines operated from 1965 to 1984, located at Maharlika Village in Davao City. It was a ground-based facility part of the WDC Kyoto network, which included magnetometer instruments for geomagnetic observations.
a955f71c-b8fa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Davao Geomagnetic Observatory, Philippines

a9620408-b6a7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "STEREO-B Position" is a dataset providing the positional data of the STEREO-B spacecraft in different coordinate systems. It's part of the CNES Observatory CDPP archive for the STEREO-B mission.
a9620408-b6a7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Position part of Solar Terrestrial Relations Observatory B

a968cd9c-baf3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Kullorsuaq (KUV) Geophysical Observatory** is a ground-based facility located in Avannaata, Greenland, equipped with a magnetometer and operational since 2007.
a968cd9c-baf3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kullorsuaq Geophysical Observatory, Greenland

a9711dc6-b693-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Explorer 54 (AE-D) was a NASA scientific satellite launched in 1975 to study the chemical processes and energy transfer mechanisms that govern the Earth's atmosphere and ionosphere, with a focus on high latitude regions.
a9711dc6-b693-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Atmospheric Explorer D

a9743e14-b9dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Cluster Ion Spectrometry (CIS)** instrument on the Cluster 2 spacecraft is designed to measure full 3D ion distributions with high time and mass-per-charge resolution, consisting of a Hot Ion Analyzer (HIA) and a time-of-flight Ion Composition and Distribution Function analyzer (CODIF).
a9743e14-b9dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cluster Ion Spectrometry on Cluster 2/FM7 (Samba)

a9827018-b601-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Niemegk Magnetic Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Niemegk, Germany, dedicated to monitoring and studying the Earth's magnetic field. It has been operational since 1890 and is funded by the GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences.
a9827018-b601-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Adolf Schmidt Observatory for Geomagnetism, Germany

a98871a4-b9bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Atmospheric Density Accelerometer (MESA) on AE-E was an instrument that measured neutral atmospheric density at altitudes between 120 to 400 km by quantifying satellite deceleration due to aerodynamic drag. It utilized three single-axis accelerometers to determine applied acceleration and provided data on various spacecraft parameters, including roll, attitude, and minimum altitude.
a98871a4-b9bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Miniature Electrostatic Analyzer on Atmosphere Explorer-E

a98fea28-bb8c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The specified magnetometer was operated at Asuka Station (ASK) from January 1, 1987, to December 31, 1991, as part of the IAGA investigation.
a98fea28-bb8c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy investigation

a9933f90-bb0d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sant Gervasi Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Barcelon, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
a9933f90-bb0d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sant Gervasi Observatory, Spain

a998d0f0-b83c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Etscorn Observatory, also known as the Frank T. Etscorn Campus Observatory, is an astronomical observatory located at New Mexico Tech in Socorro, New Mexico. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and educational activities.
a998d0f0-b83c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Etscorn Observatory at Socorro, New Mexico

a99d0f78-ba83-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Capodimonte Magnetometer was an instrument used for measuring magnetic fields at the IAGA observatory in Capodimonte from January 1, 1882, to December 31, 1922.
a99d0f78-ba83-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Capodimonte Observatory

a9a6c0a6-babd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Huygens Atmospheric Structure Instrument (HASI) is a suite of sensors on the Huygens Probe designed to measure the physical and electrical properties of Titan's atmosphere, including temperature, pressure, density, and electromagnetic activity.
a9a6c0a6-babd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Huygens Atmospheric Structure Instrument on Huygens Probe

a9a9b9ea-b86b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Virgo Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Seveso, Italy, dedicated to ground-based observations.
a9a9b9ea-b86b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Virgo Observatory, Italy

a9aabc6a-bc11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Uranium City Geomagnetic Observatory (URC) is a ground-based facility located in the Qikiqtaaluk Region of Nunavut, Canada, dedicated to monitoring and studying geomagnetic activity on Earth's surface.
a9aabc6a-bc11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Uranium City Geomagnetic Observatory, Canada

a9cb8b04-b980-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 16 Particles and Fields Subsatellite (PFS-2) was a small satellite deployed from the Apollo 16 Service Module to study the Moon's plasma, particle, and magnetic field environment. It operated in lunar orbit from April 24 to May 29, 1972, before impacting the Moon.
a9cb8b04-b980-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Particles and Fields Subsatellite part of Apollo 16

a9d2dd36-b922-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetometers at Bunia (BNA) was an instrument used to measure magnetic fields at the Bunia station from January 1, 1959, to December 31, 1960, as part of the IAGA investigation and affiliated with the iugonet-observatory-wdc_kyoto-wdc-bna observatory.
a9d2dd36-b922-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Bunia Observatory

a9e796a4-bb43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ISEE3 Spacecraft Ephemeris** provides the position and velocity data of the International Sun-Earth Explorer 3 (ISEE3) spacecraft in Geocentric Solar Ecliptic (GSE) coordinates.
a9e796a4-bb43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: International Sun/Earth Explorer 3 spacecraft position and velocity on International Sun/Earth Explorer 3

a9fc7748-b7fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Space Environment Monitor (SEM) on NOAA 8 was an instrument designed to measure proton and electron fluxes as well as energy spectra in the upper atmosphere, featuring detectors for various energy ranges of particles.
a9fc7748-b7fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: EnergeticParticleInstrument on NOAA 8

aa0781bc-b6e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Terres Blanches Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Reillanne, France, dedicated to ground-based observations of the night sky.
aa0781bc-b6e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Terres Blanches Observatory, France

aa0f59b0-bbe7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Liverpool Telescope (LT) is a two-meter robotic Ritchey–Chrétien telescope located at the Roque de los Muchachos Observatory in Garafía, La Palma, Spain. It operates autonomously, allowing professional astronomers and educational groups to submit observation requests online, with decisions made by its Robotic Control System based on visibility and weather conditions.
aa0f59b0-bbe7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.0m Liverpool Telescope at Roque de los Muchachos Observatory, Spain

aa126682-b692-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The UKIRT is a 3.8-meter infrared telescope situated at the Mauna Kea Observatory in Hawaii, operated by the United Kingdom and dedicated to observing celestial objects in the infrared spectrum.
aa126682-b692-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared 3.8m United Kingdom Infrared Telescope at Mauna Kea Observatory, United States

aa155e0a-ba20-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optec Observatory (code: Q114659494, MPC ID: 755) is an astronomical observatory located in Lowell Charter Township, Kent County, Michigan. It functions as a ground-based observatory and operates from Earth.
aa155e0a-ba20-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optec Observatory, United States

aa16ed72-b946-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Rover Camera Rear for MPFR is an imaging system mounted on the rear of a rover, providing visual data to monitor activities, terrain, and surroundings from behind. It assists with navigation and safety during exploration by capturing wide-angle views.
aa16ed72-b946-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rover Camera Rear on Mars Pathfinder

aa1b7b4e-b784-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 9-channel ELF/VLF receiver at Tjornes, Iceland is an antenna instrument designed for conducting conjugate observations in the extremely low frequency and very low frequency ranges as part of the IUGONET Observatory network.
aa1b7b4e-b784-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Antenna part of Conjugate Observation at Iceland

aa1db2b6-b788-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DMSP/F18, SESS Special Sensor Ultraviolet Spectrographic Imager (SESS/SSULI) is an instrument launched in October 2009 as part of the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program. It observes Extreme and Far UV radiation from Earth's limb to measure electron density vertical profiles, ion densities, and neutral densities using a spectrograph with a spectral range of 80-170 nm.
aa1db2b6-b788-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Special Sensor Ultraviolet Spectrographic Imager on Defense Meteorological Satellite Program 5D-3 F18

aa314a8a-b96b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Venera 8 Energetic Particles experiment was a suite of particle detectors on the Soviet Venera 8 spacecraft that measured the flux of charged particles in interplanetary space during its mission to Venus. It specifically detected protons and electrons of various energy levels from both sunward and anti-sunward directions.
aa314a8a-b96b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particles on Venera 8

aa39fc5a-b9c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The **Corcaroli Observatory**, located in Malo, Vicenza, Italy, is an astronomical observatory dedicated to ground-based observations.
aa39fc5a-b9c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Corcaroli Observatory, Italy

aa3cbea0-b930-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hot Plasma Composition Analyzer (HPCA) on MMS1 is a mass spectrometer designed to measure the velocity-space distribution of ions within an energy range from 1 eV to 40 keV, with a high time resolution of 10 to 15 seconds. It is part of the CDPP-AMDA observatory managed by CNES and contributes to studying hot plasma composition in space.
aa3cbea0-b930-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hot Plasma Composition Analyzer on Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission

aa3d2184-bac9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Flensburg Magnetometer** was an instrument used to measure magnetic fields at the IAGA station in Flensburg from January 1891 to December 1903.
aa3d2184-bac9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Flensburg Observatory

aa47995c-ba29-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Dark Energy Camera (DECam)** is a high-performance wide-field CCD imager located at the Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory, primarily designed for the Dark Energy Survey. It features 62 CCDs providing a resolution of 0.263 arcseconds per pixel and is equipped with eight filters, making it versatile for various astronomical observations.
aa47995c-ba29-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: High-performance wide-field CCD imager at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory

aa4a5dac-b986-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Margherita Hack Observatory, also known as the Osservatorio Astrofisico di Arcetri, is an astronomical observatory located in Florence, Italy. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astrophysical research and observations.
aa4a5dac-b986-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Margherita Hack Observatory at Florence

aa4e5506-b846-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the Slooh.com Australia Observatory located in Coonabarabran, New South Wales, Australia, which is a ground-based astronomical facility situated at Timor Road with coordinates approximately -31.28174 latitude and 149.08135 longitude.
aa4e5506-b846-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Slooh.com Australia Observatory at Coonabarabran

aa507aa8-b5ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Swarm mission is a European Space Agency (ESA) project launched on November 22, 2013, aiming to conduct the most comprehensive survey of Earth's geomagnetic field and its temporal changes using three identical satellites equipped with advanced magnetometers and electric field instruments.
aa507aa8-b5ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Swarm part of Earth Explorer Mission

aa516f56-b5b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, and the one referenced here has been operational since January 1, 1978, as part of the IAGA investigation at the WDC Kyoto observatory.
aa516f56-b5b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at Back Observatory

aa5290d8-b7da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BCC Observatory in Black Canyon City is a ground-based observatory located at the Black Mountain Community Church in Arizona, United States.
aa5290d8-b7da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: BCC Observatory at Black Canyon City

aa52edb6-b687-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Jaichalad-Pailin Observatory is a ground-based observatory located in Pak Chong District, Nakhon Ratchasima Province, Thailand. It operates at the coordinates of 14.69832° latitude and 101.45455° longitude on the continent of Asia.
aa52edb6-b687-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Jaichalad-Pailin Observatory, Thailand

aa57ec3e-b8e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, and the one referenced here has been operational since 1958 at the IAGA station FYU in Fort Yukon.
aa57ec3e-b8e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Fort Yukon Observatory

aa5cda0e-bb66-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **FluxGate Magnetometer (FGM)** is an instrument on the Magnetospheric Multiscale (MMS) mission that measures magnetic fields using both analog and digital fluxgate magnetometers to provide intercalibrated data. It operates in different survey modes depending on the region of interest, with calibration aided by techniques like the curlometer method and Electron Drift Instrument monitoring.
aa5cda0e-bb66-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of Magnetospheric Multiscale

aa749ffa-b6a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **AHS Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Castaic, Los Angeles County, California, United States. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
aa749ffa-b6a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: AHS Observatory, United States

aa894efe-b95e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Electron Proton Telescope (EPT) is a component of the Energetic Particle Detector (EPD) suite, designed to measure electrons and ions in the lower energy range of the spectrum using the magnet/foil technique, with multiple fields of view.
aa894efe-b95e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electron Proton Telescope part of Solar Orbiter

aa8c2eea-bc28-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tacubaya Observatory was a ground-based facility in Mexico City that operated from 1890 to 1926 and included magnetometers for geophysical measurements.
aa8c2eea-bc28-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tacubaya Observatory, Mexico

aa8c97b0-b85c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: La Vara Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Valdes, Asturias, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting observations and research in astronomy.
aa8c97b0-b85c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatorio La Vara at La Vara Observatory, Spain

aa8ea5e6-b7d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Ultraviolet Imager (UVI)** on the Polar spacecraft is an ultraviolet imaging camera designed to capture global images of auroras at various wavelengths with high temporal and spatial resolution, aimed at studying energy influx into Earth's atmosphere and characteristics of precipitating particles.
aa8ea5e6-b7d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet Imager on Polar

aa9001ee-bbcb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
BARREL Balloon 4A was a high-altitude balloon mission, part of NASA's BARREL project, that operated from August 13 to August 14, 2016, in the stratosphere above Earth. It carried instruments to measure X-rays produced by precipitating relativistic electrons and study radiation belt losses.
aa9001ee-bbcb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses part of NASA Living with a Star

aa982d94-b7f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Venus Express ASPERA-4 Neutral Particle Imager (NPI) is an instrument designed to measure the integral flux of Energetic Neutral Atoms (ENAs) with specific angular resolution and a wide field of view, utilizing a graphite surface and MCP stack for detection.
aa982d94-b7f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutral Atom Imager part of Venus Express

aa9c8000-b7c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The specific magnetometer referred to here was operational from 1899 to 1938 and located at the De Bilt station in Kyoto, as part of the IAGA investigation.
aa9c8000-b7c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at De Bilt

aaa2950c-b7cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Crozet/Port Alfred Magnetometer** is an instrument located at the Port Alfred geophysical observatory in South Africa, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) investigations since 1974.
aaa2950c-b7cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Port Alfred Observatory

aabfbc6c-b807-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **NenuFAR Spectral Power Receiver** is an astronomical instrument designed to form beams for radio telescope arrays. It has been operational since July 1, 2019, and is part of the NenuFAR observatory in France.
aabfbc6c-b807-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spectral Power Receiver on NenuFAR

aac39bb6-b5fa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: North Pole 7 was a ground-based observatory located at the Earth's surface (latitude 85.82, longitude 268.13) that operated from January 01, 1957 to December 31, 1959 and included a magnetometer as part of its instrumentation.
aac39bb6-b5fa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ground Magnetometer at North Pole 7

aad4ecf0-b61c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Suprathermal Ion Spectrograph (SIS) is a component of the Energetic Particle Detector (EPD) suite onboard Solar Orbiter, designed to measure the time of flight and energy of ions between H-Fe in the energy range from just above solar wind energies to multiple MeV/nucleon, providing insights into their composition and distribution.
aad4ecf0-b61c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Suprathermal Ion Spectrograph part of Solar Orbiter

aadb2170-b800-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The Magnetometer located at the Monte Capellino geophysical observatory has been operational since July 1958 and is part of the World Data Center for Geomagnetism in Kyoto (WDC_GDMC).
aadb2170-b800-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Monte Capellino Observatory

aadf938a-b8f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR) Ooty Radio Telescope is a radio telescope located in Ooty, Asia, operated by the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research. It is primarily used for observing solar phenomena.
aadf938a-b8f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: radio Ooty Radio Telescope

aae496bc-b8ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **CPMN fluxgate magnetometer at LNP** is a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer installed at the Lunping station in Taiwan, part of the CPMN observation network under IUGONET.
aae496bc-b8ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Chinese Meridian Project Network Observation

aae6de20-b82d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **Magnetometer** is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength or direction of magnetic fields, specifically Earth's magnetic field. The **Overhauser Magnetometer** is an advanced type designed for high-precision measurements, determining proton precession frequency once per second with an accuracy better than 0.5 nT.
aae6de20-b82d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of CHAMP Mission

aaec2fda-b934-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Rabbit Lake is a ground-based observatory on Earth's surface equipped with a magnetometer, functioning as part of the CARISMA network.
aaec2fda-b934-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Rabbit Lake Observatory

aafe3646-b5fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Rosetta Orbiter Spectrometer for Ion and Neutral Analysis (ROSINA) is an instrument onboard the Rosetta spacecraft, comprising two mass spectrometers and a pressure sensor, designed to study the composition, temperature, and dynamics of a comet's atmosphere and ionosphere.
aafe3646-b5fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rosetta Orbiter Spectrometer for Ion and Neutral Analysis part of Rosetta Mission

aafee2a8-ba77-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Ion Mass Analyzer (HYPERBOLOID)** on the Interball Auroral Probe is a plasma spectrometer designed to study low-energy ion dynamics in the high latitude ionosphere and magnetosphere, capable of measuring 3D ion distribution functions over an energy range from about 0.1 to 80 eV and detecting multiple ion species simultaneously.
aafee2a8-ba77-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hyperboloid on Interball Auroral Probe

ab01519c-b5ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DMSP/F15, SEM Special Sensor Precipitating Electron and Ion Spectrometer 4 (SEM/SSJ4) is an instrument on the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program that measures the energy transfer, mass, and momentum through the magnetosphere-ionosphere in Earth's magnetic field using four electrostatic analyzers.
ab01519c-b5ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Special Sensor Precipitating Electron and Ion Spectrometer 4 on Defense Meteorological Satellite Program

ab1d631c-b875-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity describes a specific astronomical instrument, the Finger Lakes Instrumentation Pro-Line Fairchild Imaging CCD 3041B1, which is a back-illuminated CCD with 2048x2048 pixels and a pixel size of 15 microns, used at the Valle d'Aosta Observatory.
ab1d631c-b875-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Finger Lakes Instrumentation Pro-Line Fairchild Imaging CCD 3041B1 on 85cm Telescope at Valle d'Aosta Observatory

ab22fa04-b6f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Camden Ionosonde station near Sydney, Australia, operates various types of ionosondes since 1980 to study the Earth's ionosphere. It currently uses an IPS 5D digital ionosonde that sweeps frequencies from about 1.0 to 21.5 MHz with a resolution of 5 kHz.
ab22fa04-b6f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar Ionosonde part of Camden Observatory, Australia

ab232d66-b950-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Heavy Ion Large Telescope (HILT)** on SAMPEX was an instrument designed to measure the charge, energy, and mass of cosmic rays within specific energy ranges for different elements. It utilized a combination of position-sensitive proportional counters, an ionization chamber, solid state detectors, and a CsI scintillation counter to accurately determine these properties.
ab232d66-b950-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Instrument on Heavy Ion Large Telescope part of Solar Anomalous and Magnetospheric Particle Explorer

ab294ffe-b773-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ISON-Hureltogoot Observatory (code: O75) is an astronomical observatory located in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
ab294ffe-b773-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ISON-Hureltogoot Observatory, Mongolia

ab2b988a-b85a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **STEREO-B IMPACT Low Energy Telescope (LET)** is a particle detector onboard the NASA STEREO-B spacecraft, designed to measure the composition, energy spectra, and angular distributions of ions (from Hydrogen to Nickel) and identify rare isotopes like 3He, contributing to the study of Solar Energetic Particles and Coronal Mass Ejections.
ab2b988a-b85a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Low Energy Telescope part of In-Situ Measurements of Particles and CME Transients on Solar Terrestrial Relations Observatory B

ab2d3144-b6ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatorio UCM is an astronomical observatory located in Madrid, Spain. It is situated at the Colegio Oficial de Físicos (COFIS) and serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
ab2d3144-b6ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Madrid Observatory, Spain

ab2f5352-bb99-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The California Institute of Technology Caltech Millimeter Array (CMA) is an instrument located at the Owens Valley Radio Observatory in North America, operating within the millimeter waveband.
ab2f5352-bb99-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Millimeter California Institute of Technology Caltech Millimeter Array at Owens Valley Radio Observatory

ab3c0236-b5ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GRBR (GNU Radio Beacon Receiver) is a digital receiver located in Biak, Indonesia, designed to measure ionospheric total electron content (TEC) using signals from Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites. It utilizes open-source GNU Radio software and Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP) hardware for signal processing and acquisition.
ab3c0236-b5ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waveform Receiver part of GRBR (GNU Radio Beacon Receiver) investigation, Indonesia

ab4ce204-b5f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The VLF/ELF crossed loop antenna at Athabasca, Canada, is an instrument designed to measure magnetic field variations in the Very Low Frequency (VLF) and Extremely Low Frequency (ELF) ranges. It consists of two perpendicular loops (NS and EW) with a height of 5 meters and operates with a sampling rate of 100 kHz, peaking in sensitivity at 8 kHz.
ab4ce204-b5f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Very Low Frequency/Extremely Low Frequency Crossed Loop Antenna at Iugonet Observatory

ab4e5b9a-b7ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The US Naval Observatory (USNO) 1.3m Telescope at Naval Observatory Flagstaff Station (NOFS) is a telescope located in North America with an aperture of 1.3 meters, designed for observing neutrinos, particles, and gravitational waves.
ab4e5b9a-b7ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.3m Telescope at Naval Observatory Flagstaff Station

ab6c316e-bb49-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Palmerston North Observatory (Q114452736) is an astronomical observatory located in the Manawatū-Whanganui region of New Zealand. It is a ground-based facility situated at coordinates 175.47 longitude and -40.237349 latitude, primarily used for astronomical observations and research.
ab6c316e-bb49-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Palmerston North Observatory, New Zealand

ab71576a-b979-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Valdelugueros is a village located in the province of León, within the Castile and León region of Spain. It is home to the LCB Lugueros Observatory, a ground-based astronomical facility situated at coordinates approximately 42.98362° N, 54.58571° W.
ab71576a-b979-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lugueros Observatory, Spain

ab7312c4-b9a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Europa Imaging System (EIS) Wide-Angle Camera (WAC) is an instrument on the Clipper spacecraft designed to capture high-resolution color and stereoscopic images of Europa, studying geologic activity and measuring surface elevations.
ab7312c4-b9a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Europa Imaging System Wide-Angle Camera on Clipper

ab796e0c-b6e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition**:
The MEASURE Magnetometer Array's Millstone Hill instrument is a fluxgate magnetometer situated at the Millstone Hill geomagnetic observatory, designed to measure variations in the Earth’s magnetic field.
ab796e0c-b6e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of MEASURE

ab7d56e6-b735-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 1G is a high-altitude balloon mission launched as part of the BARREL project to study relativistic electron losses from Earth's radiation belts, operating in the stratosphere from January 14 to January 27, 2013.
ab7d56e6-b735-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses part of Living with a Star, Geospace Mission of Opportunity

ab817ef8-b689-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The Magnetometers at North Pole 6 (NPF) specifically refer to those located at the WDC Kyoto observatory, part of the IUGONET network, designed to monitor and record magnetic field data in that region.
ab817ef8-b689-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at WDC Kyoto Observatory

ab897cb0-bb58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Active Spacecraft Potential Control (ASPOC) on Cluster-4 is an instrument designed to regulate the electric potential of a spacecraft relative to its surrounding plasma by emitting positive ions, ensuring that the spacecraft's potential remains stable and low to minimize interference with scientific measurements.
ab897cb0-bb58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Active Spacecraft Potential Control on Cluster-4

ab8ce602-b617-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The McDonald Observatory, located in Fort Davis, Texas, is an astronomical observatory known for its ground-based facilities and contributions to astrophysical research.
ab8ce602-b617-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: McDonald Observatory, United States

ab92e6f2-b7ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Golden Hill Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Stourton Caundle, Dorset, England. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to the observation of celestial objects and phenomena.
ab92e6f2-b7ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Golden Hill Observatory

ab955c0e-b6ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tennant Creek station is a ground-based observatory in Tennant Creek, Northern Territory, Australia, which operated an ionosonde from May to November 1985.
ab955c0e-b6ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionosonde at Tennant Creek Observatory, Australia

abaa6196-b73e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Steward Observatory 1.5m (60inch) Telescope is part of the Catalina Sky Survey located at the Mount Lemmon Observing Facility in North America, designed for optical waveband observations.
abaa6196-b73e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.5m Steward Observatory Telescope part of Catalina Sky Survey on Mount Lemmon Observing Facility

abad5730-b918-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Wilhelm Foerster Observatory** in Berlin is a large public observatory named after German astronomer Wilhelm Foerster, allowing visitors to observe the sky through several telescopes.
abad5730-b918-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wilhelm Foerster Observatory, Germany

abb9ab6e-b938-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The specified entry refers to magnetometers located at the observatory in Alice Springs, part of the IUGONET network since 1992, under the IAGA investigation.
abb9ab6e-b938-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Alice Springs Observatory

abbe96b8-b88b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Blue Mountains Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Leura, New South Wales, Australia. It is situated at Observatory Cottage, 94 Rawson Parade, and serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
abbe96b8-b88b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Blue Mountains Observatory at Leura, Australia

abbee8de-bade-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Hayabusa**, formerly known as Muses-C, is a Japanese asteroid sample-return spacecraft developed by the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA). Launched in 2003, its primary objective was to collect samples from the near-Earth asteroid Itokawa and return them to Earth for analysis.
abbee8de-bade-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Spectrometer and X-ray Spectrometer on Hayabusa spacecraft

abc2abce-bbbd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Wellesley College 0.6m (24-inch) Margaret Sawyer Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Whitin Observatory in North America, primarily used for astronomical observations and educational purposes.
abc2abce-bbbd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical Wellesley College 0.6m Margaret Sawyer Telescope at Whitin Observatory

abcb8542-b69e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute (KASI) 1m Telescope is an optical telescope with a 1-meter aperture located at the Mount Lemmon Optical Astronomy Observatory in North America.
abcb8542-b69e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.0m Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute Telescope at Mount Lemmon Optical Astronomy Observatory

abd5d536-bb37-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apogee AP8 is an imaging instrument developed by Apogee Imaging Systems, primarily utilized in various astronomical and scientific applications to capture high-quality images. It's identified within NASA's Planetary Data System (PDS) context under the code urn:nasa:pds:context:instrument:modra.0m6.ap8type.
abd5d536-bb37-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Apogee AP8

abd7adba-ba4d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The GONG instrument at Mauna Loa Solar Observatory in Hawaii is an interferometer used by the Global Oscillation Network Group for helioseismology studies. It continuously monitors solar oscillations to investigate the Sun's internal structure and dynamics.
abd7adba-ba4d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Interferometer part of Global Oscillation Network Group at Mauna Loa Solar Observatory

abdcde46-b8dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "ThemisD Different Magnetospheric Analytical Models" is an instrument within the THEMIS project, hosted by CDPP-AMDA at CNES Observatory, that provides various analytical models for studying Earth's magnetosphere.
abdcde46-b8dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetospheric Analytical Models part of Themis Mission

abdddf9a-bb34-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Lunping Geomagnetic Observatory (LNP) is a ground-based facility located in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, that has operated since 1965 for geomagnetic monitoring, sponsored by China.
abdddf9a-bb34-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geomagnetometer at Lunping Geomagnetic Observatory, Taiwan

abe2ebb8-b84e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Chalandray-Canotiers Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Chalandray, France. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
abe2ebb8-b84e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Chalandray-Canotiers Observatory, France

abec9356-bab1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) All-sky imager at Shigaraki, Japan is a multi-wavelength instrument developed by Nagoya University to study the upper atmosphere's dynamics through nocturnal airglow emissions. It is part of a network aimed at investigating the mesosphere and thermosphere layers.
abec9356-bab1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Multi-wavelength All-Sky Imager part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers at Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research Observatory, Japan

ac0d7e36-b5f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Anzio Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Anzio, Italy. It is a ground-based facility used for conducting various astronomical observations and research.
ac0d7e36-b5f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Anzio Observatory, Italy

ac112280-b9ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Francisquito Observatory (G70) is an astronomical observatory located in Santa Clarita, California. It operates as a ground-based facility and is situated at the coordinates 34.463211° N, 241.4547° E.
ac112280-b9ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Francisquito Observatory

ac14d352-b674-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter (LOLA) is a laser altimeter onboard the LRO spacecraft that measures precise distances to the lunar surface, providing high-resolution topographic data and assisting future exploration activities. It also helps characterize the polar illumination environment and identify potential locations of surface ice in shadowed polar craters.
ac14d352-b674-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter on Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter

ac18a908-baea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Rani Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Sabre Springs, San Diego, California. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
ac18a908-baea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: San Diego Observatory

ac1dd916-b732-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Luckystar Observatory is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Važec, Central Slovakia. It is situated at coordinates 49.05441° N latitude and 19.987° E longitude within the District of Liptovský Mikuláš, Region of Žilina.
ac1dd916-b732-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Luckystar Observatory, Važec

ac2a2252-ba5c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a magnetometer that was operational from January 1, 1972, to December 31, 1974, located at the station with the IAGA identifier NHO in Norway House. This instrument was part of the IUGONET observatory and contributed to the IAGA investigation.
ac2a2252-ba5c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IUGONET-Observatory WDC Kyoto WDC NHO

ac323fae-b8e6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **Magnetometer** is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, specifically in this context, it includes both an Absolute Scalar Magnetometer (ASM) for measuring field intensity and a Vector Field Magnetometer (VFM) for measuring the magnetic field vector.
ac323fae-b8e6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Absolute Scalar Magnetometer and Vector Field Magnetometer part of CNES Observatory

ac34cad0-b841-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **CLPS Task Order 19D SCALPSS East Long Focal Length Camera** is a component of the Stereo CAmeras for Lunar Plume-Surface Studies (SCALPSS) system, featuring a 50mm lens designed to capture video during lunar descent and landing to analyze plume-surface interaction effects.
ac34cad0-b841-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stereo CAmeras for Lunar Plume-Surface Studies East Long Focal Length Camera on CLPS Task Order 19D spacecraft

ac36ec4e-bb2e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Furukawa Observatory (MPC code: 863) is an astronomical observatory located in Osaki, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. It is a ground-based facility situated at coordinates 36.26142° N, 137.18° E.
ac36ec4e-bb2e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Furukawa Observatory, Japan

ac3da682-b850-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CLPS Task Order 19D Regolith Adherence Characterization (RAC) Wheel A Bottom side is a camera within the RAC experiment designed to photograph and characterize regolith changes on sample materials exposed to the Lunar environment, specifically focusing on the bottom side of Wheel A from launch through landing.
ac3da682-b850-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Regolith Adherence Characterization experiment part of Commercial Lunar Payload Services Task Order 19D

ac4e2508-b656-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MASTER-Tavrida Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Nauchnyi, Crimea, Ukraine. It operates as a ground-based facility focused on astronomical research and observations.
ac4e2508-b656-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: MASTER-Tavrida Observatory, Ukraine

ac50894c-ba11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nancay Observatory is an astronomical research facility located in Nançay, France. It is known for housing the Nançay Radio Telescope, a significant instrument used for radio astronomy.
ac50894c-ba11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 35 m Radio Telescope at Nancay Observatory

ac51b49e-b8f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ASKANIA spectroheliograph is a historical imaging instrument used for solar observations, specifically capturing full-disk images of the Sun's chromosphere and photosphere in the Ca II K line and white light. It operated from 1926 to 1969 across multiple locations including Kyoto University, Kwasan Observatory, and Ikoma Observatory.
ac51b49e-b8f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ASKANIA Spectroheliograph at Kwasan Observatory

ac6071e6-b83f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the ground-based observatory located at 5, Sternstraße, Bech, Wald, Solingen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, known as "Solingen."
ac6071e6-b83f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solingen Observatory, Germany

ac61d00c-b9f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The High-resolution Fourier Transform Infrared Spectrometer (FTIR) at the Moshiri observatory is a Bruker IFS 120HR spectrograph operated by Nagoya University's Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research (ISEE), used to monitor the vertical distribution of atmospheric molecules such as O3, HCl, HNO3, and HF.
ac61d00c-b9f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: infrared High-resolution Fourier Transform Spectrometer at Moshiri Observatory

ac694268-bb36-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Tonghai Geomagnetic Observatory (THJ)** is a ground-based facility located in Tonghai County, Yunnan, China, dedicated to geomagnetic measurements and part of the IAGA observatory network.
ac694268-bb36-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tonghai Geomagnetic Observatory, China

ac6ae748-b6c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Australian National University (ANU) 1m Telescope is a telescopic observatory located in Australia and operated as part of the Las Cumbres Observatory Global Telescope Network (LCOGT).
ac6ae748-b6c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical 1.0m Telescope at Siding Spring Observatory, Australia

ac6c10ac-b77a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA station identified as EAA in East Anglia, operational since January 1973 and part of the iugonet-observatory network.
ac6c10ac-b77a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at East Anglia Observatory

ac791784-bac7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Miniature X-ray Solar Spectrometer (MinXSS) is a CubeSat designed and operated primarily by students at the University of Colorado Boulder for NASA's Science Mission Directorate to study solar x-ray emissions. It was launched in 2015 as the first science mission CubeSat under this directorate.
ac791784-bac7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray Miniature X-ray Solar Spectrometer CubeSat part of National Aeronautics and Space Administration Science Mission Directorate

ac79fc2a-b6f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Langmuir Probe Instrument (LANG) on Dynamics Explorer 2 was a cylindrical electrostatic probe used to measure electron temperature, concentration of electrons or ions, and spacecraft potential. It provided critical data on thermal plasma conditions and ionospheric effects within the magnetosphere-ionosphere system.
ac79fc2a-b6f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Langmuir Probe part of Dynamics Explorer 2

ac7b6f50-bc13-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mekrijarvi (MEK) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Mekrijärvi, Finland. It specializes in geophysical observations and includes instruments such as a magnetometer for monitoring Earth's magnetic field.
ac7b6f50-bc13-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Mekrijärvi Geophysical Observatory, Finland

ac81b6a2-bae8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity "Inge Lehmann" refers to a ground-based observatory facility located in North America, specifically in Greenland, that operated from January 01, 1966, to December 31, 1967. It includes a magnetometer and is part of the IAGA Observatory network under the Space Physics Archive Search and Extract (SPASE) framework.
ac81b6a2-bae8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Inge Lehmann Observatory, Greenland

ac87361e-b98e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** DMSP 5D-2/F7 is a meteorological satellite developed and operated by the U.S. Air Force as part of the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program, designed to provide global visual and infrared cloud cover data and specialized environmental information for defense purposes.
ac87361e-b98e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Defense Meteorological Satellite Program 5D-2/F07

ac8999e0-b7b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Multi-Band Camera (MBC) is a compact VIS-NIR camera onboard the SLIM lander, designed with a filter wheel and movable mirror to capture images in wavelengths ranging from 700 to 1700 nm.
ac8999e0-b7b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Multi-Band Camera on SLIM Lander

ac8a26dc-b842-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 15 X-ray Fluorescence Spectrometer (XRFS) was an instrument used during the Apollo 15 mission to map the lunar surface composition and conduct galactic X-ray observations. It operated by measuring the intensity and energy distribution of fluorescent x-rays produced by solar x-rays interacting with the lunar surface, featuring large-area proportional counters and a solar monitor for incident flux measurement.
ac8a26dc-b842-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray Apollo 15 X-ray Fluorescence Spectrometer on Apollo 15 Command and Service Module

ac93833c-b5ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Tbilisi Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Tbilisi, Georgia. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to the study of celestial objects and phenomena.
ac93833c-b5ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tbilisi Observatory

ac9e0c5e-b1a0-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Beliy Island Geomagnetic Observatory (BEY), located in Yamalsky Rayon, Russia, operated from 1973 to 1984 and was involved in geomagnetic measurements as part of the IAGA observatories network.
ac9e0c5e-b1a0-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Beliy Island Geomagnetic Observatory

ac9e2cf8-bae6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Santa Maria Station is a ground-based magnetometer network located at the Universidade Federal de Santa Maria in Brazil, used for monitoring geomagnetic activity.
ac9e2cf8-bae6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at Santa Maria Observatory, Brazil

aca59d1e-b607-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 1.52-m Ritchey-Chretien Cassegrain/Coude reflector is a 1.52 m telescope located at the Palomar Observatory in California, operational since 1970.
aca59d1e-b607-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.52m Ritchey-Chretien Cassegrain Coude Telescope at Palomar Observatory, United States

acac6db6-b719-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Solar Wind Ion Mass Spectrometer (SWIMS)** on the Advanced Composition Explorer (ACE) spacecraft measures the mass and energy of solar wind ions, including many isotopes, with high precision. It utilizes a deflection system and time-of-flight telescope to analyze ions within a velocity range specific to different elements, providing detailed data on solar wind composition and dynamics.
acac6db6-b719-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar Wind Ion Mass Spectrometer on ACE spacecraft

acac9478-ba5a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Balloon Observation Platforms for Planetary Science (BOPPS) Infrared Camera (BIRC) is a multispectral infrared imager designed to measure water and CO2 emissions from comets, as well as infrared absorption features in asteroids and the Moon within specific wavelength ranges.
acac9478-ba5a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Balloon Observation Platforms for Planetary Science Infrared Camera

acb066d6-bbcf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Timberlake Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Oakton, Virginia, United States. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
acb066d6-bbcf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Timberlake Observatory, United States

acb7c5e0-b5ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **University of Science and Technology of China and the Purple Mountain Observatory's 2.5m Wide Field Survey Telescope (WFST)** is an optical telescope with a 2.5-meter aperture located in Asia, designed for wide field surveys.
acb7c5e0-b5ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical 2.5m Wide Field Survey Telescope at Purple Mountain Observatory

acc2d202-b6c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The HARIMAU (Hydrometeorological ARray for Isv-Monsoon AUtomonitoring) project's transportable wind profiler, called LQ7, is an advanced active-phased array radar located in Biak, Indonesia. It uses seven Luneberg lens antennas to observe height profiles of wind velocity and atmospheric turbulence in the lower troposphere, operating at a center frequency of 1357.5 MHz with a peak transmitted power of 2800 W.
acc2d202-b6c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.5 m^2 Transportable Wind Profiler on Hydrometeorological ARray for Isv-Monsoon AUtomonitoring

acd39d5a-b796-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **IGPP-LANL Table Mountain Magnetometer** is a ground facility located near Big Pines, California, USA, designed to measure magnetic fields and is part of the IGPP/LANL Observatory.
acd39d5a-b796-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Table Mountain Observatory, United States

acd45e5c-b99e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 6.5-m Single Mirror Telescope (MMT) is a large telescope with a 650 cm aperture located at the MMT Observatory in Arizona, USA. It replaced an earlier array of six smaller reflectors and was rededicated in May 2000.
acd45e5c-b99e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 6.5m MMT Telescope at MMT Observatory, United States

acd4aed2-b6d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Rikubetsu Observatory, located in Hokkaido, Japan and operated by Nagoya University, is a ground-based facility primarily used for radio observations.
acd4aed2-b6d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rikubetsu Observatory, Japan

acdaab40-b6ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Werner Schmidt Observatory is an astronomical observatory located at Dennis-Yarmouth Regional High School in South Yarmouth, Massachusetts. It is used for ground-based observations and educational purposes.
acdaab40-b6ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Werner Schmidt Observatory at Dennis-Yarmouth Regional High School, United States

acddf584-b8cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Toyonaka Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Toyonaka, Osaka Prefecture, Japan, known for its ground-based facilities.
acddf584-b8cc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Toyonaka Observatory, Japan

acdeb66a-b960-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Big Cypress Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, United States. It operates as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
acdeb66a-b960-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Big Cypress Observatory, United States

acf9e7fa-b816-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Yunnan-HK Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Gaomeigu, Yulong Naxi Autonomous County, Lijiang City, Yunnan, China. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical observations and research.
acf9e7fa-b816-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.6m Cassegrain Telescope at Yunnan-HK Observatory, China

ad0498f6-b921-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Entity Definition:**
FedSat (Australia's 'Federation Satellite') is an Australian scientific research satellite launched in 2002. It carried various experimental payloads for communications, computing, GPS studies, magnetometry, and cultural preservation until its mission ended in 2007 due to battery failure.
ad0498f6-b921-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Federation Satellite

ad09b5a2-bc96-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tecnosky Astropark in Felizzano is a ground-based observatory located at 15023 Felizzano, Alessandria, Piedmont, Italy. It's situated at geographical coordinates of approximately 44.91289 latitude and 8.43764 longitude in Europe.
ad09b5a2-bc96-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tecnosky Astropark, Felizzano

ad0d861e-ba39-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Brelingen Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Brelingen, Wedemark, Lower Saxony, Germany. It is a ground-based observatory dedicated to astronomical research and observation.
ad0d861e-ba39-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Brelingen Observatory, Germany

ad0f0a56-b7bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The magnetometer at Yauca was an instrument used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field from January 1, 1957, to December 31, 1960. It was part of the IUGONET Observatory and operated under the investigation name IAGA.
ad0f0a56-b7bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet Observatory

ad182814-bab4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The specific one in question operates as part of the IAGA observatory in San Pablo de Los Montes starting from 1981.
ad182814-bab4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at San Pablo de Los Montes Observatory

ad26fd3a-b762-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Newport Geomagnetic Observatory (NEW)** is a ground-based facility located in Pend Oreille County, Washington, United States. It specializes in geomagnetic measurements and is part of the INTERMAGNET network, contributing to global geomagnetic data collection since 1966.
ad26fd3a-b762-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Newport Geomagnetic Observatory, United States

ad2ebaf0-b97b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Santana Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Rancho Cucamonga, California, used for ground-based observations of celestial objects.
ad2ebaf0-b97b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Santana Observatory

ad3a1e88-ba5f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **EMN Ariquemes station** is a ground-based magnetometer network located in Rio Crespo, near Ariquemes in Rondônia, Brazil. It operates under the IUGONET Observatory and contributes to geomagnetic field measurements for scientific research.
ad3a1e88-ba5f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ariquemes Observatory, Brazil

ad560bf2-b645-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Rodeno Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Alfara de la Baronia, Valencia, Spain. It operates as a ground-based observatory for conducting various astronomical observations and research.
ad560bf2-b645-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rodeno Observatory, Spain

ad611bc0-b8dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ionospheric Station at Ilorin, Nigeria (IL008) is a ground-based observatory equipped with a Digisonde for advanced ionospheric studies, focusing on evaluating signal properties reflected from the ionosphere. It operates as part of the Global Ionospheric Radio Observatory (GIRO) network and has been active since March 26, 2010.
ad611bc0-b8dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionospheric Station at Ilorin Observatory, Nigeria

ad62075c-b76e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Uraniborg Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Écija, Sevilla, Spain.
ad62075c-b76e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Uraniborg Observatory, Spain

ad67cb90-b612-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Badlands Observatory (IAU code 918) is an astronomical observatory located in Quinn, South Dakota, known for its contributions to the discovery of minor planets. It was founded by American amateur astronomer Ron Dyvig in 2000.
ad67cb90-b612-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Badlands Observatory, United States

ad69e88c-b804-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Institut de Radioastronomie Millimétrique (IRAM) 30m Telescope is a radio telescope located in Europe, specifically designed to observe astronomical phenomena in the millimeter waveband with an aperture of 30 meters.
ad69e88c-b804-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Institut de Radioastronomie Millimétrique 30m Telescope

ad7e6638-b703-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Baghdad Observatory is a ground-based facility in Baghdad, Iraq, operating since January 1987, primarily functioning as an IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) observatory with instruments such as magnetometers.
ad7e6638-b703-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Baghdad Observatory, Iraq

ad8a0e1e-b77d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Chambon la Foret Magnetic Observatory** is a ground-based magnetic observatory located in France that operates as part of the EMN magnetometer network. It is managed by the Paris Institute of Earth Physics and focuses on monitoring and studying magnetic fields on Earth's surface.
ad8a0e1e-b77d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Chambon la Foret Observatory, France

ad8c661a-bad3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Niederbexbach Observatory is a ground-based observatory located in Niederbexbach, Saarland, Germany, at coordinates 49.33085° N latitude and 7.26381° E longitude.
ad8c661a-bad3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Niederbexbach Observatory, Germany

ad99821c-b945-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Loudwater Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Buckinghamshire, England. It is designated by the Minor Planet Center with ID 497 and is a ground-based facility used for stargazing and research purposes.
ad99821c-b945-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Loudwater Observatory, United Kingdom

ad9d3abc-b970-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Remeis Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Bamberg, Germany. It is known for its ground-based facilities and contributions to astronomical research.
ad9d3abc-b970-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bamberg Observatory, Germany

ada2dfe0-ba2d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The magnetometer at Sdr. Stromfjord (STF) has been operational since January 1, 1972, and is part of the IAGA investigation at the IUGONET Observatory - WDC Kyoto.
ada2dfe0-ba2d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Sdr Stromfjord Observatory

adae46f8-b9cb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The San Miguel Magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field at the San Miguel Observatory in Spain. It was operational from January 1, 1911, until December 31, 1977.
adae46f8-b9cb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at San Miguel Observatory

adb21c42-bbb5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Freiberg was a ground-based observatory in Germany, operational from 1890 to 1899, equipped with magnetometers for geomagnetic measurements.
adb21c42-bbb5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Freiberg Observatory, Germany

adb36862-b774-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Goldstone DSS-14 64-m Radio Telescope" is a fully steerable parabolic radio/radar antenna, part of NASA's Deep Space Network (DSN), originally built in 1964 to support the Mariner 4 flyby of Mars and later upgraded.
adb36862-b774-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 70m Radio/Radar Antenna part of Deep Space Network, United States

adb9c7f0-b78f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kuma Kogen Astronomical Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Kumakōgen, Ehime Prefecture, Japan.
adb9c7f0-b78f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kuma Kogen Astronomical Observatory, Japan

adc2c252-b83d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sakamoto Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Otsu, Shiga Prefecture, Japan.
adc2c252-b83d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sakamoto Observatory, Japan

adc5f9aa-ba53-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The THEMIS A Spacecraft Modes refer to the operational configurations of the Time History of Events and Macroscale Interactions during Substorms (THEMIS) mission's A spacecraft, including slow survey, fast survey, particle burst, and wave burst modes. These modes dictate how the spacecraft collects and processes data related to Earth's magnetosphere.
adc5f9aa-ba53-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform on ARTEMIS P1

adc95204-b7b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Enkoping Geomagnetic Observatory (ENK) is a ground facility located in Mörbylånga kommun, Sweden. It operated from 1965 to 1980 and was part of the IAGA network for geomagnetic data collection.
adc95204-b7b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Enkoping Geomagnetic Observatory

adce878e-b83a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU Radio Beacon Receiver (GRBR) Station at Biak is an observatory in Indonesia designed to measure ionospheric disturbances related to middle-upper atmospheric coupling processes. It is part of the GRBR network and located near the equator at Warsansan, Biak Numfor, Papua.
adce878e-b83a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU Radio Beacon Receiver on GRBR Station at Biak Observatory, Indonesia

adcf1894-b72b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at the Vostok station, identified by IAGA as VOS, which has been operational since January 1, 1958.
adcf1894-b72b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Vostok

ade1f17a-b8a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Jena Observatory (Astrophysikalisches Institut und Universitäts-Sternwarte Jena) is an astronomical observatory owned and operated by Friedrich Schiller University of Jena, located in Jena, Germany. It has two main sites dedicated to astrophysics research and education since 1813.
ade1f17a-b8a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Jena Observatory, Germany

ade685c8-b60f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cassini Imaging Science Subsystem (ISS) Narrow Angle Camera (NAC) is a high-resolution reflecting telescope aboard the Cassini spacecraft, designed to capture detailed images of the Saturn system with a focal length of 2002.70 mm and a spectral range from 200 nm to 1100 nm, featuring advanced thermal management and data processing capabilities.
ade685c8-b60f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Narrow Angle Camera on Cassini Spacecraft

adeeacea-b839-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Neutral Atmosphere Temperature Experiment (NATE) on AE-E was a space-based instrument designed to measure the kinetic temperature of the neutral atmosphere by analyzing molecular nitrogen density variations within a spherical chamber. It utilized multiple techniques, including satellite motion analysis and baffle interception, to determine ambient temperatures independently of scale height.
adeeacea-b839-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutral Atmosphere Temperature part of AE-E

adfa0d3c-bac4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Deep Space Station 54 (DSS-54) is a 34-meter radio telescope located in Robledo de Chavela, Spain, which became operational in 1997 and utilizes a 'beam waveguide' design to enhance its transmission and reception capabilities.
adfa0d3c-bac4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 34m Deep Space Station 54 on Madrid Deep Space Communications Complex, Spain

adfcdcb2-bad1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields, particularly the Earth's magnetic field. The Van.Rensselaer Magnetometer, identified by the IAGA code VAN, has been operational since 1854 as part of a ground-based observatory.
adfcdcb2-bad1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Van Rensselaer Observatory

ae07a044-ba30-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Leura Observatory is an astronomical ground-based facility located in Leura, New South Wales, Australia. It operates a telescope with a 0.25m diameter for various astronomical observations.
ae07a044-ba30-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.25m Telescope at Leura Observatory, Australia

ae165b26-b7fa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Crescent Moon Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Columbus, Indiana. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to celestial observations and research.
ae165b26-b7fa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Crescent Moon Observatory, United States

ae17c14a-b9ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The European Gravitational Observatory (EGO) Virgo Interferometer is a scientific facility located in Europe designed to detect and study neutrinos, particles, and gravitational waves.
ae17c14a-b9ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gravitational Wave Detector at European Gravitational Observatory

ae1ed096-b99c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Palmer Divide Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Colorado Springs, Colorado. It is funded by Brian D. Warner and operates as a ground-based observatory.
ae1ed096-b99c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Palmer Divide Observatory, United States

ae2a492a-b9ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Starry Night Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Colorado County, Texas, United States. It is situated on Earth and serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
ae2a492a-b9ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Starry Night Observatory, United States

ae30fe60-ba0a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Masi (MAS) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Kautokeino, Norway, dedicated to geophysical research and equipped with instruments such as magnetometers.
ae30fe60-ba0a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Masi Geophysical Observatory

ae4ef8c0-b65e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kew Magnetometer was an instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field, operational from 1842 until 1924 at the Kew Observatory as part of the IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) network.
ae4ef8c0-b65e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kew Observatory

ae572410-bbad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Stennis Space Center Magnetic Observatory**, also known as the Bay St. Louis Observatory, is a ground-based magnetic observatory located at the Stennis Space Center in Hancock County, Mississippi. It monitors and records variations in Earth's magnetic field, funded by the United States Geological Survey.
ae572410-bbad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Bay St. Louis Observatory, United States

ae5c42e4-b976-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cawthron Atkinson Observatory is an observatory located in Nelson, New Zealand, situated in the grounds of Clifton Terrace School after previously being at Pipers Park. It is known for its contributions to astronomical observations and research within the region.
ae5c42e4-b976-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cawthron Atkinson Observatory, New Zealand

ae60b9ee-b7fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kuiper Telescope is an astronomical observatory located on Mount Bigelow in Arizona, U.S., with a 1.54-meter aperture and a focal length of 9.6 meters. It is part of the Catalina Sky Survey and situated at an altitude of 2510 meters in Pima County.
ae60b9ee-b7fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.54m Catalina Sky Survey Telescope on Mount Bigelow, United States

ae6affec-bbbe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Rosetta Spacecraft Ephemeris is a virtual instrument that provides precise positional data for the Rosetta spacecraft during its mission to study comet 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko. It helps in understanding the spacecraft's trajectory and location over time, crucial for scientific analysis of the mission's observations.
ae6affec-bbbe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Virtual Instrument part of Rosetta Spacecraft

ae6f74e6-b5f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Gamma Ray and Neutron Detector (GRAND) was an instrument onboard the Dawn spacecraft designed to measure gamma rays and neutrons to determine the elemental composition of celestial bodies like Vesta and Ceres.
ae6f74e6-b5f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gamma Ray and Neutron Detector on Dawn

ae77ee02-bbd5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Camille Flammarion Observatory** is an astronomical observatory established in 1883 by French astronomer Camille Flammarion in Juvisy-sur-Orge, France, and classified as a historical monument in March 2010.
ae77ee02-bbd5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Camille Flammarion Observatory, France

ae91cf8a-b77e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Auckland Ionosonde** is a ground-based instrument located near Auckland, New Zealand, used for investigating the ionosphere. It has operated various models of ionosondes since 1967, with data available for specific parameters like foF2 and M(3000)F2.
ae91cf8a-b77e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar Ionosonde at Auckland Observatory, New Zealand

ae96d23c-bad5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Plasma Wave Experiment on CRRES was an instrument package that included a Search Coil Magnetometer and Passive Plasma Sounder designed to measure plasma wave environments in radiation belts, with a focus on high frequency resolution, low noise levels, and broad frequency response.
ae96d23c-bad5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Search Coil Magnetometer and Passive Plasma Sounder part of CRRES

ae9a0042-b6d4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Generic Visual Wavelengths High-Speed Photometer** is a device designed to detect and measure rapid fluctuations in light intensity within the visible spectrum, used for high-speed photometric measurements in scientific, industrial, and engineering applications requiring real-time data.
ae9a0042-b6d4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Generic Visual Wavelengths High Speed Photometer

aea358ac-bb81-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Institute for Astrophysics (INAF) Catania Astrophysical Observatory's 0.15 m solar telescope, located in Europe, is a facility equipped with a 0.15-meter aperture designed to observe the Sun within the optical waveband.
aea358ac-bb81-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.15m Solar Telescope at National Institute for Astrophysics Catania Astrophysical Observatory

aea7a548-bba8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Radiation Belt Storm Probe Ion Composition Experiment (RBSPICE) is an energetic particle instrument onboard the RBSP-B observatory, designed to study ion composition and distribution in Earth's inner magnetosphere during geomagnetic storms, with high angle and energy resolution. It includes a sensor named Puck for detailed measurements.
aea7a548-bba8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Instrument Radiation Belt Storm Probe on Radiation Belt Storm Probes

aeb43aaa-b73a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 2Q X-ray Instrument (XRI) is a scintillation detector used in the BARREL project to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons, providing insights into electron losses in Earth's radiation belts.
aeb43aaa-b73a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-Ray Scintillation Detector part of Balloon Array for Relativistic Electron Losses

aeb4b04e-bb44-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Quadrispherical Analyser, part of the ELECTRON investigation on the Interball Tail Probe, is designed to measure the 3-dimensional distribution function of plasma electrons in the energy range from 10 eV to 26 keV with high angular resolution and sensitivity. It utilizes a quadri-spherical electrostatic analyzer and microchannel plates to achieve comprehensive coverage through spacecraft rotation.
aeb4b04e-bb44-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Quadrispherical Analyser part of 3D Electron Distribution Function on Interball Tail Probe

aeb4d6d2-b9be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer operated from 1963 to 1967 as part of the IAGA investigation, located at the observatory in Kyoto with the identifier NSM.
aeb4d6d2-b9be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Nitsanim Observatory

aed170c2-b742-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Wakayama Forest Research Station of Kyoto University, located in Aridagawa, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan, is a ground-based facility dedicated to environmental and atmospheric research.
aed170c2-b742-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Aerosol Photoacoustic Spectrometer at Wakayama Forest Research Station, Japan

aed23eb8-bbc4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Dual Technique Magnetometer (MAG) on the Cassini spacecraft includes a fluxgate magnetometer and a vector/scalar helium magnetometer, positioned on an 11-meter boom to minimize interference from the spacecraft's electric currents and metallic components.
aed23eb8-bbc4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dual Technique Magnetometer on Cassini

aedef060-b8fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **SWARM-A** is one of the three identical satellites in ESA's Swarm mission, launched to study Earth's geomagnetic field and its temporal evolution from a near-polar orbit.
aedef060-b8fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geomagnetic Satellite part of Swarm

aee771c8-ba68-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1A Tilt Compensated Magnetometer (TCM2)** is a three-axis magnetometer onboard the BARREL payload, designed to measure magnetic field components with high resolution for identifying substorm activity and ULF oscillations.
aee771c8-ba68-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

aef1faee-b748-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Alger Island Magnetometer** is a ground-based instrument located at the observatory on Alger Island. It measures magnetic field variations and has been operational since 1905 as part of the IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) network.
aef1faee-b748-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Alger Island Observatory

aef46bc0-b8a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Starkenburg Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Heppenheim, Germany, founded in 1970 and currently operated by about 150 members.
aef46bc0-b8a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Starkenburg Observatory, Germany

aef7489c-ba94-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Culgoora Solar Telescope, located at the Culgoora Solar Observatory in New South Wales, Australia, is a ground-based instrument equipped with a 12 cm telescope for solar H-alpha imagery and a radio spectrograph to monitor solar radio bursts.
aef7489c-ba94-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spectrometer on Culgoora Solar Telescope, Australia

aef77afa-b8c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AVON instrument is a type of antenna used for investigating Very Low Frequency (VLF) magnetic components originated from lightning discharges. It operates at the Los Banos station in the Philippines and is part of the IUGONET Observatory managed by Tohoku University's radio observation facility.
aef77afa-b8c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Antenna part of IUGONET Observatory

aef80722-b789-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Riometer station at Zhigansk, Russia (ZGN) is a ground facility developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research (ISEE), Nagoya University, to study upper atmospheric dynamics via nocturnal airglow emissions. It is located in the Sakha Republic and collaborates with the Institute of Cosmophysical Research and Aeronomy.
aef80722-b789-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer at Zhigansk Observatory, Russia

aefd08de-b1ae-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Chepil Wind Tunnel is a research facility at the High Plains Wind Erosion Laboratory (HPWEL) of Kansas State University, designed to investigate wind erosion and soil movement, especially in agricultural and desert settings.
