bab7eec6-b5a2-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Autonomous Adaptive Low-Power Instrument Platform (AAL-PIP) Chain is a network of six autonomous stations established on the East Antarctic Plateau to study geomagnetically conjugate current systems and space weather phenomena in Polar Regions, using low-power magnetometers, GPS receivers, HF radio experiments, and solar power.
bab7eec6-b5a2-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Autonomous Adaptive Low-Power Instrument Platform Chain on Southernsecs, Antarctica

baba44a2-ba7d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Yinchuan Geomagnetic Observatory (YCB), located in Xingqing District, Yinchuan City, China, is a ground-based facility for geomagnetic measurements at an altitude of 1100 meters.
baba44a2-ba7d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Yinchuan Geomagnetic Observatory, China

babc4d6e-b6e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Mount Weather is a ground-based observatory located in Loudoun County, Virginia, United States, that operates a magnetometer for geomagnetic research. It has been functional since 1908 and is part of the IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) network.
babc4d6e-b6e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Mount Weather Observatory

bad9b28e-b7d4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The LANL01A Energetic Sensor for Particles (ESP) is an instrument that measures high-energy particles, specifically electrons and protons within defined energy ranges. It utilizes a bismuth germanate crystal coupled to a plastic scintillator and a photomultiplier tube to detect these particles.
bad9b28e-b7d4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Spectrometer for Particles on Los Alamos National Laboratory Observatory

bae2dd4a-b744-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Bennington (BENN) Fluxgate Magnetometer is an instrument located at the McMAC Bennington station, used for measuring magnetic field variations as part of the Mid-continent Magnetoseismic Chain.
bae2dd4a-b744-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Mid-continent Magnetoseismic Chain

bae41692-b77b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, specifically the Earth's magnetic field in this context. The JMA magnetometer at the Kakioka Magnetic Observatory (KMO) employs torsion magnetometers for variations in H, D, and Z components, along with absolute instruments like a magnetometer theodolite for D and I measurements and a proton precession magnetometer for F measurement.
bae41692-b77b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of JMA Investigation

bae7471c-ba01-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Wyoming Infrared Observatory (WIRO) is an astronomical observatory owned and operated by the University of Wyoming, located on Jelm Mountain, approximately 25 miles southwest of Laramie. It focuses on infrared astronomy and recent research includes studying runaway stars, monitoring blazars, and observing massive binary stars.
bae7471c-ba01-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Wyoming Infrared Observatory at Jelm Mountain, United States

baef9c3e-b7de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Tocororo Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Arquillinos, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for studying celestial objects and phenomena.
baef9c3e-b7de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tocororo Observatory, Spain

baf7204e-ba31-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Euclid is a spacecraft operated by the European Space Agency (ESA), designed to conduct optical observations in space.
baf7204e-ba31-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Euclid on European Space Agency Euclid

bb0c530a-bb04-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Allahabad Geomagnetic Observatory (ALH)** is a ground-based facility in Prayagraj, India, that monitors geomagnetic activity and operates as part of the IUGONET network.
bb0c530a-bb04-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Allahabad Geomagnetic Observatory, India

bb1097c6-b1a9-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 1O Engineering Data Interface is a component of the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) project, designed to convert analog signals such as temperatures, voltages, and currents into digital data with high precision.
bb1097c6-b1a9-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses Engineering Data Interface on Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

bb113fd2-b749-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EISCAT incoherent scatter radar located in Longyearbyen, Svalbard archipelago, is a field-aligned pointing antenna with a diameter of 42 meters. It is part of the CNES observatory and CDPP archive.
bb113fd2-b749-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 42m Radar at EISCAT Observatory

bb20e0a8-b853-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The RISH Ceilometer at Shigaraki is an instrument operated by the Research Institute for Sustainable Humanosphere (RISH) in Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It uses LIDAR technology to measure cloud heights and vertical visibilities, detecting up to three cloud layers simultaneously since its operation began on June 7, 1998.
bb20e0a8-b853-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: CT12K Ceilometer at Shigaraki Observatory, Japan

bb22f2d0-b59c-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **ISIS 1 Swept-Frequency Sounder** was an instrument on the International Satellites for Ionospheric Studies (ISIS 1) satellite that measured ionospheric electron density by transmitting and recording radio-frequency pulses, providing data crucial for understanding ionospheric parameters.
bb22f2d0-b59c-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Swept-Frequency Sounder part of International Satellites for Ionospheric Studies 1

bb30eab6-b637-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The German Aerospace Center (DLR)/NASA Röntgen Satellite (ROSAT) mission was a joint space-based observatory designed to conduct astronomical observations in the X-ray waveband, focusing on detecting neutrinos, particles, and gravitational waves.
bb30eab6-b637-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: x-ray German Aerospace Center NASA ROentgen Satellite Mission

bb3c9d8a-b7f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Sunny Transcarpathian Observatory in Mukachevo is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Verkhnii Koropets Rural Hromada, Ukraine. It operates at the coordinates 48.37903° N, 22.70919° E.
bb3c9d8a-b7f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sunny Transcarpathian Observatory, Ukraine

bb3fe08e-b9e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Georgian National Astrophysical Observatory (GENAO), located on Mount Kanobili near the Abastumani resort in Georgia, is an astronomical observatory known for its excellent natural conditions and stable weather, making it ideal for observations.
bb3fe08e-b9e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Georgian National Astrophysical Observatory at Abastumani, Georgia

bb40cd52-bc61-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 1.5m GREGOR Solar Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Observatorio del Teide, primarily used for solar observations. It has an aperture of 1.5 meters and operates within the optical waveband, contributing to studies in the continent of Africa.
bb40cd52-bc61-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.5m GREGOR Solar Telescope at Observatorio del Teide

bb4391e6-b904-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Magnetometers at Madras (MDS)" is a historical magnetometer located at the World Data Center in Kyoto, Japan. It was operational from January 1, 1851, to December 31, 1855, and used for magnetic field measurements as part of the IAGA investigation.
bb4391e6-b904-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Madras Observatory

bb476a3e-b13c-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: SuperLIBS is an advanced instrument designed by Princeton Instruments for Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy (LIBS), featuring high spectral resolution and sensitivity, capable of operating under various environmental conditions including Earth, vacuum, and Mars-like atmospheres. It utilizes sophisticated detectors and spectrometers to analyze plasma light in UV, VIS, and VNIR regions, with a Quantel Ultra100 laser for sample ablation.
bb476a3e-b13c-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: SuperLIBS

bb4af416-b799-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Uppsala Magnetic Observatory (Q59508731) is a magnetic observatory located in Uppsala County, Sweden, operated by the Geological Survey of Sweden. It has been operational since 1997 and focuses on monitoring Earth's magnetic field.
bb4af416-b799-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Uppsala Magnetic Observatory, Sweden

bb4e6b6e-bbd6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Frosinone ground observatory is located at Madonna della Neve, Frosinone, Lazio, Italy (latitude 41.65322, longitude 13.33772).
bb4e6b6e-bbd6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Madonna della Neve Observatory, Italy

bb5390c8-b92c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sutherland Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Sutherland, Northern Cape, South Africa. It is part of the South African Astronomical Observatory and is situated on Earth at coordinates 20.81097 longitude and -32.37996 latitude.
bb5390c8-b92c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sutherland Observatory, South Africa

bb628f5e-bb9a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Michelson Interferometer for Global High-resolution Thermospheric Imaging (MIGHTI) is an instrument that measures the horizontal wind speed and direction in the thermosphere. It consists of two units mounted 90 degrees apart on the ICON satellite, allowing for the determination of the complete wind vector.
bb628f5e-bb9a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Michelson Interferometer for Global High-resolution Thermospheric Imaging on ICON

bb6458de-ba32-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The BARREL Balloon 2F Ephemeris is a virtual instrument that provides trajectory positions for the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) mission, offering data in various coordinate systems.
bb6458de-ba32-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

bb7c86e0-bb16-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The European Southern Observatory (ESO) 1.52m Telescope at La Silla Observatory is a 1.52-meter spectrographic Cassegrain/Coude reflector telescope located in Chile, operational since July 1968, used for optical observations.
bb7c86e0-bb16-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 1.52m European Southern Observatory Telescope at La Silla Observatory, Chile

bb8178c8-b7d6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Stardust-NExT was an extended mission of the Stardust spacecraft that conducted a flyby of comet 9P/Tempel 1 in 2011 to obtain high-resolution images and measurements, aiming to assess changes in the comet's surface between two perihelion passages and further understand the evolution of Jupiter family comets.
bb8178c8-b7d6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stardust-NExT

bb85401e-b9e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Magnetometer at Penang (PNN)" is a magnetic field measurement instrument located in Penang, Malaysia, which operated from January 1976 to December 1979 as part of the IAGA investigation and the IUGONET Observatory network.
bb85401e-b9e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Penang Observatory

bb89e4ec-bb7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL (Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2M Ephemeris is a virtual instrument that provides trajectory positions of the BARREL balloons in various coordinate systems, supporting investigations into relativistic electron losses.
bb89e4ec-bb7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

bb8a5a18-b819-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Trent Environmental Wind Tunnel (TEWT) is a specialized low-speed wind tunnel designed for studying atmospheric boundary layer simulations and sediment transport, featuring full control over humidity and temperature.
bb8a5a18-b819-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Environmental Wind Tunnel

bb8bcafa-b9f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU Radio Beacon Receiver (GRBR) is a digital receiver located in Watukosek, Indonesia, designed to measure ionospheric total electron content (TEC) using signals from Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites. It utilizes open-source software and hardware, including GNU Radio for signal processing and Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP) as a front-end.
bb8bcafa-b9f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU Radio Beacon Receiver at Watukosek Observatory, Indonesia

bb90341e-b900-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Dead Horse (DED) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility located in the North Slope Borough, Alaska, United States. It includes instruments such as magnetometers and operates on the Earth's surface for geophysical research purposes.
bb90341e-b900-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Dead Horse Geophysical Observatory, United States

bba01758-ba81-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Para Todos Remote Observatory (Z95) is an astronomical observatory located in Aras de los Olmos, Valencia, Spain. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
bba01758-ba81-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomia Para Todos Remote Observatory

bba07200-b65a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Net Flux Radiometer for Pioneer Venus Small Probe (Day) was an instrument designed to measure radiative convergence and divergence in the atmosphere of Venus, specifically targeting the dayside of the planet within a spectral range of 0.2 to 4 microns.
bba07200-b65a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Net Flux Radiometer on Pioneer Venus Small Probe (Day)

bba68c7c-b195-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ranua (RAN) Geophysical Observatory, located in Finland, is a ground-based facility focused on geophysical observations and includes instruments such as the Ranua Magnetometer.
bba68c7c-b195-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ranua Geophysical Observatory, Finland

bbba19d8-b8b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Genova.C Magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, operational from January 1, 1933, to December 31, 1969, at the observatory identified by IAGA as GEN in Genova, Italy.
bbba19d8-b8b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Genova Observatory

bbc92104-bbf1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **MAGDAS Santa Maria station** is a ground-based magnetometer facility located at the Universidade Federal de Santa Maria in Brazil, part of the global MAGDAS network, which monitors magnetic field variations on Earth's surface.
bbc92104-bbf1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Santa Maria Observatory, Brazil

bbd157ca-bacf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A Magnetometer instrument named "The Equatorial Magnetometer Network" is a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer installed at Hartland, UK, part of the IUGONET Observatory.
bbd157ca-bacf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Equatorial Magnetometer Network

bbd4f8c8-bb40-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Dawson magnetometer is a ground-based facility located on Earth's surface at coordinates 64.048°N, 220.890°E, and is part of the CARISMA (Canadian Array for Realtime Investigations of Magnetic Activity) array. It functions as an observatory instrument used to measure magnetic field variations.
bbd4f8c8-bb40-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Dawson Observatory

bbd5b4ae-b733-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Europa Clipper Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) Subsystem provides tools for uplink operations to predict spacecraft states and downlink operations to analyze telemetry, aiding in the calibration of Gravity/Radio Science data.
bbd5b4ae-b733-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Guidance, Navigation, and Control Subsystem part of Europa Clipper

bbdf5516-b7e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Wind Tunnel (MWT) is a specialized wind tunnel facility operated by Arizona State University at NASA Ames Research Laboratory, designed for testing under both low-pressure and standard atmospheric conditions to simulate Martian environments. It features a 12-meter long, open circuit design with various sections for airflow management and instrumentation for data collection.
bbdf5516-b7e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mars Wind Tunnel at Planetary Aeolian Laboratory

bbe11a4e-bb78-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Space Environment Monitor (SEM) on GOES 9 is an instrument suite designed to provide real-time measurements of solar activity and space environmental conditions, including magnetic field data, solar X-ray emissions, and energetic particle fluxes.
bbe11a4e-bb78-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Space Environment Monitor on GOES 9

bbe147a6-badf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the Magnetometers at Novokazalinsk (NKK), a magnetic field instrument operated from 1965 to 1993 as part of the IAGA investigation at the Novokazalinsk ground observatory.
bbe147a6-badf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Novokazalinsk Observatory

bbec197a-b9e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **CPMN fluxgate magnetometer at KTN** is a three-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer installed in Kotel'nyy, Russia. It is part of the IUGONET observatory network and measures magnetic field variations.
bbec197a-b9e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Circum-pan Pacific Magnetometer Network on Kotel'nyy, Russia

bbeebd30-b61d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Suprathermal Ion Telescope (SIT) is a Time-of-Flight Ion Mass Spectrometer onboard the STEREO-A spacecraft designed to measure elemental composition and energy of ions in the range of 30 keV/n to 2000 keV/n, focusing on energetic particles from solar events like CMEs and flares. It is part of the IMPACT suite for in-situ measurements of particles and CME transients.
bbeebd30-b61d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Suprathermal Ion Telescope on STEREO A

bc0241a6-b916-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 2D Engineering Data Interface** is an instrument designed for the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) project, responsible for converting analog data from key temperatures, voltages, and currents into digital format with high precision. It supports various inputs for voltage, current, and temperature monitoring, all scaled to a 5V ADC range.
bc0241a6-b916-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

bc05fd84-bbe9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kuiper Airborne Observatory's 0.91m telescope is an airborne infrared observatory designed for astronomical observations, offering a unique platform for studying celestial phenomena from high altitudes.
bc05fd84-bbe9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.91m Telescope on Kuiper Airborne Observatory

bc0e5dca-b686-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Viking Orbiter 1 Spacecraft Infrared Thermal Mapper (IRTM)** was a multichannel radiometer on the Viking Orbiter 1 designed to measure temperatures of Mars' atmosphere and surface, as well as reflected sunlight. It utilized four small telescopes with infrared detectors to make observations every 1.12 seconds within a temperature range of -130°C to +57°C.
bc0e5dca-b686-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Thermal Mapper on Viking Orbiter 1 Spacecraft

bc1cbe54-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The Luanda Capelo Ground Magnetic Field Instrument, part of the IAGA investigation, was operational from 1881-01-01 to 1993-12-31 at the Luanda observatory.
bc1cbe54-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IUGONET Observatory WDC Kyoto WDC Luanda

bc2396b2-b826-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Shattuck Observatory is an astronomical observatory owned and operated by Dartmouth College in Hanover, New Hampshire, United States. It is one of the early ground-based observatories established at educational institutions.
bc2396b2-b826-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Shattuck Observatory, United States

bc3818aa-b734-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Grain Impact Analyser and Dust Accumulator (GIADA) is an instrument onboard the Rosetta spacecraft designed to detect and analyze dust particles using optical, impact, and cumulative deposit sensing methods.
bc3818aa-b734-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Grain Impact Analyser and Dust Accumulator on Rosetta Orbiter

bc562f66-b8b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **Riometer** is an instrument used to measure the absorption of cosmic radio noise in the ionosphere, which can indicate disturbances caused by solar activity. The **AGO P6 Riometer** is specifically located at the AGO P6 ground station as part of the ICESTAR observatory network.
bc562f66-b8b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer part of International Collaborative Experiments for Space-atmosphere interaction Analysis and Research

bc58573a-b709-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Bragg Crystal Spectrometer (BCS)** on Yohkoh is an instrument designed to capture high-resolution X-ray spectra during solar flares, utilizing four bent germanium crystals to measure temperature and density in hot plasmas by analyzing specific X-ray emission lines.
bc58573a-b709-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bragg Crystal Spectrometer on Yohkoh

bc615078-b958-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Marratxi Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in the Balearic Islands, Spain. It operates as a ground-based facility and is identified by the Minor Planet Center code K12.
bc615078-b958-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatorio Astronómico de Marratxí, Spain

bc66246a-b97e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Science Laboratory (MSL) Curiosity Rover rear Hazard Avoidance Cameras (Hazcams) are designed to assist with navigation and safety by providing high-resolution images of the terrain behind the rover, helping it avoid obstacles and plan movements.
bc66246a-b97e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rear Hazard Avoidance Camera on Mars Science Laboratory Curiosity Rover

bc77c3ba-b6b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Retarding Potential Analyzer/Drift Meter (RPA)** on the AE-E satellite is an instrument designed to measure vector ion drift velocities, ion concentration and temperature, total ion concentration roughness, and spacecraft potential using four planar sensor heads. It consists of a retarding potential analyzer that can detect ions in specific mass ranges and determine plasma drift velocity parallel to the spacecraft's velocity vector.
bc77c3ba-b6b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Retarding Potential Analyzer and Drift Meter on AE-E

bc7915e8-bbb3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mcmurdo Geomagnetic Observatory (MCM) is a ground-based facility located on Observation Hill Road, McMurdo Station in Antarctica, operated by the U.S.A., and equipped with magnetometers for geomagnetic observations.
bc7915e8-bbb3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Mcmurdo Geomagnetic Observatory, Antarctica

bc86a18e-ba2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kodaikanal Geomagnetic Observatory (KOD), located in Tamil Nadu, India, is a ground-based facility that conducts geomagnetic measurements and has been operational since 1957.
bc86a18e-ba2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kodaikanal Geomagnetic Observatory, India

bc90a342-b696-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Coriolis**: Coriolis is an American (DOD) spacecraft launched in January 2003 from Vandenberg AFB to monitor ocean surface winds and image Solar Mass Ejections using the WindSat and SMEI instruments.
bc90a342-b696-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: WindSat and Solar Mass Ejection Imager on Coriolis

bca00212-b752-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer operational from January 1986 to December 1989 at the Great Wall Station, used for IAGA investigations to measure magnetic fields.
bca00212-b752-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Great Wall Station Observatory

bca25d38-bb8e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) station at Magadan, Russia is a ground facility developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research (ISEE), Nagoya University, to study upper atmospheric dynamics through nocturnal airglow emissions.
bca25d38-bb8e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers at Geofizicheskaya Observatory, Russia

bcd1c4f6-b616-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: BARREL Balloon 2T is part of the BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) mission, designed to study particles escaping from Earth's radiation belts using balloons equipped with scientific instruments in the stratosphere.
bcd1c4f6-b616-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses part of Living with a Star, Geospace Mission of Opportunity

bcd3ac72-bb92-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solar Electron Proton Telescope (SEPT) is an instrument onboard STEREO-B designed to measure the energy and direction of electrons and protons in space, providing crucial data for studying solar energetic particles and coronal mass ejections.
bcd3ac72-bb92-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: In-Situ Measurements of Particles and CME Transients, IMPACT, part of STEREO B

bcea21d4-baff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **CPMN Kotel'nyy Station** is a ground-based magnetometer observatory located in Bulunsky Ulus, Sakha Republic, Russia. It operates as part of the CPMN (Circum-Pan Pacific Magnetometer Network) and measures magnetic field variations to study geomagnetic phenomena.
bcea21d4-baff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at CPMN Kotel'nyy Station, Russia

bcf3b1f0-b798-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Katy Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Fort Bend County, Texas, United States. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical research and observations.
bcf3b1f0-b798-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Katy Observatory

bcfea9ca-b9d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Amderma, operational from 1973 to 1979, used for geomagnetic field measurements as part of the IAGA investigation.
bcfea9ca-b9d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Amderma Observatory

bd174248-b728-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **MAGDAS Legazpi station** is a ground-based observatory located in Central City Subdivision, Legazpi, Philippines. It is part of the MAGDAS magnetometer network and operates a fluxgate instrument to monitor magnetic field variations.
bd174248-b728-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Magnetic Data Acquisition System Observatory, Philippines

bd26f594-b7f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences (NAOC) Schmidt Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Xinglong Station of the Beijing Astronomical Observatory in Asia.
bd26f594-b7f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Schmidt Telescope at Beijing Astronomical Observatory

bd27bd5a-b8cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Adati Observatory (Q115522338) is an astronomical observatory located in Minamisoma, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
bd27bd5a-b8cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Adati Observatory, Japan

bd2997ee-b6b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Vega 1 Trajectory** instrument refers to the data set and tools used for determining the position and movement of the Vega 1 spacecraft during its mission. It is part of the observational facilities associated with the Vega 1 space probe, providing essential ephemeris information.
bd2997ee-b6b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris on Vega 1 Spacecraft

bd2a0106-ba22-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA Infrared Telescope Facility (IRTF) is a 3.0-meter telescope located on Mauna Kea in Hawaii, optimized for infrared astronomy and primarily used for planetary science and deep space observations. It is operated by the University of Hawaii under an agreement with NASA.
bd2a0106-ba22-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared NASA 3m Infrared Telescope Facility at Mauna Kea Observatory, United States

bd30a334-b929-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Hackney.Wick.1 Magnetometer** was an instrument used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field at Hackney Wick Observatory from January 1813 to December 1815, as part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) investigations.
bd30a334-b929-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hackney Wick Observatory

bd30aba0-b95a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Surlari Geophysical Observatory was a ground-based facility in Gruiu, Ilfov, Romania, operational from July 1957 to December 31, 1959, primarily involved in geomagnetic observations.
bd30aba0-b95a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geomagnetic Observatory at Surlari Observatory, Romania

bd3cc430-badb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tashkent-2/Yangi-Bazar observatory is a ground facility located in Baykazan, Uzbekistan, primarily used for geomagnetic research and has been operational since 1883.
bd3cc430-badb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Yangi-Bazar Observatory, Uzbekistan

bd42dee8-b89b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Bixhoma Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Bixby, Oklahoma, dedicated to ground-based observations.
bd42dee8-b89b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bixhoma Observatory, United States

bd4a367a-b84b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sooke Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Sooke, British Columbia, Canada. It operates as a ground-based facility and is identified by the Minor Planet Center (MPC) ID 655.
bd4a367a-b84b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sooke Observatory, Canada

bd56bb9e-ba7f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 1.83-m Perkins Warner & Swasey reflector is a telescope with a 1.83-meter aperture, situated at the Anderson Mesa Station in Arizona, operational since 1961.
bd56bb9e-ba7f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.83m Perkins Telescope at Lowell Observatory, United States

bd586ace-b8af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Large Cassegrain Spectrometer is an instrument used for analyzing the spectra of celestial objects, providing high-resolution spectroscopic data to understand their chemical composition, temperature, and motion.
bd586ace-b8af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Large Cassegrain Spectrometer on Harlan J. Smith Telescope

bd5b0064-b5bb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The meteor radar at the EISCAT Bjornoya site is an instrument used to measure neutral wind velocity at altitudes between 80-110 km. It operates as part of the IUGONET observatory under the ISEE EISCAT facility, utilizing radar technology for atmospheric investigations.
bd5b0064-b5bb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar Meteor Radar at EISCAT Bjornoya Observatory

bd5ccab8-bafa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MMS 4 Fast Plasma Instrument (FPI) Suite, Dual Electron Spectrometers (DES) is a component of the Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission, designed to measure the velocity-space distribution of electrons with high temporal resolution. It operates within an energy range of 10 eV to 30 keV and provides data crucial for understanding plasma dynamics in Earth's magnetosphere.
bd5ccab8-bafa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dual Electron Spectrometer part of Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission

bd6ca08c-b8f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Ironwood Remote Observatory:** An astronomical observatory located in Kalaeloa, Kapolei on the island of Oahu, Hawaii. It is a ground-based facility known for its remote observation capabilities.
bd6ca08c-b8f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ironwood Remote Observatory, United States

bd712b0e-ba17-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Uenohara Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Uenohara, Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan. Established in 1985, it operates as a ground-based facility at an altitude of 747 meters.
bd712b0e-ba17-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.6m Telescope at Uenohara Observatory, Japan

bd72961a-ba62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Experimenta Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Heilbronn, Germany, dedicated to ground-based observations.
bd72961a-ba62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 360° Dome and Telescopes at Experimenta Observatory, Germany

bd74565c-b65d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 2C X-ray Instrument (XRI) is a scintillation detector designed to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons. It features a NaI crystal scintillator, a photomultiplier tube, and operates with an energy response from 10 keV to 10 MeV, providing data in various time and energy resolutions for studying electron precipitation events.
bd74565c-b65d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Scintillation Detector part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

bd7a528a-bb19-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: BlackGEM is a ground-based astronomical observatory located at La Silla, in the Coquimbo Region of Chile. It is situated at the coordinates -29.25742 latitude and 289.26208 longitude on Earth.
bd7a528a-bb19-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: BlackGEM at La Silla Observatory, Chile

bd85b1d0-b721-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Thermal Ion Trap (ALPHA-3) on the Interball Auroral Probe is an instrument designed to study cold magnetospheric plasma using planar electrostatic analyzers, with a focus on measuring low-energy particles and their currents. It has an effective collector area of 11.3 square cm and can detect proton densities as low as 1 per cc.
bd85b1d0-b721-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electrostatic Analyser on Interball Auroral Probe part of Thermal Ion Trap

bd8e4396-b662-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Parma Observatory (code A56) is an astronomical observatory located in Neviano degli Arduini, Italy. It operates as a ground-based facility for observing celestial objects and phenomena from Earth.
bd8e4396-b662-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Parma Observatory, Italy

bd90df10-bb18-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of California, Los Angeles Solar Tower Atmospheric Cherenkov Effect Experiment (STACEE) is a gamma-ray telescope located in North America, designed to study high-energy astrophysical phenomena using the atmospheric Cherenkov technique.
bd90df10-bb18-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: gamma-ray University of California, Los Angeles Solar Tower Atmospheric Cherenkov Effect Experiment

bd9d19b0-b76c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Piombino Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Piombino, Italy, known as the Osservatorio Astronomico di Punta Falcone. It has been operational since 1975 and is situated at an altitude of 55 meters above sea level.
bd9d19b0-b76c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.6m Telescope at Osservatorio di Punta Falcone, Italy

bd9d2eb8-bae2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: La Silla Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Chile, operated by the European Southern Observatory (ESO), featuring multiple telescopes and known as one of the largest observatories in the Southern Hemisphere.
bd9d2eb8-bae2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: La Silla Observatory, Chile

bdac61e2-b7e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Tjörnes, Iceland, used for conducting conjugate observations as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
bdac61e2-b7e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Conjugate Observation at Iceland

bdbb4756-bb85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lick Observatory is an astronomical observatory owned and operated by the University of California, located on the summit of Mount Hamilton near San Jose, California. It is named after James Lick and managed by the University of California Observatories.
bdbb4756-bb85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lick Observatory, United States

bdc17806-b86a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Space Environment Monitor (SEM) on GOES 5 is an instrument suite designed to measure the impact of solar activity on the near-Earth electromagnetic environment in real time. It includes sensors for energetic particles, high energy protons and alpha detectors, solar X-rays, and magnetic fields, aiding in space weather forecasting crucial for various systems like communications and satellites.
bdc17806-b86a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ion Chamber part of Space Environment Monitor on GOES 5

bdc625d4-bca9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Valentines Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Bex, Switzerland, specifically at 2, Chemin de Belmont. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to the study of celestial objects and phenomena.
bdc625d4-bca9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Valentines Observatory, Switzerland

bdcaa4f4-b80f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of California, Berkeley Infrared Spatial Interferometer (ISI) is an infrared telescope located at Mount Wilson in North America. It specializes in high-resolution imaging and spectroscopy, primarily used for studying stars and other celestial objects through their infrared emissions.
bdcaa4f4-b80f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared University of California, Berkeley Infrared Spatial Interferometer at Mount Wilson Observatory

bdce0d58-bb5f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: Xingming Observatory is a private amateur astronomical observatory located in Gangou Township, Ürümqi, Xinjiang, China. It was founded by amateur astronomer Gao Xing in 2007 and features telescopes like the Ningbo Education Xinjiang 0.6m Telescope (NEXT).
bdce0d58-bb5f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.6m Telescope at Xingming Observatory, China

bdceea04-b97d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Niue Ionospheric Scintillation Monitor is a specialized GPS receiver located near Niue Island, designed to monitor ionospheric scintillation levels in real time and collect statistical data on scintillation indices for up to eleven visible satellites.
bdceea04-b97d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionospheric Scintillation Monitor at Niue Observatory

bdcf8464-b685-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Hay River Geomagnetic Observatory (HRI)** is a ground-based facility located in Hay River, Northwest Territories, Canada, dedicated to observing and recording geomagnetic data. It operates under the World Data Centre for Geomagnetism, Kyoto, and contributes to global geomagnetic monitoring networks.
bdcf8464-b685-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hayriver Geomagnetic Observatory, Canada

bddc8b6c-b63c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lviv Magnetic Observatory was a ground-based magnetic observatory located in Ukraine that operated from 1957 to 2015.
bddc8b6c-b63c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Lviv Magnetic Observatory, Ukraine

bde72d36-ba49-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mercury Dual Imaging System (MDIS) is a dual-camera system on the MESSENGER spacecraft designed to provide high-resolution and wide-angle images of Mercury's surface, supporting objectives such as global stereo imaging and color coverage.
bde72d36-ba49-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Narrow Angle Camera part of Mercury Dual Imaging System

bdfbd160-b9f8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a ground-based observatory located in Al Nakhil, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (latitude: 21.5218, longitude: 39.25827), identified by the code M41.
bdfbd160-b9f8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Jeddah Observatory, Saudi Arabia

bdfd7768-b8f4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Refuge Harbour**: A ground-based observatory facility located in North America (Greenland) that houses a magnetometer instrument and has been operational since January 1924. It is part of the IAGA network and situated at coordinates approximately 78.533° N, 287.617° E.
bdfd7768-b8f4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Refuge Harbour Observatory

be07ea76-bb39-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Electric Fields Instrument (EFI) on the THEMIS spacecraft is designed to measure the three components of the ambient vector electric field using a combination of wire spin plane booms and rigid axial booms, providing both waveform measurements and on-board spectral analyses.
be07ea76-bb39-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electric Field Instrument on THEMIS Spacecraft

be20a9a0-bab0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IUCAA Girawali Observatory is an optical astronomy observatory located about 80 km from Pune, India, operated by the Inter-University Centre for Astronomy and Astrophysics (IUCAA). It houses a 2-meter telescope and is situated in Girawali.
be20a9a0-bab0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.6m Telescope at Girawali Observatory, India

be24814c-b93e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Interface Region Imaging Spectrograph (IRIS) is a NASA solar observation satellite designed to study the physical conditions of the solar limb, particularly the interface region between the chromosphere and transition region. It aims to trace the flow of energy and plasma into the corona and heliosphere using high-resolution UV spectra and images.
be24814c-b93e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet Interface Region Imaging Spectrograph part of Small Explorer Program

be315f56-b723-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Radio Astronomy Observatory (NRAO) 42.6m Robert C. Byrd Green Bank Telescope is a large radio telescope located in North America, specifically in Green Bank, West Virginia. It has an aperture of 42.6 meters and operates in the radio waveband for astronomical observations.
be315f56-b723-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 42.6m radio Robert C. Byrd Green Bank Telescope at National Radio Astronomy Observatory

be32b00e-b700-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Imaging Science Subsystem - Wide Angle (ISS-WA) for Voyager 1 is an instrument designed to capture broad field-of-view images for studying planetary atmospheres, rings, and large-scale space structures. It was part of the Voyager 1 mission.
be32b00e-b700-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Imaging Science Subsystem - Wide Angle on Voyager 1

be3e1e38-b85b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity is the "Fucama, Casalincontrada" ground observatory located in Via Colle Petrano, Casalincontrada, Chieti, Abruzzo, Italy. It serves as an astronomical facility for conducting observations from the ground.
be3e1e38-b85b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fucama Observatory at Casalincontrada, Italy

be484d5e-b9b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 6m Bolshoi Teleskop Azimutalnyi (BTA-6) is a large optical telescope with an aperture of 6.0 meters, located at the Special Astrophysical Observatory in Asia.
be484d5e-b9b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical 6.0m Bolshoi Teleskop Azimutalnyi at Special Astrophysical Observatory

be49caba-b7ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Radio Science Subsystem (RSS) for Gravity Science on MESSENGER was a telecommunications system that utilized an X-band transponder to perform precise tracking of the spacecraft's trajectory, enabling the study of Mercury’s gravity field and refining its shape model through range, Doppler measurements, and occultation timing.
be49caba-b7ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Science Subsystem for Gravity Science on Mercury Surface, Space Environment, Geochemistry and Ranging

be4abc34-bbc5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Leadville Geomagnetic Observatory (LDV) was a ground-based facility located in Birdseye, Lake County, Colorado, United States, operational from July 1957 to December 31, 1959, dedicated to geomagnetic research.
be4abc34-bbc5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Leadville Geomagnetic Observatory at IAGA WDC Observatory, United States

be5210e4-b740-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Solar Ultraviolet Monitor (SUVM) is a spectrometer on the Solar Mesospheric Explorer that measures solar radiation at Lyman alpha and in the 1600-3100 Å range with high resolution.
be5210e4-b740-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar Ultraviolet Monitor part of Solar Mesospheric Explorer

be6acc4c-b6e6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Sopot Astronomical Observatory is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Ropocevo, Sopot Urban Municipality, Serbia. It serves as a facility for conducting astronomical research and observations.
be6acc4c-b6e6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sopot Astronomical Observatory, Serbia

be75509e-b9b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Magsat (Magnetic Field Satellite) was a joint NASA and USGS satellite launched in 1979 to map the Earth's magnetic field using advanced magnetometers.
be75509e-b9b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Vector Magnetometer and Scalar Cesium Vapor Magnetometer on Magnetic Field Satellite

be879988-ba80-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Radio JOVE Observatory at Middle Tennessee State University (MTSU) is a ground-based facility equipped with specialized arrays and receivers to observe radio emissions from Jupiter, the Sun, and the Galactic Background. It participates in the global Radio JOVE project, contributing valuable data to the scientific community.
be879988-ba80-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Terminated Folded Dipole Array and JOVE Dipole Array at Radio JOVE Observatory, China

be897bce-b9a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Kelmis Observatory (code: K85) is an astronomical observatory located in Kelmis, Belgium. It operates as a ground-based facility with the Minor Planet Center ID K85.
be897bce-b9a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kelmis Observatory, Belgium

be8b4160-b6f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nanyo Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Nanyo, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan. It was established in 1995 and operates as a ground-based facility at an altitude of approximately 252 meters.
be8b4160-b6f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.6m Telescope at Nanyo Observatory, Japan

be963b1c-ba23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **STEREO-A IMPACT Solar Wind Plasma Electron Analyzer (SWEA)** is a particle detector designed to measure the distribution of solar wind core and halo electrons with high spectral and angular resolution. It is part of the STEREO mission, specifically the In-Situ Measurements of Particles and CME Transients investigation, and helps distinguish between different electron components during both undisturbed periods and Coronal Mass Ejection (CME) disturbances.
be963b1c-ba23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar Wind Plasma Electron Analyzer part of In-Situ Measurements of Particles and CME Transients on STEREO A

be9fe85a-b754-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Winchester Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Winchester, Massachusetts, United States. It operates as a ground-based facility with the MPC ID 799 and can be found at Hope Christian Church on Mount Vernon Street.
be9fe85a-b754-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Winchester Observatory, United States

bea0c0a8-b778-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lomazzo Observatory (L53) is an astronomical observatory located in Como, Italy. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
bea0c0a8-b778-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Como Observatory, Italy

bea2186c-bba7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **IAGA:FRB Magnetometer** is an instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field at the Freiberg station, operational from January 1890 to December 1899 as part of the IAGA observatory network.
bea2186c-bba7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Freiberg Observatory

bea42ebe-b935-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Norfolk Island Station**: A ground-based observatory located on Norfolk Island, Australia, operational since February 1964, primarily known for its magnetometer instrument.
bea42ebe-b935-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Norfolk Island Observatory, Australia

beb8ff2c-b7ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The magnetometers at Collmberg (CLL), part of the IUGONET observatory in Kyoto since 1935, provide valuable data for geomagnetic research under the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA).
beb8ff2c-b7ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at Collmberg Observatory

bebabb78-b707-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: TRACE Positions refer to the specific locations and orientations of the TRACE (Transition Region And Coronal Explorer) spacecraft as recorded in different coordinate systems, essential for accurate astronomical observations.
bebabb78-b707-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: TRACE Ephemeris on TRACE Spacecraft

bebe1092-b63b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Nagano Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Ōmachi, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
bebe1092-b63b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Nagano Observatory, Japan

bec04380-bad7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Palaudescription** refers to a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Koror, Palau. It operated from January 1, 1926, until December 31, 1941, and was part of the IAGA observatory network.
bec04380-bad7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Palau Observatory, Palau

bec0f8b4-ba70-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Meanook Magnetic Observatory is a magnetic observatory located in Athabasca County, Alberta, Canada, that has been operational since 1932. It is funded by the Geological Survey of Canada and specializes in monitoring Earth's magnetic field.
bec0f8b4-ba70-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Meanook Magnetic Observatory, Canada

becdb188-b9a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Brazil National Observatory, located in Rio de Janeiro, is one of the oldest scientific institutions in Brazil. It was founded by Pedro I on October 15, 1827, initially to guide geographic studies and teach navigation.
becdb188-b9a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: National Observatory, Brazil

bee32564-b7b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nobeyama Radio Observatory 1.2m submillimeter-wave Telescope is a radio telescope located in Asia, specifically on Mount Fuji, designed for millimeter waveband observations.
bee32564-b7b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.2m submillimeter-wave Telescope at Nobeyama Radio Observatory

bee35d1a-b920-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solar-Terrestrial Relations Observatory (STEREO) is a NASA mission consisting of two spacecraft that orbit the Sun to provide 3-D imaging and radio observations of coronal mass ejections (CMEs), which are significant drivers of major geomagnetic storms on Earth.
bee35d1a-b920-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sun Earth Connection Coronal and Heliospheric Investigation on Solar-Terrestrial Relations Observatory A and Sun Earth Connection Coronal and Heliospheric Investigation on Solar-Terrestrial Relations Observatory B part of STEREO

bee92018-b968-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity is the **AT138 Athens Digisonde Ionospheric Station**, an advanced ground-based facility in Salamina, Greece, that measures various characteristics of skywave signals reflected from the ionosphere to study its properties.
bee92018-b968-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digisonde Ionospheric Station at Athens Observatory, Greece

beee736e-b680-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: An astronomical observatory located in Gelenau/Erzgebirge, Saxony, Germany, known as the Gelenau Observatory.
beee736e-b680-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gelenau Observatory

bef508fc-b8fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Low Energy Telescope (LET) is an instrument onboard NASA's STEREO Mission, designed to measure the composition, energy spectra, and angular distributions of ions (from Hydrogen to Nickel) and identify rare isotopes. It is part of the Solar Energetic Particle (SEP) instrument suite for the IMPACT investigation, focusing on particles with energies from ~3 to 30 MeV/n.
bef508fc-b8fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Low Energy Telescope on Solar Terrestrial Relations Observatory A

bf0ad250-b646-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A Riometer is an instrument used to measure cosmic noise absorption in the ionosphere. The specific instrument located at Isafjordur, Iceland, is a broad-beam riometer and part of the IUGONET observatory network.
bf0ad250-b646-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer at Iugonet Observatory

bf1331f2-b786-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **South Pole Antenna Instrument** is part of the ICESTAR investigation and functions as an antenna located at the South Pole ground station. It is integrated within the Bartol Research Institute's Neutron Monitor Observatory, contributing to scientific observations in the region.
bf1331f2-b786-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Antenna on ICESTAR part of Bartol Research Institute Neutron Monitor Observatory, Antarctica

bf22f718-b6dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ekaterinburg geophysical observatory is a ground-based facility in Yekaterinburg, Russia, known for its magnetometer and contributions to geophysical research since 1887.
bf22f718-b6dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ekaterinburg Observatory, Russia

bf2d9142-b7b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Vega 2 MISCHA Magnetometer** was a dual-sensor fluxgate system on the Vega 2 spacecraft designed to measure magnetic fields and their fluctuations in interplanetary space and during Comet Halley's approach. It featured axial and triaxial sensors with a dynamic range of ±100 nT and a sensitivity of 0.05 nT, operating in various data rate modes.
bf2d9142-b7b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Vega 2

bf2e02e8-b91b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA Reflectance Experiment Laboratory (RELAB) Thermo Nexus 870 Fourier-Transform infrared spectrometer is an instrument used for reflectance measurements across the near, mid, and far-infrared ranges. It features various beam splitters, detectors, and a large gold mirror to accommodate different spectral measurements.
bf2e02e8-b91b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fourier Transform Infrared Spectrometer at NASA Reflectance Experiment Laboratory

bf2f2e18-b6bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Australian National University (ANU) 1.88m Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Mount Stromlo Observatory in Australia, with a primary mirror diameter of 1.88 meters.
bf2f2e18-b6bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.9m Telescope at Mount Stromlo Observatory

bf4941b2-b5eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Benito Loyola Observatory is a ground-based observatory located at 3261 Wilderness Lane in Virginia Beach, Virginia. It serves as an astronomical facility within the United States.
bf4941b2-b5eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Benito Loyola Observatory, United States

bf5340a2-b7dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Antipolo Geomagnetic Observatory (ANO), located in Santa Cruz, Antipolo, Rizal, Philippines, was a ground-based facility that operated from 1910 to 1940, focused on geomagnetic measurements.
bf5340a2-b7dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Antipolo Geomagnetic Observatory, Philippines

bf6258e0-b772-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA-identified station TLK in Talkeetna, part of the IUGONET Observatory network.
bf6258e0-b772-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet Observatory

bf664eee-b75b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AKEBONO Low Energy Particle (LEP) instrument is a satellite-based tool onboard the AKEBONO (EXOS-D) observatory, designed to study particle acceleration processes in the auroral magnetosphere by measuring energy and pitch-angle distributions of electrons and ions, as well as analyzing mass/charge ratios of positive ions.
bf664eee-b75b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Low Energy Particle Instrument on Akebono

bf69fa16-bb53-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer at LWA is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument installed in Liwa, Indonesia, designed to measure magnetic field variations as part of the MAGDAS observation network.
bf69fa16-bb53-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of MAGDAS observation network

bf825590-b133-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **UHF Radio Telescope at Fuji, Japan** is a scintillation detector used for Interplanetary Scintillation (IPS) measurements and is part of the IUGONET Observatory.
bf825590-b133-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultra High Frequency Radio Telescope part of Interplanetary Scintillation Project and Ionospheric Scintillation Monitoring Network Observatory

bf825c2e-b5f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Salamanca is a city in the Castile and León region of Spain, known for its historic role as a center of learning, particularly with its prestigious university founded in 1218.
bf825c2e-b5f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Salamanca Observatory, Spain

bf8566e2-bb5e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Port Jeanne D'Arc was a ground-based observatory located in the Kerguelen Archipelago, French Southern and Antarctic Lands, France. It operated from 1930 to 1962 and was known for its magnetometer instrumentation as part of the IAGA network.
bf8566e2-bb5e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Port Jeanne d'Arc Observatory, Antarctica

bf8d6c92-bc3b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Catania Astrophysical Observatory, operated by INAF (National Institute for Astrophysics), is an astronomical observatory located in the city of Catania on the island of Sicily in southern Italy.
bf8d6c92-bc3b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Catania Astrophysical Observatory "A. Riccò", Italy

bf9de592-b955-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Hakos Astrofarm, located at Gamsberg Pass in Khomas, Namibia, is a ground-based observatory situated on the African continent. It serves as part of the SNX-NET network for astronomical observations and research.
bf9de592-b955-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: SNX-NET at Hakos Observatory, Namibia

bf9f14f6-b830-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The El.Abiod.Sidi Magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field at a specific observatory identified by IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy), operational from January 1, 1948, to December 31, 1954.
bf9f14f6-b830-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at El Abiod Sidi Observatory

bfaa5a70-b923-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Jodrell Bank Observatory** is an astronomical observatory in Cheshire, England, known for its radio telescopes and significant contributions to astrophysics research.
bfaa5a70-b923-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 76.2m Lovell Telescope at Jodrell Bank Observatory, United Kingdom

bfb42626-b92e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 2D Ephemeris is a virtual instrument providing trajectory positions in various coordinate systems for the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) investigation.
bfb42626-b92e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses part of BARREL Balloon

bfb6a2ba-b5fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The VIR (Visible and Infrared) Imaging Spectrometer was an instrument on the Dawn spacecraft designed to capture moderate-resolution images in both visible and infrared wavelengths, utilizing a dual-arm optical design.
bfb6a2ba-b5fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Visible and Infrared Imaging Spectrometer on Dawn Spacecraft

bfd8a0e0-b141-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Dax Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Dax, France. It has been operational since 1976 and is identified by the MPC code 958.
bfd8a0e0-b141-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Dax Observatory, France

bfe968b0-babc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Southside Observatory** is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Steeple Aston, Oxfordshire, England. It serves as a facility for observing celestial objects and conducting research related to astronomy.
bfe968b0-babc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.6m Telescope at Southside Observatory, Steeple Aston

bff82348-ba74-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Submillimeter Array (SMA) on Mauna Kea is an astronomical observatory located in Hawaii, designed for high-resolution imaging at submillimeter wavelengths. It consists of eight 6-meter diameter antennas used to study the universe's cold and distant objects.
bff82348-ba74-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Submillimeter Array at Submillimeter Array Observatory, United States

bff84d4c-b78a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The HNRAO Long Wavelength Array (LWA) and FSX-2 spectrograph system is a ground-based radio astronomy instrument located at the Hawk's Nest Radio Astronomy Observatory. It consists of a 4 element square array of crossed dipoles with a bandwidth of 15-30 MHz, capable of selecting either right circular polarization (RCP) or left circular polarization (LCP).
bff84d4c-b78a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Long Wavelength Array 4 phase crossed dipoles and FSX-2 10 bit single polarization spectrograph on Hawk's Nest Radio Astronomy Observatory

bffadb66-b69f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kryoneri Observatory, located in Corinthia, Greece, is an astronomical observatory operated by the IAASARS research institute of the National Observatory of Athens. It houses one of the largest telescopes in Greece and conducts various astronomical research projects, including participation in international programs.
bffadb66-b69f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kryoneri Observatory, Greece

bffb093e-b81a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Viking was the first Swedish satellite, launched in 1986 to study the acceleration processes of charged particles in Earth's auroral regions using various instruments for measuring fields, particles, and waves.
bffb093e-b81a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Viking Sweden part of Swedish National Satellite Mission

bffd5af0-bacb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The W. M. Keck Observatory (Keck 2) is a ground-based astronomical observatory located at the Mauna Kea Observatories on Mauna Kea, Hawaii. It is renowned for its two large telescopes used for high-resolution astronomical observations.
bffd5af0-bacb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Keck II Telescope at W. M. Keck Observatory

c0010718-b620-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Charters Towers is a ground-based observatory facility located in Queensland, Australia, primarily known for its WDC magnetometer instrument operated by IUGONET. It has been operational since 1990 and is situated at an altitude of 370 meters on the Earth's surface.
c0010718-b620-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Charters Towers Observatory, Australia

c006f4a4-b78b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Einstein Tower is an astrophysical observatory located in the Albert Einstein Science Park in Potsdam, Germany. It was designed by architect Erich Mendelsohn and completed in 1924.
c006f4a4-b78b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Einstein Tower Observatory at Albert Einstein Science Park, Germany

c0115cd0-b99f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nagoya University 4m Millimeter Telescope is a research facility located in Asia, featuring a 4-meter aperture designed for millimeter waveband observations.
c0115cd0-b99f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 4.0m Millimeter Telescope at Nobeyama Radio Observatory

c01d61c6-b763-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kuyper Geomagnetic Observatory (KUY) was a ground-based facility in Banten, Indonesia, operating from 1929 to 1962 for geomagnetic measurements.
c01d61c6-b763-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kuyper Geomagnetic Observatory, Indonesia

c01e1488-bbc6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: AeroCube-6A (AC6) CubeSat is a nanosatellite developed by the Aerospace Corporation for technical research, featuring advanced upgrades and micro dosimeters to measure space radiation. It operated from June 21, 2014, until April 12, 2019, in Earth's equatorial region.
c01e1488-bbc6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: AeroCube-6A CubeSat

c01f5fbc-b880-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Djibouti Observatory (IAGA: DJI) is a ground-based facility located in Holl-Holl, Arta, Djibouti, Africa. It operates a magnetometer and has been active since January 1, 2011.
c01f5fbc-b880-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Djibouti Observatory, Djibouti

c025b6e0-b9c1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity represents the **Patrony/Irkoutsk Observatory**, a ground-based facility in Irkutsk, Russia, that is part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) network. It operates a magnetometer for geophysical observations and has been operational since 1887.
c025b6e0-b9c1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Irkutsk Observatory, Russia

c0316ca8-bb45-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA Ramaty High Energy Solar Spectroscopic Imager (RHESSI) Satellite Mission is a space-based observatory designed to study solar flares and other high-energy phenomena on the Sun using gamma-ray observations.
c0316ca8-bb45-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: gamma-ray NASA Ramaty High Energy Solar Spectroscopic Imager part of RHESSI Satellite Mission

c0348094-bb51-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ivigtut Geomagnetic Observatory (IVI), located in Sermersooq, Greenland, was a ground-based facility operating from 1863 to 1960 that conducted geomagnetic measurements.
c0348094-bb51-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ivigtut Geomagnetic Observatory, Greenland

c0366c8e-b7b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mauritius Radio Telescope (MRT) is a synthesis radio telescope located in Mauritius, designed to image the sky at 151.5 MHz with a resolution of approximately 4 arc minutes and a point source sensitivity of 150 mJy.
c0366c8e-b7b8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: radio Mauritius Radio Telescope at Mauritius Observatory

c03a7130-bb23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 1.25m Ritchey-Chretien Reflector AZT-11 is a telescope located at the Crimean Astrophysical Observatory in Partizanskoye, known for its 1.25-meter aperture and focal length of 16 meters, built by LOMO under Prof. V.B. Nikonov's supervision in 1981.
c03a7130-bb23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.25m Ritchey-Chretien Reflector AZT-11 optical Telescope at Crimean Astrophysical Observatory

c04b1180-ba14-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The IUE Short-Wavelength Spectrograph was an ultraviolet spectrograph on the International Ultraviolet Explorer (IUE), operating in the range of 1150 to 2000 angstroms with high and low resolution modes, featuring a fully operational Prime camera (SWP).
c04b1180-ba14-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Short-Wavelength Spectrograph on International Ultraviolet Explorer

c0510c72-b738-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Ultraviolet Imaging Spectrograph (UVS)** on the Juno mission is an instrument designed to study Jupiter's auroras by detecting ultraviolet emissions in the range of 68-210 nanometers with high spectral resolution.
c0510c72-b738-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet Imaging Spectrograph on Juno Spacecraft

c05a22c0-b6a3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Kairos Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Letnik, Rostov Oblast, Russia. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical research and observations.
c05a22c0-b6a3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Letnik Observatory

c05b476e-b6a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The SMART/T3 Flare Imaging System is an instrument at the Hida Observatory designed for high-speed observations of solar flares, specifically targeting continuum and H-alpha emissions to study high energy events on the Sun's chromosphere and photosphere.
c05b476e-b6a2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: SMART/T3 Flare Imaging System in Continuum and H-alpha at Kwasan and Hida Observatory

c05c488a-b684-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gran Telescopio Canarias (GTC) is a 10.4-meter reflecting telescope located at the Roque de los Muchachos Observatory on La Palma, Canary Islands, Spain. It is currently one of the largest and most advanced optical and infrared telescopes globally.
c05c488a-b684-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 10.4m Gran Telescopio Canarias at Roque de los Muchachos Observatory, Spain

c05db80c-b67d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "CARISMA Magnetometer at Fort McMurray" is a scientific instrument located in the Canadian ground station at Fort McMurray, designed to measure magnetic fields as part of the CARISMA (Canadian Array for Realtime Investigations of Magnetic Activity) network.
c05db80c-b67d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Fort McMurray Observatory

c0621b72-b7ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 2Q Engineering Data Interface** is an instrument used in the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) project to perform analog-to-digital conversion of key temperatures, voltages, and currents. It has multiple inputs for voltage and current pairs, voltage only, and temperature sensors, all converted with 16-bit precision.
c0621b72-b7ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

c063fc46-b6b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Glyndon Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation since 2007.
c063fc46-b6b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of THEMIS Mission

c065d282-bb80-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NICT Ionosonde at Yamagawa is a Type 10C Ionosonde instrument operated by the National Institute of Information and Communications Technology in Japan, used for regular ionospheric investigations.
c065d282-bb80-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar Type 10C Ionosonde at Yamagawa Observatory

c0689d26-b6f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Katanning station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Katanning, Australia (latitude -33.68, longitude 117.62), part of the IUGONET observatory network for studying geomagnetic fields.
c0689d26-b6f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Katanning Observatory, Australia

c06af3d2-b6a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The DMSP/F17 SESS Special Sensor Ultraviolet Limb Imager (SSUSI) is a photometer launched in 2006 as part of the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program to observe vertical profiles of Extreme and Far UV radiation from Earth's limb, particularly the H Lyman-alpha line, providing measurements of electron density and ion/neutral densities.
c06af3d2-b6a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Special Sensor Ultraviolet Limb Imager part of Defense Meteorological Satellite Program

c06c2056-b7c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetic Field Experiment (MGF) on the GEOTAIL mission is a set of instruments designed to measure magnetic field variations in the Earth's magnetotail at frequencies below 50 Hz. It includes dual three-axis fluxgate magnetometers and a three-axis search coil magnetometer, deployed on booms to minimize spacecraft interference.
c06c2056-b7c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on GEOTAIL

c07a229a-b8c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Exploration Rover (MER) Opportunity Inertial Measurement Unit is a device used to provide three-axis rotation rate and acceleration measurements during the entry and landing phases of the MER mission, utilizing fiber optic gyros and silicon accelerometers.
c07a229a-b8c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Inertial Measurement Unit part of Mars Exploration Rover

c07ace36-b657-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) Two-Channel Tilting Photometer at Rikubetsu, Japan is an instrument designed to measure airglow emissions in the upper atmosphere, specifically targeting Hbeta and N2+ first negative lines every 10 minutes across various zenith angles.
c07ace36-b657-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Two-Channel Tilting Photometer part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers at Rikubetsu

c07c67ac-b97a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **West Challow Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in West Challow, Oxfordshire, England, dedicated to ground-based observations.
c07c67ac-b97a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: West Challow Observatory, United Kingdom

c09299e0-b8c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity "CHAMP Positions" refers to the precise locations of the CHAMP (Challenging Minisatellite Payload) spacecraft in various coordinate systems, which are essential for scientific and observational purposes.
c09299e0-b8c7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: CHAMP Positions on CHAMP Spacecraft

c0932292-b7a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Mountainville Observatory (code: V01) is an astronomical observatory located in Alpine, Utah, USA. It operates as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
c0932292-b7a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mountainville Observatory, United States

c09c821a-b7f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Cademuir Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Dalkey, County Dublin, Ireland. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observation.
c09c821a-b7f6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cademuir Observatory, Ireland

c0a21bfe-b65b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Popovich Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Ivanivka, Ukraine. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
c0a21bfe-b65b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ivanivka Observatory, Ukraine

c0aeecfe-b9de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Arequipa Geomagnetic Observatory (ARE) is a ground-based facility located in Quisco, El Punque, La Huaylla, Characato, Province of Arequipa, Peru, dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity. It has been operational since 1958 and is part of the IAGA observatory network.
c0aeecfe-b9de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Arequipa Geomagnetic Observatory

c0b45ed0-b6d9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Search Coil Magnetometer (SCM)** is an instrument aboard the Parker Solar Probe designed to measure magnetic field fluctuations in the solar wind across a wide frequency range, from 10 Hz to 50 kHz and up to 1 MHz for single-component measurements. It plays a crucial role in studying solar wind turbulence and transient events caused by interplanetary shocks and reconnection.
c0b45ed0-b6d9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Search Coil Magnetometer on Parker Solar Probe

c0b54830-b770-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Monte Generoso Observatory is a ground-based astronomical observatory originally located on Monte Generoso in Ticino, Switzerland, but moved to Park im Grünen in Bern as of 2021.
c0b54830-b770-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Monte Generoso Observatory

c0b64c7c-b747-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Cassini Radar (RADAR) is an instrument on the Cassini spacecraft designed to investigate the surface and atmosphere of Saturn's moon Titan using synthetic aperture radar imaging, altimetry, scatterometry, and radiometry, enabling scientists to study Titan's geologic features, oceans, and other properties.
c0b64c7c-b747-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ku-band Cassini Radar part of NASA's Cassini Spacecraft

c0b71a18-b962-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Via Capote Sky Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Thousand Oaks, California, United States. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to the observation of celestial objects and phenomena.
c0b71a18-b962-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Via Capote Sky Observatory, United States

c0bae506-bafe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Electron and Proton Anisotropy (DOK-2A) on Interball Auroral Probe is an instrument designed to study the acceleration and transport of energetic particles within Earth's magnetosphere. It uses two pairs of particle telescopes to measure electron spectra in the 20-420 keV range and proton spectra in the 20-850 keV range, providing detailed insights into particle population dynamics.
c0bae506-bafe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Instrument Electron and Proton Anisotropy part of Interball Auroral Probe

c0c13822-b84f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sogra Geomagnetic Observatory (SOG) is a ground-based facility located in the Verkhnetoyemsky Municipal District of Arkhangelsk Oblast, Russia, dedicated to monitoring and studying geomagnetic activities.
c0c13822-b84f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Sogra Geomagnetic Observatory, Russia

c0ca7f06-b96f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CERGA Observatory (Centre de recherches en géodynamique et astrométrie) was an astronomical station of the Côte d'Azur Observatory in southern France, where several asteroids were discovered between 1984 and 1993.
c0ca7f06-b96f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Centre de recherches en géodynamique et astrométrie, France

c0ce1bae-b1bb-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BKH Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Fearrington Village, North America, specifically at 422, North Serenity Hill Circle, Chapel Hill, Chatham County, North Carolina.
c0ce1bae-b1bb-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: BKH Observatory

c0ce76ba-b811-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 1M magnetometer is a three-axis instrument designed to measure magnetic field components with high resolution. It is part of the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) mission and helps identify substorm activity and ULF oscillations, crucial for studying precipitation modulations on ULF timescales.
c0ce76ba-b811-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

c0cec626-b87d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Filzi School Observatory (MPC ID: D12) is an astronomical observatory located in Laives, South Tyrol, Italy. It operates as a ground-based facility primarily for educational and scientific purposes.
c0cec626-b87d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Filzi School Observatory

c0cf9660-b9da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The BARREL Balloon 4F was a component of the BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) mission, which operated from August 28 to August 29, 2016. It was designed to study the loss of relativistic electrons from Earth's radiation belts by measuring Bremsstrahlung X-rays in the stratosphere using a NaI scintillator and other scientific instruments.
c0cf9660-b9da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses part of Living with a Star Geospace Mission of Opportunity

c0d3f6ec-b9ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MF radar at Wakkanai, Japan is an instrument that measures the height profile of horizontal wind in the mesosphere and lower thermosphere using full-correlation analysis and meteor echo measurement. It is part of the IUGONET Observatory NICT SALMON network.
c0d3f6ec-b9ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: MF Radar at Wakkanai Observatory, Japan

c0d7dca8-ba52-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mariner 6 Spacecraft Wide Angle Camera (WAC) is an instrument equipped with Zeiss refractor optics and a vidicon to capture digital images of Mars.
