It features a wide-angle f/5.6 lens with a 52.5 mm focal length and four spectral filters, producing high-resolution images for geometric analysis.
c0d7dca8-ba52-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wide Angle Camera on Mariner 6 Spacecraft

c0dade26-ba0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Mars Express ASPERA-3 Neutral Particle Detector (NPD)** is an instrument on the Mars Express spacecraft that measures the differential flux of Energetic Neutral Atoms (ENAs) within the energy range of 100 eV to 10 keV, resolving hydrogen and oxygen with a coarse angular resolution.
c0dade26-ba0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutral Atom Imager part of Mars Express

c0e9cb20-b714-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The S.O.S. Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial phenomena.
c0e9cb20-b714-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Minneapolis Observatory

c0eecb4a-b87a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Werrington Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Peterborough, Cambridgeshire and Peterborough, England. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
c0eecb4a-b87a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Werrington Observatory, United Kingdom

c0f0713a-bb12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cassini Radio and Plasma Wave Science (RPWS) instrument is a sophisticated device on the Cassini spacecraft designed to study radio emissions, plasma waves, thermal plasma, and dust in Saturn's system using electric field sensors, magnetometers, and a Langmuir probe.
c0f0713a-bb12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio and Plasma Wave Science part of Cassini

c0fde194-bb26-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Hume Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Santa Rosa, California, specifically at Pepperwood Ranch Road in Sonoma County. It is classified as a ground-based observatory and is known for its astronomical research and observations.
c0fde194-bb26-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hume Observatory at Santa Rosa

c1023492-b7ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "MMS 2 Spacecraft Ephemeris Virtual Instrument" is a platform used for investigating the position and trajectory data of the MMS 2 spacecraft, part of the CDPP-AMDA observatory managed by CNES.
c1023492-b7ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission part of CDPP AMDA

c102bc58-b8d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) All-Sky Imager at Syowa Base, Antarctica is a multi-wavelength instrument developed to study the dynamics of the upper atmosphere by observing nocturnal airglow emissions. It is part of the IUGONET Observatory and was created by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research at Nagoya University.
c102bc58-b8d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Multi-wavelength Imager part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers at Syowa Base, Antarctica

c11c5aa8-b648-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
"Artemis-P1 different magnetospheric analytical models" refers to a set of scientific models used in the Artemis-P1 investigation, which are designed to analyze and interpret data related to Earth's magnetosphere. These models are part of the CDPP/AMDA observatory managed by CNES.
c11c5aa8-b648-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetospheric Analytical Models part of Artemis-P1

c12214a2-b706-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Kremsmunster is a ground observatory and facility located in Kremsmünster, Austria, operational from January 1, 1891, to December 31, 1904, primarily for magnetometer measurements.
c12214a2-b706-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kremsmünster Observatory, Austria

c1232d38-b80a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Lohbach Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Benninghofen, Dortmund, Germany. It is a ground-based facility used for sky observations and research.
c1232d38-b80a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lohbach Observatory at Benninghofen, Germany

c14183a4-b932-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Plasma Wave System (PWS) on Voyager 2** is an instrument designed to measure electron density profiles and wave-particle interactions in the magnetospheres of Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. It includes a step frequency receiver and a low-frequency waveform receiver, operating within a frequency range from 10 Hz to 56 kHz.
c14183a4-b932-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waveform Receiver part of Voyager 2

c1481d72-b7c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Adhara Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Sorocaba, Brazil. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
c1481d72-b7c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Adhara Observatory at Law School of Sorocaba, Brazil

c1485830-bbf5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **MAGDAS Nairobi Station** is a ground-based observatory located in Ewuaso Oonkidong'i ward, Kajiado County, Kenya, which operates as part of the MAGDAS magnetometer network to monitor magnetic field variations.
c1485830-bbf5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at MAGDAS Nairobi Observatory, Kenya

c14d9830-b5b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU Radio Beacon Receiver (GRBR) is an open-source digital receiver installed in Phuthuy, Vietnam, designed to measure ionospheric total electron content (TEC) using LEO satellite signals at 150 and 400 MHz. It utilizes GNU Radio software for signal processing and Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP) as the hardware front-end.
c14d9830-b5b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU Radio Beacon Receiver at Phuthuy Observatory

c154e182-bb4a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Digital Wave Processor (DWP) on Cluster 2/FM8 (Tango) is a key component of the Wave Experiment Consortium (WEC) on the Cluster mission, responsible for coordinating operations and processing wave data from DC to over 100 kHz, utilizing various data compression methods and diagnostic techniques like particle correlation.
c154e182-bb4a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digital Wave Processor part of Cluster mission

c156b470-b894-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Siding Spring Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Coonabarabran, New South Wales, Australia, known for its ground-based telescopes and facilities.
c156b470-b894-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Siding Spring Observatory, Australia

c159754e-b7b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "GEOS-1 spacecraft positions" dataset provides the position and velocity data of the GEOS-1 spacecraft in different coordinate systems, part of the CNES Observatory CDPP Archive.
c159754e-b7b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GEOS-1 spacecraft positions part of CDPP Archive

c15a120e-b994-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Astronomical Observatory of Trieste (OAT) is a ground-based astronomical research center located in the city of Trieste, Italy. It was established in 1753 and is part of the National Institute for Astrophysics.
c15a120e-b994-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Observatory of Trieste, Italy

c1731750-baab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The LIGO Scientific Collaboration (LSC) German-British 600m Arm Length Gravitational Wave Detector (GEO600), located in Europe, is a telescope with a 600-meter aperture designed to observe neutrinos, particles, and gravitational waves. It operates as part of the broader LIGO Scientific Collaboration network, contributing to advanced research in astrophysics and cosmology through its precise measurements.
c1731750-baab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: LIGO Scientific Collaboration German-British 600m Arm Length Gravitational Wave Detector, Europe

c1745cb4-b6a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Zaldibia Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Lizardi, Zaldibia, Gipuzkoa, in the Autonomous Community of the Basque Country, Spain. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
c1745cb4-b6a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Zaldibia Observatory, Spain

c17c2b6c-b7e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Courroux Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Courroux, Jura, Switzerland. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
c17c2b6c-b7e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Courroux Observatory, Switzerland

c191969c-b99a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Crimean Astrophysical Observatory-Partizanskoye is a ground-based observatory located in Nauchny, Crimea, Ukraine. It features the 1m25 AZT-11 telescope and conducts astrophysical research as part of its operational activities.
c191969c-b99a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.25m AZT-11 Telescope at Crimean Astrophysical Observatory-Partizanskoye, Ukraine

c1944b76-b9a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Bavarian Public Observatory Munich**, located in Germany, is a ground-based public observatory established in 1946 for astronomical observations and educational purposes.
c1944b76-b9a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bavarian Public Observatory Munich, Germany

c1cab28e-b683-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ondřejov Observatory is the principal astronomical observatory of the Czech Academy of Sciences, located in Ondřejov, about 35 kilometers southeast of Prague. It houses a 2-meter wide telescope, which is the largest in the country.
c1cab28e-b683-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2m Telescope at Ondřejov Observatory, Czechia

c1dbf41c-b8c8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Riometer station at Husafell, Iceland (HUS) is a ground-based facility developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research (ISEE), Nagoya University, to study the dynamics of the upper atmosphere through nocturnal airglow emissions.
c1dbf41c-b8c8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer at Husafell Observatory, Iceland

c1dd5ce4-b701-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA Cosmic Background Explorer (COBE) was a space mission designed to measure the cosmic microwave background radiation and infrared emissions from the early universe. It is also known as Explorer 66.
c1dd5ce4-b701-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cosmic Background Explorer part of NASA COsmic Background Explorer satellite mission

c1e2cdda-b640-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Pioneer Venus Day Probe was the third Small Probe of NASA's Pioneer Venus Multiprobe mission, designed to collect and transmit atmospheric data from the day side of Venus during its descent and briefly after landing.
c1e2cdda-b640-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.8m Day Probe part of Pioneer Venus Multiprobe

c1e8221c-bb7c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The La Puebla de Vallbona Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in L'Arenal, la Pobla de Vallbona, Valencia, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
c1e8221c-bb7c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: La Puebla de Vallbona Observatory, Spain

c1eafe90-b8d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The AGO P2 Riometer Instrument is a device located at the AGO P2 ground station, designed to measure cosmic radio noise absorption in the ionosphere. It is part of the ICESTAR observatory network and helps study space weather phenomena.
c1eafe90-b8d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer on ICESTAR part of Automated Geophysical Observatory

c1f71ff2-bb8f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Baranov (BRN) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Дежнёвское сельское поселение, Russia, equipped with instruments such as magnetometers for geophysical measurements.
c1f71ff2-bb8f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Baranov Geophysical Observatory, Russia

c1fbf088-b93a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) all-sky imager at Darwin, Australia is a multi-wavelength instrument developed to study the dynamics of the upper atmosphere by observing nocturnal airglow emissions. It was created by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research at Nagoya University and is part of the IUGONET Observatory network.
c1fbf088-b93a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Multi-wavelength All-Sky Imager part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Investigation, Antarctica

c20198be-bb9f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lucy Terminal Tracking Cameras (TTCAM) are instruments aboard the Lucy spacecraft designed to autonomously point at Trojan asteroids during close approaches and collect monochromatic images to determine their shapes.
c20198be-bb9f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Terminal Tracking Cameras on Lucy Spacecraft

c204170c-bb67-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Dunsink Observatory** is an astronomical observatory established in 1785 near Dublin, Ireland. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
c204170c-bb67-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dunsink Observatory, Ireland

c214f2b0-b848-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Atmospheric Imaging Assembly (AIA)** is an instrument onboard the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) that studies the Sun's atmospheric magnetic environment and its interaction with plasma. It provides high-resolution, full-disk images of the Sun in multiple UV and EUV wavelengths, enabling continuous monitoring for solar physics research and space weather prediction.
c214f2b0-b848-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Atmospheric Imaging Assembly on Solar Dynamics Observatory

c21d30bc-ba2b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Mishima Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Mishima, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. It has the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code 886 and is situated at coordinates 138.9367 longitude and 35.17058 latitude.
c21d30bc-ba2b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mishima Observatory, Japan

c227d178-b753-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetometer at Alert is an instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field and was installed in 1961 as part of the IAGA network within the iugonet-observatory-wdc_kyoto-wdc observatory.
c227d178-b753-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Alert Observatory

c22b52d0-b94c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Peyrole Observatory is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Peyrole, Albi, France. It serves as an observation point for studying celestial phenomena and conducting research in astronomy.
c22b52d0-b94c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Peyrole Observatory, France

c23b35b4-b7d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Viking Meteorology Instrument System (VMIS) aboard the Viking Lander 1 was designed to measure atmospheric temperature, pressure, wind speed, and direction. It consists of three main components: the Meteorology Sensor Array, the Meteorology Boom Assembly, and the Meteorology Electronic Assembly.
c23b35b4-b7d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Viking Meteorology Instrument System on Viking Lander 1

c23cd152-baf7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Steward Observatory 0.6m Super-LOTIS Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Kitt Peak National Observatory in North America, with a primary mirror of 0.6 meters in diameter. It is part of the facilities operated by Steward Observatory and used for astronomical research.
c23cd152-baf7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 0.6m Super-LOTIS Telescope at Kitt Peak National Observatory

c2499d46-b70b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Galleywood Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Galleywood, Chelmsford, Essex, England. It is identified by the Minor Planet Center code 477 and offers ground-based observation facilities.
c2499d46-b70b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Galleywood Observatory, United Kingdom

c25037e8-b759-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Japanese Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) Network (JVN) is a ground-based observatory in Asia that operates in the radio waveband for astronomical observations.
c25037e8-b759-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio The Japanese Very Long Baseline Interferometry Network

c2592864-bbbc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Uppsala Observatory (Uppsala.1) is a ground-based facility located in Uppsala, Sweden, primarily focused on geomagnetic measurements with instruments such as magnetometers.
c2592864-bbbc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Uppsala Observatory, Sweden

c268aafa-bb5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Burgsolms Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Wetzlar, Germany. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.
c268aafa-bb5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Burgsolms Observatory, Germany

c26a848e-b7d3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of Virginia 10-inch Cooke Astrograph is a telescope located at Fan Mountain Observatory in North America, designed for optical waveband observations.
c26a848e-b7d3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 25cm Cooke Astrograph at Fan Mountain Observatory

c275f90e-ba35-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Leamington Spa Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Royal Leamington Spa, Warwickshire, England. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
c275f90e-ba35-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Leamington Spa Observatory, United Kingdom

c279d266-b965-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: An Imaging Spectrometer named the Extreme Ultraviolet Spectrograph (EUV), operational since October 11, 2019, is a one-dimensional instrument designed to capture vertical slices of the sky and create two-dimensional images as it moves horizontally in a "push-broom" configuration.
c279d266-b965-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Extreme Ultraviolet Spectrograph part of ICON

c27d094e-b948-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Antares MTM Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in San Donato Val di Comino, Frosinone, Italy (Lazio region), known by its Minor Planet Center ID as L91.
c27d094e-b948-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Antares MTM Observatory, Italy

c282fcd4-b6d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) mission** is a NASA-funded technology demonstration aimed at impacting the smaller asteroid Dimorphos in the Didymos system to measure and understand the effects on its orbit.
c282fcd4-b6d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: part of Double Asteroid Redirection Test Mission

c289ce38-bb1c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Berta Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Sabadell, Catalonia, Spain. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical research and observations.
c289ce38-bb1c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Berta Observatory, Spain

c28b4ed6-b831-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: NOAA-12 is a third-generation operational meteorological satellite launched in 1991 to measure the Earth's atmosphere, surface, and cloud cover for the National Environmental Satellite, Data, and Information Service (NESDIS).
c28b4ed6-b831-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Advanced Very High Resolution Radiometer on NOAA 12

c28b7fe6-b769-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kew Observatory was a ground-based facility in London that operated from 1842 to 1924, known for its magnetometer instruments and contributions to geomagnetic research.
c28b7fe6-b769-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kew Observatory, United Kingdom

c28fab50-bb30-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The one described here is located at Fort Severn (FSV) as part of the WDC Kyoto observatory, operational since 1977, under the IAGA investigation.
c28fab50-bb30-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Fort Severn Observatory

c29570b0-ba1f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 1.5m Solar Submillimeter Telescope at El Leoncito Astronomical Complex (CASLEO) is a millimeter-wave telescope located in South America, designed for observing the Sun.
c29570b0-ba1f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.5m Solar Submillimeter Telescope at El Leoncito Astronomical Complex

c2988eb4-b6ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Larson IHW spectrograph is an instrument designed by Steve Larson for the International Halley Watch program, combining a spectrograph with a two-dimensional CCD camera to cover wavelengths from 0.33 to 0.85 microns with a spectral resolution of 23 Å.
c2988eb4-b6ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1m54 Larson International Halley Watch Spectrograph

c2a2f88a-b7ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EMN magnetometer network in Cuiabá, Brazil is a ground-based facility located at approximately 15.35° S latitude and 56.05° W longitude, designed to measure magnetic field variations on Earth's surface.
c2a2f88a-b7ee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Cuiabá Observatory, Brazil

c2af25ce-b834-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The NEAR Multispectral Imager (MSI) was a primary instrument on the Near Earth Asteroid Rendezvous spacecraft designed to capture images and gather data on asteroid morphology, surface composition, size, shape, and spin characteristics using an 8-filter CCD camera covering spectral ranges from 0.4 to 1.1 microns.
c2af25ce-b834-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Multispectral Imager on Near Earth Asteroid Rendezvous spacecraft

c2b006a0-b8b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetic Field Monitor (MFM) on GOES 3 was a biaxial fluxgate magnetometer designed to measure magnetic fields in space, featuring two sensors aligned at right angles and mounted on a short boom for accurate measurements.
c2b006a0-b8b7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetic Field Monitor on Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 3

c2bbae02-b145-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) station at Shigaraki, Japan (SGK), is a ground-based facility developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research (ISEE) at Nagoya University to study upper atmospheric dynamics through nocturnal airglow emissions. It collaborates with RISH, Kyoto University and is located in Iga, Mie Prefecture, Japan.
c2bbae02-b145-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers at Shigaraki Observatory, Japan

c2d10e1e-b609-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The VSK-Fregat Imaging System was a three-channel television camera onboard the Phobos 2 spacecraft, designed for surveying Mars, navigation around its moons Phobos and Deimos, and conducting detailed investigations of Phobos' surface structure.
c2d10e1e-b609-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: VSK-FREGAT Imaging System on Phobos 2

c2d8e9d0-b5f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM) 0.84m Telescope at El Observatorio Astronómico Nacional/Sierra San Pedro Mártir (OAN/SPM) is an optical telescope located in North America, specifically in Sierra San Pedro Mártir, used for astronomical observations and research.
c2d8e9d0-b5f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.84m optical Telescope at El Observatorio Astronómico Nacional Sierra San Pedro Mártir

c2e76f8c-b777-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Sternwarte Herne** is a public observatory located in Herne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and educational purposes.
c2e76f8c-b777-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.6m Telescope at Sternwarte Herne Observatory, Germany

c2ed95a8-bb8a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Wildberg Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Wildberg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. It is situated at the coordinates 48.631946 latitude and 8.75674 longitude on Earth.
c2ed95a8-bb8a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wildberg Observatory, Germany

c2ee33d0-b952-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Salisbury station was a ground-based observatory located in Salisbury, South Australia, operational from June 1960 to April 1989, primarily known for its ionosonde instrument used for atmospheric studies.
c2ee33d0-b952-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionosonde at Salisbury Observatory, Australia

c2eef398-bc7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a magnetometer located at the Tambey station with the IAGA identifier TMB, which is part of the WDC Kyoto Observatory network and used for geomagnetic measurements.
c2eef398-bc7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tambey Observatory

c2f058bc-b94e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NF Observatory (G99) is an astronomical observatory located in Grant County, New Mexico, USA. It is a ground-based facility situated at coordinates 32.770984° N, 105.6496° W.
c2f058bc-b94e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Silver City Observatory

c2f2aa08-bbfc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Magnetometers at Val Joyeux (VLJ)" refers to a set of magnetometers that were operational from 1901 to 1936 at the Val Joyeux observatory, used for geomagnetic field measurements as part of the IAGA investigation.
c2f2aa08-bbfc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Val Joyeux Observatory

c2f3c24a-bb56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer at Cape Schmidt (CST) is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument used for measuring magnetic fields, installed as part of the MAGDAS observation network in Russia.
c2f3c24a-bb56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

c2f699ba-b97c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Viking mission was a NASA space exploration program consisting of two spacecraft, each with an orbiter and a lander, sent to Mars in 1975. The mission aimed to study the Martian surface, atmosphere, and search for signs of life, making it one of the most ambitious and successful early missions to the Red Planet.
c2f699ba-b97c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Viking 75 Mission part of Voyager Mission

c2f88da0-b7e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cuzco Geomagnetic Observatory (CUS), located in Peru, operated from 1965 to 1966 and was part of the IAGA observatories network. It primarily focused on geomagnetic measurements using magnetometers.
c2f88da0-b7e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Cuzco Geomagnetic Observatory, Peru

c2f92ca6-ba18-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Granville Observatory (MPC ID: 825) is an astronomical observatory located in Boylston, Worcester County, Massachusetts. It is situated at coordinates 42.33796° N latitude and 288.2595° E longitude on the continent of North America.
c2f92ca6-ba18-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Granville Observatory, United States

c3064e04-ba63-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Greenwich Geomagnetic Observatory (GRW) was a ground-based facility in Greenwich, England, operational from 1818 to 1925, dedicated to monitoring and studying the Earth's magnetic field.
c3064e04-ba63-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Greenwich Geomagnetic Observatory, United Kingdom

c315a424-b650-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **MTSU Dual Dipole Array and Radio JOVE receiver system** is a ground-based instrument located at Middle Tennessee State University, comprising two 25-foot antenna elements separated by 20 feet. It operates at 20.1 MHz with a 7 KHz RF bandwidth, aligned to magnetic north for radio astronomy observations.
c315a424-b650-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Jove Dual Dipole Array and Radio Jove receiver at Middle Tennessee State University Observatory

c3193fc8-b9cd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer installed at the Baghdad observatory in 1987, used for measuring magnetic field variations as part of IAGA's global monitoring network.
c3193fc8-b9cd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Baghdad Observatory

c31a3d92-b941-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The millimeter-wave spectroscopic radiometer at the Atacama observatory is an instrument equipped with a superconducting receiver used to monitor variations in the vertical distributions of minor atmospheric constituents in the stratosphere and mesosphere.
c31a3d92-b941-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Millimeter-Wave Spectroscopic Radiometer part of International Space Environment Explorer investigation

c32122ae-b907-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Ujjain, operational from 1976 to 2003 and part of the IUGONET Observatory network under WDC Kyoto.
c32122ae-b907-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ujjain Observatory

c324a7c2-ba3c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GONG instrument at the Big Bear Solar Observatory is part of a global network used for helioseismology to study the Sun's internal structure and dynamics by observing solar oscillations.

c32be752-bb55-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The JPL SynTrack Robotic Telescope is an astronomical observatory located in Auberry, California. It operates as a ground-based facility and is situated at Sierra Remote Observatories on Bald Mountain Road.
c32be752-bb55-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: JPL SynTrack Robotic Telescope at Sierra Remote Observatories

c33821c2-b91e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Gonzales Videla Geomagnetic Observatory** is a ground-based facility located on Earth's surface at an altitude of 60.0 meters and latitude -64.82, longitude 297.15. It was established in 1961 and includes a magnetometer as part of its instrumentation.
c33821c2-b91e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Gonzales Videla Geomagnetic Observatory

c34902aa-b7e6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 1C magnetometer is a three-axis instrument used to measure magnetic field components with high resolution. It is part of the BARREL project and helps identify substorm activity and ULF oscillations for studying radiation belt dynamics.
c34902aa-b7e6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

c34b48aa-baaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Albox Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in San Roque, Almeria, Andalusia, Spain. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
c34b48aa-baaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Albox Observatory, Spain

c35e022a-baa9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EDL Demonstrator Module (EDM), also known as Schiaparelli, was a module designed to test key technologies for future Mars landings, specifically focusing on Entry, Descent, and Landing (EDL) procedures.
c35e022a-baa9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: EDL Demonstrator Module

c35ecb84-b7c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Tenma, previously known as ASTRO-B, was an X-ray astronomy satellite mission operated by the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA), designed to observe celestial objects in the X-ray waveband.
c35ecb84-b7c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: x-ray Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency Tenma X-ray Satellite Mission

c36eb776-ba38-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MMS 2 FIELDS Suite, Spin-plane Double Probe (SDP) Instrument is a scientific tool on the Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission (MMS), consisting of four 48-meter wire booms with spherical sensors designed to measure three-dimensional electric fields from DC to 100 kHz.

c370e15c-baee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ELECTRON instrument, featuring a quadri-spherical analyzer, is designed to measure the 3D electron distribution function aboard the Interball Tail Probe spacecraft. It uses microchannel plates and anodes to detect electrons within a wide field of view, providing detailed energy spectra and moment computations.
c370e15c-baee-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Quadrispherical Analyser part of Interball Tail Probe

c372c396-bb6b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Faraday Cup** was a multigrid, split-collector instrument on the Explorer 35 spacecraft designed to measure the directional intensity of solar wind positive ions and electrons, particularly studying their interaction with the moon. It operated successfully from launch until July 1968, providing detailed energy-per-charge measurements within specific windows.
c372c396-bb6b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Faraday Cup on Explorer 35

c37720e4-ba71-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The given entity refers to a specific type of astronomical instrument, identified by the ESA's Planetary Science Archive (PSA) system. It includes contextual information about instrument types and associated product sets within the PSA framework.

c37a1814-ba6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the Ionospheric Station at I-Cheon, South Korea (URSI-code: IC437), which is an advanced ground facility equipped with a Digisonde that evaluates various characteristics of skywave signals reflected from the ionosphere.

c37b579e-b63a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EMN magnetometer network in Vilhena, Brazil is a ground-based observatory located at Rua Bahia, Parque Novo Tempo. It is part of the ICSWSE and includes a fluxgate instrument to measure magnetic field variations on Earth's surface.

c37e1146-b60d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Manzhouli Observatory is a ground-based facility in Xinghua, Manzhouli, Inner Mongolia, China, which includes a magnetometer and has been operational since 1995. It is part of the IAGA observatory network and is located at an altitude of 682 meters with coordinates 49.6°N, 117.4°E.

c3802f64-b827-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Phoenix Lander Microscopy, Electrochemistry, and Conductivity Analyzer (MECA) Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) was an instrument on the Phoenix Mars lander designed to examine the surface properties of Martian soil at a nanometer scale using a sharp tip to scan samples.

c38348a0-b603-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Lyford Geophysical Observatory, operational since 2007 as part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation.
c38348a0-b603-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Lyford Geophysical Observatory

c385337e-b985-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hyperion IFS-3000 Series Infrasound Sensor, also known as a Microbarometer, is an instrument developed by Hyperion Technology Group for detecting low-frequency sound waves with high sensitivity and a wide dynamic range.

c3906c8e-b6ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of Virginia 31-inch Tinsley Telescope is located at the Fan Mountain Observatory in North America and operates within the optical waveband with an aperture of 0.79 meters.

c3a66308-b838-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Leiden Southern Station is an astronomical observatory located in Johannesburg, South Africa. Established in 1938, it serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations.

c3a90272-b679-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tsingtao Observatory in Qingdao, China, was an IAGA ground facility operational from 1906 to 1936, equipped with magnetometers and located at an altitude of 80 meters.
c3a90272-b679-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Qingdao Observatory, China

c3a94114-b8f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity "DSS-69" is a ground observatory with the code 399069, which serves as an astronomical facility for Earth-based observations.
c3a94114-b8f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: DSS-69 Observatory

c3adfa82-b8a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The entity refers to the Lander Radioscience (LaRa) experiment aboard the ExoMars mission's surface platform. LaRa is designed for precise radio tracking to study Mars' internal structure and rotation.
c3adfa82-b8a1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Value on ExoMars part of LARA

c3bb3230-b7ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Northwest Florida State College Observatory (MPC ID: I44) is an astronomical observatory located in Niceville, Florida. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and education.
c3bb3230-b7ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Niceville Observatory

c3bf1b24-b6ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Research Council (NRC) Herzberg Institute of Astrophysics Synthesis Telescope at the Dominion Radio Astrophysical Observatory (DRAO) is a radio telescope located in North America, used for astronomical research and observations. c3bf1b24-b6ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: radio National Research Council Herzberg Institute of Astrophysics Synthesis Telescope at Dominion Radio Astrophysical Observatory

c3c2ccb6-b7eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Custer Institute and Observatory is a ground-based observatory located in Southold, Suffolk County, New York, United States. It offers opportunities for astronomy education and observation to the public.
c3c2ccb6-b7eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Custer Institute and Observatory, United States

c3cf7e08-b74f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU radio beacon receiver (GRBR) station at Nha Trang is an observatory located in Vietnam that measures ionospheric disturbances related to middle-upper atmospheric coupling processes. It is part of the GRBR network and situated at Nha Trang University.
c3cf7e08-b74f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU Radio Beacon Receiver Station at Nha Trang, Vietnam

c3d1cf92-b69a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sant Martí Sesgueioles Observatory is a ground-based observatory located in Anoia, Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. It is situated at the coordinates 41.70233° N and 1.4892° E.
c3d1cf92-b69a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatory at Sant Martí Sesgueioles, Spain

c3d6e8e6-b998-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **IPS Kiso Station** is an antenna facility located in Kiso, Nagano Prefecture, Japan, dedicated to Interplanetary Scintillation (IPS) measurements. It includes a UHF radio telescope and operates as part of the IUGONET ground facilities for space observation.
c3d6e8e6-b998-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultra High Frequency Radio Telescope at Interplanetary Scintillation Kiso Station, Japan

c3f3abf6-b83b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Zimmerwald Observatory is an astronomical facility owned and operated by the Astronomical Institute of the University of Bern, located in Zimmerwald, approximately 10 kilometers south of Bern, Switzerland.
c3f3abf6-b83b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Zimmerwald Observatory, Switzerland

c3fcede8-b81c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The KSA SEM Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Danggam-dong, Busan, South Korea, operated by the Korea Science Academy of KAIST.
c3fcede8-b81c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Astronomical Observatory at Danggam-dong, Korea, Republic of

c40578e0-b9fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Rubidium Vapor Magnetometer (RVM) on the OGO-2 spacecraft was an instrument designed to refine the analytical description of Earth's main geomagnetic field and measure its secular changes. It operated using a dual-cell, optically pumped, self-oscillating rubidium vapor system from October 1965 until intermittent data collection ended on October 2, 1967.
c40578e0-b9fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rubidium Vapor Magnetometer on OGO-2 spacecraft

c40b8838-b6ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 14 Command and Service Module (CSM), nicknamed "Kitty Hawk," was the spacecraft that orbited the Moon during the Apollo 14 mission in 1971. Piloted by Stuart A. Roosa, it facilitated the lunar landing of astronauts Alan B. Shepard Jr. and Edgar D. Mitchell while providing crucial support systems for their return to Earth.
c40b8838-b6ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Command and Service Module on Apollo 14

c40f69bc-b9db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 2N Optical Photometer** is an instrument designed to detect visible light at wavelengths near 486.1 nm during relativistic electron precipitation events, specifically aimed at determining the presence of protons accompanying these electrons to support theories about scattering mechanisms involving EMIC waves. It operates by collecting photons through a collimator tube and utilizing a Hβ filter and photomultiplier tube to generate charge pulses that are then processed to measure proton flux.
c40f69bc-b9db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Photometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

c41e5d70-b5a1-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity describes a GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) instrument used in the SWARM-C mission, which is part of the CNES observatory CDPP-AMDA and began operation on December 2, 2013.
c41e5d70-b5a1-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Antenna part of SWARM-C

c420168c-bbd3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ujjain Geomagnetic Observatory (UJJ), located in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, India, is a ground facility that operated from 1976 to 2003 for monitoring geomagnetic data.
c420168c-bbd3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ujjain Geomagnetic Observatory, India

c4222f26-bb29-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The SAMBA Magnetometer Array's Fluxgate Magnetometer at the Putre geomagnetic observatory is a ground-based instrument designed to measure variations in the Earth's magnetic field. It is part of a broader network aimed at enhancing our understanding of geomagnetic phenomena and space weather dynamics.
c4222f26-bb29-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of SAMBA Magnetometer Array

c4277296-b8d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Tasiusak is a ground-based observatory located in Sermersooq, Greenland (North America), established in 1899. It operates as part of the IAGA network and includes a magnetometer for monitoring geomagnetic activity.
c4277296-b8d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tasiusak Observatory, Greenland

c4284f96-b908-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Low Energy Electrostatic Analyzer (LEESA)** is an instrument designed to measure the energy fluxes and spectra of low-energy electrons and protons ranging from 20 eV to 50 keV, with applications in studying surface electric charging and damage to thin films. It features two sets of spherical electrostatic analyzers for electron and ion measurements, providing high sensitivity and compact design.
c4284f96-b908-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Instrument Low Energy Electrostatic Analyzer part of DSX-SWx

c42ecf68-b6fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Evryscope is a set of ground-based, wide-field optical telescopes designed for rapid, continuous observation of the sky. It features an array of camera units with cooled CCDs, providing a vast field of view for astronomical surveys and monitoring.
c42ecf68-b6fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Evryscope at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory, Chile

c4445844-b9a3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Panoramic Survey Telescope and Rapid Response System (Pan-STARRS) is an advanced astronomical survey telescope located at the Haleakala Observatory in Hawaii. It continuously surveys the sky for moving or variable objects, producing accurate astrometry and photometry of detected objects.
c4445844-b9a3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.8m Panoramic Survey Telescope and Rapid Response System at Haleakala Observatory, United States

c44e0150-b944-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Byurakan Astrophysical Observatory is an astronomical observatory operated by the Armenian Academy of Sciences, located on Mount Aragats in Byurakan, Armenia.
c44e0150-b944-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Byurakan Observatory, Armenia

c4520dc6-ba5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer that operated from 1883 to 1933 at the Jan Mayen observatory as part of the IAGA investigation to measure magnetic field variations on Earth.
c4520dc6-ba5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Jan. Mayen Observatory

c4613156-b626-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Elianto Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Baroncino, Aquara, within the municipality of Pontecagnano Faiano in the Province of Salerno, Italy. It operates as a ground-based facility for celestial observation and research.
c4613156-b626-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Elianto Observatory, Italy

c461bb14-b15b-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Viking Orbiter 2 Spacecraft Infrared Thermal Mapper (IRTM) was a multichannel radiometer designed to measure the temperatures of Mars' atmosphere and surface, as well as the amount of sunlight reflected by the planet.
c461bb14-b15b-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Thermal Mapper on Viking Orbiter 2 Spacecraft

c4673460-b906-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: AMPTE-IRM (Active Magnetospheric Particle Tracer Explorers - Ion Release Module) was a research satellite launched in 1984 as part of the AMPTE mission to study solar wind ion access to Earth's magnetosphere, particle transport and energization, and plasma interactions. It was a collaborative project between NASA, ESA, and the West German Max Planck Institute.
c4673460-b906-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Active Magnetospheric Particle Tracer Explorers Ion Release Module part of Active Magnetospheric Particle Tracer Explorers mission

c4677308-baa5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tomsk Geomagnetic Observatory (TMK), located in Tomsk, Russia, was a ground-based facility that operated from 1958 to 1964, dedicated to monitoring and studying geomagnetic activity.
c4677308-baa5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tomsk Geomagnetic Observatory, Russia

c471e6ec-bb42-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Mars Exploration Rover (MER) Spirit Radio Science Subsystem was a component of the Spirit rover (MER 2), designed to collect telemetry and measure Doppler shift in radio signals for position determination and radio science experiments, with its performance influenced by both spacecraft and tracking station calibration.
c471e6ec-bb42-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Science Subsystem on Mars Exploration Rover Spirit

c473c1e6-b73d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Inst_NAOJ_Mitaka_Whitelight_1997 is a 10 cm refractor telescope equipped with a CCD and green filter, used to capture full-disk images of the solar photosphere at the Solar Science Observatory in Mitaka, Japan, operational since November 1997.
c473c1e6-b73d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: White Light Imager at Solar Science Observatory, Mitaka

c4802be2-b991-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **LANL1997 Synchronous Orbit Particle Analyzer (SOPA)** is an energetic particle instrument designed to measure differential fluxes of protons, electrons, and various ions in synchronous orbit using three silicon solid state detector telescopes. It operates within a specific energy range for different particles and employs advanced shielding and cooling techniques to ensure precise measurements.
c4802be2-b991-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: EnergeticParticleInstrument on Los Alamos National Laboratory 1997 Observatory

c4973f8c-bad4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Fosseway Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Stratton-on-the-Fosse, Somerset, England. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to the observation and study of celestial objects.
c4973f8c-bad4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fosseway Observatory, United Kingdom

c49a2d9c-b83f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Morrison Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Glasgow, Missouri, United States. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
c49a2d9c-b83f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Morrison Observatory

c49fda24-b62a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 2D Tilt Compensated Magnetometer (TCM2)** is a commercial three-axis magnetometer used in the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) project. It measures magnetic field components with high resolution and includes tilt sensors to differentiate between horizontal and vertical components, essential for studying substorm activity and ULF oscillations.
c49fda24-b62a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

c4a45afa-bb24-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The **Sierra Sinagua Observatory (V10)** is an astronomical observatory located in Flagstaff, Arizona, United States. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
c4a45afa-bb24-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sierra Sinagua Observatory

c4a63c56-b149-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Starhopper Observatory** in Sfântu Gheorghe, Romania is a ground-based astronomical observatory located at 45.86549 latitude and 25.76889 longitude, known for its contributions to astronomy and affiliated with the International Astronomical Union's Minor Planet Center (MPC) list.
c4a63c56-b149-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Starhopper Observatory, Romania

c4ac7b20-b8e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Advanced Composition Explorer (ACE) is a NASA spacecraft designed to observe and analyze particles from the Sun, interplanetary space, and the galaxy, providing critical data for studying solar wind and forecasting space weather.
c4ac7b20-b8e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Advanced Composition Explorer part of Explorers Program

c4b40c40-b9ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in the Llano de Chajnantor Observatory, South America, operated jointly by ESO, NSF, and National Institutes of Natural Sciences, Japan. It specializes in millimeter wavelength observations for exploring the universe's coldest regions.
c4b40c40-b9ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: millimeter Atacama Large Millimeter Array at Llano de Chajnantor Observatory

c4b99c42-b82e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The STAFF (Spatio-Temporal Analysis of Magnetic Field Fluctuations) instrument on Cluster 2/FM7 (Samba) is a search coil magnetometer and spectrum analyzer designed to measure magnetic components of electromagnetic fluctuations up to 4 kHz and compute spectral matrix coefficients for wave analysis in space.
c4b99c42-b82e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: SearchCoil Magnetometer part of Spatio-Temporal Analysis of Magnetic Field Fluctuations on Cluster

c4c3af2e-b613-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EISCAT Sodankyla UHF receiver is a radar instrument located at the EISCAT observatory in Sodankylä, used for studying the upper atmosphere and ionosphere through high-frequency radio waves.
c4c3af2e-b613-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultra High Frequency Radar on EISCAT Observatory

c4d42c4c-b7f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The ISEE 3 SWP instrument was an electrostatic analyzer onboard the ISEE-3 spacecraft designed to measure solar wind plasma by providing 2D and 3D distribution functions for protons (150eV-7keV) and electrons (10eV-1keV).
c4d42c4c-b7f7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar wind plasma on ISEE 3

c4dbdb2e-b840-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nanortalik Magnetometer was an instrument used for measuring magnetic fields at the IAGA-identified station in Nanortalik, operating from January 1, 1884 to December 31, 1960.
c4dbdb2e-b840-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Nanortalik Observatory

c4e07b98-b7aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at Heard Island, operational from 1947 to 1954, used for measuring magnetic field variations as part of the IAGA investigation.
c4e07b98-b7aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IAGA investigation

c4f6d38e-bb97-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kevola Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Paimio, Finland. Owned by Turun Ursa ry, it features facilities such as a 50-cm Schmidt-Väisälä telescope and various observation buildings, operating since 1963.
c4f6d38e-bb97-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 50-cm Schmidt Telescope at Kevola Observatory, Finland

c500177e-b6eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The Magnetometers at Shatsk (SHT), operational from 1957 to 1960, were part of the IAGA investigation and located at the WDC Kyoto observatory in Shatsk.
c500177e-b6eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IAGA

c5024264-bc9b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Explorer 47 (IMP-7) was a NASA space probe launched in 1972 to study interplanetary and magnetotail regions from a nearly circular orbit around Earth. It was designed to measure energetic particles, plasma, and electric and magnetic fields.
c5024264-bc9b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Interplanetary Monitoring Platform H on Explorer 47

c50503aa-b9c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Mountain Creek Ranch Observatory (code: V08) is an astronomical observatory located in Vail, Arizona. It is a ground-based facility situated at coordinates 32.079598 latitude and -110.661 longitude (-249.339 converted to standard format).
c50503aa-b9c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mountain Creek Ranch Observatory, United States

c5075c28-bba0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Electrostatic Analyzer on IMP-I was an instrument designed to measure and analyze the particle populations, including electrons and positive ions, in the solar wind, magnetosheath, and magnetotail. It utilized a hemispherical electrostatic analyzer with four operational modes to gather detailed energy spectra of these particles at various energy levels and angular ranges.

c50d4c7c-bc23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Chibougamau (CHBG) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Nord-du-Québec, Quebec, Canada, established on September 15, 2006. It is part of the THEMIS Ground-Based Observatories network and includes instruments such as a magnetometer for geophysical measurements.
c50d4c7c-bc23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Chibougamau Geophysical Observatory, Canada

c523fcae-bab8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The TÜBİTAK National Observatory (TUG) is a ground-based astronomical observatory operated by the Scientific and Technological Research Council of Turkey, located in Bakırtepe, about 50 km west-southwest of Antalya.
c523fcae-bab8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: TÜBİTAK National Observatory, Türkiye

c53095fc-b65f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **THJ77 Qaanaaq, Greenland** is an ionospheric observatory located in Qaanaaq, Greenland, which operates a Digisonde to study the characteristics of skywave signals reflected from the ionosphere.
c53095fc-b65f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digisonde at Ionospheric Station Qaanaaq, Greenland

c5360d30-b997-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Arecibo 2380 MHz Radar Receiver is a cryogenically-cooled High Electron Mobility Transistor (HEMT) amplifier mounted on the Arecibo 305-m telescope, designed with a filter bandpass of approximately 100 MHz centered at 2380 MHz.
c5360d30-b997-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Planetary Radar Receiver on 305m Telescope at Arecibo Observatory

c53812ea-b755-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Samuel Oschin Telescope, also known as the 1.24/1.83-m Oschin Schmidt photographic equatorial telescope, is located at Palomar Observatory in California and has been operational since 1948. It is a significant astronomical instrument used for various observational studies.
c53812ea-b755-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.24m Oschin Schmidt Telescope at Palomar Observatory, United States

c5405662-bbc9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Chiripa is a ground-based magnetometer observatory located in Tilarán, Guanacaste, Costa Rica. It operates as part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) network and has been active since 1984.
c5405662-bbc9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Chiripa Observatory, Costa Rica

c544d538-b6de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA/ISA Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE) satellite is a spacecraft designed to study the polarization of X-rays from cosmic sources, providing insights into high-energy astrophysical phenomena.
c544d538-b6de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: x-ray NASA/ISA Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer satellite

c5492d78-ba1b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Mars Exploration Rover Spirit Descent Camera** (DESCAM) is a camera mounted on the Mars rover Spirit's lander radar bracket, designed to capture images of Mars during descent with a broadband visible filter and producing 1024 x 1024 pixel images.
c5492d78-ba1b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Descent Camera on Mars Exploration Rover Spirit

c54c07a4-baad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Tyrone Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in County Tyrone, Grant County, New Mexico, United States. It is a ground-based facility situated at the coordinates 32.71084° N, 108.3013° W.
c54c07a4-baad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tyrone Observatory, United States

c56b3e5c-b5a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Stonyhurst geophysical observatory is a ground-based facility located in Scotland, United Kingdom, that operated from 1865 to 1967 and was part of the IAGA network for monitoring geomagnetic activity.
c56b3e5c-b5a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geomagnetic Observatory at Stonyhurst Observatory, United Kingdom

c56defae-b7e7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The DMSP_5D2-F14 Positions entity provides the spatial coordinates of the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program's F14 spacecraft in different reference frames.
c56defae-b7e7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris on DMSP_5D2-F14

c56fd7bc-b7a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: An **Interferometer** is a scientific instrument that uses the principle of interference to make precise measurements, often employed in astronomy and optical metrology. The **NenuFAR Radio Imager**, activated on July 1, 2020, is part of the NenuFAR observatory and functions as an interferometer for radio imaging purposes.
c56fd7bc-b7a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: NenuFAR Radio Imager part of NenuFAR

c5713d08-b6e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "ISIS1 Positions" is a dataset that provides the spacecraft positions of the ISIS1 mission in various coordinate systems, facilitating precise tracking and analysis for scientific investigations.
c5713d08-b6e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ISIS1 part of Space Mission Working Group

c5723d7a-b9a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique (CNRS)/National Institute for Astrophysics (INAF) 0.9m THEMIS Telescope at Observatorio del Teide is a solar observatory located in Africa, designed to study the magnetism and instabilities of the Sun using optical wavebands.
c5723d7a-b9a4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.9m optical Telescope Heliographique pour l'Etude du Magnetisme et des Instabilites Solaires at Observatorio del Teide

c574af4c-b634-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The McMurdo Photometer Instrument, part of the ICESTAR investigation, is a photometer located at the McMurdo ground station used for atmospheric and astronomical observations.
c574af4c-b634-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Photometer part of ICESTAR investigation, Antarctica

c578e642-b6da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The "Magnetometers at Tokyo (TOK)" were instruments used to measure the Earth's magnetic field in Tokyo from 1887 to 1912 as part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) investigations.
c578e642-b6da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tokyo Observatory

c5790200-ba75-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: Nizamia Observatory was an optical astronomical observatory established in Hyderabad, India, in 1908 by Mahbub Ali Khan, the 6th Nizam of Hyderabad. It contributed significantly to the Carte du Ciel project and housed notable telescopes like an 8" Cooke Astrograph and a 15" Grubb refractor.
c5790200-ba75-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Nizamia Observatory, India

c57aecf0-baf2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) mission is a collaborative project between NASA and ISRO to develop and launch a dual-frequency synthetic aperture radar satellite for Earth observation, set to be the first of its kind.
c57aecf0-baf2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar part of NISAR

c57b3108-b852-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Tarleton State University Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Stephenville, Texas. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical research and observations on Earth.
c57b3108-b852-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stephenville Observatory, United States

c57d2c84-b99b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Tihany Geomagnetic Observatory (THY)** is a ground-based facility located in Tihany, Hungary, primarily involved in geomagnetic measurements and research since 1957. It operates under the World Data Center for Geomagnetism in Kyoto.
c57d2c84-b99b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tihany Geomagnetic Observatory, Hungary

c57d2d6c-b6ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 210 Magnetic Meridian (210MM) Biak magnetometer station is a ground-based facility located in Biak Numfor, Papua, Western New Guinea, Indonesia. It is part of the ISEE network and specifically measures magnetic field variations using a fluxgate instrument.
c57d2d6c-b6ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Biak Observatory, Indonesia

c57ddb32-b99d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EMN Pohnpei Station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in U, Federated States of Micronesia, part of the EMN magnetometer network. It is situated at latitude 7.0 and longitude 158.33 in Oceania.
c57ddb32-b99d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Pohnpei Observatory, Federated States of Micronesia

c5826764-bb1a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Andean Northern Observatory** (ANO) is an astronomical observatory located in Nummi-Pusula, Finland. It operates as a ground-based facility for observing celestial objects and phenomena.
c5826764-bb1a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Nummi-Pusula Observatory, Finland

c582ca84-b768-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Köln Observatory (A19) is an astronomical observatory located in Heumar, Cologne, Germany. It is a ground-based facility used for studying and observing celestial objects from Earth.
c582ca84-b768-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cologne Observatory, Germany

c582ddc8-b739-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Paramaribo Geomagnetic Observatory (PAB), located in Suriname, South America, is a ground-based facility that operated from 1957 to 1974, sponsored by the Netherlands. It was part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) network and contributed to geomagnetic data collection.
c582ddc8-b739-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Paramaribo Geomagnetic Observatory, Suriname

c585ddf8-b5fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "DMSP_5D2-F08 Positions" dataset provides the spatial coordinates of the DMSP 5D2-F08 spacecraft in different reference systems. It is part of the observatory framework for the DMSP 5D2-F08 mission and includes ephemeris data.
c585ddf8-b5fd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: DMSP 5D-2 F08 on DMSP Observatory

c5903c08-b9f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ObsCT observatory is an astronomical facility located in Catania, Sicily, Italy, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial phenomena.
c5903c08-b9f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatory at Catania

c594bfaa-ba56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Solar Energetic Particle Ionic Charge Analyzer (SEPICA) on the Advanced Composition Explorer (ACE) is an instrument designed to measure the ionic charge state, kinetic energy, and nuclear charge of energetic ions originating from solar flares and other space phenomena.
c594bfaa-ba56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electrostatic Analyser Solar Energetic Particle Ionic Charge Analyzer on Advanced Composition Explorer

c59c94d4-b8ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Sobradillo Observatory (also known as Observatorio Astronómico Sobradillo) is an astronomical observatory located in Sobradillo de Palomares, Zamora, Spain. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical observations and research.
c59c94d4-b8ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatorio Astronómico Sobradillo, Spain

c59dc1d0-b5e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Huygens Probe Housekeeping (HK)** is a component of the Huygens Probe mission that documents and calibrates various systems not covered by the probe's subsystems.
c59dc1d0-b5e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Huygens Probe Housekeeping on Huygens Probe

c5a0580e-b765-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Farm Cove Observatory (FCO) was an amateur astronomical observatory located in Pakuranga, Auckland, New Zealand, notable for the discovery of the main-belt asteroid 386622 New Zealand by Jennie McCormick in September 2009.
c5a0580e-b765-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Farm Cove Observatory, New Zealand

c5a97148-bc81-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nord Geomagnetic Observatory (NRD) is a ground-based facility located in Greenland that operates as part of the IUGONET network, specifically under the World Data Center Kyoto. It conducted geomagnetic measurements from 1981 to 1970.
c5a97148-bc81-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Nord Geomagnetic Observatory

c5b69f30-bbd2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL Balloon 1R Optical Photometer is an instrument designed to detect visible light at wavelengths near 486.1 nm, specifically during relativistic electron precipitation events, in order to determine the presence of accompanying protons and support the study of electromagnetic ion cyclotron (EMIC) waves as a precipitation mechanism.
c5b69f30-bbd2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Photometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

c5b94eca-bbae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Hazardous Observatory** (code: V31) is an astronomical observatory located in Mayhill, New Mexico, United States. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical observations and research.
c5b94eca-bbae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mayhill Observatory, United States

c5bbe7d2-bbd8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Daocheng Glacier Observatory** is a ground-based observatory located in Zilong, Daocheng County, Kardze, Sichuan, China. It is situated at coordinates 29.01175°N, 100.22664°E and focuses on glacier research and monitoring.
c5bbe7d2-bbd8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Daocheng Glacier Observatory, China

c5c78de4-b78c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gromme Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Maasmechelen, Belgium. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
c5c78de4-b78c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gromme Observatory at Maasmechelen, Belgium

c5cb2cb4-b86e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **EISCAT Sodankylä Station** is a ground-based facility located at the Sodankylä Geophysical Observatory in Northern Lapland, Finland. It consists of an EISCAT UHF receiver antenna that receives signals transmitted by the Tromsø radar for atmospheric and ionospheric research.
c5cb2cb4-b86e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: UHF Receiver Antenna at Sodankylä Geophysical Observatory, Finland

c5ce6d5a-bbc7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Fluxgate Magnetometer on CRRES (Combined Release and Radiation Effects Satellite) was an instrument designed to measure the ambient geomagnetic field and its low-frequency variations up to 10 Hz, providing crucial data for understanding particle pitch angles, global geomagnetic disturbances, plasma gyrofrequencies, electric fields, and spacecraft attitude.
c5ce6d5a-bbc7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Chemical Release and Radiation Effects Satellite

c5d7f4a4-b74b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IAGA:DJI Magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field at the Djibouti station, operational since January 1, 2011.
c5d7f4a4-b74b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Djibouti Observatory

c5de136c-b70e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Novosibirsk (NVS), operational since 1967, used for measuring the Earth's magnetic field as part of the IAGA investigation.
c5de136c-b70e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Klyuchi Observatory

c5ebf496-ba7e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Space Environmental Monitor (SEM)** on NOAA 14 is an instrument designed to measure proton and electron flux densities and energy spectra in the upper atmosphere. It consists of two main components: the Total Energy Detector (TED) and the Medium Energy Proton and Electron Detector (MEPED).
c5ebf496-ba7e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Space Environmental Monitor on NOAA 14

c60f5b72-baae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Venera 7 Energetic Particles experiment was a Soviet instrument suite onboard the Venera 7 spacecraft designed to detect and measure the flux of medium-energy charged particles in interplanetary space, focusing on protons from both sunward and anti-sunward directions during its mission to Venus.
c60f5b72-baae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particles Experiment on Venera 7 Spacecraft

c6253f58-b641-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tehran geophysical observatory is a ground facility located in Tehran, Iran, that operated from 1965 to 1969 and was part of the World Data Center system, primarily focusing on geomagnetic measurements.
c6253f58-b641-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tehran Geomagnetic Observatory, Iran

c63c0f98-bae3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer used in the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation located at the Nuuk Geophysical Observatory since May 2009, which measures vector magnetic field data with a resolution of one minute.
c63c0f98-bae3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Nuuk Observatory

c6498776-b837-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Grems Timmons Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Graettinger, Palo Alto County, Iowa, United States. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
c6498776-b837-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Grems Timmons Observatory at Graettinger, United States

c652a1e0-ba6b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Geel Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Geel, Antwerp, Belgium. It serves as a ground-based facility for observing celestial bodies and phenomena.
c652a1e0-ba6b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Geel Observatory, Belgium

c65b7ffc-b117-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Entity Definition:**
Aditya-L1 is an Indian solar observation satellite designed to study the Sun's atmosphere and its impact on Earth from a halo orbit around the Lagrange point 1 (L1).
c65b7ffc-b117-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Aditya L1 Solar Probe part of Indian Space Research Organisation

c65d4176-bbb1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 1V is a high-altitude balloon payload launched as part of the BARREL mission to study the precipitation of relativistic electrons from Earth's radiation belts, operating in the stratosphere from January 30, 2013, to February 6, 2013.
c65d4176-bbb1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses Balloon 1V part of Living with a Star Mission of Opportunity

c668face-b6a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Indian Space Research Organization 1.2m InfraRed Telescope at Mount Abu InfraRed Observatory (MIRO) is a 1.2-meter telescope located in Asia, specifically at the Mount Abu InfraRed Observatory in India, designed for optical and infrared astronomical observations.
c668face-b6a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical Indian Space Research Organization 1.2m InfraRed Telescope at Mount Abu InfraRed Observatory

c66ba7aa-bacd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "GOES 3 Position" refers to the spatial coordinates and trajectory data of the GOES-3 spacecraft, which is part of the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite (GOES) system used for weather forecasting and environmental monitoring.
c66ba7aa-bacd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Position on GOES 3 Spacecraft

c68645be-b90c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA/German Aerospace Center (DLR) 2.5m Stratospheric Observatory for Infrared Astronomy (SOFIA) is an airborne observatory equipped with a 2.5-meter telescope designed for infrared astronomy, operating at high altitudes to minimize atmospheric interference.
c68645be-b90c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: infrared NASA German Aerospace Center 2.5m Stratospheric Observatory for Infrared Astronomy

c686ac48-b60a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Clementine 1** spacecraft, also known as DSPSE (Deep Space Program Science Experiment), was a lunar orbiter built by the US Naval Research Laboratory and launched in 1994. It was designed for a low-cost demonstration of advanced technologies and carried various instruments, including cameras and sensors, to map the Moon's surface and gather scientific data.
c686ac48-b60a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Clementine Spacecraft part of Deep Space Program Science Experiment

c68887f8-b7e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Keetmanshoop Magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of Earth's magnetic field, located at the Keetmanshoop Observatory in Namibia, with operations starting on January 1, 2005.
c68887f8-b7e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Keetmanshoop Observatory

c69c9ace-ba26-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The North Pole 7 Geomagnetic Observatory (NPG) was a ground-based facility located in the Arctic, sponsored by Russia, and operated from 1957 to 1959. It included a magnetometer for geomagnetic measurements.
c69c9ace-ba26-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at North Pole 7 Geomagnetic Observatory, Antarctica

c69f45cc-b624-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The magnetometers at Yinchuan (YCB) are part of the IUGONET observatory network, specifically under the World Data Center in Kyoto, and they provide valuable data on Earth's geomagnetic field at that location.
c69f45cc-b624-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Yinchuan Observatory

c6a23ffc-ba2a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Astronomical Observatory of the University of Warsaw is an institute dedicated to research and teaching in astronomy, located in Warsaw, Poland. It is part of the Faculty of Physics at the University of Warsaw and conducts notable sky surveys like OGLE and ASAS using telescopes in Chile.
c6a23ffc-ba2a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Warsaw Observatory, Poland

c6a43ec8-b5df-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The STAFF (Spatio-Temporal Analysis of Magnetic Field Fluctuations) instrument on the Cluster 2/FM6 (Salsa) mission is a search coil magnetometer designed to measure magnetic components of electromagnetic fluctuations up to 4 kHz and compute spectral matrix coefficients using magnetic and electric wave components.
c6a43ec8-b5df-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: SearchCoil on Spatio-Temporal Analysis of Magnetic Field Fluctuations

c6aaf99a-bb41-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Chajnantor Observatory is an astronomical research facility located in the Atacama Desert, Chile, that houses various telescopes and instruments for studying the cosmos, including the California Institute of Technology Cosmic Background Imager (CBI).
c6aaf99a-bb41-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cosmic Background Imager at Chajnantor Observatory
