d6e2bd1e-bb2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gemini South Observatory on Cerro Pachon, Chile

d6e4e07e-ba05-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hankasalmi Geophysical Observatory (HAN) is a ground-based facility located in Central Finland that specializes in geomagnetic measurements, including the use of magnetometer instruments.
d6e4e07e-ba05-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hankasalmi Geophysical Observatory, Finland

d6ed0406-b62d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Exploration Rover Opportunity Microscopic Imager (MI) was a fixed-focus camera on the Instrument Deployment Device of the MER 1 spacecraft, designed to capture high-resolution images for geological and petrologic analysis on Mars.
d6ed0406-b62d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Microscopic Imager on Mars Exploration Rover Opportunity

d6f0bdb8-b7c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The OCA-Anza Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Riverside County, California, United States. It is operated by the Orange County Astronomers and serves as a ground-based observatory for conducting astronomical research and observations.
d6f0bdb8-b7c6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: OCA-Anza Observatory, United States

d6f7a8e4-b735-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Science Laboratory (MSL) Curiosity Rover's ChemCam instrument suite combines a Laser Induced Breakdown Spectrometer (LIBS) and Remote Micro-Imager (RMI), housed in mast and body units, for chemical analysis and imaging on Mars.
d6f7a8e4-b735-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Chemistry Camera on Mars Science Laboratory Curiosity Rover

d6fb3eec-b5fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Haleakala Observatory is an astronomical facility located on the summit of Mount Haleakalā, Hawaii. It includes specific instruments such as the Tōhoku University's 0.6m telescope for various scientific observations and research purposes.
d6fb3eec-b5fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.6m Telescope at Haleakala Observatory

d7005fea-b6c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** McMillin Observatory was an astronomical observatory located at Ohio State University in Columbus, Ohio. Built around 1895 and operated by the university, it focused on both education and scientific research until its closure in 1968.
d7005fea-b6c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: McMillin Observatory

d703bfe8-b6af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, particularly the Earth's magnetic field. The Podkamenaya Tunguska Magnetometer, operational since 1969 and part of the IAGA observatory network, is located at the POD station in Russia and contributes to global geomagnetic monitoring efforts.
d703bfe8-b6af-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Podkamenaya Tunguska Observatory

d7068b08-bbd5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of California 1m Anna L. Nickel Telescope is an optical telescope with a 1-meter aperture located at the Lick Observatory in North America. It is operated by the University of California and is used for astronomical observations.
d7068b08-bbd5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.0m Anna L. Nickel Telescope at Lick Observatory

d714278c-b6c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 9-channel ELF/VLF receiver at Husafell, Iceland is an instrument used for conjugate observation of extremely low frequency (ELF) and very low frequency (VLF) electromagnetic waves as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
d714278c-b6c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ELF/VLF Receiver part of Conjugate Observation Investigation

d717f5ec-b7ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mauna Loa Solar Observatory (MLSO) is a solar observatory situated on the slopes of Mauna Loa in Hawaii, operated by the High Altitude Observatory within the National Center for Atmospheric Research.
d717f5ec-b7ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mauna Loa Solar Observatory

d71b935e-ba86-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Rusty Mountain Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Gold Canyon, Arizona, United States. It is situated at 18201 East San Ignacio Court and operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
d71b935e-ba86-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rusty Mountain Observatory

d71bced0-b64b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Barlad Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Bârlad, Vaslui County, Romania. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting various astronomical observations and research on Earth.
d71bced0-b64b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Barlad Observatory, Romania

d71d21c8-b67c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IPS Fuji Station is an antenna facility in Fujikawaguchiko, Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan, dedicated to Interplanetary Scintillation (IPS) measurements. It includes a UHF radio telescope and contributes to the study of solar wind and other space weather phenomena.
d71d21c8-b67c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Antenna Station of Interplanetary Scintillation Measurements at Fuji Observatory, Japan

d721ddb8-ba59-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Low-Energy Ion Composition Analyzer (LICA)** on the SAMPEX mission was an instrument designed to measure solar and magnetospheric ions with energies between 0.5--5 MeV/nucleon, providing detailed composition data by determining the mass of ions through time-of-flight and residual energy measurements.
d721ddb8-ba59-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Low-Energy Ion Composition Analyzer on SAMPEX

d7302452-b713-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Radio Mapping of Solar Wind Disturbances (Type III bursts) in 3-D" experiment on the ISEE 3 spacecraft uses two perpendicular dipole antennas to map the trajectories of Type III solar radio bursts by determining their angular coordinates as a function of frequency and time, providing insights into solar wind disturbances.
d7302452-b713-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Antenna part of Radio Mapping of Solar Wind Disturbances (Type III bursts) in 3-D on ISEE 3

d730b362-b7e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Gemini North Observatory**, located on Mauna Kea, Hawaii, is a ground-based astronomical observatory that includes the 8.1-meter Gemini North Telescope for advanced optical and infrared observations.
d730b362-b7e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 8m Telescope at Gemini North Observatory

d733078a-b817-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Sternwarte Feuerstein** is a public observatory located in Ebermannstadt, Germany. It operates as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and is situated at an altitude of approximately 499.5 meters above sea level.
d733078a-b817-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Feuerstein Observatory, Germany

d734b09a-b677-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Charged Particle Composition** (CPC) instrument on Pioneer 11 was designed to measure the composition and energy spectra of solar and galactic particles with energies above about 0.5 MeV/nucleon using two telescopes, providing detailed information on particle arrival directions and types.
d734b09a-b677-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Instrument part of Pioneer 11

d73891ee-b6cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Unistellar Telescope Network** is a collection of optical telescopes located on Earth, facilitating astronomical observations and research. It operates under the management of Unistellar and utilizes advanced technologies to enhance our understanding of the cosmos through collaborative efforts.
d73891ee-b6cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Optical Unistellar Telescope Network

d73ae6bc-b6be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **PESCOPE Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Gqeberha (formerly Port Elizabeth), South Africa. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
d73ae6bc-b6be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Port Elizabeth Observatory, South Africa

d74838a6-b81e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The BARREL Balloon 1V X-ray Instrument (XRI) is a scintillation detector designed to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons. It operates with an energy response from 10 keV to 10 MeV and is part of the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) mission.
d74838a6-b81e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray Scintillation Detector part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

d748641e-b8fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NOAA 10 Positions entity refers to the recorded spatial locations of the NOAA 10 spacecraft within different coordinate frameworks, providing essential data for various scientific investigations and applications.
d748641e-b8fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spacecraft Position part of National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration 10

d74a1e88-ba89-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The High Energy Particle Spectrometer (HEPS) is an instrument on the DSX mission designed to measure the differential energy spectrum of protons and electrons in specific energy ranges, providing data crucial for understanding space weather effects such as microelectronics damage and deep dielectric charging.
d74a1e88-ba89-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: High Energy Particle Spectrometer part of Demonstration and Science Experiments

d74c59a8-ba4f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **DCAM3-D (DCAM3 Digital)** is a digital imaging system onboard the DCAM3 spacecraft, designed for scientific observation with both wide-angle and high-resolution capabilities.
d74c59a8-ba4f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: DCAM3 Digital on DCAM3

d74e8efe-bb7a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The NRAO 300-foot Green Bank Telescope is a large radio telescope located in North America, with an aperture of 91.44 meters and operating primarily in the radio waveband.
d74e8efe-bb7a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 91.44m Radio Telescope at Green Bank Observatory

d7566e48-bc2a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **UAdeC Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Saltillo, Coahuila, Mexico. It operates as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical research and observations.
d7566e48-bc2a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatorio Astronómico UAdeC at Saltillo, Mexico

d75b70f0-b5c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences (NAOC) 2.4m Optical Telescope at Yunnan Astronomical Observatory (YAO), also known as Lijiang Observatory, is a large astronomical telescope located in Asia, specifically designed for optical waveband observations.
d75b70f0-b5c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.4m optical National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences Telescope at Yunnan Astronomical Observatory Lijiang Observatory

d76165ba-ba30-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Phu Thuy Geomagnetic Observatory (PHU) is a ground-based facility located in Gia Lâm District, Hanoi, Vietnam. It specializes in geomagnetic measurements and is sponsored by Vietnam as part of the World Data Center system.
d76165ba-ba30-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Phu Thuy Geomagnetic Observatory, Vietnam

d7659cde-b742-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: DEMETER spacecraft position and velocity refer to the positional coordinates and movement data of the DEMETER satellite, specifically provided in the Geocentric Equatorial Inertial (GEI) coordinate system. This information is crucial for tracking and analyzing the satellite's orbital trajectory and movements.
d7659cde-b742-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform part of DEMETER

d766e296-b90a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Science Laboratory (MSL) Curiosity Rover's Front Hazard Avoidance Camera Right String A is one of the Hazcams mounted on the rover to provide stereo imaging for hazard detection and avoidance, primarily focusing on the near field in front of the rover. It aids in building range maps and supports science operations by capturing 1024 x 1024 pixel images with a broadband visible filter.
d766e296-b90a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Front Hazard Avoidance Camera on Mars Science Laboratory Curiosity Rover

d7717da6-ba3a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The specific instance referred to here is a magnetometer located at the Ashkhabad observatory, part of the IUGONET network, operational since January 1959.
d7717da6-ba3a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at IUGONET Observatory

d77fa9e0-b629-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Davao, operational from 1968 to 1984, used for measuring the magnetic field as part of the IAGA investigation.
d77fa9e0-b629-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Davao Observatory

d78088c4-ba43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Felsina AAB Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Monte San Pietro, Bologna, Italy. It operates as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
d78088c4-ba43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Osservatorio Felsina AAB Observatory, Italy

d7822bd8-b8b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Integrated Science Investigation of the Sun (ISOIS)** aboard the Parker Solar Probe uses a Mass Spectrometer to investigate energetic particles in the inner heliosphere. It consists of two instruments, EPI-Lo and EPI-Hi, with EPI-Lo specifically designed to measure low-energy electrons, protons, and ions, providing detailed insights into their acceleration and transport mechanisms.
d7822bd8-b8b4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mass Spectrometer part of Parker Solar Probe ISOIS Investigation

d782f794-b124-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Fine Guidance Sensor (FGS)** is a set of three instruments on the Hubble Space Telescope used for precise pointing and stabilization, capable of aiming the telescope with an accuracy of 0.01 arcseconds by detecting and correcting drift using guide stars.
d782f794-b124-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Fine Guidance Sensor on Hubble Space Telescope

d78567d2-bac4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Pondicherry Geomagnetic Observatory (PND), located in Puducherry, India, is a ground-based facility that monitors geophysical phenomena using instruments such as magnetometers.
d78567d2-bac4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Pondicherry Geomagnetic Observatory, India

d78e7068-b8c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A fluxgate magnetometer located in Tixie, part of the 210 Magnetic Meridian (210MM) network, used for magnetic field measurements within the IUGONET observatory.
d78e7068-b8c9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IUGONET Observatory

d7af1b00-bb2c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Montsec Astronomical Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Sant Esteve de la Sarga, Catalonia, Spain. It was established on October 24, 2008, and is known for its ground-based observations.
d7af1b00-bb2c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Montsec Astronomical Observatory at Fabra Observatory, Spain

d7b7bcb0-b73a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ionospheric Station at Osan Air Base (SN437), South Korea, was a ground facility equipped with an advanced Digisonde for studying ionospheric reflections, operational from December 1999 to August 2006.
d7b7bcb0-b73a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Digisonde at Ionospheric Station on Osan Air Base, South Korea

d7cb3332-ba12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Siding Spring 2.3 m Telescope, also known as the Advanced Technology Telescope (ATT), is an optical telescope with a 2.3-meter aperture located at the Siding Spring Observatory in Australia, operated by the Australian National University since 1984.
d7cb3332-ba12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.3m Advanced Technology Telescope at Siding Spring Observatory, Australia

d7dcc48c-bb82-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The **Kushiro Observatory**, located in Shibecha, Hokkaido Prefecture, Japan, is an astronomical observatory dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial phenomena.
d7dcc48c-bb82-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kushiro Observatory, Japan

d7e5dbfe-b6b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Lunar Trailblazer**: A NASA SIMPLEx mission involving a small lunar orbiter designed to detect and map water on the Moon's surface, launched in 2025 but experienced communication issues shortly after deployment.
d7e5dbfe-b6b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label:
High-resolution Volatiles and Minerals Moon Mapper on Lunar Trailblazer
Lunar Thermal Mapper on Lunar Trailblazer

d7ec0e9c-b6a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: An astronomical observatory located in Las Negras, Níjar, Almeria, Andalusia, Spain.
d7ec0e9c-b6a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Las Negras Observatory, Spain

d7eca23e-b7be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 14 Lunar Module "Antares" was the third crewed vehicle to land on the Moon, carrying astronauts Alan B. Shepard Jr. and Edgar D. Mitchell, who deployed scientific experiments and collected lunar samples during their mission in February 1971.
d7eca23e-b7be-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Camera and Multi-Object Spectrometer on Hubble Space Telescope

d7eca726-b6f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Nijmegen Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Nijmegen, Netherlands.
d7eca726-b6f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Nijmegen Observatory, Netherlands

d7f5d1b2-b947-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **IAS Remote Observatory** is a ground-based observatory located at Hakos Astrofarm on the Gamsberg Pass in Khomas, Namibia. It operates from coordinates -23.23655 latitude and 16.36172 longitude.
d7f5d1b2-b947-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared IAS Remote Observatory at Hakos Astrofarm, Namibia

d8064dba-bbe2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **DSS-46** was a 26-meter radio telescope in Canberra, Australia, primarily used for communication with Earth orbiting spacecraft and initial acquisition post-launch, notable for relaying the first Moon landing images.
d8064dba-bbe2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 26m Deep Space Station 46 Radio Telescope at Canberra Deep Space Communications Complex, Australia

d80f6746-b922-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Toma Observatory (MPC ID: 899) is an astronomical observatory located in Tohma, Kamikawa County, Hokkaido Prefecture, Japan. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to studying celestial phenomena and contributing to scientific research in astronomy.
d80f6746-b922-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Toma Observatory, Japan

d81549e0-b67a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Rotation and Interior Structure Experiment (RISE)** is an instrument on NASA's InSight Mars lander designed to use X-band telecommunications and Doppler tracking to measure the precession and nutation of Mars' spin axis, providing insights into the planet's interior structure.
d81549e0-b67a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rotation and Interior Structure Experiment on InSight

d81747e0-bb0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Barth:** A former ground-based observatory in Barth, Germany that operated from 1898 to 1903, focusing on magnetometer measurements as part of the IAGA network.
d81747e0-bb0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Barth Observatory, Germany

d817bd50-b62b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1G Tilt Compensated Magnetometer (TCM2)** is a three-axis magnetometer deployed on high-altitude balloons as part of the BARREL mission. It measures magnetic field components with high resolution to detect substorm activity and ULF oscillations, crucial for studying electron precipitation modulations.
d817bd50-b62b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

d818872e-b853-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at the Brorfelde ground station used for measuring magnetic field variations, part of the IUGONET observatory network since 1980.
d818872e-b853-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at Brorfelde

d818f78c-b8b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Biak station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Biak Numfor, Papua, Western New Guinea, Indonesia, operating as part of the CPMN magnetometer network. It monitors magnetic field variations at coordinates -1.08 latitude and 136.05 longitude on the Asian continent.
d818f78c-b8b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at Biak Station, Indonesia

d81a556c-b705-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the "Steward Observatory 1.5m (60 inch) Telescope," which is a part of the Catalina Sky Survey (CSS) located at the Mount Lemmon Observing Facility.
d81a556c-b705-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.5m Telescope part of Catalina Sky Survey at Mount Lemmon Observatory

d828384e-bb65-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Electron Auroral Imager (EAI) at Syowa Station, Antarctica, is an all-sky imaging device designed to observe electron auroras emitted by atmospheric atoms and molecules excited by precipitating electrons. It consists of two units with different wavelength filters to study the energy characteristics of these electrons.
d828384e-bb65-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electron Auroral Imager at Syowa Observatory, Antarctica

d8397f58-b789-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Baffin Island Magnetometer was an instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field at a station identified by IAGA as BFI from January 1, 1921, to December 31, 1922.
d8397f58-b789-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Baffin Island Observatory

d83f56a6-bae7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU radio beacon receiver (GRBR) station at Ho Chi Minh City is an observatory located in Xuan Thoi Thuong Commune, Hóc Môn District, Vietnam, designed to measure ionospheric disturbances and study middle-upper atmospheric coupling processes.
d83f56a6-bae7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU Radio Beacon Receiver Station at Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

d8444de2-b951-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Sharjah Observatory (M47) is an astronomical observatory located in Muwaileh, Sharjah, United Arab Emirates. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to the study of celestial objects and phenomena.
d8444de2-b951-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sharjah Observatory, United Arab Emirates

d8486ee8-bafc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Munin MEDUSA is a miniaturized electrostatic dual-top hat spherical analyzer designed for the Munin spacecraft. It functions as both an electron and ion spectrometer, capable of measuring particles with energies up to 17 keV/q simultaneously in 16 sectors aligned with Earth's magnetic field.
d8486ee8-bafc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Miniaturized Electrostatic Dual-top-hat Spherical Analyser on Munin Spacecraft

d84bb82a-ba0a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Space Environment Monitor (SEM)** on the GOES 15 spacecraft is an instrument package designed to monitor various aspects of the space environment, including local fluxes of electrons, protons, and alpha-particles, solar X-ray flux, geomagnetic activity, and solar ultraviolet radiation.
d84bb82a-ba0a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Space Environment Monitor on GOES 15 spacecraft

d84bc3ba-b6ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Stepanovka Ground Magnetic Field Instrument is a magnetometer located at the Stepanovka ground station and has been operational since 1936. It is part of the IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) investigation network.
d84bc3ba-b6ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Stepanovka Observatory

d858ad6e-bafa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: HaloSat is a CubeSat developed by the University of Iowa and NASA designed to study the hot galactic halo using X-ray observations.
d858ad6e-bafa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: x-ray University of Iowa NASA HaloSat on Spacecraft

d85ba044-b741-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Steward Observatory in Tucson, Arizona is a ground-based astronomical observatory located at East 2nd Street. It serves as a research facility for the University of Arizona, contributing to various astronomical studies and discoveries.
d85ba044-b741-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 692 Telescope at Steward Observatory, United States

d861964e-ba06-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Near Earth Asteroid Rendezvous – Shoemaker (NEAR Shoemaker) was a robotic space probe launched in 1996 to study the near-Earth asteroid Eros from close orbit, becoming the first spacecraft to orbit and land on an asteroid.
d861964e-ba06-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Earth Asteroid Rendezvous – Shoemaker part of Near Earth Asteroid Rendezvous Mission

d865aa86-b9b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Martin S. Kraar Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Rehovot, Israel. It operates as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
d865aa86-b9b6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Martin S. Kraar Observatory

d86abe0c-bbbb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Cockfield Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Cockfield, Suffolk, England. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical observations and research.
d86abe0c-bbbb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cockfield Observatory, United Kingdom

d86c5412-b6ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ugut Geomagnetic Observatory (UGT) is a ground-based facility in Russia that operated from 1975 to 1979, located in the Surgutsky District of the Khanty-Mansiysk Autonomous Okrug – Ugra, primarily focused on geomagnetic measurements.
d86c5412-b6ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Ugut Geomagnetic Observatory, Russia

d8851d4a-bae6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Annamalainagar Ground Observatory**: A ground-based facility located in Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu, India, that operated from 1957 to 1993 and was part of the IUGONET instrument network managed by the WDC Kyoto for magnetometer data.
d8851d4a-bae6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Annamalainagar Ground Observatory, India

d89a72e8-b84e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The Magnetometers at Lycksele (LYC), part of the WDC_Kyoto observatory under IUGONET, have been operational since January 1, 2008, providing valuable data on geomagnetic activity in the region.
d89a72e8-b84e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at Lycksele

d89affec-b731-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Inastars Observatory Potsdam was an astronomical observatory located in Potsdam, Germany, operational until 2006. It was situated at 6 Moosglöckchenweg, Waldstadt II, and focused on ground-based observations.
d89affec-b731-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Inastars Observatory Potsdam, Germany

d8a02b76-b65e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Civico Osservatorio Astronomico di Rozzano is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Rozzano, Milan, Italy. It serves as a facility for astronomical observations and research within Europe.
d8a02b76-b65e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Civico Osservatorio Astronomico di Rozzano, Italy

d8a3b926-baf5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **AGO P1**: The **AGO P1 Ground Observatory** is a ground-based scientific facility located at an altitude of 2813 meters on Earth's surface, specifically situated at coordinates -83.86 latitude and 129.61 longitude. It includes a magnetometer instrument as part of the ICESTAR observatory network.
d8a3b926-baf5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at AGO P1 Observatory, Antarctica

d8a55d6a-b75a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "EMN fluxgate magnetometer at POH" is a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer installed in Pohnpei, FSM, part of the Equatorial Magnetometer Network (IUGONET), used for measuring magnetic fields.
d8a55d6a-b75a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Pohnpei Observatory

d8b0dcc4-b775-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **New Year Island Observatory**: A historical ground-based magnetic observatory located on New Year Island, Argentina, operational from 1902 to 1917, contributing to early geomagnetic research.
d8b0dcc4-b775-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at New Year Island Observatory, Argentina

d8b91ef2-b7fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A Magnetometer, specifically a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer, is part of the MAGDAS observation network installed at Manado, Indonesia. This instrument measures magnetic field variations and is associated with the IUGONET observatory.
d8b91ef2-b7fc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

d8be74bc-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Los Angeles Magnetometer was an instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field at the IAGA-identified station LOS in Los Angeles from 1882 to 1889.
d8be74bc-b9e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Los Angeles Observatory

d8c26fb8-b7cd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Tiruchirapalli Geomagnetic Observatory (TIP) is a ground-based facility in Tamil Nadu, India, dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity since 1975. It operates under the IAGA and contributes data to the WDC Kyoto with instruments like magnetometers.
d8c26fb8-b7cd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tiruchirapalli Geomagnetic Observatory, India

d8c2a630-b65c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Darwin Ionosonde** is an instrument station near Darwin, NT, Australia, used for investigating the ionosphere through radio wave propagation. It has operated various models of ionosondes since 1982, with the current model being the IPS 5D, which conducts vertical sounding sweeps from approximately 1.0 to 21.5 MHz.
d8c2a630-b65c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radarinvestigation Darwin Ionosonde

d8c59ca4-b72a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Institute of Astronomy of Kharkiv National University, also known as the Kharkiv Astronomical Observatory, is a ground-based astronomical observatory in Ukraine that was established in 1808 and has been conducting astronomical research since then.
d8c59ca4-b72a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Kharkiv Astronomical Observatory, Ukraine

d8eac590-b745-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Nagycenk observatory since 1961, part of the IUGONET-Observatory network, used for measuring and monitoring the Earth's magnetic field.
d8eac590-b745-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Nagycenk Observatory

d8fc7d30-b85d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Pioneer Venus**: A NASA space mission comprising two main components—the Orbiter and the Multiprobe—launched in 1978 to study Venus. The Orbiter mapped the planet's surface and studied its atmosphere until 1992, while the Multiprobe consisted of one large and three smaller probes that collected data during their descent through Venus’s atmosphere.
d8fc7d30-b85d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Pioneer Venus Mission

d9069a34-b643-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Tromso UHF** is an incoherent scatter radar located in Tromsø, Norway, featuring a steerable antenna with a 32-meter diameter. It is part of the EISCAT (European Incoherent Scatter Scientific Association) facility and is used for atmospheric research.
d9069a34-b643-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar part of European Incoherent Scatter Scientific Association, Norway

d9090e3e-b5f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Fluxgate Magnetometer** on ISEE 2 was a tri-axial instrument designed to study magnetic fields and magnetohydrodynamic waves within and around the Earth's magnetosphere. It featured three ring-core sensors in an orthogonal configuration, with two operating ranges (+/- 8192 nT and +/- 256 nT) and a maximum resolution of up to +/- 1/4 nT.
d9090e3e-b5f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer on International Sun-Earth Explorer 2

d90ca248-b914-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Southern Astrophysical Research (SOAR) telescope** is a 4.1-meter aperture optical and near-infrared telescope located on Cerro Pachón in Chile, operated by an international consortium since its commissioning in 2003. It is used for astrophysical research and is part of the Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO).
d90ca248-b914-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 4.1m Southern Astrophysical Research Telescope at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory, Chile

d90ce886-b6a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences (NAOC) 1.2m Altazimuth Telescope is located at the Yunnan Astronomical Observatory in Asia and operates in the optical waveband.
d90ce886-b6a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.2m National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences (NAOC) Altazimuth Telescope at Yunnan Astronomical Observatory

d9177ea8-ba62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "ISIS2 Positions" refers to the dataset containing the spatial coordinates of the ISIS2 spacecraft in different reference frames.
d9177ea8-ba62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ISIS2 Positions part of International Sun Earth Explorer 2

d91cfd36-b861-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Great Shefford Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Great Shefford, West Berkshire, England. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
d91cfd36-b861-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Great Shefford Observatory, United Kingdom

d91dff82-b8ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ISEE atmospheric aerosol observation's Particle Detector, specifically the photoacoustic spectrometer located at Wakayama within the IUGONET observatory, is an instrument designed to measure absorption and scattering coefficients of atmospheric aerosols.
d91dff82-b8ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Particle Detector part of International Space Environment Explorer Mission

d91f2dee-b77c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
THEMIS (Time History of Events and Macroscale Interactions during Substorms) is a space mission comprising five identically-instrumented spacecraft designed to study the dynamics of substorms in Earth's magnetotail, particularly focusing on how solar wind energy is released and its impact on auroras.
d91f2dee-b77c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.6m Bernard Lyot Telescope at Midi-Pyrénées Observatory, France

d920cf6c-b986-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Spacewatch Mosaic Camera** is an advanced imaging system used by the University of Arizona's Lunar and Planetary Laboratory for wide-field surveys to detect and track small solar system bodies, including near-Earth objects (NEOs), asteroids, and comets.
d920cf6c-b986-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.9m Spacewatch Mosaic Camera at Kitt Peak Observatory

d9333100-bb95-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ROCG Observatory (MPC ID: Y16) is an astronomical observatory located in Campos dos Goytacazes, Brazil. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical observations and research.
d9333100-bb95-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Campos dos Goytacazes Observatory, Brazil

d9349534-b787-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Thule Air Base in Greenland, operational since July 1, 2013, as part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG to measure geomagnetic field variations.
d9349534-b787-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Thule Air Base Observatory, Antarctica

d934cd9e-b6db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Institute of Astronomy of Nicolaus Copernicus University in Torun's 90cm Schmidt-Cassegrain Telescope, also known as the TSC, is a optical telescope located in Europe with an aperture of 0.9 meters.
d934cd9e-b6db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.9m optical Schmidt-Cassegrain Telescope

d94e2ab0-b5e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Orbiter Mission (MOM), also known as Mangalyaan, is an Indian space probe launched in 2013 to study Mars' surface features, morphology, mineralogy, and atmosphere from orbit. It made India the first Asian nation to reach Martian orbit and operated until April 2022.
d94e2ab0-b5e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label:
Mars Color Camera on Mars Orbiter Mission
Thermal Imaging Spectrometer on Mars Orbiter Mission
Lyman Alpha Photometer on Mars Orbiter Mission
Mars Exospheric Neutral Composition Analyzer on Mars Orbiter Mission
Methane Sensor for Mars on Mars Orbiter Mission

d954630a-ba34-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Blue Canyon Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Placer County, California. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to the study of celestial objects and phenomena.
d954630a-ba34-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Blue Canyon Observatory, United States

d957fdc8-ba4b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Prodromos Observatory is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Prodromos, Limassol District, Cyprus. It operates under the SNX-NET and is situated at coordinates 34.93209 N, 32.84019 E on the Asian continent.
d957fdc8-ba4b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Telescope at Prodromos Observatory, Cyprus

d95a8d56-ba58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Los Cerrillos Fluxgate Magnetometer is an instrument located at the Los Cerrillos geomagnetic observatory, designed to measure variations in the Earth's magnetic field as part of the SAMBA Magnetometer Array.
d95a8d56-ba58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at Los Cerrillos Observatory

d965e4d0-ba3f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer at TWV** is a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer installed in Townsville, Australia, as part of the MAGDAS observation network. This instrument measures magnetic field variations and contributes to geomagnetic studies under the IUGONET observatory framework.
d965e4d0-ba3f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

d967d3a0-b76d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **JCPM Yakiimo Station** is an astronomical observatory located in Shimizu, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. It is known for its contributions to astronomy and operates as a ground-based observatory.
d967d3a0-b76d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Yakiimo Observatory, Japan

d9753a2e-b847-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Neutral Atmosphere Temperature Experiment (NATE) on Aeros-A was an instrument designed to measure atmospheric temperature and, in an alternate mode, function as a neutral mass spectrometer to detect densities of argon, atomic oxygen, nitrogen, and helium.
d9753a2e-b847-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutral Atmosphere Temperature Experiment part of Aeros-A

d9799ee2-b5f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The Davis Ground Magnetic Field Instrument, operational since January 1979, is a specific type of magnetometer located at the Davis observatory, contributing to global geomagnetic monitoring efforts as part of the IUGONET network.
d9799ee2-b5f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Davis Observatory

d9898020-b819-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ironwood Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Haleiwa, Honolulu County, Hawaii, on the North American continent. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
d9898020-b819-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ironwood Observatory, United States

d991ce0a-b9ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NICT Ionosonde at Wakkanai is a Type 10C Ionosonde located in Wakkanai, Japan, operated by the National Institute of Information and Communications Technology for regular ionospheric investigations.
d991ce0a-b9ff-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Type 10C Ionosonde at Wakkanai Observatory

d992207e-b8bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Casasco Observatory (also known as Osservatorio di Casasco) is an astronomical observatory located in Casasco, Alessandria, Piedmont, Italy. It is identified by the Minor Planet Center with the code B66 and operates as a ground-based facility for celestial observations.
d992207e-b8bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Casasco Observatory, Italy

d993a0de-b9de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Chelford Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Chelford, Cheshire East, England, dedicated to ground-based observations.
d993a0de-b9de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Chelford Observatory, United Kingdom

d9997828-b656-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Supernova Integral Field Spectrograph (SNIFS) is a visible wavelength spectrometer permanently installed at the University of Hawaii 2.2m telescope on Mauna Kea.
d9997828-b656-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Visible Supernova Integral Field Spectrograph on 2.2m Telescope at Mauna Kea Observatory

d9a83166-bba5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The National Institute for Astrophysics (INAF) 32m Radio Telescope is a 32-meter aperture radio telescope located at the Medicina Radio Observatory in Europe, used for astrophysical research.
d9a83166-bba5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 32.0m National Institute for Astrophysics Radio Telescope at Medicina Radio Observatory

d9af3f64-bb0b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Le Crès Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Le Crès, Montpellier, France. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to the observation of celestial bodies and phenomena.
d9af3f64-bb0b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Le Crès Observatory, France

d9bd093c-b9e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hallett Cove Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Hallett Cove, South Australia. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
d9bd093c-b9e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hallett Cove Observatory, Australia

d9dc343a-b7f8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Solar Orbiter**: A space mission by the European Space Agency (ESA), launched in 2020 to study the Sun and heliosphere from a highly elliptical orbit, equipped with in-situ and remote-sensing instruments to observe solar wind, magnetic fields, and solar transients.
d9dc343a-b7f8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray Spectrometer/Telescope on Solar Orbiter

d9dd732e-b788-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Venus Express Visible and Infrared Thermal Imaging Spectrometer (VIRTIS) is a hyperspectral imager on the Venus Express spacecraft that captures light dispersed onto a detector array through a scanning mirror and refraction grating, producing data structured in cubes with one spectral dimension and two spatial dimensions.
d9dd732e-b788-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Visible and Infrared Thermal Imaging Spectrometer on Venus Express

d9e5dea2-b791-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) All-Sky Imager is a multi-wavelength instrument located near Norilsk, Russia, designed to study the upper atmosphere's dynamics by observing nocturnal airglow emissions. It was developed at Nagoya University’s Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research and operates as part of the broader OMTI network.
d9e5dea2-b791-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Multi-wavelength Imager part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers at ISEE Observatory

d9f0da64-bbb0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Van Allen Probes, formerly known as the Radiation Belt Storm Probes (RBSP), are a pair of robotic spacecraft launched by NASA to study the Van Allen radiation belts around Earth, focusing on understanding their environment and variability for practical applications in space missions.
d9f0da64-bbb0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Van Allen Probes part of Living With a Star

d9f13434-bc30-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The BARREL (Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses) Balloon 2O Engineering Data Interface is a component of the BARREL observatory that converts analog signals, such as temperatures, voltages, and currents, into digital data with high precision. It includes multiple input channels that can be configured to monitor various types of measurements.
d9f13434-bc30-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform for Relativistic Electron Losses part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

d9f174d6-b8bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Fair Oaks Ranch Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Fair Oaks Ranch, Texas, United States. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
d9f174d6-b8bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fair Oaks Ranch Observatory, United States

d9fe445c-b6b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Putman Mountain Observatory, designated by the code V60 and MPC ID V60, is an astronomical observatory located in Loyal Valley, Texas, United States. It operates as a ground-based facility situated on Earth.
d9fe445c-b6b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Putman Mountain Observatory, United States

da01a8da-b76e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Europa Thermal Emission Imaging System (E-THEMIS):** A thermal imager designed to detect warmer regions on Jupiter's moon Europa by using infrared light, aiming to identify areas where liquid water may be near or have erupted onto the surface.
da01a8da-b76e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: infrared Europa Thermal Emission Imaging System on Europa Clipper

da174714-ba6e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Giordano Bruno Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Brallo di Pregola, Italy. It is identified by the Minor Planet Center code L86 and operates as a ground-based facility.
da174714-ba6e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Giordano Bruno Observatory, Italy

da1fe280-b793-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Explorer 50, also known as IMP-8, was a NASA research satellite launched in 1973 to study the magnetosphere and interplanetary space. It collected data on cosmic rays, solar particles, plasma, and electric and magnetic fields until its decommissioning in 2006.
da1fe280-b793-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Interplanetary Monitoring Platform part of Explorer Program

da1ff86a-b75c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the IRIDIUM 1_70 satellite, which is part of the IRIDIUM satellite constellation and operates as a space facility near Earth's surface.
da1ff86a-b75c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: IRIDIUM 1 70 part of IRIDIUM Satellite Constellation

da36077e-bb8d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Adak Geomagnetic Observatory (ADA)** was a ground-based facility in Adak, Alaska, that operated from 1964 to 1966 to monitor geomagnetic activity.
da36077e-bb8d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Adak Geomagnetic Observatory, United States

da3666d6-bae0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gnevsdorf Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Gnevsdorf, Buchberg, Germany. It operates as a ground-based observatory dedicated to studying celestial phenomena.
da3666d6-bae0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gnevsdorf Observatory, Germany

da381cc4-baea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Explorer 41, also known as IMP 5 (Interplanetary Monitoring Platform), was a NASA spacecraft launched in 1969 to study energetic particles, magnetic fields, and plasma in the region of space near Earth and the Moon. It operated successfully until 1972, providing nearly continuous data except for a brief period.
da381cc4-baea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Explorer 41 part of Interplanetary Monitoring Platform

da43429c-b7da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Spacecraft Potential Control, Ion Beam Emitter (RON)** is an instrument on the Interball Auroral Probe designed to neutralize and stabilize the positive floating potential of a sunlit spacecraft in near-Earth space by emitting adjustable currents of singly charged indium or N2 ions.
da43429c-b7da-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spacecraft Potential Control, Ion Beam Emitter part of Interball Auroral Probe

da4593aa-bbed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Framing Camera 1 (FC1) is a multispectral CCD imager used on the NASA Dawn mission to capture images of asteroids 4 Vesta and 1 Ceres. It was one of two identical units mounted on the spacecraft, equipped with filters ranging from 438-965 nm for detailed observations.
da4593aa-bbed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Framing Camera part of Dawn

da467414-b639-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The LONEOS (Lowell Observatory Near-Earth Object Search) telescope is a 0.6m Schmidt telescope located at the Lowell Observatory on Anderson Mesa in Arizona, designed for optical observations of near-Earth objects.
da467414-b639-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.6m Schmidt Telescope at Lowell Observatory, United States

da4a4aba-ba28-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Solliès-Pont Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Solliès-Pont, France, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial bodies.
da4a4aba-ba28-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solliès-Pont Observatory, France

da54c728-b98e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Isaac Newton Group (ING) 1m Jacobus Kapteyn Telescope (JKT), located at the Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos in Africa, is an optical telescope with a 1.0-meter aperture used for astronomical observations.
da54c728-b98e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 1.0m Jacobus Kapteyn Telescope at Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos

da68db3c-bb50-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Stockport Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Stockport, South Australia. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
da68db3c-bb50-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stockport Observatory, Australia

da79cccc-b64f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Wien-Auhof, operational from 1929 to 1950 as part of the IAGA investigation.
da79cccc-b64f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet Observatory

da7ac5fc-b8f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EFW (Electric Field and Waves) instrument on Cluster 3 is a scientific device designed to measure electric fields and waves in space using four orthogonal spherical sensors deployed from cable booms. It provides high-quality data on electric field vectors, plasma density fluctuations, and other related phenomena for research purposes.
da7ac5fc-b8f0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electric Field and Waves part of Cluster 3

da7bd7f2-b6b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Starry Knight Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Coto de Caza, California, United States. It is a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical observations and research.
da7bd7f2-b6b2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Starry Knight Observatory, United States

da7cf414-bae2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Jeffreys South Pole Observatory (JSPO) is a space observatory located in the heliosphere near Earth, equipped with instruments for scientific research.
da7cf414-bae2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Jeffreys South Pole Observatory, Antarctica

da8464ce-b9ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Tunde-M (TNM) Energetic Particle Analyzer on Vega 1 was an instrument designed to measure the energy and flux of cometary ions accelerated by magnetic fields, utilizing two telescopes with silicon detectors for data collection.
da8464ce-b9ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tunde-M Energetic Particle Analyzer on Vega 1

da88a63a-b9a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Wickede Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Dortmund, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
da88a63a-b9a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dortmund Observatory, Germany

da960e66-b8dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Forcarei Astronomical Observatory** is an astronomical facility located in the municipality of Forcarei, Spain. It was established in 2009 and is situated within an oak forest at an altitude of 670 meters.
da960e66-b8dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Forcarei Astronomical Observatory, Spain

da99ca80-b7fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Kiyose and Mizuho Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Higashikurume, Tokyo, Japan. It is a ground-based facility with the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code 409.
da99ca80-b7fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mizuho Observatory, Japan

daa02b30-bbd4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solar X-ray Sensor (XRS) on GOES 15 is an x-ray telescope designed to observe and measure solar x-ray emissions in specific ranges, providing real-time data for alerts and warnings of geophysical responses that can disrupt radio communications and GPS signals. It also estimates parameters such as rise-time and temperature of solar flares to predict energetic proton events.
daa02b30-bbd4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar X-ray Sensor on GOES 15

daa54ae4-bb60-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located in Cebu (CCP), operational from 1961 to 1963, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the IAGA investigation.
daa54ae4-bb60-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy

daa63ee4-bcb0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The ROASTERR-1 Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Cluj-Napoca, Romania, dedicated to ground-based astronomical observations.
daa63ee4-bcb0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 3.7m Telescope at ROASTERR-1 Observatory, Romania

daa77378-b97b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **DeKalb Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in St. Joe, DeKalb County, Indiana, United States. It is situated at coordinates 41.311195° N, 274.9276° W and operates as a ground-based facility.
daa77378-b97b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: DeKalb Observatory, United States

daacfe18-b969-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The European Space Agency (ESA) X-ray Observatory satellite, also known as EXOSAT (originally named HELOS), was a spacecraft designed to observe celestial objects in the X-ray waveband.
daacfe18-b969-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray European Space Agency X-ray Observatory satellite

daadaae4-bbb6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Parker Solar Probe (PSP) Spacecraft Ephemeris is an instrument aboard the Parker Solar Probe spacecraft that provides precise positional data for the probe. It was launched on August 12, 2018, and is part of NASA's Living With a Star program.
daadaae4-bbb6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris part of Parker Solar Probe

dab1ce06-b75d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: NAOC-Zhongwei Observatory (LW-2) is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Shapotou District, Ningxia, China. It is operated by the National Astronomical Observatories of China (NAOC).
dab1ce06-b75d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: LW-2 Telescope at Zhongwei Observatory, China

dad2b39a-b687-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Observatory of Atmospheric Environment in Fukue Island is a ground-based facility located in Goto, Nagasaki Prefecture, Japan, dedicated to monitoring and studying atmospheric conditions. It includes specialized instruments such as a NO2 laser-induced fluorescence detector for detailed environmental analysis.
dad2b39a-b687-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Laser Induced Fluorescence Detector at Observatory of Atmospheric Environment in Fukue Island, Japan

dad9ba92-b6c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Capri Geomagnetic Observatory (CPI), located in Anacapri, Naples, Italy, is a ground-based facility that has been monitoring geomagnetic activity since 1957. It operates as part of the IUGONET and WDC Kyoto network, focusing on magnetometer data collection.
dad9ba92-b6c2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Capri Geomagnetic Observatory, Italy

dadad914-b9c8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The RISH All Sky Camera at Kototabang is an imaging instrument located in Indonesia that continuously captures color images of the entire sky every minute, using a Prede PSV-100 model camera.
dadad914-b9c8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Imager on RISH All Sky Camera at IUGONET Observatory, Indonesia

dadfaabe-bafb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Okayama Astrophysical Observatory (OAO) is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Asakuchi, Oda County, Okayama Prefecture, Japan. It houses the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan's 1.88m telescope and conducts various astrophysical research activities.
dadfaabe-bafb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.88m Telescope at Okayama Astrophysical Observatory, Japan

dae105d6-b938-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Oiso station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Manazuru, Japan (latitude 35.18° N, longitude 139.17° E), part of the global MAGDAS network monitoring Earth's magnetic field.
dae105d6-b938-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Oiso Observatory, Japan

daeed88a-b73c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Nitsanim Geomagnetic Observatory (NSM):** A ground-based facility in Israel that operated from 1963 to 1967, focusing on geomagnetic measurements.
daeed88a-b73c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Nitsanim Geomagnetic Observatory, Israel

daf3e990-b93c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The RAS Observatory in Officer is an astronomical observatory located at Muddy Gates Lane, Clyde, Tooradin, Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical observations and research.
daf3e990-b93c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: RAS Observatory, Australia

dafd3842-b996-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
Palomar Observatory is an astronomical research facility located in the Palomar Mountains of San Diego County, California, owned and operated by Caltech.
dafd3842-b996-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Palomar Observatory

db16c974-bbb2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nancay Decameter Array (NDA) JunoN is a spectral power receiver, part of the SMWG Observatory in SRN-NRT, used for radio astronomy observations. It began operations on June 26, 2016.
db16c974-bbb2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Nancay Decameter Array on Juno

db1765c8-b5ef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Colville National Forest Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based research facility located in Bead Lake Trail, Pend Oreille County, Washington. It operates a magnetometer and has been active since January 1, 2007.
db1765c8-b5ef-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Colville National Forest Geophysical Observatory, United States

db179956-b934-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NICT Ionosonde at Kokubunji is a Type 10C Ionosonde operated by the National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT) in Japan, used for regular radar investigations.
db179956-b934-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar Type 10C Ionosonde at Kokubunji Observatory

db1aceda-ba5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The SMART/T3 H-alpha Solar Partial-region Filtergraph at Hida Observatory is an imaging instrument designed to study the chromosphere of the Sun, utilizing a Lyot filter for detailed observations.
db1aceda-ba5d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: SMART/T3 H-alpha Solar Partial-region Filtergraph with Lyot-filter at Kwasan and Hida Observatory

db1b3b36-ba17-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, and the Lethbridge Magnetometer specifically operates within the THEMIS Mission GMAGs framework at the Lethbridge Geophysical Observatory.
db1b3b36-ba17-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Lethbridge Observatory

db21ea46-b7d6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Dun Echt Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Aberdeenshire, Scotland.
db21ea46-b7d6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dun Echt Observatory, United Kingdom

db31b07c-b6e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Yamakawa Station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Ibusuki, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. It is part of the CPMN network and operates to measure magnetic fields for geophysical research.
db31b07c-b6e4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at CPMN Yamakawa Station, Japan

db3da90a-b8a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mercury Magnetometer (MPO-MAG) on the BepiColombo Mercury Planetary Orbiter is an instrument designed to measure magnetic fields around Mercury using two identical sensors mounted on a deployable boom. It aims to distinguish between internal and external magnetic field contributions by collecting comprehensive data across various surface areas.
db3da90a-b8a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of BepiColombo

db3ebf1a-bb58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "MAVEN: Mars crustal magnetic field analytical models" is a scientific dataset and analysis tool used to study the magnetic fields of Mars, particularly focusing on the planet's crust. It is part of the MAVEN mission and accessible through the CDPP-AMDA observatory at CNES.
db3ebf1a-bb58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN part of CNES Observatory

db546b38-b7bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Explorer 35 was a spin-stabilized spacecraft launched by NASA in 1967 to study interplanetary plasma, magnetic fields, energetic particles, and solar X-rays from lunar orbit. It operated successfully for six years before being turned off in 1973.
db546b38-b7bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: NASA's Explorer 35 Spacecraft

db584604-b79a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lunar Atmosphere and Dust Environment Explorer (LADEE) was a NASA mission designed to study the composition and variability of the lunar atmosphere and investigate the presence of dust in the Moon's exosphere. Launched in September 2013, LADEE orbited the Moon for about seven months before intentionally crashing into its surface in April 2014.
db584604-b79a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lunar Atmosphere and Dust Environment Explorer part of Lunar Quest

db6209ce-b749-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Kevo Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG since 2017, used to measure magnetic field variations.
db6209ce-b749-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kevo Geophysical Observatory

db6ce448-b72b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mawson Ionosonde is an instrument located in Mawson, Antarctica, used to study the ionosphere by transmitting radio waves and measuring their reflection. It has been operational since 1958 with various upgrades, currently using a CADI system for vertical sounding.
db6ce448-b72b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionosonde at Mawson Observatory, Antarctica

db6e5cce-bac3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **210MM Onagawa Station** is a magnetic observatory located in Onagawa, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. It operates as part of the 210 Magnetic Meridian (210MM) magnetometer network and includes a fluxgate instrument for measuring magnetic fields.
db6e5cce-bac3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Onagawa Station, Japan

db706dfe-b878-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Science Laboratory (MSL) Curiosity Rover Navigation Camera Right String B is a high-resolution stereo camera positioned on the rover's mast, used to assist in autonomous navigation and capture detailed 3D images of Martian terrain.
db706dfe-b878-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Navigation Camera on Mars Science Laboratory Curiosity Rover

db752c2e-b862-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Royal Astronomical Society of Canada 1.88m Telescope at David Dunlap Observatory (DDO) is a large optical telescope located in North America, used for astronomical observations and research.
db752c2e-b862-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 1.88m Royal Astronomical Society of Canada Telescope at David Dunlap Observatory

db7abeee-b7a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Dolomites Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Madonna di Campiglio, Italy, known for its ground-based telescopes and facilities.
db7abeee-b7a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dolomites Observatory, Italy

db80d57c-bb70-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity "DSS-24" refers to a ground observatory with the code 399024. It is part of the Deep Space Network, specifically designated as a 24-meter antenna used for space communications and tracking.
db80d57c-bb70-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: DSS-24 Observatory

db8e7990-bb23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Florence and George Wise Observatory is an astronomical research facility that includes the Tel Aviv University 1m Telescope, located in Israel.
db8e7990-bb23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1m Telescope at Florence and George Wise Observatory

db935bd0-ba2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Beijing Ming Tombs Magnetic Observatory is a ground-based facility in China that monitors magnetic field variations and geophysical data.
db935bd0-ba2f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Beijing Ming Tombs Observatory, China

db9aebce-baf3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The BARREL Balloon 1H Engineering Data Interface (EDI) is a component of the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) mission, responsible for converting analog signals to digital data. It monitors key temperatures, voltages, and currents with high precision, featuring multiple inputs for versatile measurements.
db9aebce-baf3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Engineering Data Interface part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

dbb40978-b8b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Charged Particle Instrument on Pioneer 10 was designed to measure the composition and energy spectra of charged particles using four detector systems. It provided detailed data on protons, electrons, and other nuclei in space, with its measurements synchronized with the spacecraft's spin for directional analysis.
dbb40978-b8b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Charged Particle Composition on Pioneer 10

dbb58888-b695-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Altamira Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Fasnia, Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain. It operates as a ground-based observatory for celestial observations and research.
dbb58888-b695-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Altamira Observatory, Spain

dbc44afe-b68f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A broad-beam riometer located in Aedey, Iceland, used for conducting conjugate observations as part of the IUGONET observatory network. This instrument is designed to measure cosmic radio noise absorption to study ionospheric disturbances and solar activity impacts on Earth's atmosphere.
dbc44afe-b68f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer part of Conjugate Observation at Iceland

dbcfb596-b9b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Space Technology 5 (ST5) mission was a NASA project consisting of three microsatellites launched in 2006 to test innovative technologies and gather data on Earth's auroral currents and crustal magnetic field. The satellites were equipped with advanced magnetometers and operated for a 90-day period, providing unique multi-point measurements at low altitudes.
dbcfb596-b9b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Miniature Magnetometers on Space Technology 5

dbd8c2b8-b833-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lake Clear Observatory is an astronomical facility located in the Town of Harrietstown, Franklin County, New York. It is situated at 639 Forest Home Road and serves as a ground-based observatory for astronomical research and observations.
dbd8c2b8-b833-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lake Clear Observatory, United States

dbdce10c-b619-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Prince George Magnetometer is an instrument located at the Prince George (PGEO) Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation, used to measure magnetic fields. It has been operational since January 1, 2005.
dbdce10c-b619-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of THEMIS Mission

dbec30fc-b854-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lunar Trailblazer (LT) Spacecraft Lunar Thermal Mapper (LTM) is a multispectral infrared imager designed to map temperature, physical properties, and composition on the Moon with a spatial resolution of 25 m/pixel over an 11 km width. It features four broadband thermal channels (6-100 μm) and eleven compositional channels (7-10 μm), utilizing a five-mirror telescope and uncooled microbolometer detector array.
dbec30fc-b854-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Lunar Thermal Mapper on Lunar Trailblazer Spacecraft

dbeded96-b8ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover Helicopter Imaging Suite (Helicam) was a set of cameras and instruments used to capture images of the Ingenuity helicopter during its flights on Mars for scientific evaluation and performance assessment. It was part of the experimental mission to test powered flight in the Martian atmosphere.
dbeded96-b8ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Helicopter Imaging Suite part of Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover

dbf05458-bab5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mid-continent Magnetoseismic Chain (McMAC) Glyndon Station is a ground-based observatory located in Glyndon, Minnesota, USA. It operates as one of the nine magnetometers within the McMAC network to monitor geomagnetic activity.
dbf05458-bab5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Mid-continent Magnetoseismic Chain Glyndon Station, United States

dbf2f498-b8ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mark III Spectrograph is a pair of low-resolution grism spectrographs used on the McGraw-Hill and Hiltner telescopes at MDM Observatory, equipped with different CCD configurations for astronomical observations.
dbf2f498-b8ca-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Low-resolution grism spectrograph on 2.4 m Hiltner Telescope at MDM Observatory, United States and Low-resolution grism spectrograph on 1.3m McGraw-Hill Telescope at MDM Observatory

dbfca500-b871-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetometers at Nagpur (NGP) are instruments used to measure the Earth's magnetic field at the ground station in Nagpur. They have been operational since January 1, 1991, and are part of the IUGONET observatory network associated with WDC Kyoto.
dbfca500-b871-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet Observatory

dc00d3e6-b9c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Volatiles Investigating Polar Exploration Rover (VIPER) was a NASA lunar rover designed to search for water ice and other volatiles in the Moon's south polar region. The mission aimed to study the distribution of lunar resources and demonstrate technologies for future human exploration, but it was cancelled in 2024.
dc00d3e6-b9c5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Volatiles Investigating Polar Exploration Rover part of NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services

dc06b168-b690-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Arecibo's 305-meter radio telescope was a significant instrument at the Arecibo Observatory in Puerto Rico, operational from 1963 to 2020. It featured a fixed spherical reflecting antenna used for radio astronomy and radar studies of the solar system, including Earth's upper atmosphere, until its collapse due to structural failures.
dc06b168-b690-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 305m National Astronomy and Ionosphere Center Radio Telescope at Arecibo Observatory, United States

dc0e45ae-badc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The GNU radio beacon receiver (GRBR) station at Shionomisaki is an observatory in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan, dedicated to measuring ionospheric disturbances related to middle-upper atmospheric coupling processes.
dc0e45ae-badc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: GNU Radio Beacon Receiver Station at Shionomisaki, Japan

dc17a912-b746-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The New Alesund Geomagnetic Observatory (NAL) is a ground-based facility located in Ny-Ålesund, Svalbard, Norway, established in 1966 to monitor geomagnetic activity on Earth's surface.
dc17a912-b746-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at New Alesund Geomagnetic Observatory, Norway

dc1b8846-bbdf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: ASPERA-4 is an instrument suite onboard the Venus Express mission, designed to study the interaction between the solar wind and Martian atmosphere by analyzing plasma and neutral gas environments using components like a Neutral Particle Imager (NPI) and Neutral Particle Detector (NPD).
dc1b8846-bbdf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Neutral Atom Imager part of Analysis of Space Plasmas and Energetic Atoms, version 4

dc202bd2-b746-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Barter Island Geomagnetic Observatory (BTI) is a ground-based facility in Alaska, U.S.A., that operated from 1957 to 1959, focused on geomagnetic measurements as part of the World Data Center for Geomagnetism in Kyoto.
dc202bd2-b746-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Barter Island Geomagnetic Observatory

dc21869c-b991-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Puckett Observatory is a private astronomical observatory in Georgia, USA, dedicated to studying comets and discovering supernovae.
dc21869c-b991-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Puckett Observatory

dc2a0250-b7bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Viking Orbiter 2 Spacecraft Visual Imaging Subsystem (VIS) - Camera A is a high-resolution television framing camera used on the Viking Orbiter 2 to aid in landing site selection, observe and map Mars' geologic features, and investigate its atmosphere.
dc2a0250-b7bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Visual Imaging Subsystem - Camera A on Viking Orbiter 2

dc2b5350-b803-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DSS-13 34-m Goldstone Solar System Radar receiver is a cryogenically-cooled, low-noise amplifier designed to receive X-band radio signals at 8560 MHz or 3.5 cm wavelength. It is part of the Deep Space Network's Goldstone complex and is used for solar system radar observations.
dc2b5350-b803-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-band Goldstone Solar System Radar Receiver on Deep Space Station 13

dc3976c6-ba2c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apache Point Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in the Sacramento Mountains in Sunspot, New Mexico, United States. It is operated by New Mexico State University and owned by the Astrophysical Research Consortium (ARC).
dc3976c6-ba2c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Apache Point Observatory, United States

dc3d4988-b92b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Energetic Electrons and Protons (EEP) instrument** on the IMP-8 satellite was designed to study solar cosmic ray propagation, electron and proton fluxes in the geomagnetic tail and magnetosphere entry, using a three-element telescope with solid-state detectors and a magnet for particle measurements.
dc3d4988-b92b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Protons and Electrons on IMP-J

dc50271c-ba37-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Atmospheric Density Accelerometer (MESA) on AE-C is an instrument that measures the neutral density of Earth's atmosphere between 120 to 400 km altitude by detecting satellite deceleration due to aerodynamic drag. It consists of three mutually perpendicular accelerometers and provides data on atmospheric density, spacecraft attitude, and orbital adjustments.
dc50271c-ba37-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Miniature Electrostatic Analyzer part of Atmospheric Density Accelerometer on AE-C

dc635e2c-ba19-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The San Benedetto Po Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Stradello Gorgo, San Benedetto Po, Mantua, Italy. It is a ground-based facility with the Minor Planet Center (MPC) code 434.
dc635e2c-ba19-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: San Benedetto Po Observatory, Italy

dc664d9a-b612-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Piszkés-tető Station, often referred to as the Konkoly Observatory, is an astronomical observatory located at Piszkés-tető in Mátraszentimre, Hungary. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical research and observations.
dc664d9a-b612-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Piszkesteto Station at Konkoly Observatory, Hungary

dc67479a-b8dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lucy Radio Science Investigation is an instrument aboard the Lucy spacecraft that utilizes its X-band telecommunication system to measure Doppler shifts before and after flybys, allowing for the determination of velocity changes imparted by Trojan asteroids.
dc67479a-b8dd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Science Investigation on Lucy spacecraft

dc69439c-ba9f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Potential Control Device (PCD) on Equator-S is an instrument designed to reduce spacecraft potentials to a few volts, allowing for accurate plasma particle measurements at very low energies. It emits beams of 6 keV indium ions to compensate for positive charging and can adjust beam currents automatically based on real-time electron energy spectrum data from the 3DA instrument.
dc69439c-ba9f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Potential Control Device on Equator-S

dc69935a-b9a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Entity Definition:**
The STP P78-2, also known as SCATHA (Spacecraft Charging At High Altitudes), was a spacecraft launched in 1979 to study environmental and engineering aspects of satellite surface charging in near-synchronous orbit. Its mission included collecting scientific data on plasma-wave interactions and substorm studies.
dc69935a-b9a6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spacecraft Charging At High Altitudes

dc722d54-b9dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** "ThemisE different magnetospheric analytical models" refers to a collection of scientific models used to analyze and interpret data related to Earth's magnetosphere, specifically within the context of the THEMIS mission. These models are part of the CDPP-AMDA observatory managed by CNES.
dc722d54-b9dc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Different Magnetospheric Analytical Models part of THEMIS

dc7f2da8-b5d4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN magnetometer network in Cañete, Peru, is a ground-based facility located in the Province of Cañete, Lima, dedicated to measuring magnetic fields. It includes instruments such as fluxgate magnetometers and is situated at coordinates -13.06 latitude and -76.38 longitude.
dc7f2da8-b5d4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at CPMN Canete Station, Peru

dc8850cc-b5ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Karlsruhe Observatory, located in Karlsruhe, Germany, is a public observatory established on May 11, 1959, dedicated to ground-based astronomical observations.
dc8850cc-b5ed-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Karlsruhe Observatory, Germany

dc8d9900-b698-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition**:
BARREL Balloon 4E was a specific payload within the BARREL (Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses) mission, launched on August 24, 2016, and ending on August 25, 2016. It operated in the Earth's stratosphere to study relativistic electron losses from the radiation belts by measuring Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced during these events.
dc8d9900-b698-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for Radiation-belt Relativistic Electron Losses part of Living with a Star Geospace Mission of Opportunity

dc9875fa-bab2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Jeonbuk Science High School Observatory** is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Iksan, South Korea. It serves as an educational facility associated with Jeonbuk Science High School.
dc9875fa-bab2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Jeonbuk Science High School Observatory, Korea, Republic of
