f293a956-b8e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Malibert Observatory (code: A08) is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Babeau-Bouldoux, France, dedicated to celestial observations and research.
f293a956-b8e1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Malibert Observatory, France

f29a2854-b8fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatory of Atmospheric Environment in Hongo Campus is a ground-based facility at The University of Tokyo, dedicated to monitoring and studying the atmospheric environment. It includes an ozone monitor and is located at 5-chome, Hongo, Bunkyō, Tokyo, Japan.
f29a2854-b8fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ozone Monitor at Observatory of Atmospheric Environment in Hongo Campus of The University of Tokyo, Japan

f29da046-b7ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity "Scoresby Sund" refers to a ground-based observatory located in Sermersooq, North America (Greenland), which operated from 1892 to 1933 and included magnetometer instruments.
f29da046-b7ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Scoresby Sund Observatory, Greenland

f2aa63a0-baba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Dominion Observatory was an astronomical observatory in Ottawa, Ontario that operated from 1902 to 1970 and served as a Canadian Federal Government institution for precise coordinates and timekeeping.
f2aa63a0-baba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dominion Observatory, Canada

f2ace3a4-ba1b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Interball Project, launched in 1996, is a multinational space mission involving four spacecraft designed to study the transmission of solar wind energy to Earth's magnetosphere and its subsequent effects on the auroral regions.
f2ace3a4-ba1b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Interball-2 part of CNES Observatory CDPP Archive Interball Auroral

f2b78bda-b780-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gakona (GAKO) Station is a ground-based observatory located in Gakona, Alaska, operated as part of the NASA THEMIS Ground Based Observatories (GBO), primarily for magnetic and space weather studies.
f2b78bda-b780-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Themis Ground Based Observatory UCLA Instrument at Gakona Station, United States

f2c4aeea-bb14-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Nagpur Geomagnetic Observatory (NGP) is a ground-based facility located in Hingna, Nagpur, India, dedicated to geomagnetic measurements. It has been operational since January 1995 and is part of the IAGA observatories network.
f2c4aeea-bb14-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Nagpur Geomagnetic Observatory, India

f2cc4a50-b6c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The University of South Carolina Geomagnetic Observatory was a ground facility in Aiken, South Carolina, that operated from January 20 to February 12, 2001, to study geomagnetic data.
f2cc4a50-b6c4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Aiken Observatory, United States

f2ccefe4-b91e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The IMPACT Magnetometer on STEREO A is a tri-axial flux gate instrument designed to measure magnetic fields in interplanetary space. It features a compact, low-power design with automatic range switching for optimal sensitivity.
f2ccefe4-b91e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of In-Situ Measurements of Particles and CME Transients on STEREO A

f2d0b6f0-b857-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Electron-Proton-Angle Spectrometer (EPAS) on the CRRES satellite was an instrument designed to measure electrons in the energy range of 16-300 keV and protons in the range of 20-3300 keV, utilizing a magnetic field for particle deflection and focusing, along with solid-state detectors for energy analysis.
f2d0b6f0-b857-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Instrument on Combined Release and Radiation Effects Satellite part of Chemical Release and Radiation Effects Satellite

f2d94910-b7cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hawk's Nest Radio Astronomy Observatory is a ground-based facility in China that participates in the RadioJOVE project, focusing on observing radio emissions from Jupiter, the Sun, and the Galactic Background.
f2d94910-b7cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hawk's Nest Radio Astronomy Observatory, China

f2e76f54-b720-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Riometer station at Athabasca, Canada (ATH) is a ground facility developed by the Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research (ISEE), Nagoya University, to study upper atmosphere dynamics through nocturnal airglow emissions.
f2e76f54-b720-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Riometer at Athabasca Observatory, Canada

f2e8e42a-b909-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Equator-S Positions" refers to the dataset containing the spatial coordinates of the Equator-S spacecraft, providing its location across different reference frames.
f2e8e42a-b909-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Positions on Equator-S

f2f28922-b962-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The LPMR Observatory in Broad Chalke is a ground-based observatory located at Knighton Road, Broad Chalke, Wiltshire, England. It operates within the United Kingdom and focuses on astronomical observations from its coordinates at latitude 51.02595 and longitude -1.86748 (or 358.06548 in positive degrees).
f2f28922-b962-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: LPMR Observatory at Broad Chalke, United Kingdom

f2f93e50-b702-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Bagnall Beach Observatory is a privately owned astronomical observatory in Corlette, New South Wales, Australia, known for discovering three minor planets.
f2f93e50-b702-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bagnall Beach Observatory, Australia

f30ad4a8-b9a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: Cedar Glen Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Lake Arrowhead, California, dedicated to ground-based observations.
f30ad4a8-b9a0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cedar Glen Observatory, United States

f310db14-b81f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Zuben Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Alhaurín de la Torre, Málaga, Spain. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomy and astrophysics research.
f310db14-b81f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Zuben Observatory, Spain

f3182b90-b73d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** REASON is a multi-frequency, ice-penetrating radar system designed for the Europa Clipper mission to explore Jupiter's moon Europa. It aims to measure the thickness and structure of Europa’s icy shell and search for evidence of a subsurface ocean and surface plumes.
f3182b90-b73d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radar for Europa Assessment and Sounding: Ocean to Near-surface part of Europa Clipper

f3197622-ba7f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Magnetic Ion-Mass Spectrometer (MIMS)** on AE-D is an instrument designed to measure in situ the concentrations of ambient positive ion species within a mass range from 1 to 90 atomic mass units, mounted on a satellite for atmospheric studies.
f3197622-ba7f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetic Ion-Mass Spectrometer on AE-D

f31ee8d8-ba56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Viking Orbiter 1**: A component of the Viking mission, Viking Orbiter 1 was a spacecraft that orbited Mars and carried scientific instruments for imaging, atmospheric water detection, and thermal mapping.
f31ee8d8-ba56-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Viking Orbiter 1 part of Viking Mission

f32c99a4-b8b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Chuhuiv Observational Station is an astronomical observatory near Ivanovka, Kharkiv Oblast, Ukraine, founded in the early 1960s and operated by the Institute of Astronomy of Kharkiv National University. It was severely damaged during the Russian occupation in 2022.
f32c99a4-b8b9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Chuhuiv Observational Station at Kharkiv National University Observatory, Ukraine

f336e242-baad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ESO La Silla 1-m photometric Cassegrain reflector is a 1.04-meter telescope located at the European Southern Observatory in Chile, operational since 1966.
f336e242-baad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.04m Telescope at European Southern Observatory La Silla, Chile

f3434bde-bbcc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The magnetometer at the La Quiaca ground station is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of Earth's magnetic field, operational since 1920 as part of the IAGA investigation within the IUGONET-Observatory network.
f3434bde-bbcc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at La Quiaca Observatory

f34c0f78-bb75-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Piconcillo Observatory (G05) is an astronomical observatory located in Sierra Morena, Fuente Obejuna, Córdoba, Andalusia, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
f34c0f78-bb75-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Piconcillo Observatory, Spain

f34ca14c-b7e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity is a 3-axis ring-core type fluxgate magnetometer named "CPMN," installed in Eusebio, Brazil, which is part of the IUGONET observatory and designed to measure magnetic fields.
f34ca14c-b7e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Circum-Pan Pacific Magnetometer Network Investigation

f352a3b4-b7e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Pueblo (PBLO) Geophysical Observatory was a ground-based facility located in Pueblo, Colorado, operating from May 13, 2009, to May 5, 2012. It included magnetometers and was part of the THEMIS ground observatory network.
f352a3b4-b7e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Pueblo Geophysical Observatory, United States

f359100c-b674-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The RKI-2 instrument on Interball Tail Probe measures hard ionizing radiation at specific energy levels (5, 15, 40, 100, and 500 MeV) and solar ultraviolet (UV) radiation.
f359100c-b674-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Hard ionizing radiation and solar UV radiation RKI-2 on Interball Tail Probe

f3668308-b689-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer station located on Beliy Island, operational from 1973 to 1984, used for geomagnetic field measurements as part of the IAGA investigation.
f3668308-b689-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of International Real-time Magnetic Observatory Network

f3681f0a-b694-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DMSP/F15 SEM Special Sensor Ionospheric Plasma Drift/Scintillation Monitor-2 (SEM/SSI/ES-2) is a scintillation detector onboard the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program F15 satellite, launched in 1999, which measures electron and ion densities, temperatures, plasma drift, and scintillation at orbital altitudes.
f3681f0a-b694-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Special Sensor Ionospheric Plasma Drift and Scintillation Monitor-2 part of Defense Meteorological Satellite Program

f369f254-b995-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Plasma Spectrometer (PLS) on Voyager 2**, also known as the Plasma Science Experiment for VG2, is an instrument featuring Faraday-cup detectors used to study solar wind properties and interactions with planetary magnetospheres and interstellar space. It measures plasma ion velocity, density, and pressure, along with electron energy ranges from 5 eV to 1 keV.
f369f254-b995-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Faraday Cup on Plasma Spectrometer part of Voyager 2

f36bc8c2-b9b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The JCPM Sapporo Station is an astronomical observatory located in Takino, Minami Ward, Sapporo, Japan. It is a ground-based facility focused on astronomical observations and research.
f36bc8c2-b9b3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: JCPM Sapporo Observatory, Japan

f3726fac-b7a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Wilkes Geomagnetic Observatory (WIL) was a ground-based facility in Australia that operated from July 1957 to January 31, 1966, focusing on geomagnetic measurements.
f3726fac-b7a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Wilkes Geomagnetic Observatory, Antarctica

f376f486-b78d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Tokyo-Dodaira Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Tokigawa, Hiki County, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It operates as a ground-based observatory and is part of the University of Tokyo's Institute of Astronomy.
f376f486-b78d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dodaira Observatory, Japan

f3771ac8-b8ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Sormano 2 Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located at Glamping Bellagio in Bellagio Via Lattea, Italy. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
f3771ac8-b8ce-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sormano 2 Observatory, Italy

f3808df8-ba8e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Novaastro Observatory in Banon is a ground-based astronomical observatory located at Route de Manosque in Dauban, France. It serves as a facility for stargazing and celestial observations within the region of Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur.
f3808df8-ba8e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Novaastro Observatory, Banon, France

f38417be-b74d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Hot Springs (HOTS) Geophysical Observatory Magnetometer is an instrument used in the THEMIS Mission, starting from September 9, 2004, to measure magnetic field variations at the observatory site.
f38417be-b74d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Hot Springs Observatory

f38578e0-ba7a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **CEAMIG-REA Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to astronomical research and observations.
f38578e0-ba7a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: CEAMIG-REA Observatory, Brazil

f3893430-b827-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **CPMN fluxgate magnetometer** is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument used for measuring magnetic fields, specifically installed as part of the CPMN observation network in Piura, Peru. It operates within the IUGONET observatory and provides crucial data for geomagnetic studies.
f3893430-b827-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IUGONET Observatory, Peru

f3904ac2-b8bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The "Cluster 1 Ephemeris" is a dataset that provides the positions of the Cluster 1 spacecraft in various coordinate systems, part of the CDPP Archive maintained by CNES.
f3904ac2-b8bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform on Cluster 1 spacecraft

f397a744-b6d4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Los Cabezones Observatory (Q115633447) is an astronomical observatory located in Villa Santillán, Santa Rosa, La Pampa, Argentina. It operates as a ground-based facility for celestial observations.
f397a744-b6d4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Los Cabezones Observatory, Argentina

f3b75412-bb1c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Savelli Observatory, also known as the K96 astronomical observatory, is a ground-based facility located in Pino Grande, Savelli, Crotone, Calabria, Italy. It is situated at coordinates 39.314406° N, 16.75119° E and operates under the Minor Planet Center ID K96.
f3b75412-bb1c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Savelli Observatory, Italy

f3c5cad0-b967-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Altrincham Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Hale, Altrincham, Greater Manchester, United Kingdom. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
f3c5cad0-b967-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Altrincham Observatory

f3cea2bc-b81e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Sonoita Research Observatory (MPC code G93) is an astronomical facility located in Sonoita, Arizona, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial objects.
f3cea2bc-b81e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sonoita Research Observatory

f3d66396-b7f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Gauteng Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Randpark Ridge, Johannesburg, South Africa. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
f3d66396-b7f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gauteng Observatory, South Africa

f3d80e96-bb2b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kaktovik Magnetometer is an instrument located at the Kaktovik Geophysical Observatory in Alaska, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG. It has been operational since January 1, 2007, and measures variations in the Earth's magnetic field to support geophysical research.
f3d80e96-bb2b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kaktovik Observatory

f3d93e50-b7ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: King George Island is a ground facility located on Earth's surface, part of the IAGA Observatory network, equipped with a magnetometer and situated at coordinates -62.221 latitude and 301.247 longitude.
f3d93e50-b7ad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at King George Island Observatory

f3dabc8a-b636-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Suprathermal Ion Telescope (SIT) on STEREO B is a Time-of-Flight Ion Mass Spectrometer designed to measure the elemental composition of He-Fe ions in the energy range of 30 keV/n to 2000 keV/n, focusing on energetic particles produced by solar and interplanetary events.
f3dabc8a-b636-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Suprathermal Ion Telescope on STEREO B

f3ef162a-b5b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS fluxgate magnetometer at LAQ is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument located in L'Aquila, Italy, used for measuring magnetic field variations as part of the MAGDAS observation network.
f3ef162a-b5b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Magnetic Data Acquisition System observation network

f3f2fffc-b8e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Key.West Magnetometer is an instrument used for measuring magnetic fields at the IAGA station identified as KWT, operational from 1860 to 1866 and part of the SMWG Observatory.
f3f2fffc-b8e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Key West Observatory

f3fb768e-b6bb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields, particularly Earth's magnetic field. The specific device referenced here is located at the station with the IAGA identifier CPA and has been operational since 1955 as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
f3fb768e-b6bb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Iugonet Observatory

f408dee4-b668-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Capodimonte is a ground-based observatory in Naples, Italy, that operated from 1882 to 1922 and was equipped with magnetometers for geophysical measurements.
f408dee4-b668-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Capodimonte Observatory, Italy

f41b9c74-b92d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Brno Observatory and Planetarium** is an astronomical observatory located in Brno, Czechia. It features facilities for both observation and public education in astronomy.
f41b9c74-b92d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Brno Observatory, Czechia

f41ca284-b196-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Igloolik (IGLO) Geophysical Observatory Magnetometer" is part of the THEMIS Mission and operates at the Igloolik Ground Observatory in Canada. It is a magnetometer instrument used for geophysical observations, starting operations on October 9, 2008.
f41ca284-b196-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Igloolik Observatory, Antarctica

f41dffd0-b722-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** WHISPER (Waves of HIgh frequency and Sounder for Probing of the Electron density by Relaxation) is an instrument onboard the Cluster-1 spacecraft designed to measure electron density via active sounding of plasma resonances and record natural wave emissions in the high-frequency range from 4–80 KHz.
f41dffd0-b722-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waves of High Frequency and Sounder for Probing Electron Density by Relaxation part of Cluster-1

f420d368-ba3d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is a scientific instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The magnetometers at Gelania (GEL) are part of the IUGONET observatory network and are utilized for geomagnetic research and monitoring as per IAGA standards.
f420d368-ba3d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at Gelania

f4361342-b5db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer, specifically a fluxgate type, used in the SAMBA Magnetometer Array at the Osorno geomagnetic observatory.
f4361342-b5db-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer part of SAMBA Magnetometer Array

f445a202-b753-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **AMPTE CCE Plasma Wave Experiment (PWE)** was an instrument on the Active Magnetospheric Particle Tracer Explorers - Charge Composition Explorer (AMPTE-CCE) mission. It consisted of a balanced electric dipole designed to measure plasma waves at specific frequencies, with an effective length of 70 cm.
f445a202-b753-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Plasma Wave Experiment on Active Magnetospheric Particle Tracer Explorers Charge Composition Explorer, part of AMPTE Mission

f453df2a-bad2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to a specific astronomical instrument used at the Siding Spring Observatory. It is identified as a LORAL 4K CCD with white light capabilities and a scroll shutter, labeled SI_600-263 or ValueSet(SI_600-263).
f453df2a-bad2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 4k CCD Camera on Uppsala 0.5m Telescope at Siding Spring Observatory

f4543ff6-ba0f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The NASA Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer (RXTE) was a satellite mission designed to observe and study the temporal variability of astronomical X-ray sources. It provided valuable data on objects like black holes, neutron stars, and X-ray binaries from 1995 until its decommission in 2012.
f4543ff6-ba0f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray NASA Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer Satellite Mission

f4567196-bb35-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Equatorial Magnetometer Network's (EMN) fluxgate magnetometer at Huancayo, Peru is a 3-axis ring-core type instrument designed to measure magnetic field variations in the equatorial region.
f4567196-bb35-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of The Equatorial Magnetometer Network

f45970f8-b6f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Cobram Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Cobram, Victoria, Australia, dedicated to ground-based observations of celestial bodies.
f45970f8-b6f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cobram Observatory, Australia

f45a8630-b8a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity represents the Deep Space Station 64 (DSS-64), a ground-based observatory used for space communication and tracking, often referred to as DSS-64.
f45a8630-b8a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: DSS-64

f45ca0be-b92a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Manado station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Winangun I, Manado, North Sulawesi, Indonesia, part of the broader MAGDAS magnetometer network. It operates at coordinates 1.44 latitude and 124.84 longitude on Earth's surface.
f45ca0be-b92a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at MAGDAS Manado Observatory, Indonesia

f4613184-b771-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1S X-ray Instrument (XRI)** is a scintillation detector used in the BARREL project to measure the energy spectrum and flux of Bremsstrahlung X-rays produced by precipitating electrons. It utilizes a NaI crystal, photomultiplier tube, and peak detect board to convert X-ray energy into charge pulses for spectral analysis.
f4613184-b771-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Scintillation Detector part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

f4692616-bbcf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Zonalunar Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Puçol, Valencia, Spain, dedicated to ground-based observations. It is known for its contributions to lunar and other celestial studies.
f4692616-bbcf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Zonalunar Observatory at Puzol, Spain

f4695a84-b66e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Borok station with the IAGA identifier BOX, part of the IUGONET observatory network.
f4695a84-b66e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Borok Observatory

f46caad4-bb0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at Johnson Point (JOP), part of the IUGONET Observatory in Kyoto, used for magnetic field measurements and associated with the IAGA code.
f46caad4-bb0c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at Johnson Point

f46e9500-b63a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lisbon Astronomical Observatory is an astronomical research facility located in Tapada da Ajuda, Lisbon, known for its historical contributions to positional astronomy and current affiliation with the University of Lisbon.
f46e9500-b63a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatório Astronómico de Lisboa, Portugal

f47324ee-b6e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAGDAS Crib Point station is a ground-based facility in the MAGDAS magnetometer network, located at Cook Road, HMAS Cerberus, Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. It operates as part of the IUGONET infrastructure and includes a fluxgate instrument for magnetic field measurements.
f47324ee-b6e9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Crib Point Observatory, Australia

f473462c-bb58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The TIROSN observatory is a space facility located on Earth's near surface, designed for astronomical observations.
f473462c-bb58-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: TIROSN Observatory

f4771ba4-b8fa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Radio Occultation Experiment for V16 is an instrument that analyzes variations in radio waves to study atmospheric density, pressure, and temperature profiles of planetary atmospheres.
f4771ba4-b8fa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Occultation Experiment for V16 on New Horizons

f48194e6-b71d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Argelander Institute for Astronomy Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Bonn, Germany. It is a ground-based facility used for various astronomical observations and research.
f48194e6-b71d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Argelander Institute for Astronomy Observatory, Germany

f4850902-b73e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Cosmic Ray System on Pioneer 11**: An instrument designed to measure high-energy particles from various astrophysical sources, contributing to the study of cosmic radiation in the outer solar system.
f4850902-b73e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cosmic Ray System on Pioneer 11

f4aac7ac-ba11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Iwaki Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Iwaki, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. It is a ground-based facility used for observing celestial objects and phenomena from Earth.
f4aac7ac-ba11-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Iwaki Observatory, Japan

f4b6a622-b93e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Imaging Riometer Observation at Gakona is a 60MHz Riometer located in Gakona, Alaska, USA. It features an 8x8-element dipole antenna array that produces independent beams covering approximately 180km x 180km at D region altitude to study upper atmosphere dynamics through nocturnal airglow emissions.
f4b6a622-b93e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 60MHz Imaging Riometer at Gakona Observatory

f4b9af48-bbbe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Ephemeris: Cassini" is a dataset that includes the regular and special ephemerides of the Cassini spacecraft, calculated using SPICE kernels and specialized tools from IRAP and the University of Iowa.
f4b9af48-bbbe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ephemeris part of Cassini Spacecraft

f4bda404-b6eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The US Air Force 3.5m Starfire Optical Range (SOR) Telescope is a large optical telescope with an aperture of 3.5 meters, located at Kirkland Air Force Base in North America. It is used for various astronomical and defense-related observations.
f4bda404-b6eb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 3.5m US Air Force Starfire Optical Range Telescope at Kirkland Airforce Base

f4c4bcc2-b6d6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the ground-based observatory located at 29, Via della Sibilla in San Giovanni Galermo, Catania, Italy. It is identified by the label "Catania" and is situated at coordinates 37.54879° N, 15.0557° E on the European continent.
f4c4bcc2-b6d6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Catania Observatory, Italy

f4c5fe68-b69d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mars Exploration Rover Spirit Miniature Thermal Emission Spectrometer (Mini-TES) was an instrument on the Spirit rover that measured mineralogy and thermophysical properties of Martian surfaces by analyzing infrared radiation, aiding in understanding Mars' geology and past water activity.
f4c5fe68-b69d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Infrared Mars Exploration Rover Spirit Miniature Thermal Emission Spectrometer on Spirit Rover

f4d3a0ce-b961-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EMN Maroua Station is a ground-based magnetometer network facility located in Moda, Moutourwa, Mayo-Kani, Far-North, Cameroon. It operates under the ICSWSE observatory and contributes to magnetic field measurements in Africa.
f4d3a0ce-b961-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Maroua Observatory, Cameroon

f4d7ba90-b6b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Entity Definition:**
The Magellan spacecraft was a NASA mission launched in 1989 to map the surface of Venus using Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR). It provided detailed radar images and gravity data, significantly enhancing our understanding of Venus' geological structure.
f4d7ba90-b6b1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 6.5m Walter Baade and Landon T. Clay Telescopes at Las Campanas Observatory, Chile

f4e0502c-b956-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Kiso Observatory is an astronomical observatory located at Mt. Ontake in Japan, known for its 105 cm Schmidt Telescope and its focus on studying extra-galactic objects. It was founded in 1974 as a branch of the Tokyo Astronomical Observatory and is currently maintained by the Institute of Astronomy at the University of Tokyo.
f4e0502c-b956-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.05m Schmidt Telescope at Kiso Observatory, Japan

f4e0d6fa-b7df-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Orcades del Sur Geomagnetic Observatory (ORC), located in Argentina, is a ground-based facility dedicated to monitoring geomagnetic activity on Earth.
f4e0d6fa-b7df-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Orcades del Sur Geomagnetic Observatory

f4ee9de4-bafa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Heartland Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Carmel, Indiana, United States. It is a ground-based facility used for stargazing and scientific research.
f4ee9de4-bafa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Heartland Observatory

f5067ede-b67f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Repulse Bay (RBAY) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility located in the Kivalliq Region of Nunavut, Canada, established in 2008 for geophysical observations.
f5067ede-b67f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Repulse Bay Geophysical Observatory, Canada

f5112644-b766-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Light Italian CubeSat for Imaging of Asteroids (LICIACube) mission is an initiative by the Agenzia Spaziale Italiana to observe and document the impact and aftermath of the DART spacecraft's collision with the asteroid Dimorphos.
f5112644-b766-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Light Italian CubeSat for Imaging of Asteroids part of Double Asteroid Redirection Test

f513026c-b738-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Low-Energy Electrons (LEE) experiment on the AE-D satellite used an Electrostatic Analyser to directly measure energy input into the upper atmosphere from electrons and protons within the range of 0.2 to 25 keV, providing differential measurements of energy influx and angular distribution through its detectors.
f513026c-b738-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Low Energy Electron Experiment on Atmosphere Explorer D

f5130ac0-b9f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lyman-Alpha Mapping Project (LAMP) is a far ultraviolet spectrograph on the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) spacecraft, designed to map the lunar surface using Lyman-alpha skyglow and UV starlight.
f5130ac0-b9f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lyman-Alpha Mapping Project on Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter

f51381ea-b6f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The 2.15m Jorge Sahade Telescope is an optical telescope located at the El Leoncito Astronomical Complex (CASLEO) in South America, used for astronomical observations.
f51381ea-b6f9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: optical 2.15m Jorge Sahade Telescope at El Leoncito Astronomical Complex

f514ff16-b870-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Nagycenk station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Nagycenk, Hungary, part of the CPMN magnetometer network. It is situated at coordinates 47.63 latitude and 16.72 longitude within Western Transdanubia, Hungary.
f514ff16-b870-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at CPMN Nagycenk Station, Hungary

f51c0cc8-b836-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Donna (DON) Geophysical Observatory, located in Dønna, Nordland, Norway, is a ground-based facility that includes instruments such as the DONNA magnetometer for geophysical research.
f51c0cc8-b836-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Donna Geophysical Observatory, Norway

f52565aa-b8e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Interstellar Boundary Explorer (IBEX)** is a NASA spacecraft launched in 2008 to study the interaction between the solar wind and interstellar medium, equipped with instruments to measure energetic neutral atoms and providing full-sky measurements every six months.
f52565aa-b8e2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spacecraft Ephemeris part of Interstellar Boundary Explorer

f531735c-b5ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Teide Observatory is an astronomical observatory located on Mount Teide in Tenerife, Spain, operated by the Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias since 1964.
f531735c-b5ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Teide Observatory, Spain

f5398202-ba7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Mount Nyūkasa Optical Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Fujimi, Nagano Prefecture, Japan, operated by the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency. It is situated at an altitude of 1816 meters and has been operational since January 1990.
f5398202-ba7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mount Nyūkasa Optical Observatory, Japan

f543856e-b5de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Aso ground station, operational from 1932 to 1965, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of IAGA investigations.
f543856e-b5de-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at Aso Observatory

f54460fe-bbc6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 2D Optical Photometer** is an instrument designed to detect visible light at wavelengths near 486.1 nm, specifically during relativistic electron precipitation events, to determine the presence of protons accompanying these electrons and support research on scattering by electromagnetic ion cyclotron waves.
f54460fe-bbc6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses 2D Optical Photometer part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses Observatory

f547aae0-b732-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Shimada Observatory (MPC code: 384) is an astronomical observatory located in Shimada, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan.
f547aae0-b732-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Shimada Observatory, Japan

f54d75be-b74c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Guitalens Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Guitalens-L'Albarède, France. It operates as a ground-based observatory dedicated to studying celestial phenomena.
f54d75be-b74c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Guitalens Observatory, France

f54db1ce-b818-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Indian Institute of Astrophysics 2.3m Vainu Bappu Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Vainu Bappu Observatory in Asia, known for its significant contributions to astronomical research.
f54db1ce-b818-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 2.3m optical Vainu Bappu Telescope at Vainu Bappu Observatory

f5500b84-b8f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The COSPIN-Anisotropy Telescope (AT) is an instrument aboard the Ulysses spacecraft designed to measure the three-dimensional distribution of charged particles in specific energy ranges, aiding studies of solar particle events and cosmic rays. It consists of two telescopes with silicon detectors arranged at different angles to the spacecraft's spin axis for comprehensive coverage.
f5500b84-b8f1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.7-23 MeV/n Anisotropy Telescopes part of Cosmic ray and Solar Particle Investigation on Ulysses

f551b20c-b907-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **BARREL Balloon 1A Engineering Data Interface** is an instrument within the Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses (BARREL) project, designed to perform analog-to-digital conversion of key temperatures, voltages, and currents with high precision.
f551b20c-b907-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Platform part of Balloon Array for RBSP Relativistic Electron Losses

f5556a0c-bb71-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Steward Observatory 0.7m (28-inch) Schmidt Telescope is part of the Catalina Sky Survey (CSS) and located at the Mount Lemmon Observing Facility in North America, specializing in optical waveband observations.
f5556a0c-bb71-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.7m Steward Observatory Schmidt Telescope part of Catalina Sky Survey and Mount Lemmon Observing Facility

f55aea00-b684-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The LANL1990 Energetic Spectrometer for Particles (ESP) is an instrument designed to measure higher-energy particles, specifically electrons and protons within specific energy ranges. It consists of a bismuth germanate crystal coupled to a thick plastic scintillator and a photomultiplier tube, operational since 1989.
f55aea00-b684-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Instrument on LANL 1990 Observatory

f55aeb54-bacb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **E1 Plasma Experiment** is an instrument suite aboard the Helios 2 spacecraft, consisting of four instruments (I1a, I1b, I2, and I3) designed to measure positive ions and electrons in the solar wind. It utilizes the spacecraft's spin to enhance azimuthal resolution and provides detailed plasma distribution data.
f55aeb54-bacb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electrostatic Analyser part of E1 Plasma Experiment

f563c094-ba12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Altona Observatory was an astronomical observatory located in Hamburg, Germany. It operated from 1823 to 1871 and was founded by Heinrich Christian Schumacher.
f563c094-ba12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Altona Observatory

f5671e7e-b82d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **DMSP_5D2-F13 Positions** dataset provides the spacecraft positions of the DMSP_5D2-F13 in various coordinate systems.
f5671e7e-b82d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Part of Defense Meteorological Satellite Program 5D-2 F13

f56ecb86-b839-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "LANL 2002 Positions" instrument provides data on the spacecraft positions for the LANL 2002 mission in various coordinate systems. It is part of the SMWG observatory and is used for ephemeris calculations.
f56ecb86-b839-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Investigation part of Los Alamos National Laboratory 2002

f573c31e-b908-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 17 Lunar Surface Gravimeter (LSG) Experiment was part of the ALSEP and aimed to measure lunar surface gravitational acceleration and detect cosmic-induced free oscillations of the Moon.
f573c31e-b908-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lunar Surface Gravimeter on Apollo 17 Lunar Surface Experiments Package

f5774cd2-bbd3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solar Occultation For Ice Experiment (SOFIE) is a spectrometer on the AIM spacecraft that performs solar occultation measurements to retrieve vertical profiles of temperature, gases like O3 and H2O, and Polar Mesospheric Clouds extinction at various wavelengths.
f5774cd2-bbd3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Solar Occultation for Ice Experiment on Aeronomy of Ice in the Mesosphere

f57eb260-b688-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The University of Arizona/Smithsonian Institution 6.5m MMT Telescope is an optical telescope located at the Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory in North America, with a primary mirror diameter of 6.5 meters.
f57eb260-b688-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 6.5m Multiple Mirror Telescope at Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory

f5807338-bb02-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The specific instance mentioned here refers to the magnetometers located in Mogadishu (MOG), part of the IAGA investigation at the WDC Kyoto observatory, starting from January 1933.
f5807338-bb02-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Mogadiscio Observatory

f58172f4-b979-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Energetic Ion Composition Spectrometer (EICS)** on the Dynamics Explorer 1 (DE-1) spacecraft is a high-sensitivity, high-resolution instrument designed to measure the composition and energy of ions in Earth's magnetosphere and ionosphere. It covers a mass range from less than 1 amu/e to over 150 amu/e across 64 mass channels and 32 energy per charge steps, up to approximately 17 keV/e, to study auroral acceleration, ring current loss processes, and ion tracing.
f58172f4-b979-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Ion Composition Spectrometer on Dynamics Explorer 1

f58d3150-b6ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The Magnetometers at Lovozero (LOZ), part of the IAGA investigation since 1957, are situated within the iugonet-observatory and contribute data to the WDC Kyoto.
f58d3150-b6ec-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Lovozero Observatory

f5a01a92-bb4f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer onboard Solar Orbiter that measures magnetic fields continuously, providing key insights into both large-scale structures and small-scale plasma processes in the heliosphere.
f5a01a92-bb4f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Solar Orbiter

f5a0dfe6-bb12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ISEE Magnetometer is an induction magnetometer located in Gakona, Alaska, designed to measure variations in the 3-D vector geomagnetic field with a sampling rate of 64 Hz. It is part of the IUGONET observatory and provides high-frequency data controlled by a PC clock signal.
f5a0dfe6-bb12-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Induction Magnetometer part of International Space Environment Explorer Magnetometer Investigation

f5a43de8-baaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The Jovian Auroral Distributions Experiment (JADE) on Juno is an instrument suite designed to measure electrons and ions in the Jovian magnetosphere, helping understand the plasma processes that drive auroras on Jupiter. It includes three electron sensors, one ion sensor, and a control and processing unit called EBox.
f5a43de8-baaf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Particle Instrument on Juno part of Jovian Auroral Distributions Experiment

f5a7082e-bbd2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CLPS Task Order 2-AB PITMS is an Ion-Trap Mass Spectrometer designed to characterize the lunar exosphere and measure volatiles on the Moon's surface, with heritage from the Rosetta mission, operated by NASA and ESA.
f5a7082e-bbd2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ion-Trap Mass Spectrometer for Lunar Surface Volatiles on Peregrine Lunar Lander

f5b3d832-babb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTI) Spectral Airglow Temperature Imager at Shigaraki, Japan, is an instrument that measures the temperature of the mesopause region by observing specific atmospheric emissions every 4 minutes. It operated from December 1997 to 2012 as part of the Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers (OMTIs) network developed by Nagoya University.
f5b3d832-babb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Spectral Airglow Temperature Imager part of Optical Mesosphere Thermosphere Imagers at Shigaraki Observatory

f5c06bd4-b5bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity refers to the Donnersberg Observatory, a ground-based facility located in Milešov u Lovosic, Czechia (formerly part of Germany), which operated between January 1, 1933, and December 31, 1934. It was equipped with magnetometers for geomagnetic measurements as part of the IAGA network.
f5c06bd4-b5bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Donnersberg Observatory, Czechia

f5c732f8-ba32-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at Campbell Island station with the IAGA identifier CAI, used for geomagnetic measurements.
f5c732f8-ba32-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Campbell Island Observatory

f5de4fe8-ba45-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Interplanetary Magnetic Field (IMF) Experiment was a magnetometer on the Sakigake spacecraft designed to study magnetic fields and waves in the helio-magnetosphere and cometary environments, particularly during the encounter with comet 1P/Halley.
f5de4fe8-ba45-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Interplanetary Magnetic Field Experiment on Sakigake

f5e0644a-bb85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Mount Lemmon Observatory (MLO)**, also known as the Mount Lemmon Infrared Observatory, is an astronomical observatory located on Mount Lemmon in the Santa Catalina Mountains approximately 28 kilometers northeast of Tucson, Arizona. It is managed by the University of Arizona's Steward Observatory and contains multiple independently operated telescopes within the Coronado National Forest.
f5e0644a-bb85-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mount Lemmon Observatory, United States

f5ee1000-baa8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: GOES 1 (SMS-C) was a NASA-developed and NOAA-operated geosynchronous spacecraft designed for meteorological observations and data collection. It carried instruments such as the Visible Infrared Spin Scan Radiometer (VISSR), a meteorological data collection system, and a Space Environment Monitor (SEM) to measure various environmental parameters.
f5ee1000-baa8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Visible Infrared Spin-Scan Radiometer on Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 1

f5f6b232-b6f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Vanimostation**: A ground-based observatory located in Vanimo, Papua New Guinea, operational since July 1964, primarily monitoring ionospheric scintillations.
f5f6b232-b6f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionospheric Scintillation Monitor at Vanimo, Papua New Guinea

f609dd8c-b75e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Sutherland-LCO A is an astronomical observatory located in Sutherland, South Africa. It operates as a ground-based observatory and is part of the broader Sutherland Observatory complex.
f609dd8c-b75e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Sutherland Observatory, South Africa

f60aafdc-b96b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Wide Band Data (WBD)** investigation on the Cluster 2 spacecraft is an instrument designed to capture high-resolution frequency/time spectra of plasma waves in Earth's magnetosphere by measuring electric and magnetic fields within a range of 25 Hz to 577 KHz. It operates as part of the Wave Experiments Consortium (WEC) and supports very-long-baseline-interferometer measurements using signals from multiple Cluster spacecraft.
f60aafdc-b96b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Waveform Receiver part of Cluster 2/FM5 (Rumba)

f60ba474-bba4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 15 Command and Service Module Orbital Mass Spectrometer (OMS) Experiment was an instrument on board the Command and Service Module that analyzed the composition of gases in the lunar atmosphere during its orbit around the moon.
f60ba474-bba4-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Orbital Mass Spectrometer on Apollo 15 Command and Service Module

f61e87d0-b97c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Kangerlussuaq (STF) Geophysical Observatory is a ground-based facility in Kangerlussuaq, Greenland, part of the IUGONET observatory network, and equipped with a magnetometer for geophysical measurements. It has been operational since January 1, 2007.
f61e87d0-b97c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Kangerlussuaq Geophysical Observatory, Greenland

f61f066a-b9ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The "ST5-094 Positions" is a dataset containing the spatial coordinates of the ST5-094 spacecraft in different reference frames, providing essential information for tracking and analyzing its trajectory.
f61f066a-b9ae-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: ST5-094 Positions part of Observatory

f62d0d7e-b83b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Apollo 16 Panoramic Camera is a high-resolution camera designed to capture detailed panoramic photographs of the lunar surface from orbit, providing both stereoscopic and monoscopic images. It was part of the Scientific Instrument Module (SIM) on the Command Service Module (CSM) during the Apollo 16 mission.
f62d0d7e-b83b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Panoramic Camera on Apollo 16 Command and Service Module

f62dd1b4-bb29-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Magnetometer at Siple Station (identified by the IAGA code SPL) is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields and is part of the IUGONET observatory network, specifically associated with WDC Kyoto and Siple.
f62dd1b4-bb29-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers part of International Monitor for Auroral Geomagnetic Effects Observatory on IUGONET WDC Kyoto and WDC SP

f638a854-b760-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the IAGA station on Palmyra Island, operational from January 1957 to December 1958.
f638a854-b760-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Palmyra Island Observatory

f63b85e6-b734-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Soil Moisture Active and Passive (SMAP) spacecraft is an Earth observation satellite designed to monitor soil moisture levels actively and passively.
f63b85e6-b734-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Soil Moisture Active and Passive

f6450076-b603-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Low and Energetic Charged Particle Composition and Anisotropy (SKA-2) instrument on the Interball Tail Probe measures solar wind ion fluxes and energy-angular distributions of H+ and He++ with high time resolution, providing detailed insights into charged particle behaviors around the Sun.
f6450076-b603-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Low and Energetic Charged Particle Composition and Anisotropy on Interball Tail Probe

f6529c00-b9bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The LONEOS Mosaic CCD is an astronomical imaging system designed for wide-field observations of the night sky, primarily used in the Lowell Observatory Near-Earth Object Survey (LONEOS) to detect and study near-Earth objects like asteroids and comets.
f6529c00-b9bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Lowell Observatory Near-Earth Object Survey 0m60 Telescope at Lowell Observatory

f65803ec-bacc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Discovery Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Caruaru, Pernambuco, Brazil. It is situated at Avenida Dantas Barreto and serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
f65803ec-bacc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Discovery Observatory, Brazil

f65ad6c2-b5a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Dust Particle Detector (SP-2) on Vega 2 was an acoustic instrument designed to measure the mass of dust particles within a specific range, utilizing piezo-electric elements and logarithmically distributed sensitivity channels.
f65ad6c2-b5a8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dust Particle Detector on Vega 2

f66df29a-b6aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The CONTOUR Forward Imager (CFI) was a telescope designed for ultraviolet imaging, mounted on the CONTOUR spacecraft to capture detailed images of comet nuclei and their inner comae during flybys.
f66df29a-b6aa-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet CONTOUR Forward Imager on Contour

f683adae-b652-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lunar Crater Observation and Sensing Satellite (LCROSS) Near Infrared Spectrometer 1 (NSP1), also known as the nadir NSP, was an instrument designed to capture near-infrared emission reflectance spectrometry of the vapor plume and ejecta cloud from the Centaur impact, providing data on grain properties and broad water features.
f683adae-b652-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Near Infrared Spectrometer 1 on Lunar Crater Observation and Sensing Satellite

f68e03a6-b6d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Monte Capellino (MCP):** A former ground-based observatory located in Savignone, Genoa, Italy, operational from 1958 to 1959, known for its magnetometer facility sponsored by Italy.
f68e03a6-b6d1-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Monte Capellino Observatory, Italy

f69f847e-bb44-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MDM Observatory is an optical astronomical observatory situated on Kitt Peak in Arizona, owned and operated by a consortium of universities including the University of Michigan, Dartmouth College, Ohio State University, Columbia University, and Ohio University.
f69f847e-bb44-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: MDM Observatory

f6a44e54-b83e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, particularly the Earth's magnetic field. This specific magnetometer was operational at the Peking Observatory from January 1, 1868, to December 31, 1883.
f6a44e54-b83e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Beijing Observatory

f6a661ee-b785-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **GRAIL-B (Q28472964)** was one of two spacecraft in NASA's Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory (GRAIL) mission, designed to map the lunar interior and understand the Moon's thermal evolution. It operated in tandem with GRAIL-A to perform precise gravity measurements from lunar orbit.
f6a661ee-b785-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory-B on Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory Mission

f6af4932-b954-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Bucharest Observatory is a ground-based facility located in Bucharest, Romania, specializing in geomagnetic measurements. It operates under the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) and has been functional since 1898.
f6af4932-b954-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Bucharest Observatory, Romania

f6afe156-b8f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Starlight Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Tianhuangping, Earth. It operates as a ground-based facility and is situated at the coordinates 119.59736 longitude and 30.469175 latitude in Anji County, Huzhou, Zhejiang, China.
f6afe156-b8f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Starlight Observatory, China

f6b43a3c-b79c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Rosarno Astronomical Observatory (Q115632275) is a ground-based observatory located in Rosarno, Calabria, Italy, with the MPC code L90.
f6b43a3c-b79c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: AB Observatory, Rosarno, Italy

f6b6e8ba-bc27-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Viking Orbiter Spacecraft Visual Imaging Subsystem (VIS)** was a set of high-resolution cameras on the Viking Orbiters used for selecting landing sites, mapping Mars' geology, and studying its atmosphere.
f6b6e8ba-bc27-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Visual Imaging Subsystem on Viking Orbiter 1

f6bfd8be-b99b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Inamori Magellan Areal Camera and Spectrograph (IMACS) is a versatile astronomical instrument featuring wide-field imaging and multi-object spectroscopy capabilities with two 8Kx8K CCD cameras, offering a spectral resolution range from 20 to 20,000.
f6bfd8be-b99b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 6.5m Inamori Magellan Areal Camera and Spectrograph on Baade Telescope

f6cafea6-bc07-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Fluxgate Magnetometer (FGM) on Cluster 2/FM8 (Tango)** is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields in space. It consists of two triaxial fluxgate magnetometers and an onboard data processing unit, with one sensor located at the end of a radial boom to minimize magnetic interference from the spacecraft.
f6cafea6-bc07-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer on Cluster 2

f6dcdd00-b6e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Alouette 1**: Alouette 1 was a small ionospheric observatory and Canada's first satellite, launched in 1962 to study the Earth's upper atmosphere. It carried instruments such as an ionospheric sounder, VLF receiver, energetic particle detector, and cosmic noise experiment, making it a pioneering spacecraft for ionospheric research.
f6dcdd00-b6e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ionospheric Observatory part of Alouette 1

f6e56370-bbdc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields, and the ones at Scoresbysund (SCO) are part of the WDC Kyoto observatory network, providing data on geomagnetic activity in that region.
f6e56370-bbdc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Scoresbysund Observatory

f6eabbd0-b8e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Oosato Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Kumagaya, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. It is designated as a ground-based observatory with the Minor Planet Center (MPC) ID 401.
f6eabbd0-b8e5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Oosato Observatory, Japan

f6f83ca6-b78c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ground-based Electro-Optical Deep Space Surveillance (GEODSS) is a 1.0 m telescope located at the Air Force Maui Optical and Supercomputing Site (AMOS) in Haleakala, Maui, Hawaii, used for deep space surveillance.
f6f83ca6-b78c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.0m Ground-based Electro-Optical Deep Space Surveillance Telescope at Air Force Maui Optical and Supercomputing Site, United States

f6fd234c-b95d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Space Environment Monitor-2 (SEM-2)** on NOAA 16 is an instrument designed to measure the Earth's radiation belts and charged particle precipitation in the upper atmosphere due to solar activity. It consists of two sensors, the Total Energy Detector (TED) and the Medium Energy Proton/Electron Detector (MEPED), along with a Data Processing Unit (DPU).
f6fd234c-b95d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Space Environment Monitor-2 on NOAA 16

f700597e-baf0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DMSP/S20 Special Sensor Ultraviolet Spectrographic Imager (SSUSI) is an instrument aboard the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program that observes Extreme and Far UV radiation from Earth's limb, measuring vertical profiles of electron density as well as ion and neutral densities.
f700597e-baf0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Special Sensor Ultraviolet Limb Imager part of Defense Meteorological Satellite Program

f7133f64-b6c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Observatory of the State University of Missouri is an astronomical observatory located on the campus of the University of Missouri in Columbia, Missouri. It is a ground-based facility used for astronomical observations and research.
f7133f64-b6c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: State University of Missouri Observatory, United States

f718fc3e-bc32-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Europa Clipper**: A NASA mission designed to explore Jupiter's moon Europa through multiple flybys, aimed at gathering data to determine its habitability and characterize its ice shell and subsurface ocean.
f718fc3e-bc32-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Europa Clipper part of Flagship Program

f719ba3c-b725-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Goose Bay Magnetometer is an instrument located at the Goose Bay (GBAY) Geophysical Observatory, part of the THEMIS Mission GMAG investigation. It measures magnetic field variations and has been operational since February 23, 2006.
f719ba3c-b725-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Goose Bay Observatory

f721fb9c-b9bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The THEMIS Electric Fields Instrument (EFI) is a device on the THEMIS spacecraft designed to measure the three components of the ambient vector electric field using wire and rigid booms, providing both waveform and spectral measurements across various frequency ranges.
f721fb9c-b9bf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electric Field Instrument on THEMIS spacecraft

f72b335e-b976-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Dainik Astronomical Observatory is a ground-based astronomical observatory located in Shiga Prefecture, Japan. It has been operational since August 1987 and is situated at an altitude of 220 meters.
f72b335e-b976-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dainik Astronomical Observatory, Japan

f72f4192-b5f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mercury Electron Analyzer 1 (MEA1) is an instrument onboard the Mio spacecraft of the BepiColombo mission, designed to measure the 3D distribution function of electrons in both the solar wind and Mercury's magnetosphere. It utilizes a top-hat type toroidal electrostatic analyzer to select electron energies ranging from 3 eV/q up to 26 keV/q across various operation modes.
f72f4192-b5f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mercury Electron Analyzer 1 on Mio

f7318678-bb6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Rosetta Lander Imaging System (ROLIS) was a miniature CCD imager on the Philae Lander designed to capture images of the comet surface during descent and after landing, utilizing LEDs for illumination in visible and near-infrared spectral bands.
f7318678-bb6f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rosetta Lander Imaging System Descent and Closeup Imager for the Philae on Rosetta

f739eecc-b67d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Ion Mass Spectrometer on OGO 6** was a Bennett radio frequency ion mass spectrometer aboard the Orbiting Geophysical Observatory 6 (OGO 6). It was designed to study the global distribution, temporal and spatial variations of ion composition in the upper ionosphere, particularly focusing on magnetic coordinates and earth-sun relationships.
f739eecc-b67d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Bennett Radio Frequency Ion Mass Spectrometer on Orbiting Geophysical Observatory 6

f73d9274-b692-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The French Antarctica Search for Transiting ExoPlanets (ASTEP) facility is an optical ground-based observatory located at the Concordia station in Dome C, Antarctica. It is dedicated to searching for exoplanets using the transit method.
f73d9274-b692-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: French Antarctica Search for Transiting ExoPlanets facility at The Concordia Station Observatory, Antarctica

f752962a-b70e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Halley Bay Geomagnetic Observatory (HBA)** was a ground-based facility located on Earth's surface at Halley Bay, operational from January 1957 to December 31, 1980. It included magnetometer instruments and was part of the International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy (IAGA) observatory network.
f752962a-b70e-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Halley Bay Geomagnetic Observatory

f755d638-b609-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Double Star 2 spacecraft position** refers to the precise location data of the Double Star 2 satellite, recorded with a 1-minute resolution in Geocentric Solar Ecliptic (GSE) coordinates. This information is part of the CDPP Archive managed by CNES and can be used for scientific investigations involving space weather and magnetospheric studies.
f755d638-b609-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Double Star 2 part of CNES Observatory

f757dc02-b5a1-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.definition: The entity represents the Genova C ground-based observatory facility in Italy, which operated from 1933 to 1969 and was part of the IAGA (International Association of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy) network.
f757dc02-b5a1-11f1-8724-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Genova Observatory, Italy

f75c549a-b7d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Parker Solar Probe's Radio Frequency Spectrometer (RFS) is a dual-channel digital spectrometer designed for both remote sensing of radio waves and in situ measurement of electrostatic fluctuations. It operates within two frequency ranges: the Low Frequency Receiver (LFR), spanning from 10 kHz to 2.4 MHz, primarily focuses on quasi-thermal noise spectrum measurements, while the High Frequency Range (HFR) covers 1.6 kHz to 19.2 MHz for remote sensing tasks.
f75c549a-b7d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Low Frequency Receiver part of Parker Solar Probe Mission

f763bccc-b5ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Timberland Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Flower Hill, Lawrence County, Alabama, United States. It is a ground-based facility situated at coordinates 34.671195 latitude and -87.1667 longitude.
f763bccc-b5ea-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Timberland Observatory at Decatur

f76dda90-bb7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The DSX (Demonstration and Science Experiments) satellite is a spacecraft designed to conduct research in the Earth's magnetosphere, specifically focusing on understanding and mitigating the effects of radiation in medium earth orbit (MEO), with applications for enhancing defense capabilities and improving satellite communication and navigation systems.
f76dda90-bb7b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Wave Particle Interaction Experiment on Demonstration and Science Experiments Satellite

f7728b68-ba62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Mueggelheim Observatory (A37) is an astronomical observatory located in Berlin, Germany. It is a ground-based facility used for sky observations and research.
f7728b68-ba62-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mueggelheim Observatory, Germany

f772b38c-b5e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer is an instrument used to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields. The magnetometer at Terra Nova Bay (TNB), part of the IUGONET observatory network in Kyoto, has been operational since 1987 and provides valuable data for geomagnetic research under the IAGA investigation.
f772b38c-b5e8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometers at IUGONET Observatory

f774b8b2-ba48-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Mars Polar Lander** was a 290-kilogram robotic spacecraft launched by NASA on January 3, 1999, to study the soil and climate near Mars' south pole. It lost communication during its descent phase on December 3, 1999, and is presumed to have crashed.
f774b8b2-ba48-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mars Polar Lander part of Mars Surveyor '98

f77d7d86-b94d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Aedey Geomagnetic Observatory (AED), located in Iceland and sponsored by Japan, is a ground facility dedicated to geomagnetic observations. It operates as part of the IUGONET observatory network and plays a key role in monitoring Earth's magnetic field in Europe.
f77d7d86-b94d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Aedey Geomagnetic Observatory, Iceland

f77da44e-b8a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Saltsjöbaden Observatory is an architectural ensemble and ground-based observatory located in Nacka Municipality, Sweden. It was established in 1931 and is situated at an altitude of approximately 50 meters above sea level.
f77da44e-b8a5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Saltsjöbaden Observatory, Sweden

f78546ca-b8cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Mercury Atmospheric and Surface Composition Spectrometer (MASCS) is an instrument on the MESSENGER spacecraft designed to study Mercury's exosphere and surface composition using ultraviolet, visible, and infrared spectroscopy.
f78546ca-b8cf-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mercury Atmospheric and Surface Composition Spectrometer on MESSENGER

f785edf2-b93b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nebula Knoll Observatory (code: W81) is an astronomical observatory located in East Wakefield, New Hampshire. It functions as a ground-based facility for observing celestial objects.
f785edf2-b93b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: East Wakefield Observatory

f7ab1ee0-b951-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Dark Rosanne Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Middlefield, Connecticut, focused on ground-based observations.
f7ab1ee0-b951-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dark Rosanne Observatory, United States

f7b25fce-b849-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The Karmakuly Geomagnetic Observatory (KAR), located in Novaya Zemlya, Russia, is a ground-based facility dedicated to monitoring and studying geomagnetic activities. It is equipped with instruments like magnetometers and is part of the global network of observatories contributing to geophysical research.
f7b25fce-b849-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Karmakuly Geomagnetic Observatory

f7b8c67a-b6f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **World Data Center Ground Data Master Catalog** is a network of ground observatories that collectively form the World Data Centers (WDC), dedicated to gathering and managing data related to various scientific disciplines on Earth's surface.
f7b8c67a-b6f5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: World Data Center Ground Observatories

f7c2e56e-bbf6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Suprathermal Electron Telescope (STE) on STEREO B is an instrument designed to measure electrons in the energy range of ~2 keV to 20 keV, ideal for tracing heliospheric magnetic field lines and probing interplanetary coronal mass ejections.
f7c2e56e-bbf6-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Suprathermal Electron Telescope on STEREO B part of In-Situ Measurements of Particles and CME Transients

f7c5f860-b757-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Surface Dust Analyzer (SUDA) is a time-of-flight mass spectrometer on the Europa Clipper spacecraft designed to analyze material ejected from Europa's surface and plumes, providing insights into the moon's chemistry and potential subsurface ocean.
f7c5f860-b757-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Surface Dust Analyzer on Europa Clipper

f7c670b8-b600-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Observatory of the Collegio Romano** is an astronomical observatory located in Rome, Italy. It is situated at Liceo Classico Ennio Quirino Visconti within the historic center of Rome and serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations.
f7c670b8-b600-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Observatory of the Collegio Romano, Italy

f7c7ddb4-bac8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Iso-Heikkilä Observatory is an amateur astronomical observatory located in the Iso-Heikkilä district of Turku, Finland, operated by the local amateur astronomical association, Turun Ursa ry.
f7c7ddb4-bac8-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Iso-Heikkilä Observatory, Finland

f7cc815e-bb43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The ACOS/DPM at MLSO is a former H-alpha telescope operational from 1980 to 1997, originally using film and later upgraded to a CCD detector for capturing solar disk and limb images.
f7cc815e-bb43-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: H-alpha Imager part of ACOS at Mauna Loa Solar Observatory

f7ceb548-b678-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition**: The **Vector Helium Magnetometer (VHM)** is a scientific instrument designed to measure the strength and direction of magnetic fields in space. Mounted on a 3-meter boom, it operates within a frequency range of 0-3 Hz and automatically selects from eight measurement ranges for optimal precision.
f7ceb548-b678-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Vector Helium Magnetometer part of International Cometary Explorer

f7d9faa4-b6d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Mid-Infrared Array Camera (MIRAC)** was an instrument used for infrared astronomy on the IRTF 3.0-meter and Steward Observatory 2.3-meter telescopes, equipped with a 20 X 64 pixel arsenic-doped silicon array cooled to 10 K, operating at wavelengths from 2 to 26 microns.
f7d9faa4-b6d5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mid-Infrared Array Camera on Infrared Telescope Facility

f7def888-b801-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Navigation Camera (NAVCAM) for Stardust was a multi-purpose imaging instrument used for both navigation and scientific observations, featuring a 200mm focal length and a cooled CCD detector.
f7def888-b801-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Navigation Camera on Stardust spacecraft

f7dfc46a-b9b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) Radio Science Subsystem (RSS) is a sophisticated instrument suite on the LRO spacecraft that combines communication, tracking, and timekeeping systems to enable precise geolocation for scientific investigations. It utilizes both radio Doppler tracking and laser ranging techniques for accurate data collection.
f7dfc46a-b9b0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Radio Science Subsystem on Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter

f7ee20c2-b6cd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Nancay Decameter Array (NDA) New Routine is an instrument that operates as a Spectral Power Receiver, part of the Nancay Radio Telescope. It has been in use since November 1, 2012, and is designed for specific radio astronomical observations.
f7ee20c2-b6cd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Decameter Spectral Power Receiver on Nancay Decameter Array

f7f31d18-bb08-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The AstroExplor Observatory in Tinjacá is a ground-based astronomical facility located in Ricaurte, Boyacá, Colombia. It is situated at coordinates 5.61098° N latitude and 286.36626° W longitude.
f7f31d18-bb08-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: AstroExplor Observatory, Colombia

f7f84d2a-b9fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Netherlands Institute for Space Research (NIVR) and NASA Astronomical Netherland Satellite (ANS) mission was a collaborative space project focused on conducting X-ray astronomy observations.
f7f84d2a-b9fe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: X-ray Netherlands Institute for Space Research and NASA Astronomical Netherland Satellite Mission

f7f9e514-b9bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Rosetta** is a European Space Agency (ESA) mission that launched in 2004 and successfully rendezvoused with Comet 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko in 2014, becoming the first mission to escort a comet and deploy a lander on its surface.
f7f9e514-b9bc-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Rosetta

f7fd1b66-b742-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A CPMN fluxgate magnetometer at KAG is a three-axis ring-core type instrument located in Kagoshima, Japan, used for measuring magnetic fields as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
f7fd1b66-b742-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IUGONET Observatory Network, Japan

f8013d1a-bb23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Stamford Observatory**: An astronomical observatory located in Stamford, Connecticut, USA, used for ground-based observations of celestial bodies.
f8013d1a-bb23-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Stamford Observatory, United States

f801439a-ba39-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Island Lake Geomagnetic Observatory (ISL) is a ground-based facility located in Garden Hill (Kistiganwacheeng), Canada, that operates a magnetometer to study geomagnetic activity. It has been active since 1976 and is part of the IUGONET observatory network.
f801439a-ba39-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Island Lake Geomagnetic Observatory, Canada

f801a9a2-baf2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The McMath-Pierce Main Solar Telescope is a 1.61-meter reflecting telescope located in Arizona, USA, which uses a heliostat to direct sunlight down a shaft to its primary mirror for solar observations and spectroscopy.
f801a9a2-baf2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 1.61m McMath-Pierce Main Solar Telescope at Kitt Peak National Observatory, United States

f80aa46a-b76b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Transient Gamma-Ray Spectrometer (TGRS) on the Wind spacecraft is an instrument designed to conduct high-resolution observations of transient gamma-ray events, particularly in the energy range from 20 keV to 10 MeV, focusing on solar flares and galactic center emissions.
f80aa46a-b76b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Transient Gamma Ray and EUV Spectrometer on Wind spacecraft

f824f390-b8f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Picoto Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Souto da Carpalhosa e Ortigosa, Leiria, Portugal. It operates as a ground-based facility dedicated to the observation of celestial bodies and phenomena.
f824f390-b8f3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Picoto Observatory, Portugal

f82ecb1a-b68f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Gornotayezhnaya ground observatory, used to measure and record variations in Earth's magnetic field.
f82ecb1a-b68f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Gornotayezhnaya Observatory

f840b07c-ba5f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A **Magnetometer** is an instrument used to measure magnetic fields. The **IGPP-LANL Cambridge Magnetometer** specifically refers to a fluxgate magnetometer located at the IGPP-LANL Cambridge station, which is part of the IGPP-LANL Magnetometer Array.
f840b07c-ba5f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of IGPP-LANL Magnetometer Array

f841d4f8-b89c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer installed in Ancon, Peru, used for measuring magnetic fields along three axes as part of the IUGONET observatory network.
f841d4f8-b89c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Circum-Pan Pacific Magnetometer Network

f842a7d8-bab9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The "Venus Orbiter" is a type of spacecraft designed to study and explore the planet Venus. It falls under the category defined by the namespace https://voparis-ns.obspm.fr/rdf/obsfacilities#spacecraft, with alternative labels including specific identifiers such as Value@P12 and Value@VENUS ORBITER.
f842a7d8-bab9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Venus Orbiter

f8437dd6-b918-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The High Energy Telescope (HET) on STEREO A is a particle detector designed to measure protons, helium ions, and electrons with high energies as part of the IMPACT investigation for studying solar particles and Coronal Mass Ejections (CMEs).
f8437dd6-b918-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: High Energy Telescope on Solar Terrestrial Relations Observatory A

f84cc3c8-bb93-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sonmiani Magnetometer is an instrument located at the IAGA-identified station SON, used for measuring magnetic field variations. It has been operational since January 1, 2008, and is part of the Sonmiani Observatory.
f84cc3c8-bb93-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Sonmiani Observatory

f85a8a0c-bc02-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EMN Memanbetsu Station is a ground-based observatory located in Memanbetsu, Japan, equipped with magnetometers to monitor Earth's magnetic field. It is part of the broader ICSWSE/EMN magnetometer network and situated specifically at 43.9° N latitude and 144.2° E longitude within Hokkaido Prefecture.
f85a8a0c-bc02-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Fluxgate Magnetometer at Earth Magnetic Network Memanbetsu Station, Japan

f86351d4-b787-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The CPMN Davao station is a ground-based magnetometer facility located in Davao City, Philippines, operated by the CPMN magnetometer network.
f86351d4-b787-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at CPMN Davao Observatory, Philippines

f86a9e52-b6ac-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Closed-Source Neutral Mass Spectrometer on AE-C** was an instrument aboard the Atmosphere Explorer-C satellite designed to measure the spatial distribution and temporal changes of neutral atmospheric species, utilizing a gold-plated stainless steel thermalizing chamber and quadrupole analyzer for precise mass selection.
