feb675dc-bafe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: COMICS (Cooled Mid-Infrared Camera and Spectrometer) is a mid-infrared astronomical instrument mounted on the Subaru 8.2 m telescope in Hawai'i, designed to study interstellar dust, galaxies, and other celestial objects within the wavelength range of 7.5 - 25 µm.
feb675dc-bafe-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Mid-Infrared Cooled Mid-Infrared Camera and Spectrometer on Subaru 8.2m Telescope at National Astronomical Observatory of Japan

fed8c46c-bb25-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Karasuyama Observatory (also known as the Karasuyama observatory or Value@Karasuyama) is an astronomical observatory located in Nasukarasuyama, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan. It is situated on Earth and has been assigned the Minor Planet Center (MPC) ID 889.
fed8c46c-bb25-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Karasuyama Observatory, Japan

fed8ed5e-bb8c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Solar Flux Radiometer (LSFR) on the Pioneer Venus Large Probe was designed to measure solar energy deposition in Venus' atmosphere by detecting scattered solar light across a specific spectral range, helping understand atmospheric radiation balance and greenhouse effects.
fed8ed5e-bb8c-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Large Probe Solar Flux Radiometer part of Pioneer Venus

ff0010bc-b8c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The EMN magnetometer network in Victoria, Canada is a ground-based facility located at the Herzberg Astronomy and Astrophysics Research Centre that measures magnetic field variations on Earth's surface.
ff0010bc-b8c3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Victoria Observatory, Canada

ff066e0e-bb8d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Penang Geomagnetic Observatory (PNN), located in Malaysia, was a ground facility dedicated to geomagnetic measurements from 1976 to 1979. It was part of the IUGONET network and sponsored by Malaysia.
ff066e0e-bb8d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Penang Geomagnetic Observatory, Malaysia

ff11ef5e-b61a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** The Cluster Ion Spectrometry (CIS) instrument on the Cluster 2/FM5 spacecraft is a mass spectrometer designed to measure full 3D ion distributions with high time and mass-per-charge resolution. It consists of two main components: the Hot Ion Analyzer (HIA) and the Composition and Distribution Function analyzer (CODIF), each providing detailed data on ion energy, charge, and angular distribution.
ff11ef5e-b61a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Cluster Ion Spectrometer on Cluster 2/FM5 (Rumba) part of ESA Cluster

ff2cce68-b7ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Yunquera Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in Calle Mezquita, Yunquera, Sierra de las Nieves, Malaga, Andalusia, Spain. It serves as a ground-based facility for astronomical observations and research.
ff2cce68-b7ba-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Yunquera Observatory, Spain

ff2df79c-b991-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Jiama'erdeng Tianwentai Observatory** is an astronomical observatory located in Ngari Prefecture, Tibet, China. It is situated along the National Highway 219 and operates as a ground-based observational facility.
ff2df79c-b991-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ali Observatory, China

ff51bf60-ba1d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Atmosphere Structure Experiment for Pioneer Venus Small Probe (North) was an instrument package on the Pioneer Venus mission, featuring sensors to measure pressure, temperature, and wind velocities, aimed at profiling Venus's atmospheric conditions from the surface up to 140 km altitude.
ff51bf60-ba1d-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Atmosphere Structure Experiment part of Pioneer Venus Small Probe North

ff53ab8c-b6e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Energetic Electron and Proton Detector** on Helios-A (code: spase://SMWG/Instrument/Helios1/E8) is a magnetic spectrometer designed to study the origin and distribution of low-energy electrons and protons, featuring six semiconductor detectors that measure electrons from 17 to 835 keV and protons from 21 to 677 keV.
ff53ab8c-b6e3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Energetic Electron and Proton Detector on Helios-A

ff7a0290-b7f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Dynamics Explorer 1 (DE-1)** is a NASA high-altitude satellite launched on August 3, 1981, as part of the Dynamics Explorer mission to investigate interactions between plasmas in Earth's magnetosphere and ionosphere. The spacecraft operated until February 28, 1991.
ff7a0290-b7f2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dynamics Explorer part of Dynamics Explorer mission

ff8b00a2-b69b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Compact Spherical Coil (CSC) Fluxgate Vector Magnetometer was an instrument on the Oersted spacecraft designed to measure magnetic fields. It operated from March 15, 1999, until November 22, 2007.
ff8b00a2-b69b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Compact Spherical Coil Fluxgate Vector Magnetometer on Oersted spacecraft

ff903526-b93f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Europa Clipper Magnetometer (ECM) is an instrument on the Europa Clipper spacecraft designed to confirm the existence of Europa's ocean, measure its depth and salinity, and study the moon's ice shell thickness and ionized atmosphere.
ff903526-b93f-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer on Europa Clipper

ff92648a-b5d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Chinese Academy of Sciences Meter-wave Aperture Synthesis Radio Telescope (MSRT) is located at the Beijing Astronomical Observatory (BAO) in Miyun, Asia. It operates in the radio waveband and is part of the astronomical facilities managed by the Chinese Academy of Sciences.
ff92648a-b5d0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Meter-wave aperture Synthesis Radio Telescope at Beijing Astronomical Observatory

ff93ae32-b5fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Defense Meteorological Satellite Program (DMSP) F17 is a space facility in the Block 5D-3 series of satellites, primarily tasked with cloud imagery and microwave imaging/temperature/humidity sounding, contributing significantly to space weather monitoring from its sun-synchronous near-polar orbit at an altitude of 830km.
ff93ae32-b5fb-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Space Weather Instrument Suite on Defense Meteorological Satellite Program, DMSP-F17

ff942064-b7d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Definition:** Vega 2 was a Soviet space probe launched in December 1984 as part of the Vega program. It conducted a Venus flyby and deployed a lander and balloon before performing a Comet Halley flyby, contributing to international cometary research.
ff942064-b7d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Dust Particle Detector on Vega 2

ff9a34ca-b810-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Pioneer 8 is a NASA space probe launched on December 13, 1967 to study interplanetary phenomena such as magnetic fields, plasma, and cosmic rays. It was part of a series of solar-orbiting satellites designed to collect data from widely separated points in space.
ff9a34ca-b810-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 0.94m Pioneer 8 part of Pioneer 6, 7, 8 and 9

ff9d604c-b9e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **SN1572 Tycho Observatory** is a ground-based astronomical facility located in La Spezia, Italy. It serves as an observational center for studying celestial phenomena and conducting research in astronomy.
ff9d604c-b9e0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Tycho Observatory, Italy

ff9e5ec8-b938-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer at Tuntungan (TUN) is an instrument used to measure the Earth's magnetic field as part of the IAGA investigation since 1982.
ff9e5ec8-b938-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Tuntungan Observatory

ffa3bc14-b19b-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Rondchamp Observatory** in Reconvilier, Switzerland is a ground-based observatory primarily known for its astronomical observations and is informed by the IAU-MPC list.
ffa3bc14-b19b-11f1-8a57-405b7f7031a0.label: Rondchamp Observatory, Switzerland

ffa8da20-b842-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: **Fort Rae Geomagnetic Observatory (FRA):** A ground-based facility in the North Slave Region of Canada that operated from 1932 to 1933, focused on geomagnetic measurements as part of a global observatory network.
ffa8da20-b842-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Fort Rae Geomagnetic Observatory, Canada

ffafba8c-b6d2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gibilmanna Geomagnetic Observatory (GIB), located in Cefalù, Palermo, Sicily, Italy, is a ground-based facility that operated from 1954 to 1957, conducting geomagnetic measurements at an altitude of 990 meters.
ffafba8c-b6d2-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Gibilmanna Geomagnetic Observatory, Italy

ffb7cf74-bb0a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Sodankylä Geophysical Observatory is a magnetic observatory located in Northern Lapland, Finland, that has been operational since 1996 and is part of the INTERMAGNET network.
ffb7cf74-bb0a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Sodankylä Geophysical Observatory, Finland

ffb84596-bbad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Gemini Observatory is an astronomical observatory comprising twin 8.1-meter optical/infrared telescopes located in Hawaii and Chile, providing comprehensive coverage of the northern and southern skies.
ffb84596-bbad-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 8.1m Telescope at Gemini Observatory

ffbce546-b6bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MAVEN Imaging Ultraviolet Spectrograph (IUVS) is an instrument on the MAVEN spacecraft designed to profile Mars' upper atmosphere and ionosphere by creating three-dimensional maps of neutral and ionized species from altitudes of 100 km to 225 km. It operates in various modes, including limb scanning and disk mapping, using far ultraviolet (FUV) and middle ultraviolet (MUV) detectors.
ffbce546-b6bd-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Imaging Ultraviolet Spectrograph on MAVEN spacecraft

ffc662d8-b721-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition:**
The South Pole Search Coil Instrument is a scientific apparatus located at the South Pole ground station, designed to measure magnetic field variations using search coils.
ffc662d8-b721-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Search Coil part of ICESTAR investigation on Antarctica

ffca5e08-b8d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Ultraviolet and Visible Light Spectrometer (UVS) on the LADEE mission was designed to characterize the lunar atmosphere by measuring gases and dust at wavelengths ranging from 230 to 810 nm. It is a symmetric f/4 crossed Czerny-Turner spectrometer that captures spectral data using a CCD detector array, providing insights into the concentrations and distributions of atmospheric species like Na and K.
ffca5e08-b8d7-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Ultraviolet and Visible Light Spectrometer on LADEE

ffda65b0-bae3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Barão Geraldo Observatory is an astronomical facility located in Barão Geraldo, Campinas, Brazil. It serves as a ground-based observatory for astronomical research and observations.
ffda65b0-bae3-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Barao Geraldo Observatory, Brazil

ffda7112-b800-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The **Electric field Double Probe (EDP)** is an instrument on the MMS1 spacecraft in the Magnetospheric Multiscale mission. It measures 3-D electric fields using Spin-plane and Axial Double Probes with high accuracy and frequency range.
ffda7112-b800-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Electric Field Double Probe on Magnetospheric Multiscale mission

ffdd944e-b9b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition:
**Definition**:
Castello Tesino Geomagnetic Observatory (CAT), located in Italy, is a ground-based facility that has been operating since 1965 to monitor geomagnetic activity.
ffdd944e-b9b5-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Castello Tesino Observatory, Italy

ffe8428e-b656-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Nanchuan Observatory is an astronomical observatory located in the Tianhe District of Guangzhou City, China. It serves as a ground-based facility for conducting astronomical research and observations.
ffe8428e-b656-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Guangzhou Observatory, China

ffec2aaa-b62b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The San Jose Las Lajas Observatory was a ground-based facility in Caimito, Artemisa, Cuba, operational from 1964 to 1976, primarily used for geomagnetic measurements.
ffec2aaa-b62b-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at San Jose Las Lajas Observatory, Cuba

fff1e902-b9c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The C-Tape Planetary Spectrophotometer Facility Analytical Spectral Devices LabSpec 4 is a high-precision portable spectrometer located in Manitoba, Canada, used for field spectroscopic measurements across visible, near-infrared (NIR), and shortwave infrared (SWIR) regions.
fff1e902-b9c0-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Analytical Spectral Devices LabSpec 4 at C-Tape Planetary Spectrophotometer Facility, Canada

fff32c02-bada-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: Fregenal de la Sierra is a municipality in the province of Badajoz, Extremadura, Spain. It hosts the ApolloIV5 ground observatory, located at Camino de los Molinos.
fff32c02-bada-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: 4.0m Telescope at ApolloIV5 Observatory, Spain

fff6a830-b69a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: A magnetometer located at the Fort Smith station with IAGA identifier FSM, operational since January 1973.
fff6a830-b69a-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer at Fort Smith

fffa1378-b7ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The Centro Astronômico Nevoeiro is a ground-based observatory located in Antônio Olinto, Paraná, Brazil. It is situated at coordinates -25.9086 latitude and 309.92475 longitude within the South Region of Brazil.
fffa1378-b7ab-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Nevoeiro Telescope at Centro Astronomico Nevoeiro, Brazil

fffe5d12-b8a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.definition: The MIF-M instrument on the Interball Tail Probe is a magnetometer used for multicomponent investigations of magnetic field fluctuations, featuring triaxial fluxgate sensors and a search-coil to measure both DC and AC magnetic fields.
fffe5d12-b8a9-11f1-985a-405b7f7031a0.label: Magnetometer part of Multicomponent Investigations of Fluctuations of Magnetic Fields
